articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian
paras.zh: 卓越的非公路制动和摩擦性能均来自意大利

paras.en: SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: SK Wellman 是一家专门生产非公路用制动和摩擦部件的公司，拥有活跃的基因。工厂仍位于 Orzinuovi (Bs) 的历史现实中，多年来，它经历了转型和变化，从而使其成为今天的样子：一家不断发展的公司，能够不断发展对意大利当地领土的忠诚度，并在全球范围内以创造力和灵活性创新其行业。如今，作为 CentroMotion 集团及其 Carlisle 制动与摩擦部门的一部分，SK Wellman 已成为该领域的领导者，受到土方、农业和建筑机械领域主要品牌的认可和选择。摩擦工程全球总监工程师 Alessandro Gamba 向我们介绍了持续增长的情况。

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: “S.K. Wellman S.R.L. 拥有 340 名员工，到 2023 年营业额将达到 1.27 亿美元，”Gamba 开始说道。在过去的五年里，强大的推动力来自于市场，但最重要的是来自 SK 的特点，如创造力、创新性、灵活性，归根结底，这些都是这家公司最大财富的结果：“人”。正是他们使这家位于布雷西亚的公司成为一家真正的、顽强的公司，以至于不仅能够成功出口他们的产品，而且能够将他们的技能和设计技能出口到卡莱尔制动和摩擦部门的其他工厂。刚刚结束的 2023 年，仅销售收入就实现了积极的表现，与上一个出色的 2022 财年相比，略有下降 -5%；对于布雷西亚和非布雷西亚经济的许多现实来说，后者可能是不可重复的一年。事实上，2023 年无疑是变革的一年，帮助人们培养了更强的能力来管理不确定性，以更强的韧性接受和处理意外情况。

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: 工程师解释说：“成功的基础是通过集团治理形成的矩阵组织：所有职能和技能的垂直驱动，能够在全球范围内定义和指导流程并产生最佳实践。而这还不是全部，”Gamba 补充道，“我们是人员流动率最低的公司之一，这使我们能够将长期与我们在一起的人的经验传授给我们特别关注的年轻人。除此之外，公司人口还来自 15 个不同的国家，他们的强有力的合作创造了真正宁静的工作氛围，”人力资源经理说道。成长的方向尤其是社会责任并非巧合。

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.
paras.zh: 他指出，“SK Wellman 和 Carlisle 的主要项目中，最突出的是 Enactus，这是一家国际非营利组织，通过其活动，让大学生参与创建可持续创业项目，帮助缩小大学和企业之间的差距；然后是 Treedom，该公司承诺在三年内种植 1,600 棵树，并让利益相关者参与到该项目中”。金属加工行业还有两颗稀有宝石吗？工作事故率接近于零，人才发展处于中心地位。迈向卓越并超越。

paras.en: Source: Il Corriere della Sera – edizione Lombardia
paras.zh: 资料来源：《晚邮报》——伦巴第版

articles.title: A Holiday Season of Giving

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.
paras.zh: 这个假期，Carlisle Brake & Friction 的麦地那办事处很荣幸能够为我们同事的 15 名孩子提供支持，他们需要一点额外的欢乐。我们的员工慷慨捐赠玩具、衣服和其他必需品，为这些年轻的生命带来欢乐。

paras.en: By coming together as a team, we’re demonstrating our commitment to making a positive impact on our community. We’re grateful for the kindness and generosity of our employees, and we hope this initiative will bring warmth and happiness to the children who receive these gifts.
paras.zh: 通过作为一个团队聚集在一起，我们展示了我们对为社区产生积极影响的承诺。我们感谢员工的善意和慷慨，希望这一举措能为收到这些礼物的孩子们带来温暖和快乐。

paras.en: Want to join us in spreading holiday cheer? Consider donating to Toys for Tots. This incredible organization ensures that every child experiences the joy of Christmas. Visit their website to find a drop-off location near you.
paras.zh: 想和我们一起传播节日的欢乐吗？考虑向 Toys for Tots 捐款。这个令人难以置信的组织确保每个孩子都能体验到圣诞节的欢乐。访问他们的网站查找您附近的下车地点。

articles.title: NABC Donates Recycled Rides to Two Chicago Veterans
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: On Thursday, Oct. 8, two refurbished vehicles were presented to two Chicago-area U.S. Army veterans in need. The donations were made possible by the National Auto Body Council (NABC) Recycled Rides program, vehicle donor Allstate and repair partner Gerber Collision & Glass and were sponsored by the Growth Conference 2026, a three-day event at the David Rubenstein Forum at the University of Chicago.
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日星期四，两辆翻新车辆被赠送给芝加哥地区两名有需要的美国陆军退伍军人。这些捐赠是由国家汽车车身委员会 (NABC) 回收乘车计划、车辆捐赠者 Allstate 和维修合作伙伴 Gerber Collision & Glass 提供的，并由 2026 年增长会议（在芝加哥大学大卫鲁宾斯坦论坛举行的为期三天的活动）赞助。

paras.en: A 2019 Ram 1500 was presented to Michael Powell, who was nominated by Chicago Veterans. Powell is a 15-year U.S. Army combat veteran who has dedicated his life after military service to uplifting fellow veterans, young men, children and families throughout his community. He actively serves as a veteran peer leader, life coach, physical fitness coach, mentor and community volunteer, helping others develop confidence, discipline, leadership and healthier lifestyles. Through his work, Powell supports veterans transitioning to civilian life, promotes physical and mental wellness, and mentors young boys and men. Despite his commitment to serving others, limited access to reliable transportation created challenges in attending community programs, mentoring sessions and volunteer opportunities. This refurbished vehicle from the Recycled Rides program will allow Powell to expand his outreach, transport necessary equipment, and continue making a meaningful difference in the lives of veterans and underserved communities.
paras.zh: 一辆 2019 Ram 1500 被赠送给由芝加哥退伍军人提名的迈克尔·鲍威尔 (Michael Powell)。鲍威尔是一名拥有 15 年军龄的美国陆军退伍军人，退役后将自己的一生奉献给了整个社区的退伍军人同胞、年轻人、儿童和家庭。他积极担任资深同伴领袖、生活教练、体能教练、导师和社区志愿者，帮助他人培养自信、纪律、领导力和更健康的生活方式。鲍威尔通过他的工作支持退伍军人过渡到平民生活，促进身心健康，并指导年轻男孩和男人。尽管他致力于为他人服务，但可靠的交通有限，给参加社区项目、辅导课程和志愿者机会带来了挑战。这辆来自回收乘车计划的翻新车辆将使鲍威尔能够扩大他的服务范围，运输必要的设备，并继续为退伍军人和服务不足的社区的生活带来有意义的改变。

paras.en: A 2021 Kia K5 was presented to Michelle Scott-Bovell, who was nominated by the Edward Hines, Jr. VA Hospital. Scott-Bovell served in the U.S. Army from 2014-2016. She and her husband are both veterans. Unfortunately, she recently fell on hard times due to her husband suffering a stroke and having their income slashed because he is no longer able to work. They were working on rebuilding their lives, but rideshares and public transportation were extremely expensive. Scott-Bovell needed reliable transportation to take her husband to crucial medical appointments. This refurbished vehicle through the Recycled Rides program will guarantee she’ll be able to get him the critical care he needs.
paras.zh: 一辆 2021 款起亚 K5 被赠送给了 Michelle Scott-Bovell，她是由 Edward Hines, Jr. VA 医院提名的。斯科特-博维尔于 2014 年至 2016 年在美国陆军服役。她和她的丈夫都是退伍军人。不幸的是，她最近陷入了困境，因为她的丈夫中风，并且由于他无法工作而收入减少。他们正在努力重建生活，但拼车和公共交通非常昂贵。斯科特-博维尔需要可靠的交通来带她的丈夫去参加重要的医疗预约。这辆通过回收乘车计划翻新的车辆将保证她能够为他提供所需的重症护理。

paras.en: Those in the community can support this program in two ways — donate to the program directly or donate their unwanted or non-running vehicle through the Changing and Saving Lives Keys for Change program. They will receive a tax donation for their contribution, and proceeds will help provide reliable transportation for those in need across the country — and in their community.
paras.zh: 社区中的人们可以通过两种方式支持该计划——直接向该计划捐款，或者通过“改变和拯救生命钥匙促进改变”计划捐赠他们不需要或未运行的车辆。他们的贡献将获得税收捐赠，收益将有助于为全国各地及其社区有需要的人提供可靠的交通。

paras.en: Additional partners in this presentation included Mobile Auto Solutions, Zeigler Auto Group, Hi-Tech PDR, Advanced Remarketing Services, Cars for Charity, Copart and Enterprise.
paras.zh: 本次演讲中的其他合作伙伴包括 Mobile Auto Solutions、Zeigler Auto Group、Hi-Tech PDR、Advanced Remarketing Services、Cars for Charity、Copart 和 Enterprise。

paras.en: Allstate, a level one partner of the NABC, has donated nearly 400 vehicles to people and organizations through the Recycled Rides program, making it one of the largest vehicle donor partners of Recycled Rides.
paras.zh: Allstate 是 NABC 的一级合作伙伴，已通过 Recycled Rides 计划向个人和组织捐赠了近 400 辆车辆，使其成为 Recycled Rides 最大的车辆捐赠合作伙伴之一。

paras.en: Gerber Collision & Glass, a level one member of the NABC, was founded in 1937 as a single glass and trim shop and has grown to be one of the largest auto collision and glass repair companies in North America.
paras.zh: Gerber Collision & Glass 是 NABC 的一级会员，成立于 1937 年，最初是一家单一的玻璃和装饰店，现已发展成为北美最大的汽车碰撞和玻璃维修公司之一。

paras.en: For more information on Recycled Rides, click here.
paras.zh: 有关回收游乐设施的更多信息，请单击此处。

articles.title: SCRS Welcomes Return of AkzoNobel as RDE Supporter for 2026 SEMA Show
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) is welcoming AkzoNobel Coatings back as a supporter and contributor to the Repairer Driven Education (RDE) experience at the 2026 SEMA Show Nov. 3-6 in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS) 欢迎阿克苏诺贝尔涂料作为修复者驱动教育 (RDE) 体验的支持者和贡献者回归，参加 11 月 3 日至 6 日在拉斯维加斯举行的 2026 年 SEMA 展会。

paras.en: AkzoNobel will sponsor the RDE classroom sessions, IDEAS Collide Showcase and the OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit.
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔将赞助 RDE 课堂课程、IDEAS 碰撞展示和 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会。

paras.en: “Repairers are being asked to do more with less leverage, and improving that position starts with what happens inside the shop every day,” said Nada Jokic, business consulting service manager for AkzoNobel. “The programs SCRS delivers through RDE give repairers practical, actionable tools they can put to work right away. We’re proud to stand alongside SCRS in supporting education that helps businesses operate with more confidence and clarity.”
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔业务咨询服务经理纳达·约基奇 (Nada Jokic) 表示：“维修人员被要求以更少的杠杆做更多的事情，而改善这一状况要从车间内每天发生的事情开始。” “SCRS 通过 RDE 提供的计划为维修人员提供了实用、可操作的工具，他们可以立即投入工作。我们很自豪能够与 SCRS 一起支持教育，帮助企业更加自信和清晰地运营。”

paras.en: RDE Session: The 3 Daily Mistakes Repair Shops Make That Empower Insurers
paras.zh: RDE 会议：维修店日常犯的 3 个错误，为保险公司提供帮助

paras.en: Among the sessions in the RDE lineup, AkzoNobel’s Tim Ronak, senior services consultant, will join Sean Preston, managing attorney at Coverall Law, to present, “The 3 Daily Mistakes Repair Shops Make That Empower Insurers,” on Wednesday, Nov. 4 from 9:30-11 a.m.
paras.zh: 在 RDE 阵容的会议中，阿克苏诺贝尔的高级服务顾问 Tim Ronak 将与 Coverall Law 的执行律师 Sean Preston 一起于 11 月 4 日星期三上午 9:30 至 11 点发表题为“维修店的 3 个日常错误赋予保险公司权力”的演讲。

paras.en: The session examines how routine shop practices can give insurers leverage in negotiations and disputes. The discussion shifts the lens inward, helping repairers recognize how operational choices can influence payment outcomes, documentation strength and negotiating position.
paras.zh: 本次会议探讨了保险公司的常规做法如何在谈判和纠纷中发挥作用。讨论将视角转向内部，帮助维修商认识到操作选择如何影响付款结果、文件强度和谈判立场。

paras.en: Built around three categories — protection, payment and process — the presentation introduces 30 steps shops can implement to strengthen their position, reduce friction during claims handling and improve operational clarity. The session focuses on practical adjustments supported by real-world scenarios and encourages audience participation.
paras.zh: 该演示围绕三个类别（保护、支付和流程）介绍了商店可以实施的 30 个步骤，以巩固其地位、减少索赔处理过程中的摩擦并提高操作清晰度。会议重点关注现实场景支持的实际调整，并鼓励观众参与。

paras.en: Participants will leave with practical changes they can begin implementing the next business day.
paras.zh: 参与者将带着实际的改变离开，他们可以在下一个工作日开始实施。

paras.en: To register for this session, click here visit or learn more about the RDE lineup at scrs.com/rde.
paras.zh: 要注册参加本次会议，请单击此处访问 scrs.com/rde 或了解有关 RDE 系列的更多信息。

paras.en: AkzoNobel also supports the OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit on Thursday, Nov. 5, a three-session program that follows vehicle safety from national objectives, through vehicle engineering and into the repair process:
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔还支持 11 月 5 日星期四举行的 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会，该峰会分为三个会议，从国家目标到车辆工程，再到维修过程，跟踪车辆安全：

paras.en: - “The National Safety Objective: Safer Vehicles, Safer Roads” with NHTSA Deputy Administrator Lee White
paras.zh: - 与 NHTSA 副局长 Lee White 共同探讨“国家安全目标：更安全的车辆、更安全的道路”

paras.en: - “Engineering the Safety Benefit: From Requirement to Real-World Performance” with engineers from General Motors, Rivian and Ford
paras.zh: - 与通用汽车、Rivian 和福特的工程师一起“设计安全效益：从要求到实际性能”

paras.en: - “Preserving the Safety System: Sensors, Calibration and Repairability”
paras.zh: - “保护安全系统：传感器、校准和可修复性”

paras.en: Register for all three OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit Sessions here.
paras.zh: 请在此处注册参加所有三场 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会。

paras.en: Attendees can register for the RDE Full Series Pass, which includes Tuesday and Wednesday RDE sessions, the IDEAS Collide Showcase, all three Thursday OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit sessions, and the SCRS Afterparty.
paras.zh: 与会者可以注册 RDE 全系列通行证，其中包括周二和周三的 RDE 会议、IDEAS 碰撞展示会、所有三场周四 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会会议以及 SCRS 余兴派对。

paras.en: Find AkzoNobel at the SEMA Show in the Upper South Hall booth no. 35144 in the Collision Repair & Refinish section.
paras.zh: 在 SEMA 展会上南大厅 3 号展位可找到阿克苏诺贝尔。碰撞修复和修补部分中的 35144。

paras.en: RDE is made possible through the support of partners, including 3M Automotive Aftermarket; AirPro Diagnostics; AkzoNobel; Axalta; Blue Vista Data; CAR-O-LINER; CCC; Enterprisev Hunter Engineering; I-CAR; KECO; KPA; Milwaukee; Reliable Automotive Equipment; Revv; Southern California Collision Equipment; Spanesi; Toyota Certified Collision; and SEMA.
paras.zh: RDE 的实现得益于合作伙伴的支持，包括 3M 汽车售后市场； AirPro 诊断；阿克苏诺贝尔；艾仕得；蓝色远景数据； CAR-O-LINER； CCC；亨特工程企业； I-CAR；凯科；韩国PA；密尔沃基；可靠的汽车设备；修订版；南加州碰撞设备；斯帕内西；丰田碰撞认证；和SEMA。

paras.en: For more information about SCRS or to join as a member, visit scrs.com, call (877) 841-0660 or e-mail [email protected]@scrs.com.
paras.zh: 有关 SCRS 的更多信息或加入成为会员，请访问 scrs.com、致电 (877) 841-0660 或发送电子邮件至 [email protected]@scrs.com。

paras.en: To register for RDE at the SEMA Show, visit scrs.com/rde.
paras.zh: 要在 SEMA 展会上注册 RDE，请访问 scrs.com/rde。

articles.title: GM plans ‘eyes-off’ driving for most popular selling SUVs, trucks
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: GM plans to extend “eyes-off” autonomous highway driving beyond its EV lineup to its gas-powered vehicles, including full-size SUVs and light-duty pickups, in upcoming years, according to a press release.
paras.zh: 据一份新闻稿称，通用汽车计划在未来几年将“闭眼”自动高速公路驾驶从其电动汽车产品线扩展到其汽油动力汽车，包括全尺寸 SUV 和轻型皮卡。

paras.en: “The promise of personal autonomy is giving people their time back,” the release states. “By pairing our centralized compute architecture with rigorous real-world validation, GM is moving from an initial limited debut to widespread availability across our most popular trucks and SUVs, making trusted autonomy available to everyday drivers.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“个人自治的承诺正在让人们重新获得时间。” “通过将我们的集中式计算架构与严格的现实世界验证相结合，通用汽车正在从最初的有限首次亮相转向在我们最受欢迎的卡车和 SUV 上广泛使用，为日常驾驶员提供值得信赖的自主权。”

paras.en: The automaker announced last year that it would launch “eyes-off” autonomous highway driving on its Cadillac ESCALADE IQ in 2028. It plans to expand the technology to its highest-volume and best-selling vehicle lineups following the Cadillac ESCALADE IQ.
paras.zh: 该汽车制造商去年宣布，将于 2028 年在凯迪拉克 ESCALADE IQ 上推出“闭眼”自动高速公路驾驶。该公司计划将该技术扩展到继凯迪拉克 ESCALADE IQ 之后销量最高、最畅销的车型系列中。

paras.en: “Our vision is to build vehicles that can drive themselves or their occupants anywhere they need to be,” the release states. “This includes a future where your vehicle can handle mundane tasks for you, like heading out into bumper-to-bumper traffic to pick up groceries or dry cleaning, giving you valuable time back.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“我们的愿景是制造能够自动驾驶或乘员前往任何需要去的地方的车辆。” “这包括未来您的车辆可以为您处理日常任务，例如前往拥挤的交通中去取杂货或干洗，从而为您节省宝贵的时间。”

paras.en: Reuters reports that, currently, GM’s Super Cruise and Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (Supervised) control steering and speed in certain settings. It adds the systems can sometimes be hands-free but require the driver to remain attentive.
paras.zh: 路透社报道称，目前，通用汽车的超级巡航和特斯拉的全自动驾驶（监督）在某些设置下控制转向和速度。它补充说，系统有时可以免提，但要求驾驶员保持注意力集中。

paras.en: Only a few automakers have introduced eyes-off systems, including Mercedes-Benz. However, service typically is limited to small geographic areas at low speeds, according to the article.
paras.zh: 只有少数汽车制造商引入了视线转移系统，包括梅赛德斯-奔驰。然而，据文章称，服务通常仅限于低速的小地理区域。

paras.en: GM points to its new central compute architecture that decouples software from physical hardware as one advancement that helps it push autonomy forward.
paras.zh: 通用汽车指出，其新的中央计算架构将软件与物理硬件分离，这是帮助其推动自动化发展的一项进步。

paras.en: “It’s designed to provide a common computing, network, software, and interface foundation across a broad portfolio while allowing each vehicle to retain the hardware and controls required for its specific purpose,” the release adds.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿补充道：“它的设计目的是在广泛的产品组合中提供通用的计算、网络、软件和接口基础，同时允许每辆车保留其特定用途所需的硬件和控制装置。”

paras.en: A liquid-cooled central compute unit (CCU) is another advancement.
paras.zh: 液冷中央计算单元 (CCU) 是另一项进步。

paras.en: GM says it has 40 times more compute capability, which can support AI and autonomy. It adds that the computing hub consolidates autonomy, active safety, chassis, and propulsion software onto a single, high-speed core.
paras.zh: 通用汽车表示，其计算能力提高了 40 倍，可以支持人工智能和自动化。它还补充说，计算中心将自主、主动安全、底盘和推进软件整合到单个高速核心上。

paras.en: Regional zonal hubs also replace complex wiring harnesses by aggregating sensors and actuators into an “ultra-fast data backbone,” according to the release. The hubs are connected by high-speed ethernet, which supports 36 times more data than previous systems, it adds.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，区域区域中心还通过将传感器和执行器聚合成“超快速数据主干”来取代复杂的线束。它补充说，这些集线器通过高速以太网连接，支持的数据量是以前系统的 36 倍。

paras.en: The technology can also be innovated continuously, the release states. It adds that improvements validated on one model can be deployed across the portfolio via frequent over-the-air updates.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，该技术还可以不断创新。它补充说，在一种模型上验证的改进可以通过频繁的无线更新部署到整个产品组合中。

paras.en: “By integrating the full autonomous driving stack — from newly developed ultra-high-resolution, ultra-low-cost radar to frontier machine learning architectures — our autonomy platform can scale efficiently across popular retail lineups,” the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“通过集成完整的自动驾驶堆栈——从新开发的超高分辨率、超低成本雷达到前沿机器学习架构——我们的自动驾驶平台可以在流行的零售产品线中高效扩展。”

paras.en: GM says it is using data collected from 1.2 billion hands-free miles driven by Super Cruise customers. The company’s engineering teams are combining real-world data collection with frontier AI and machine learning tools, the release states.
paras.zh: 通用汽车表示，它正在使用从 Super Cruise 客户驾驶的 12 亿英里免提里程中收集的数据。新闻稿称，该公司的工程团队正在将现实世界的数据收集与前沿人工智能和机器学习工具结合起来。

paras.en: “We’ve built a continuously compounding flywheel, including data from retail vehicles where customers have opted in, to operating hundreds of data collection vehicles collecting 1 million miles per month of full-rate, multi-sensor data across diverse weather, traffic patterns, and edge cases,” the release states. “This scale helps us learn from what drivers do well and anticipate where challenges can arise.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“我们构建了一个持续复合的飞轮，包括来自客户选择的零售车辆的数据，以及运营数百辆数据收集车辆，每月收集 100 万英里的全速率、跨不同天气、交通模式和边缘情况的多传感器数据。” “这种规模有助于我们了解驾驶员的表现并预测可能出现的挑战。”

paras.en: Reinforcement learning builds on real-world data by allowing the system to generate new experiences and learn from those.
paras.zh: 强化学习建立在现实世界数据的基础上，允许系统生成新的经验并从中学习。

paras.en: For example, different versions of merging onto a busy highway can be simulated. The release adds that the software can control the merging vehicle and surrounding traffic, learning through repeated interactions when to yield, adjust speed, or enter a gap.
paras.zh: 例如，可以模拟不同版本的并入繁忙高速公路的情况。该新闻稿还补充说，该软件可以控制并道车辆和周围的交通，通过反复交互来学习何时让路、调整速度或进入间隙。

paras.en: In closed loop, multi-agent training, the vehicles and simulators continually challenge one another.
paras.zh: 在闭环多智能体训练中，车辆和模拟器不断相互挑战。

paras.en: “As the driving policy improves, scenarios become more demanding — creating an adaptive curriculum that builds resilience to the variation of real-world roads,” according to the release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“随着驾驶政策的改进，场景变得更加苛刻——创建适应性课程，增强对现实世界道路变化的适应能力。”

paras.en: GM’s stack drives more than 3 billion virtual miles daily, the release states. It adds that the virtual vehicle travel about 1,200 miles per day. It would take about 2.5 million vehicles to match the virtual daily output, it states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，通用汽车的堆栈每天行驶虚拟里程超过 30 亿英里。它还补充说，虚拟车辆每天行驶约 1,200 英里。据称，大约需要 250 万辆汽车才能满足虚拟日产量的要求。

paras.en: “Our vision, Concept Horizon, showcases a future where autonomous highway driving transforms the cabin into a space to relax, work, and unwind,” the release states. “Built around human needs and informed by our research into how passengers use longer autonomous journeys, Concept Horizon is designed to understand context, respond at the right moment, and create greater calm and confidence. Grounded in the trust GM drivers have placed in Super Cruise — more than 1.2 billion hands-free miles across nearly 750,000 vehicles — it points toward a future where every journey is more productive, restorative, and human.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“我们的愿景《概念地平线》展示了自动高速公路驾驶将驾驶室转变为放松、工作和放松的空间的未来。” “Concept Horizo​​n 围绕人类需求而构建，并以我们对乘客如何使用较长自动驾驶旅程的研究为基础，旨在了解环境、在正确的时刻做出反应，并营造更大的平静和信心。基于通用汽车驾驶员对 Super Cruise 的信任——近 750,000 辆车的免提行驶里程超过 12 亿英里——它指向一个未来，即每次旅程都更加高效、恢复活力和人性化。”

articles.title: Entegral and GEICO partner for automotive claims process
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Entegral and GEICO have entered into a partnership to “enhance the automotive claims experience through improved claim routing, repair coordination, and customer communication,” a press release states.
paras.zh: 一份新闻稿称，Entegral 和 GEICO 已建立合作伙伴关系，“通过改进索赔路线、维修协调和客户沟通来增强汽车索赔体验”。

paras.en: The claims technology platform is a subsidiary of Enterprise Mobility that streamlines the automotive claims process for all stakeholders, according to the release. The technology will support GEICO with additional tasks such as clearer appointment communication and “more informed repairer-provider selection, creating a simpler and more transparent experience for policyholders and repair partners.”
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，该索赔技术平台是 Enterprise Mobility 的子公司，旨在为所有利益相关者简化汽车索赔流程。该技术将为 GEICO 提供额外的支持，例如更清晰的预约沟通和“更明智的维修服务提供商选择，为保单持有人和维修合作伙伴创造更简单、更透明的体验。”

paras.en: “At GEICO, we’re focused on delivering a seamless, first-class experience for millions of customers, from their initial quote through claim resolution,” said Shane Wheeler, GEICO chief claims officer. “With a 97% customer satisfaction rating, we know the standard our customers expect. Working with Entegral helps us deliver a more connected and efficient claims process while making it easier for customers to navigate repairs.”
paras.zh: GEICO 首席索赔官 Shane Wheeler 表示：“在 GEICO，我们致力于为数百万客户提供无缝、一流的体验，从最初的报价到索赔解决。” “凭借 97% 的客户满意度，我们了解客户期望的标准。与 Entegral 合作帮助我们提供更加互联、高效的索赔流程，同时让客户更轻松地进行维修。”

paras.en: Joe Rector, Entegral vice president, says in the release that today’s claims environment requires solutions that help insurers, repairers, and customers navigate the process with greater clarity, speed, and confidence.
paras.zh: Entegral 副总裁 Joe Rector 在新闻稿中表示，当今的理赔环境需要解决方案来帮助保险公司、维修商和客户以更清晰、更快速和更自信的方式驾驭整个流程。

paras.en: “Our partnership with GEICO reflects a shared commitment to leveraging technology and insights to simplify the claims process, improve repair-network coordination and deliver better outcomes for policyholders,” Rector says.
paras.zh: Rector 表示：“我们与 GEICO 的合作体现了我们的共同承诺，即利用技术和见解来简化索赔流程、改善维修网络协调并为保单持有人提供更好的结果。”

paras.en: According to the release, the partnership aims to drive improvements across key claims touchpoints. The two companies will align data, workflows, repair-network capabilities, and mobility touchpoints to improve visibility, enhance coordination, and create a more consistent customer experience from claim reporting through vehicle repair.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，此次合作旨在推动关键索赔接触点的改进。两家公司将协调数据、工作流程、维修网络功能和移动接触点，以提高可视性、加强协调，并从索赔报告到车辆维修创造更一致的客户体验。

paras.en: Rector urged collision industry stakeholders to break down silos and better connect their systems during the IDEAS Collide Showcase at the SEMA Show last year.
paras.zh: 去年 SEMA 展会上的 IDEAS Collide Showcase 期间，Rector 敦促碰撞行业利益相关者打破孤岛，更好地连接他们的系统。

paras.en: The collision industry is made up of many partners, Rector said. There are OEMs, insurance providers, and tow, glass, and salvage companies.
paras.zh: Rector 表示，碰撞行业由许多合作伙伴组成。其中包括原始设备制造商、保险提供商以及拖车、玻璃和废品回收公司。

paras.en: “Collision repair facilities are very unique in the fact that you have your own value chain outside of just the partners across the industry,” Rector said.
paras.zh: “碰撞修复设施非常独特，因为除了整个行业的合作伙伴之外，您还拥有自己的价值链，”Rector 说。

paras.en: He gave other examples of ADAS sublets and paint, parts, and equipment providers.
paras.zh: 他还举了 ADAS 转租以及油漆、零件和设备供应商的其他例子。

paras.en: Customers are the middle of the ecosystem, he explained.
paras.zh: 他解释说，客户是生态系统的中间部分。

paras.en: “The customer doesn’t care about the entire value chain that surrounds them,” Rector said. “These are all back-end services. They may not know every company that level of customer service that they expect. What they are looking for is a timely repair and one that’s done safe and in proper manner.”
paras.zh: “客户并不关心他们周围的整个价值链，”雷克托说。 “这些都是后端服务。他们可能不知道每家公司的客户服务水平都达到他们期望的水平。他们寻求的是及时的维修，并且是以安全、正确的方式完成的。”

paras.en: This means one company is not more important than another, he said. This also means multiple shop operators, sole proprietors, and direct repair programs all look the same to the customers.
paras.zh: 他说，这意味着一家公司并不比另一家公司更重要。这也意味着多家商店经营者、独资经营者和直接维修计划对客户来说都是一样的。

paras.en: “But what is interesting about our customers is that they are not just in the middle of our industry; they’re actually an active participant helping connect and move information around,” he said.
paras.zh: “但我们的客户的有趣之处在于，他们不仅仅是我们行业的中间人；他们实际上是帮助连接和移动信息的积极参与者，”他说。

paras.en: When a customer has a claim, they have to contact the insurance company, select a repair facility, schedule a shop appointment, schedule transportation while their car is in for repair, and possibly arrange towing to the proper location, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，当客户提出索赔时，他们必须联系保险公司，选择维修机构，安排商店预约，安排汽车维修期间的运输，并可能安排拖车到正确的位置。

paras.en: “There’s a lot of information being exchanged before the car is even repaired with a number of parties in our ecosystem,” Rector said. “It all runs through the customer. It doesn’t run around the customer. The customer is interacting with each of these other businesses to get on their way.”
paras.zh: “在汽车维修之前，我们的生态系统中的多方就已经交换了大量信息，”Rector 说。 “这一切都是通过客户来运行的。它不会围绕客户运行。客户正在与其他每个企业进行互动，以继续他们的工作。”

paras.en: If something goes wrong, for example, the repair facility can’t complete the necessary repair, meaning numerous extra steps for the consumer has to take. For example, they have to schedule a new repair shop, a new tow, and inform the insurance company.
paras.zh: 例如，如果出现问题，维修机构无法完成必要的维修，这意味着消费者必须采取许多额外的步骤。例如，他们必须安排新的维修店、新的拖车，并通知保险公司。

paras.en: “I think we honestly can do better than that,” he said. “If you go just beyond the onset of the repair, look at what happens when the customer is within the repair,” Rector said. “They’re relying on an accurate estimate and completion date to pick the car back up and get on the road. But that information is equally valuable to the rest of the industry as well and getting it not just in the hands of the customer but also the rental car providers, to the insurance carriers to handle invoicing appropriately.”
paras.zh: “我认为我们确实可以做得更好，”他说。 “如果你刚超出维修开始时间，看看客户在维修期间会发生什么，”雷克托说。 “他们依靠准确的估计和完成日期来提车并上路。但这些信息对于行业的其他部分也同样有价值，不仅可以交到客户手中，还可以交到租车提供商手中，交到保险公司手中，以便适当处理发票。”

paras.en: If the information is inaccurate to one member, then the consumer has to make more phone calls, he said. He added that every member of the industry has to start calling each other.
paras.zh: 他说，如果一名会员的信息不准确，那么消费者就必须拨打更多电话。他补充说，该行业的每个成员都必须开始互相打电话。

paras.en: “It sounds a little chaotic,” he said. “It does not sound like harmony.”
paras.zh: “听起来有点混乱，”他说。 “听起来不太和谐。”

paras.en: He asked what would happen if all of the partners were connected.
paras.zh: 他询问如果所有合作伙伴都连接起来会发生什么。

paras.en: “Let’s say the body shop and their scheduling and their data on their drop-off and repair status is connected seamlessly to the rental car providers and to the insurance carriers,” Rector said. “When the customer makes selections throughout the process everyone is informed without the need to call each other.”
paras.zh: “假设车身修理厂及其日程安排以及还车和维修状态的数据与租车提供商和保险公司无缝连接，”雷克托说。 “当客户在整个过程中做出选择时，每个人都会收到通知，而无需互相打电话。”

articles.title: SCRS education at SEMA: Documenting repairs, bringing mechanical in-house, and more
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Repair planning tips, how to document OEM repair procedures and get paid for following them, and in-house mechanical work — those are just three of several topics covered during the Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) Repairer Driven Education (RDE) sessions at this year’s SEMA Show.
paras.zh: 维修规划技巧、如何记录 OEM 维修程序并通过遵循这些程序获得报酬，以及内部机械工作 — 这些只是今年 SEMA 展会上碰撞维修专家协会 (SCRS) 维修人员驱动教育 (RDE) 会议涵盖的几个主题中的三个。

paras.en: Justin Lewis, president of Accurate Auto Body in Washington, will lead “Reclaiming Technical Authority: Earning Consumer Authorization,” focused on the collision repair shop’s role in repair planning.
paras.zh: 华盛顿 Accurate Auto Body 总裁贾斯汀·刘易斯 (Justin Lewis) 将领导“夺回技术权威：赢得消费者授权”，重点关注碰撞维修店在维修计划中的作用。

paras.en: “The whole point of the presentation is essentially to establish the shop is building a repair plan that the customer is the person authorizing that, and the insurer’s role is indemnification,” Lewis said. “And too many times shops are relying on the insurer’s cost estimate to dictate repairs and giving up their technical authority. In turn, it’s causing them liability issues.”
paras.zh: 刘易斯说：“演示的重点是确定商店正在制定维修计划，客户是授权人，而保险公司的角色是赔偿。” “很多时候，商店依赖保险公司的成本估算来决定维修并放弃他们的技术权威。反过来，这又给他们带来了责任问题。”

paras.en: He added that the session will explain how shops can:
paras.zh: 他补充说，会议将解释商店如何：

paras.en: - Gain customer authorization to make repair decisions in their best interest;
paras.zh: - 获得客户授权，根据他们的最佳利益做出维修决定；

paras.en: - Support documentation with OEM repair procedures; and
paras.zh: - OEM 维修程序的支持文档；和

paras.en: - Separate those three items so that one doesn’t control the other.
paras.zh: - 将这三项分开，以便其中一项无法控制另一项。

paras.en: Lewis said he’ll cover what proper documentation looks like, when and how thoroughly to complete it, and how to get the customer’s buy-in.
paras.zh: 刘易斯表示，他将介绍什么是正确的文档、何时以及如何彻底完成文档，以及如何获得客户的认可。

paras.en: Backing up repair plans with documented OEM repair procedures and explaining that process builds a foundation of trust with customers, Lewis said.
paras.zh: Lewis 说，用记录的 OEM 维修程序来支持维修计划，并解释该流程可以为客户建立信任的基础。

paras.en: “Just because an insurer disagrees doesn’t necessarily mean that it’s not something that’s required or necessary to fix the car right, and then how to support your customer in that situation,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“仅仅因为保险公司不同意，并不一定意味着不需要或不需要正确修理汽车，以及在这种情况下如何为客户提供支持。”

paras.en: Lewis also plans to touch on the right to appraisal and minimum standards for insurer claims handling that took effect earlier this week in Washington. After six years of advocating by the Washington Independent Collision Repair Association (WICRA) for mandatory right to appraisal, Gov. Bob Ferguson signed it into law last year.
paras.zh: 刘易斯还计划讨论本周早些时候在华盛顿生效的评估权和保险公司索赔处理的最低标准。华盛顿独立碰撞修复协会 (WICRA) 六年来一直倡导强制评估权，州长鲍勃·弗格森 (Bob Ferguson) 去年将其签署为法律。

paras.en: While Lewis’s session name mentions the technical side of customer authorization, he said he plans to keep it simple.
paras.zh: 虽然刘易斯的会议名称提到了客户授权的技术方面，但他表示他计划保持简单。

paras.en: “My intention is to make people think, ‘Oh, I’m matching insurance sheets. I shouldn’t be doing that,'” he said. “One of my big things in there is this industry made a change. It went from what’s required to fix the car to what the insurance is willing to pay, and that’s not the right way to address repair requirements. That’s going to be the whole premise: getting the mindset changed from will they pay for it to what’s required and what’s my liability if I don’t do it. What does the OEM say I have to do versus what does the insurance want to indemnify? And then how do I get my customer to authorize what needs to be done, and how do I support that?”
paras.zh: “我的目​​的是让人们思考，‘哦，我正在匹配保险单。我不应该这样做，’”他说。 “我在这个行业所做的一件大事就是这个行业发生了变化。它从修车的要求变成了保险公司愿意支付的费用，这不是解决维修要求的正确方式。这将是整个前提：将心态从他们是否愿意付费转变为需要什么以及如果我不这样做我的责任是什么。OEM 要求我必须做什么，而保险公司想要赔偿什么？然后我如何让我的客户授权需要做什么，我如何支持？”

paras.en: Isaac Aronson’s “Repair Planning That Pays: Protecting Revenue Through Research” session will cover the inconsistencies of collision repair planning from the perspective of front-end research behaviors. Aronson, OEConnection’s product manager, will discuss how those behaviors translate into measurable financial outcomes.
paras.zh: Isaac Aronson 的“付费维修计划：通过研究保护收入”会议将从前端研究行为的角度探讨碰撞维修计划的不一致问题。 OEConnection 的产品经理 Aronson 将讨论这些行为如何转化为可衡量的财务成果。

paras.en: “Modern vehicles require extensive OEM research, conditional procedure evaluation, and calibration consideration before repairs even begin,” the session description states. “Yet inconsistent workflows create supplements, delays, and lost revenue opportunities for performed work.”
paras.zh: “现代车辆在维修开始之前需要进行广泛的 OEM 研究、条件程序评估和校准考虑，”会议描述指出。 “然而，不一致的工作流程会造成工作的补充、延误和收入机会的损失。”

paras.en: Based on patterns across thousands of repair plans, Aronson will identify where breakdowns most commonly occur and how early research decisions influence final profitability, such as including calibration evaluation into a structured workflow.
paras.zh: 根据数千个维修计划的模式，阿伦森将确定最常发生故障的位置以及早期研究决策如何影响最终盈利能力，例如将校准评估纳入结构化工作流程。

paras.en: A panel discussion centered on mechanical repairs will include Steve Dawson, Hunter Engineering regional manager; Todd Hesford, owner of Mission Viejo Auto Collision; Dan Stander, president of Fix Auto Highlands Ranch; Chris Dacus, owner of Dacus Auto Body and Collision Repair; and Gerry McNee, owner of Ultimate Collision Repair.
paras.zh: 以机械维修为中心的小组讨论将包括 Hunter Engineering 区域经理 Steve Dawson；托德·赫斯福德 (Todd Hesford)，Mission Viejo 汽车碰撞公司的所有者；丹·斯坦德 (Dan Stander)，Fix Auto Highlands Ranch 总裁； Chris Dacus，Dacus Auto Body and Collision Repair 所有者；和 Gerry McNee，Ultimate Collision Repair 的所有者。

paras.en: Titled “Bringing Mechanical Repairs In-house,” the session will candidly cover what transitioning to in-house availability entails, according to the session description.
paras.zh: 根据会议描述，该会议的标题为“将机械维修引入内部”，将坦诚地讨论向内部可用性过渡所需的内容。

paras.en: “More collision repair businesses are evaluating whether bringing mechanical work in-house can create new revenue opportunities, improve cycle time, and strengthen control over the repair process,” the description states. “But what does that transition really look like in practice?”
paras.zh: 描述称：“越来越多的碰撞修复企业正在评估将机械工作引入内部是否可以创造新的收入机会、缩短周期时间并加强对修复过程的控制。” “但这种转变在实践中到底是什么样的呢？”

paras.en: SCRS notes that the panelists are from high-performing shops, and they’ll share why they decided to expand into mechanical repairs, how they implemented the change, and what impact it has had on their operations and profitability.
paras.zh: SCRS 指出，小组成员来自高绩效商店，他们将分享为什么决定扩展到机械维修领域、他们如何实施变革，以及变革对他们的运营和盈利能力产生了哪些影响。

paras.en: The sessions above are only part of SCRS’s 2026 SEMA Show education opportunities. SCRS will hold its annual OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit, IDEAS Collide Showcase, and more. Learn more about RDE here.
paras.zh: 上述会议只是 SCRS 2026 年 SEMA 展会教育机会的一部分。 SCRS 将举办年度 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会、IDEAS 碰撞展示会等。在此处了解有关 RDE 的更多信息。

paras.en: An SCRS RDE Full Series Pass provides access to Tuesday and Wednesday RDE sessions, IDEAS Collide, the OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit, and the SCRS Afterparty. To register for the full series pass, click here. Individual sessions are $125 each.

articles.title: Magnaflow President Dan Paolone on the ‘Long-Term Play’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: In this episode of DriveTime, featuring Dan Paolone, president of Magnaflow, learn how Magnaflow’s family-owned heritage has shaped both its culture and its long-term approach to the market.
paras.zh: 在本期 DriveTime 节目中，由 Magnaflow 总裁 Dan Paolone 主持，了解 Magnaflow 的家族传统如何塑造其文化及其长期市场策略。

paras.en: Founded in 1981 by his uncle, Jerry Paolone, the company has operated around a “build it and stand by it” philosophy while emphasizing lasting relationships and accountability from design through manufacturing. While Magnaflow is widely associated with performance exhaust, Paolone emphasized that the company is fundamentally an emissions and exhaust business, with approximately 10,000 SKUs across catalytic converters and BRExhaust. That breadth, combined with its premium performance brands, gives Magnaflow a much broader aftermarket presence than its performance reputation alone might suggest, he explained.
paras.zh: 该公司由他的叔叔 Jerry Paolone 于 1981 年创立，围绕“打造并坚持”的理念运营，同时强调从设计到制造的持久关系和责任。虽然 Magnaflow 与高性能排气有着广泛的联系，但 Paolone 强调，该公司本质上是一家排放和排气业务，在催化转换器和 BRExhaust 方面拥有大约 10,000 个 SKU。他解释说，这种广度，加上其优质的性能品牌，使 Magnaflow 拥有比其性能声誉本身所暗示的更广泛的售后市场影响力。

paras.en: Vertical integration is another key part of Magnaflow’s strategy. Paolone said the company invests consistently in employees, infrastructure and capital to maintain greater control from research and development through manufacturing and distribution. That approach also extends to data, an area where Magnaflow has made significant investments. By controlling more of the process and supply chain, Paolone said the company gains flexibility while supporting its long-term strategy. That philosophy reflects Magnaflow’s broader approach to business: Rather than managing quarter to quarter, the company views each quarter as another step toward executing a plan measured in years and decades.
paras.zh: 垂直整合是 Magnaflow 战略的另一个关键部分。 Paolone 表示，公司持续投资于员工、基础设施和资本，以保持从研发到制造和分销的更大控制力。这种方法还延伸到了数据领域，Magnaflow 在这个领域进行了大量投资。 Paolone 表示，通过控制更多的流程和供应链，公司在支持其长期战略的同时获得了灵活性。这一理念反映了 Magnaflow 更广泛的业务方法：该公司不是按季度进行管理，而是将每个季度视为执行以年和几十年为单位的计划的又一步。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Paolone sees significant growth opportunities across Magnaflow’s existing emissions and exhaust business, BRExhaust and its expanding OE business. The company models vehicle trends through 2040 and expects hybrids, which still require catalytic converters and exhaust systems, to create additional opportunities. BRExhaust is also expanding by offering complete installation kits for repair shops that eliminate the need for welding, cutting or pipe bending, helping technicians complete more repairs in-house. On the OE side, Magnaflow sees an opportunity to serve lower-volume platforms, particularly vehicles in the 10,000- to 20,000-unit range, where its infrastructure and consumer-facing brand can make it an attractive partner.
paras.zh: 展望未来，Paolone 认为 Magnaflow 现有的排放和废气业务、BRExhaust 及其不断扩大的 OE 业务存在巨大的增长机会。该公司对 2040 年的汽车趋势进行了建模，预计仍需要催化转换器和排气系统的混合动力汽车将创造更多机会。 BRExhaust 还通过为维修店提供完整的安装套件来扩展业务，消除了焊接、切割或弯管的需要，帮助技术人员在内部完成更多维修。在OE方面，Magnaflow看到了为小批量平台提供服务的机会，特别是10,000至20,000辆范围内的车辆，其基础设施和面向消费者的品牌可以使其成为有吸引力的合作伙伴。

paras.en: To hear more of Paolone’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解 Paolone 的更多见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

paras.zh: • Magnaflow 的优势超出了性能排气，包括催化转化器和 BRExhaust。 （4:37）
