articles.title: In a Hoard of 5,500 Viking Age Coins, Archaeologists in Norway Found One So Rare That They Already Consider It a 'National Treasure'

paras.en: In April, metal detectorists stumbled upon a massive cache of 1,000-year-old silver coins in eastern Norway. At the time, archaeologists were impressed by the sheer size of the find, known as the Mørstad hoard, which totals thousands of coins and counting. They hailed it as the largest Viking Age coin stash ever found in Norway.
paras.zh: 4 月，金属探测器在挪威东部偶然发现了大量拥有 1000 年历史的银币。当时，考古学家对这一被称为莫斯塔德宝藏的巨大发现印象深刻，其中总共有数千枚硬币，而且还在不断增加。他们称赞这是挪威迄今为止发现的最大的维京时代硬币储藏室。

paras.en: Now, researchers are even more excited about the cache. While cataloging the hoard, they found an exceedingly rare silver coin minted during the reign of Olaf II Haraldsson, a Norwegian king who later became the patron saint of Norway.
paras.zh: 现在，研究人员对缓存更加兴奋。在对宝藏进行编目时，他们发现了一枚极其罕见的银币，该银币是在挪威国王奥拉夫二世·哈拉尔松（Olaf II Haraldsson）统治时期铸造的，他后来成为挪威的守护神。

paras.en: Anne Skogsfjord, an archaeologist with the University of Oslo’s Museum of Cultural History, was the one who discovered the coin. She didn’t realize its significance at first, until she took a closer look at the inscription: “ONLAF R+ NORMANORV,” which means “Olaf, King of the Norwegians,” according to a statement.
paras.zh: 奥斯陆大学文化历史博物馆的考古学家安妮·斯科格斯菲尤尔 (Anne Skogsfjord) 是发现这枚硬币的人。一份声明称，她一开始并没有意识到它的重要性，直到她仔细观察了铭文：“ONLAF R+ NORMANORV”，意思是“奥拉夫，挪威人的国王”。

paras.en: She was shocked, as only four coins of that type had ever been found before, just one of which was discovered in Norway, during the restoration of church ruins in 1924. Fewer than 20 coins minted under Olaf have ever been found, and most have been discovered outside of Norway.
paras.zh: 她很震惊，因为以前只发现了四枚这种类型的硬币，其中只有一枚是在挪威 1924 年修复教堂遗址时发现的。奥拉夫时期铸造的硬币不到 20 枚，而且大多数是在挪威境外发现的。

paras.en: “I realized that we had found a national treasure,” she says in the statement.
paras.zh: “我意识到我们发现了一件国宝，”她在声明中说。

paras.en: Jon Anders Risvaag, a numismatist at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, agrees with that characterization, adding that finding an Olaf coin is like “finding a needle in a haystack,” he tells Science Norway’s Ida Irene Bergstrøm. “There are so few of them.”
paras.zh: 挪威科技大学的钱币学家乔恩·安德斯·里斯瓦格（Jon Anders Risvaag）同意这一描述，并补充说，找到奥拉夫硬币就像“大海捞针”，他告诉《科学挪威》的艾达·艾琳·伯格斯特罗姆（Ida Irene Bergstrøm）。 “他们的数量太少了。”

paras.en: The obverse side of the coin features Olaf’s left-facing bust wearing a conical battle helmet, as well as a so-called Golgotha cross on three steps, inspired by Byzantine coinage. The other side depicts a double cross and an inscription that means “My leader, my lord.”
paras.zh: 硬币的正面是奥拉夫戴着圆锥形战斗头盔的左半身像，以及受拜占庭硬币启发的所谓各各他三级十字架。另一面描绘了一个双十字架和一个铭文，意思是“我的领袖，我的主”。

paras.en: The design, researchers say, is emblematic of Olaf’s bid to establish Christianity in Norway.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这一设计象征着奥拉夫在挪威建立基督教的努力。

paras.en: “It is a Christianization coin on a grand scale,” Svein Gullbekk, a numismatist at the University of Oslo, says in the statement. “We can see how Olaf used coinage to legitimize the new faith and to establish himself as a Christian king of European standing. This is branding.”
paras.zh: 奥斯陆大学钱币学家斯文·古尔贝克 (Svein Gullbekk) 在声明中表示：“这是一枚规模宏大的基督教化硬币。” “我们可以看到奥拉夫如何利用铸币来使新信仰合法化，并确立自己作为欧洲基督教国王的地位。这就是品牌。”

paras.en: Only three types of coins were issued under Olaf’s reign, so the king and his inner circle were probably intimately involved in the design and production process. “We can almost imagine Olaf himself holding this coin in his hand,” adds Gullbekk.
paras.zh: 奥拉夫统治时期只发行了三种硬币，因此国王和他的核心圈子可能密切参与了设计和生产过程。 “我们几乎可以想象奥拉夫本人手里拿着这枚硬币，”古尔贝克补充道。

paras.en: Coin production in Norway didn’t really take off until Harald Hardrada came to power in 1045 C.E. For Olaf, minting coins was likely more of a political power move than anything else.
paras.zh: 直到公元 1045 年哈拉尔德·哈德拉达 (Harald Hardrada) 掌权后，挪威的硬币生产才真正开始腾飞。对于奥拉夫来说，铸造硬币可能更多的是一种政治权力举动。

paras.en: “It’s someone pulling out all the stops and showing that he can do what people do abroad,” Risvaag tells Science Norway. “It’s a demonstration of kingship.”
paras.zh: 里斯瓦格告诉《挪威科学》杂志：“这是一个人使出浑身解数，证明他可以做国外人能做的事情。” “这是王权的体现。”

paras.en: However, this particular coin may also have been used as currency. It bears numerous small cuts that appear to have been made by a knife, which was a method of testing the silver content during transactions.
paras.zh: 然而，这种特殊的硬币也可能被用作货币。它有许多似乎是用刀划出的小切口，这是在交易过程中测试银含量的一种方法。

paras.en: Researchers think the coin was probably produced around 1024 to 1028, near the end of the Viking Age, then buried with the rest of the Mørstad hoard in the late 1040s. During those intervening years, the cut marks suggest it changed hands several times.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这枚硬币可能是在 1024 年至 1028 年左右生产的，接近维京时代末期，然后在 1040 年代末与莫斯塔德宝藏的其余部分一起埋葬。在此期间，切割痕迹表明它曾数次转手。

paras.en: Olaf, born around 995, first discovered Christianity as a young man, when he joined Viking raids against England and France. He was baptized in Rouen, France, around 1013. He became king not long after and ruled from 1015 to 1028.
paras.zh: 奥拉夫出生于 995 年左右，他在年轻时第一次发现了基督教，当时他参加了维京人对英格兰和法国的袭击。他于 1013 年左右在法国鲁昂受洗。不久后他成为国王，并于 1015 年至 1028 年统治。

paras.en: During his reign, he pushed for the acceptance of Christianity, and his 1024 religious code is considered the founding of the Church of Norway. His aggressive efforts to Christianize Norway sparked resistance, particularly in Trøndelag and the inland districts of eastern Norway, according to the museum.
paras.zh: 在他的统治期间，他推动接受基督教，他的1024年宗教法典被认为是挪威教会的创立。据博物馆称，他对挪威基督教化的积极努力引发了抵制，特别是在特伦德拉格和挪威东部的内陆地区。

paras.en: Olaf was killed in 1030 and canonized in 1031. His popularity skyrocketed after his death, with churches and shrines built in his honor across the world.
paras.zh: 奥拉夫于1030年被杀，并于1031年被册封。他的知名度在他去世后飙升，在世界各地为他建造了教堂和神社。

paras.en: - When Danish King Cnut conquered Norway in 1028, Olaf took refuge with his brother-in-law, Yaroslav the Wise, the Grand Prince of Kyivan Rus.
paras.zh: -当丹麦国王克努特（ Cnut ）于1028年征服挪威时，奥拉夫（ Olaf ）与他的姐夫，基辅罗斯（ Kyivan Rus ）大王子智者雅罗斯拉夫（ Yaroslav the Wise ）一起避难。

paras.en: - Olaf’s comeback attempt in 1030 failed, resulting in his death at the Battle of Stiklestad.
paras.zh: - 奥拉夫在1030年的复出尝试失败，导致他在斯蒂克莱斯塔德战役中阵亡。

paras.en: Historical accounts of Olaf are relatively scarce, so the newfound coin offers a rare and valuable glimpse into his life and royal power. The museum plans to feature it in an upcoming exhibition on the Mørstad hoard, marking the first time any part of the cache will go on public display.
paras.zh: 关于奥拉夫的历史记载相对较少，因此新发现的硬币为人们提供了了解他的生活和王权的罕见而宝贵的机会。博物馆计划在即将举行的莫斯塔德宝库展览中展示它，这标志着该藏品的任何部分将首次公开展示。

paras.en: In the meantime, researchers are continuing to catalog the hoard—a process that’s not likely to wrap up any time soon. The cache now contains an estimated 5,500 coins, according to the latest count.
paras.zh: 与此同时，研究人员正在继续对这些宝藏进行编目——这一过程不太可能很快结束。根据最新统计，该缓存目前估计包含 5,500 个硬币。

paras.en: “I am beginning to think that the hoard may soon exceed 6,000 coins,” Florent Audy, who is overseeing the Mørstad hoard cataloging process, says in the statement.
paras.zh: “我开始认为这些宝藏可能很快就会超过 6,000 枚硬币，”负责监督莫斯塔德宝藏编目过程的弗洛伦特·奥迪 (Florent Audy) 在声明中表示。

articles.title: These Big, Fierce Birds Found Love in Australia—and Laid the First Southern Cassowary Eggs at the Adelaide Zoo in 34 Years

paras.en: Finding love isn’t always easy—especially if you’re a southern cassowary, a massive, solitary bird with an aggressive reputation. But conservationists in Australia seem to have cracked the matchmaking code: A female cassowary recently laid two eggs after being paired with a potential mate.
paras.zh: 寻找真爱并不总是那么容易——尤其是如果你是一只南方食火鸡，一种体型巨大、独居且具有攻击性的鸟类。但澳大利亚的自然资源保护主义者似乎已经破解了配对密码：一只雌性食火鸡在与潜在配偶配对后最近产下了两个蛋。

paras.en: The large, bright green orbs are the first southern cassowary eggs laid at Adelaide Zoo in South Australia in more than three decades—and their arrival is an encouraging bright spot for a species facing an uncertain future.
paras.zh: 这些大而亮绿色的球体是三十多年来在南澳大利亚阿德莱德动物园产下的第一批南方食火鸡蛋，它们的到来对于一个面临不确定未来的物种来说是一个令人鼓舞的亮点。

paras.en: “This is really exciting news for us because it has been 34 years since we’ve had successful cassowary chicks here at Adelaide Zoo, so the team and myself included are very excited,” says Erin Kasteliz, team supervisor for birds at the zoo, in a statement.
paras.zh: “这对我们来说确实是令人兴奋的消息，因为我们已经 34 年没有在阿德莱德动物园成功饲养食火鸡雏鸟了，所以包括我在内的团队都非常兴奋，”动物园鸟类团队主管艾琳·卡斯特里兹 (Erin Kasteliz) 在一份声明中说道。

paras.en: Native to Australia, southern cassowaries are huge flightless birds found primarily in Queensland’s Wet Tropics and Cape York Peninsula; they also live in New Guinea and eastern Indonesia. Weighing up to 175 pounds and standing more than five feet tall, they’re the third-largest birds in the world, trailing behind emus and ostriches.
paras.zh: 南方食火鸡原产于澳大利亚，是一种巨大的不会飞的鸟类，主要分布在昆士兰州的湿热带地区和约克角半岛。他们还生活在新几内亚和印度尼西亚东部。它们重达 175 磅，站立高度超过 5 英尺，是世界第三大鸟类，仅次于鸸鹋和鸵鸟。

paras.en: Beyond their imposing size, southern cassowaries are known for their striking appearance. Inky-black feathers cover most of their bodies, contrasting with vibrant blue necks, two dangling red wattles and a Mohawk-like casque—a raised, bony structure—atop their heads.
paras.zh: 除了巨大的体型之外，南方食火鸡还以其引人注目的外观而闻名。墨黑色的羽毛覆盖了它们的大部分身体，与充满活力的蓝色脖子、两个悬垂的红色肉垂和头顶上的莫霍克式头盔（一种凸起的骨质结构）形成鲜明对比。

paras.en: Scientists don't know why cassowaries have casques atop their heads. But they recently discovered that this helmet-like head ornament fluoresces under ultraviolet (UV) light, a discovery that only deepens the mystery.
paras.zh: 科学家们不知道为什么食火鸡的头上有头盔。但他们最近发现，这种类似头盔的头饰在紫外线（UV）光下会发出荧光，这一发现只会加深谜团。

paras.en: Southern cassowaries have been recorded eating more than 200 different kinds of plants, and they play an important role in maintaining rainforest diversity by dispersing seeds via their droppings. They’re mostly solitary creatures, but they aren’t afraid to use their powerful legs and sharp claws to defend their turf when necessary.
paras.zh: 据记录，南方食火鸡吃 200 多种不同的植物，它们通过粪便传播种子，在维持雨林多样性方面发挥着重要作用。它们大多是独居动物，但在必要时它们并不害怕使用强大的腿和锋利的爪子来保卫自己的地盘。

paras.en: The International Union for Conservation of Nature considers southern cassowaries a species of least concern, but Australia lists them as endangered, with an estimated 4,400 individuals remaining on the continent. Their survival has been threatened primarily by habitat loss and fragmentation resulting from forest clearing for agriculture and infrastructure, but the species is also vulnerable to vehicle strikes, poaching, dog attacks and competition with feral pigs.
paras.zh: 国际自然保护联盟认为南方食火鸡是最不受关注的物种，但澳大利亚将其列为濒危物种，估计澳大利亚大陆上仅存有 4,400 只食火鸡。它们的生存主要受到农业和基础设施砍伐造成的栖息地丧失和破碎化的威胁，但该物种也容易受到车辆撞击、偷猎、狗攻击和与野猪的竞争。

paras.en: Some Australian zoos have captive populations, which are part of a breeding program managed by the Zoo Aquarium Association Australasia (ZAA). The organization maintains a studbook to help determine which birds should breed, with an overarching goal of maintaining genetic diversity.
paras.zh: 一些澳大利亚动物园有圈养种群，这是澳大利亚动物园水族馆协会 (ZAA) 管理的繁殖计划的一部分。该组织维护着一份血统簿，以帮助确定哪些鸟类应该繁殖，其总体目标是保持遗传多样性。

paras.en: Earlier this year, staff at the Adelaide Zoo got the go-ahead to try breeding their resident southern cassowaries: 10-year-old Martina and 13-year-old Jeffrey. Though the two birds seemed like a good match on paper, there was no guarantee sparks would fly when they met in person.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，阿德莱德动物园的工作人员获准尝试繁殖当地的南方食火鸡：10 岁的玛蒂娜和 13 岁的杰弗里。尽管这两只鸟在纸面上看起来很般配，但并不能保证它们见面时会擦出火花。

paras.en: Chad Crittle, the zoo’s director, compared the team’s matchmaking efforts to online dating, where it “might look like everything lines up really well. We like the same things and you might like the same food, but when you actually meet, it doesn’t always work,” he tells the New York Times’ Jennifer Sinco Kelleher. “And the same can be for animals in a zoo setting as part of these programs.”
paras.zh: 动物园园长查德·克里特尔 (Chad Crittle) 将团队的牵线搭桥工作与网上约会进行了比较，“可能看起来一切都很顺利。我们喜欢同样的东西，你可能喜欢同样的食物，但当你们真正见面时，它并不总是有效，”他告诉《纽约时报》的詹妮弗·辛科·凯莱赫 (Jennifer Sinco Kelleher)。 “作为这些计划的一部分，同样的情况也适用于动物园里的动物。”

paras.en: Fortunately, Martina and Jeffrey seemed to hit it off right away. When they were officially introduced in August, Jeffrey started preening Martina—and, later that same day, they copulated. After that, staff members saw them mating on "multiple occasions," Kasteliz says in the statement.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，玛蒂娜和杰弗里似乎一拍即合。当他们八月份正式见面时，杰弗里开始为玛蒂娜打扮——当天晚些时候，他们就交配了。卡斯特里兹在声明中说，此后，工作人员“多次”看到它们交配。

paras.en: This month, caretakers were overjoyed when they spotted two, fluorescent green eggs in the birds’ enclosure. And, they say, more could be on the way, as cassowary clutches typically contain three to five eggs. Whenever Martina is done laying eggs, it will be Jeffrey’s job to incubate them.
paras.zh: 本月，当饲养员在鸟舍内发现两个荧光绿色的蛋时，他们欣喜若狂。而且，他们说，可能还会有更多的蛋，因为一窝食火鸡通常含有三到五个蛋。每当玛蒂娜产完蛋后，杰弗里的工作就是孵化它们。

paras.en: According to Kasteliz, the eggs’ neon-green color helps them blend in with their surroundings.
paras.zh: 据卡斯特里兹介绍，鸡蛋的霓虹绿色有助于它们与周围环境融为一体。

paras.en: “That color comes from pigment in the shell and helps camouflage the egg," she says in the statement. "In the wild, cassowaries live in dense rainforest and will find a safe area amongst the leaves to lay, so that green helps keep the eggs hidden from predators.”
paras.zh: “这种颜色来自蛋壳中的色素，有助于伪装鸡蛋，”她在声明中说。 “在野外，食火鸡生活在茂密的雨林中，会在树叶中找到安全的区域产卵，因此绿色有助于防止捕食者发现它们的卵。”

paras.en: Zoo staffers don’t know whether the eggs are viable and will ultimately hatch into chicks. However, the sheer fact that Martina laid the eggs is a major win, since breeding southern cassowaries in captivity is so tricky. If the eggs do end up being viable, the zoo expects to have chicks in about 50 days—and Jeffrey would be responsible for rearing them.
paras.zh: 动物园工作人员不知道这些蛋是否能存活并最终能否孵化成小鸡。然而，玛蒂娜下蛋这一事实本身就是一个重大胜利，因为人工饲养南方食火鸡非常棘手。如果鸡蛋最终确实能存活，动物园预计大约 50 天后就会生出小鸡，而杰弗里将负责饲养它们。

paras.en: For now, the team is cautiously optimistic. They’re keeping an eye on Jeffrey and Martina, while also trying to give them their space. They plan to be largely hands-off to let Jeffrey “have his first go at doing this so he can learn,” Crittle tells the Times.
paras.zh: 目前，团队持谨慎乐观态度。他们密切关注杰弗里和玛蒂娜，同时也试图给他们空间。克里特尔告诉《泰晤士报》，他们计划在很大程度上不干涉，让杰弗里“第一次尝试这样做，这样他就可以学习”。

articles.title: Astronomers Detect the Oldest Known Fast Radio Burst, Spewed From an Ancient Galaxy Just Three Billion Years After the Big Bang

paras.en: About ten billion years ago, in a faraway galaxy, some astronomical object released a brief but extremely powerful burst of energy into the universe. Now, scientists have detected that flash and figured out where it came from.
paras.zh: 大约一百亿年前，在一个遥远的星系中，一些天体向宇宙释放了短暂但极其强大的能量爆发。现在，科学家们已经检测到了那道闪光，并查明了它的来源。

paras.en: The findings, published in the journal Science on October 8, mark the oldest fast radio burst (FRB) ever detected. The mysterious flash was produced during the early universe, so it can help scientists better understand the ancient cosmos.
paras.zh: 该研究结果于 10 月 8 日发表在《科学》杂志上，标志着迄今为止检测到的最古老的快速射电暴 (FRB)。这种神秘的闪光是在早期宇宙中产生的，因此它可以帮助科学家更好地了解远古宇宙。

paras.en: “If you put this in human perspective, when the light left the source, the sun didn’t exist, the solar system didn’t exist, no humans existed,” says study co-author Manisha Caleb, an astrophysicist at the University of Sydney, to Jacinta Bowler at the Australian Broadcasting Corporation. “Civilization formed and we built radio telescopes, and then we just happened to look at the right patch of sky at the right time.”
paras.zh: “如果你从人类的角度来看，当光线离开光源时，太阳就不存在，太阳系也不存在，人类也不存在，”该研究的合著者、悉尼大学天体物理学家马尼沙·卡勒布 (Manisha Caleb) 向澳大利亚广播公司的杰辛塔·鲍勒 (Jacinta Bowler) 说道。 “文明形成了，我们建造了射电望远镜，然后我们恰好在正确的时间看到了正确的天空。”

paras.en: The solar system formed about 4.6 billion years ago. A dense cloud of gas and dust collapsed and formed a swirling disk of material. It continued pulling in more space stuff until immense pressure in the core birthed the sun.
paras.zh: 太阳系形成于大约 46 亿年前。浓密的气体和尘埃云塌陷，形成一个旋转的物质盘。它继续吸引更多的太空物质，直到核心的巨大压力诞生了太阳。

paras.en: FRBs are short but powerful flashes of radio waves. The first one was discovered in 2007, and thousands of them have been detected ever since. However, scientists still aren’t sure what produces the outbursts. One possibility is that they originate from the merging of two neutron stars, extremely dense remnants of dead giant stars. Another hypothesis is that they’re emitted by magnetars, rare types of young neutron stars with powerful magnetic fields. Researchers previously showed that at least one FRB probably came from a magnetar, but that doesn’t mean all of them are made by these strange stellar leftovers.
paras.zh: FRB 是短暂但强大的无线电波闪光。第一个发现于 2007 年，此后又发现了数千个。然而，科学家们仍然不确定是什么产生了爆发。一种可能性是它们起源于两颗中子星的合并，中子星是死亡巨星的极其致密的残余物。另一种假设是，它们是由磁星发射的，磁星是一种罕见的年轻中子星，具有强大的磁场。研究人员此前表明，至少有一个快速射电暴可能来自磁星，但这并不意味着所有快速射电暴都是由这些奇怪的恒星残余物形成的。

paras.en: Detecting and measuring FRBs, as well as the galaxies they came from, can help solve this puzzle, says study co-author Themiya Nanayakkara, an astrophysicist at the University of Sydney, to Scientific American’s Adam Kovac. The MeerKAT radio telescope array in South Africa detected the newly described flash of radio waves, dubbed FRB 20240304B, in March 2024. The different frequencies of energy within the burst—like the rainbow produced when white light passes through a prism—arrived at different times, suggesting that the FRB traveled through a lot of plasma in outer space before reaching Earth. (The greater the dispersion of frequencies, the longer the distance traveled.)
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、悉尼大学天体物理学家 Themiya Nanayakkara 向《科学美国人》的 Adam Kovac 表示，探测和测量 FRB 以及它们来自的星系可以帮助解决这个难题。南非的 MeerKAT 射电望远镜阵列于 2024 年 3 月探测到了新描述的无线电波闪光，称为 FRB 20240304B。爆发中不同频率的能量（就像白光穿过棱镜时产生的彩虹）在不同时间到达，这表明 FRB 在到达地球之前穿过了外太空的大量等离子体。 （频率分散度越大，传播的距离越长。）

paras.en: Then, the researchers used NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) to pinpoint the FRB’s origins. Analyses revealed that it came from a primitive galaxy that formed roughly three billion years after the Big Bang, which happened 13.8 billion years ago.
paras.zh: 然后，研究人员使用美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）来查明快速射电暴的起源。分析显示，它来自一个原始星系，形成于138亿年前的大爆炸后约30亿年。

paras.en: “We thought it would be a big, nicely formed galaxy with lots of stars, and instead it was a little dwarf galaxy, although it was actively forming stars,” Caleb says in a statement. It also had a low amount of metal. That’s consistent with the idea that FRBs originate from magnetars, Nanayakkara and Caleb write for the Conversation, hinting that FRB 20240304B came from one.
paras.zh: 迦勒在一份声明中说：“我们认为这将是一个巨大的、结构良好的星系，拥有大量恒星，但实际上它是一个小矮星系，尽管它正在积极形成恒星。”它还含有少量金属。 Nanayakkara 和 Caleb 在对话中写道，这与 FRB 起源于磁星的观点一致，暗示 FRB 20240304B 来自磁星。

paras.en: While the findings don’t definitively solve the mystery of what exactly produces FRBs, they’re useful in other ways. Scientists can use the flashes to learn more about the distant universe, based on how they were affected by the material they passed through during their journeys to Earth.
paras.zh: 虽然这些发现并没有彻底解决快速射电暴产生的谜团，但它们在其他方面也很有用。科学家可以利用这些闪光来了解更多关于遥远宇宙的信息，了解它们在前往地球的旅程中如何受到所经过的物质的影响。

paras.en: “Our discovery is particularly important because we have shown that we can do this across approximately 80 percent of cosmic history,” Nanayakkara explains to Scientific American. “The further back we push FRB detections, the further we can map this otherwise unseen matter.”
paras.zh: Nanayakkara 向《科学美国人》解释说：“我们的发现特别重要，因为我们已经证明，我们可以在大约 80% 的宇宙历史中做到这一点。” “我们将 FRB 探测推得越远，我们就越能绘制出这种看不见的物质的图谱。”

paras.en: Matthew Bailes, an astrophysicist at Swinburne University of Technology in Australia who wasn’t involved in the research, tells Donna Lu at the Guardian that the new study is “a validation of how powerful the FRBs are for probing the universe.”
paras.zh: 澳大利亚斯威本科技大学的天体物理学家马修·拜尔斯（Matthew Bailes）没有参与这项研究，他告诉《卫报》的唐娜·卢，这项新研究“验证了快速射电暴在探测宇宙方面的威力。”

paras.en: The next step, according to the study authors, is to find more of them. They estimate that the MeerKAT telescope can detect several ancient FRBs each year, per the statement. The team has also secured time to use the JWST to identify the sources of other old FRBs.
paras.zh: 研究作者表示，下一步是找到更多这样的东西。根据声明，他们估计 MeerKAT 望远镜每年可以探测到几个古老的快速射电暴。该团队还确保了时间使用 JWST 来识别其他旧 FRB 的来源。

paras.en: “The more distant FRBs we find, the stronger the constraints we can place on the objects and emission mechanisms that produce them, the environments in which they occur and the distribution of matter across the universe,” Nanayakkara tells Scientific American.
paras.zh: 纳纳亚卡拉告诉《科学美国人》：“我们发现的快速射电暴距离越远，我们对产生它们的物体和发射机制、它们发生的环境以及物质在宇宙中的分布的限制就越强。”

articles.title: How Many Billions Would It Take to Hold Meta Accountable?
articles.author: Lauren Goode

paras.en: Earlier this week, a New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay a $25 billion fine for violating consumer protection laws dating back to the Cambridge Analytica scandal. $25 billion is a massive fine, the largest Meta has ever faced, but it still had us folks at WIRED wondering: Would Meta even feel the pain?
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，新墨西哥州的一名法官命令 Meta 支付 250 亿美元的罚款，原因是其违反了自剑桥分析丑闻以来的消费者保护法。 250 亿美元是一笔巨额罚款，是 Meta 有史以来面临的最大一笔罚款，但它仍然让我们《连线》的人想知道：Meta 会感到痛苦吗？

paras.en: A quick recap of the case: Filed in 2021, the suit alleged that the company violated the state’s Unfair Practices Act by lying to Meta users about the way it handled their data. (Later, New Mexico’s attorney general also made claims against Meta’s content moderation policies.) In September, a jury ruled in favor of the state. Then came the multibillion-dollar penalty.
paras.zh: 案件快速回顾：该诉讼于 2021 年提起，指控该公司在处理数据的方式上向 Meta 用户撒谎，违反了该州的《不公平行为法》。 （后来，新墨西哥州总检察长也对 Meta 的内容审核政策提出了指控。）9 月，陪审团做出了有利于该州的裁决。然后是数十亿美元的罚款。

paras.en: “This ruling, and the Attorney General's approach to enforcement, makes it all but impossible to do business in the state of New Mexico,” C.J. Mahoney, Meta’s chief legal officer, said in a statement. “At its core, this lawsuit seeks to impose a tax on speech to enforce new rules for what people can say online. We are confident we will prevail on appeal.”
paras.zh: Meta 的首席法律官 C.J. Mahoney 在一份声明中表示：“这项裁决以及总检察长的执法方式使得在新墨西哥州开展业务几乎变得不可能。” “这起诉讼的核心目的是对言论征税，以对人们在网上的言论执行新规则。我们有信心在上诉中获胜。”

paras.en: Meta’s legal troubles have proliferated so much this year that it’s hard to keep track of them. Earlier this year in New Mexico, a jury ruled that the social media company should pay $375 million for violating the state’s Unfair Practices Act. That trial was related to child safety. A second phase of the case resulted in Meta being ordered to pay $567 million.
paras.zh: 今年，Meta 的法律麻烦激增，以至于很难对其进行追踪。今年早些时候，在新墨西哥州，陪审团裁定这家社交媒体公司因违反该州的《不公平行为法》而应支付 3.75 亿美元。该试验与儿童安全有关。该案的第二阶段导致 Meta 被判支付 5.67 亿美元。

paras.en: Meanwhile, a Los Angeles County superior court found Meta—and Google-owned YouTube—liable for harming a user’s mental health with the addictive design features of their apps. The plaintiff, a young woman, was awarded $6 million; Meta is on the hook for the bulk of that payment. Then in August, Meta settled a landmark federal case brought against the company by the majority of US states. This suit, once again, centered on addictive features in its apps that were alleged to be harmful to kids. As part of that settlement, Meta will pay the states between $17 and $18 billion over 10 years.
paras.zh: 与此同时，洛杉矶县高等法院裁定 Meta 和谷歌旗下的 YouTube 对其应用程序的令人上瘾的设计功能损害了用户的心理健康负有责任。原告是一名年轻女性，被判赔偿 600 万美元； Meta 承担了大部分付款。随后在 8 月，Meta 就美国大多数州针对该公司提起的具有里程碑意义的联邦案件达成了和解。这起诉讼再次集中于其应用程序中据称对儿童有害的令人上瘾的功能。作为和解协议的一部分，Meta 将在 10 年内向各州支付 17 至 180 亿美元。

paras.en: Added up, that’s a lot of billions. And yet: It’s still just the cost of doing business for Meta. Reuters reports that in the most recent New Mexico trial, the state’s attorneys originally asked Judge Francis Mathew to award the state between $35 and $45 billion. That would’ve been significant for the state, but would that extra $20 billion have kneecapped Meta? Nope.
paras.zh: 加起来，有好几亿了。然而：这仍然只是 Meta 开展业务的成本。路透社报道称，在新墨西哥州最近的审判中，该州检察官最初要求弗朗西斯·马修法官判给该州 35 至 450 亿美元。这对国家来说意义重大，但是额外的 200 亿美元会削弱 Meta 的能力吗？没有。

paras.en: Even if Meta was forced to pay the total maximum fine of the New Mexico ruling—a whopping $219 billion, or $5,000 across 43 million violations, reduced by the judge to $25 billion—the company would have felt only a mild sting. As of writing, Meta is worth around $1.7 trillion. Its stock took a hit on Thursday, but that was due to a confluence of factors, like Meta’s earnings report on Wednesday, the company’s massive capital expenditures on AI, and AI stocks dragging overall.
paras.zh: 即使 Meta 被迫支付新墨西哥州裁决的最高罚款总额（高达 2,190 亿美元，即 4,300 万起违规行为中的 5,000 美元，法官将其减少至 250 亿美元），该公司也只会感到轻微的刺痛。截至撰写本文时，Meta 的价值约为 1.7 万亿美元。其股价周四受到打击，但这是由于多种因素综合作用的结果，例如 Meta 周三的收益报告、该公司在人工智能方面的巨额资本支出以及人工智能股票整体拖累。

paras.en: At this point, with no immediate monetary damage to Meta, it would take an accumulation of events to force some kind of change, legal experts tell me. For one, Meta has a clear perception problem: Juries are ruling against it, protesters have railed against it, even its own employees have been more vocal about the company’s internal policies.
paras.zh: 法律专家告诉我，目前，Meta 不会立即遭受金钱损失，需要事件的积累才能迫使某种改变。其一，Meta 存在明显的认知问题：陪审团对其做出不利裁决，抗议者对其提出抗议，甚至其自己的员工也对公司的内部政策更加直言不讳。

paras.en: Every time Meta doesn’t settle a case, the evidence presented during trial can be scrutinized by the public and used in future cases against Meta, says Corban Rhodes, partner at DiCello Levitt, the outside law firm representing New Mexico in this case. “This trial included more than 100 exhibits that we were able to put into public record, things that had been kept secret for more than a decade since Cambridge Analytica,” Rhodes told WIRED.
paras.zh: 代表新墨西哥州本案的外部律师事务所 DiCello Levitt 的合伙人 Corban Rhodes 表示，每次 Meta 未能解决案件时，公众都会审查审判期间提供的证据，并在未来针对 Meta 的案件中使用这些证据。罗德斯告诉《连线》杂志：“这次试验包括了我们能够公开记录的 100 多件证据，这些事情自剑桥分析以来一直保密了十多年。”

paras.en: One such item is a 2018 email that then COO Sheryl Sandberg sent to a few colleagues days after the Cambridge Analytica scandal broke. Sandberg wrote, “The single biggest issue we face—and I really need everyone to know this—is that there were a MILLION developers with access to the data. We are going to have many, many, many more moments like this in the next month and year.”
paras.zh: 其中之一是 2018 年的一封电子邮件，是剑桥分析公司丑闻爆发几天后，时任首席运营官谢丽尔·桑德伯格 (Sheryl Sandberg) 向几位同事发送的。桑德伯格写道：“我们面临的最大问题——我真的需要每个人都知道这一点——是有数百万开发人员可以访问数据。在接下来的一个月和一年里，我们将会有很多很多这样的时刻。”

paras.en: There are early signals that private insurers may start balking at having to cover the cost of a tech company’s legal defenses. Some experts are suggesting that insurance companies could even end up being de facto governance for AI, as they “inject responsibility into how AI is designed, developed, and deployed as a condition for obtaining insurance.” Meta learned this firsthand in March, when a Delaware judge ruled that insurers do not have a duty to defend Meta against the literal thousands of lawsuits being brought against it.
paras.zh: 早期迹象表明，私人保险公司可能会开始犹豫是否必须承担科技公司的法律辩护费用。一些专家建议，保险公司甚至可能最终成为人工智能事实上的治理者，因为它们“将责任注入到人工智能的设计、开发和部署方式中，作为获得保险的条件。” Meta 在三月份亲眼目睹了这一点，当时特拉华州的一名法官裁定，保险公司没有义务为 Meta 辩护，使其免受数以千计的诉讼。

paras.en: There’s no well-defined number at which Meta suddenly becomes vulnerable—the company is unlikely to ever fold from legal penalties alone. But problems could crop up if shareholders or board members stop seeing the company as some inanimate entity and start to focus on the individual directors or officers who have been making bad decisions, says Brian Quinn, a law professor at Boston College Law School who studies corporate law, M&A, and transaction law. Like, say, the people who keep appearing in lawsuits.
paras.zh: 没有明确的数字表明 Meta 会突然变得脆弱——仅靠法律处罚，该公司不太可能倒闭。但波士顿学院法学院研究公司法、并购和交易法的法学教授布莱恩·奎恩表示，如果股东或董事会成员不再将公司视为无生命的实体，而是开始关注做出错误决定的个别董事或高管，问题可能会突然出现。就像那些不断出现在诉讼中的人一样。

paras.en: “The way that indemnification law is written right now, the fact that a person in a company was found to have violated a law doesn’t necessarily make them liable. It can be believed that they were acting in good faith, or in the best interest of their company,” Quinn says. “But problems start to arise if shareholders say, wait a minute, there’s not only evidence that this director or operator is violating the law, but it has appeared in the same set of facts seven times now.”
paras.zh: “按照目前赔偿法的规定，公司中的某个人被发现违反了法律，并不一定意味着他们要承担责任。可以相信，他们的行为是出于善意，或者是为了公司的最大利益，”奎因说。 “但如果股东说，等一下，不仅有证据表明该董事或经营者违反了法律，而且它已经在同一组事实中出现了七次，那么问题就开始出现了。”

paras.en: After a huge accumulation of these kinds of results, Quinn says, some angry shareholders might stand up and say the corporation should no longer be able to indemnify those directors. That’s when you might see change, because Meta’s executives would no longer be as protected.
paras.zh: 奎因说，在这些结果大量积累之后，一些愤怒的股东可能会站起来说，公司不应该再向这些董事提供赔偿。到那时你可能会看到变化，因为 Meta 的高管将不再受到保护。

paras.en: Finally, since litigation is often behind the curve on society-disrupting technology, Meta’s legal woes are likely far from over—especially as it wades deeper into AI. “Regulators and courts have for a long time been focused on the impact of social media 1.0 and 2.0, and I think we’re moving on from that era,” says Rhodes. “I expect the next wave of litigation will be focused on AI.”
paras.zh: 最后，由于扰乱社会的技术的诉讼往往落后于现状，Meta 的法律困境可能还远未结束——尤其是当它更深入地涉足人工智能领域时。 “监管机构和法院长期以来一直关注社交媒体 1.0 和 2.0 的影响，我认为我们正在从那个时代继续前进，”罗兹说。 “我预计下一波诉讼将集中在人工智能方面。”

articles.title: Elon Musk Just Dumped Another $76 Million Into the Midterms
articles.author: Dell Cameron

paras.en: Elon Musk gave his personal political committee, America PAC, more than $76 million in the first two weeks of October to boost Republicans in the final stretch of the midterms, according to a pre-election report the PAC filed Thursday evening with the Federal Election Commission.
paras.zh: 根据美国政治行动委员会周四晚上向联邦选举委员会提交的一份选前报告，埃隆·马斯克在 10 月的前两周向他的个人政治委员会美国政治行动委员会提供了超过 7600 万美元，以在中期选举的最后阶段支持共和党。

paras.en: The group spent nearly $43 million in the first two weeks of October, and entered the campaign’s last leg holding nearly $47 million in cash.
paras.zh: 该组织在 10 月的前两周花费了近 4300 万美元，并持有近 4700 万美元的现金进入竞选的最后阶段。

paras.en: The Texas Senate race dominated the new spending. It drew $15.2 million, double what the PAC spent there all summer. That spending included $12.4 million to attack Democratic candidate James Talarico and $2.8 million to promote Republican Ken Paxton.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州参议院竞选主导了新的支出。它筹集了 1520 万美元，是 PAC 整个夏天花费的两倍。这些支出包括 1240 万美元用于攻击民主党候选人詹姆斯·塔拉里科 (James Talarico) 和 280 万美元用于宣传共和党候选人肯·帕克斯顿 (Ken Paxton)。

paras.en: Daily filings since then show $9.1 million more against Talarico, bringing the PAC’s spending against him this cycle to nearly $28 million, about 40 percent of everything it has spent supporting or opposing candidates. The PAC also shifted toward online ads, spending $11.4 million on digital ads in the same two weeks, which is close to what it spent on mail and texting combined.
paras.zh: 此后每天提交的文件显示，针对塔拉里科的支出增加了 910 万美元，这使得 PAC 在本周期针对他的支出达到近 2800 万美元，约占其支持或反对候选人支出的 40%。 PAC 还转向在线广告，在两周内在数字广告上花费了 1140 万美元，这接近于邮件和短信的花费总和。

paras.en: All told, Musk has given more than $445 million to Republican political groups this election cycle, according to WIRED’s analysis of FEC filings, making him the biggest known individual donor in the midterms. More than $165 million of that has gone to America PAC since July alone.
paras.zh: 根据《连线》对 FEC 文件的分析，马斯克在本次选举周期中总共向共和党政治团体捐赠了超过 4.45 亿美元，这使他成为中期选举中已知的最大个人捐赠者。仅自 7 月份以来，其中就有超过 1.65 亿美元流入 America PAC。

paras.en: Musk—who has several companies, including Tesla and SpaceX, based in Texas—has also been posting online about the race. On Wednesday, Musk posted on X that “there is something deeply wrong with Talarico,” then called him “a creep” and claimed, without evidence, that he “would vote to take away your kids and transition them.” Earlier this month, Musk amplified a false claim that Talarico had been treated at a mental health facility. Talarico shot back the same day: “There is something deeply wrong with a political system that allows one trillionaire to buy his own personal US Senator.”
paras.zh: 马斯克拥有多家公司，包括位于德克萨斯州的特斯拉和 SpaceX，他也在网上发布了有关这场比赛的信息。周三，马斯克在 X 上发帖称“塔拉里科存在严重问题”，然后称他为“变态者”，并在没有证据的情况下声称他“会投票带走你的孩子并让他们过渡”。本月早些时候，马斯克放大了塔拉里科曾在精神卫生机构接受治疗的虚假说法。塔拉里科当天反驳道：“允许一位亿万富翁购买自己的美国参议员的政治制度存在严重错误。”

paras.en: The Texas race remains a toss-up. An Emerson College poll of 1,000 likely Texas voters, conducted October 17 to 19, found Talarico at 48 percent and Paxton at 46 percent, within the poll’s 3-point margin of error.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州的竞选仍然是一个难以抉择的问题。艾默生学院于 10 月 17 日至 19 日对 1,000 名可能投票的得克萨斯州选民进行了民意调查，发现塔拉里科的支持率为 48%，帕克斯顿的支持率为 46%，均在民意调查的 3 分误差范围内。

paras.en: The stakes for Musk reach well beyond Texas. If Democrats win the House, the lawmakers in line to lead its committees have signaled they will investigate his role in the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), his companies’ federal contracts, and what Zoe Lofgren, a California Democrat, called an “astounding” number of conflicts of interest. Unified Democratic control of Congress would pose even more problems for him.
paras.zh: 马斯克的赌注远远超出了德克萨斯州。如果民主党赢得众议院，领导其委员会的立法者已表示，他们将调查他在政府效率部 (DOGE) 中的角色、他的公司的联邦合同，以及加州民主党人佐伊·洛夫格伦 (Zoe Lofgren) 所说的“数量惊人”的利益冲突。民主党对国会的统一控制会给他带来更多问题。

paras.en: Silicon Valley Democrats added another target on Friday: restrictions on SpaceX’s Starshield satellite service in Ukraine. In a letter to the White House demanding an investigation, Representatives Sam Liccardo, Jimmy Panetta, and Ro Khanna vowed that the next Congress “will closely scrutinize federal funding awarded to Mr. Musk’s businesses.”
paras.zh: 硅谷民主党周五增加了另一个目标：限制 SpaceX 在乌克兰的 Starshield 卫星服务。众议员山姆·利卡多（Sam Liccardo）、吉米·帕内塔（Jimmy Panetta）和罗·卡纳（Ro Khanna）在致白宫的一封要求进行调查的信中誓言，下一届国会“将仔细审查授予马斯克先生企业的联邦资金”。

articles.title: What’s the Best iPhone to Buy or Avoid Right Now? (2026)
articles.author: Julian Chokkattu, Simon Hill

paras.en: Apple sells seven iPhone models, from the $699 iPhone 17e to the $1,999 iPhone Duo, but which iPhone is best for you? This is a good time of the year to buy an iPhone if you need to upgrade, since Apple just released its flagship models. (We don't expect the more affordable iPhone 18 models until spring 2027.) We've tested nearly every model and outlined their strengths and weaknesses so you can get the right one for you.
paras.zh: 苹果销售七款 iPhone 型号，从 699 美元的 iPhone 17e 到 1,999 美元的 iPhone Duo，但哪款 iPhone 最适合您呢？如果你需要升级，现在是一年中购买 iPhone 的好时机，因为苹果刚刚发布了旗舰机型。 （我们预计到 2027 年春季才会推出更实惠的 iPhone 18 型号。）我们测试了几乎所有型号，并概述了它们的优点和缺点，以便您找到适合您的型号。

paras.en: Check out our other Apple buying guides, including Which iPhone 18 Models to Buy, Which iPhone 17 Model to Buy, Best iPhone 17 Cases, Best MagSafe Accessories, Best MagSafe Chargers, Best MagSafe Wallets, and Best Apple 3-in-1 Chargers. Wondering what's new in iOS 27? We have details on that, too.
paras.zh: 查看我们的其他 Apple 购买指南，包括购买哪些 iPhone 18 型号、购买哪些 iPhone 17 型号、最佳 iPhone 17 手机壳、最佳 MagSafe 配件、最佳 MagSafe 充电器、最佳 MagSafe 钱包和最佳 Apple 三合一充电器。想知道 iOS 27 中有哪些新功能？我们也有这方面的详细信息。

paras.en: Updated October 2026: We’ve added more details on the iPhone Duo and links to our reviews and other related coverage now that it's available.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月更新：我们添加了有关 iPhone Duo 的更多详细信息以及我们的评论和其他相关报道的链接（现已推出）。

paras.en: If you’re upgrading from an iPhone, you can trade it in to Apple for a small discount. Before you do that, check whether you can sell it elsewhere for more money. iPhones hold their value incredibly well, particularly if they’re in mint or good condition. We have a guide that runs through the process of selling your phone, and we generally recommend you use websites like Swappa, Gazelle, or Back Market.
paras.zh: 如果您要从 iPhone 升级，可以以小幅折扣以旧换新到 Apple。在此之前，请检查是否可以将其出售到其他地方以获得更多钱。 iPhone 的保值能力令人难以置信，尤其是在完好或状况良好的情况下。我们有一份贯穿手机销售流程的指南，通常建议您使用 Swappa、Gazelle 或 Back Market 等网站。

paras.en: We also have a handful of setup guides you should follow:
paras.zh: 我们还有一些您应该遵循的设置指南：

paras.en: Most people in the US purchase iPhones from carriers, which means the devices are locked to that network. If you bought an iPhone from Verizon, you can't easily switch to another carrier without breaking a contract and paying extra fees. It also poses headaches for travelers who want to use international SIM cards or eSIMs.
paras.zh: 大多数美国人从运营商处购买 iPhone，这意味着这些设备被锁定到该网络。如果您从 Verizon 购买了 iPhone，则无法在不违反合同和支付额外费用的情况下轻松更换到其他运营商。这也给想要使用国际 SIM 卡或 eSIM 的旅行者带来了麻烦。

paras.en: The easier approach is to buy directly from Apple, though there are some things you should know:
paras.zh: 更简单的方法是直接从 Apple 购买，但您应该了解一些事项：

paras.en: Connect to any carrier later: Choose this option for the most hassle-free experience. You get an unlocked iPhone, then all you need to do is transfer the SIM card or eSIM from your old iPhone to the new one to get started. This might be painless, though you may need to contact your carrier if the iPhone can't complete the eSIM transfer. In the US, Apple hasn't included a SIM tray since 2022's iPhone 14.
paras.zh: 稍后连接到任何运营商：选择此选项以获得最轻松的体验。您获得一部解锁的 iPhone，然后您只需将 SIM 卡或 eSIM 从旧 iPhone 转移到新 iPhone 即可开始使用。这可能很简单，但如果 iPhone 无法完成 eSIM 传输，您可能需要联系您的运营商。在美国，苹果自 2022 年的 iPhone 14 起就不再配备 SIM 卡托盘。

paras.en: Choose a carrier: If you choose a carrier through Apple.com, you will get an unlocked iPhone, no matter which carrier you choose (except if you purchase with AT&T on an installment plan). The downside is that Apple doesn't have the same offers as the carriers, so you may lose out on a deal. However, carrier offers often require new lines, trade-ins, or an upgraded plan, and the savings come in the form of bill credits, so these deals aren't as amazing as they may seem.
paras.zh: 选择运营商：如果您通过 Apple.com 选择运营商，则无论您选择哪家运营商，您都将获得一部解锁的 iPhone（除非您通过 AT&T 分期付款计划购买）。缺点是苹果没有提供与运营商相同的优惠，因此您可能会失去交易机会。然而，运营商的优惠通常需要新线路、以旧换新或升级计划，并且节省的费用以账单抵免的形式出现，因此这些优惠并不像看起来那么令人惊奇。

paras.en: Finance: You can finance your iPhone either with Apple's credit card via monthly installments or as Apple iPhone Payments via a Citizens One loan. You need to choose a carrier here, but Apple confirmed these devices are all unlocked. You have to fill out a credit application to see if you qualify. If you opt to finance through a carrier on Apple.com, only the T-Mobile and Verizon models will be unlocked. The AT&T and Boost Mobile options are locked iPhones, so it's no different from buying it on an installment plan directly from those carriers.
paras.zh: 融资：您可以通过 Apple 信用卡按月分期付款或通过 Citizens One 贷款作为 Apple iPhone Payments 为您的 iPhone 融资。您需要在此处选择运营商，但苹果确认这些设备均已解锁。您必须填写信用申请表才能查看您是否符合资格。如果您选择通过 Apple.com 上的运营商进行融资，则只有 T-Mobile 和 Verizon 型号将被解锁。 AT&T 和 Boost Mobile 选项是锁定的 iPhone，因此这与直接从这些运营商处分期付款购买没有什么不同。

paras.en: Apple Upgrade: Buying directly from Apple also nets you access to the Apple Upgrade leasing option. Is it worth it? Broadly speaking, no. Most people do not need to upgrade to a new iPhone every year or two. It's expensive, and you must return your leased iPhone in good condition to avoid additional charges. AppleCare is not included, as it was with the discontinued iPhone Upgrade Program.
paras.zh: Apple 升级：直接从 Apple 购买还可以让您获得 Apple 升级租赁选项。值得吗？从广义上讲，没有。大多数人不需要每一两年就升级到新的 iPhone。价格昂贵，而且您必须完好无损地归还租用的 iPhone，以免产生额外费用。 AppleCare 不包括在内，因为它包含在已终止的 iPhone 升级计划中。

paras.en: The most hyped-up feature from the iPhone 16 range was Apple Intelligence, which rolled out in iOS 18.1. This is Apple's suite of AI features, following the wave started by the likes of ChatGPT and Google's Gemini. Apple Intelligence is available on the iPhone 15 Pro/Pro Max and newer, including the iPhone 16e (not to mention select iPads and MacBooks).
paras.zh: iPhone 16 系列中最受关注的功能是 Apple Intelligence，该功能在 iOS 18.1 中推出。这是继 ChatGPT 和谷歌 Gemini 等公司发起的浪潮之后，苹果推出的人工智能功能套件。 Apple Intelligence 适用于 iPhone 15 Pro/Pro Max 及更新机型，包括 iPhone 16e（更不用说部分 iPad 和 MacBook）。

paras.en: What exactly is Apple Intelligence in the first place? It's a collection of features that draw on the power of large language models to introduce “smart” capabilities. For example, in the Voice Memo and Notes app, you can now start a recording and get a real-time transcription. You can even record a call and get the transcription saved in the Notes app. Siri has been redesigned to understand when you misspeak and can even plug into ChatGPT for more powerful responses to open-ended questions. There are writing tools available throughout the operating system that let you change the tone of your emails or proofread text so you don't make an unnecessary typo on Threads.
paras.zh: Apple Intelligence 到底是什么？它是一系列功能的集合，利用大型语言模型的力量来引入“智能”功能。例如，在语音备忘录和笔记应用程序中，您现在可以开始录音并获得实时转录。您甚至可以录制通话并将转录内容保存在 Notes 应用程序中。 Siri 经过重新设计，可以理解您何时说错，甚至可以插入 ChatGPT，对开放式问题做出更强有力的回答。整个操作系统都有可用的书写工具，可让您更改电子邮件的语气或校对文本，这样您就不会在 Threads 上犯下不必要的打字错误。

paras.en: This is just a small sampling. We've boiled down many of the Apple Intelligence features here, and additional features keep rolling out in iOS updates. For example, Genmoji—which lets you create your own emojis—debuted alongside the AI image-generation app, Image Playground, in iOS 18.2. In iOS 27, Apple added the revamped, conversational Siri AI assistant. Siri now understands personal context and can retrieve information from your messages, emails, and photos. It can also act on your behalf to draft a message with a particular tone or find a good restaurant for your partner's birthday dinner. Here's everything you can do with Siri AI.
paras.zh: 这只是一个小样本。我们在这里总结了许多 Apple Intelligence 功能，并且 iOS 更新中不断推出其他功能。例如，Genmoji（可让您创建自己的表情符号）与 AI 图像生成应用程序 Image Playground 一起在 iOS 18.2 中首次亮相。在 iOS 27 中，苹果添加了经过改进的对话式 Siri AI 助手。 Siri 现在可以理解个人背景，并可以从您的消息、电子邮件和照片中检索信息。它还可以代表您起草具有特定语气的消息或为您伴侣的生日晚餐寻找一家好餐厅。这是您可以使用 Siri AI 执行的所有操作。

paras.en: If you don't care for Apple Intelligence and want to turn it off, you can! We have a helpful guide detailing the exact steps.
paras.zh: 如果您不喜欢 Apple Intelligence 并且想要将其关闭，您可以！我们有一份有用的指南，详细说明了具体步骤。

paras.en: Magnetic MagSafe wireless charging is available on the iPhone 12, iPhone 13, iPhone 14, iPhone 15, iPhone 16, iPhone 17, and iPhone 18 models (except the iPhone 16e), and it allows you to magnetically attach various accessories to the back of the iPhone. (iPhones support Qi2, which is the open standard, whereas MagSafe is proprietary; you can use Qi2 accessories just like MagSafe.)
paras.zh: 磁性 MagSafe 无线充电适用于 iPhone 12、iPhone 13、iPhone 14、iPhone 15、iPhone 16、iPhone 17 和 iPhone 18 型号（iPhone 16e 除外），它允许您将各种配件以磁性方式连接到 iPhone 背面。 （iPhone 支持 Qi2，这是开放标准，而 MagSafe 是专有标准；您可以像 MagSafe 一样使用 Qi2 配件。）

paras.en: You can get first-party accessories like Apple's MagSafe Wireless Charger, which sticks to the back for faster charging. Or snag the MagSafe Wallet so you can keep your credit card attached to your phone. There are plenty of third-party accessories (you'll find quite a few in our guide), and MagSafe doesn't just have to be charging accessories like power banks or wireless chargers. There is a wealth of useful tools, from wallets, tripods, and camera cages to notepads and ring lights that can attach to the back of the iPhone and add extra versatility.
paras.zh: 您可以获得第一方配件，例如 Apple 的 MagSafe 无线充电器，该充电器可粘贴在背面以加快充电速度。或者使用 MagSafe 钱包，这样您就可以将信用卡固定在手机上。有很多第三方配件（您会在我们的指南中找到很多），MagSafe 不仅仅只是移动电源或无线充电器等充电配件。有大量有用的工具，从钱包、三脚架、相机架到记事本和环形灯，可以连接到 iPhone 背面并增加额外的多功能性。

paras.en: If you plan to use a case, get one that has MagSafe embedded inside to ensure a strong magnetic connection with Apple's accessories (non-MagSafe cases can interrupt MagSafe and make the magnetic connection weaker). All of the cases in our case guides are MagSafe-tested. And yes, a case is a smart investment because iPhones are made of glass, and glass breaks, even if Apple uses ceramic to strengthen it. We cracked an iPhone 16 Plus after a 4-foot drop to the pavement—that model's ceramic glass was supposed to be twice as strong as previous iPhones, too! Ouch. See our favorite cases for the iPhone 17, iPhone 16, iPhone 15, and iPhone 14 ranges.
paras.zh: 如果您打算使用保护壳，请购买一个内置 MagSafe 的保护壳，以确保与 Apple 配件的强磁性连接（非 MagSafe 保护壳可能会中断 MagSafe 并使磁性连接变弱）。我们的案例指南中的所有案例均经过 MagSafe 测试。是的，保护壳是一项明智的投资，因为 iPhone 是由玻璃制成的，即使苹果使用陶瓷来加固玻璃，玻璃也会破裂。我们将 iPhone 16 Plus 从 4 英尺高处跌落到人行道上后破裂——该型号的陶瓷玻璃的强度应该是以前 iPhone 的两倍！哎哟。查看我们最喜欢的 iPhone 17、iPhone 16、iPhone 15 和 iPhone 14 系列手机壳。

paras.en: While last year's iOS 26 debuted the divisive Liquid Glass, iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 focus squarely on quality-of-life improvements, with a redesigned and much improved Siri AI assistant, easier Shortcuts, and lots of little tweaks to enhance speed and stability.
paras.zh: 去年的 iOS 26 首次推出了引起争议的 Liquid Glass，而 iOS 27 和 iPadOS 27 则完全专注于生活质量的改进，包括重新设计和大幅改进的 Siri AI 助手、更简单的快捷方式以及许多旨在提高速度和稳定性的小调整。

paras.en: Siri AI doesn't just look different—now resembling a glass orb—it can also understand your personal context, pulling info from your messages, emails, or even photos, and helping you draft messages or find the right wine to pair with your dinner. Siri can also now pop up in the camera app to help you choose your next book or split a bill with friends.
paras.zh: Siri AI 不仅看起来不同（现在看起来像一个玻璃球），它还可以了解您的个人背景，从您的消息、电子邮件甚至照片中提取信息，并帮助您起草消息或找到适合您晚餐的葡萄酒。 Siri 现在还可以在相机应用程序中弹出，帮助您选择下一本书或与朋友分摊账单。

paras.en: Apple says iOS 27 is faster than ever, with app launches up to 30 percent faster, newly captured photos in your Photo Library loading up to 70 percent faster, and AirDrop transfers completing up to 80 percent faster. For more details, read our guide on the top features in iOS 27 and how to download it.
paras.zh: Apple 表示，iOS 27 比以往任何时候都更快，应用程序启动速度提高了 30%，照片库中新拍摄的照片加载速度提高了 70%，AirDrop 传输完成速度提高了 80%。有关更多详细信息，请阅读我们有关 iOS 27 的主要功能以及如何下载的指南。

paras.en: Apple hasn't offered a charging brick in the box since the iPhone 12, so if you don't have one, we've got you covered with a few recommendations. Most of these are 30-watt chargers that will fast-charge most iPhones. If you want the fastest speeds on the iPhone 18 models, you'll need a 40-watt charger, and we have some picks for you.
paras.zh: 自 iPhone 12 以来，Apple 就不再在包装盒中提供充电模块，因此，如果您没有充电模块，我们可以为您提供一些建议。其中大多数是 30 瓦充电器，可为大多数 iPhone 快速充电。如果您想在 iPhone 18 机型上获得最快的速度，则需要一个 40 瓦的充电器，我们为您提供了一些选择。

paras.en: Anker 511 Nano 3 30-Watt Charger for $16: This is one of the tiniest chargers we've tested, and the prongs fold up for even more space savings. It comes in fun colors, and it's nice and cheap.
paras.zh: Anker 511 Nano 3 30 瓦充电器售价 16 美元：这是我们测试过的最小的充电器之一，并且插脚可折叠以节省更多空间。它有有趣的颜色，而且又漂亮又便宜。

paras.en: Counterpart The Charger for $44: Why carry a charger and cable separately when you can get both in one? Retractable chargers are popular, and I love this attractive model from Counterpart. You can get it in a few colors, and the USB-C cable extends up to 4 feet. The prongs fold so they won't scratch anything in your bag, and the 35-watt output is enough to fast-charge most iPhones and iPads. It'll recharge a MacBook, though a MacBook Pro requires a more powerful charger.
paras.zh: 对应的充电器售价 44 美元：既然充电器和数据线可以合二为一，为什么还要单独携带呢？可伸缩充电器很受欢迎，我喜欢 Counterpart 的这款有吸引力的型号。您可以选择多种颜色，USB-C 电缆可延长至 4 英尺。插脚可折叠，因此不会划伤包中的任何物品，35 瓦的输出足以为大多数 iPhone 和 iPad 快速充电。它可以为 MacBook 充电，但 MacBook Pro 需要更强大的充电器。

paras.en: Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter for $39: Apple's Dynamic Power Adapter will get you the fastest charging speeds possible on the iPhone 17 models. That's 50 percent in just 20 minutes, and I was able to replicate that in my tests. It's a smaller charger than prior models, and it's one of the few chargers with SPR AVS support (Standard Power Range Adjustable Voltage Supply). It's a mouthful, but essentially, it can boost power output up to 60 watts when needed. That means it's a more versatile charger that you can use for your MacBook Air and your iPhone.
paras.zh: Apple 40W 动态电源适配器售价 39 美元：Apple 动态电源适配器将为您的 iPhone 17 机型提供最快的充电速度。只需 20 分钟即可完成 50%，并且我能够在测试中复制这一点。它是一款比之前型号更小的充电器，并且是少数支持 SPR AVS（标准功率范围可调电压供应）的充电器之一。虽然听起来很拗口，但本质上，它可以在需要时将功率输出提高至 60 瓦。这意味着它是一款功能更丰富的充电器，可用于 MacBook Air 和 iPhone。

paras.en: The problem with USB-C is that its capabilities are so vast, but not every USB-C cable supports every single function. You need to make sure the cable you buy supports video output, speedy data transfer, and fast charging if that's what you want. The cable Apple includes in the box can carry up to 60 watts of power, and that's pretty much it. You can use this cable to recharge a MacBook but maybe not a MacBook Pro under heavy load.
paras.zh: USB-C 的问题在于其功能如此广泛，但并非每条 USB-C 电缆都支持每一项功能。您需要确保您购买的电缆支持视频输出、快速数据传输和快速充电（如果您需要的话）。 Apple 包装盒中随附的电缆可承载高达 60 瓦的功率，仅此而已。您可以使用此电缆为 MacBook 充电，但在重负载下可能无法为 MacBook Pro 充电。

paras.en: If you get a cable like this one from Cable Matters, you'll be covered for every scenario. It supports up to 100 watts of power so you can use it for all your gadgets, has DisplayPort to work with external monitors, and supports up to 40 gigabits per second of data transfer. It also comes in multiple lengths.
paras.zh: 如果您从 Cable Matters 获得像这样的电缆，那么您将涵盖所有场景。它支持高达 100 瓦的功率，因此您可以将其用于所有小工具，具有 DisplayPort 可与外部显示器配合使用，并支持高达每秒 40 GB 的数据传输。它还具有多种长度。

paras.en: Read our Best USB-C Cables guide for more.
paras.zh: 请阅读我们的最佳 USB-C 线缆指南了解更多信息。

paras.en: The beauty of MagSafe is that you can pop a battery on the back of your iPhone, and you don't have to worry about any wires. This is our top recommendation, and it supports the Qi2 standard, so it will work with any device with Qi2. It has a 10,000-mAh capacity that is good to recharge an iPhone fully once and then some, and there's a built-in kickstand so you can continue watching your favorite show as it charges. Best of all is the built-in LED display, helpful for seeing how much juice the charger has left.
paras.zh: MagSafe 的美妙之处在于，您可以将电池安装在 iPhone 背面，而无需担心任何电线。这是我们的首要推荐，它支持 Qi2 标准，因此它可以与任何支持 Qi2 的设备配合使用。它具有 10,000 mAh 的容量，非常适合为 iPhone 一次充满电，然后再充电一次，并且有一个内置支架，因此您可以在充电时继续观看您喜爱的节目。最棒的是内置 LED 显示屏，有助于查看充电器还剩多少电量。

paras.en: Read our Best MagSafe Power Banks guide for more recommendations.
paras.zh: 请阅读我们的最佳 MagSafe 移动电源指南以获取更多建议。

paras.en: Apple has a dedicated slim MagSafe Battery for the iPhone Air. It takes advantage of the Air's new design and fits perfectly on the back. (It will work with other iPhones, but you have to place the battery horizontally, making the whole thing awkward.) No, this $99 accessory isn't really worth it. You can find higher-capacity batteries for less money. In my tests, I was able to get 68 percent back on my iPhone Air before the 3,149-mAh MagSafe Battery died. However, it's still pretty dang slim, works reliably, and fits like a glove. Maybe catch it on sale.
paras.zh: Apple 为 iPhone Air 提供了专用的超薄 MagSafe 电池。它利用了 Air 的全新设计，完美贴合背部。 （它可以与其他 iPhone 配合使用，但你必须水平放置电池，这让整个事情变得很尴尬。） 不，这个 99 美元的配件真的不值得。您可以花更少的钱找到更高容量的电池。在我的测试中，在 3,149 mAh MagSafe 电池耗尽之前，我的 iPhone Air 能够恢复 68% 的电量。然而，它仍然非常纤薄，工作可靠，而且像手套一样合身。也许能赶上特价。

paras.en: If you have an iPhone, there's a chance you have another Apple gadget, like AirPods or an Apple Watch. If so, you really should get a 3-in-1 charger for your home. We have tons of options in our Best Apple 3-in-1 Chargers guide, but this Belkin MagSafe model is our favorite. It has an elegant design and charges the iPhone and Apple Watch at maximum speeds, and you can pop your earbuds on the base to top them up. It won't work with the iPhone 16e unless you get a MagSafe case, and even then, you won't be privy to the faster and more efficient charging speeds.
paras.zh: 如果您有 iPhone，那么您也有可能拥有其他 Apple 产品，例如 AirPods 或 Apple Watch。如果是这样，您确实应该为您的家购买一个三合一充电器。我们的最佳苹果三合一充电器指南中有大量选择，但这款 Belkin MagSafe 型号是我们的最爱。它设计优雅，能够以最快的速度为 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 充电，您还可以将耳塞放在底座上为其充电。除非你有 MagSafe 保护壳，否则它无法与 iPhone 16e 配合使用，即便如此，你也无法享受到更快、更高效的充电速度。

paras.en: Hate bringing a wallet with you everywhere? Stick it to the back of your iPhone! This Nomad leather wallet is classy and can hold about four cards. What makes it unique is that it features Apple's Find My, meaning you can track its location in the Find My app if you lose it. That does mean the wallet needs to recharge every once in a while, but you can conveniently recharge it with any MagSafe charger, no proprietary cable needed. (It should last around five months on a single charge.) Read our Best MagSafe Wallets guide for more options.
paras.zh: 讨厌到处都带着钱包吗？将其粘贴到 iPhone 背面！这款 Nomad 皮革钱包非常优雅，可容纳大约四张卡片。它的独特之处在于它具有 Apple 的“查找我的”功能，这意味着如果您丢失了它，您可以在“查找我的”应用程序中跟踪它的位置。这确实意味着钱包需要每隔一段时间充电一次，但您可以使用任何 MagSafe 充电器方便地为其充电，无需专用电缆。 （一次充电可持续使用约五个月。）请阅读我们的最佳 MagSafe 钱包指南以了解更多选项。

paras.en: The MagSafe world is wonderful and weird. We have plenty more recommendations in our Best MagSafe Accessories guide, ranging from MagSafe camera cages and tripods to notepads you can magnetically stick to the back of your iPhone.
paras.zh: MagSafe 的世界既奇妙又奇怪。我们在“最佳 MagSafe 配件”指南中提供了更多建议，从 MagSafe 相机架和三脚架到可以磁性粘在 iPhone 背面的记事本。

paras.en: The iPhone 14 and older iPhones are probably available somewhere, but you shouldn't take the bait. They don't have the processing power to keep up with the latest software, and even if they do, they will have a much shorter software shelf life or lack modern features like USB-C. The only older iPhones worth considering at the moment are the iPhone 15 or iPhone 16 series, even better if it's the Pro models, if you can find them at low prices. The iPhone 16e is also another option, though only if you can find it at a steep discount.
paras.zh: iPhone 14 和旧款 iPhone 可能在某处有售，但您不应该上当。它们没有跟上最新软件的处理能力，即使有，它们的软件保质期也会短得多，或者缺乏 USB-C 等现代功能。目前唯一值得考虑的旧款 iPhone 是 iPhone 15 或 iPhone 16 系列，如果是 Pro 型号就更好了，如果你能以低价找到它们。 iPhone 16e 也是另一种选择，但前提是你能以大幅折扣找到它。

paras.en: The iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, and iPhone XR are cut off from receiving the iOS 27 update, so they're especially ones to avoid. Without software support, your device will slowly become less secure and could become a slow, buggy mess.
paras.zh: iPhone XS、iPhone XS Max 和 iPhone XR 无法接收 iOS 27 更新，因此尤其要避免使用它们。如果没有软件支持，您的设备将慢慢变得不那么安全，并且可能会变得缓慢且充满漏洞。

paras.en: The iPhone's Charging Port Is USB-C, Not Lightning
paras.zh: iPhone 的充电端口是 USB-C，而不是 Lightning

paras.en: The iPhone 15 range ditched the long-standing Lightning port for USB-C, and it's in every iPhone since. This is the same charging port on iPads, MacBooks, Android phones, Windows laptops, and many more personal tech gadgets. USB-C is often called the “universal port” because it can technically handle various responsibilities. For example, you can plug in external displays and extend the iPhone's screen or connect the same USB-C accessories you might be currently using on your laptop, like SD card readers. Sadly, it does mean your Lightning accessories won't work unless you get dongles.
paras.zh: iPhone 15 系列放弃了长期存在的 Lightning 端口，转而采用 USB-C，此后的每款 iPhone 都采用了 USB-C 端口。这与 iPad、MacBook、Android 手机、Windows 笔记本电脑和许多其他个人科技产品上的充电端口相同。 USB-C 通常被称为“通用端口”，因为它在技术上可以处理各种职责。例如，您可以插入外部显示器并扩展 iPhone 的屏幕，或者连接您当前在笔记本电脑上使用的相同 USB-C 配件，例如 SD 读卡器。遗憾的是，这确实意味着除非您有适配器，否则您的闪电配件将无法工作。

paras.en: The iPhone 15, iPhone 15 Plus, iPhone 16, iPhone 16 Plus, iPhone 16e, iPhone 17, iPhone 17e, and iPhone Air support the USB 2.0 standard just like the iPhones before, so you'll max out at 480 megabits per second of data transfer speeds.
paras.zh: iPhone 15、iPhone 15 Plus、iPhone 16、iPhone 16 Plus、iPhone 16e、iPhone 17、iPhone 17e 和 iPhone Air 与之前的 iPhone 一样支持 USB 2.0 标准，因此数据传输速度可达每秒 480 兆比特。

paras.en: The iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPhone 16 Pro, iPhone 16 Pro Max, iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Duo support the USB 3.0 standard and are capable of up to 10 gigabits per second of data transfer speeds.
paras.zh: iPhone 15 Pro、iPhone 15 Pro Max、iPhone 16 Pro、iPhone 16 Pro Max、iPhone 17 Pro、iPhone 17 Pro Max、iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max 和 iPhone Duo 支持 USB 3.0 标准，数据传输速度高达每秒 10 GB。

paras.en: There's a chance you may still run into some issues, especially if you're coming from an Android phone (or want to switch back to an Android phone). You'll have to check with your carrier to get your cellular connection working again. It shouldn't take long, but it's not as simple as popping in a physical card.
paras.zh: 您可能仍然会遇到一些问题，特别是如果您使用的是 Android 手机（或想要切换回 Android 手机）。您必须与您的运营商联系才能使您的蜂窝网络连接再次正常工作。应该不会花很长时间，但它并不像插入实体卡那么简单。

paras.en: If you don't want to spend the money to get a new iPhone, consider a fresh battery. If the biggest issues with your aging iPhone revolve around how long it lasts in a day, replacing the battery might make it feel brand-new. (Apple's iPhone 16, 16 Plus, and 16e have an easier-to-replace battery.)
paras.zh: 如果您不想花钱购买新 iPhone，请考虑购买新电池。如果老化的 iPhone 最大的问题在于它一天的续航时间，那么更换电池可能会让它感觉焕然一新。 （Apple 的 iPhone 16、16 Plus 和 16e 的电池更容易更换。）

paras.en: Replacements for older iPhones are $89, and $99 or $119 for newer models. If that doesn't do the trick, read our guide on ways to fix your iPhone's problems or our guide on selling your iPhone to get the most money for it.
paras.zh: 旧款 iPhone 的更换价格为 89 美元，新款 iPhone 的更换价格为 99 美元或 119 美元。如果这不起作用，请阅读我们有关解决 iPhone 问题的方法的指南，或有关出售 iPhone 以获得最大收益的指南。

paras.en: What Is the Action Button and Camera Control Button?
paras.zh: 什么是动作按钮和相机控制按钮？

paras.en: The Action Button debuted on the iPhone 15 Pro models, and it's now standard on every iPhone in the lineup. It sits above the volume rocker on the left edge of the phone. It effectively replaces the old Mute Switch, but think of it as just a configurable button. You can have it still control the mute function of the phone, or customize it (Settings > Action Button) to trigger the flashlight, a Voice Memo, or even launch an app or Shortcut.
paras.zh: 操作按钮首次出现在 iPhone 15 Pro 机型上，现在已成为该系列中每款 iPhone 的标配。它位于手机左侧边缘的音量摇杆上方。它有效地取代了旧的静音开关，但将其视为只是一个可配置的按钮。您仍然可以让它控制手机的静音功能，或对其进行自定义（设置 > 操作按钮）以触发手电筒、语音备忘录，甚至启动应用程序或快捷方式。

paras.en: Camera Control is another newer addition that debuted on the iPhone 16 series. On the right edge of the phone below the power button, press it to launch the Camera app, and you can press it to capture a photo or start recording a video. A light tap and swipe can move through different camera lenses or modes, but I found this annoying. (You can configure it by heading to Settings > Camera > Camera Control.) Press and hold this button, and you'll trigger Apple's Visual Intelligence. It'll use the camera to identify subjects in front of you, very much like Google Lens, so you can ask questions via Google or ChatGPT about what you're looking at.
paras.zh: 相机控制是 iPhone 16 系列上首次推出的另一个新功能。在手机右边缘电源按钮下方，按下它可启动相机应用程序，然后您可以按下它来拍摄照片或开始录制视频。轻按和滑动可以在不同的相机镜头或模式之间移动，但我发现这很烦人。 （您可以通过前往“设置”>“相机”>“相机控制”来配置它。）按住此按钮，您将触发 Apple 的视觉智能。它将使用摄像头识别您面前的拍摄对象，非常类似于 Google Lens，因此您可以通过 Google 或 ChatGPT 就您正在查看的内容提出问题。

articles.title: Look: Public works employee rescues stuffed animal from storm drain

paras.en: Oct. 23 (UPI) -- A public works employee in an Ohio city is being praised for an unusual rescue involving a stuffed toy that fell into a storm drain.
paras.zh: 10 月 23 日（合众国际社）——俄亥俄州一座城市的一名公共工程员工因一次不寻常的救援行动而受到赞扬，这次救援涉及一个掉入雨水渠的毛绒玩具。

paras.en: The City of Riverside said in a social media post that Riverside Public Works employee Kevin Miller fished into action when a young child lost their stuffed toy into a storm drain on the way to school.
paras.zh: 河滨市在社交媒体上发帖称，河滨公共工程公司的员工凯文·米勒(Kevin Miller)在一名小孩在上学途中将毛绒玩具掉进雨水沟时采取了行动。

paras.en: "The child's mom called this in and sent the photos she took of Kevin's act of kindness," the post said.
paras.zh: 帖子中写道：“孩子的妈妈打电话过来，并发送了她拍摄的凯文善举的照片。”

paras.en: The photos show Miller removing a cover from the storm drain and using a reaching tool to life the stuffed cat.
paras.zh: 照片显示米勒从雨水渠上取下盖子，并使用伸手工具救活了这只毛绒猫。

paras.en: "It may seem like a small act of kindness, but to a child, that stuffed animal means the world," officials wrote. "Thank you, Kevin, for showing that heroes don't always wear capes -- sometimes, they wear a City of Riverside employee badge!"
paras.zh: 官员们写道：“这似乎是一个小小的善举，但对于一个孩子来说，这只毛绒动物意味着整个世界。” “凯文，谢谢你让我们看到英雄并不总是穿着斗篷——有时，他们会佩戴河滨市员工徽章！”

articles.title: Mexico arrests alleged cartel leader tied to deadly car bombing

paras.en: Oct. 23 (UPI) -- Mexican authorities arrested Leopoldo David López Sánchez, also known as "Mando 20" or "T-20," an alleged leader of a criminal cell linked to the Jalisco New Generation Cartel in connection with a car bombing that killed six people in the western state of Michoacán.
paras.zh: 10 月 23 日（UPI）——墨西哥当局逮捕了莱奥波尔多·大卫·洛佩斯·桑切斯（Leopoldo David López Sánchez），他也被称为“Mando 20”或“T-20”，据称是与哈利斯科新一代卡特尔有关联的一个犯罪团伙的头目，该犯罪团伙与西部米却肯州发生的一起造成六人死亡的汽车爆炸事件有关。

paras.en: López Sánchez is suspected of orchestrating the attack and coordinating criminal violence in the region.
paras.zh: 洛佩斯·桑切斯涉嫌策划此次袭击并协调该地区的犯罪暴力活动。

paras.en: Two other suspected members of the criminal organization, identified as Sinuhe "N" and Cristian "N," were also arrested during the operation, Security and Citizen Protection Secretary Omar García Harfuch announced Friday.
paras.zh: 安全和公民保护部长奥马尔·加西亚·哈富赫周五宣布，该犯罪组织的另外两名涉嫌成员，即西努赫“N”和克里斯蒂安“N”，也在行动中被捕。

paras.en: García Harfuch said the suspects were linked to the Dec. 6, 2025, explosion of a vehicle outside the headquarters of the community police force in Coahuayana, Michoacán, which killed six people and injured several others.
paras.zh: 加西亚·哈富奇表示，嫌疑人与 2025 年 12 月 6 日米却肯州科阿瓦亚纳社区警察部队总部外的一辆汽车爆炸有关，该爆炸造成 6 人死亡、数人受伤。

paras.en: The arrests followed intelligence and surveillance operations in the municipality of Tecomán, in Colima, one of Mexico's smallest states.
paras.zh: 此次逮捕行动是在墨西哥最小的州之一科利马州特科曼市的情报和监视行动之后进行的。

paras.en: Authorities searched two properties in the municipality as part of an investigation coordinated by the Mexican Navy's Naval Intelligence Unit, the Security and Citizen Protection Ministry and the Attorney General's Office through its Criminal Investigation Agency.
paras.zh: 作为墨西哥海军海军情报部门、安全和公民保护部以及总检察长办公室通过刑事调查机构协调的调查的一部分，当局搜查了该市的两处房产。

paras.en: During the raids, authorities seized firearms, vehicles, cash, documents and propaganda associated with the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, García Harfuch said.
paras.zh: 加西亚·哈富奇说，在突袭中，当局查获了与哈​​利斯科新一代卡特尔有关的枪支、车辆、现金、文件和宣传品。

paras.en: Investigators identified López Sánchez as the alleged leader of a CJNG cell operating in Tecomán and surrounding municipalities.
paras.zh: 调查人员确认洛佩斯·桑切斯是在特科曼及周边城市活动的 CJNG 组织的头目。

paras.en: Authorities are continuing their investigation into the December bombing to identify everyone involved, including those who carried out the attack and those who ordered it.
paras.zh: 当局正在继续调查 12 月的爆炸事件，以查明所有涉案人员的身份，包括发动袭击的人和下令发动袭击的人。

paras.en: "An attack that claimed the lives of six people cannot go unpunished," García Harfuch said in a statement posted on X.
paras.zh: 加西亚·哈富奇 (García Harfuch) 在 X 上发布的一份声明中表示：“一场夺走六人生命的袭击不能逃脱惩罚。”

paras.en: He emphasized the importance of coordination between federal and state security agencies in combating criminal organizations and protecting Mexican communities.
paras.zh: 他强调联邦和州安全机构之间协调在打击犯罪组织和保护墨西哥社区方面的重要性。

paras.en: Initial reports suggested the explosive device had been remotely detonated. However, the driver who brought the vehicle to the community police headquarters was unable to escape and died at the scene, Mexican newspaper El Financiero reported.
paras.zh: 初步报告表明爆炸装置是远程引爆的。然而，据墨西哥报纸《金融报》报道，将车辆开往社区警察总部的司机未能逃脱，当场死亡。

paras.en: According to local media reports, the bombing was primarily linked to a territorial dispute between the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and the rival Cárteles Unidos criminal alliance, as well as confrontations with local community police groups.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，这起爆炸事件主要与哈利斯科新一代卡特尔与竞争对手卡特尔联盟犯罪联盟之间的领土争端以及与当地社区警察团体的对抗有关。

paras.en: Community police forces in parts of Mexico are locally organized security groups that operate in areas affected by organized crime.
paras.zh: 墨西哥部分地区的社区警察部队是当地组织的安全团体，在受有组织犯罪影响的地区开展活动。

paras.en: At the time of the bombing, García Harfuch ruled out a terrorist motive, saying the attack stemmed from a conflict between organized crime groups over power and territorial control.
paras.zh: 爆炸发生时，加西亚·哈富赫排除了恐怖主义动机，称袭击源于有组织犯罪集团之间对权力和领土控制的冲突。

articles.title: Michigan woman turns birthday money into $150,000 lottery prize

paras.en: Oct. 23 (UPI) -- A Michigan woman used money she received for her birthday to play an online lottery game and wound up winning a $150,000 prize.
paras.zh: 10 月 23 日（合众国际社）——一名密歇根州妇女用她收到的生日礼物玩在线彩票游戏，最终赢得了 15 万美元的奖金。

paras.en: The 47-year-old Oakland County woman told Michigan Lottery officials her road to lottery luck started with a birthday gift.
paras.zh: 这位 47 岁的奥克兰县妇女告诉密歇根州彩票官员，她的彩票好运之路始于一份生日礼物。

paras.en: "My aunt sent me a card with money in it for my birthday which was a few days prior, so I used the money buy an online game card," the player said. "I was playing Lucky Coins Disco Pig and decided to do one $20 wager. When the game finished and $150,000 came up on the screen, I thought to myself: 'Did I play in demo mode? This can't be real!' It was the best birthday gift ever!"
paras.zh: “前几天我的生日，阿姨给我寄了一张卡，里面有钱，我就用这些钱买了一张网游卡。”该玩家说道。 “我当时正在玩 Lucky Coins Disco Pig，决定下注 20 美元。当游戏结束并且屏幕上出现 150,000 美元时，我心想：‘我玩的是演示模式吗？这不可能是真的！’这是有史以来最好的生日礼物！”

paras.en: The recent birthday celebrant said some of her prize money will go toward a new car and the rest will go into savings.
paras.zh: 最近的生日庆祝者表示，她的部分奖金将用于购买新车，其余的将用于储蓄。

articles.title: Billy Corgan on Why He’s Stood By Marilyn Manson: ‘I Don’t Want the World to Tell Me Who My Friends Are’
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: Billy Corgan is standing by Marilyn Manson. In his Thursday (Oct. 22) appearance on The New York Times Popcast, The Smashing Pumpkins frontman explained why he’s maintained his friendship with the controversial shock rocker.
paras.zh: 比利·科根站在玛丽莲·曼森一边。周四（10 月 22 日），Smashing Pumpkins 主唱在《纽约时报 Popcast》节目中解释了他与这位备受争议的摇滚歌手保持友谊的原因。

paras.en: “As a Christian person, you have to stand by your friends, but that doesn’t mean you don’t have an opinion, and it doesn’t mean you’re not critical,” Corgan began, pausing to choose his words carefully. “In his case — and I’m not here to adjudicate it — but the [district attorney] looked at the case for five years.”
paras.zh: “作为一名基督徒，你必须支持你的朋友，但这并不意味着你没有意见，也不意味着你不挑剔，”科根开始说道，停下来仔细选择他的措辞。 “就他的案件而言——我不是来裁决的——但[地区检察官]对此案进行了五年的审查。”

paras.en: “In some cases, I knew personal things behind the scenes that are not in the public sphere,” the Chicago musician continued. “I personally didn’t feel that he was guilty of the things that he was being charged with, and ultimately the fact that the DA didn’t pursue … [it] was commensurate with the person I knew.”
paras.zh: “在某些情况下，我知道幕后不属于公共领域的个人事情，”这位芝加哥音乐家继续说道。 “我个人并不认为他对自己被指控的事情有罪，而且最终检察官没有追究这一事实……[这]与我认识的人相称。”

paras.en: Corgan and Manson — whose real name is Brian Warner — have known each other for decades. A couple of years after they became friends in the ’90s, they went through a rift that lasted up until 2015, when they reunited to embark on their joint End Times Tour.
paras.zh: 科根和曼森——真名是布莱恩·华纳——已经认识几十年了。他们在 90 年代成为朋友几年后，他们经历了一段裂痕，一直持续到 2015 年，他们才重聚，开始了他们的联合 End Times 巡演。

paras.en: It was about six years after the two men buried the hatchet that Evan Rachel Wood named Manson as her alleged abuser after years of advocating against domestic violence, which was followed by multiple other women coming forward with accusations of sexual assault and misconduct against the rocker; Manson has continuously denied all of the claims. In January 2025, Los Angeles DA Nathan J. Hochman announced that after investigating for four years, Manson would not face criminal charges due to the statute of limitations on the charges and a lack of ways to prove them.
paras.zh: 两人言归于好大约六年后，埃文·雷切尔·伍德(Evan Rachel Wood)在多年倡导反对家庭暴力后，将曼森列为她所谓的施虐者，随后又有多名女性站出来指控这位摇滚歌手性侵犯和不当行为；曼森不断否认所有指控。 2025 年 1 月，洛杉矶地方检察官内森·J·霍克曼 (Nathan J. Hochman) 宣布，经过四年的调查，曼森将不会面临刑事指控，因为指控已有时效且缺乏证明方法。

paras.en: “While we are unable to bring charges in this matter, we recognize that the strong advocacy of the women involved has helped bring greater awareness to the challenges faced by survivors of domestic abuse and sexual assault,” Hochman stated at the time.
paras.zh: 霍赫曼当时表示：“虽然我们无法就此事提出指控，但我们认识到，涉案妇女的大力倡导有助于提高人们对家庭暴力和性侵犯幸存者所面临挑战的认识。”

paras.en: Manson’s attorney Howard King told Billboard shortly after the decision, “We are very pleased that, after a thorough and incredibly lengthy review of all of the actual evidence, the district attorney has concluded what we knew and expressed from the start — Brian Warner is innocent.”
paras.zh: 曼森的律师霍华德·金在判决后不久告诉《公告牌》，“我们非常高兴地看到，在对所有实际证据进行彻底且极其漫长的审查之后，地方检察官得出了我们从一开始就知道和表达的结论——布莱恩·华纳是无辜的。”

paras.en: On Popcast, Corgan shared a bit of his point of view on the legal proceedings. “I knew the inside baseball of the case, and so you make those evaluations,” he said. “At the end of the day, I feel I made the right determination.”
paras.zh: 在 Popcast 上，Corgan 分享了他对法律诉讼的一些看法。 “我了解案件的内部情况，所以你可以做出这些评估，”他说。 “最终，我觉得我做出了正确的决定。”

paras.en: “I don’t want the world to tell me who my friends are and who I should associate with, politically, socially,” Corgan also noted. “In Brian’s case, we have a relationship that goes back 30 years. Manson’s wife, Lindsay [Usich] is a twin, and her twin is Ashley, and Ashley is married to James Iha of the Pumpkins. So Manson’s basically a part of our family. There’s a deeper set of relationships there.”
paras.zh: “我不想让世界告诉我谁是我的朋友，以及我应该在政治上、社交上与谁交往，”科根还指出。 “就布莱恩而言，我们的关系可以追溯到 30 年前。曼森的妻子 Lindsay [Usich] 是双胞胎，她的双胞胎是阿什利，阿什利嫁给了南瓜队的詹姆斯·伊哈。所以曼森基本上是我们家庭的一部分。那里有更深层次的关系。”

paras.en: Though the criminal investigation into Manson was dropped, he has been dealing with civil lawsuits filed by some of his accusers for years. In January, his former assistant Ashley Walters successfully reopened her sexual assault lawsuit against him for a second time after two prior dismissals. He has also been sued by Game of Thrones actress Esmé Bianco — with whom he settled in 2023 — and model Ashley Morgan Smithline, whose case was dismissed that same year.
paras.zh: 尽管对曼森的刑事调查被撤销，但多年来他一直在处理一些原告提起的民事诉讼。今年一月，他的前助理阿什利·沃尔特斯(Ashley Walters)在两次被驳回后，成功第二次重新提起针对他的性侵犯诉讼。他还被《权力的游戏》女演员埃斯梅·比安科 (Esmé Bianco) 和模特阿什利·摩根·史密斯莱 (Ashley Morgan Smithline) 起诉（两人于 2023 年和解），后者的案件于同年被驳回。

paras.en: Again, Manson has always vehemently denied all of the allegations against him in each of the aforementioned cases, as well as the initial set of accusations made by Wood that sparked the chain of women coming forward. “The name of my abuser is Brian Warner, also known to the world as Marilyn Manson,” she alleged on Instagram at the time. “He started grooming me when I was a teenager and horrifically abused me for years. I was brainwashed and manipulated into submission. I am done living in fear of retaliation, slander or blackmail.”
paras.zh: 曼森再次强烈否认上述每起案件中针对他的所有指控，以及伍德最初提出的一系列指控，这些指控引发了一系列女性的站出来。 “施虐者的名字叫布莱恩·华纳 (Brian Warner)，全世界都知道她叫玛丽莲·曼森 (Marilyn Manson)，”她当时在 Instagram 上声称。 “当我十几岁的时候，他就开始培养我，多年来一直对我进行可怕的虐待。我被洗脑并被操纵屈服。我已经厌倦了生活在报复、诽谤或勒索的恐惧中。”

paras.en: “Obviously, my art and my life have long been magnets for controversy, but these recent claims about me are horrible distortions of reality,” Manson in response to the actress, with whom he was romantically involved for four years before parting ways months after getting engaged in 2010. “My intimate relationships have always been entirely consensual with like-minded partners. Regardless of how — and why — others are now choosing to misrepresent the past, that is the truth.”
paras.zh: “显然，我的艺术和我的生活长期以来一直引起争议，但最近这些关于我的说法是对现实的可怕扭曲，”曼森在回应这位女演员时说道，“我的亲密关系一直都是与志同道合的伴侣完全自愿的。无论其他人如何以及为何选择歪曲过去，这就是事实。”曼森与这位女演员恋爱了四年，然后在 2010 年订婚几个月后分道扬镳。

paras.en: If you or anyone you know needs support, you can reach out to the Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network. The organization provides free, confidential support to sexual assault victims. Call RAINN’s National Sexual Assault Hotline (800-656-HOPE) — which is available 24/7, 365 days — or visit the anti-sexual violence organization’s website.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的任何人需要支持，您可以联系强奸、虐待和乱伦国家网络。该组织为性侵犯受害者提供免费、保密的支持。请拨打 RAINN 的全国性侵犯热线 (800-656-HOPE)（365 天、每天 24/7）或访问反性暴力组织的网站。

articles.title: Drake, Travis Scott & Quavo Show Love to Druski for Upcoming ‘SNL’ Hosting Gig: ‘So F–king Proud’
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: Druski was announced as a season 52 host for Saturday Night Live on Thursday (Oct. 22), and plenty of his hip-hop friends showed him love for the trailblazing feat.
paras.zh: 周四（10 月 22 日），Druski 被宣布担任《周六夜现场》第 52 季的主持人，他的许多嘻哈朋友都对他这一开创性的壮举表示喜爱。

paras.en: Among those sending Druski congratulatory messages were Drake, Travis Scott, Quavo, Wheezy and Reese LaFlare.
paras.zh: 向 Druski 发送贺电的人包括 Drake、Travis Scott、Quavo、Wheezy 和 Reese LaFlare。

paras.en: “So f—king proud,” Drizzy wrote in Druski’s IG comments in the post announcing his upcoming hosting gig. Quavo added: “That boy good!”
paras.zh: “太他妈的自豪了，”Drizzy 在 Druski 的 IG 评论中写道，他宣布了即将主持的演出。夸沃补充道：“这孩子不错！”

paras.en: Fans can expect Travis Scott to be in attendance come Nov. 7 when Druski takes over Rockefeller Center’s Studio 8H in Midtown Manhattan.
paras.zh: 粉丝们可以期待特拉维斯·斯科特 (Travis Scott) 将于 11 月 7 日出席，届时德鲁斯基 (Druski) 接管曼哈顿中城洛克菲勒中心的 8H 工作室。

paras.en: “N—A WE MADE IT,” a hyped La Flame wrote. “I WILL BE THERE. !!!? CANT MISS THIS.” Scott also reposted Druski’s hosting gig on his IG Story. “What ever u doing on the 7th you gotta be tapped in,” he wrote.
paras.zh: “我们做到了，”大肆宣传的 La Flame 写道。 “我会在那里。！！！？不能错过这个。” Scott 还在他的 IG Story 上转发了 Druski 的主持演出。 “无论你在 7 号做什么，你都必须被监听，”他写道。

paras.en: Continuing his meteoric and unique rise in entertainment, Druski — who graced one of Billboard’s 2025 covers — will be the first-ever digital content creator to host SNL in the show’s history. The Strokes will perform as the musical guest on Nov. 7.
paras.zh: 德鲁斯基 (Druski) 继续在娱乐领域迅速而独特地崛起，他登上了 Billboard 2025 年封面，将成为该节目历史上第一位主持 SNL 的数字内容创作者。 The Strokes 乐队将于 11 月 7 日作为音乐嘉宾演出。

paras.en: In a rare candid interview with The Diary of a CEO in September, Druski opened up about his childhood and journey as an internet comedian, which saw him credit Drake with changing his trajectory after casting him in one of the rapper’s videos in 2020.
paras.zh: 在 9 月份接受《CEO 日记》的一次罕见的坦诚采访中，德鲁斯基讲述了他的童年和作为一名网络喜剧演员的旅程，他认为德雷克在 2020 年让德雷克出演了一位说唱歌手的视频后改变了他的人生轨迹。

paras.en: “The thing that changed my life at the time was Drake calling for the ‘Laugh Now Cry Later’ music video. Everything shifted after that because brands started to take me seriously,” he explained. “Now it’s transactional with everything.”
paras.zh: “当时改变我生活的事情是 Drake 呼吁制作‘Laugh Now Cry Later’音乐视频。此后一切都发生了变化，因为品牌开始认真对待我，”他解释道。 “现在它可以与一切事物进行交易。”

paras.en: Druski continued: “Once I was seen with Drake, Lil Durk, we had Marshawn Lynch, Kevin Durant, Odell Beckham Jr. all in this video alongside me. Me being the comedic relief in this video, which was called ‘Laugh Now, Cry Later,’ this meant a lot more than another music video.”
paras.zh: Druski 继续说道：“当我和 Drake、Lil Durk 一起出现在这个视频中时，Marshawn Lynch、Kevin Durant、Odell Beckham Jr. 都和我一起出现在这个视频中。我是这个视频中的喜剧演员，这个视频被称为“现在笑，稍后哭”，这比另一部音乐视频意义重大。”

paras.en: Season 52 of SNL is slated to resume on Halloween with Obsession actress Inde Navarrette hosting and Gracie Abrams performing. Following Druski’s episode, John Mulaney will play host on Nov. 14 with Phoebe Bridgers serving as the musical guest.
paras.zh: 《SNL》第 52 季定于万圣节恢复，由《Obsession》女演员 Inde Navarrette 主持，Gracie Abrams 表演。在 Druski 的剧集结束后，约翰·木兰尼 (John Mulaney) 将在 11 月 14 日担任主持人，菲比·布里杰斯 (Phoebe Bridgers) 担任音乐嘉宾。

articles.title: Executive Turntable: Barbara Cane Retires From BMI After 50 Years; Ron Broitman Named Global Synch President at WMG
articles.author: Ariel King

paras.en: Barbara Cane has announced her retirement from BMI after 50 years at the company. She most recently served as vp of worldwide creative at the publishing company, and agreed to continue serving in an advisory capacity working directly with CEO Mike O’Neill.
paras.zh: Barbara Cane 在公司工作 50 年后宣布从 BMI 退休。她最近担任出版公司全球创意副总裁，并同意继续以顾问身份直接与首席执行官迈克·奥尼尔合作。

paras.en: Cane began at BMI in 1970, where she worked part time while still in high school. She spent the entirety of her professional career at the company, starting in BMI’s Song Research department. She held roles including general manager of the Los Angeles office and as vp of create in New York, Los Angeles and London.
paras.zh: Cane 于 1970 年开始在 BMI 工作，当时她还在读高中时就在那里做兼职。她的整个职业生涯都在公司度过，从 BMI 的歌曲研究部门开始。她曾担任洛杉矶办事处的总经理以及纽约、洛杉矶和伦敦的 create 副总裁。

paras.en: “After more than five decades, BMI is not simply where I have built my career — it is part of who I am,” Cane said in a statement. “It gave me the opportunity to grow, to discover, and, most importantly, to uncover the soul within the songwriter. Through every chapter of my journey, I have come to understand that creativity is not simply a profession it is the heart of who songwriters are and the force that moves our industry forward. What has made this journey so meaningful is that my own values remain deeply aligned with those of BMI — to believe in creators, to nurture their gifts, and to create an environment in which their careers can flourish. After 50 years, that purpose still lives in my heart — and it is why this work has never felt simply like a career, but like a calling.”
paras.zh: 凯恩在一份声明中表示：“五十多年过去了，BMI 不仅仅是我建立职业生涯的地方，它也是我的一部分。” “它给了我成长、发现、最重要的是揭示歌曲作者内心灵魂的机会。通过我旅程的每一章，我逐渐明白创造力不仅仅是一种职业，它是词曲作者的核心，也是推动我们行业前进的力量。这段旅程之所以如此有意义，是因为我自己的价值观与 BMI 的价值观保持着深深的一致——相信创作者，培养他们的天赋，并创造一个让他们的职业生涯蓬勃发展的环境。50 年后，这个目标仍然活在我的心里——这就是为什么这项工作从来不只是一种职业，而是一种使命。”

paras.en: O’Neill added, “Barbara is one of the first people I met when I joined BMI almost 32 years ago, and her kindness, caring nature and warm welcome showed me exactly why she is so loved by so many in our industry. She has demonstrated that same care and attention time and again to the many songwriters she worked with, nurtured and supported, and it’s why her relationships in this industry have endured. While Barbara and I started out as colleagues, we’ve ended up as family, and I don’t know many who can say that about the people they work with. The beautiful thing for me is that Barbara has agreed to continue working with me as an advisor, allowing BMI and our writers to still have her insight and counsel, while also allowing her to enjoy some time away from us for the first time in fifty years.”
paras.zh: 奥尼尔补充道：“芭芭拉是我大约 32 年前加入 BMI 时遇到的第一批人之一，她的善良、关爱和热情欢迎让我明白了为什么她在我们的行业中如此受到如此多的喜爱。她一次又一次地向与她一起工作、培养和支持的许多歌曲作者表现出同样的关心和关注，这就是为什么她在这个行业的关系能够持久。虽然芭芭拉和我最初是同事，但我们最终成为了家人，我不知道有多少人能这样评价他们的同事，对我来说，最美妙的事情是，芭芭拉同意继续与我一起担任顾问，让 BMI 和我们的作家仍然能够得到她的见解和建议，同时也让她能够享受五十年来第一次离开我们的时光。”

paras.en: In 2019, Cane received the NMPA Lifetime Service Award, and she is a member of NARAS, CMA, ACM and the Songwriters Hall of Fame. She was named one of Billboard’s Top Women in Music in 2011 and 2024.
paras.zh: 2019年，Cane获得了NMPA终身服务奖，她是NARAS、CMA、ACM和歌曲作者名人堂的成员。她于 2011 年和 2024 年被评为公告牌音乐界最佳女性之一。

paras.en: “When it comes to inspiring and elevating songwriters, Barbara is in a league of her own,” Mike Steinberg, executive vp and chief revenue and creative officer at BMI, said in a statement. “Her innate gift for seeing in songwriters what they often could not yet see in themselves has left an indelible mark on the lives and careers of so many creators. She exemplifies what it means to be a mentor, advocate and champion for our creative community. I have been incredibly fortunate to call her one of my dearest friends, a treasured colleague and a once-in-a-lifetime teacher. I am just one of many people whose lives have been enriched by knowing and working alongside her. Barbara’s contributions to BMI, our affiliates and our creative community are quite simply immeasurable, and her enduring influence and legacy will continue to be felt through the songs, stories and songwriters whose journeys she has helped shape for generations to come.” — Ariel King
paras.zh: BMI 执行副总裁兼首席营收和创意官迈克·斯坦伯格 (Mike Steinberg) 在一份声明中表示：“在激励和提升词曲作者方面，芭芭拉处于领先地位。” “她在歌曲作者身上看到了他们在自己身上往往看不到的东西的天生天赋，这在许多创作者的生活和职业生涯中留下了不可磨灭的印记。她体现了成为我们创意社区的导师、倡导者和拥护者的意义。我非常幸运地称她为我最亲爱的朋友之一、一位珍贵的同事和一位千载难逢的老师。我只是通过认识她并与她一起工作而丰富了生活的许多人之一。芭芭拉的对 BMI、我们的附属机构和创意社区的贡献是不可估量的，她持久的影响力和遗产将继续通过她帮助塑造子孙后代的歌曲、故事和词曲作者感受到。” — 阿里尔·金
