paras.zh: 罗格斯大学牙科医学院的科学家在 PNAS Nexus 上发表的一项新研究表明，细菌会逐渐腐蚀牙种植体，将微小的钛颗粒释放到附近的组织中。这些颗粒会干扰负责抵抗感染的免疫细胞，使它们陷入过度炎症状态，从而逐渐破坏颌骨。

paras.en: The researchers examined human tissue samples, studied human immune cells in the laboratory, and conducted experiments using genetically engineered mice. Their investigation identified a calcium channel in macrophages, the immune cells that engulf bacteria, that becomes activated by titanium particles. When this channel was disabled in mice, the disease was prevented.
paras.zh: 研究人员检查了人体组织样本，在实验室研究了人体免疫细胞，并使用基因工程小鼠进行了实验。他们的研究发现了巨噬细胞（吞噬细菌的免疫细胞）中的钙通道，该通道被钛颗粒激活。当老鼠的这个通道被禁用时，这种疾病就被预防了。

paras.en: This discovery provides the first credible drug target for a condition that affects as many as one in five dental implant recipients and costs healthcare systems worldwide more than $1 billion annually.
paras.zh: 这一发现为这种疾病提供了第一个可靠的药物靶点，这种疾病影响多达五分之一的牙种植接受者，并且每年给全球医疗保健系统造成超过 10 亿美元的费用。

paras.en: "For the first time, we show why all the antibiotic treatments that work around teeth do not work around implants," said Georgios Kotsakis, senior author of the study and assistant dean for clinical research at Rutgers School of Dental Medicine. "Now that we know the cause, we can start developing therapeutics."
paras.zh: 该研究的资深作者、罗格斯大学牙科医学院临床研究助理院长 Georgios Kotsakis 说：“我们第一次证明了为什么所有对牙齿有效的抗生素治疗方法对种植体不起作用。” “既然我们知道了原因，我们就可以开始开发治疗方法了。”

paras.en: Why Dental Implant Infections Resist Antibiotics
paras.zh: 为什么种植牙感染对抗生素产生耐药性

paras.en: One of the biggest mysteries surrounding peri-implantitis has been its similarity to periodontitis, the gum disease that develops around natural teeth. Both conditions begin with the same types of bacteria found in the mouth, yet they respond very differently to treatment.
paras.zh: 种植体周围炎最大的谜团之一是它与牙周炎（一种在天然牙齿周围发生的牙龈疾病）的相似之处。这两种情况都始于口腔中发现的相同类型的细菌，但它们对治疗的反应却截然不同。

paras.en: For natural teeth, antibiotics combined with routine professional cleaning can resolve the infection. Around dental implants, however, the same medications are successful in fewer than half of cases. Even when treatment is attempted, the underlying jawbone may continue to deteriorate.
paras.zh: 对于天然牙齿，抗生素结合常规专业清洁可以解决感染。然而，在种植牙方面，相同的药物在不到一半的病例中取得成功。即使尝试治疗，下面的颌骨也可能继续恶化。

paras.en: For the past two decades, scientists have largely concentrated on the bacteria responsible for these infections. Researchers in Kotsakis' laboratory decided to investigate another possible contributor: the implant material itself.
paras.zh: 在过去的二十年里，科学家们主要关注导致这些感染的细菌。科察基斯实验室的研究人员决定研究另一个可能的因素：植入材料本身。

paras.en: Their work showed that bacteria accumulating on implant surfaces create acidic biofilms that slowly damage the titanium. Over time, this corrosion can release billions of microscopic metal particles, each smaller than a red blood cell.
paras.zh: 他们的工作表明，细菌在植入物表面积累会产生酸性生物膜，慢慢损坏钛。随着时间的推移，这种腐蚀会释放出数十亿个微小的金属颗粒，每个颗粒都比红细胞小。

paras.en: Titanium particles can also be dislodged during routine dental cleaning. This is particularly concerning when instruments designed for natural teeth are used on implants, because they can scrape and damage the metal surface.
paras.zh: 在日常牙齿清洁过程中，钛颗粒也可能被清除。当为天然牙设计的器械用于种植体时，这一点尤其令人担忧，因为它们会刮擦和损坏金属表面。

paras.en: How Titanium Particles Hijack the Immune System
paras.zh: 钛颗粒如何劫持免疫系统

paras.en: Once released into the gums, the tiny titanium fragments attract a bacterial toxin known as lipopolysaccharide, which coats their surfaces. This combination creates a deceptive target for the immune system, making the particles resemble unusually large bacteria that cannot be broken down.
paras.zh: 一旦释放到牙龈中，微小的钛碎片就会吸引一种称为脂多糖的细菌毒素，覆盖在牙龈表面。这种组合为免疫系统创造了一个欺骗性目标，使颗粒类似于无法分解的异常大的细菌。

paras.en: Macrophages, the white blood cells responsible for engulfing and destroying harmful microorganisms, attempt to consume these particles. But because the cells cannot digest titanium, they become stuck in a prolonged state of excessive inflammation.
paras.zh: 巨噬细胞是负责吞噬和消灭有害微生物的白细胞，试图消耗这些颗粒。但由于细胞无法消化钛，它们会陷入长期的过度炎症状态。

paras.en: As a result, the macrophages produce large quantities of inflammatory signaling molecules, including interleukin-1 beta. This protein is also associated with inflammatory processes involved in rheumatoid arthritis and Alzheimer's disease.
paras.zh: 结果，巨噬细胞产生大量炎症信号分子，包括白介素-1β。这种蛋白质还与类风湿性关节炎和阿尔茨海默氏病的炎症过程有关。

paras.en: The resulting immune response gradually breaks down the bone supporting the dental implant. At the same time, the macrophages become less effective at fighting the bacteria that triggered the infection in the first place.
paras.zh: 由此产生的免疫反应逐渐破坏支撑牙种植体的骨骼。与此同时，巨噬细胞在对抗最初引发感染的细菌方面变得不那么有效。

paras.en: Laboratory experiments revealed just how severely their defenses were disrupted. Macrophages exposed to titanium particles engulfed fewer than half as many bacteria as immune cells that had not encountered the particles.
paras.zh: 实验室实验揭示了它们的防御系统被破坏的严重程度。暴露于钛颗粒的巨噬细胞吞噬的细菌数量不到未接触钛颗粒的免疫细胞的一半。

paras.en: "These particles are little magnets that attract the bacterial toxin, and they hijack the immune system, preventing it from clearing bacteria," said Kotsakis. "You have a perfect storm that defies antibiotics."
paras.zh: 科察基斯说：“这些颗粒是吸引细菌毒素的小磁铁，它们会劫持免疫系统，阻止其清除细菌。” “你有一场对抗抗生素的完美风暴。”

paras.en: Scientists Identify a Potential New Treatment Target
paras.zh: 科学家确定了潜在的新治疗目标

paras.en: After uncovering how titanium particles disrupt immune defenses, the researchers investigated the molecular pathway responsible for the damaging reaction.
paras.zh: 在揭示钛颗粒如何破坏免疫防御后，研究人员研究了导致破坏性反应的分子途径。

paras.en: They traced the process to TRPC1, a calcium channel (a specialized, pore-forming protein structure within cell membranes) found in macrophages. This channel plays a central role in the inflammatory response triggered by titanium particles and bacterial toxins.
paras.zh: 他们将这一过程追溯到TRPC1，这是一种在巨噬细胞中发现的钙通道（细胞膜内一种特殊的成孔蛋白质结构）。该通道在钛颗粒和细菌毒素引发的炎症反应中发挥着核心作用。

paras.en: To test its importance, the team used genetically engineered mice that lacked TRPC1. When these animals were exposed to the same combination of titanium particles and bacteria, their immune systems responded much more effectively.
paras.zh: 为了测试其重要性，研究小组使用了缺乏 TRPC1 的基因工程小鼠。当这些动物接触相同的钛颗粒和细菌组合时，它们的免疫系统反应更有效。

paras.en: The mice developed dramatically smaller abscesses, produced fewer inflammatory signaling molecules, and regained the ability to clear bacteria. Disabling the channel prevented the destructive disease process observed when TRPC1 was present.
paras.zh: 这些小鼠出现了明显更小的脓肿，产生了更少的炎症信号分子，并重新获得了清除细菌的能力。禁用该通道可以防止 TRPC1 存在时观察到的破坏性疾病过程。

paras.en: The results point toward a potentially new approach to treating peri-implantitis by targeting the immune system response rather than relying exclusively on antibiotics.
paras.zh: 研究结果指出，通过针对免疫系统反应而不是仅仅依赖抗生素来治疗种植体周围炎的潜在新方法。

paras.en: With funding from the National Institutes of Health, Kotsakis and his colleagues are now evaluating potential drugs that act on the same molecular pathway in human cells.
paras.zh: 在美国国立卫生研究院的资助下，科察基斯和他的同事现在正在评估作用于人类细胞中相同分子途径的潜在药物。

paras.en: Why Proper Dental Implant Cleaning Matters
paras.zh: 为什么正确的种植牙清洁很重要

paras.en: Although the research opens the door to future therapies, it also reinforces an important preventive measure for people who already have dental implants.
paras.zh: 尽管这项研究为未来的治疗打开了大门，但它也为已经种植牙的人强化了一项重要的预防措施。

paras.en: Regular professional cleaning remains the strongest known protection against peri-implantitis. However, the instruments and techniques used during those appointments can make a significant difference.
paras.zh: 定期的专业清洁仍然是预防种植体周围炎的最强已知保护措施。然而，在这些预约期间使用的仪器和技术可能会产生重大影响。

paras.en: Until approximately a decade ago, many dentists routinely cleaned implants with the same metal scalers used to remove deposits from natural teeth. Research by the Rutgers team and other scientists has since demonstrated that these tools can damage and corrode titanium surfaces, potentially releasing additional particles and accelerating the disease.
paras.zh: 直到大约十年前，许多牙医还经常使用用于去除天然牙齿沉积物的相同金属洁牙机清洁种植体。罗格斯大学团队和其他科学家的研究表明，这些工具会损坏和腐蚀钛表面，可能释放额外的颗粒并加速疾病的发生。

paras.en: Today, nonabrasive cleaning methods have become standard practice, helping protect implant surfaces while reducing the risk of complications.
paras.zh: 如今，非磨蚀性清洁方法已成为标准做法，有助于保护种植体表面，同时降低并发症的风险。

paras.en: By revealing how corroded titanium can interfere with immune defenses, the findings offer a new explanation for why some dental implant infections are so difficult to treat and identify a promising direction for developing more effective therapies.
paras.zh: 通过揭示腐蚀的钛如何干扰免疫防御，这些发现为为什么某些牙种植体感染如此难以治疗提供了新的解释，并确定了开发更有效疗法的有希望的方向。

paras.en: Materials provided by Rutgers University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由罗格斯大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Juliana GirÃ³n Bastidas, Danyal A Siddiqui, Viviane Nascimento Da Conceicao, Yuyang Sun, Mashael Al Thunayan, Brij B Singh, Georgios A Kotsakis. Implant-derived titanium particles impair macrophage bacterial clearance via TRPC1 and lysosomal dysfunction. PNAS Nexus, 2026; 5 (4) DOI: 10.1093/pnasnexus/pgag081
paras.zh: - Juliana Girón Bastidas、Danyal A Siddiqui、Viviane Nascimento Da Conceicao、Yuyang Sun、Mashael Al Thunayan、Brij B Singh、Georgios A Kotsakis。植入物衍生的钛颗粒通过 TRPC1 和溶酶体功能障碍损害巨噬细胞的细菌清除率。美国国家科学院院刊，2026 年； 5 (4) DOI：10.1093/pnasnexus/pgag081

articles.title: One of Earth’s most powerful supervolcanoes is refilling with fresh magma

paras.en: One of Earthâs most powerful supervolcanoes is refilling with fresh magma
paras.zh: 地球上最强大的超级火山之一正在充满新鲜的岩浆

paras.en: - Deep beneath Japanâs Kikai caldera, a massive magma reservoir is refilling 7,300 years after one of the most powerful volcanic eruptions in Earth's recent geological history. Scientists used underwater seismic surveys to reveal a vast store of magma that appears to have accumulated since the ancient catastrophe. The discovery could help explain how supervolcanoes like Yellowstone and Toba rebuild their magma supplies.
paras.zh: - 在日本 Kikai 火山口的深处，一个巨大的岩浆库正在重新充盈，这是地球近代地质史上最猛烈的火山喷发之一之后的 7,300 年。科学家利用水下地震勘测揭示了自古代灾难以来积累的大量岩浆。这一发现可能有助于解释黄石公园和多巴火山等超级火山如何重建岩浆供应。

paras.en: One of Earth's most powerful supervolcanoes is slowly refilling its enormous underground magma reservoir, thousands of years after producing one of the largest volcanic eruptions in recent geological history. Scientists at Kobe University have discovered evidence that fresh magma is accumulating beneath Japan's Kikai caldera, which unleashed a catastrophic eruption about 7,300 years ago.
paras.zh: 地球上最强大的超级火山之一正在缓慢地重新填充其巨大的地下岩浆库，数千年前发生了近代地质史上最大规模的火山喷发之一。神户大学的科学家发现了证据，表明新鲜的岩浆正在日本的 Kikai 火山口下方积聚，该火山口在大约 7,300 年前引发了一场灾难性的喷发。

paras.en: The discovery offers a rare look at how giant volcanic systems rebuild their magma supplies after massive eruptions. It could also provide important clues about the behavior of other supervolcanoes, including Yellowstone in the United States and Toba in Indonesia, potentially helping scientists improve their ability to recognize warning signs of future eruptions.
paras.zh: 这一发现为人们罕见地了解了巨型火山系统在大规模喷发后如何重建岩浆供应提供了机会。它还可以提供有关其他超级火山行为的重要线索，包括美国的黄石火山和印度尼西亚的多巴火山，有可能帮助科学家提高识别未来喷发警告信号的能力。

paras.en: How Supervolcanoes Store Enormous Amounts of Magma
paras.zh: 超级火山如何储存大量岩浆

paras.en: Some volcanic eruptions are so immense that they dramatically reshape the landscape. The amount of magma released can be staggering, enough to bury all of New York City's Central Park beneath a layer roughly 12 kilometers (7.5 miles) thick.
paras.zh: 有些火山喷发的规模如此之大，以至于极大地重塑了地貌。释放的岩浆量可能非常惊人，足以将整个纽约中央公园埋在大约 12 公里（7.5 英里）厚的岩浆层之下。

paras.en: When such enormous volumes of magma escape from underground, the rock above the emptied reservoir can collapse, leaving behind a broad, relatively shallow depression known as a caldera. These features are associated with some of the most powerful eruptions in Earth's history.
paras.zh: 当如此大量的岩浆从地下逸出时，排空的水库上方的岩石可能会塌陷，留下一个宽阔、相对较浅的凹陷，称为破火山口。这些特征与地球历史上一些最强烈的火山喷发有关。

paras.en: Famous examples include Yellowstone, Toba, and Japan's Kikai caldera, most of which lies beneath the ocean. Kikai last experienced a giant eruption approximately 7,300 years ago, producing the largest known volcanic eruption of the Holocene, the geological epoch that began roughly 11,700 years ago and continues today.
paras.zh: 著名的例子包括黄石公园、鸟羽公园和日本的 Kikai 火山口，其中大部分位于海底。 Kikai 上次经历一次大喷发是在大约 7,300 年前，产生了全新世已知最大规模的火山喷发，这一地质时代开始于大约 11,700 年前并持续至今。

paras.en: Although scientists know that giant caldera volcanoes can erupt more than once, they still have an incomplete understanding of how the enormous quantities of magma required for these events accumulate underground. This makes it extremely difficult to anticipate when another major eruption might occur.
paras.zh: 尽管科学家知道巨型破火山口火山可以多次喷发，但他们仍然不完全了解这些事件所需的大量岩浆是如何在地下积聚的。这使得预测何时可能发生另一次大规模喷发变得极其困难。

paras.en: "We must understand how such large quantities of magma can accumulate to understand how giant caldera eruptions occur," says Kobe University geophysicist Nobukazu Seama.
paras.zh: “我们必须了解如此大量的岩浆是如何积聚的，才能了解巨型火山口喷发是如何发生的，”神户大学地球物理学家 Seama Nobukazu 说道。

paras.en: Scientists Discover a Massive Magma Reservoir Beneath Japan
paras.zh: 科学家在日本地下发现了巨大的岩浆库

paras.en: Kikai's underwater location might seem like an obstacle to studying the volcano, but it actually gives researchers an important advantage. The surrounding seafloor allows scientists to carry out extensive geological surveys across the volcanic structure.
paras.zh: Kikai 的水下位置似乎是研究这座火山的一个障碍，但它实际上为研究人员提供了一个重要的优势。周围的海底使科学家能够对火山结构进行广泛的地质调查。

paras.en: "The underwater location allows us to implement systematic, large-scale surveys," Seama explains.
paras.zh: “水下位置使我们能够实施系统的大规模调查，”Seama 解释道。

paras.en: To investigate what lies beneath Kikai, researchers from Kobe University collaborated with the Japan Agency for Marine-Earth Science and Technology (JAMSTEC). They used powerful airgun arrays to generate seismic pulses that traveled through the crust beneath the ocean floor.
paras.zh: 为了调查 Kikai 之下的情况，神户大学的研究人员与日本海洋地球科学技术机构 (JAMSTEC) 合作。他们使用强大的气枪阵列来产生穿过海底地壳的地震脉冲。

paras.en: Instruments called ocean bottom seismometers recorded how these waves moved through the underground rock. Because seismic waves travel differently through solid rock and regions containing molten material, scientists can analyze their behavior to investigate structures that cannot be observed directly.
paras.zh: 称为海底地震仪的仪器记录了这些波如何穿过地下岩石。由于地震波在固体岩石和含有熔融物质的区域中的传播方式不同，因此科学家可以分析它们的行为来研究无法直接观察的结构。

paras.en: The findings, published in Communications Earth & Environment, revealed a substantial region containing a high proportion of magma directly beneath the site of Kikai's massive eruption 7,300 years ago.
paras.zh: 发表在《Communications Earth & Environment》上的研究结果揭示了 7,300 年前 Kikai 大规模喷发地点正下方的一个相当大的区域含有大量岩浆。

paras.en: By examining the seismic measurements, the team was able to determine the approximate size and shape of the underground reservoir. Its position and extent suggest that it occupies the same magma storage system involved in the ancient eruption.
paras.zh: 通过检查地震测量，研究小组能够确定地下水库的大致大小和形状。它的位置和范围表明它占据了与古代火山喷发相同的岩浆储存系统。

paras.en: "Due to its extent and location it is clear that this is in fact the same magma reservoir as in the previous eruption," Seama says.
paras.zh: 西马说：“从其范围和位置来看，很明显，这实际上是与上次喷发时相同的岩浆库。”

paras.en: Fresh Magma Is Recharging the Ancient Supervolcano
paras.zh: 新鲜的岩浆正在为古老的超级火山补充能量

paras.en: Perhaps the most intriguing finding is that the magma currently beneath Kikai does not appear to be simply leftover material from its catastrophic eruption thousands of years ago.
paras.zh: 也许最有趣的发现是，目前位于 Kikai 下方的岩浆似乎并不只是数千年前灾难性喷发的剩余物质。

paras.en: Previous investigations revealed that a new lava dome has been developing near the center of the caldera over approximately the past 3,900 years. A lava dome forms when relatively thick, viscous lava accumulates around a volcanic vent rather than flowing freely across the surrounding landscape.
paras.zh: 之前的调查显示，在过去大约 3,900 年间，火山口中心附近一直在形成一个新的熔岩穹顶。当相对较厚、粘稠的熔岩堆积在火山口周围而不是自由流过周围景观时，就会形成熔岩穹顶。

paras.en: Chemical analyses also showed that volcanic material from this dome and other more recent activity differs in composition from the material released during Kikai's giant eruption.
paras.zh: 化学分析还表明，该圆顶和其他近期活动产生的火山物质在成分上与基凯大喷发期间释放的物质不同。

paras.en: That difference provides an important clue. It suggests that the magma now stored beneath the volcano was supplied by new injections of molten rock from deeper within Earth's crust or mantle, rather than remaining unchanged since the previous eruption.
paras.zh: 这种差异提供了一个重要的线索。这表明现在储存在火山下方的岩浆是由地壳或地幔深处新注入的熔岩提供的，而不是自上次喷发以来保持不变。

paras.en: "This means that the magma that is now present in the magma reservoir under the lava dome is likely newly injected magma," summarizes Seama.
paras.zh: “这意味着熔岩穹顶下的岩浆库中现在存在的岩浆很可能是新注入的岩浆，”西玛总结道。

paras.en: Together, the seismic observations and chemical evidence help researchers develop a clearer picture of how a giant volcanic system can gradually rebuild its underground magma supply following a massive eruption.
paras.zh: 地震观测和化学证据共同帮助研究人员更清楚地了解巨型火山系统如何在大规模喷发后逐渐重建其地下岩浆供应。

paras.en: This replenishment process does not mean that another catastrophic eruption is imminent. Instead, it reveals how a magma reservoir can be recharged over thousands of years, an important process that scientists need to understand before they can reliably assess the long-term behavior of supervolcanoes.
paras.zh: 这一补充过程并不意味着另一次灾难性喷发即将来临。相反，它揭示了岩浆库如何在数千年的时间内得到补给，这是科学家们需要了解的一个重要过程，然后才能可靠地评估超级火山的长期行为。

paras.en: What the Discovery Could Reveal About Yellowstone
paras.zh: 这一发现可以揭示黄石公园的什么

paras.en: The findings could have implications far beyond Japan.
paras.zh: 这些发现的影响可能远远超出日本范围。

paras.en: Researchers believe the process identified beneath Kikai may help explain why other enormous caldera systems, including Yellowstone and Toba, also contain large magma reservoirs relatively close to Earth's surface.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，在 Kikai 下方发现的过程可能有助于解释为什么其他巨大的火山口系统，包括黄石公园和多巴火山，也包含距离地球表面相对较近的大型岩浆库。

paras.en: "This magma re-injection model is consistent with the existence of large shallow magma reservoirs beneath other giant calderas like Yellowstone and Toba," says Seama.
paras.zh: “这种岩浆重新注入模型与黄石和多巴等其他巨型破火山口下方存在大型浅层岩浆库是一致的，”西马说。

paras.en: The proposed model suggests that, following a giant eruption, new magma can gradually enter and replenish an existing underground reservoir. Understanding how this happens could reveal important patterns in the long-term cycles of magma accumulation, volcanic activity, and major eruptions.
paras.zh: 所提出的模型表明，在一次巨大的喷发之后，新的岩浆可以逐渐进入并补充现有的地下水库。了解这种情况是如何发生的可以揭示岩浆积累、火山活动和大型喷发的长期循环的重要模式。

paras.en: Researchers now hope to improve the seismic techniques used at Kikai so they can investigate the movement and storage of magma in greater detail.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在希望改进 Kikai 使用的地震技术，以便更详细地研究岩浆的运动和储存。

paras.en: "We want to refine the methods that have proved to be so useful in this study to more deeply understand the re-injection processes. Our ultimate goal is to become better able to monitor the crucial indicators of future giant eruptions."
paras.zh: “我们希望改进在这项研究中被证明非常有用的方法，以更深入地了解重新注入过程。我们的最终目标是能够更好地监测未来巨型喷发的关键指标。”

paras.en: By revealing how fresh magma accumulates beneath a volcano responsible for one of Earth's most extraordinary eruptions, the research brings scientists closer to understanding the processes that eventually make such colossal events possible.
paras.zh: 通过揭示新鲜岩浆如何在造成地球上最不寻常的喷发之一的火山下方积聚，这项研究使科学家们更进一步了解最终使此类巨大事件成为可能的过程。

paras.en: This research was funded by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT) (The Third Earthquake and Volcano Hazards Observation and Research Program (Earthquake and Volcano Hazard Reduction Research)) and the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (grant 20H00199). It was conducted in collaboration with researchers from the Japan Agency for Marine-Earth Science and Technology (JAMSTEC).
paras.zh: 这项研究由文部科学省（文部科学省）（第三次地震和火山灾害观测研究计划（地震和火山灾害减少研究））和日本学术振兴会资助（拨款 20H00199）。该研究是与日本海洋地球科学技术机构（JAMSTEC）的研究人员合作进行的。

paras.en: Materials provided by Kobe University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 资料由神户大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Akihiro Nagaya, Nobukazu Seama, Gou Fujie, Satoru Tanaka, Hiroko Sugioka, Shuichi Kodaira. Melt re-injection into large magma reservoir after giant caldera eruption at Kikai Caldera Volcano. Communications Earth, 2026; 7 (1) DOI: 10.1038/s43247-026-03347-9
paras.zh: - Akihiro Nagaya、Nobukazu Seama、Gou Fujie、Satoru Tanaka、Hiroko Sugioka、Shuichi Kodaira。基凯火山口巨型火山口喷发后，熔体重新注入大型岩浆库。通信地球，2026； 7 (1) DOI：10.1038/s43247-026-03347-9

articles.title: 'Stupendously large black holes' aren't a major component of dark matter, study finds
articles.author: Charles Q. Choi

paras.en: Black holes more massive than entire galaxies are not a major component of the mysterious dark matter that's thought to make up most of the matter in the cosmos, a new study finds.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究发现，比整个星系还要大的黑洞并不是神秘暗物质的主要组成部分，而神秘暗物质被认为构成了宇宙中的大部分物质。

paras.en: For decades, to explain why galaxies do not spin apart at the speeds at which they whirl, scientists have suggested the existence of an unseen substance known as dark matter, whose gravitational pull helps keep galaxies together. Dark matter is thought to make up about five-sixths of all matter in the universe.
paras.zh: 几十年来，为了解释为什么星系不会以它们旋转的速度旋转，科学家提出存在一种看不见的物质，称为暗物质，其引力有助于将星系保持在一起。暗物质被认为约占宇宙中所有物质的六分之五。

paras.en: Much remains unknown about dark matter, however — including whether or not it actually exists. Black holes make good potential contenders for dark matter, since they are extremely massive and are difficult to spot in the dark depths of space.
paras.zh: 然而，关于暗物质还有很多未知之处——包括它是否确实存在。黑洞是暗物质的潜在竞争者，因为它们质量极大，在黑暗的太空深处很难被发现。

paras.en: In the new study, researchers investigated whether dark matter could be made of "stupendously large black holes," ones with masses greater than 100 billion times the mass of the sun. Stupendously large black holes greater than 1 million billion to 10 million billion suns in mass would be heavier than entire galaxies.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，研究人员调查了暗物质是否可以由“巨大的黑洞”构成，这些黑洞的质量超过太阳质量的 1000 亿倍。质量超过 100 万亿至 1000 万亿个太阳的巨大黑洞将比整个星系还要重。

paras.en: So far, astronomers have not detected any stupendously large black holes — currently, the largest black hole known may weigh about 36 billion suns. Since researchers have not seen any even after looking at many galaxies, the new study noted they cannot make up all of dark matter — but team members wondered if the exotic objects still might constitute a significant portion of the puzzling substance.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，天文学家还没有发现任何巨大的黑洞——目前已知最大的黑洞可能重约 360 亿个太阳。由于研究人员在观察了许多星系后还没有看到任何暗物质，因此新研究指出它们无法构成所有暗物质，但团队成员想知道这些奇异物体是否仍然可能构成这种令人费解的物质的重要组成部分。

paras.en: Often, dark matter is thought of "as a fine dust spread everywhere," study co-author Christopher Gerlach, a theoretical physicist at the Mainz Institute for Theoretical Physics in Germany, told Space.com. However, if dark matter is packed into a handful of gigantic objects such as stupendously large black holes, "the universe becomes grainy on very large scales. And we can check that."
paras.zh: 研究合著者、德国美因茨理论物理研究所的理论物理学家克里斯托弗·格拉赫 (Christopher Gerlach) 告诉 Space.com，通常，暗物质被认为“就像散布在各处的细尘”。然而，如果暗物质被填充到一些巨大的物体中，例如巨大的黑洞，“宇宙就会在非常大的尺度上变得颗粒状。我们可以检查这一点。”

paras.en: Specifically, the scientists analyzed the light from the dawn of the universe, study co-author Yann Gouttenoire, a theoretical physicist at the Mainz Institute for Theoretical Physics, told Space.com.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、美因茨理论物理研究所的理论物理学家雅恩·古特努瓦 (Yann Gouttenoire) 告诉 Space.com，具体来说，科学家们分析了宇宙诞生之初的光。

paras.en: For the first 380,000 years after the Big Bang, the cosmos was filled with a hot plasma in which light was trapped. Eventually, the expansion of the universe let the cosmos cool enough for the plasma to largely dissipate and form atoms. This in turn let light shine freely, "and that light is still arriving today," Gerlach explained. "We call it the cosmic microwave background, a snapshot of the infant universe covering the whole sky."
paras.zh: 在大爆炸后的最初 38 万年里，宇宙充满了热等离子体，光被困在其中。最终，宇宙的膨胀使宇宙冷却到足以使等离子体大量消散并形成原子。这反过来又让光线自由地照射，“而那光今天仍然到来，”格拉赫解释道。 “我们称之为宇宙微波背景，是覆盖整个天空的婴儿宇宙的快照。”

paras.en: The temperature of the cosmic microwave background "varies from place to place by about one part in 100,000," study co-author Antonio Iovino, a theoretical physicist at New York University, Abu Dhabi, in the United Arab Emirates, told Space.com. "That pattern tells us how matter was spread back then."
paras.zh: 研究合著者、阿拉伯联合酋长国阿布扎比纽约大学的理论物理学家安东尼奥·伊维诺（Antonio Iovino）告诉 Space.com，宇宙微波背景的温度“因地而异，差异约为十万分之一”。 “这种模式告诉我们当时物质是如何传播的。”

paras.en: Analyzing the cosmic microwave background revealed it is not grainy the way stupendously black holes would have made it. "So these black holes can't be a significant part of the dark matter," Nicholas Leister, a theoretical physicist at the Mainz Institute for Theoretical Physics, told Space.com.
paras.zh: 分析宇宙微波背景表明，它并不像黑洞那样呈颗粒状。 “所以这些黑洞不可能是暗物质的重要组成部分，”美因茨理论物理研究所的理论物理学家尼古拉斯·莱斯特告诉 Space.com。

paras.en: The researchers cautioned that the new findings do not suggest that stupendously large black holes cannot exist, only that they do not make up a major fraction of dark matter. They added that another candidate for dark matter — relatively tiny black holes the size of asteroids — might potentially exist. They are now investigating whether they can rule out such itty-bitty black holes as a major constituent of dark matter.
paras.zh: 研究人员警告说，新发现并不意味着巨大的黑洞不可能存在，只是它们不构成暗物质的主要部分。他们补充说，暗物质的另一种候选者——小行星大小的相对较小的黑洞——可能存在。他们现在正在研究是否可以排除这种微小的黑洞是暗物质的主要成分。

paras.en: The scientists detail their findings in a study that will be published Oct. 26 in the journal Physical Review Letters.
paras.zh: 科学家们在一项研究中详细介绍了他们的发现，该研究将于 10 月 26 日发表在《物理评论快报》杂志上。

paras.en: Charles Q. Choi is a contributing writer for Space.com and Live Science. He covers all things human origins and astronomy as well as physics, animals and general science topics. Charles has a Master of Arts degree from the University of Missouri-Columbia, School of Journalism and a Bachelor of Arts degree from the University of South Florida. Charles has visited every continent on Earth, drinking rancid yak butter tea in Lhasa, snorkeling with sea lions in the Galapagos and even climbing an iceberg in Antarctica. Visit him at http://www.sciwriter.us
paras.zh: Charles Q. Choi 是 Space.com 和 Live Science 的特约撰稿人。他涵盖了人类起源和天文学以及物理学、动物和一般科学主题的所有内容。 Charles 拥有密苏里大学哥伦比亚分校新闻学院文学硕士学位和南佛罗里达大学文学学士学位。查尔斯去过地球上的每一个大陆，在拉萨喝腐臭的酥油茶，在加拉帕戈斯群岛与海狮一起浮潜，甚至在南极洲攀登冰山。请访问他：http://www.sciwriter.us

articles.title: Private Griffin moon lander gets put to the test | Space photo of the day for Oct. 23, 2026
articles.author: Chelsea Gohd

paras.en: The robotic Griffin lunar lander has passed a host of critical tests ahead of its first-ever moon mission, which is scheduled to launch later this year.
paras.zh: 机器人格里芬月球着陆器在其首次月球任务之前已经通过了一系列关键测试，该任务计划于今年晚些时候发射。

paras.en: At NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) in Southern California, Voyager Technologies' Griffin Mission One (or Griffin-1) lunar lander has gone through an absolute gauntlet of tests. The spacecraft was put through environmental testing that explored how the vehicle will fare in the extreme conditions it will experience on its ride to the surface of the moon.
paras.zh: 在位于南加州的 NASA 喷气推进实验室 (JPL)，Voyager Technologies 的 Griffin Mission One（或 Griffin-1）月球着陆器已经经历了严格的测试。该航天器经过了环境测试，旨在探索该航天器在前往月球表面时将经历的极端条件下的表现。

paras.en: This testing simulated the extreme temperatures, shaking and even the sounds that the spacecraft will experience from launch to landing. And, as JPL announced recently, the lander passed this series of tests with flying colors, as we can see in this image snapped Aug. 31 of the lander inside the 25-foot-wide (7.6 meters) space simulator at JPL.
paras.zh: 这项测试模拟了航天器从发射到着陆所经历的极端温度、震动甚至声音。而且，正如喷气推进实验室最近宣布的那样，着陆器出色地通过了这一系列测试，正如我们在 8 月 31 日拍摄的这张着陆器在喷气推进实验室 25 英尺宽（7.6 米）的太空模拟器内拍摄的图片中看到的那样。

paras.en: "NASA JPL’s Environmental Test Laboratory has been putting robotic explorers to the test since the Ranger program gave us NASA’s first up-close views of the moon's surface in the mid-1960s. We’re proud to provide our expertise and facilities to support this new phase of commercial lunar exploration," Charles Whetsel, manager for the Exploration Systems Development Office at JPL, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室探索系统开发办公室经理 Charles Whetsel 在一份声明中表示：“自 20 世纪 60 年代中期，美国宇航局喷气推进实验室的环境测试实验室一直在对机器人探险家进行测试。游骑兵计划让美国宇航局首次近距离观察月球表面。我们很自豪能够提供我们的专业知识和设施来支持商业月球探索的新阶段。”

paras.en: Griffin-1 is expected to launch to the moon later this year as part of NASA's CLPS (Commercial Lunar Payload Services) initiative. The spacecraft will carry over 1,100 pounds (455 kilograms) of cargo to its landing site near the lunar south pole.
paras.zh: 作为 NASA CLPS（商业月球有效载荷服务）计划的一部分，Griffin-1 预计将于今年晚些时候发射到月球。该航天器将携带超过 1,100 磅（455 公斤）的货物到达月球南极附近的着陆点。

paras.en: In this cargo will be science experiments and new technologies that will be tested on the moon's surface, including Astrolab's FLIP rover, which will explore the lunar surface with a history-making supercomputer onboard.
paras.zh: 这批货物中将载有将在月球表面进行测试的科学实验和新技术，其中包括 Astrolab 的 FLIP 漫游车，它将搭载一台创造历史的超级计算机来探索月球表面。

paras.en: This suite of experimental hardware won't just expand our understanding of the moon up close. Griffin-1's exploration will also help set the stage for a future, crewed moon base, which NASA aims to build near the south pole over the next half-decade or so.
paras.zh: 这套实验硬件不仅可以扩大我们对月球的近距离了解。 Griffin-1 的探索还将有助于为未来的载人月球基地奠定基础，美国宇航局的目标是在未来五年左右的时间内在南极附近建造该基地。

paras.en: Chelsea Gohd served as a Senior Writer for Space.com from 2018 to 2022 before returning in 2026, covering everything from climate change to planetary science and human spaceflight in both articles and on-camera in videos. With a M.S. in Biology, Chelsea has written and worked for institutions including NASA JPL, the American Museum of Natural History, Scientific American, Discover Magazine Blog, Astronomy Magazine, and Live Science. When not writing, editing or filming something space-y, Gohd is writing music and performing as Foxanne, even launching a song to space in 2021 with Inspiration4. You can follow her online @chelsea.gohd and @foxanne.music
paras.zh: Chelsea Gohd 于 2018 年至 2022 年担任 Space.com 的高级作家，并于 2026 年回归，在文章和视频中报道了从气候变化到行星科学和载人航天的所有内容。拥有硕士学位在生物学领域，Chelsea 曾为 NASA JPL、美国自然历史博物馆、《科学美国人》、Discover 杂志博客、天文学杂志和 Live Science 等机构撰写文章和工作。在创作、编辑或拍摄太空作品之余，Gohd 会创作音乐并以 Foxanne 的身份进行表演，甚至于 2021 年与 Inspiration4 一起向太空推出了一首歌曲。您可以在线关注她@chelsea.gohd 和@foxanne.music

articles.title: Never finishing the fight: Where did Xbox go wrong with Halo?
articles.author: Fran Ruiz

paras.en: Halo: Campaign Evolved was Xbox’s second attempt at refreshing the 2001 sci-fi FPS classic, and it is perfectly fine. A cromulent remake, if ever there was one, but it’s hardly a franchise-saver, especially as Xbox looks to rethink its studio structure and approach to renowned IPs like Halo or Gears of War.
paras.zh: 《光环：战役进化》是 Xbox 对 2001 年科幻 FPS 经典的第二次尝试，它非常出色。如果有的话，这是一部全面的重制版，但它很难成为特许经营权的保护者，尤其是当 Xbox 寻求重新考虑其工作室结构和对《光环》或《战争机器》等著名 IP 的处理方法时。

paras.en: Halo hasn’t been the same since original developer Bungie — now owned by Sony and working on Destiny and Marathon — departed, leaving 343 Industries (now Halo Studios) to guide the franchise.
paras.zh: 自从最初的开发商 Bungie（现为索尼所有，负责《命运》和《马拉松》的开发）离开后，《光环》就不再一样了，留下了 343 Industries（现在的光环工作室）来指导该系列。

paras.en: Neither Halo 4 nor 5 meaningfully evolved the gameplay formula or overarching narrative. Halo Infinite found more success by reheating what “old Halo felt like” and sticking it into a half-baked open world, but it still felt far from the series’ glory days.
paras.zh: 《光环 4》和《光环 5》都没有对游戏玩法或总体叙事进行有意义的改进。 《光环：无限》通过重新加热“旧光环的感觉”并将其融入半生不熟的开放世界中获得了更大的成功，但它仍然与该系列的辉煌岁月相去甚远。

paras.en: This year’s full remake of Combat Evolved's campaign delivered exactly what it promised: a shiny, 2026 version of the game that made audiences fall in love with the franchise. It was a clear attempt to reignite faith in 343’s vision, but how is a faithful, shinier remake proof of anything?
paras.zh: 今年对 Combat Evolved 战役的全面重制完全兑现了其承诺：闪亮的 2026 版游戏让观众爱上了该系列游戏。这显然是为了重新点燃人们对 343 愿景的信心，但忠实、闪亮的翻拍作品如何证明一切呢？

paras.en: It might not even matter anymore, as the new Xbox leadership has rocked the ship again, leaving Master Chief and the universe’s future cloudier than ever before. Now, with rumors of a reboot being considered at new steward Activision, is there hope for the Spartans, or will Xbox run into another dead end?
paras.zh: 这可能已经不重要了，因为新的 Xbox 领导层再次撼动了这艘船，让士官长和宇宙的未来比以往任何时候都更加阴云密布。现在，有传言称动视公司正在考虑重新启动，斯巴达人队还有希望吗？或者 Xbox 会陷入另一个死胡同吗？

paras.en: Rebooted or not, Halo needs to leave Master Chief behind
paras.zh: 无论是否重启，光环都需要将士官长抛在身后

paras.en: It looks like the ‘Halo Studios’ moniker only lasted a single (remade) game, as Xbox has recently announced that Call of Duty maker and publisher Activision — which houses many FPS-oriented studios — is taking over development, essentially leaving the 343 veterans as a minor support studio, which translates into more layoffs.
paras.zh: 看起来“光环工作室”的绰号只持续了一款（重制）游戏，因为 Xbox 最近宣布，《使命召唤》制作商和发行商动视公司（拥有许多面向 FPS 的工作室）将接管开发工作，基本上让 343 老兵成为一个次要的支持工作室，这意味着更多的裁员。

paras.en: If we put aside the human and institutional cost of this whole back-and-forth over the years (a big ask in today’s climate), there are reasons to be optimistic about the quality of an Activision-developed Halo. Regardless of what you think about the Call of Duty IP in 2026 and the publisher’s overall vision for it, it’s clear there’s plenty of talent holding everything together and, more importantly, enough experience to iterate on what Halo’s multiplayer side needs to shine bright again.
paras.zh: 如果我们抛开多年来整个来回的人力和机构成本（在当今的环境下这是一个很大的要求），我们有理由对动视开发的光环的质量感到乐观。无论你如何看待 2026 年的《使命召唤》IP 以及发行商对其的整体愿景，很明显有大量人才将一切整合在一起，更重要的是，有足够的经验来迭代《光环》的多人游戏方面需要再次闪耀光芒。

paras.en: But this won’t fix the larger issue with Halo, which is that Master Chief should’ve been left behind long ago. Like it or not, it’s difficult to deny Halo’s “golden era” ended with Halo: Reach (Bungie’s swansong under Xbox) and the Halo Wars spinoffs, which took the series into the real-time strategy genre. These games were wildly different, but they had one core thing in common: they made the sci-fi setting feel bigger instead of smaller, offering the perfect blueprint to build upon in a post-Halo 3 world.
paras.zh: 但这并不能解决《光环》中更大的问题，那就是士官长早就应该被抛在后面了。不管你喜欢与否，很难否认《光环》的“黄金时代”以《光环：致远星》（Bungie 在 Xbox 下的绝唱）和《光环战争》衍生作品结束，后者将该系列带入了即时战略类型。这些游戏截然不同，但它们有一个核心共同点：它们让科幻场景感觉更大而不是更小，为后光环 3 世界提供了完美的蓝图。

paras.en: There’s nothing inherently wrong with the Master Chief. Franchises can be built around iconic characters like Mario or Lara Croft. But in the post-Bungie era, his role changed from an extremely competent Spartan soldier to a space messiah. Halo 4, 5, and Infinite used sci-fi nonsense to transform him into this larger-than-life figure, rendering the rest of the UNSC largely powerless in the process.
paras.zh: 士官长本身并没有什么问题。特许经营权可以围绕马里奥或劳拉·克劳馥等标志性角色打造。但在后Bungie时代，他的角色从一个极其能干的斯巴达士兵变成了太空救世主。 《光环 4》、《光环 5》和《无限》使用了科幻小说中的废话将他变成了这个具有传奇色彩的人物，而在这个过程中，联合国安理会的其他成员基本上无能为力。

paras.en: It’s the same mistake ID Software made with Doomguy, centering the story on how super special he is, and not on the world he inhabits. Now rumours are rumbling that Activision’s reboot might focus on Chief’s origins; that's the last thing Halo needs.
paras.zh: ID Software 在《毁灭战士》中也犯了同样的错误，将故事的重点放在了他的超级特别上，而不是他所居住的世界。现在有传言称动视暴雪的重启可能会集中在酋长的起源上。这是 Halo 最不需要的东西。

paras.en: Forgetting Activision’s next Halo for a second, we were teased with (even if there wasn’t an official confirmation from Xbox) at least a Halo 2 remake via Halo: Campaign Evolved’s alternative ending.
paras.zh: 暂时忘记动视的下一款光环吧，我们被嘲笑（即使 Xbox 没有官方确认）至少会通过《光环：战役进化》的另类结局重制光环 2。

paras.en: Back in May 2026, renowned insider Rebs Gaming confidently reported that Halo 2 and 3 remakes were in development. But can fans realistically expect them after new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma’s latest shakeup?
paras.zh: 早在 2026 年 5 月，著名内部人士 Rebs Gaming 就自信地报道称，《光环 2》和《光环 3》的重制版正在开发中。但在 Xbox 新任首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马 (Asha Sharma) 进行最新改组后，粉丝们真的能期待他们的表现吗？

paras.en: Halo Studios could have done a "fine" job with safe remakes of the two original Halo sequels while Activision handles new projects. It’s hard to reject that approach, especially after Xbox finding success with Bethesda’s The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered and confirming two Fallout remasters are in the works. It seems like money waiting to be made, but the remakes could be cooked too.
paras.zh: 光环工作室本可以在动视公司处理新项目的同时，安全地重拍两部原版光环续作，从而完成“出色”的工作。很难拒绝这种做法，尤其是在 Xbox 凭借 Bethesda 的《上古卷轴 IV：湮没重制版》获得成功并确认两款《辐射》重制版正在制作中之后。看起来钱等着赚钱，但翻拍也可以做。

paras.en: Xbox and 343/Halo Studios have made plenty of mistakes with Halo, but the killer has always been their lack of conviction in their ideas. And look, nostalgia shouldn’t be the driving force behind a franchise in dire need of reinvention, but I’m far more annoyed by the creative rollbacks, flip-flopping, and now the loss of knowledge and talent accompanying the gutting of Halo Studios.
paras.zh: Xbox 和 343/Halo Studios 在《光环》中犯了很多错误，但致命的问题始终是他们对自己的想法缺乏信心。看，怀旧不应该成为急需重塑的系列背后的驱动力，但我更恼火的是创意的倒退、反复无常，以及现在伴随着光环工作室的破产而造成的知识和人才的流失。

paras.en: We haven’t even touched on the mess that was the live-action Halo show. It lasted only two seasons, had John-117 walking around outside the Mjolnir armor for most of its runtime, and was cancelled just as the story finally got to the titular Halo. Why would you stray so far from the source material, and how do you miss the mark so badly?
paras.zh: 我们甚至还没有触及真人光环秀中的混乱局面。它只持续了两季，约翰-117在大部分时间里都在雷神锤盔甲外走动，就在故事最终到达标题光环时被取消了。为什么你会偏离源材料这么远，你怎么会如此严重地偏离目标？

paras.en: In many ways, it perfectly encapsulated what’s been wrong with Halo as a whole for so many years. The powers that be can’t decide what they really want from it, and thus it’s stuck, unable to leave the past behind or convincingly establish a new horizon for itself. Other franchises have run into the same issues — looking at you, Star Wars — but Halo has been stuck in this purgatory for 15+ years, as Xbox leaders and strategy shifts come and go.
paras.zh: 从很多方面来说，它完美地概括了《光环》多年来的整体问题。当权者无法决定他们真正想要从中得到什么，因此它陷入了困境，无法将过去抛在脑后，也无法令人信服地为自己建立一个新的视野。其他系列也遇到了同样的问题——比如《星球大战》——但随着 Xbox 领导者和战略的更迭，《光环》已经在这个炼狱中深陷了 15 年以上。

paras.en: Could Xbox’s newly-formed XP division deliver the focused big-screen adaptation the series has always deserved? I’m sure that’s the plan, but even a cursory glance back at Xbox’s handling of the franchise for the past decade or so says no.
paras.zh: Xbox 新成立的 XP 部门能否提供该系列一直应有的集中大屏幕改编？我确信这就是计划，但即使粗略地回顾一下 Xbox 在过去十年左右对特许经营权的处理，你也会发现答案不是这样。

paras.en: Halo’s deep problems won’t be fixed overnight, and throwing a bunch of hard-working developers to the curb certainly won’t help. Halo’s current struggles didn’t come from Halo Studios or 343 Industries; they came from impatient and incompetent leadership calling the property-defining shots. I’ve seen nothing to suggest that’s changed.
paras.zh: Halo 的深层问题不会在一夜之间得到解决，将一群辛勤工作的开发人员扔到路边肯定无济于事。 Halo 当前的困境并非来自 Halo Studios 或 343 Industries；而是来自 Halo Studios。他们来自不耐烦和无能的领导层，他们对财产做出了决定。我没有看到任何迹象表明情况发生了变化。

paras.en: Fran Ruiz is our resident Star Wars guy. His hunger for movies and TV series is only matched by his love for video games. He got a BA of English Studies, focusing on English Literature, from the University of Malaga, in Spain, as well as a Master's Degree in English Studies, Multilingual and Intercultural Communication. On top of writing features and other longform articles for Space.com since 2021, he is a frequent collaborator of VG247 and other gaming sites. He also serves as associate editor over at Star Wars News Net and its sister site, Movie News Net.
paras.zh: 弗兰·鲁伊斯是我们的星球大战常驻人员。他对电影和电视剧的渴望与他对电子游戏的热爱相匹配。他在西班牙马拉加大学获得英语研究学士学位，主修英国文学，以及英语研究、多语言和跨文化交流硕士学位。自 2021 年以来，他除了为 Space.com 撰写专题文章和其他长篇文章外，还经常与 VG247 和其他游戏网站合作。他还担任星球大战新闻网及其姊妹网站电影新闻网的副编辑。

articles.title: Space Nuclear Power Corporation Awarded DARPA Agreement for Ground Test of Autonomous Nuclear Reactor Controller
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M. — October 21, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes) announced today that the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) has awarded the company an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under the Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program. Managed by Dr. Tabitha Dodson in DARPA’s Defense Sciences Office, the Fat Cat program seeks to advance autonomous reactor operation for national security missions. The contract supports development and ground testing of advanced reactor control technologies that extend the demonstrated capability of American nuclear power.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯 — 2026 年 10 月 21 日 — 太空核电公司 (SpaceNukes) 今天宣布，国防高级研究计划局 (DARPA) 已根据快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划授予该公司一份其他交易协议 (OTA)。 Fat Cat 项目由 DARPA 国防科学办公室的 Tabitha Dodson 博士管理，旨在推进国家安全任务的自主反应堆运行。该合同支持先进反应堆控制技术的开发和地面测试，以扩展美国核电的展示能力。

paras.en: The award extends a continuous line of nuclear power development and builds directly on SpaceNukes’ successful nuclear power demonstration heritage. In 2018, key members of the SpaceNukes team, while employed by Los Alamos National Laboratory and NASA, performed the foundational Kilopower Reactor Using Stirling Technology (KRUSTY) work — conducting the only full-power ground test of a new American space reactor in five decades. Under the current agreement, SpaceNukes and Los Alamos National Laboratory will design, build, and conduct a follow-on nuclear ground test of a Kilopower reactor incorporating active control rod operation—an advancement beyond the passively controlled architecture demonstrated in the 2018 KRUSTY test.
paras.zh: 该奖项延伸了核电开发的连续路线，并直接建立在 SpaceNukes 成功的核电示范遗产之上。 2018 年，SpaceNukes 团队的主要成员在受雇于洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室和 NASA 的同时，进行了使用斯特林技术的千功率反应堆 (KRUSTY) 的基础工作——对美国新型太空反应堆进行了 5 年来唯一的全功率地面测试。根据目前的协议，SpaceNukes 和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室将设计、建造并进行后续的 Kilopower 反应堆核地面测试，该反应堆采用主动控制棒操作，这是超越 2018 年 KRUSTY 测试中展示的被动控制架构的进步。

paras.en: “This award recognizes the maturity and continuity of the team that designed, built, and tested KRUSTY in 2018,” said Patrick McClure, COO of SpaceNukes. “We are proud to work alongside Dr. Dodson and Los Alamos National Laboratory to deliver the next demonstrated step in American nuclear power.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席运营官帕特里克·麦克卢尔 (Patrick McClure) 表示：“该奖项是对 2018 年设计、建造和测试 KRUSTY 团队的成熟度和连续性的认可。” “我们很自豪能够与多德森博士和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室合作，在美国核电领域迈出下一步。”

paras.en: The phased program structure includes design, procurement, and integration gates leading to the ground demonstration, producing both nuclear-tested hardware and the engineering basis for autonomous, actively-controlled reactor operation. Integration work will be conducted at SpaceNukes’ workshop in Medina, Ohio, led by Chief Engineer Marc Gibson. The work positions American industry to provide reliable nuclear power across a broader range of mission profiles, including those requiring dynamic power management and rapid response under varying operational conditions.
paras.zh: 分阶段的计划结构包括设计、采购和集成，直至地面演示，生产核试验硬件和自主、主动控制反应堆运行的工程基础。集成工作将在 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的车间进行，由总工程师 Marc Gibson 领导。这项工作使美国工业界能够在更广泛的任务范围内提供可靠的核电，包括那些需要动态电力管理和在不同操作条件下快速响应的任务。

paras.en: “There is no substitute for demonstrated technology when American national security objectives are at stake,” said Andy Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “This award lets us advance the work begun in the KRUSTY program and bring another tested capability forward for the nation.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安迪·菲尔普斯 (Andy Phelps) 表示：“当美国国家安全目标受到威胁时，已证实的技术是无可替代的。” “这个奖项让我们能够推进 KRUSTY 计划中开始的工作，并为国家带来另一种经过考验的能力。”

paras.en: About Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes)
paras.zh: 关于太空核电公司（SpaceNukes）

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corporation was founded on the belief that nuclear power is essential to our future, both on Earth and in space. The company’s goal is to enable the successful deployment of fission reactors in space. SpaceNukes brings together the core engineering and program management team behind the foundational KRUSTY demonstration in 2018. David Poston (CTO) and Patrick McClure (COO) performed this work at Los Alamos National Laboratory; Marc Gibson (Chief Engineer) led the program at NASA Glenn Research Center. The team is joined by Omar Mireles (formerly NASA Marshall Space Flight Center) and Andy Phelps (CEO). SpaceNukes holds a license from Los Alamos National Laboratory for the Kilopower technology and operates from headquarters in Los Alamos, New Mexico, and workshops in Los Alamos with additive 3D printing and in Medina, Ohio, with thermal and vacuum capabilities.
paras.zh: 太空核电公司的成立基于这样的信念：核电对我们的未来至关重要，无论是在地球上还是在太空中。该公司的目标是在太空成功部署裂变反应堆。 SpaceNukes 汇集了 2018 年 KRUSTY 基础演示背后的核心工程和项目管理团队。David Poston（首席技术官）和 Patrick McClure（首席运营官）在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室执行了这项工作；马克·吉布森（首席工程师）在美国宇航局格伦研究中心领导了该项目。该团队由 Omar Mireles（前 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心）和 Andy Phelps（首席执行官）加入。 SpaceNukes 持有洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室的 Kilopower 技术许可证，总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，在洛斯阿拉莫斯设有增材 3D 打印车间，在俄亥俄州麦地那设有热力和真空能力的车间。

articles.title: Global Satcom Services Revenues to Reach $145 Billion by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | October 2026 – Global satellite services revenues are forecast to grow 44% to reach $145 billion by 2035, according to the 33rd edition of Novaspace’s Satellite Connectivity and Video Market report. The next decade will mark a fundamental shift in the industry as data services become the dominant growth engine, driving revenues to nearly $100 billion by 2035.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 10 月——根据 Novaspace 第 33 版卫星连接和视频市场报告，全球卫星服务收入预计将增长 44%，到 2035 年达到 1,450 亿美元。随着数据服务成为主要的增长引擎，到 2035 年收入将接近 1000 亿美元，未来十年将标志着该行业的根本性转变。

paras.en: Data services are expected to increase their share of total satellite services revenues from 26% to 68% over the decade, as demand for connectivity accelerates across consumer, defense, government, and enterprise markets.
paras.zh: 随着消费者、国防、政府和企业市场对连接的需求加速增长，数据服务在卫星服务总收入中的份额预计将在十年内从 26% 增加到 68%。

paras.en: While video remains the industry’s largest revenue segment today, future growth will be driven by connectivity. Consumer Broadband, Milsatcom, and Enterprise Networks are forecast to lead market expansion, adding $22.6 billion, $19.2 billion, and $17.2 billion in revenues, respectively, over the next decade.
paras.zh: 虽然视频仍然是当今行业最大的收入领域，但未来的增长将由连接性推动。消费者宽带、军事卫星通信和企业网络预计将引领市场扩张，在未来十年内分别增加 226 亿美元、192 亿美元和 172 亿美元的收入。

paras.en: Milsatcom is emerging as a particularly important growth engine, fueled by rising defense spending and broader adoption of satcom-enabled operational concepts across military forces. At the same time, NGSO constellations are becoming an increasingly important source of resilient capacity for government and defense users.
paras.zh: 在国防支出不断增加以及军队更广泛采用卫星通信作战概念的推动下，军事卫星通信正在成为一个特别重要的增长引擎。与此同时，NGSO 星座正成为政府和国防用户日益重要的弹性能力来源。

paras.en: “Satellite connectivity is moving firmly into the mainstream,” said Dimitri Buchs, Project Manager and Editor of the report. “The rapid expansion of NGSO capacity, declining bandwidth costs, and growing demand for resilient, always-available connectivity are fundamentally changing where and how satellite communications compete.”
paras.zh: “卫星连接正在坚定地成为主流，”项目经理兼报告编辑 Dimitri Buchs 说。 “NGSO 容量的快速扩张、带宽成本的下降以及对弹性、始终可用连接的需求不断增长，正在从根本上改变卫星通信的竞争地点和方式。”

paras.en: The satellite capacity market is forecast to exceed $46 billion by 2035, more than tripling from 2025 levels. Video Distribution, the largest capacity segment in 2025, is expected to account for just 3% of capacity revenues by 2035. Consumer Broadband and Milsatcom, meanwhile, are projected to represent more than half of total capacity revenues.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，卫星容量市场将超过 460 亿美元，比 2025 年的水平增加两倍多。视频分发是 2025 年最大的容量部分，预计到 2035 年将仅占容量收入的 3%。与此同时，消费者宽带和军事卫星通信预计将占总容量收入的一半以上。

paras.en: Declining bandwidth costs, driven by HTS systems and a growing number of NGSO projects, are accelerating satellite connectivity’s expansion into mass-market applications. Providers such as Starlink are increasingly competing with terrestrial broadband on price, strengthening satellite broadband’s position as a viable alternative to fiber and wireless connectivity in a growing range of markets.
paras.zh: 在 HTS 系统和越来越多的 NGSO 项目的推动下，带宽成本不断下降，正在加速卫星连接向大众市场应用的扩展。 Starlink 等提供商在价格上与地面宽带的竞争日益激烈，从而巩固了卫星宽带在越来越多的市场中作为光纤和无线连接的可行替代方案的地位。

paras.en: The transformation is also reshaping the role of GEO operators. Following a low of six commercial GEO orders in 2024, the market rebounded to 10 orders in 2025, with another 14 recorded by mid-September 2026. The renewed activity reflects evolving multi-orbit strategies and continued demand for GEO capabilities alongside rapidly expanding NGSO systems.
paras.zh: 这一转变也正在重塑 GEO 运营商的角色。继 2024 年 6 个商业 GEO 订单的低点之后，市场在 2025 年反弹至 10 个订单，到 2026 年 9 月中旬又记录了 14 个订单。新的活动反映了不断发展的多轨道战略以及对 GEO 能力的持续需求以及快速扩展的 NGSO 系统。

paras.en: “This is not a return to the traditional GEO model,” Buchs added. “Software-defined satellites, more flexible commercial models, sovereign requirements, and growing multi-orbit strategies are redefining GEO’s role. The future of satellite communications will not be GEO or NGSO—it will increasingly be an ecosystem in which each architecture serves distinct and complementary requirements.”
paras.zh: “这并不是对传统 GEO 模式的回归，”布克斯补充道。 “软件定义的卫星、更灵活的商业模式、主权要求和不断增长的多轨道战略正在重新定义 GEO 的角色。卫星通信的未来将不再是 GEO 或 NGSO，而是越来越成为一个生态系统，其中每种架构都满足不同且互补的需求。”

paras.en: The 33rd edition of Satellite Connectivity and Video Market provides a comprehensive assessment of global satellite service revenues, capacity demand, pricing trends, competitive dynamics, and operator strategies across video, broadband, enterprise, mobility, government, and defense markets through 2035.
paras.zh: 第 33 版《卫星连接和视频市场》对 2035 年之前的视频、宽带、企业、移动、政府和国防市场的全球卫星服务收入、容量需求、定价趋势、竞争动态以及运营商战略进行了全面评估。

paras.en: This edition introduces a granular bottom-up model for Enterprise Networks Back-up terminals, providing greater visibility into market demand and deployment trends. It also features a revised commercial Milsatcom model with deeper analysis by region, frequency band, and infrastructure type.
paras.zh: 该版本引入了企业网络备份终端的细粒度自下而上模型，提供了对市场需求和部署趋势的更深入的了解。它还具有修订后的商业军事卫星通信模型，可按地区、频段和基础设施类型进行更深入的分析。

paras.en: The report also provides an updated assessment of major developments shaping the satellite communications market, including the evolution of NGSO constellations, emerging Q/V frequency bands and other regulatory developments, government and defense spending trends, and the changing competitive dynamics between satellite and terrestrial connectivity.
paras.zh: 该报告还对塑造卫星通信市场的主要发展进行了最新评估，包括NGSO星座的演变、新兴的Q/V频段和其他监管发展、政府和国防支出趋势，以及卫星和地面连接之间不断变化的竞争动态。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球范围内开展业务，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。

articles.title: TechnoMile Recognized as a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Award Winner
articles.author: TechnoMile

paras.en: TechnoMile, the leading AI solution that unifies growth, contracts, compliance, and security workflows, has been named a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Awards winner, recognizing the company among the leading B2B partners supporting entrepreneurs and businesses across the country.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 是统一增长、合同、合规性和安全工作流程的领先 AI 解决方案，被评为 2026 年 Inc. Power 合作伙伴奖得主，认可该公司是支持全国企业家和企业的领先 B2B 合作伙伴之一。

paras.en: The annual Inc. Power Partner Awards honor B2B companies that have demonstrated a track record of helping entrepreneurs and businesses navigate the challenges of building and growing a company. From hiring and compliance to technology, infrastructure, fundraising, marketing, and more, these partners provide expertise and services that enable businesses to operate, scale, and pursue their ambitions.
paras.zh: 一年一度的 Inc. Power 合作伙伴奖旨在表彰那些在帮助企业家和企业应对创建和发展公司的挑战方面取得良好记录的 B2B 公司。从招聘和合规到技术、基础设施、筹款、营销等，这些合作伙伴提供专业知识和服务，使企业能够运营、扩大规模并实现其抱负。

paras.en: “Business owners have no shortage of tools at their disposal, and B2B companies need to make clear why their products and services are worth the investment,” says Bonny Ghosh, editorial director at Inc. “The companies on this year’s Power Partners list have done just that. They don’t just have customers – they have superfans and evangelists. Across industries like marketing, financial services, and technology, they’ve proved their dedication to helping fellow business owners grow and succeed.”
paras.zh: Inc 编辑总监邦尼·戈什 (Bonny Ghosh) 表示：“企业主并不缺乏可用的工具，B2B 公司需要明确为什么他们的产品和服务值得投资。今年 Power Partners 名单上的公司已经做到了这一点。他们不仅拥有客户，还拥有超级粉丝和传播者。在营销、金融服务和技术等行业，他们已经证明了自己致力于帮助其他企业主成长和成功。”

paras.en: TechnoMile was recognized for its investment in their clients’ long-term success, solving the persistent challenges that growing government contractors face – identifying the right opportunities among thousands of federal solicitations, managing pipelines through manual processes, lacking visibility to forecast and make confident pursuit decisions, and meeting stringent compliance and security requirements once contracts are won.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 因其对客户长期成功的投资而获得认可，解决了不断增长的政府承包商面临的持续挑战——在数千个联邦招标中识别合适的机会，通过手动流程管理管道，缺乏预测和做出自信的追求决策的可见性，以及赢得合同后满足严格的合规性和安全要求。

paras.en: TechnoMile’s unified platform connects growth, contracts, and security workflows, delivering GovCon, Defense, and Public Sector organizations greater visibility, stronger compliance, lower risk, and more efficient operations. By combining purpose-built technology, trusted AI, and deep government contracting experience, TechnoMile helps organizations compete for, win, and successfully execute mission-critical government work.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 的统一平台连接增长、合同和安全工作流程，为 GovCon、国防和公共部门组织提供更高的可视性、更强的合规性、更低的风险和更高效的运营。通过将专用技术、可信人工智能和深厚的政府签约经验相结合，TechnoMile 帮助组织竞争、获胜并成功执行关键任务的政府工作。

paras.en: “TechnoMile solves a real problem for the contracting market – providing a unified way to manage the full lifecycle of federal business,” said Ashish Khot, CEO of TechnoMile. “This award is a special honor because it is largely based on the feedback and experience of our customers and shows that we are living up to our promise to be a partner for business growth, helping companies better manage the work behind winning and delivering federal business.”
paras.zh: “TechnoMile 解决了承包市场的一个真正问题——提供统一的方式来管理联邦业务的整个生命周期，”TechnoMile 首席执行官 Ashish Khot 表示。 “这个奖项是一项特殊的荣誉，因为它主要基于我们客户的反馈和经验，表明我们正在履行我们的承诺，成为业务增长的合作伙伴，帮助公司更好地管理赢得和交付联邦业务背后的工作。”

paras.en: For more information on Inc.’s Power Partner Awards or to view the complete list of honorees, visit https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards.
paras.zh: 有关 Inc. 电力合作伙伴奖的更多信息或查看获奖者的完整列表，请访问 https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards。

paras.en: Inc. is the leading media brand and playbook for the entrepreneurs and business leaders shaping our future. Through its journalism, Inc. aims to inform, educate, and elevate the profile of its community: the risk-takers, the innovators, and the ultra-driven go-getters who are creating the future of business. Inc. is published by Mansueto Ventures, along with fellow leading business publication Fast Company. For more information, visit www.inc.com.
paras.zh: Inc. 是领先的媒体品牌，是为塑造我们未来的企业家和商业领袖提供的手册。 Inc. 旨在通过其新闻报道、教育和提升其社区的形象：冒险者、创新者和正在创造商业未来的超强进取者。 Inc. 由 Mansueto Ventures 以及领先的商业出版物 Fast Company 共同出版。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.inc.com。

articles.title: NASA Invites Media to 2026 von Braun Space Exploration Symposium
articles.author: Lee Mohon

paras.en: Members of the media are invited to join NASA at the 2026 von Braun Space Exploration Symposium from Monday, Oct. 26, to Wednesday, Oct. 28, at the University of Alabama in Huntsville.
paras.zh: 媒体成员受邀参加 NASA 于 10 月 26 日星期一至 10 月 28 日星期三在亨茨维尔阿拉巴马大学举行的 2026 年冯·布劳恩太空探索研讨会。

paras.en: This year’s symposium is focused on humanity’s return to the Moon, sustainable lunar infrastructure, advanced space propulsion, and the evolving space workforce.
paras.zh: 今年的研讨会重点关注人类重返月球、可持续月球基础设施、先进的太空推进以及不断发展的太空劳动力。

paras.en: Panels include discussions on Artemis II and III, space propulsion flash talks, building utilities and infrastructure for sustainable lunar operations, Moon base supply chain resilience, space nuclear technology, navigating the new NASA workforce, and engineering the future, featuring keynotes and awards presentations.
paras.zh: 小组讨论包括关于阿耳忒弥斯二号和三号、太空推进快闪演讲、为可持续月球运行建设公用事业和基础设施、月球基地供应链弹性、空间核技术、引导美国宇航局新员工队伍以及设计未来的讨论，包括主题演讲和颁奖典礼。

articles.title: El Niño Then and Now

paras.en: El Niño is part of a natural climate pattern that occurs roughly every two to seven years, bringing warmer-than-normal water to parts of the equatorial Pacific. The most recent very strong El Niño events, in 1997-98 and 2015-16, upended weather patterns. Impacts spanned the planet, from fires in Indonesia and the Amazon, to crop failures due to drought in southern Africa, to heavy rain and coastal flooding in Southern California. The current El Niño rivals these past heavyweights.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象是自然气候模式的一部分，大约每两到七年发生一次，为赤道太平洋部分地区带来比正常情况更温暖的水温。最近一次非常强烈的厄尔尼诺事件（1997-98 年和 2015-16 年）颠覆了天气模式。影响遍及全球，从印度尼西亚和亚马逊的火灾，到南部非洲干旱造成的农作物歉收，再到南加州的暴雨和沿海洪水。当前的厄尔尼诺现象可与过去的这些重量级现象相媲美。

paras.en: Every El Niño grows from a feedback loop between the atmosphere and the ocean. Trade winds normally keep warm water piled up in the western Pacific, where it stands higher than in the east. When those winds weaken, that warm water begins to pulse eastward, which further weakens and sometimes reverses the winds, allowing even more warm water to move east. The cycle intensifies as waters continue to warm and pile up in the central and eastern Pacific.
paras.zh: 每次厄尔尼诺现象都是由大气和海洋之间的反馈循环产生的。信风通常会使西太平洋的温暖海水堆积起来，那里的水位高于东太平洋。当风减弱时，暖水开始向东流动，风进一步减弱，有时甚至逆转风，使更多的暖水向东移动。随着太平洋中部和东部海水持续变暖和堆积，这一循环加剧。

paras.en: But each El Niño has its own character, shaped by where in the Pacific the warmth builds and how the atmosphere responds. “The search for the ‘typical’ El Niño is very elusive,” said Josh Willis, project scientist for sea level missions at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL). “They’re all different in terms of where they land and how their impacts play out.”
paras.zh: 但每次厄尔尼诺现象都有其自己的特征，其特征取决于太平洋温暖的位置以及大气的反应。美国宇航局喷气推进实验室（JPL）海平面任务项目科学家乔什·威利斯（Josh Willis）表示：“寻找‘典型’厄尔尼诺现象非常难以捉摸。” “它们的着陆地点和影响如何发挥都是不同的。”

paras.en: Altimetry satellites can track those differences by measuring the height of the sea surface. Because water expands as it warms, higher-than-normal sea levels in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific signal the buildup of heat associated with El Niño. The maps above depict sea surface height anomalies across the Pacific Ocean on October 13, 1997 (left), and on October 12, 2026 (right). Data are from the TOPEX/Poseidon satellite and the Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich satellite, respectively, and were processed by scientists at JPL.
paras.zh: 测高卫星可以通过测量海面的高度来跟踪这些差异。由于水会随着变暖而膨胀，赤道中部和东部太平洋的海平面高于正常水平，标志着与厄尔尼诺现象相关的热量积聚。上面的地图描绘了 1997 年 10 月 13 日（左）和 2026 年 10 月 12 日（右）整个太平洋的海面高度异常。数据分别来自 TOPEX/Poseidon 卫星和 Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich 卫星，并由 JPL 的科学家处理。

paras.en: Shades of red indicate where sea levels were higher than average. Normal sea level conditions appear white, and lower areas are blue. Signals related to seasonal cycles and long-term trends have been removed to highlight sea level anomalies associated with El Niño and other short-term natural phenomena.
paras.zh: 红色阴影表示海平面高于平均水平的地方。正常海平面条件显示为白色，较低区域显示为蓝色。与季节周期和长期趋势相关的信号已被删除，以突出与厄尔尼诺现象和其他短期自然现象相关的海平面异常。

paras.en: “What’s unique about altimetry is that we have a 35-year record from nearly identical satellites flying almost the same ground track, with each mission overlapping the next,” Willis said. “That lets us look back in time and compare this El Niño to what happened in 1997. And right now, this one is on track to be even bigger.”
paras.zh: 威利斯说：“高度测量的独特之处在于，我们拥有 35 年的记录，几乎相同的卫星在几乎相同的地面轨道上飞行，每次任务都与下一个任务重叠。” “这让我们回顾过去，将这次厄尔尼诺现象与 1997 年发生的情况进行比较。而现在，这次厄尔尼诺现象的规模可能会更大。”

paras.en: Compared with the 1997-98 event, El Niño in 2026 came on much more suddenly. But as of October, the two events appear similar in character—the tilt of sea level (low in the west and high in the east) and high, warm water extending all the way to South America—so Willis thinks the impacts could be similar as well. In 1997-98, that meant, for instance, lots of rain in California and across the southern tier of the U.S.
paras.zh: 与1997-98年相比，2026年的厄尔尼诺现象来得突然得多。但截至 10 月，这两个事件在性质上似乎很相似——海平面倾斜（西部低，东部高）和高而温暖的海水一直延伸到南美洲——因此威利斯认为影响也可能相似。例如，1997-98 年，这意味着加利福尼亚州和美国南部地区会出现大量降雨。

paras.en: The 2015-16 El Niño was another heavy hitter but differed in its character. Sea surface height anomalies on October 12, 2015, based on altimetry data from the Jason-2 satellite, are shown above in context with maps from around the same time in 1997 and 2026. In 2015, the exceptionally warm, high water along the equator didn’t push up against South America to the extent it did in the other years. Rainfall impacts that winter concentrated more over Central America and the southeastern U.S., with significant flooding in Mexico.
paras.zh: 2015-16 年的厄尔尼诺现象是另一个重磅事件，但其特征有所不同。根据 Jason-2 卫星的测高数据，2015 年 10 月 12 日的海面高度异常如上图所示，并结合 1997 年和 2026 年大约同一时间的地图。2015 年，赤道沿线异常温暖的高水位没有像其他年份那样对南美洲产生推力。冬季的降雨影响主要集中在中美洲和美国东南部，墨西哥发生严重洪灾。

paras.en: NOAA’s El Niño outlook on October 8, 2026, called for an 83 percent chance of a strong-to-very strong El Niño through the first three months of 2027. But exactly how the impacts will play out in winter 2026-27 and beyond remains to be seen. Willis noted that El Niño's influence propagates through a chaotic atmosphere, and the signal can get muddled as it extends beyond the tropics. “There's always a bit of a dice roll here,” Willis said. “Just because this El Niño looks like 1997 doesn't mean it will be exactly the same—it's just our best guess at the moment.”
paras.zh: 美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 2026 年 10 月 8 日的厄尔尼诺现象展望预计，2027 年前三个月出现强至极强厄尔尼诺现象的可能性为 83%。但其影响在 2026-27 年冬季及以后将如何发挥，仍有待观察。威利斯指出，厄尔尼诺现象的影响通过混乱的大气层传播，当它延伸到热带地区之外时，信号可能会变得混乱。 “这里总是有一些掷骰子的事情，”威利斯说。 “仅仅因为这次厄尔尼诺现象看起来像 1997 年，并不意味着它会完全相同——这只是我们目前最好的猜测。”

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory maps by Lauren Dauphin, using NASA-SSH altimetry data provided by Josh Willis, Severine Fournier, and Kevin Marlis, NASA/JPL-Caltech. Story by Kathryn Hansen.
