articles.title: Yemen: Deepening concerns for Taiz City as aid is blocked from entering

paras.en: Yemen: Deepening concerns for Taiz City as aid is blocked from entering
paras.zh: 也门：援助物资无法进入，加深了对塔伊兹市的担忧

paras.en: Aid agencies warned on Friday of the fast-developing humanitarian emergency inside Taiz City in Yemen, which has been encircled by de facto Houthi forces fighting government troops along the country’s west coast.
paras.zh: 援助机构周五警告称，也门塔伊兹市内的人道主义紧急情况正在迅速发展，该市已被沿该国西海岸与政府军作战的事实上的胡塞武装包围。

paras.en: “It’s 20 days and counting since Taiz has been cut off…we are seeing increasingly that the fighting makes it impossible for us to get in and impossible for people to get out,” said Jens Laerke, spokesperson for the UN aid coordination office, OCHA. “Access roads have been cut off and that means that very little fuel, food or other supplies have reached the city since.”
paras.zh: 联合国人道协调厅发言人延斯·拉尔克表示：“塔伊兹与外界的联系已经过去了 20 天，而且还在继续……我们越来越多地看到，战斗使我们无法进入，人们也无法离开。” “进出道路已被切断，这意味着自那以后到达该市的燃料、食品或其他物资非常少。”

paras.en: The escalation between Houthi separatists and the Aden-based Government began in early September, ending the relative calm brought about by a 2022 truce.
paras.zh: 胡塞分裂分子与亚丁政府之间的冲突于 9 月初开始升级，结束了 2022 年休战带来的相对平静。

paras.en: Among the agencies responding to chronic and acute needs across Yemen, the UN World Food Programme (WFP) reported that more than 800,000 people in Taiz have been cut off from assistance. This includes 600,000 people who depend on humanitarian assistance and 200,000 women and children. “We’re desperately trying to regain access to Taiz and we continue to support the broader operations across Yemen,” said Azfar Deen, WFP Regional Communications Officer for Eastern and Southern Africa.
paras.zh: 在应对也门各地长期和紧急需求的机构中，联合国世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 报告称，塔伊兹有超过 80 万人无法获得援助。其中包括 60 万名依赖人道主义援助的人以及 20 万名妇女和儿童。粮食计划署东部和南部非洲区域通讯官员阿兹法尔·迪恩 (Azfar Deen) 表示：“我们正在拼命努力重新进入塔伊兹，并继续支持也门各地更广泛的行动。”

paras.en: There is growing concern about dwindling water supplies inside Taiz City because most residents depend on water delivered by trucks, OCHA spokesperson Mr. Laerke explained. But “with the roads closed and the diesel to run the trucks very scarce, water production in the city has fallen by about half. And the cost of the truck water has roughly tripled. You can imagine what that does to these people who are trapped there,” he told journalists at a scheduled briefing in Geneva.
paras.zh: 人道协调厅发言人拉尔克先生解释说，人们越来越担心塔伊兹市内供水减少，因为大多数居民依赖卡车运送水。但“由于道路封闭，卡车行驶的柴油非常稀缺，该市的水产量下降了大约一半。卡车水的成本大约增加了两倍。你可以想象这对被困在那里的人们会造成什么影响，”他在日内瓦举行的预定新闻发布会上告诉记者。

paras.en: The UN Children’s Fund, UNICEF, highlighted deepening concerns about widespread hunger in Yemen. In Taiz alone, the agency has screened more than 168,000 children this year, with more than 52,000 found to be acutely malnourished, including more than 11,500 children suffering from severe acute malnutrition.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会强调了对也门普遍饥饿现象日益加深的担忧。仅在塔伊兹，该机构今年就筛查了超过168,000名儿童，发现超过52,000名儿童患有严重营养不良，其中超过11,500名儿童患有严重急性营养不良。

paras.en: The agency has pre-positioned nearly 8,000 cartons of ready-to-use therapeutic food across Taiz governorate to help treat children with severe acute malnutrition. This is enough to sustain services for approximately three months, but “even when stocks are available, access constraints and disruptions to supply routes can make it more difficult for partners to transport supplies and for families to safely reach treatment”, said spokesperson Ricardo Pires.
paras.zh: 该机构已在塔伊兹省预先放置了近 8,000 箱即用型治疗食品，以帮助治疗患有严重急性营养不良的儿童。这足以维持大约三个月的服务，但发言人里卡多·皮雷斯表示，“即使有库存，进入限制和供应路线中断也会使合作伙伴运输物资和家庭安全到达治疗变得更加困难”。

paras.en: Between 7 June and 19 October 2026, the UN migration agency, IOM, recorded approximately 258,679 displaced individuals, the majority in Taiz and Lahj governorates. Many families are experiencing repeated movements and seeking refuge in already overstretched displacement sites and host communities.
paras.zh: 2026 年 6 月 7 日至 10 月 19 日期间，联合国移民机构国际移民组织记录了大约 258,679 名流离失所者，其中大多数在塔伊兹省和拉赫季省。许多家庭正在经历反复的迁移，并在已经不堪重负的流离失所地点和收容社区寻求庇护。

paras.en: In addition, as of 17 October, 3,836 Yemeni nationals arrived in Djibouti, reportedly fleeing the deteriorating security situation.
paras.zh: 此外，截至 10 月 17 日，有 3 836 名也门国民抵达吉布提，据报道是为了逃离日益恶化的安全局势。

paras.en: Reports indicate that at least 1,574 people have been killed and 6,939 others injured in the Yemen conflict since August.
paras.zh: 报道称，自8月以来，也门冲突已造成至少1,574人死亡、6,939人受伤。

articles.title: ‘Burden and loss’ builds in DR Congo, as Kenya strengthens Ebola containment

paras.en: ‘Burden and loss’ builds in DR Congo, as Kenya strengthens Ebola containment
paras.zh: 随着肯尼亚加强埃博拉病毒遏制，刚果民主共和国的“负担和损失”加剧

paras.en: “If we lift the foot off the pedal, the virus will resurge very quickly, will continue to spread to newly affected areas and pose a threat for the country, the region and the world at large,” warned Dr. Catherine Smallwood, World Health Organization (WHO) incident manager in the DRC.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）刚果民主共和国事件经理凯瑟琳·斯莫尔伍德（Catherine Smallwood）博士警告说：“如果我们松开踏板，病毒将很快卷土重来，并将继续传播到新受影响的地区，并对国家、地区和全世界构成威胁。”

paras.en: The country remains the epicentre of an outbreak of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease that was officially declared in mid-May. It began in the volatile eastern region and has now spread to eight provinces, the latest being Nord-Ubangi in the northwest.
paras.zh: 该国仍然是 5 月中旬正式宣布的埃博拉本迪布焦病毒病爆发的中心。它始于动荡的东部地区，现已蔓延到八个省份，最新的一个是西北部的北乌班吉省。

paras.en: There have been 9,765 cases to date and nearly half – 4,727 – have died. Additionally, 30,000 contacts are being monitored each day over a three-week period.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，已有 9,765 例病例，其中近一半（4,727 例）死亡。此外，在三周的时间内每天都会监控 30,000 名接触者。

paras.en: A smaller outbreak in Uganda was officially declared over in August, while cases have also been confirmed in Kenya, Nigeria and France.
paras.zh: 乌干达的小规模疫情于八月正式宣布结束，肯尼亚、尼日利亚和法国也已确诊病例。

paras.en: In the DRC, “we’re seeing an incredible permanent burden and loss of livelihoods in those families that are affected”, said Dr. Smallwood, speaking from the eastern city of Bunia to journalists in Geneva.
paras.zh: 在刚果民主共和国，“我们看到受影响的家庭承受着令人难以置信的永久性负担和生计损失”，斯莫尔伍德博士在东部城市布尼亚对日内瓦的记者说。

paras.en: At nearly six months in, the outbreak “is occurring in an area that is geographically vast and moving into ever hard to reach locations and remote locations”, she noted. Some places can take several days to reach by boat or motorcycle and are inaccessible by car or plane.
paras.zh: 她指出，近六个月后，疫情“发生在一个地理广阔的地区，并蔓延到难以到达的地点和偏远地区”。有些地方乘船或摩托车可能需要几天时间才能到达，而汽车或飞机则无法到达。

paras.en: The crisis continues to unfold amid ongoing conflict, hunger and displacement, and the World Food Programme (WFP) is working to ensure that families get enough to eat. The UN agency is also building Ebola treatment centres, among other operations.
paras.zh: 这场危机在持续的冲突、饥饿和流离失所中继续蔓延，世界粮食计划署（粮食计划署）正在努力确保家庭有足够的食物。除其他行动外，该联合国机构还正在建设埃博拉治疗中心。

paras.en: WFP’s Representative in the DRC David Stevenson shared stories of the people who depend on its support.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署驻刚果民主共和国代表戴维·史蒂文森分享了依赖其支持的人们的故事。

paras.en: One woman, Francine Birungi Amoti, lost a child to Ebola and is raising her six surviving children and a baby entrusted to her care. She is unable to attend to her fields due to violence.
paras.zh: 一位名叫弗朗辛·比龙吉·阿莫蒂 (Francine Birungi Amoti) 的妇女在埃博拉病毒中失去了一个孩子，目前正在抚养她的六个幸存的孩子和一个委托她照顾的婴儿。由于暴力，她无法干农活。

paras.en: “For Francine, food assistance means being able to feed the children in her care when reaching her fields could cost her life,” he said, speaking from the capital Kinshasa.
paras.zh: “对于弗朗辛来说，粮食援助意味着在到达田地时为她照顾的孩子提供食物可能会导致她丧生，”他在首都金沙萨发表讲话时说。

paras.en: “This is what a crisis on top of a crisis looks like: disease and bereavement, compounded by insecurity and hunger.”
paras.zh: “这就是危机之上的危机：疾病和丧亲之痛，再加上不安全和饥饿。”

paras.en: Dr. Smallwood also pointed to another concern as the number of people dying from Ebola outside recognised treatment centres “remains a big flag of late detection of cases at the community level”.
paras.zh: 斯莫尔伍德博士还指出了另一个令人担忧的问题，即在公认的治疗中心之外死于埃博拉病毒的人数“仍然是社区一级病例发现较晚的一个重要标志”。

paras.en: The past week has seen a decline in the number of people dying in the community or outside Ebola treatment centres which indicates that actions to increase early detection and quick referral to care have been working.
paras.zh: 过去一周，社区或埃博拉治疗中心外的死亡人数有所下降，这表明加强早期发现和快速转诊治疗的行动正在发挥作用。

paras.en: However, WHO understands that in some parts of eastern DRC, “patients are visiting between two to five different health facilities before they're referred to Ebola treatment centres”, representing “a really, really big challenge”.
paras.zh: 然而，世卫组织了解到，在刚果民主共和国东部的一些地区，“患者在被转诊到埃博拉治疗中心之前要到两到五个不同的医疗机构就诊”，这是“一个非常非常大的挑战”。

paras.en: Dr. Smallwood said there have been significant improvements in the quality of care provided at Ebola treatment centres. WHO had set a target of 3,000 beds across affected areas and currently over 2,000 are available.
paras.zh: 斯莫尔伍德博士说，埃博拉治疗中心提供的护理质量有了显着改善。世卫组织设定了在受影响地区提供 3,000 个床位的目标，目前可用床位超过 2,000 个。

paras.en: She also highlighted the positive fact that 2,600 people in the DRC have survived Ebola. Clinics are being opened where they can access care, including to monitor presence of the virus and any related conditions that may arise, as well as psychosocial support.
paras.zh: 她还强调了刚果民主共和国有 2,600 人从埃博拉病毒中幸存下来的积极事实。正在开设诊所，让他们能够获得护理，包括监测病毒的存在和可能出现的任何相关情况，以及心理社会支持。

paras.en: There is also good news on the Ebola front in Kenya following the country’s first case and fatality earlier this month – a Kenyan man who had been working in the DRC before flying back to Nairobi via Uganda.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，肯尼亚出现首例埃博拉病例并死亡，该国埃博拉疫情方面也传来了好消息——一名肯尼亚男子在经乌干达飞回内罗毕之前一直在刚果民主共和国工作。

paras.en: More than 100 contacts were identified, some of whom will complete their 21-day quarantine on Sunday and will be heading home to their families.
paras.zh: 已确定 100 多名接触者，其中一些人将于周日完成 21 天的隔离，然后回家与家人团聚。

paras.en: WHO representative in Kenya Dr. Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo welcomed the development.
paras.zh: 世卫组织驻肯尼亚代表 Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo 博士对这一进展表示欢迎。

paras.en: “I think their sacrifice has been important in ensuring that the community is protected and that we don’t have community spread today,” she told UN News.
paras.zh: 她告诉联合国新闻：“我认为他们的牺牲对于确保社区受到保护以及我们今天不会出现社区传播非常重要。”

paras.en: She stressed that these people should not be stigmatised as being released from quarantine does not mean that they had Ebola, only that they had contact with someone who did.
paras.zh: 她强调，这些人不应该受到污名化，因为解除隔离并不意味着他们感染了埃博拉病毒，只是表明他们与感染埃博拉病毒的人有过接触。

paras.en: With Ebola now confirmed in four African countries, Dr. Kimambo underscored that governments must remain vigilant.
paras.zh: 随着埃博拉病毒现已在四个非洲国家得到证实，金博博博士强调，各国政府必须保持警惕。

paras.en: “Africa is very interconnected and nobody is safe until everyone is safe,” she said. “So, as long as we have Ebola in DRC at the scale that it is, or in any other country, it means that we are not safe. Therefore, the key message is preparedness.”
paras.zh: “非洲的联系非常紧密，除非所有人都安全，否则没有人是安全的，”她说。 “因此，只要刚果民主共和国或任何其他国家出现如此规模的埃博拉病毒，就意味着我们不安全。因此，关键信息是做好准备。”

articles.title: Soil mapping aims to boost agricultural production in Kenya

paras.en: Soil mapping aims to boost agricultural production in Kenya
paras.zh: 土壤测绘旨在提高肯尼亚的农业生产

paras.en: The Soil Mapping for Resilient Agrifood systems (SoilFER) programme supports farmers to develop reliable soil information that will inform agricultural decisions such as which fertilizer to use and how much.
paras.zh: 弹性农业食品系统土壤测绘 (SoilFER) 计划支持农民开发可靠的土壤信息，为农业决策提供信息，例如使用哪种肥料和用量。

paras.en: So far, more than 3,600 soil samples have been collected and mapped across 45 counties, contributing to a digital soil map designed to provide farmers with location-specific information about their land.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，已经在 45 个县收集了 3,600 多个土壤样本并绘制了地图，形成了数字土壤地图，旨在为农民提供有关其土地的特定位置信息。

paras.en: Select farmers also receive training to diagnose and fix soil degradation – earning the title “soil doctor” – who then go on to teach their peers.
paras.zh: 精选的农民还接受诊断和修复土壤退化的培训——获得“土壤医生”的称号——然后他们继续教导他们的同伴。

paras.en: SoilFER was launched through a partnership between the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the Kenya Agricultural and Livestock Research Organization (KALRO) in Kabete, with financial support from the United States Department of State and Japan.
paras.zh: SoilFER 是联合国粮食及农业组织 (FAO) 与肯尼亚农业和畜牧研究组织 (KALRO) 在卡贝特合作推出的，并得到了美国国务院和日本的财政支持。

paras.en: For Agness Munialo, a farmer from Kakamega county in western Kenya, learning about soil composition and fertility has changed how she thinks about farming.
paras.zh: 对于来自肯尼亚西部卡卡梅加县的农民 Agness Munialo 来说，了解土壤成分和肥力改变了她对农业的看法。

paras.en: “Farmers would use excessive chemicals, sometimes even more fertilizers in an attempt to get more yields. Now we know better,” she said.
paras.zh: “农民会使用过量的化学品，有时甚至使用更多的化肥，以期获得更高的产量。现在我们知道得更清楚了，”她说。

paras.en: Ms. Munialo, a trained soil doctor who participated in the SoilFER programme, said the initiative was helping farmers, particularly in rural areas, better understand soil composition, pH levels and fertility.
paras.zh: 参加过 SoilFER 项目的训练有素的土壤医生 Munialo 女士表示，该倡议正在帮助农民，特别是农村地区的农民，更好地了解土壤成分、pH 值和肥力。

paras.en: According to Barrack Okoba, FAO-Kenya’s national coordinator of the programme, making soil information accessible is essential to building resilience in agriculture.
paras.zh: 粮农组织驻肯尼亚计划国家协调员巴拉克·奥科巴表示，提供土壤信息对于增强农业抵御能力至关重要。

paras.en: “Part of resilience is to make sure that our information system is available and supporting farmers to build sustainable farm management,” he said.
paras.zh: “弹性的一部分是确保我们的信息系统可用并支持农民建立可持续的农场管理，”他说。

paras.en: Through the support of FAO, KALRO has renovated three labs and equipped them with state-of-the-art technology to support analysis of soil samples collected across the country.
paras.zh: 在粮农组织的支持下，KALRO 翻新了三个实验室，并为其配备了最先进的技术，以支持对全国各地收集的土壤样本进行分析。

paras.en: The samples are georeferenced, with the findings transmitted directly to farmers’ mobile phones.
paras.zh: 这些样本经过地理参考，结果直接传输到农民的手机上。

paras.en: The initiative is also attracting interest from young people exploring opportunities in agriculture.
paras.zh: 该倡议还吸引了探索农业机会的年轻人的兴趣。

paras.en: Jackline Kioko, a KALRO intern who participated in the launch, said the information shared had given her a better understanding of how soil testing could inform decisions on her family’s farm.
paras.zh: 参与此次发布的 KALRO 实习生 Jackline Kioko 表示，分享的信息让她更好地了解了土壤测试如何为她家农场的决策提供信息。

paras.en: “I'd love to do farming more, now that I have the information that you can actually test your soils to know what nutrients it requires,” she said.
paras.zh: “既然我掌握了可以实际测试土壤以了解其需要哪些养分的信息，我就愿意更多地从事农业，”她说。

paras.en: Kenya’s Cabinet Secretary for Agriculture, Mutahi Kagwe called for stronger collaboration among agricultural institutions to promote coordinated decision-making, enhance information sharing, and ensure that soil health is integrated into the work of all relevant institutions.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚农业内阁秘书穆塔希·卡格韦呼吁农业机构之间加强合作，促进协调决策，加强信息共享，并确保将土壤健康纳入所有相关机构的工作中。

paras.en: “I want to urge Kenyans that before thinking about what to plant or the fertilizer to use, think about soil testing,” he said.
paras.zh: “我想敦促肯尼亚人在考虑种植什么或使用肥料之前，先考虑一下土壤测试，”他说。

paras.en: The event also marked the launch of the Kenya Soil Partnership, the Kenya Soil Laboratory Network and the national rollout of the Global Soil Doctors Programme.
paras.zh: 此次活动还标志着肯尼亚土壤伙伴关系、肯尼亚土壤实验室网络的启动以及全球土壤医生计划在全国的推出。

paras.en: The SoilFER programme is currently being implemented in six other countries: Ghana, Guatemala, Honduras, Mozambique, Tunisia and Zambia.
paras.zh: SoilFER 计划目前正在其他六个国家实施：加纳、危地马拉、洪都拉斯、莫桑比克、突尼斯和赞比亚。

articles.title: Rodgers' magnificent obsession lands in Paris

paras.en: NFL Paris 2026: Aaron Rodgers and his magnificent obsession ready for more NFL history in final season of storied career
paras.zh: NFL 巴黎 2026：亚伦·罗杰斯 (Aaron Rodgers) 和他对 NFL 传奇职业生涯最后一个赛季的巨大痴迷做好了准备

paras.en: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers tells Sky Sports he is on the '18th green' of his NFL career amid what marks his final season; watch Rodgers' Steelers take on the New Orleans Saints at Stade de France in Paris, live on Sky Sports NFL from 1pm Sunday
paras.zh: 匹兹堡钢人队四分卫亚伦·罗杰斯告诉天空体育，他正处于 NFL 职业生涯的“第 18 绿”，这标志着他的最后一个赛季；周日下午 1 点，天空体育 NFL 直播，观看罗杰斯的钢人队在巴黎法兰西体育场迎战新奥尔良圣徒队

paras.en: A book on the shelf behind Aaron Rodgers is entitled 'A Magnificent Obsession', to which he sees the irony-meets-humour in relation to his own NFL love affair.
paras.zh: 亚伦·罗杰斯身后书架上有一本书，题为《伟大的痴迷》，他在这本书中看到了与自己的 NFL 爱情故事相关的讽刺与幽默。

paras.en: It is the game he cannot say goodbye to, but one he will say goodbye to at the end of this season, which he has insisted shall be the last of his stellar Hall of Fame career.
paras.zh: 这是一场他无法告别的比赛，但他将在本赛季结束时告别，他坚称这将是他辉煌的名人堂生涯的最后一场比赛。

paras.en: Just moments earlier Pittsburgh Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy had been asked about the difference in the Rodgers of now compared to the Rodgers with whom he had worked and won a Super Bowl in Green Bay. More grey hairs was the first answer.
paras.zh: 就在不久前，匹兹堡钢人队主教练迈克·麦卡锡被问及现在的罗杰斯队与他在绿湾共事并赢得超级碗的罗杰斯队相比有何不同。第一个答案是更多的白发。

paras.en: But at the age of 42 Rodgers will lead the Steelers out as a prized attraction when they face the New Orleans Saints in the NFL's historic Paris debut at Stade de France on Sunday, live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 但 42 岁的罗杰斯将带领钢人队周日在法兰西体育场举行 NFL 历史性的巴黎首秀，对阵新奥尔良圣徒队，比赛将由天空体育直播。

paras.en: - NFL in Paris 'all systems go' despite riots in France
paras.zh: - 尽管法国发生骚乱，巴黎的 NFL 仍“所有系统正常运转”

paras.en: - Latest NFL fixtures, results and UK kick-off times
paras.zh: - 最新 NFL 赛程、赛果和英国开球时间

paras.en: - Get latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: "To steal a line from one of my all-time favourite movies, 'Obsession is a young man's game'," Rodgers told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯告诉天空体育：“借用我最喜欢的电影之一的台词，‘痴迷是年轻人的游戏’。”

paras.en: "And the NFL is the young man's game. I'm hanging on and enjoying this last one."
paras.zh: “NFL 是年轻人的比赛。我会坚持下去并享受最后一场比赛。”

paras.en: So often the four-time MVP has likened his latter years to being on the proverbial 'back nine' of his NFL career, continuing to ride the highs and lows of a game that hasn't always fallen in his favour.
paras.zh: 这位四届 MVP 经常将自己的晚年比喻为 NFL 职业生涯中众所周知的“后九段”，继续经历一场并不总是对他有利的比赛的高潮和低谷。

paras.en: "I think I'm on the 18th green!" he laughed."
paras.zh: “我想我在 18 号洞果岭！”他笑了。”

paras.en: Rodgers has thrown for a ninth-most 1,487 yards and 12 touchdowns to five interceptions across Pittsburgh's 4-2 start to the season, having been reunited with former Packers coach McCarthy following Mike Tomlin's exit. His quest to win an elusive second Super Bowl ring may not have materialised as planned, but he is at peace with what awaits at the end of his 22nd campaign.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯在匹兹堡队本赛季4胜2负的开局中，传球1,487码，12次达阵，5次被拦截，排在第九位，在迈克·汤姆林退出后与前包装工队主教练麦卡锡重聚。他想要赢得第二枚超级碗戒指的愿望可能没有按计划实现，但他对第 22 届超级碗赛季结束时所面临的一切感到平静。

paras.en: "I've given a lot to this game, the game has given me a lot in return. I've got zero qualms about this being the end, zero fears about what's next. I'm just trying to live in the moment and enjoy this time with these guys."
paras.zh: “我为这款游戏付出了很多，这款游戏也给了我很多回报。我对这一切的结束毫无疑虑，对接下来会发生的事情零恐惧。我只是努力活在当下，享受和这些家伙在一起的时光。”

paras.en: Rodgers has long embraced opportunities to reach different corners of the world through football, last year being a leading advocate for Pittsburgh's historic appearance in Dublin and now preparing to be part of another milestone for the NFL in France.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯长期以来一直拥抱通过足球到达世界不同角落的机会，去年是匹兹堡在都柏林历史性亮相的主要倡导者，现在准备成为 NFL 在法国的另一个里程碑的一部分。

paras.en: "There's definitely only one moment in France," he said. "I'm going to enjoy this for the next couple of days. It's fun to be out here.
paras.zh: “在法国，这绝对只有一个时刻，”他说。 “接下来的几天我会很享受这个。来到这里很有趣。

paras.en: "It's fun to be a part of the first. As you get older you don't get a lot of firsts. To be in the first game in Paris is special.
paras.zh: “成为第一的一部分很有趣。随着年龄的增长，你不会获得很多第一。在巴黎参加第一场比赛很特别。

paras.en: "That's part of the game; that's the beauty of the game. It's going to keep on rolling. You're going to be here for a short time. You've got to enjoy it. Because you never know when it's going to be done. We've all been blessed.
paras.zh: “这是比赛的一部分；这就是比赛的美妙之处。它会继续下去。你会在这里呆很短的时间。你必须享受它。因为你永远不知道什么时候会完成。我们都很幸运。

paras.en: "I'm just thankful for the game and the places it's taken me. We've been to a lot of different countries now to play games."
paras.zh: “我只是感谢这款游戏以及它带我去的地方。我们现在已经去过很多不同的国家玩游戏了。”

paras.en: It is a welcome return to these shores for Rodgers, who recalled the time he was mobbed by Packers fans after entering the WOS Bar during a previous trip to Paris.
paras.zh: 对于罗杰斯来说，这次回到这片海岸是一次受欢迎的经历，他回忆起上次去巴黎时进入 WOS 酒吧后被包装工队球迷围攻的经历。

paras.en: He and the Steelers landed in the French capital on just Friday morning following a red-eye flight from Pittsburgh, while the Saints came into town on Monday as the designated home team.
paras.zh: 他和钢人队在从匹兹堡乘坐红眼航班后于周五早上抵达法国首都，而圣徒队则作为指定的主队于周一抵达法国首都。

paras.en: "I've played in three countries now, and each of them we've left on Thursday early evening. Would have been nice one time to come over on a Monday," he said.
paras.zh: “我现在已经在三个国家打过球了，每个国家我们都在周四傍晚离开。周一过来一次就好了，”他说。

articles.title: Burning Up backed to rise to Futurity challenge

paras.en: Racing tips: Burning Up backed to rise to Futurity challenge
paras.zh: 赛车技巧：Burning Up 支持迎接未来挑战

paras.en: The Weekend Winners panel of Kate Tracey, Declan Rix and Sam Boswell offer their views ahead of action from Cheltenham and Doncaster - which plays host to the Futurity Trophy; Watch the episode in full on the At The Races YouTube channel
paras.zh: 由凯特·特雷西 (Kate Tracey)、德克兰·里克斯 (Declan Rix) 和萨姆·博斯韦尔 (Sam Boswell) 组成的周末获奖者小组在切尔滕纳姆 (Cheltenham) 和未来杯 (Futurity Trophy) 主办地唐卡斯特 (Doncaster) 的比赛之前发表了他们的看法；在 At The Races YouTube 频道上观看完整剧集

paras.en: Ahead of another Saturday of racing, the Weekend Winners team reconvene to discuss the best betting angles.
paras.zh: 在又一个星期六的比赛之前，周末获胜者团队重新聚集在一起讨论最佳投注角度。

paras.en: At the end of the show, each of the trio nominated their best bet, next best and longshot, with Declan Rix taking aim at Doncaster for his top fancy.
paras.zh: 演出结束时，三人各自提名了自己的最佳选择、次佳选择和可能性不大的选择，而德克兰·里克斯则将目标瞄准了唐卡斯特。

paras.en: "My NAP is coming in the Prospect Stakes at 2.05 at Doncaster on Saturday and it's Hi Corbett Court for the Paddy Twomey and Billy Lee team. I think he has stronger form than Bengal Tiger from that sales race that he ran well in. He's got a bit of class about him, and he has a significant knee action which will help him on Saturday.
paras.zh: “我的小睡将于周六下午2点05分在Doncaster的Prospect Stakes进行，这是Paddy Twomey和Billy Lee团队的Hi Corbett Court。我认为他的身材比他参加的销售比赛中的孟加拉虎更强壮。他对他有点好感，他有一个重要的膝盖动作，这将在周六对他有所帮助。

paras.en: "The longshot comes in the opener at Doncaster with the Kevin Phillipart de Foy-trained Sovereign Spell. If you go back and look at this horse's form at Newmarket this season, he looks well handicapped. He goes well fresh and he comes here off a break."
paras.zh: “在唐卡斯特的揭幕战中，凯文·菲利普·德·福伊训练的主权咒语是最有希望的。如果你回头看看这匹马本赛季在纽马基特的表现，它看起来很差劲。它状态很好，来这里休息一下。”

paras.en: "My NAP is Bengal Tiger in the Listed Prospect Stakes and it's purely down to the lack of quality in behind. The cheekpieces have seemed to help him, and this is a good opportunity for him to win again.
paras.zh: “我的 NAP 是预期锦标赛中的孟加拉虎，这纯粹是因为后面的质量不足。护颊板似乎对他有帮助，这是他再次获胜的好机会。

paras.en: "My next best is going to be Katate Dori for Sam Thomas. He's in the staying chase and his trainer always starts the season well and he is fitted with first-time blinkers today. He is well handicapped on last year's form and I think he will go well."
paras.zh: “我的下一个最佳球员是萨姆·托马斯的卡塔特·多里。他一直在追赶，他的教练总是在赛季开始时表现出色，今天他第一次戴上了眼罩。他去年的状态很差，我认为他会表现出色。”

paras.en: "Burning Up in the Futurity Trophy at Doncaster is the NAP for me. I think the conditions will suit and he will handle the flatter track. He has good pace on paper and I hope he can go well here.
paras.zh: “在唐卡斯特的未来奖杯中燃烧对我来说是小睡。我认为条件会适合，他会处理更平坦的赛道。他在纸上有很好的速度，我希望他能在这里取得好成绩。

paras.en: "I'm going to a bumper race for my next best and it's a Joe Tizzard-trained runner in Thyingman. His horses are flying at the minute, with four winners at Ffos Las the other day. He won at Hereford on soft ground on his first career start and the test will hopefully suit him."
paras.zh: “我将参加一场精彩的比赛，争取我的下一个最佳成绩，这是在蒂英曼 (Thyingman) 接受乔·蒂扎德 (Joe Tizzard) 训练的赛马。他的马匹正在飞翔，前几天在 Ffos Las 获得了四次冠军。他在赫里福德 (Hereford) 的软土上赢得了他职业生涯的第一次比赛，这次测试希望适合他。”

articles.title: One person killed in shooting near Paris, French prime minister says
articles.author: Gabrielle Nolin

paras.en: At least one person was killed and four people were injured in a shooting near Paris, French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said Friday.
paras.zh: 法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努周五表示，巴黎附近发生枪击事件，造成至少一人死亡、四人受伤。

paras.en: “The individual has been apprehended and taken into police custody,” he said on X.
paras.zh: “此人已被逮捕并被警方拘留，”他在 X 上说。

paras.en: One person has been arrested and charged on four counts, including murder and possession of a firearm, with the “aggravating circumstance that the acts were committed on the basis of actual or supposed membership in a particular race, ethnicity, a purported race, ethnic group, nation, or specific religion,” France’s anti-terrorism prosecutor’s office told NBC News in a statement.
paras.zh: 法国反恐检察官办公室在一份声明中告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，其中一人已被逮捕并被指控犯有四项罪名，包括谋杀和持有枪支，“情节严重的是，这些行为是基于实际或假定的特定种族、族裔、声称的种族、族裔群体、民族或特定宗教的成员身份而实施的”。

paras.en: The incident occurred in Trappes and La Verrière, a suburb in Yvelines department, about 20 miles west of Paris, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，这起事件发生在巴黎以西约 20 英里的伊夫林省郊区特拉普和拉维里埃。

paras.en: Trappes Mayor Ali Rabeh said on X that a man had opened fire on people from his car. An investigation was underway to determine the motive of the shooter, he added.
paras.zh: 特拉普市市长阿里·拉贝 (Ali Rabeh) 在 X 上表示，一名男子在车内向行人开枪。他补充说，正在进行调查以确定枪手的动机。

paras.en: One of those injured was a 12-year-old girl, he told France’s BFM TV.
paras.zh: 他告诉法国 BFM 电视台，其中一名受伤者是一名 12 岁女孩。

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron said he was shocked by the events in a post on X, adding: “Our thoughts go to the victims, their families, and all the residents of Yvelines. During this terrible ordeal, the nation stands with them.”
paras.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙（ Emmanuel Macron ）在X上的一篇帖子中表示，他对这些事件感到震惊，并补充说： “我们的想法是受害者、他们的家人和伊夫林的所有居民。在这场可怕的考验中，国家与他们站在一起。”

paras.en: “We extend our gratitude to our law enforcement agencies,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们向我们的执法机构表示感谢，”他说。

paras.en: This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.
paras.zh: 这是一个发展的故事。请回来查看更新。

articles.title: Meghan Markle ‘deeply distressed’ by allegations her dad possessed child sexual abuse images
articles.author: Adela Suliman

paras.en: LONDON — Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, said Friday that she was “deeply distressed” by a report alleging that her estranged father, Thomas Markle Sr., possessed child sexual abuse images, adding that she was informed by police of “disturbing allegations” against him in 2018.
paras.zh: 伦敦——苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根周五表示，有报道称她关系疏远的父亲老托马斯·马克尔拥有儿童性虐待图片，她对此感到“深感悲痛”，并补充说，警方在 2018 年向她通报了针对他的“令人不安的指控”。

paras.en: In a statement Friday, Meghan addressed the report that her father was being investigated over claims he kept child sexual abuse videos and images at his home in the Philippines. “The breadth of what has now been uncovered is more sickening than one could ever imagine,” said Meghan, who has in recent years had a limited and fraught relationship with her father. He did not attend her wedding to Prince Harry in 2018, drawing widespread media scrutiny.
paras.zh: 梅根在周五的一份声明中谈到了有关她父亲因涉嫌在菲律宾家中保存儿童性虐待视频和图像而受到调查的报道。 “现在所发现的事情的广度比人们想象的更加令人作呕，”梅根说，她近年来与父亲的关系有限且令人担忧。他没有参加 2018 年她与哈里王子的婚礼，引起了媒体的广泛关注。

paras.en: The allegations against Markle Sr. were first reported Thursday by The Sun newspaper, a British tabloid, which reported that his son had informed police after he said he found “hundreds, if not thousands” of child sex abuse images in boxes at his father’s home. The Sun published a photo it said showed his son, Thomas Markle Jr., signing a sworn statement it said he had submitted to police and quoted him as saying: “I won’t speak to my father ever again unless I’m called to give evidence against him.”
paras.zh: 英国小报《太阳报》周四首次报道了针对老马克尔的指控，该报报道称，他的儿子在父亲家的盒子里发现了“数百甚至数千张”儿童性虐待照片后，通知了警方。 《太阳报》刊登了一张照片，据称显示他的儿子小托马斯·马克尔签署了一份据称是他向警方提交的宣誓声明，并援引他的话说：“我不会再和我的父亲说话，除非我被传唤提供对他不利的证据。”

paras.en: Markle Sr., 82, denied the reported allegations, calling them “sick lies” in a statement to Britain’s Daily Mail newspaper. He added they were “the worst thing anyone could accuse me of.”
paras.zh: 82 岁的老马克尔在给英国《每日邮报》的一份声明中否认了所报道的指控，称这些指控是“病态的谎言”。他补充说，这是“任何人都可以指责我的最糟糕的事情。”

paras.en: NBC News was not immediately able to identify a contact for Markle Sr., who the Daily Mail reported was now in a Florida rehab center recovering from surgery.
paras.zh: NBC新闻未能立即确定老马克尔的联系人，据《每日邮报》报道，老马克尔目前正在佛罗里达州的一家康复中心接受手术康复。

paras.en: Markle Jr. told the Sun that he had reported his discovery to the FBI, as well as local Philippine authorities. NBC News has reached out to the FBI for comment, which did not immediately respond.
paras.zh: 小马克尔告诉《太阳报》，他已向联邦调查局以及菲律宾当地当局报告了这一发现。 NBC 新闻已联系联邦调查局征求意见，但联邦调查局没有立即回应。

paras.en: The Philippines’ justice department confirmed Friday that “the matter is under investigation” but otherwise declined to “provide further details at this time.”
paras.zh: 菲律宾司法部周五证实，“此事正在调查中”，但拒绝“目前提供进一步的细节”。

paras.en: Police in Cebu City, the location of Markle Sr.’s home in the Philippines, and London’s Metropolitan Police did not immediately respond to requests for comment from NBC News.
paras.zh: 老马克尔在菲律宾的家所在地宿务市警方和伦敦警察厅没有立即回应 NBC 新闻的置评请求。

paras.en: In the rare statement Friday, Meghan said that she had chosen to keep her children, Prince Archie, 7, and Princess Lilibet, 5, away from her father “for one reason: to protect them.”
paras.zh: 在周五罕见的声明中，梅根表示，她选择让自己的孩子——7岁的阿奇王子和5岁的莉莉贝特公主——远离父亲，“原因只有一个：保护他们”。

paras.en: “I am deeply distressed at the news that has come to light in the last 24 hours, and my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed,” she said in the statement.
paras.zh: 她在声明中表示：“我对过去 24 小时内曝光的消息深感悲痛，我的心与所有可能受到伤害的儿童同在。”

paras.en: Meghan said that she had been made aware of a letter sent to the British police and other authorities in 2018, that “made troubling and disturbing allegations against my father and I was given assurances that these were being investigated.”
paras.zh: 梅根表示，她已获悉 2018 年英国警方和其他当局收到的一封信，“对我父亲提出了令人不安和不安的指控，我得到保证，这些指控正在接受调查”。

paras.en: “I hope it can now be understood that, despite certain media publications’ distortion over the years, any distance from my father and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children, was for one reason: to protect them,” she added.
paras.zh: “我希望现在大家能够理解，尽管多年来某些媒体出版物歪曲事实，但我与父亲的任何距离以及我选择不允许他与我们的孩子接触的原因只有一个：保护他们，”她补充道。

paras.en: “Although the breadth of what has now been uncovered is more sickening than one could ever imagine, my sincerest hope is that justice will be fully served and that the priority remains the safety and protection of innocent children,” Meghan said.
paras.zh: 梅根说：“尽管现在所揭露的事情比人们想象的更加令人作呕，但我最真诚的希望是正义能够得到充分伸张，优先事项仍然是无辜儿童的安全和保护。”

paras.en: Asked by NBC News when Meghan was made aware of the letter to the Metropolitan Police, a spokesman for the couple said it was in the summer of 2018, after her wedding with Harry.
paras.zh: 当被 NBC 新闻问到梅根何时知道这封写给伦敦警察厅的信时，这对夫妇的发言人表示，那是在 2018 年夏天，她与哈里结婚后。

paras.en: Separately, a source close to the couple told NBC News that Meghan’s decision not to speak publicly eight years ago should be understood in a particular context: “When she was made aware of these allegations in 2018 after they were reported to the police, they remained just that — allegations.”
paras.zh: 另外，一位与这对夫妇关系密切的消息人士告诉 NBC 新闻，梅根八年前不公开发表言论的决定应该在特定背景下理解：“2018 年，当这些指控向警方报案后，她才得知这些指控时，它们仍然只是指控。”

paras.en: “To have repeated them publicly at that stage would not only have potentially exposed her to civil action for making unsubstantiated claims, but she had also been advised that doing so could jeopardize any subsequent investigation,” the source added.
paras.zh: 消息人士补充说：“在那个阶段公开重复这些内容不仅可能会让她因提出未经证实的指控而受到民事诉讼，而且她还被告知这样做可能会危及任何后续调查。”

paras.en: Markle Sr. told the Daily Mail he had not spoken to his son “for months” and said “these terrible lies are being made against me with no proof.” He added that he would “welcome an investigation” into the matter and labeled the accusations “a bunch of lies.”
paras.zh: 老马克尔告诉《每日邮报》，他已经“几个月”没有和儿子说过话了，并说“这些可怕的谎言是针对我的，没有任何证据。”他补充说，他“欢迎对此事进行调查”，并将这些指控称为“一堆谎言”。

paras.en: His daughter, Samantha Markle, also told the Daily Mail of her brother’s allegations: “there is no merit in these disgusting allegations whatsoever ... He wants to destroy our dad. Shame on him.”
paras.zh: 他的女儿萨曼莎·马克尔也向《每日邮报》讲述了她哥哥的指控：“这些令人厌恶的指控毫无价值……他想毁掉我们的父亲。他真丢脸。”

paras.en: NBC News did not immediately receive responses to requests for comment from Markle Jr. or Samantha Markle — Meghan’s half-siblings.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻没有立即收到小马克尔或梅根同父异母的兄弟姐妹萨曼莎·马克尔的置评请求。

paras.en: Markle Sr. married Meghan’s mother, Doria Ragland, in 1979 and they subsequently divorced in 1987.
paras.zh: 老马克尔于 1979 年与梅根的母亲多莉亚·拉格兰 (Doria Ragland) 结婚，随后于 1987 年离婚。

paras.en: Meghan, 45, and Harry, 42, moved back to the United Kingdom earlier this summer after several years in the United States.
paras.zh: 45 岁的梅根和 42 岁的哈里在美国呆了几年后，于今年夏天早些时候搬回了英国。

paras.en: The couple made their first joint public appearance last week visiting charities in central England. King Charles III has made clear that their return does not signal a return to active royal life. Harry, however, has said recently that he wants his disagreements with his family to “work out.”
paras.zh: 上周，这对夫妇首次联合公开露面，访问英格兰中部的慈善机构。查理三世国王明确表示，他们的回归并不意味着恢复活跃的王室生活。然而，哈里最近表示，他希望与家人的分歧“得到解决”。

articles.title: Russian diesel tanker heads to the U.S., the first since Trump’s deal with Putin
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: A tanker loaded with diesel fuel set sail Friday from Russia for the United States, the first shipment since President Donald Trump agreed to a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to release more fuel into the global market.
paras.zh: 一艘满载柴油的油轮周五从俄罗斯启航前往美国，这是自唐纳德·特朗普总统同意与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京达成协议以向全球市场释放更多燃料以来的第一批货物。

paras.en: Trump eased some sanctions on the Kremlin two weeks ago and has since waived more, reversing years of American policy despite Moscow’s ongoing illegal invasion of Ukraine in an apparent bid to lower prices ahead of the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 特朗普两周前放松了对克里姆林宫的一些制裁，此后又放弃了更多制裁，扭转了美国多年来的政策，尽管莫斯科不断非法入侵乌克兰，显然是为了在中期选举前降低物价。

paras.en: The ship’s departure for the U.S. was confirmed by the Kremlin. The tanker, a Malta-flagged ship named Agioi Fanendes, left a port in Russia’s Primorsk today, according to MarineTraffic tracking data reviewed by NBC News. The ship listed New York as its destination.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫证实了这艘船将启程前往美国。根据 NBC 新闻查阅的 MarineTraffic 跟踪数据，这艘名为 Agioi Fanendes 的油轮今天离开了俄罗斯普里莫尔斯克的一个港口。该船将纽约列为目的地。

paras.en: Energy Aspects, a market intelligence firm, said that it had confirmed with its industry sources that the ship loaded up 298,000 barrels of diesel in Primorsk.
paras.zh: 市场情报公司Energy Aspects表示，已向业内消息人士证实，该船在普里莫尔斯克装载了298,000桶柴油。

paras.en: The firm said that currently the ship plans to unload that fuel in New York. It is expected to arrive Nov. 10.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，目前该船计划在纽约卸货。预计11月10日到货。

paras.en: The ship’s expected arrival would put it just after the midterm elections. Trump’s Republican Party is on edge for potentially heavy losses in House and Senate seats its candidates are defending, driven in part by blowback from consumers facing soaring energy prices.
paras.zh: 这艘船预计将在中期选举之后抵达。特朗普领导的共和党正处于其候选人所捍卫的众议院和参议院席位可能遭受重大损失的边缘，部分原因是面临能源价格飙升的消费者的反弹。

paras.en: Trump and his administration have scrambled to try to bring down those prices, which have increased in the wake of supply shocks stemming from the Iran war launched by the U.S. and Israel, and the Russia-Ukraine war.
paras.zh: 特朗普和他的政府争先恐后地试图降低这些价格，由于美国和以色列发动的伊朗战争以及俄罗斯-乌克兰战争造成供应冲击，这些价格已经上涨。

paras.en: Trump has taken a number of steps to warm ties with the Kremlin and pressure Kyiv to agree to end the war, drawing outrage from Ukraine and its bipartisan backers in Congress.
paras.zh: 特朗普采取了一系列措施来缓和与克里姆林宫的关系，并向基辅施压，要求其同意结束战争，这引起了乌克兰及其国会两党支持者的愤怒。

paras.en: “I believe there have already been reports from the Ministry of Energy that the first tanker has departed for its destinations and that further shipments will continue on a regular basis,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said early Friday.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫周五早些时候表示：“我相信能源部已经收到报告称，第一艘油轮已启航前往目的地，并将继续定期运送更多货物。”

paras.en: Crude oil was headed for a third straight weekly gain. Brent, the most important global oil benchmark, traded around $114 per barrel, less than $13 away from its highest point this year.
paras.zh: 原油将连续第三周上涨。全球最重要的石油基准布伦特原油价格约为每桶 114 美元，距离今年的最高点不到 13 美元。

paras.en: Since the start of the year, the average price of diesel fuel has soared from $3.55 per gallon to $6.32, an unprecedented rise of 78%.
paras.zh: 今年以来，柴油平均价格从每加仑3.55美元飙升至6.32美元，涨幅高达78%，史无前例。

paras.en: Energy Aspect’s analysts said the impact of the cargo’s arrival would likely be “limited.”
paras.zh: Energy Aspect 的分析师表示，货物抵达的影响可能“有限”。

paras.en: Diesel’s sky-high price has troubled economists more than the jump in the price of regular gasoline because, “the cost of diesel gets into just about everything,” as KPMG chief economist Diane Swonk told NBC News in an August interview.
paras.zh: 柴油的天价价格比普通汽油价格的上涨更让经济学家感到困扰，因为正如毕马威首席经济学家黛安·斯旺克（Diane Swonk）在 8 月份接受 NBC 新闻采访时所说，“柴油的成本几乎影响到一切”。

paras.en: “Everything from … running a farm … cost of food, but also everything across the economy that’s shipped gets that extra fee tacked onto it,” she said.
paras.zh: “从……经营农场……食品成本，以及整个经济中运输的所有东西，都会产生额外的费用，”她说。

paras.en: Currently, U.S. daily diesel demand is about 3.8 million barrels, meaning that Friday’s shipment would satisfy not even a full day’s worth of usage.
paras.zh: 目前，美国每日柴油需求约为380万桶，这意味着周五的发货量甚至无法满足一整天的使用量。

paras.en: “Global distillate markets have tightened sharply,” Bank of America’s head of global commodities, Francisco Blanch, wrote in a recent note, adding that it signals “an acute scarcity of refined products.”
paras.zh: 美国银行全球大宗商品主管弗朗西斯科·布兰奇(Francisco Blanch)在最近的一份报告中写道，“全球馏分油市场急剧收紧”，并补充说，这表明“精炼产品严重短缺”。

paras.en: Diesel is a distillate fuel, produced by refining crude oil.
paras.zh: 柴油是一种馏分燃料，通过精炼原油生产。

paras.en: “Geopolitical disruptions are exacerbating that shortage as attacks on shipping around Hormuz make energy flows more difficult and costly, while attacks on Russian refining capacity further restrict product availability,” he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“地缘政治的干扰正在加剧这种短缺，因为霍尔木兹周边航运受到的攻击使能源流动变得更加困难和成本更高，而对俄罗斯炼油能力的攻击则进一步限制了产品的供应。”

paras.en: Russia has historically been one of the world’s largest exporters of diesel.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯历来是世界上最大的柴油出口国之一。

paras.en: In September and for some of October, the Kremlin restricted the export of diesel fuel amid a Ukrainian campaign of attacks on its energy infrastructure. It lifted those export restrictions after Putin’s diesel deal with Trump.
paras.zh: 9 月和 10 月的部分时间，由于乌克兰对其能源基础设施发起攻击，克里姆林宫限制了柴油出口。在普京与特朗普达成柴油协议后，它取消了这些出口限制。

paras.en: Easing sanctions on Russia to open up some previously-blocked diesel supplies was just the latest in a number of policy levers pulled by Trump.
paras.zh: 放松对俄罗斯的制裁以开放一些此前被封锁的柴油供应只是特朗普采取的一系列政策杠杆中的最新一项。

paras.en: In just the last few weeks, the president has also signed an order allowing more widespread use of an off-road variety of diesel. The administration also pressured European allies, particularly Germany and France, to urgently release some of their diesel reserves.
paras.zh: 就在过去几周，总统还签署了一项命令，允许更广泛地使用越野柴油。美国政府还向欧洲盟国施压，特别是德国和法国，要求其紧急释放部分柴油储备。

paras.en: The administration has also reportedly pushed for a fresh release of crude and diesel reserves, though the International Energy Agency has rebuffed that request.
paras.zh: 据报道，美国政府还推动释放新的原油和柴油储备，但国际能源署拒绝了这一要求。

paras.en: Experts say that even with all this put together, Trump’s actions will do little to help ease prices, which have continued to trend higher.
paras.zh: 专家表示，即使将所有这些放在一起，特朗普的行动也无助于缓解持续走高的价格。

paras.en: “Policy intervention can provide temporary relief, but there is no silver bullet for diesel,” Blanch wrote.
paras.zh: 布兰奇写道：“政策干预可以提供暂时的缓解，但柴油没有灵丹妙药。”

articles.title: One dead, four injured in Paris shooting as police probe terror link

paras.en: One dead and four injured in Paris shooting, as police probe possible terror link
paras.zh: 巴黎枪击案造成一死四伤 警方调查可能与恐怖分子有关

paras.en: A man is in custody after allegedly opening fire on a Paris neighbourhood, killing one and injuring at least four others, including a 12-year-old girl.
paras.zh: 一名男子涉嫌向巴黎一处街区开枪，造成一人死亡、至少四人受伤，其中包括一名 12 岁女孩，目前已被拘留。

paras.en: Authorities say the gunman appeared to have fired shots at random.
paras.zh: 当局表示，枪手似乎是随意开枪的。

paras.en: France's anti-terrorism prosecutors are investigating the shooting for possible terror links.
paras.zh: 法国反恐检察官正在调查这起枪击事件是否与恐怖活动有关。

articles.title: Gunmen open fire at church in Jordan, killing at least seven

paras.en: Gunmen have opened fire inside a church during a funeral in southern Jordan.
paras.zh: 在约旦南部的一场葬礼上，枪手在一座教堂内开枪。

paras.en: At least seven people have been killed and more than 30 others injured.
paras.zh: 至少7人死亡，30多人受伤。

paras.en: Jordan's King has vowed to punish those responsible with "an iron fist".
paras.zh: 约旦国王发誓要用“铁拳”惩罚肇事者。

paras.en: Gunmen have opened fire inside a church in southern Jordan, killing at least seven people, according to local authorities.
paras.zh: 据当地政府称，枪手在约旦南部一座教堂内开枪，造成至少七人死亡。

paras.en: The Director of Public Security Major General Abdullah Al-Maaytah said seven had died and 34 others injured in an attack by unidentified assailants during a funeral in Jordan's Karak region, about 180 kilometres south of the capital, Amman.
paras.zh: 公共安全总监阿卜杜拉·迈塔少将表示，在首都安曼以南约 180 公里的约旦卡拉克地区举行的一场葬礼上，身份不明的袭击者袭击了 7 人死亡、34 人受伤。

paras.en: At least 27 of those injured were still receiving medical treatment.
paras.zh: 其中至少27名伤者仍在接受治疗。

paras.en: The attack took place during a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church with between 150 and 200 people inside, the state news agency said.
paras.zh: 官方通讯社称，袭击发生在一座希腊东正教教堂举行葬礼期间，教堂内有 150 至 200 人。

paras.en: Jordan's King Abdullah has vowed to punish those responsible.
paras.zh: 约旦国王阿卜杜拉发誓要惩罚肇事者。

paras.en: "The terrorist attack against Karak will be met with the harshest retaliation," he said in an English-language post on X.
paras.zh: 他在 X 上的一篇英文帖子中表示：“针对卡拉克的恐怖袭击将遭到最严厉的报复。”

paras.en: "We will strike with an iron fist against those who dare to threaten our nation."
paras.zh: “我们将用铁拳打击那些胆敢威胁我们国家的人。”

paras.en: An eyewitness told the news outlet that a vehicle arrived carrying the gunmen, who fired continuously for five minutes before fleeing the scene.
paras.zh: 一名目击者告诉新闻媒体，一辆载着枪手的车辆抵达，枪手连续开枪五分钟，然后逃离现场。

paras.en: Karak is home to a significant Christian community in the Muslim-majority kingdom.
paras.zh: 卡拉克是这个穆斯林占多数的王国中一个重要基督教社区的所在地。

paras.en: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun called the shooting at the church a "heinous terrorist attack".
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩总统约瑟夫·奥恩称教堂枪击事件是“令人发指的恐怖袭击”。

paras.en: It "reaffirms once again that terrorism has no religion and no homeland, and its aim is to strike at coexistence and spread strife", he said in a statement.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中表示，这“再次重申恐怖主义没有宗教，没有祖国，其目的是打击共存、散布冲突”。

paras.en: While the country's Interior Minister Mazen Al-Faraya told a press conference a "terrorist group" was responsible for the "horrific act".
paras.zh: 该国内政部长马赞·法拉亚（Mazen Al-Faraya）在新闻发布会上表示，一个“恐怖组织”应对这一“可怕行为”负责。

paras.en: "The security services are working round the clock to track them down," he said.
paras.zh: “安全部门正在全天候工作以追踪他们，”他说。

paras.en: He said the perpetrators had "absolutely no connection whatsoever to human values" and it "only serves to strengthen the Jordanians' resolve... to combat and fight terrorism in all its forms".
paras.zh: 他说，肇事者“与人类价值观完全没有任何关系”，这“只会增强约旦人打击和打击一切形式恐怖主义的决心”。

paras.en: Attacks on houses of worship in Jordan are rare.
paras.zh: 在约旦，针对礼拜堂的袭击很少见。

paras.en: The Greek Orthodox Archdiocese in Jordan said that if the attack was aimed at driving out Christians from the holy land, it would not work,
paras.zh: 约旦希腊东正教总教区表示，如果袭击的目的是将基督徒赶出圣地，那是行不通的，

paras.en: "It will only make us cling to it more firmly and deepen our roots in it," the church said.
paras.zh: 教会表示：“这只会让我们更加坚定地坚持它，并加深我们在其中的根基。”

paras.en: "We are absolutely certain that Jordanian society will remain impervious to every dark, extremist ideology, and that this criminal act is far removed from -- and alien to -- the moderate Islam of our country."
paras.zh: “我们绝对确信，约旦社会将不会受到任何黑暗、极端主义意识形态的影响，这种犯罪行为与我国温和的伊斯兰教相距甚远，而且格格不入。”

paras.en: Authorities said an investigation was underway and that they would announce its findings as they became available.
paras.zh: 当局表示调查正在进行中，并将在调查结果公布后公布。

articles.title: Netanyahu orders major West Bank offensive after Hebron attack
articles.author: Laura Tingle

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has pledged to mount a major offensive to "destroy" parts of Hebron in the occupied West Bank.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡承诺发动大规模攻势，“摧毁”被占领的约旦河西岸希伯伦部分地区。

paras.en: It comes after two Israeli soldiers were shot dead at a checkpoint.
paras.zh: 此前，两名以色列士兵在检查站被枪杀。

paras.en: Mr Netanyahu has also threatened to broaden the assault across the West Bank.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡先生还威胁要扩大整个西岸的攻击范围。

paras.en: Benjamin Netanyahu has seized on an attack at a military checkpoint in Hebron, which killed two Israeli soldiers and two Palestinian gunmen, to launch a major offensive in the city, with Israeli forces going house-to-house to "destroy" what he described as “terrorist infrastructure”.
paras.zh: 本杰明·内塔尼亚胡抓住希伯伦军事检查站发生的袭击事件，造成两名以色列士兵和两名巴勒斯坦枪手死亡，在该市发动大规模攻势，以色列军队挨家挨户“摧毁”他所说的“恐怖基础设施”。

paras.en: The Israeli PM also threatened to broaden the assault across the West Bank to a scale "unlike any seen since the Six-Day War".
paras.zh: 以色列总理还威胁要将袭击范围扩大到约旦河西岸，其规模“是六日战争以来从未有过的”。

paras.en: Mr Netanyahu also used the incident, which took place on Friday, to endorse the increasingly violent actions of "our heroic" Israeli settlers in the West Bank for "standing in the breach".
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡先生还利用周五发生的这一事件来支持西岸“我们英勇的”以色列定居者“站在突破口”日益暴力的行为。

paras.en: "You are a role model for the people of Israel, you are a role model for the State of Israel", he said, vowing an expansion of settlements regarded as illegal under international law at an even greater rate in the future.
paras.zh: 他说：“你们是以色列人民的榜样，你们是以色列国的榜样”，并誓言未来将以更大的速度扩建被国际法视为非法的定居点。

paras.en: Four days before the first Israeli election since catastrophic security failures led to the October 7 Hamas attack in 2023, the embatted PM arrived in Hebron at the scene of what had been a 20-minute gun battle between two Palestinian gunmen and security forces which killed two Israeli soldiers and injured three others. The two gunmen were also killed.
paras.zh: 自灾难性的安全失败导致 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击以来，距以色列首次选举四天，这位四面楚歌的总理抵达希伯伦，现场发生了两名巴勒斯坦枪手和安全部队之间长达 20 分钟的枪战，造成两名以色列士兵死亡，三人受伤。两名枪手也被击毙。

paras.en: Israel Defence Forces (IDF) immediately claimed that a large quantity of ammunition found in the attackers' car showed they had been planning a mass shooting of Israeli citizens.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军（IDF）立即声称，袭击者车内发现大量弹药，表明他们计划对以色列公民进行大规模枪击。

paras.en: Hamas issued a statement praising the actions of the two gunmen, identified by Israeli security forces as two 27-year-old members of the same family, Mohammad Jaaba and Firas Jaaba.
paras.zh: 哈马斯发表声明，赞扬两名枪手的行动，以色列安全部队确认，这两名枪手是同一家庭的两名 27 岁成员，穆罕默德·贾巴 (Mohammad Jaaba) 和菲拉斯·贾巴 (Firas Jaaba)。

paras.en: Israel's prime minister immediately ordered the sealing of the predominantly Palestinian city of Hebron and threatened the possible closure of the entire West Bank.
paras.zh: 以色列总理立即下令封锁以巴勒斯坦人为主的希伯伦市，并威胁可能关闭整个西岸。

paras.en: After cancelling planned election events, Mr Netanyahu arrived in Hebron to announce major retaliations in the neighbourhood where the attackers lived and warned that Israeli defence forces could broaden out their assault.
paras.zh: 在取消计划中的选举活动后，内塔尼亚胡先生抵达希伯伦，宣布对袭击者居住的社区进行重大报复，并警告以色列国防军可能会扩大袭击范围。

paras.en: "We will implement the successful and aggressive offensive model we carried out in the refugee camps inside the cities — the IDF will enter the neighbourhoods from which the terrorists emerged, evacuate the residents, go house-to-house, and destroy the terrorist infrastructure", Mr Netanyahu, appearing in a flak jacket, said in Hebrew.
paras.zh: 身着防弹衣的内塔尼亚胡用希伯来语说道：“我们将实施在城市内难民营中实施的成功且积极的进攻模式——以色列国防军将进入恐怖分子出现的社区，疏散居民，挨家挨户摧毁恐怖分子的基础设施。”

paras.en: "We are prepared for a broad operation in Judea and Samaria [the Israeli name for the West Bank]."
paras.zh: “我们准备在朱迪亚和撒玛利亚（以色列对约旦河西岸的称呼）开展广泛的行动。”

paras.en: "We warned a few weeks ago about attempts by our enemies to harm us, our citizens, and our soldiers ahead of the elections.
paras.zh: “几周前，我们警告说，我们的敌人企图在选举前伤害我们、我们的公民和我们的士兵。

paras.en: "That is what they tried to do here. IDF soldiers blocked this with their bodies and were also wounded. The soldiers not only stopped the terrorists but also charged heroically and eliminated them."
paras.zh: “这就是他们试图在这里做的事情。以色列国防军士兵用身体挡住了这一切，也受伤了。士兵们不仅阻止了恐怖分子，还英勇冲锋并消灭了他们。”

paras.en: Mr Netanyahu's culpability for the security failures on October 7, 2023, his failure to act to get Israeli hostages back out of Gaza, and his refusal to allow a proper inquiry into the events that led to the biggest mass killing of Jews since the Holocaust are a central issue in the election campaign.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡先生对 2023 年 10 月 7 日的安全失败负有责任，他未能采取行动将以色列人质带出加沙，以及他拒绝对导致大屠杀以来最大规模犹太人屠杀的事件进行适当调查，这些都是竞选活动的核心问题。

paras.en: There has been considerable apprehension that any escalation of violence could be seized on to enhance his security credentials.
paras.zh: 人们非常担心，任何暴力升级都可能被用来提高他的安全信誉。

paras.en: In Hebron, Mr Netanyahu said "we will act to destroy this place, to change it completely, but to do something that has not been done until now — we are going to implement the successful and aggressive model we used in the refugee camps, which are essentially terrorist strongholds".
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在希伯伦表示，“我们将采取行动摧毁这个地方，彻底改变它，但要做一些迄今为止尚未做过的事情——我们将实施我们在难民营中使用的成功和激进的模式，这些难民营本质上是恐怖分子的据点”。

paras.en: In language that carried clear echoes of the devastation the IDF brought to Gaza after the October 7 attacks, Mr Netanyahu said "we will evacuate the residents, we will go house-to-house, we will also confiscate the weapons there, and all terrorist infrastructures will be dealt with and destroyed".
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡先生的语言清楚地呼应了10月7日袭击后以色列国防军给加沙带来的破坏，“我们将疏散居民，我们将挨家挨户走访，我们还将没收那里的武器，所有恐怖主义基础设施都将得到处理和摧毁”。

paras.en: "At the same time, we are cordoning off the cities of Hebron and Halhul.
paras.zh: “与此同时，我们正在封锁希伯伦和哈胡尔市。

paras.en: "We will consider expanding this model to other cities as well. We will clear out illegal houses along the routes at an accelerated pace. This threatens our forces."
paras.zh: “我们也会考虑将这种模式推广到其他城市。我们将加快清理沿线非法房屋的速度。这对我们的部队构成威胁。”

paras.en: The prime minister said that he and Defence Minister Israel Katz had reviewed "a very broad IDF operation in Judea and Samaria unlike any seen since the Six-Day War".
paras.zh: 总理表示，他和国防部长以色列·卡茨审查了“以色列国防军在朱迪亚和撒马利亚的一次非常广泛的行动，这与六日战争以来的任何一次行动都不同”。

paras.en: "The IDF is prepared to carry it out, and we will determine the timing, but it is on the way"
paras.zh: “以色列国防军已准备好执行这一任务，我们将确定时间，但它正在路上”

paras.en: Mr Netanyahu said he also wanted to say "a word about our heroic settlers".
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡先生表示，他还想“谈谈我们英雄的定居者”。

paras.en: "You are standing in the breach. You are a role model for the people of Israel, you are a role model for the State of Israel.
paras.zh: “你正站在突破口。你是以色列人民的榜样，你是以色列国的榜样。

paras.en: "We are going to destroy the terror infrastructures, and we are going to build the settlement infrastructures"
paras.zh: “我们将摧毁恐怖基础设施，我们将建造定居点基础设施”

articles.title: Hundreds of flights cancelled, schools closed as Typhoon Champi hits Taiwan

paras.en: Hundreds of flights cancelled, schools closed as Typhoon Champi hits Taiwan
paras.zh: 台风“占比”袭击台湾数百航班取消、学校停课

paras.en: 1 person killed after being swept by waves off southeastern coast
paras.zh: 东南沿海被海浪卷走致1人死亡

paras.en: Taiwan shut down schools and offices and grounded hundreds of flights as Typhoon Champi brushed by the island Friday, packing strong winds and torrential rains.
paras.zh: 周五，台风“占比”席卷台湾，带来强风和暴雨，台湾关闭了学校和办公室，并停飞了数百架航班。

paras.en: Champi peaked at 298 kilometres per hour maximum sustained winds earlier this week but has weakened to 155 kilometres per hour winds as it approached Taiwan from the southwest. Its centre is forecast to remain offshore as it sweeps by the island's northeastern tip before turning north toward Japan's southwestern islands.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，“占比”最大持续风速达到每小时 298 公里，但在从西南方向接近台湾时，风速减弱至每小时 155 公里。预计其中心仍将位于近海，穿过该岛的东北端，然后向北转向日本西南部岛屿。

paras.en: Taiwan's Central Weather Administration urged residents in coastal areas to avoid outdoor activities and driving and be cautious of falling objects.
paras.zh: 台湾中央气象局敦促沿海地区居民避免户外活动和驾驶，并小心坠落物体。

paras.en: One person was killed Thursday after being swept by waves in Liuqiu, a small island off the southeastern coast of Taiwan's main island, according to the fire department. Ninety-four others were injured in the storm.
paras.zh: 据消防部门称，周四，台湾主岛东南沿海的小岛琉球岛有一人被海浪卷走身亡。另有九十四人在风暴中受伤。

paras.en: More than 2,600 people have been evacuated from vulnerable, mountainous areas, the government said.
paras.zh: 政府表示，已有 2,600 多人从脆弱山区撤离。

paras.en: Taiwan officials urged residents in coastal areas to avoid outdoor activities and driving and be cautious of falling objects. (Ann Wang/Reuters)
paras.zh: 台湾官员敦促沿海地区居民避免户外活动和驾驶，并小心坠落物体。 （王安/路透社）

paras.en: All of Taiwan's 262 domestic flights were cancelled along with 669 international flights, according to the Transport Ministry. High-speed rail services on the western coast were operating normally.
paras.zh: 据交通运输部称，台湾262个国内航班全部取消，还有669个国际航班被取消。西部沿海高铁运行正常。

paras.en: Champi has a massive radius of around 320 kilometres, large enough to engulf most of Taiwan, though transportation services including the subway were still open in the capital Taipei, which saw light showers and gusts of winds.
paras.zh: 占比的半径约为 320 公里，足以吞没台湾大部分地区，但首都台北的地铁等交通服务仍然开放，并出现小阵雨和阵风。

paras.en: Experts expect its biggest effect on Taiwan to last through Saturday and that it will reach Japan's southern mainland on Monday.
paras.zh: 专家预计，其对台湾的最大影响将持续到周六，并将于周一到达日本南部大陆。

paras.en: In southwestern Japan, the typhoon has injured one person, grounded flights and knocked out power.
paras.zh: 在日本西南部，台风造成一人受伤、航班停飞、电力中断。

paras.en: On Miyako island, a woman in her 70s suffered a broken leg in the blowing wind, according to the Okinawa prefecture government. On Ishigaki island, nearly 2,000 homes were without electricity.
paras.zh: 据冲绳县政府称，在宫古岛，一名 70 多岁的妇女在狂风中腿部骨折。石垣岛有近2000户家庭断电。

paras.en: Dozens of flights in and out of the southwestern islands, including Miyako, Ishigaki and Okinawa, have been cancelled.
paras.zh: 进出西南岛屿（包括宫古岛、石垣岛和冲绳岛）的数十个航班已被取消。

paras.en: In the Philippines, the coast guard prohibited ships and ferries from venturing into the increasingly choppy waters off several northern towns and cities Friday.
paras.zh: 在菲律宾，海岸警卫队周五禁止船只和渡轮冒险进入北部几个城镇和城市附近日益波涛汹涌的水域。

paras.en: The main domestic airport in Batanes provincial capital of Basco was shut down Friday and two local flights were cancelled, Philippine aviation officials said. The airport's windows were boarded up as a safety precaution.
paras.zh: 菲律宾航空官员表示，巴丹省首府巴斯科的主要国内机场于周五关闭，两趟当地航班被取消。为了安全起见，机场的窗户被用木板封住。

paras.en: In Cagayan province, nearly 200 people moved to safer grounds as a precaution, including nearly 100 who moved to government-run emergency shelters. Classes were suspended in all levels in the island town of Calayan off Cagayan due to the typhoon, provincial officials said.
paras.zh: 在卡加延省，作为预防措施，近 200 人转移到更安全的地方，其中近 100 人转移到政府运营的紧急避难所。省官员表示，受台风影响，卡加延附近的卡拉延岛小镇各级学校停课。

paras.en: Champi earlier this month blew past several Pacific islands, including Guam, where a federal disaster area was declared.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，“占皮”气旋吹过几个太平洋岛屿，其中包括关岛，那里被宣布为联邦灾区。

articles.title: Europe's killer heat this summer claims record 50,000 lives, study suggests

paras.en: Europe's killer heat this summer claims record 50,000 lives, study suggests
paras.zh: 研究表明，今年夏天欧洲的致命高温夺去了创纪录的 5 万人的生命

paras.en: 71 per cent more deaths than in previous deadliest summer, 2022
paras.zh: 2022 年，死亡人数比上一个死亡人数最多的夏季增加了 71%

paras.en: Blistering record heat in Europe this summer helped kill more than 50,000 people, with nearly two-thirds of that death toll blamed on human-caused climate change, a new study found.
paras.zh: 一项新研究发现，今年夏天欧洲创纪录的高温导致 5 万多人死亡，其中近三分之二的死亡人数归因于人为造成的气候变化。

paras.en: Researchers modelled heat-related deaths for different age groups in 854 European cities during repeated heat waves in June, July and August and found that 50,391 people died from warmer temperatures, and of those, 32,619 died because of the extra heat caused by the burning of coal, oil and gas, according to a study in an upcoming issue of Nature Health.
paras.zh: 根据即将出版的《自然·健康》杂志上的一项研究，研究人员对 854 个欧洲城市在 6 月、7 月和 8 月反复发生的热浪期间不同年龄段的高温相关死亡进行了建模，发现 50,391 人死于气温升高，其中 32,619 人死于煤炭、石油和天然气燃烧造成的额外热量。

paras.en: That's 71 per cent higher than the previous deadliest summer, which was 29,480 in 2022, according to the same researchers, who produced a study earlier this month tracking yearly summer heat-related deaths in those European cities. And this summer's death figures are underestimates because they don't count a deadly heat wave in May and they only look at deaths in those 854 cities, which hold about 40 per cent of Europe's population, study authors said.
paras.zh: 根据同一研究人员的说法，这比上一个最致命的夏季（2022 年的死亡人数为 29,480 人）高出 71%，他们本月早些时候进行了一项研究，追踪了这些欧洲城市每年与夏季高温相关的死亡人数。研究作者表示，今年夏天的死亡人数被低估，因为他们没有计算 5 月份致命的热浪，而且只关注这 854 个城市的死亡人数，这些城市约占欧洲人口的 40%。

paras.en: About one-third of the deaths were from June 17 to July 1, a particularly intense heat wave when temperatures were 5.3 C above normal, said study co-author Garyfallos Konstantinoudis, a biostatistician at Imperial College London.
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、伦敦帝国理工学院的生物统计学家加里法洛斯·康斯坦丁努迪斯(Garyfallos Konstantinoudis)表示，大约三分之一的死亡发生在6月17日至7月1日期间，这是一场特别强烈的热浪，当时气温比正常水平高出5.3摄氏度。

paras.en: "Much of Western and Northern Europe, our infrastructure is just not designed to cope with the sort of temperatures that we are seeing now because of the effects of human-caused warming," said lead author Clair Barnes, a climate scientist at Imperial College London. She said some European cities this summer had temperatures 12 C warmer than normal.
paras.zh: 主要作者、伦敦帝国理工学院的气候科学家克莱尔·巴恩斯说：“在西欧和北欧的大部分地区，我们的基础设施的设计无法应对我们现在所看到的由于人为变暖的影响而出现的气温。”她说，今年夏天一些欧洲城市的气温比正常情况高出12摄氏度。

paras.en: Of those 50,000, more than 32,000 died from the added heat of human-caused climate change, the study also found. Italy, France, Spain and Germany had the highest death tolls, the study said. Of all the European capitals, Rome had the highest heat death total from 2000 to 2025, according to the team's study earlier this month.
paras.zh: 研究还发现，在这 50,000 人中，超过 32,000 人死于人为气候变化造成的高温。研究称，意大利、法国、西班牙和德国的死亡人数最高。根据该团队本月早些时候的研究，在所有欧洲国家首都中，罗马从 2000 年到 2025 年的热死总数最高。

paras.en: An extra dose of heat from fossil fuel burning
paras.zh: 化石燃料燃烧产生的额外热量

paras.en: This would've already been an abnormal natural hot spell on top of a huge amount of climate change, Barnes said. She said Europe is the fastest-warming continent — although the Arctic, which is not a continent, is warming even faster — and is 2.5 C hotter than pre-industrial times.
paras.zh: 巴恩斯说，除了巨大的气候变化之外，这已经是一场异常的自然炎热天气。她说，欧洲是变暖最快的大陆——尽管北极不是大陆，但变暖速度更快——而且比工业化前时期热2.5摄氏度。

paras.en: "Just the underlying warming from human activity, from mostly the burning of fossil fuels, it's increasing all of our temperatures by what sounds like quite a small amount," Barnes said. "For many people, it's certainly the case that that extra two-and-a-half degrees [Celsius] of warming is what's going to tip those temperatures from uncomfortable to dangerous and potentially deadly."
paras.zh: 巴恩斯说：“仅仅是人类活动造成的潜在变暖，主要是化石燃料的燃烧，就使我们所有人的气温升高了，幅度听起来很小。” “对于许多人来说，额外的摄氏两度半的升温肯定会让气温从不舒服变成危险的，甚至可能致命。”

paras.en: More than half of the people who died in Europe's heat were age 85 or older, but the stifling temperatures also killed more than 800 people between the ages of 20 and 44, Konstantinoudis said.
paras.zh: 康斯坦丁努迪斯说，在欧洲的高温中死亡的人中有一半以上年龄在 85 岁或以上，但令人窒息的气温也导致了 800 多名 20 岁至 44 岁之间的人死亡。

paras.en: The team used an established and accepted scientific method to figure out how many of the 50,000 heat deaths were from natural high summer heat and how many were due to what heat-trapping gases have done to the climate. They ran computer simulations of a world without climate change and compared it with the deaths that happened this summer. The difference is what was caused by global warming.
paras.zh: 该团队使用一种既定且公认的科学方法来计算，在 50,000 例高温死亡事件中，有多少是由于夏季自然高温造成的，有多少是由于吸热气体对气候造成的影响造成的。他们对没有气候变化的世界进行了计算机模拟，并将其与今年夏天发生的死亡人数进行了比较。差异在于全球变暖造成的差异。

paras.en: The percentage of heat deaths attributable to global warming has grown from about 45 per cent in the early 2000s to 65 per cent now, Barnes said.
paras.zh: 巴恩斯说，全球变暖导致的热死亡比例已从 2000 年代初的 45% 左右上升到现在的 65%。

paras.en: "Summers are getting hotter, and the analytical tools for attributing deaths to heat are getting more accurate," said Dr. Howard Frumkin, former director of the National Center for Environmental Health in the U.S., who wasn't part of the study. "Together, these two trends yield increasingly high and increasingly accurate counts of heat-related deaths."
paras.zh: “夏天越来越热，将死亡归因于高温的分析工具也越来越准确，”美国国家环境卫生中心前主任霍华德·弗鲁姆金博士说，他没有参与这项研究。 “这两种趋势共同导致与高温相关的死亡人数越来越高、越来越准确。”

paras.en: The scientific team also had to use statistical modelling to come up with the base count of 50,000 heat deaths because those deaths are underreported and often not listed in death certificates, despite being a major factor, Konstantinoudis said. Several outside experts agreed with him, calling the methods state-of-the-art.
paras.zh: 康斯坦丁努迪斯说，科学团队还必须使用统计模型来得出 50,000 例中暑死亡的基本计数，因为这些死亡人数被低估，并且通常没有列在死亡证明中，尽管这是一个主要因素。几位外部专家同意他的观点，称这些方法是最先进的。

paras.en: The researchers ran a complex mathematical equation that has been used in several previously peer-reviewed studies, Barnes said, which factors in specific age and temperatures for each of the 854 cities based on a localized optimal temperature that coincides with the fewest deaths. When it's warmer or colder, the equation calculates excess deaths above lowest-death conditions.
paras.zh: 巴恩斯说，研究人员运行了一个复杂的数学方程，该方程已在之前的几项同行评审的研究中使用过，该方程根据与死亡人数最少的局部最佳温度，将 854 个城市中每个城市的具体年龄和温度考虑在内。当天气变暖或变冷时，该方程计算出高于最低死亡条件的超额死亡人数。

paras.en: Researchers then checked their calculations against real-time estimates from government agencies. Mostly — but not always — they matched fairly well, Konstantinoudis said. The team's methods for May and June British heat waves calculated 2,700 excess deaths and the United Kingdom health statistics agency said it was 2,800, he said.
paras.zh: 然后研究人员根据政府机构的实时估计检查了他们的计算结果。康斯坦丁努迪斯说，大多数情况下——但并非总是——他们匹配得相当好。他说，该团队根据 5 月和 6 月英国热浪的方法计算出 2,700 人超额死亡，英国卫生统计局称实际死亡人数为 2,800 人。

paras.en: Cooling and adapting are needed, but they're not enough
paras.zh: 需要冷却和适应，但这还不够

paras.en: "We need to prepare for the heat we cannot now avoid, with urgent investments in heat early-warning systems, equitable access to low-carbon cooling, and neighborhood buddy systems that check on and support people most at risk — while rapidly reducing the fossil fuel use driving the crisis," said Canadian emergency room physician Dr. Courtney Howard, president-elect of the Canadian Medical Association, who wasn't part of the research.
paras.zh: “我们需要为现在无法避免的高温做好准备，紧急投资于高温预警系统，公平地获得低碳冷却，以及检查和支持高危人群的邻里伙伴系统，同时迅速减少导致危机的化石燃料使用，”加拿大医学会候任主席、加拿大急诊室医生考特尼·霍华德博士（未参与这项研究）说道。

paras.en: Adapting is only part of the answer, said Dr. Jonathan Patz of the University of Wisconsin-Madison, who wasn't part of the research but also praised it.
paras.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的乔纳森·帕茨博士说，适应只是答案的一部分。他没有参与这项研究，但也对这项研究表示赞赏。

paras.en: "We can't just be mopping up the mess on the floor without thinking about turning the faucet off," said Patz, a professor of health and the environment. "So we need prevention at different levels. We need better cooling and protecting vulnerable populations from inevitable increased frequency and extreme heat waves. But we also need to go to the root of the problem and absolutely address the burning of fossil fuels."
paras.zh: 健康与环境学教授帕茨说：“我们不能只是把地板上的乱七八糟的东西擦干净，而不考虑关掉水龙头。” “因此，我们需要在不同层面进行预防。我们需要更好的冷却并保护弱势群体免受不可避免的频率增加和极端热浪的影响。但我们也需要找到问题的根源，并绝对解决化石燃料的燃烧问题。”

articles.title: Melania Trump, Pope Leo broker humanitarian ceasefire for ravaged Ukraine city Oleshky

paras.en: Melania Trump, Pope Leo broker humanitarian ceasefire for ravaged Ukraine city Oleshky
paras.zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普和教皇利奥斡旋为饱受蹂躏的乌克兰城市奥列什基达成人道主义停火

paras.en: Ceasefire for Oleshky in southern Ukraine to begin late next week
paras.zh: 乌克兰南部奥列什基停火将于下周晚些时候开始

paras.en: Melania Trump has secured a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the Russian-controlled city of Oleshky, which will begin on Oct. 29, the White House said on Friday.
paras.zh: 白宫周五表示，梅拉尼娅·特朗普已确保俄罗斯和乌克兰在俄罗斯控制的奥列什基市实现停火，停火将于 10 月 29 日开始。

paras.en: Residents of the southern Ukrainian town, occupied by Russian forces since February 2022, have reported a deepening food crisis.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年 2 月以来，这座乌克兰南部小镇一直被俄罗斯军队占领，当地居民报告称，粮食危机日益严重。

paras.en: "Both nations agreed to temporarily stop all military action in Oleshky to allow for humanitarian aid to enter and to prepare a civilian evacuation through a designated safe passageway," a White House statement said.
paras.zh: 白宫声明称：“两国同意暂时停止在奥列什基的所有军事行动，以允许人道主义援助进入，并准备通过指定的安全通道疏散平民。”

paras.en: The statement said Melania Trump and her representative worked directly with Russian and Ukrainian leadership to define the terms of the localized ceasefire.
paras.zh: 声明称，梅拉尼娅·特朗普和她的代表直接与俄罗斯和乌克兰领导人合作，确定局部停火的条款。

paras.en: "The situation in Oleshky is dire. Oleshky is a front-line war city on the brink of disaster. Oleshky's remaining population is comprised primarily of elderly residents who urgently need medical attention, medicine, food and clean water," Melania Trump said in the statement.
paras.zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普在声明中表示：“奥列什基的情况十分严峻。奥列什基是一座处于灾难边缘的前线战争城市。奥列什基的剩余人口主要由老年居民组成，他们迫切需要医疗护理、药品、食物和清洁水。”

paras.en: The ceasefire will allow non-military teams from both countries to visit residents in their homes and co-ordinate transportation for those wishing to evacuate to either Russia or Ukraine.
paras.zh: 停火协议将允许两国的非军事小组探访居民家中，并为那些希望撤离到俄罗斯或乌克兰的人协调交通。

paras.en: A still image taken from an undated drone video released Sept. 12 shows a destroyed buildings in Oleshky, Kherson region. (34th Separate Marine Brigade/Reuters)
paras.zh: 9 月 12 日发布的一段未注明日期的无人机视频中拍摄的静止图像显示了赫尔松地区奥莱什基 (Oleshky) 被毁的建筑物。 （第34独立海军陆战旅/路透社）

paras.en: Ukraine's top negotiator, David Arakhamia, said on Telegram that the humanitarian operation would start once a ceasefire was in place.
paras.zh: 乌克兰最高谈判代表戴维·阿拉卡米亚(David Arakhamia)在电报上表示，一旦停火到位，人道主义行动就会开始。

paras.en: Arakhamia said the accord, the result of a long process involving Melania Trump and also Pope Leo, would set up a humanitarian corridor for residents to leave and allow assistance into the town.
paras.zh: 阿拉卡米亚表示，该协议是梅拉尼娅·特朗普和教皇利奥漫长进程的结果，将为居民建立一条人道主义走廊，供居民离开并允许援助进入该镇。

paras.en: The Kremlin said an evacuation in Oleshky would take at least a few days. It praised Melania Trump and said work was underway to ease the humanitarian situation in Oleshky after Russian President Vladimir Putin told Pope Leo he was ready to co-operate on the issue. Leo and Putin reportedly spoke by telephone last week.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫表示，奥列什基的疏散至少需要几天时间。它赞扬了梅拉尼娅·特朗普，并表示在俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京告诉教皇利奥他准备在这个问题上进行合作之后，缓解奥列什基人道主义局势的工作正在进行中。据报道，利奥和普京上周通了电话。

paras.en: Russian forces will halt fire from 4 a.m. local time on Oct. 27 to facilitate the humanitarian operation, Russian Chief of the General Staff Valery Gerasimov said on Friday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总参谋长瓦列里·格拉西莫夫周五表示，俄罗斯军队将于当地时间 10 月 27 日凌晨 4 点起停火，以便利人道主义行动。

paras.en: Since U.S. President Donald Trump returned to the White House early last year, Melania Trump has been been active in trying to get Ukrainian children seized by Russia during the war returned to their families.
paras.zh: 自美国总统唐纳德·特朗普去年初重返白宫以来，梅拉尼娅·特朗普一直积极努力让在战争期间被俄罗斯劫持的乌克兰儿童送回家人身边。

paras.en: Oleshky, located across the Dnipro River from Kherson, has a remaining population of 1,700 to 2,000 people — primarily elderly residents, along with about 50 children — down from roughly 24,000 before the war, the White House said. About 90 per cent of the city was flooded following the destruction of the Kakhovka Dam, according to the White House.
paras.zh: 白宫称，奥列什基位于赫尔松与第聂伯罗河对岸，仅剩 1,700 至 2,000 人，其中主要是老年人，还有约 50 名儿童，较战前的约 24,000 人有所减少。据白宫称，卡霍夫卡大坝被毁后，该市约 90% 的地区被洪水淹没。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Friday that peace negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States had agreed to meet at a technical level in the first half of November in Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰总统泽连斯基周五表示，乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国的和平谈判代表已同意于 11 月上半月在阿布扎比举行技术层面会议。

paras.en: Zelenskyy, in comments to the Hudson Institute think-tank, said he spoke with U.S. envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff on Friday after their meeting with Putin earlier this week. Zelenskyy said any peace agreement would need strong security guarantees for Ukraine and funding for 10 years to maintain the Ukrainian army.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在哈德逊研究所智囊团发表评论时表示，他在本周早些时候与普京会面后，于周五与美国特使贾里德·库什纳和史蒂夫·威特科夫进行了交谈。泽连斯基表示，任何和平协议都需要为乌克兰提供强有力的安全保障，并提供十年的资金来维持乌克兰军队。

paras.en: Previous rounds of talks with mediation from Turkey did not change the landscape of the war, though exchanges of war prisoners followed.
paras.zh: 尽管随后进行了战俘交换，但在土耳其调解下进行的前几轮谈判并未改变战争格局。

paras.en: The developments Friday come after a two-week period in which the White House's interventions into the nearly five-year war have received bracing criticism from Ukraine's European allies, Democrats and even some Republicans.
paras.zh: 周五的事态发展是在两周的时间里，白宫对这场近五年战争的干预受到了乌克兰的欧洲盟友、民主党甚至一些共和党的强烈批评。

paras.en: First, President Trump struck a deal with Putin to import diesel. The Trump administration has pressured Kyiv to halt its attacks on Russian energy infrastructure — which it blames for driving up the price of diesel.
paras.zh: 首先，特朗普总统与普京达成进口柴油协议。特朗普政府已向基辅施压，要求其停止对俄罗斯能源基础设施的攻击——特朗普政府指责这推高了柴油价格。

paras.en: Trump announced soon after, unilaterally, that the two sides had agreed to a ceasefire on energy attacks. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine was open to that possibility, but Russia had shown no inclination to halt its fire.
paras.zh: 特朗普不久后单方面宣布，双方同意就能源袭击停火。乌克兰总统泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰对这种可能性持开放态度，但俄罗斯没有表现出停止开火的意愿。

paras.en: Zelenskyy on Oct. 14 then said Elon Musk's SpaceX had restricted its Starlink services. Throttling the speed of the satellite service, according to Ukraine officials, hampers its ability to conduct strikes on Russian targets and to defend itself from Russian drones using its own interceptor drones.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基随后于 10 月 14 日表示，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 已限制其星链服务。乌克兰官员表示，限制卫星服务的速度会妨碍其对俄罗斯目标进行打击以及使用自己的拦截无人机防御俄罗斯无人机的能力。

paras.en: - Starlink restrictions would hamper Ukraine's war effort. But the country can adapt, experts say
paras.zh: - 星链限制将阻碍乌克兰的战争努力。但专家表示，国家可以适应

paras.en: Trump and Musk, along with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, have since offered shifting explanations on precisely what occurred and who ordered the Starlink services throttled.
paras.zh: 此后，特朗普和马斯克以及美国国务卿马可·卢比奥对到底发生了什么以及是谁下令限制星链服务提供了不断变化的解释。

paras.en: "Whether I called or whether somebody else called, doesn't make any difference, I guess," Trump told reporters on Thursday. "The bottom line — [Musk] put it back."
paras.zh: “我想，无论我打电话还是其他人打电话，都没有任何区别，”特朗普周四对记者说。 “底线是——[马斯克]把它放回去了。”

paras.en: The relationship between Trump and Zelenskyy has often been tense since 2019, when the U.S. president was impeached, though ultimately acquitted in the Senate, of pressuring the Ukraine president for political favours in exchange for military aid to Kyiv. Last year, Trump and Vice-President JD Vance berated Zelenskyy in the White House for what they perceived as a lack of gratitude for U.S. support of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 自2019年以来，特朗普和泽伦斯基之间的关系经常紧张，当时美国总统因向乌克兰总统施压以换取对基辅的军事援助而被弹劾，尽管最终在参议院被宣告无罪。去年，特朗普和副总统万斯在白宫斥责泽连斯基，认为他对美国对乌克兰的支持缺乏感激之情。

paras.en: In fighting on Friday, Moscow's largest airport, Sheremetyevo, resumed operations after it was forced to briefly suspend its work and ask passengers to move to safe locations due to a Ukrainian drone threat.
paras.zh: 在周五的战斗中，莫斯科最大的机场谢列梅捷沃机场因乌克兰无人机威胁而被迫短暂暂停工作并要求乘客转移到安全地点后恢复运营。

paras.en: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said in a statement on Telegram that air defence forces had shot down 21 Ukrainian drones that were headed to the Russian capital over a 2-hour period.
paras.zh: 莫斯科市长谢尔盖·索比亚宁在 Telegram 上发表声明称，防空部队在 2 小时内击落了 21 架飞往俄罗斯首都的乌克兰无人机。

paras.en: Rosaviatsiya, Russia's aviation watchdog, said earlier on Friday that three of Moscow's airports had temporarily suspended flight operations, something they do when there is Ukrainian drone activity.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯航空监管机构 Rosaviatiya 周五早些时候表示，莫斯科的三个机场已暂时停止航班运营，这是在乌克兰无人机活动时采取的做法。

paras.en: The warring sides engaged in another exchange of war prisoners, Ukraine officials confirmed on Friday, involving 270 people on each side being repatriated. Earlier in the week, the two sides exchanged the bodies of several people killed in the war, in Belarus.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员周五证实，交战双方再次进行了战俘交换，双方各有 270 人被遣返。本周早些时候，双方在白俄罗斯交换了几名在战争中丧生的人的尸体。

paras.en: More than 19,000 Ukrainian civilians, including 762 children, have been killed since Russia launched its full-scale war, Ukraine's acting prosecutor general said on Friday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰代理总检察长周五表示，自俄罗斯发动全面战争以来，已有超过 19,000 名乌克兰平民被杀，其中包括 762 名儿童。

paras.en: In 2026 alone, Ukrainian prosecutors confirmed the deaths of 2,960 civilians, including 668 children, Anton Kovalskyi said on Telegram.
paras.zh: 安东·科瓦尔斯基 (Anton Kovalskyi) 在 Telegram 上表示，仅 2026 年，乌克兰检察官就确认了 2,960 名平民死亡，其中包括 668 名儿童。

articles.title: Japan-Russia ties erode as journalist sits in Moscow jail

paras.en: Japanese Foreign Ministry officials were in Moscow this week in an attempt to contact a journalist arrested in Russia's far east on spying claims.
paras.zh: 日本外务省官员本周在莫斯科试图联系一名因间谍指控而在俄罗斯远东地区被捕的记者。

paras.en: Journalist Yuki Imai was arrested on October 14 by Russia's FSB security service in the city of Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk on Sakhalin Island. Televised footage of the arrest showed FSB officers barging into his hotel room as he slept.
paras.zh: 记者今井由纪于10月14日在萨哈林岛南萨哈林斯克市被俄罗斯联邦安全局安全部门逮捕。逮捕的电视画面显示，联邦安全局官员趁他熟睡时闯入他的酒店房间。

paras.en: The correspondent for the Hokkaido Shimbun newspaper was accused of attempting to obtain information on soldiers in the region, which is near the Kiril islands, a geopolitical sore spot in Russia-Japan relations.
paras.zh: 《北海道新闻》的记者被指控试图获取该地区士兵的信息，该地区靠近基里尔群岛，这是俄罗斯与日本关系中的一个地缘政治痛点。

paras.en: Russian authorities quickly transferred him to Lefortovo Prison in Moscow, where a court ordered him to be held in pre-trial detention until at least December 12. If convicted, 34-year-old Imai faces up to 20 years in jail, according to the International Federation of Journalists, which has called for his immediate release.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯当局很快将他转移到莫斯科的莱福尔托沃监狱，法院下令将他审前拘留至少到 12 月 12 日。国际记者联合会称，如果罪名成立，34 岁的今井将面临最高 20 年的监禁，并呼吁立即释放他。

paras.en: Officials of the Japanese embassy in Moscow have been refused access to Imai. In Tokyo, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has condemned the arrest and dismissed the claim that Imai was a spy.
paras.zh: 日本驻莫斯科大使馆的官员被拒绝接触今井。在东京，首相高市早苗谴责了此次逮捕，并驳斥了今井是间谍的说法。

paras.en: Russian Ambassador Nikolay Nozdrev said Imai had been caught "red-handed," Russia's TASS news agency reported. He has claimed that Japanese intelligence agencies use Japanese journalists to collect classified information with the goal of "undermining Russia's security and defense capability."
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯塔斯社报道，俄罗斯大使尼古拉·诺兹德列夫表示，今井已被“当场”抓获。他声称日本情报机构利用日本记者收集机密信息，目的是“破坏俄罗斯的安全和防御能力”。

paras.en: Russia accuses journalists of being 'spies'
paras.zh: 俄罗斯指责记者是“间谍”

paras.en: Yoji Gomi, a veteran journalist and author who has reported from across Asia, told DW Japanese journalists may occasionally meet with diplomats in the course of their work and "share thoughts and impressions." However, he rejects the idea that reporters are paid spies.
paras.zh: 曾在亚洲各地进行报道的资深记者兼作家五味洋二告诉德国之声，日本记者在工作过程中偶尔会与外交官会面，“分享想法和印象”。不过，他否认记者是受雇间谍的说法。

paras.en: "One-party nations often see foreign correspondents as spies because that is exactly what they use their journalists for," he said.
paras.zh: “一党国家经常将外国记者视为间谍，因为这正是他们利用记者的目的，”他说。

paras.en: "I can completely see how the Russians decided that Imai was a spy, as it is how they operate, plus he was in a sensitive part of Russia where there are lots of North Korean laborers that they want to keep quiet," Gomi added.
paras.zh: 五味补充道：“我完全可以理解俄罗斯人如何认定今井是间谍，因为这就是他们的运作方式，而且他身处俄罗斯的敏感地区，那里有很多朝鲜劳工，他们希望对他们保持沉默。”

paras.en: Stephen Nagy, a professor of international relations at Tokyo's International Christian University, said that Russia may see Imai as a bargaining chip it can use to exchange for its nationals detained overseas.
paras.zh: 东京国际基督教大学国际关系教授史蒂芬·纳吉表示，俄罗斯可能将今井视为交换在海外被拘留的本国国民的筹码。

paras.en: However, Nagy doubts Japan will give in to pressure.
paras.zh: 然而，纳吉怀疑日本会屈服于压力。

paras.en: "They are going to resist because it means that Russia, or any other country, can then just seize a Japanese national, put them on trial for espionage and demand the release of one of their people," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“他们会抵制，因为这意味着俄罗斯或任何其他国家可以逮捕一名日本公民，以间谍罪对他们进行审判，并要求释放其中一名日本人。”

paras.en: "It would set a dangerous precedent," he added.
paras.zh: “这将开创一个危险的先例，”他补充道。

paras.en: The arrest comes after a member of a Russia-linked hacking group "Qilin" was arrested in Japan and extradited to Germany to face charges in connection with a 2024 cyberattack on a logistics center.
paras.zh: 此次逮捕之前，与俄罗斯有联系的黑客组织“Qilin”的一名成员在日本被捕，并被引渡到德国，面临与 2024 年物流中心网络攻击有关的指控。

paras.en: The last time a journalist was arrested in Russia was in 2019 for "attempting to obtain classified information about Russia's military potential in the Far East," Russia's Interfax news agency reported. However, in this case, the journalist was quickly released.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯国际文传电讯社报道，上一次有记者在俄罗斯被捕是在 2019 年，原因是“试图获取有关俄罗斯在远东军事潜力的机密信息”。不过，在这种情况下，记者很快就被释放了。

paras.en: Imai's case is perhaps the most serious since 2023, when Wall Street Journal reporter Evan Gershkovich was arrested in Russia and sentenced to 16 years in a penal colony before being released in a prisoner exchange with Western countries in 2024.
paras.zh: 今井的案件可能是自 2023 年以来最严重的案件，当时《华尔街日报》记者埃文·格什科维奇 (Evan Gershkovich) 在俄罗斯被捕，并被判处 16 年流放地监禁，然后于 2024 年在与西方国家的囚犯交换中获释。

paras.en: Imai's arrest is the latest in a series of incidents that have sent bilateral relations into a tailspin.
paras.zh: 今井的被捕是一系列导致双边关系陷入混乱的事件中的最新一起。

paras.en: Nagy said Imai's seizure is designed to put pressure on Tokyo. He added this is part of a coordinated approach with China to isolate Japan at a time when the US is preoccupied with domestic issues and the conflict in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 纳吉表示，今井的扣押旨在向东京施加压力。他补充说，这是在美国全神贯注于国内问题和中东冲突之际与中国协调孤立日本的举措的一部分。

paras.en: "Moscow and Beijing are coordinating to create the image that Japan is not a reformed member of the international community but still the military state of the 1930s and that it poses a threat to stability in the Indo-Pacific region," Nagy said.
paras.zh: 纳吉说：“莫斯科和北京正在协调，营造这样一种形象：日本不是国际社会改革后的成员，而是 1930 年代的军事国家，并对印太地区的稳定构成威胁。”
