paras.en: "This is all designed to smear Japan's efforts to lead diplomacy in the region at a time when the US is perhaps distracted," he told DW. "And it does not even matter much that it is not true; they will just continue to repeat the claim to discredit and weaken Tokyo."
paras.zh: 他对德国之声表示：“这一切都是为了抹黑日本在该地区主导外交的努力，而此时美国可能已经心不在焉。” “即使这不是真的也没有多大关系；他们只会继续重复这样的说法，抹黑和削弱东京。”

paras.en: Tadashi Anno, a professor of politics at Tokyo's Sophia University, believes Japan had been working hard to maintain a stable relationship with Moscow, even after Tokyo joined international condemnation of the invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 东京上智大学政治学教授安野正认为，即使在东京加入国际社会谴责入侵乌克兰之后，日本也一直在努力维持与莫斯科的稳定关系。

paras.en: Anno said Moscow's timing on turning up the heat on Tokyo is puzzling.
paras.zh: 庵野说，莫斯科对东京升温的时机令人费解。

paras.en: "Japan condemned the invasion of Ukraine in 2022 because it was a fundamental violation of international law, but Russia is only now pushing back hard," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“日本谴责2022年对乌克兰的入侵，因为这从根本上违反了国际法，但俄罗斯现在才大力反击。”

paras.en: At the center of deteriorating ties is a territorial dispute about a chain of islands off the far north of Japan that were seized by Soviet forces after Japan's surrender in World War II.
paras.zh: 两国关系恶化的核心是日本最北端一系列岛屿的领土争端，这些岛屿在二战日本投降后被苏联军队占领。

paras.en: Known as the Northern Territories in Japan and the Southern Kurils by Russia, there have been hopes in the past in Tokyo that a concerted diplomatic effort could be sufficient to convince Russia to return them to Japanese sovereignty.
paras.zh: 日本称其为北方四岛，俄罗斯称其为南千岛群岛，东京过去一直希望通过协调一致的外交努力足以说服俄罗斯将其主权归还给日本。

paras.en: That campaign has faltered in the last couple of years, however, and was further dented when Japan announced in the spring that it would be joining the NATO initiative to provide non-lethal assistance to Kyiv.
paras.zh: 然而，这一行动在过去几年中步履蹒跚，当日本在春季宣布将加入北约倡议向基辅提供非致命援助时，这一行动进一步受到削弱。

paras.en: In August, President Vladimir Putin visited the disputed islands, only the second Russian leader to do so. Earlier this month, a delegation of Chinese businesspeople was welcomed on one of the islands and talks are under way on the possibility of economic cooperation.
paras.zh: 八月，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京访问了有争议的岛屿，这是第二位这样做的俄罗斯领导人。本月早些时候，一个中国商人代表团在其中一个岛屿受到欢迎，目前正在就经济合作的可能性进行谈判。

articles.title: Ukraine tries to shut Moscow's airports with drone strikes on Russia

paras.en: For months, drone strikes by Ukraine have forced the suspension of flights to and from airports in Russia. Moscow's Domodedovo, Sheremetyevo, Zhukovsky and Vnukovo airports have had to shut down operations almost daily in October, according to reports from the independent investigative media outlet Agentstvo. On some days, the airports were reportedly closed for up to nine hours.
paras.zh: 几个月来，乌克兰的无人机袭击迫使往返俄罗斯机场的航班暂停。据独立调查媒体 Agentstvo 报道，莫斯科的多莫杰多沃机场、谢列梅捷沃机场、茹科夫斯基机场和伏努科沃机场在 10 月份几乎每天都被迫关闭。据报道，有时机场关闭长达九个小时。

paras.en: In early September, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that Ukraine would seek to cut off the airspace around Moscow and other destinations in Russia. "Today, we would like to warn every airline that uses Russian airspace, every insurer, and everyone who continues to use major Russian airports: Russian airspace will become completely unsafe," Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 9月初，总统泽连斯基宣布乌克兰将寻求切断莫斯科周围和俄罗斯其他目的地的领空。泽伦斯基说：“今天，我们要警告每家使用俄罗斯领空的航空公司、每家保险公司以及所有继续使用俄罗斯主要机场的人：俄罗斯领空将变得完全不安全。”

paras.en: The following day, Ukraine sent a corresponding warning to the International Civil Aviation Organization.
paras.zh: 次日，乌克兰向国际民航组织发出相应警告。

paras.en: Ukraine's airspace has been closed since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion in February 2022.
paras.zh: 自2022年2月俄罗斯开始全面入侵乌克兰以来，乌克兰领空一直被关闭。

paras.en: Russia's aviation authority, Rosaviatsiya, has issued an emergency safety "carpet" protocol that is designed to immediately shut down the airspace over a specific region or around affected airports if an aircraft violates Russian airspace, weapons are used, or unidentified objects appear in the skies. Once the protocol is announced, drastic restrictions apply to all air traffic.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯航空管理局Rosaviatsiya发布了一项紧急安全“地毯”协议，旨在如果飞机侵犯俄罗斯领空、使用武器或天空中出现不明物体，立即关闭特定地区或受影响机场周围的空域。该协议一旦公布，所有空中交通都将受到严格限制。

paras.en: "If there is a military threat, a specific section of airspace is closed off, and this carpet is declared," Oleksandr Laneckij, the chief executive officer of the Friendly Avia Support consultancy, told DW. "Essentially, every drone poses a military threat."
paras.zh: 友好航空支持咨询公司首席执行官奥列克桑德·兰内基 (Oleksandr Laneckij) 告诉德国之声：“如果存在军事威胁，特定区域的空域将被关闭，并宣布铺设地毯。” “从本质上讲，每架无人机都会构成军事威胁。”

paras.en: Laneckij noted that Yemen's Houthis have managed to significantly disrupt Saudi airspace. "I think Ukraine's military capabilities far exceed those of the Houthis," Laneckij said.
paras.zh: 拉内基指出，也门胡塞武装已成功严重扰乱沙特领空。拉内基说：“我认为乌克兰的军事能力远远超过胡塞武装。”

paras.en: The military analyst Jan Matvejev also said Ukraine would have little trouble severely disrupting Moscow-area air traffic. Though Ukraine has not yet managed to completely shut down Russian airspace as Zelenskyy plans, Matvejev said, its armed forces "remain committed to this idea."
paras.zh: 军事分析家扬·马特维耶夫还表示，乌克兰轻而易举地严重扰乱莫斯科地区的空中交通。马特维耶夫表示，尽管乌克兰尚未按照泽连斯基的计划完全关闭俄罗斯领空，但其武装部队“仍然致力于这一想法”。

paras.en: "To close off the airspace and trigger the 'carpet' plan, all you need are simple drones that don't have to be equipped with a warhead or even have a long range," Matvejev said. Ukraine's arms industry can produce hundreds of combat-ready long-range drones in a day, he added. That is why he believes Ukraine could have the necessary resources to shut down Moscow's airports.
paras.zh: 马特维耶夫说：“要封锁空域并触发‘地毯’计划，你所需要的只是简单的无人机，不需要配备弹头，甚至不需要具备很长的射程。”他补充说，乌克兰的军火工业一天可以生产数百架战备远程无人机。这就是为什么他认为乌克兰可能拥有关闭莫斯科机场所需的资源。

paras.en: Indeed, Ukraine's efforts to shut down Russian airspace are "just getting started," Simon Shuster wrote in October in the US magazine The Atlantic, citing well-informed sources.
paras.zh: 事实上，乌克兰关闭俄罗斯领空的努力“才刚刚开始”，西蒙·舒斯特（Simon Shuster）十月份在美国杂志《大西洋月刊》上援引消息灵通人士的话说。

paras.en: Matvejev said Russia's air-defense systems were not entirely effective in efforts to prevent Ukrainian drones from penetrating Moscow's airspace. "If it were possible to shoot them down, they would have done so by now," he said. He added that Russia would have deployed additional air-defense troops if they were available.
paras.zh: 马特维耶夫表示，俄罗斯的防空系统在阻止乌克兰无人机侵入莫斯科领空方面并不完全有效。 “如果有可能击落它们，他们现在就已经这么做了，”他说。他补充说，如果有的话，俄罗斯将部署更多的防空部队。

paras.en: Laneckij said Russia might lower the threshold for declaring the carpet protocol, which could increase the risk of deadly incidents such as the 2024 Christmas day crash of an Azerbaijan Airlines flight. Investigators say the flight was struck by a Russian air-defense missile that was being used to defend against drones, killing 38 people.
paras.zh: 拉内基表示，俄罗斯可能会降低宣布地毯协议的门槛，这可能会增加致命事件的风险，例如2024年圣诞节阿塞拜疆航空公司航班坠毁的事件。调查人员称，这架飞机被一枚用于防御无人机的俄罗斯防空导弹击中，造成 38 人死亡。

paras.en: Matvejev seconded the fear that Russia's defenses could again mistakenly target civilian aircraft instead of military objects. He said little had changed about Russia's air-defense protocol since the Azeri flight was shot in 2024.
paras.zh: 马特维耶夫也担心俄罗斯的防御可能再次错误地瞄准民用飞机而不是军事目标。他表示，自 2024 年阿塞拜疆航班遭枪击以来，俄罗斯的防空协议几乎没有发生任何变化。

paras.en: In an operation against a low-flying drone, the target is visually identified and fired upon with a machine gun. In such a scenario, the danger to aircraft is extremely low, unless they happen to be flying in the immediate vicinity.
paras.zh: 在针对低空飞行的无人机的行动中，目标通过视觉识别并用机枪射击。在这种情况下，飞机的危险极低，除非它们恰好在附近飞行。

paras.en: The risk to civil aviation increases significantly when anti-aircraft missiles are deployed, Matvejev said. A missile could have defects that are practically unavoidable in mass production and could veer toward an aircraft flying nearby. Matvejev said such defense measures could not guarantee the safety of civilian aircraft during operations.
paras.zh: 马特维耶夫说，部署防空导弹后，民航面临的风险会大大增加。导弹可能存在批量生产中几乎不可避免的缺陷，并且可能会转向附近飞行的飞机。马特维耶夫表示，此类防御措施并不能保证民用飞机在作战过程中的安全。

paras.en: He said drones did not have to carry explosives to be disruptive. A collision between an airplane and a basic drone can have serious consequences — and, he said, a drone sent from Ukraine all the way to Moscow must be relatively large, "weighting dozens of kilograms."
paras.zh: 他说，无人机不一定要携带炸药才能造成破坏。飞机和普通无人机之间的碰撞可能会造成严重后果，而且他说，从乌克兰一路飞往莫斯科的无人机必须相对较大，“重达数十公斤”。

paras.en: In the summer of 2023, Ukrainian armed forces attacked the airport in the Russian city of Pskov, where both military and civilian aircraft were parked. Earlier this month, drone debris fell on the Sochi airport, on Russia's Black Sea coast.
paras.zh: 2023年夏天，乌克兰武装部队袭击了俄罗斯城市普斯科夫的机场，那里停放着军用和民用飞机。本月早些时候，无人机碎片落在俄罗斯黑海沿岸的索契机场。

paras.en: Russia also attacks Ukraine's airports. In September, Zelenskyy said Kyiv's airport had been struck, as well as the Boryspil airport near the capital.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯还袭击了乌克兰的机场。 9月，泽伦斯基表示基辅机场以及首都附近的鲍里斯波尔机场遭到袭击。

paras.en: Laneckij said three factors would determine whether international airlines suspend their flights to Russia: the military threat, the degree of demand and the insurance cost.
paras.zh: 拉内基表示，三个因素将决定国际航空公司是否暂停飞往俄罗斯的航班：军事威胁、需求程度和保险费用。

paras.en: He said issues could emerge around insurance. When insurers rate the security risk of flying to Russia as very high, they could significantly raise their rates for aircraft headed there. This would cause ticket prices to skyrocket.
paras.zh: 他表示，保险方面可能会出现问题。当保险公司将飞往俄罗斯的安全风险评估为非常高时，他们可能会大幅提高飞往俄罗斯的飞机的保险费率。这将导致门票价格飞涨。

paras.en: Competition within Russia's aviation market has already declined because many airlines are no longer in business, Laneckij said. This has increased demand for tickets from the remaining foreign airlines.
paras.zh: 拉内基表示，由于许多航空公司不再营业，俄罗斯航空市场的竞争已经减弱。这增加了剩余外国航空公司的机票需求。

paras.en: "Whether they stay or not depends on the price they have to pay for the danger faced," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“他们是否留下来取决于他们必须为面临的危险付出的代价。”

paras.en: This article was translated from German.
paras.zh: 这篇文章是从德文翻译过来的。

articles.title: Afghan women could lose one of their last paths to a higher education

paras.en: "Laila" awoke in the middle of the night for a glass of water, checked her phone almost by accident, and saw an email that made her stomach drop. The US would stop funding the American University of Afghanistan (AUAF), one of the last places women can still study in the country.
paras.zh: “莱拉”半夜醒来喝了一杯水，几乎不小心查看了手机，看到了一封让她胃口大开的电子邮件。美国将停止资助阿富汗美国大学（AUAF），该大学是女性仍可在该国学习的最后几所大学之一。

paras.en: Laila said she sat on her bed, staring, her thoughts racing through the past five years and everything she had endured just to get an education.
paras.zh: 莱拉说，她坐在床上，凝视着，思绪飞快地回想起过去五年以及她为了接受教育而经历的一切。

paras.en: It had not been easy to find a way to study in Afghanistan after the Taliban outlawed women's education.
paras.zh: 塔利班宣布妇女教育非法后，在阿富汗找到学习的途径并不容易。

paras.en: The American University campus was already taken over by the Taliban, but she could study secretly through the university's online program. But now that the university is losing its financing, she told DW she and her classmates fear it will shut down entirely. Her name has been changed for safety reasons.
paras.zh: 美国大学校园已被塔利班占领，但她可以通过大学的在线课程秘密学习。但现在该大学正在失去融资，她告诉德国之声，她和她的同学担心该大学会完全关闭。出于安全原因，她的名字已被更改。

paras.en: A hidden education for women in Afghanistan
paras.zh: 阿富汗妇女的隐性教育

paras.en: Laila is in her mid-twenties. She studies political science and international studies and is one of around 1,000 enrolled students at the university, three-quarters of them women.
paras.zh: 莱拉二十多岁。她主修政治学和国际研究，是该大学大约 1,000 名在校学生之一，其中四分之三是女性。

paras.en: When the Taliban returned to power in August 2021, Laila was studying at another university in Kabul, with just two final exams remaining to finish her semester. Then, in December 2022, the Taliban announced the ban. Laila's degree was left unfinished.
paras.zh: 当塔利班于 2021 年 8 月重新掌权时，莱拉正在喀布尔的另一所大学学习，只剩下两次期末考试才能完成她的学期。随后，2022年12月，塔利班宣布了禁令。莱拉的学位尚未完成。

paras.en: Laila secured a scholarship to AUAF and started over. "Not every girl got that opportunity," she said.
paras.zh: 莱拉获得了 AUAF 的奖学金并重新开始。 “并不是每个女孩都有这样的机会，”她说。

paras.en: Laila has told few people outside of her family about her online studies. On most days, she stays home for remote lectures, alongside classmates who use aliases and keep their cameras off for security. "I just know their voices," she said.
paras.zh: 莱拉很少向家人以外的人透露她的在线学习情况。大多数时候，她都呆在家里进行远程讲座，旁边的同学也使用化名，为了安全起见，他们关闭了摄像头。 “我只知道他们的声音，”她说。

paras.en: Laila speaks English with an American accent. She learned it as a child, watching cartoons. In her early twenties, she was learning even more about the world outside Afghanistan and studying foreign governments.
paras.zh: 莱拉说英语带有美国口音。她小时候看动画片就学会了这一点。在她二十岁出头的时候，她对阿富汗以外的世界有了更多的了解，并研究了外国政府。

paras.en: Then on August 14, 2021, Laila's life changed. She and a friend sat in a restaurant in Kabul. They had just finished an exam and wanted to celebrate passing the test by ordering coffee and cake. Suddenly, a man came in, stopped at the entrance, and shouted "Allahu Akbar." He yelled that the mujahideen would always be victorious.
paras.zh: 然后，2021 年 8 月 14 日，莱拉的生活发生了变化。她和一个朋友坐在喀布尔的一家餐馆里。他们刚刚完成考试，想通过点咖啡和蛋糕来庆祝通过考试。突然，一个男人进来了，在入口处停下来，高喊“真主至大”。他高喊圣战者将永远取得胜利。

paras.en: That was the day the Taliban retook power in Afghanistan, they soon forced women out of public life, banning them from many jobs and from attending school and university.
paras.zh: 就在那一天，塔利班在阿富汗重新掌权，他们很快就迫使妇女退出公共生活，禁止她们从事许多工作以及上学和大学。

paras.en: Laila said she recalls losing feeling in her hands or feet. She pulled money from her purse and slammed it on the table without checking the amount. "We all thought maybe this would be the last day that we are alive," she said.
paras.zh: 莱拉说她记得自己的手或脚失去了知觉。她从钱包里掏出钱，没有检查金额，就摔在桌子上。 “我们都认为这可能是我们活着的最后一天，”她说。

paras.en: Since then, some of Laila's peers have received threatening calls and messages. Now, whenever she leaves home, she worries that Taliban authorities might search her phone.
paras.zh: 从那时起，莱拉的一些同龄人就接到了恐吓电话和短信。现在，每当她离开家时，她都会担心塔利班当局可能会搜查她的手机。

paras.en: "What if they see my emails from my work, from my university?" she said. "It's always in the back of my head that maybe tomorrow it's my turn. Maybe they will detain me."
paras.zh: “如果他们看到我的工作邮件、大学邮件怎么办？”她说。 “我的脑海里总是想着，也许明天就轮到我了。也许他们会拘留我。”

paras.en: Even her home isn't safe. Laila said Taliban authorities have entered on several occasions to search their belongings.
paras.zh: 就连她的家也不安全。莱拉说，塔利班当局曾多次进入搜查他们的财物。

paras.en: Yet, she has continued studying. For all its limitations and risks, the online program offered a chance to graduate.
paras.zh: 然而，她仍然继续学习。尽管有其局限性和风险，在线课程还是提供了毕业的机会。

paras.en: A place for Afghanistan's 'future leaders'
paras.zh: 阿富汗“未来领导人”的地方

paras.en: With the US pulling out as the university's primary funder, Laila said she doubts whether she has the strength to start over.
paras.zh: 随着美国退出该大学的主要资助者，莱拉表示她怀疑自己是否有能力重新开始。

paras.en: The American University of Afghanistan was always intended, largely, for women. Before the campus opened in 2006, former US first lady Laura Bush announced that the US had committed millions to support it.
paras.zh: 阿富汗美国大学一直主要是为女性设立的。 2006年校园开放前，美国前第一夫人劳拉·布什宣布美国已投入数百万美元支持。

paras.en: Appearing in Kabul, Bush said the new university would teach "future leaders," particularly women. Women like Laila, who was four years old at the time.
paras.zh: 布什在喀布尔露面时表示，新大学将培养“未来的领导人”，特别是女性。像当时四岁的莱拉这样的女性。

paras.en: "These are more than just development projects," Bush said at the time. "They also signify the bond between the American and Afghan people. They are symbols of our shared hopes and dreams."
paras.zh: “这些不仅仅是开发项目，”布什当时说道。 “它们还象征着美国和阿富汗人民之间的纽带。它们是我们共同希望和梦想的象征。”

paras.en: Patrick Fine was Afghanistan mission director at USAID, the now-defunct American development agency. Fine told DW that many at USAID considered the university idea risky. Critics thought training elites was a waste of money.
paras.zh: 帕特里克·法恩（Patrick Fine）是美国国际开发署（现已解散的美国开发机构）阿富汗任务主任。法恩告诉德国之声，美国国际开发署的许多人认为大学的想法有风险。批评者认为培养精英是浪费金钱。

paras.en: But the Bush administration saw an opportunity to stabilize a budding democracy, Fine said.
paras.zh: 但法恩说，布什政府看到了稳定萌芽民主的机会。

paras.en: By 2003, the Taliban had been driven from power. US President George W. Bush wanted to foster goodwill for the US-backed interim government that had replaced the Taliban. The university served that goal, and also offered other "facets of advantage" in educating women, training future politicians, and supporting the Afghan economy.
paras.zh: 到2003年，塔利班已被赶下台。美国总统乔治·W·布什希望为美国支持的取代塔利班的临时政府培养善意。该大学实现了这一目标，并在教育女性、培训未来政治家和支持阿富汗经济方面提供了其他“方面的优势”。

paras.en: "It really impacted the lives of thousands of Afghan youth," Fine said, referencing alumni. "The organization has managed to achieve that against incredible odds."
paras.zh: “这确实影响了数千名阿富汗年轻人的生活，”法恩谈到校友时说道。 “该组织克服了难以置信的困难，成功实现了这一目标。”

paras.en: The university continued with US support. But in Washington, that support started to come under question.
paras.zh: 该大学在美国的支持下继续发展。但在华盛顿，这种支持开始受到质疑。

paras.en: The US government suspected the university of mishandling money. In 2016, US inspectors opened an investigation into its finances. By 2018, investigators said they could not tell exactly how it was spending US aid money, because its accounting was so poor.
paras.zh: 美国政府怀疑该大学处理资金不当。 2016年，美国检查人员对其财务状况展开调查。到 2018 年，调查人员表示，他们无法准确判断该公司如何使用美国的援助资金，因为其会计核算非常糟糕。

paras.en: John Sopko, a former US federal inspector, oversaw that investigation. When DW contacted him for this story, he replied, "I was surprised they were still funding AUAF."
paras.zh: 前美国联邦监察员约翰·索普科 (John Sopko) 监督了这项调查。当德国之声就此事联系他时，他回答说：“我很惊讶他们仍然资助 AUAF。”

paras.en: This year, after the funding was pulled, the US State Department Press Office told DW in an email that the move was made given the university's "history of repeated lack of accountability for millions of American taxpayer dollars."
paras.zh: 今年，在资金被撤回后，美国国务院新闻办公室在一封电子邮件中告诉德国之声，此举是鉴于该大学“一再对数百万美国纳税人的资金缺乏问责的历史”而做出的。

paras.en: Fine, the former USAID director, rejected the State Department's fraud explanation.
paras.zh: 美国国际开发署前局长法恩驳斥了国务院关于欺诈的解释。

paras.en: "Those are just smear tactics," he said. He conceded that past audits found the university struggling to keep up with USAID's extensive rules, "but they didn't find major fraud," he said.
paras.zh: “这些只是抹黑策略，”他说。他承认，过去的审计发现该大学很难遵守美国国际开发署的广泛规则，“但他们没有发现重大欺诈行为，”他说。

paras.en: "It is still a useful investment, a worthy investment," Fine said, "and the reason for that is that it's one of the few organizations left that is reaching Afghan women."
paras.zh: “这仍然是一项有用的投资，一项有价值的投资，”法恩说，“原因是它是为数不多的为阿富汗妇女提供服务的组织之一。”

paras.en: The US isn't the university's only funder, but it has long covered most of its costs: nearly 90% as of 2018, according to a US report.
paras.zh: 美国并不是该大学的唯一资助者，但它长期以来一直承担着该大学的大部分费用：根据美国的一份报告，截至 2018 年，该费用已接近 90%。

paras.en: The US State Department told DW that the university is "free to identify other funders and partners, so the end of their receipt of American taxpayer money does not necessarily equate to an end to their operations."
paras.zh: 美国国务院告诉德国之声，该大学“可以自由地确定其他资助者和合作伙伴，因此停止接受美国纳税人的钱并不一定意味着停止运营。”

paras.en: But without the $25 million grant the State Department recently refused, the university's future is in doubt.
paras.zh: 但如果没有国务院最近拒绝的 2500 万美元拨款，这所大学的未来就令人怀疑。

paras.en: What is next for women students in Afghanistan?
paras.zh: 阿富汗女学生的下一步是什么？

paras.en: "I have lost all my motivation and hope," Laila said, adding that each time she prepares for a lecture, she wonders whether there will be another.
paras.zh: “我已经失去了所有的动力和希望，”莱拉说，并补充说，每次她准备讲座时，她都会想知道是否还会有另一场讲座。

paras.en: Since she learned about the funding cut, she said she's barely left her room. Her curtains are usually closed, and she's lost her appetite. "Maybe I'm so disappointed that I can't even cry about it," she said.
paras.zh: 她说，自从得知资金削减后，她几乎没有离开过自己的房间。她的窗帘通常是拉着的，她已经没有胃口了。 “也许我太失望了，我什至都哭不出来，”她说。

paras.en: She said she was supposed to have graduated years ago. She was supposed to be making the world a better place. She was supposed to be studying for a master's degree abroad. Now, she's thinking, maybe she'll find a way in five or ten years.
paras.zh: 她说她几年前就应该毕业了。她应该让世界变得更美好。她原本应该去国外攻读硕士学位。现在，她在想，也许五年或十年后她就能找到办法。

articles.title: European, Middle East ministers urge US-Iran diplomacy, not new attacks

paras.en: Foreign ministers from eight countries are cautioning the United States against further attacks on Iran after meeting in Turkiye to discuss the Strait of Hormuz and other regional developments.
paras.zh: 来自八个国家的外交部长在土耳其举行会议讨论霍尔木兹海峡和其他地区事态发展后警告美国不要对伊朗发动进一步袭击。

paras.en: Ministers from the United Kingdom, France and Germany, known as the E3, convened with counterparts from the R4 group of Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Egypt on Friday, along with Italy.
paras.zh: 英国、法国和德国（E3）的部长于周五与土耳其、沙特阿拉伯、巴基斯坦和埃及以及意大利的 R4 集团的部长们举行了会议。

paras.en: Speaking after the meeting in Istanbul, Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said that none of the countries participating in the meeting approved of another military intervention or attack on Iran.
paras.zh: 土耳其外交部长哈坎·菲丹在伊斯坦布尔会议结束后表示，与会国家均不同意对伊朗再次进行军事干预或袭击。

paras.en: Such a move would only exacerbate tensions and further expand the conflict, he said, adding that diplomacy and dialogue were the only way to end the war.
paras.zh: 他说，此举只会加剧紧张局势，进一步扩大冲突，并补充说，外交和对话是结束战争的唯一途径。

paras.en: A further escalation between Iran and the US “would create nothing but losers and would undoubtedly have very serious consequences for hydrocarbon prices,” French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot told reporters.
paras.zh: 法国外交部长让-诺埃尔·巴罗对记者表示，伊朗和美国之间的进一步升级“只会造成输家，并且无疑会对碳氢化合物价格产生非常严重的后果”。

paras.en: “And so the first thing this group of eight countries … will do is call on both sides to exercise the utmost restraint, because we cannot afford another escalation in the region,” he added.
paras.zh: “因此，这个由八个国家组成的集团……要做的第一件事就是呼吁双方保持最大限度的克制，因为我们无法承受该地区局势再次升级，”他补充道。

paras.en: Italy’s Antonio Tajani said the aim was to work for “de-escalation to guarantee freedom of navigation.”
paras.zh: 意大利的安东尼奥·塔贾尼表示，其目标是“努力缓和局势，保证航行自由”。

paras.en: “I do not believe the problem can be solved from a purely military standpoint,” he said, noting that “we must promote dialogue” in order to reopen Hormuz.
paras.zh: “我不认为从纯粹的军事角度可以解决这个问题，”他说，并指出“我们必须促进对话”才能重新开放霍尔木兹。

paras.en: The group also discussed Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, escalating fighting in Yemen and prospects for ending the Russia-Ukraine war.
paras.zh: 该组织还讨论了以色列对加沙的种族灭绝战争、也门不断升级的战斗以及结束俄罗斯-乌克兰战争的前景。

paras.en: Reporting from Istanbul, Al Jazeera’s Sinem Koseoglu said the summit was a “first-of-its-kind” attempt to discuss the parameters of regional conflicts and possible solutions.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台记者西内姆·科塞奥格鲁在伊斯坦布尔报道称，这次峰会是讨论地区冲突的范围和可能的解决方案的“首次”尝试。

paras.en: Although participating countries “all have different national interests, especially when it comes to the crisis in the Gulf”, the Turkish foreign minister “underlined that what is happening in the Gulf … is affecting the other parts of the world”, Koseoglu added.
paras.zh: 科塞奥格鲁补充说，尽管参与国“都有不同的国家利益，特别是在海湾危机方面”，但土耳其外交部长“强调海湾地区正在发生的事情……正在影响世界其他地区”。

paras.en: The meeting at an Istanbul hotel came as Turkiye seeks to bolster its role in the region, including through the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, the trilateral pact launched with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia in August.
paras.zh: 这次在伊斯坦布尔酒店举行的会议正值土耳其寻求加强其在该地区的作用，包括通过麦加联合防御协议，这是八月份与巴基斯坦和沙特阿拉伯签署的三边协议。

paras.en: Turkiye has said that the pact is not aimed at any specific country and remains open to others joining, including Egypt.
paras.zh: 土耳其表示，该协议并不针对任何特定国家，并且仍然向包括埃及在内的其他国家开放。

paras.en: Fidan told reporters the pact has “several advantages, particularly because it is informal and flexible and focuses specifically on the issues we face.”
paras.zh: 菲丹告诉记者，该协议有“几个优点，特别是因为它是非正式的、灵活的，并且专门针对我们面临的问题。”

paras.en: “We are not aware of any other platform that brings together countries with such different geographical and political backgrounds,” he said, noting that Ankara “is well placed to play a constructive role in this process”.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们不知道还有任何其他平台能够将地理和政治背景如此不同的国家聚集在一起。”他指出，安卡拉“完全有能力在这一进程中发挥建设性作用”。

paras.en: Cairo has yet to decide whether to join the agreement. President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi recently said that Egypt would “carry out any measure to protect” Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 开罗尚未决定是否加入该协议。总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西最近表示，埃及将“采取任何措施保护”沙特阿拉伯。

paras.en: The Iran-backed Houthis are fighting Yemen’s Saudi-backed internationally recognised government forces and have launched a series of deadly attacks on Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 伊朗支持的胡塞武装正在与沙特支持的国际公认的也门政府军作战，并对沙特阿拉伯发动了一系列致命袭击。

articles.title: Israeli roadblocks disrupt schools and medical care in West Bank village

paras.en: Wail Qut, 42, usually commutes to work in Ramallah, in the occupied West Bank. But for more than two weeks he has been stuck at home in the village of Madama, south of Nablus, due to a tight Israeli siege.
paras.zh: 42 岁的韦尔·库特 (Wail Qut) 通常在被占领的西岸拉马拉上班。但由于以色列的严密围困，他已经被困在纳布卢斯南部马达马村的家中两个多星期了。

paras.en: On October 11, the Israeli army blocked the village’s four entrances with earthen barriers, citing “security reasons”. Qut says that the Israeli military has told residents that the restrictions would remain until Palestinian farmers stopped trying to access their land, particularly in the northern part of the village, where an illegal settler outpost is located.
paras.zh: 10月11日，以色列军队以“安全原因”为由，用土栅封锁了该村的四个入口。库特说，以色列军方已告诉居民，这些限制将继续存在，直到巴勒斯坦农民停止试图进入他们的土地，特别是在村庄北部，那里有一个非法定居者前哨基地。

paras.en: The decision has completely restricted the movement of more than 2,500 residents. On October 20, the army briefly opened the northern entrance for a few hours before closing it once again.
paras.zh: 这一决定彻底限制了2500多名居民的行动。 10月20日，军队短暂开放北入口几个小时，然后再次关闭。

paras.en: Qut works as a legal consultant for the Jerusalem Legal Aid and Human Rights Center in Ramallah. Three days into the siege, he needed to reach his office in the city to deal with urgent case files.
paras.zh: 库特是拉马拉耶路撒冷法律援助和人权中心的法律顾问。围困三天后，他需要到达城里的办公室处理紧急案件档案。

paras.en: “The residents managed to clear a rough, unpaved dirt track between Madama and Asira, which I used to reach Ramallah. It was a dangerous gamble, though the area is swarming with settlers, and the path is not even passable for most vehicles,” he told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “居民们设法清理了马达马和阿西拉之间一条崎岖不平、未铺砌的土路，我曾用它到达拉马拉。这是一场危险的赌博，尽管该地区挤满了定居者，而且这条路甚至对大多数车辆来说都无法通行，”他告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: Whenever Palestinian residents attempted to leave Madama via this makeshift route, the Israeli army deployed a drone to monitor them. Soldiers have also attacked the residents and fired sound grenades and tear gas canisters to force them back.
paras.zh: 每当巴勒斯坦居民试图通过这条临时路线离开马达马时，以色列军队就会部署一架无人机监视他们。士兵们还袭击了居民，并发射声波手榴弹和催泪瓦斯罐，迫使他们后退。

paras.en: The soldiers have subsequently blocked the dirt track, cutting off the only small opening that had allowed some residents to leave the village. As a result, Qut was forced to spend days away in Ramallah, only returning home once he learned that the northern entrance had been briefly reopened.
paras.zh: 随后，士兵们封锁了土路，切断了一些居民离开村庄的唯一小口。结果，库特被迫在拉马拉呆了几天，直到得知北部入口已短暂重新开放后才回家。

paras.en: “I returned to the village and found settlers everywhere, monitoring the tight siege. Shortly afterwards, the army closed the entrance once again. Some residents who had left were unable to return and had to leave their vehicles outside the village,” he added.
paras.zh: “我回到村里，发现到处都有定居者，监视着严密的围困。不久之后，军队再次关闭了入口。一些离开的居民无法返回，不得不把车辆留在村外，”他补充道。

paras.en: The restrictions have coincided with Israeli bulldozing operations that residents say have destroyed agricultural land and uprooted hundreds of olive trees.
paras.zh: 这些限制恰逢以色列的推土行动，居民称推土行动毁坏了农田，并将数百棵橄榄树连根拔起。

paras.en: Locals in Madama have described the scenes as “horrific”, particularly as they came during the annual olive harvest season, a vital source of income for local farmers already struggling to access their land because of Israeli restrictions.
paras.zh: 马达马当地​​人形容这些场景“可怕”，尤其是在每年的橄榄收获季节，橄榄收获季节是当地农民的重要收入来源，由于以色列的限制，他们已经很难获得自己的土地。

paras.en: Al Jazeera has reached out to the Israeli military for comment, but has yet to receive a response.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台已联系以色列军方征求意见，但尚未收到回应。

paras.en: Rami Nassar, head of the Madama Village Council, told Al Jazeera that the village spans about 340 hectares (840 acres). He said Israel had seized village land in the 1980s for the establishment of the illegal Yitzhar settlement, while another portion was taken in the 1990s to construct a settler-only road – Route 60 – which now restricts residents’ access to their agricultural land.
paras.zh: Madama 村委员会主席 Rami Nassar 告诉半岛电视台，该村占地约 340 公顷（840 英亩）。他说，以色列在 20 世纪 80 年代征用了村庄的土地，用于建立非法的伊扎尔定居点，而在 1990 年代又征用了另一部分土地，用于修建定居者专用的道路——60 号公路，该公路现在限制了居民进入他们的农田。

paras.en: Last April, Nassar said, Israeli settlers established an illegal pastoral settlement northwest of the village, near the al-Murabbaa checkpoint. Since then, he said, settlers have been siphoning electricity and water from the village’s utility networks and destroying agricultural crops.
paras.zh: 纳萨尔说，去年四月，以色列定居者在该村西北部穆拉巴检查站附近建立了一个非法的牧区定居点。他说，从那时起，定居者一直从村里的公用设施网络中抽取电力和水，并毁坏农作物。

paras.en: Last July, the council leader added, under the protection of the Israeli army, settler bulldozers levelled what he estimated to have been about 57 hectares (140 acres) of land in the northwest of the village, and uprooted hundreds of mature, fruit-bearing olive trees.
paras.zh: 去年 7 月，该委员会领导人补充说，在以色列军队的保护下，定居者推土机夷平了村庄西北部约 57 公顷（140 英亩）的土地，并连根拔起了数百棵成熟、结果实的橄榄树。

paras.en: During the current olive harvest season, according to Nassar, Israeli soldiers have chased Palestinian farmers away from their fields, while settlers have stolen both harvested olives and farming equipment from those who managed to reach their land.
paras.zh: 纳萨尔表示，在当前的橄榄收获季节，以色列士兵将巴勒斯坦农民赶出他们的田地，而定居者则从那些设法到达他们土地的人那里偷走了收获的橄榄和农具。

paras.en: “The olive harvest season has come to an end for the people of Madama, a season they rely on entirely, especially given their harsh living conditions. Every year, the harvest felt like a celebration; now, all we see is them bulldozing and uprooting our trees,” Nassar said sorrowfully.
paras.zh: “对马达玛人民来说，橄榄收获季节已经结束，这是他们完全依赖的季节，特别是考虑到他们恶劣的生活条件。每年，收获都像是一场庆祝；现在，我们看到的只是他们推土机和连根拔起我们的树木，”纳萨尔悲伤地说。

paras.en: The closures have disrupted daily life in Madama, preventing residents from reaching work, schools and hospitals, while blocking the delivery of essential supplies, including cooking gas, Nassar said.
paras.zh: 纳萨尔说，封锁扰乱了马达马的日常生活，导致居民无法上班、上学和医院，同时也阻碍了包括烹饪燃气在内的基本物资的运送。

paras.en: “A few days ago, a resident suffered a heart attack and needed to be taken to a hospital,” he recalled. “As the village doctor, I had to transport him carrying him over earthen berms and navigate through olive groves and steep slopes in a private vehicle travelling between various villages to reach a nearby hospital. It took over two hours to get him there; under normal circumstances, this journey would take no more than 15 minutes.”
paras.zh: “几天前，一名居民心脏病发作，需要送往医院，”他回忆道。 “作为村医，我得开着私家车穿梭于各个村庄之间，翻过土堤，穿过橄榄林和陡坡，才能到达附近的医院。花了两个多小时才把他送到附近的医院，正常情况下，这段路不会超过15分钟。”

paras.en: The siege has also disrupted schooling across Madama and neighbouring villages, preventing teachers from reaching classrooms.
paras.zh: 围困还扰乱了马达玛和邻近村庄的学校教育，导致教师无法到达教室。

paras.en: Samer al-Jamal, director general of education for the southern Nablus district, said that the closure of roads and gates, combined with the restrictions on the movement of educational staff, had deprived thousands of students of their education.
paras.zh: 纳布卢斯南部地区教育总监萨米尔·贾迈勒表示，道路和大门的关闭，加上对教育人员行动的限制，导致数千名学生无法接受教育。

paras.en: Three schools in Madama, Burin, and Asira were forced to switch to remote learning for three days following the imposition of the blockade. As the closure continued, students and teachers were eventually compelled to cross earthen barriers on foot to reach their schools.
paras.zh: 封锁实施后，马达马、布林和阿西拉的三所学校被迫转向远程学习三天。随着封锁的继续，学生和教师最终被迫步行穿过土垒到达学校。

paras.en: Maryam Rayan, 48, the principal of al-Fayha Kindergarten in Asira, told Al Jazeera that the simple task of ensuring children could arrive at and leave the kindergarten safely was increasingly dangerous, as 35 of the school’s enrolled children live in Madama.
paras.zh: 48 岁的玛丽亚姆·拉扬 (Maryam Rayan) 是阿西拉 al-Fayha 幼儿园的园长，他告诉半岛电视台，确保孩子们安全到达和离开幼儿园的简单任务变得越来越危险，因为学校有 35 名在校儿童住在马达马。

paras.en: She explained that she lives in the neighbouring village of Burin. The journey from there, passing through Madama to reach Asira, should typically take no more than eight minutes; however, due to the blockade of Madama, the trip now takes more than an hour and a half.
paras.zh: 她解释说，她住在邻近的布林村。从那里出发，经过马达玛到达阿西拉，通常不会超过八分钟；然而，由于Madama的封锁，行程现在需要一个半小时以上。

paras.en: “The kindergarten bus would have to stop near the earthen barrier after we verified that no soldiers or settlers were present, and we would wait for the children to arrive on a local shuttle from within the village. I would then cross the barrier on foot to help them get over it, one by one. It was a tragic scene, but we had no other choice,” she added.
paras.zh: “在我们确认没有士兵或定居者在场后，幼儿园巴士必须停在土墙附近，然后等待孩子们从村内乘坐当地班车到达。然后我会步行穿过土墙，帮助他们一个一个地越过土墙。这是一个悲惨的场景，但我们别无选择，”她补充道。

paras.en: On the return journey, Rayan would again help the children cross the barrier, boarding the shuttle with them to ensure they all reached their homes safely. Afterwards, she would cross the barrier alone to return to the kindergarten bus, which would then take her back to Burin.
paras.zh: 回程时，Rayan 会再次帮助孩子们穿过障碍，与他们一起登上班车，确保他们都能安全到达家。之后，她会独自穿过隔离栏，返回幼儿园巴士，然后巴士将带她返回布林。

paras.en: “I have been working in education for 25 years, yet I have never encountered circumstances as difficult as those we have lived through due to the blockade of Madama. From the moment I left my home until I returned, I felt tense, fearful, and anxious, all because I am responsible for the lives of 135 children at the kindergarten, while the streets are filled with soldiers or settlers,” she explained.
paras.zh: “我从事教育工作已经25年了，但我从未遇到过像我们因马达玛的封锁而经历的困难。从我离开家的那一刻起，直到我回来，我都感到紧张、恐惧和焦虑，这一切都是因为我要对幼儿园135名孩子的生命负责，而街道上却挤满了士兵或定居者，”她解释道。

paras.en: On Thursday, Israel reopened the northern entrance to Madama, though Palestinians expect it could be closed again at any moment, especially since the other entrances to the village remain shut. And on Friday, Israel began imposing widespread restrictions on movement throughout the West Bank after an attack in Hebron killed two soldiers, with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordering preparations for a complete lockdown and a large-scale operation throughout the occupied territory.
paras.zh: 周四，以色列重新开放了马达马的北部入口，尽管巴勒斯坦人预计该入口可能随时再次关闭，特别是因为该村的其他入口仍然关闭。周五，在希伯伦发生袭击造成两名士兵死亡后，以色列开始对整个西岸地区的行动实施广泛限制，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡下令准备在整个被占领土进行全面封锁和大规模行动。

paras.en: The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) said it had identified 925 physical obstacles restricting the movement of Palestinians in the West Bank by December 2025, including 167 earth mounds, which collectively affect the movement of approximately 3.4 million Palestinians.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义事务协调办公室（OCHA）表示，到2025年12月，已在西岸确定了925处限制巴勒斯坦人行动的实体障碍，其中包括167个土堆，这些土堆总共影响了约340万巴勒斯坦人的行动。

paras.en: The agency noted that these obstacles sever connections between villages, towns, and main roads, forcing residents to take longer, alternative routes and limiting their access to workplaces, essential services, and agricultural land.
paras.zh: 该机构指出，这些障碍切断了村庄、城镇和主要道路之间的联系，迫使居民走更长的替代路线，并限制他们进入工作场所、获得基本服务和农田。

articles.title: Brazil’s right has already changed the balance of power

paras.en: In a televised presidential debate in Sao Paulo on October 18, Flavio Bolsonaro brought a number from Brazil’s prisons into an argument over crime. “Seventy-three percent”. The 45-year-old senator claimed that was the share of prisoners who had voted for his opponent, President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, 80. The figure came from polling stations inside detention facilities, where staff and eligible detainees awaiting trial could cast ballots. Convicted prisoners serving final sentences could not vote. Lula paused. “I want 100 percent,” he replied. “Even your father.”
paras.zh: 10 月 18 日，在圣保罗举行的总统电视辩论中，弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗 (Flavio Bolsonaro) 与巴西监狱中的一些人就犯罪问题进行了辩论。 “百分之七十三”。这位 45 岁的参议员声称，这是投票支持他的对手、80 岁的总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦 (Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva) 的囚犯比例。这个数字来自拘留设施内的投票站，工作人员和等待审判的合格被拘留者可以在那里投票。服刑期满的囚犯不能投票。卢拉停了下来。 “我想要百分百，”他回答道。 “甚至是你的父亲。”

paras.en: Jair Bolsonaro, the absent father, had spent 28 years in Congress, where he repeatedly praised the 1964 military coup that ushered in more than two decades of dictatorship. He went on to become president, lost re-election to Lula in 2022 and was later convicted of plotting to overturn the result. He is serving a 27-year sentence under house arrest. A week after Lula’s inauguration, thousands of Bolsonaro supporters invaded and vandalised the presidential palace, Congress and Supreme Court in Brasilia, claiming without evidence that the election had been stolen.
paras.zh: 缺席的父亲雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 在国会任职 28 年，多次赞扬 1964 年军事政变，这场政变开启了二十多年的独裁统治。他后来成为总统，但在 2022 年连任时输给了卢拉，后来因密谋推翻结果而被定罪。他被软禁 27 年，正在服刑。卢拉就职一周后，数千名博尔索纳罗支持者入侵并破坏了巴西利亚的总统​​府、国会和最高法院，在没有证据的情况下声称选举被窃取。

paras.en: Back in the studio, Flavio was promising to “redemocratise” Brazil. He demanded respect for the 56 million Brazilians who had voted for him and said he would send Lula into retirement.
paras.zh: 回到工作室后，弗拉维奥承诺让巴西“重新民主化”。他要求尊重投票给他的 5600 万巴西人，并表示他将让卢拉退休。

paras.en: On October 4, Brazil held the first round of its presidential election, alongside elections for the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate. Flavio received 56.1 million votes, or 47.03 percent of valid ballots, against Lula’s 53.9 million and 45.16 percent. Since then, Bolsonaro’s lead in the polls has narrowed, with several surveys placing the candidates within the margin of error. The latest readings suggest Lula is gaining ground, although just days before the October 25 run-off, it remains uncertain whether the president can overcome Flavio’s first-round lead.
paras.zh: 10月4日，巴西举行第一轮总统选举，同时举行众议院和参议院选举。弗拉维奥获得了 5610 万张选票，占有效选票的 47.03%，而卢拉则获得了 5390 万张选票和 45.16%。从那时起，博尔索纳罗在民意调查中的领先优势已经缩小，多项调查都将候选人置于误差范围内。最新的读数表明卢拉正在取得进展，尽管距离 10 月 25 日决选仅几天，但总统能否克服弗拉维奥在第一轮的领先优势仍不确定。

paras.en: The October 18 debate had begun with a discussion of armed groups spreading through Brazilian neighbourhoods. Nearly 69 million Brazilians say they perceive the presence of criminal gangs or militias in their neighbourhoods, even as the country’s murder rate falls. Flavio called for treating those organisations as narcoterrorists and for Brazil to join United States President Donald Trump’s Shield of the Americas alongside Javier Milei’s Argentina. He promised 500,000 additional prison places, easier civilian access to firearms and a reduction in the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16, and to 14 for certain serious crimes.
paras.zh: 10 月 18 日的辩论首先讨论了在巴西社区蔓延的武装团体。近 6900 万巴西人表示，尽管该国的谋杀率有所下降，但他们仍认为自己的社区中存在犯罪团伙或民兵。弗拉维奥呼吁将这些组织视为毒品恐怖分子，并呼吁巴西与哈维尔·米莱的阿根廷一起加入美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的美洲之盾。他承诺增加 50 万个监狱场所，让平民更容易获得枪支，并将刑事责任年龄从 18 岁降低到 16 岁，某些严重犯罪的年龄则降低到 14 岁。

paras.en: For residents of poorer neighbourhoods, Flavio proposed a Ministry of Prosperity, promising vocational training and credit to help families receiving government assistance to start businesses of their own. The word “prosperity” had a history of its own in Brazil’s influential evangelical churches, where sermons sometimes link material advancement to faith and individual endeavour.
paras.zh: 对于贫困社区的居民，弗拉维奥提议成立繁荣部，承诺提供职业培训和信贷，帮助接受政府援助的家庭创办自己的企业。 “繁荣”这个词在巴西有影响力的福音派教会中有着自己的历史，这些教会的布道有时将物质进步与信仰和个人努力联系起来。

paras.en: Taken together, the promises linked the prospect of safer streets to a particular idea of prosperity, in which government assistance would become a starting point for vocational training, credit and small businesses.
paras.zh: 总而言之，这些承诺将更安全的街道前景与特定的繁荣理念联系起来，其中政府援助将成为职业培训、信贷和小企业的起点。

paras.en: Lula spoke of the social gains of his governments and of restoring democratic institutions after the Bolsonaro years. A former union leader who helped found the centre-left Workers’ Party (PT), he proposed stronger federal coordination of public security. The tougher approach to crime was not confined to Flavio’s campaign. Lula, too, supported lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 for certain serious offences.
paras.zh: 卢拉谈到了他的政府所取得的社会成就以及博尔索纳罗时代后恢复民主制度的情况。作为一名前工会领导人，他曾帮助创建中左翼工人党（PT），他提议加强联邦对公共安全的协调。对犯罪采取更严厉的态度并不仅限于弗拉维奥的竞选活动。卢拉也支持将某些严重犯罪的刑事责任年龄降低至 16 岁。

paras.en: Two days before the debate, Lula had stood among congressional leaders to celebrate a reform that would gradually bring Brazil’s six-day working week to an end, reducing hours from 44 to 40 without cutting wages. After initially criticising the reform as opportunistic, Senator Flavio Bolsonaro changed his position and voted for it, saying he had listened to workers on the campaign trail.
paras.zh: 辩论前两天，卢拉与国会领导人一起庆祝一项改革，该改革将逐步结束巴西每周六天的工作时间，将工作时间从 44 小时减少到 40 小时，但工资不减。参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗最初批评这项改革是机会主义的，但后来改变立场并投票支持这项改革，称他在竞选过程中听取了工人们的意见。

paras.en: Lula had other economic gains to highlight. Unemployment in Brazil has fallen from 7.8 percent in 2023 to 5.3 percent this year, while real wages have risen. For many households, however, expensive credit and debt repayments have dampened the impact of any improvements. Flavio has sought to capitalise on the resulting economic frustration, as well as concerns about public security.
paras.zh: 卢拉还有其他值得强调的经济成就。巴西的失业率已从 2023 年的 7.8% 下降至今年的 5.3%，而实际工资却有所上升。然而，对于许多家庭来说，昂贵的信贷和债务偿还削弱了任何改善的影响。弗拉维奥试图利用由此产生的经济挫折以及对公共安全的担忧。

paras.en: If re-elected, Lula would have to address those frustrations while dealing with a Congress reshaped by the October 4 legislative elections. In the 513-seat lower house, Bolsonaro’s Liberal Party (PL) won 121 seats, up from 97. The PT-led bloc moved from 82 to 88, while the largest alliance of traditional centre-right parties lost 18 seats. The sharpest rearrangement had taken place within the right, leaving the parliamentary left’s numbers largely intact.
paras.zh: 如果再次当选，卢拉将不得不解决这些挫败感，同时应对 10 月 4 日立法选举重塑的国会。在下议院 513 个席位中，博尔索纳罗领导的自由党从 97 个席位增加到 121 个席位。劳工党领导的党派从 82 个席位增至 88 个席位，而最大的传统中右翼政党联盟则失去了 18 个席位。最剧烈的重组发生在右翼内部，使得议会左翼的人数基本保持不变。

paras.en: The right’s gains raise a question about the kind of change the Bolsonaro movement represents. In an October Datafolha survey, 48 percent of Lula’s supporters mentioned social protection, while 41 percent of Flavio’s supporters expressed a desire for change. Yet the PL’s new deputies were hardly political novices. Of the 121 elected, 111 had held office before and 93 had belonged to other parties.
paras.zh: 右翼的进展引发了人们对博尔索纳罗运动所代表的变革类型的质疑。在 Datafolha 10 月份的一项调查中，48% 的卢拉支持者提到了社会保护，而 41% 的弗拉维奥支持者则表达了变革的愿望。然而，人民解放党的新代表绝非政治新手。在121名当选者中，111人曾担任过职务，93人属于其他政党。

paras.en: In 2002, the same party had placed Jose Alencar, a conservative textile magnate, next to Lula on the presidential ticket that first brought the former union leader to power. Alencar remained vice president until 2010, though he left the PL in 2005 amid a corruption scandal involving its leadership. Jair Bolsonaro joined only in 2021. The party now housed his family’s ambitions alongside politicians whose careers had begun under very different banners.
paras.zh: 2002年，同一政党将保守派纺织巨头何塞·阿伦卡尔(Jose Alencar)安排在卢拉旁边的总统候选人名单上，首次让这位前工会领导人上台。阿伦卡一直担任副总统直至 2010 年，但他于 2005 年因涉及领导层的腐败丑闻而离开了人民联盟。雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 于 2021 年才加入。现在，该党将他家族的雄心与政治家们的抱负融为一体，而这些政治家的职业生涯是在截然不同的旗帜下开始的。

paras.en: In a country where presidents rarely command a parliamentary majority of their own party, politicians of such experience are seldom without work. Governments change, and parties move between coalitions to negotiate cabinet appointments and influence over the funds that reach their constituencies. Established centre-right parties have served administrations of widely differing orientations. Jair Bolsonaro eventually relied on them after campaigning against the political establishment. His movement’s gains had not made those alliances obsolete.
paras.zh: 在一个总统很少能在自己政党中占据议会多数席位的国家，拥有如此经验的政客很少会失业。政府更迭，政党在联盟之间移动，以谈判内阁任命并对到达其选区的资金施加影响。既定的中右翼政党为不同取向的政府服务。雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗在反对政治建制派的竞选活动后最终依赖了他们。他的运动取得的成果并没有使这些联盟变得过时。

paras.en: Lula has spent much of his political career constructing governments with former adversaries. His current vice president and running mate, Geraldo Alckmin, once challenged him for the presidency as the candidate of the centre-right opposition. A fourth term would demand more of that experience, with the right holding greater power in Congress. Lula’s successor, Dilma Rousseff, was impeached in 2016 amid a deep recession and the collapse of her governing coalition, circumstances quite different from those Lula faces today.
paras.zh: 卢拉的大部分政治生涯都与前对手一起组建政府。他的现任副总统兼竞选搭档杰拉尔多·阿尔克明(Geraldo Alckmin)曾作为中右翼反对派候选人向他挑战总统职位。第四个任期将需要更多的经验，右翼在国会拥有更大的权力。卢拉的继任者迪尔玛·罗塞夫 (Dilma Rousseff) 于 2016 年在严重经济衰退和执政联盟崩溃之际遭到弹劾，情况与卢拉今天面临的情况截然不同。

paras.en: The new balance of power would be particularly consequential for the Supreme Court. Alexandre de Moraes had overseen the case that sent Jair Bolsonaro to prison. As the Bolsonaro family accused him of political persecution, Lula’s party defended his authority as part of its defence of democracy. But the court has become a major target of the right’s parliamentary ambitions.
paras.zh: 新的权力平衡对于最高法院来说尤其重要。亚历山大·德莫赖斯负责监督雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗入狱的案件。当博尔索纳罗家族指责他进行政治迫害时，卢拉的政党捍卫他的权威，作为捍卫民主的一部分。但最高法院已成为右翼议会野心的主要目标。

paras.en: Moraes’s name had travelled through the October 4 Senate elections, in which 54 of the chamber’s 81 seats were contested. Candidates allied with the Bolsonaros promised to impeach him and curb the court’s powers. Some wanted its jurisdiction narrowed, while others sought to limit the authority of individual justices to act alone. The collapse of Banco Master, a private bank that had a lucrative contract with the law firm of Moraes’s wife, raised questions about possible conflicts of interest. The firm has denied wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 莫赖斯的名字出现在 10 月 4 日的参议院选举中，参议院 81 个席位中的 54 个席位进行了角逐。与博索纳罗家族结盟的候选人承诺弹劾他并限制法院的权力。一些人希望缩小其管辖范围，而另一些人则寻求限制个别法官单独行事的权力。马斯特银行（Banco Master）是一家私人银行，与莫赖斯妻子的律师事务所签订了一份利润丰厚的合同，该银行的倒闭引发了人们对可能存在利益冲突的质疑。该公司否认有不当行为。

paras.en: A fourth Lula term would face 28 Liberal Party senators in an 81-seat chamber empowered to approve Supreme Court appointments and remove justices through impeachment. A survey by Folha de S. Paulo identified at least 49 members of the next Senate who had expressed support for impeaching Supreme Court justices in some circumstances. That was five short of the two-thirds required for removal, even before agreement on a particular case. Support for restricting the court’s powers extended beyond the Bolsonaro movement.
paras.zh: 卢拉的第四个任期将在拥有 81 个席位的众议院中面对 28 名自由党参议员，这些参议员有权批准最高法院的任命并通过弹劾罢免法官。 《圣保罗页报》的一项调查显示，下届参议院中至少有 49 名议员表示支持在某些情况下弹劾最高法院法官。即使在就特定案件达成一致之前，这还比移除所需的三分之二少了五分之二。对限制法院权力的支持超出了博尔索纳罗运动的范畴。

paras.en: Congress’s growing power could also constrain Lula’s ability to deliver the economic and social improvements on which he has based much of his political appeal. Control over public money had been moving towards Congress. In 2025, parliamentary allocations for local projects reached about 47 billion reais ($9.3bn) in committed funds, more than four times their level 11 years earlier. Legislators increasingly choose where that money goes. A president can secure their votes for a particular measure without recovering control over the funds they distribute.
paras.zh: 国会日益增长的权力也可能会限制卢拉实现经济和社会改善的能力，而他的政治吸引力正是以此为基础的。 Control over public money had been moving towards Congress. 2025 年，议会对地方项目的拨款承诺资金达到约 470 亿雷亚尔（93 亿美元），是 11 年前水平的四倍多。 Legislators increasingly choose where that money goes. A president can secure their votes for a particular measure without recovering control over the funds they distribute.

paras.en: On Wednesday, Lula sent Congress a proposal to make public transport free on weekends and public holidays, allowing some workers who would soon have two days off to travel without paying fares. He suggested using money politicians had set aside for projects in their constituencies. The Speaker of the lower house welcomed the idea. He wanted the money to come from somewhere else.
paras.zh: 周三，卢拉向国会提交了一项提案，要求在周末和公共假期免费提供公共交通，允许一些即将享受两天假期的工人无需支付车费即可出行。他建议使用政客们为他们选区的项目预留的资金。下议院议长对这个想法表示欢迎。他希望钱来自其他地方。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: Retired general discusses the U.S. and Israeli plan for possible attack on Iran
articles.author: Leila Fadel

paras.en: Retired general discusses the U.S. and Israeli plan for possible attack on Iran
paras.zh: 退休将军讨论美国和以色列可能袭击伊朗的计划

paras.en: NPR'S Leila Fadel speaks with retired four-star Gen. Joseph Votel about the war in Iran and the U.S. and Israeli objectives for a potential post-election bombing campaign.
paras.zh: 美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的莱拉·法德尔 (Leila Fadel) 与退役四星将军约瑟夫·沃特尔 (Joseph Votel) 谈论了伊朗战争以及美国和以色列在选举后可能进行的轰炸行动的目标。

paras.en: For more on this, let's bring in retired Army four-star General Joseph Votel, who's been listening with us. He led U.S. Central Command from 2016 through 2019, overseeing military operations across the Middle East. He now chairs the Combating Terrorism Center at West Point. General, good morning, and thank you for joining us.
paras.zh: 有关此内容的更多信息，让我们请来退役陆军四星将军约瑟夫·沃特尔，他一直在和我们一起聆听。 2016 年至 2019 年，他领导美国中央司令部，监督整个中东的军事行动。他现在担任西点军校打击恐怖主义中心主席。将军，早上好，感谢您加入我们。

paras.en: FADEL: I want to start where we heard our correspondent leave off. I mean, what, in your view, could possible new strikes do that previous attacks didn't?
paras.zh: FADEL：我想从我们记者停下来的地方开始。我的意思是，在您看来，新的袭击可能会造成哪些以前的袭击无法做到的事情？

paras.en: VOTEL: Well, a new strike could degrade Iran. But it - as your reporter stated, it's unlikely to settle the war. We've hit a lot of these targets before. Iran has demonstrated some ability to rebuild them. So our strikes can buy us time. They can punish Iran. They can further degrade some of their capabilities. But they have not been effective, to this date, in terms of changing Tehran's calculus for the direction of the war.
paras.zh: 沃特尔：嗯，新的袭击可能会削弱伊朗的实力。但正如记者所说，这不太可能解决战争。我们之前已经实现了很多这样的目标。伊朗已经展现出一定的重建能力。所以我们的罢工可以为我们赢得时间。他们可以惩罚伊朗。他们可能会进一步降低他们的一些能力。但迄今为止，它们在改变德黑兰对战争方向的考虑方面还没有发挥作用。

paras.en: FADEL: Well, I mean, what could shift Iran's calculus? 'Cause from where I'm sitting, I see a regime that's gotten more hard-line, more dug in, more willing to be bold in its counterattacks and its threats.
paras.zh: 法德尔：嗯，我的意思是，什么可以改变伊朗的算计？因为从我现在的位置来看，我看到一个政权变得更加强硬，更加固执，更加愿意大胆反击和威胁。

paras.en: VOTEL: Well, I think, first and foremost, a very clear objective of what we want to achieve with this war. What does the end state look like? How do we declare that we are done? My personal view as - is that I think that gets to kind of the enrichment issue, and it gets to the opening of Hormuz. But what done looks like is it looks like a specific objective, and then military pressure and economic pressure and diplomatic pressure and information pressure all geared to achieve that end. So military pressure is one part of it, but you need all the other elements of national power as well.
paras.zh: 沃特尔：嗯，我认为，首先也是最重要的是，我们希望通过这场战争实现一个非常明确的目标。最终状态是什么样的？我们如何声明我们已经完成了？我个人的观点是，我认为这涉及到浓缩问题，涉及到霍尔木兹海峡的开放。但所做的事情看起来像是一个具体的目标，然后军事压力、经济压力、外交压力和信息压力都旨在实现这一目标。因此，军事压力是其中之一，但你还需要国家力量的所有其他要素。

paras.en: FADEL: Are you seeing any of those other elements entering the fray here?
paras.zh: FADEL：您是否看到其他因素也参与其中？

paras.en: VOTEL: Well, we certainly are seeing the financial element of power with the blockade, with a number of the sanctions that we put on - I mean, the reporting that the Iranian ghost fleet is out of oil. These all really contribute to kind of the economic objectives that we have to try to isolate and put maximum amount of pressure on this. So that's one area where we are making some very, very significant progress. That takes time, but there's definitely movement in that direction.
paras.zh: 沃特尔：嗯，我们确实看到了封锁带来的金融因素，以及我们实施的一系列制裁——我的意思是，有报道称伊朗幽灵舰队已经没有石油了。这些都确实有助于实现某种经济目标，我们必须努力隔离这些目标，并对其施加最大的压力。因此，这是我们正在取得一些非常非常重大进展的领域。这需要时间，但肯定会朝这个方向发展。

paras.en: FADEL: Do you have a clear understanding of the U.S. goal here at this point?
paras.zh: 法德尔：您现在对​​美国的目标有清楚的了解吗？

paras.en: VOTEL: Well, I think it has been somewhat challenging to understand exactly what we're doing. I think a lot of it does get down to getting the Straits of Hormuz open so that commerce, oil and other things can continue to move through there much more freely. And at a rate that is much more reduced, that's going to, you know, drive down the cost of our gas and diesel and everything else. I think that's one. And then a second - the second thing, I think, is - has been the nuclear weapons program.
paras.zh: VOTEL：嗯，我认为准确理解我们正在做的事情有点具有挑战性。我认为这很大程度上取决于开放霍尔木兹海峡，以便商业、石油和其他物品可以继续更自由地通过那里。如果速度大大降低，这将降低我们的天然气、柴油和其他一切产品的成本。我想那就是其中之一。然后第二件事——我认为是第二件事——是核武器计划。

paras.en: So, I mean, I think those are the things we're most concerned about. Of course, Iran is doing other things. They are using their proxies to cause problems and instability across the region. They do have a link here to the Houthis that are causing problems on the other side of the peninsula. So - but I think it is the Strait of Hormuz, and I think it is the enrichment program that we are principally concerned about.
paras.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我认为这些是我们最关心的事情。当然，伊朗还在做其他事情。他们利用自己的代理人在整个地区制造问题和不稳定。他们确实与在半岛另一边造成问题的胡塞武装有联系。所以 - 但我认为这是霍尔木兹海峡，我认为我们主要关心的是浓缩计划。

paras.en: FADEL: What do you think it would take to get to the negotiating table to try to find a way out of this situation?
paras.zh: FADEL：您认为如何才能走上谈判桌，试图找到摆脱这种局面的出路？

paras.en: VOTEL: Well, first and foremost, I think it does take a very clear articulation of what our objectives are and then a gearing of our elements of national power, whether it's the military campaign or economic or our diplomacy, really focused on those types of things and then having the patience to kind of see that through. So I definitely think that's kind of what this looks like from a larger perspective.
paras.zh: 沃特尔：嗯，首先也是最重要的，我认为确实需要非常清楚地阐明我们的目标是什么，然后调整我们的国家力量要素，无论是军事行动、经济还是我们的外交，真正专注于这些类型的事情，然后有耐心把它搞清楚。所以我绝对认为从更大的角度来看这就是这个样子。

paras.en: FADEL: What's your understanding of how well-equipped the U.S. military is to continue strikes and defend U.S. bases and partners in the Gulf?
paras.zh: 法德尔：您对美国军队在持续打击和保卫美国在海湾地区的基地和合作伙伴方面的装备精良程度有何看法？

paras.en: VOTEL: I think U.S. offensive power in the region is substantial. I think we can strike. I don't think that's the question. I think if there is a - is an area where there may be some concern, it is in the missile defense. It's in the defensive aspect of our operations. You know, when you do conduct military operations, you have to be prepared to defend over time as well. And as we've seen in previous reporting and - yeah - that there has been a lot of pressure put on kind of our defensive interceptors that are critical for not only protecting U.S. forces, but for protecting our partners in the region, protecting critical infrastructure. So offensive capability - I think we are where we need to be. The defensive capability may be the area where there is a bit of a constraint.
paras.zh: 沃特尔：我认为美国在该地区的进攻力量是巨大的。我想我们可以罢工。我不认为这是问题所在。我认为如果有一个领域可能令人担忧的话，那就是导弹防御领域。这是我们行动的防御方面。你知道，当你进行军事行动时，你也必须做好长期防御的准备。正如我们在之前的报告中所看到的，是的，我们的防御拦截器承受了很大的压力，这些拦截器不仅对于保护美军至关重要，而且对于保护我们在该地区的合作伙伴、保护关键基础设施至关重要。所以进攻能力——我认为我们已经达到了我们需要达到的水平。防御能力可能是有一点限制的地方。

paras.en: FADEL: Retired General and former CENTCOM Commander Joseph Votel. Thank you so much for your time and your insights.
paras.zh: 法德尔：退役将军、前中央司令部司令约瑟夫·沃特尔。非常感谢您的宝贵时间和见解。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of NPR transcripts may vary. Transcript text may be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio on npr.org may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 文字记录的准确性和可用性可能有所不同。转录文本可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。 npr.org 上的音频可能会在其原始广播或发布后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Military reinforcements move to Mideast. And, millions of Americans vote early
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Military reinforcements move to Mideast. And, millions of Americans vote early
paras.zh: 军事增援部队移至中东。而且，数百万美国人提前投票

paras.en: Heavier fighting in Iran could resume in the coming weeks as military reinforcements arrive and some U.S. personnel leave the region. This shift comes as a person briefed on the U.S. and Israel's war planning told NPR that the countries were preparing plans for a possible attack on Iran after the U.S. midterms. Iran said it is prepared.
paras.zh: 随着军事增援部队抵达以及一些美国人员离开该地区，伊朗可能会在未来几周内恢复更激烈的战斗。这一转变发生之际，一位了解美国和以色列战争计划的人士告诉美国国家公共广播电台，两国正在制定计划，以便在美国中期选举后可能对伊朗发动袭击。伊朗表示已做好准备。

paras.en: - 🎧 There are clear signs of preparations for a possible attack, NPR's Greg Myre tells Up First. The U.S. is deploying a third aircraft carrier to the Middle East, and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth recently visited Israel to meet with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. President Trump will likely consider military action after Nov. 3 to avoid a spike in oil prices before the midterm elections. In response, Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said that Iran is ready for both diplomacy and war. While the U.S. and Israel possess the power to inflict heavy damage, Iran shows no signs of making significant concessions, Myre says. Instead, it demands formal control over the Strait of Hormuz and the withdrawal of U.S. troops from the region.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的格雷格·迈尔 (Greg Myre) 告诉 Up First，有明显迹象表明正在为可能的袭击做准备。美国正在向中东部署第三艘航母，国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯最近访问以色列，会见了总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡。特朗普总统可能会考虑在 11 月 3 日之后采取军事行动，以避免中期选举前油价飙升。对此，伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇表示，伊朗已做好外交和战争的准备。迈雷说，虽然美国和以色列有能力造成严重损害，但伊朗没有表现出做出重大让步的迹象。相反，它要求正式控制霍尔木兹海峡并从该地区撤军。

paras.en: Although Election Day is more than a week away, almost 21 million Americans have already voted, either by mail or early in-person voting, according to the University of Florida's Election Lab.
paras.zh: 根据佛罗里达大学选举实验室的数据，尽管距离选举日还有一周多的时间，但近 2100 万美国人已经通过邮寄或提前亲自投票进行了投票。

paras.en: - 🎧 That number of votes so far is a lot and is an increase of about 2 million since yesterday, according to NPR's Saige Miller. In key battleground states, early voting is significantly higher compared to the last midterm election. While the early voting data should not be overinterpreted as a predictor of final results, it shows Democrats voting at higher rates than Republicans, Miller says. Unaffiliated voters are also participating early. Democrats are generally more likely to vote early, and Republicans are more likely to turn out on Election Day, Miller says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 据 NPR 的 Saige Miller 报道，到目前为止，投票数量很多，自昨天以来增加了约 200 万张。在关键战场州，提前投票率明显高于上次中期选举。米勒说，虽然早期投票数据不应被过度解读为最终结果的预测，但它显示民主党的投票率高于共和党。无党派选民也提前参与。米勒说，民主党人通常更有可能提前投票，共和党人更有可能在选举日投票。

paras.en: - ➡️ A federal judge in California is limiting the Department of Homeland Security's pre-election field operations. The agency says they aim to identify noncitizens who allegedly voted illegally in nine states.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 加利福尼亚州的一名联邦法官正在限制国土安全部的选前现场行动。该机构表示，他们的目标是查明涉嫌在九个州非法投票的非公民。

paras.en: - ➡️ The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country, to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: - ➡️ NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中在一个地方 - 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: Trump must sit for a deposition in his $10 billion defamation case against the BBC, a federal magistrate judge ruled. Trump is required to comply with court rules or face sanctions, the judge said yesterday. The case centers on a Panorama broadcast from late October 2024, which allegedly edited the president's Jan. 6 speech to make it appear he incited a violent siege of Congress. Trump has described the broadcast as false, misleading and defamatory under Florida law.
paras.zh: 一名联邦法官裁定，特朗普必须就其针对 BBC 的价值 100 亿美元的诽谤案出庭作证。法官昨天表示，特朗普必须遵守法庭规则，否则将面临制裁。该案件以 2024 年 10 月下旬播出的《全景》为中心，据称该节目对总统 1 月 6 日的演讲进行了编辑，使之看起来像是他煽动了对国会的暴力围攻。根据佛罗里达州法律，特朗普称该广播是虚假的、误导性的和诽谤性的。

paras.en: - 🎧 It's unclear if Trump will sit for a deposition after he previously canceled for "matters of national importance" and suggested January as an alternative, NPR's David Folkenflik says. The case initially focused on the economic harm the broadcast posed to Trump's brand and financial prospects. Although the BBC apologized for the splicing, it now seeks to understand Trump's mindset during his testimony, as he may have intended to encourage violence. BBC attorneys say more than 200 defendants from Jan. 6 said Trump's speech motivated them. The BBC is actively pursuing details about how Trump has profited since regaining the White House, most likely to assess the extent of the damage he faces, Folkenflik says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的大卫·福尔肯弗利克 (David Folkenflik) 表示，目前尚不清楚特朗普是否会参加听证会，此前他曾因“国家重大问题”取消了听证会，并建议在一月份作为替代方案。该案最初关注的是广播对特朗普的品牌和财务前景造成的经济损害。尽管 BBC 为拼接事件道歉，但现在它试图了解特朗普在作证期间的心态，因为他可能有意鼓励暴力。 BBC 律师表示，自 1 月 6 日以来，已有 200 多名被告表示特朗普的演讲激励了他们。福尔肯弗利克表示，英国广播公司正在积极追查特朗普自重新入主白宫以来如何获利的细节，很可能是为了评估他所面临的损害程度。

paras.en: - 🍔 Ground beef prices have skyrocketed, reaching $6.79 per pound last month, which is an 85% increase over the past decade, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics. This surge is largely due to weather and financial pressures on producers.
paras.zh: - 🍔 根据美国劳工统计局的数据，碎牛肉价格飙升，上个月达到每磅 6.79 美元，比过去十年上涨了 85%。这种激增主要是由于天气和生产商面临的财务压力。

paras.en: - 🥚 Prices for eggs fell to $2.27 per dozen last month. Outbreaks like the avian flu can cause significant price fluctuations. In March 2025, the average dozen reached a record high of $6.23.
paras.zh: - 🥚 上个月鸡蛋价格跌至每打 2.27 美元。禽流感等爆发可能会导致价格大幅波动。 2025 年 3 月，平均每打 12 美元达到 6.23 美元的历史新高。

paras.en: - 🧈 In September, a pound of butter averaged $3.96 — down 17.3% from last year. U.S. butter production has surged as dairy farms expanded their herds and boosted milk supply for popular items like Greek yogurt. This has resulted in an oversupply of butter.
paras.zh: - 🧈 9 月份，每磅黄油平均价格为 3.96 美元，比去年下降 17.3%。随着奶牛场扩大牛群并增加希腊酸奶等受欢迎产品的牛奶供应，美国黄油产量激增。这导致黄油供应过剩。

paras.en: - ☕ The U.S. imports 99% of the coffee it consumes. Severe weather and climate change have affected harvests, and the price of coffee is still 44% higher than it was two years earlier, despite Trump removing tariffs on the product.
paras.zh: - ☕ 美国消费的咖啡 99% 依赖进口。恶劣的天气和气候变化影响了收成，尽管特朗普取消了对该产品的关税，但咖啡的价格仍比两年前高出 44%。

paras.en: Check out what NPR is watching, reading and listening to this weekend:
paras.zh: 看看 NPR 本周末正在观看、阅读和收听的节目：

paras.en: 🍿 Movies: A new film version of Jane Austen's Sense and Sensibility focuses on the Dashwood family's two oldest sisters, Elinor and Marianne, who face financial insecurity due to laws that disadvantage widows and daughters.
paras.zh: 🍿 电影：简·奥斯汀的《理智与情感》的新电影版聚焦于达什伍德家族的两个姐姐埃莉诺和玛丽安，她们因不利于寡妇和女儿的法律而面临经济上的不稳定。

paras.en: 📺 TV: Actor Sharon Horgan stars as Alex, a 50-year-old divorcée who finds herself at multiple personal and professional crossroads in HBO's new show Youth.
paras.zh: 📺 电视剧：演员莎朗·霍根 (Sharon Horgan) 在 HBO 的新剧《青春》中饰演 50 岁的离婚者亚历克斯 (Alex)，她发现自己处于个人和职业的多重十字路口。

paras.en: 📚 Books: Barbara Trapido's Brother of the More Famous Jack follows Katherine Browne, who is determined to escape her stiflingly conventional upbringing and create a life with fewer constraints.
paras.zh: 📚 书籍：芭芭拉·特拉皮多（Barbara Trapido）的《更有名的杰克的兄弟》（Brother of the More Famous Jack）讲述了凯瑟琳·布朗（Katherine Browne）的故事，凯瑟琳·布朗决心摆脱令人窒息的传统教育，创造一种更少约束的生活。

paras.en: 🎵 Music: NPR's New Music Friday host Stephen Thompson breaks down the best albums released today, including Anderson .Paak and Cordae's Heavy Is the Crown and Fenne Lily's Win Win. Listen to a playlist of the best songs from the new albums.
paras.zh: 🎵 音乐：NPR 的《新音乐星期五》主持人 Stephen Thompson 详细分析了今天发行的最佳专辑，包括 Anderson .Paak 和 Cordae 的《Heavy Is the Crown》以及 Fenne Lily 的《Win Win》。聆听新专辑中最佳歌曲的播放列表。

paras.en: 🎭 Theater: Missy Mazzoli's music brings George Saunders' Booker Prize-winning novel, Lincoln in the Bardo, to life in a stage adaptation at the Metropolitan Opera House in New York. Mazzoli is the first woman composer to have a world premiere on the Met stage.
paras.zh: 🎭 剧院：米西·马佐利 (Missy Mazzoli) 的音乐将乔治·桑德斯 (George Saunders) 的布克奖获奖小说《林肯在中阴界》 (Lincoln in the Bardo) 搬上舞台，在纽约大都会歌剧院上演。马佐利是第一位在大都会舞台上进行世界首演的女作曲家。

paras.en: - British adventurer Karl Bushby set out from Chile with the goal of walking an unbroken path to his hometown in England. After 28 years, he has returned to the U.K. and plans to return to his mother's home in Hull by Nov. 1.
paras.zh: ——英国冒险家卡尔·布什比从智利出发，目标是沿着一条不间断的道路回到他的家乡英国。 28 年后，他回到了英国，并计划在 11 月 1 日之前返回位于赫尔的母亲家。

paras.en: - At least four Trump merchandise stores closed this year as the MAGA Mall reports sales fell 30% from his presidential election years.
paras.zh: - 今年至少有四家特朗普商品店关门，因为 MAGA Mall 报告销售额比他总统选举年下降了 30%。

paras.en: - In this week's edition of Far-Flung Postcards, NPR's Carrie Kahn recalls feeling the rare power of nature at Iguazú Falls on the Brazil-Argentina border. A rain-soaked October brought near-record water volumes crashing over the cliffs.
paras.zh: - 在本周的《遥远明信片》中，美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的凯莉·卡恩 (Carrie Kahn) 回忆起在巴西和阿根廷边境的伊瓜苏瀑布感受到的罕见的自然力量。十月的雨水浸透，导致悬崖上的水量接近创纪录的水平。

articles.title: Authorities investigating whether first Kenya and Nigeria Ebola cases crossed paths
articles.author: Kate Bartlett

paras.en: Authorities investigating whether first Kenya and Nigeria Ebola cases crossed paths
paras.zh: 当局正在调查肯尼亚和尼日利亚首例埃博拉病例是否交叉

paras.en: JOHANNESBURG – The first Ebola patient confirmed in Nigeria may have crossed paths with the first Kenyan Ebola patient at a Ugandan airport, health officials said Thursday.
paras.zh: 约翰内斯堡——卫生官员周四表示，尼日利亚确诊的首例埃博拉患者可能与乌干达机场的首例肯尼亚埃博拉患者有过接触。

paras.en: Nigeria announced its first case of Ebola in more than a decade on Tuesday. Nigerian health authorities said the patient is the Ugandan-born wife of a diplomat based in Abuja who had vacationed in Uganda in September and returned to Nigeria earlier this month.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚周二宣布十多年来首例埃博拉病例。尼日利亚卫生当局表示，该患者是一名驻阿布贾外交官在乌干达出生的妻子，她于9月在乌干达度假，并于本月初返回尼日利亚。

paras.en: She is being treated and 44 people she had close contact with have been quarantined, Dr. Wessam Mankoula, head of emergency preparedness and response at the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, told a press briefing on Thursday.
paras.zh: 非洲疾病控制与预防中心应急准备和响应负责人韦萨姆·曼库拉博士在周四的新闻发布会上表示，她正在接受治疗，与她有过密切接触的 44 人已被隔离。

paras.en: Authorities are now investigating what the source of her exposure was.
paras.zh: 当局目前正在调查她的暴露来源。

paras.en: Nigeria, Africa's most populous country, is the fourth on the continent to record an Ebola case during the current outbreak, but it's the first in West Africa and the furthest away from the epicenter in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚是非洲人口最多的国家，是本次疫情期间非洲大陆第四个出现埃博拉病例的国家，但它是西非第一个出现埃博拉病例的国家，也是距离疫情中心刚果民主共和国最远的国家。

paras.en: Congo's current Ebola outbreak began in May in the country's east. It has become the fastest spreading on record. At least 4,600 people have died and about 9,700 have been infected in Congo.
paras.zh: 刚果当前的埃博拉疫情于五月在该国东部爆发。它已成为有记录以来传播速度最快的一次。刚果至少有 4,600 人死亡，约 9,700 人感染。

paras.en: Neighboring Uganda initially recorded about 20 cases but was declared Ebola-free in August.
paras.zh: 邻国乌干达最初记录了约 20 例埃博拉病例，但于 8 月宣布已消除埃博拉病毒。

paras.en: The first case in Kenya was recorded in early October and since then eight other cases have been confirmed in the east African nation.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚于十月初记录了第一例病例，此后这个东非国家又确诊了另外八例病例。

paras.en: The first Kenyan patient, who has since died, travelled from Congo to Kenya, via Uganda.
paras.zh: 第一位肯尼亚患者从刚果经乌干达前往肯尼亚，现已死亡。

paras.en: Officials are now investigating whether that person crossed paths with the Nigeria case at the Entebbe International Airport in Uganda – as they were there on the same day.
paras.zh: 官员们目前正在调查该人是否在乌干达恩德培国际机场与尼日利亚病例有过接触——因为他们同一天也在机场。

paras.en: Dr. Mankoula said the center was probing whether there had been "some sort of interaction between the two cases at the airport."
paras.zh: 曼库拉博士说，该中心正在调查“两例病例在机场是否存在某种相互作用”。

paras.en: Ebola is spread through direct contact with an infected person's bodily fluids or contaminated items. It causes severe fever and can be deadly. However, generally people are not considered infectious until they start showing symptoms.
paras.zh: 埃博拉病毒通过直接接触感染者的体液或受污染的物品传播。它会引起严重发烧并可能致命。然而，一般来说，人们在开始出现症状之前并不被认为具有传染性。

articles.title: State Department says Trump is 'spot on' with France protests after Macron decries 'stupid' comments

paras.en: The State Department told Fox News Digital that President Donald Trump's views on France are "spot on" after French President Emmanuel Macron criticized foreign leaders for making "unacceptable and stupid comments" about the protests rocking the European country.
paras.zh: 美国国务院告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，在法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙批评外国领导人对震撼欧洲国家的抗议活动发表“不可接受和愚蠢的评论”后，唐纳德·特朗普总统对法国的看法是“正确的”。

paras.en: Speaking at a midterms rally on Monday, Trump said that "the migrants have taken over France" and that the country should close its borders following a weekend of anti-government demonstrations that evolved into rioting and looting. He added that France, a "once great nation," is "being conquered, looted and burned to the ground by migrants, jihadists and communists who hate Christianity" and "the Western civilization itself."
paras.zh: 特朗普在周一的中期集会上发表讲话时表示，“移民已经占领了法国”，在周末的反政府示威演变成骚乱和抢劫后，法国应该关闭边境。他补充说，法国这个“曾经伟大的国家”正在“被仇恨基督教和西方文明本身的移民、圣战分子和共产主义者征服、掠夺和烧毁”。

paras.en: Macron then claimed Wednesday that "there was foreign manipulation of information" following the protests, including AI-generated images that showed scenes that never happened in France, which gave way to "unacceptable and stupid comments from many people including foreign leaders." Macron said he was referring to Trump, "among others," and also mentioned, "We’ve had people claiming that we were invaded by hordes of migrants and Islamists, which is completely false," The Associated Press reported.
paras.zh: 马克龙周三声称，抗议活动后“外国操纵了信息”，其中包括人工智能生成的图像，显​​示了法国从未发生过的场景，这些图像让位于“包括外国领导人在内的许多人的不可接受和愚蠢的评论”。据美联社报道，马克龙表示，他指的是特朗普“以及其他人”，并提到，“有人声称我们遭到了大批移民和伊斯兰主义者的入侵，这完全是错误的”。

paras.en: When asked for a reaction to Macron's remarks, State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott told Fox News Digital that Trump "is on point as he is consistently on point."
paras.zh: 当被问及对马克龙言论有何反应时，国务院发言人汤米·皮戈特告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，特朗普“说得对，因为他一直都说得对”。

paras.en: "He has been clear about the dangers of mass migration for years, especially since the beginning of this administration, but certainly long beforehand as well. The president has secured the border on day one when it comes to the United States of America," Pigott said. "But we've also been clear from the State Department's perspective that we are going to oppose international institutions, for example, that seek to impose an agenda upon sovereign nations to encourage mass migration.
paras.zh: 皮戈特说：“多年来，他一直清楚大规模移民的危险，特别是自本届政府上任以来，但当然也很早就清楚了。在涉及美利坚合众国的第一天，总统就确保了边境安全。” “但从国务院的角度来看，我们也明确表示，我们将反对国际机构，例如那些寻求将议程强加给主权国家以鼓励大规模移民的国际机构。

paras.en: "Mass migration is inherently destabilizing. It is inherently destabilizing. It is something that we don't believe solves problems, but actually creates problems. And this is something the president has raised time and time again. He's raised it in reaction to these recent protests," Pigott added.
paras.zh: “大规模移民本质上是不稳定的。它本质上是不稳定的。我们认为它不能解决问题，但实际上会制造问题。这是总统一次又一次提出的问题。他提出这个问题是为了回应最近的抗议活动，”皮戈特补充道。

paras.en: "He's also raised it directly to world leaders at the U.N. General Assembly. Two years in a row raising this issue, calling for an end to the destructive policies of illegal amassed migration. Illegal amassed migration that, by the way, only helps criminal cartel groups. That's something we see in our own hemisphere, for example," Pigott continued. "The fact that cartel groups have traveled along these migration pathways. So the president is spot on, he's bringing attention to this issue, he is taking action to address this issue and, from the State Department's perspective, we have also taken concrete action to end the era of mass migration."
paras.zh: “他还在联合国大会上直接向世界领导人提出了这个问题。连续两年提出这个问题，呼吁结束非法聚集移民的破坏性政策。顺便说一句，非法聚集移民只会帮助犯罪卡特尔集团。例如，这就是我们在我们自己的半球看到的情况，”皮戈特继续说道。 “事实上，卡特尔集团已经沿着这些移民路径发展。所以总统是对的，他正在提请人们注意这个问题，他正在采取行动解决这个问题，从国务院的角度来看，我们也采取了具体行动来结束大规模移民的时代。”

paras.en: The Louvre and other major museums in Paris will be closed on Saturday as more protests are scheduled in the French capital, according to the AP. Reuters also reported that businesses in central Paris have started boarding up their windows over concerns of violence.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，由于法国首都计划举行更多抗议活动，卢浮宫和巴黎其他主要博物馆将于周六关闭。路透社还报道称，出于对暴力的担忧，巴黎市中心的企业已开始用木板封住窗户。

paras.en: French officials said more than 3,000 shops were looted, and some 2,500 people were taken into police custody in connection to last weekend's nationwide protests.
paras.zh: 法国官员表示，上周末全国范围内的抗议活动导致 3,000 多家商店遭到抢劫，约 2,500 人被警方拘留。

paras.en: "One of things that we really stress to Americans is that when they're traveling abroad, if they could please register for the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP). That program lets you tell us which countries you're going to so that we can provide real-time information to Americans in the country that have registered," Pigott told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: “我们真正向美国人强调的一件事是，当他们出国旅行时，如果他们可以注册智能旅行者注册计划（STEP）。该计划可以让你告诉我们你要去哪些国家，以便我们可以向已经注册的国家的美国人提供实时信息，”皮戈特告诉福克斯新闻数字频道。

paras.en: "Speaking generally, when it comes to Americans that need assistance, we have personnel across the world at the State Department, at embassies and consulates that are working 24/7 to help the American people. If you have an issue when you're abroad, please contact the embassy or consulate," he added. "There are people that are there to help you that can provide information. Everything from a lost passport to responses to a security situation, that is something that is hugely important and a huge factor for the State Department."
paras.zh: “一般来说，当涉及到需要援助的美国人时，我们在国务院、使馆和领事馆都有工作人员全天候（24/7）工作来帮助美国人民。如果你在国外遇到问题，请联系大使馆或领事馆，”他补充道。 “有人可以帮助你提供信息。从丢失护照到对安全局势的反应，这一切对于国务院来说都是非常重要和重要的因素。”

articles.title: The iPhone Duo is officially here — get it for no money down at T-Mobile

paras.en: The newest iPhone is now available through T-Mobile, with $0 due upfront when you bring your existing number and enroll in the Experience Beyond plan. The iPhone Duo is Apple's first foldable phone and features the company's largest display on an iPhone to date. The foldable design keeps the device slim, so it slips easily into your pocket or bag.
paras.zh: 最新款 iPhone 现已通过 T-Mobile 发售，当您携带现有号码并注册 Experience Beyond 计划时，只需预付 0 美元。 iPhone Duo 是 Apple 首款可折叠手机，拥有该公司迄今为止 iPhone 上最大的显示屏。可折叠设计使设备保持纤薄，因此可以轻松放入口袋或包中。

paras.en: What sets this iPhone apart from earlier models is the large, foldable display. The 7.6-inch display is the largest in Apple history, giving you a high-quality, larger screen to stream videos, video chat with loved ones, play games and more.
paras.zh: 这款 iPhone 与早期型号的不同之处在于其大型可折叠显示屏。 7.6 英寸显示屏是 Apple 历史上最大的显示屏，为您提供高品质、更大的屏幕来播放视频、与亲人视频聊天、玩游戏等。

paras.en: The innovative build also lets you use it in more ways than ever. In portrait mode, type on a wider keyboard and enjoy the traditional iPhone orientation with a larger display.
paras.zh: 创新的构造还让您能够以比以往更多的方式使用它。在纵向模式下，使用更宽的键盘打字并享受传统 iPhone 方向和更大的显示屏。

paras.en: When closed, it has most of the same capabilities with a handy vertical control panel. Use your apps as usual, but the compact size fits better in your pocket or handbag.
paras.zh: 当关闭时，它具有大部分相同的功能，并带有一个方便的垂直控制面板。像平常一样使用您的应用程序，但紧凑的尺寸更适合您的口袋或手提包。

paras.en: Open the iPhone Duo partly to stand it up on a flat surface for easy video viewing while multitasking. When standing on its edge, the device can display a clock, photos and other widgets.
paras.zh: 将 iPhone Duo 部分打开，将其竖立在平坦的表面上，以便在处理多任务时轻松观看视频。当站在边缘时，该设备可以显示时钟、照片和其他小部件。

paras.en: Movie lovers will quickly fall in love with the unmatched display on the iPhone Duo. In addition to being the largest display on an iPhone, it's also engineered to be the most crisp and clear, with reduced glare.
paras.zh: 电影爱好者很快就会爱上 iPhone Duo 无与伦比的显示屏。它不仅是 iPhone 上最大的显示屏，而且经过精心设计，清晰度最高，眩光更少。

paras.en: Also, the small FaceTime camera that constantly lives at the top of your screen is hidden until you need it, resulting in an uninterrupted viewing experience right from your phone.
paras.zh: 此外，一直位于屏幕顶部的小型 FaceTime 摄像头会隐藏起来，直到您需要它为止，从而直接从您的手机上获得不间断的观看体验。

paras.en: If you're always excited about the new iPhone launch for the advanced camera features, this one doesn't disappoint. Smart Take senses when everyone is ready and takes a photo automatically.
paras.zh: 如果您总是对新款 iPhone 的先进相机功能的发布感到兴奋，那么这款手机不会让您失望。 Smart Take 会感知到每个人都准备好并自动拍照。

paras.en: When fully open, the subject can see themselves on the display as you take the photo, giving them a preview and allowing them to adjust accordingly.
paras.zh: 完全打开时，拍照时拍摄对象可以在显示屏上看到自己，为他们提供预览并允许他们进行相应调整。

paras.en: In the same way, when photographing little ones, a fun graphic plays on the screen, prompting kids to look and smile at the camera.
paras.zh: 同样，当拍摄小孩子时，屏幕上会播放有趣的图形，促使孩子们看着镜头并微笑。

paras.en: And finally, when FaceTiming friends, those on both sides of the camera can see one another and join the call.
paras.zh: 最后，当 FaceTiming 好友时，摄像头两侧的人都可以看到对方并加入通话。

paras.en: Another benefit of the folding screen is the split-screen ability, which lets you view multiple apps side by side and move images and files between them as needed.
paras.zh: 折叠屏幕的另一个好处是分屏功能，它可以让您并排查看多个应用程序，并根据需要在它们之间移动图像和文件。

paras.en: This iPhone also has greater memory bandwidth and Apple's first dual-battery system, which means longer time between charges.
paras.zh: 这款 iPhone 还拥有更大​​的内存带宽和苹果首个双电池系统，这意味着充电间隔时间更长。

paras.en: Siri and Apple Intelligence are built into the iPhone Duo. They can help answer questions, brainstorm solutions, find personal photos in your collection, take action in your apps and so much more.
paras.zh: Siri 和 Apple Intelligence 内置于 iPhone Duo 中。他们可以帮助回答问题、集思广益解决方案、在您的收藏中查找个人照片、在您的应用程序中采取行动等等。

paras.en: For more deals, visit www.foxnews.com/deals
paras.zh: 欲了解更多优惠，请访问 www.foxnews.com/deals

paras.en: The iPhone Duo is available today. Buy it through T-Mobile for $0 upfront when you bring your existing number and enroll in the Experience Beyond plan. Choose from two colors: Night Sky or Star White.
paras.zh: iPhone Duo 现已上市。当您携带现有号码并加入 Experience Beyond 计划时，可通过 T-Mobile 以 0 美元预付费用。有两种颜色可供选择：夜空色或星光白。

paras.en: Also, the price will vary depending on the storage. Choose between 256 GB, 512 GB, 1 TB and 2 TB of storage.
paras.zh: 此外，价格也会根据存储情况而有所不同。存储空间有 256 GB、512 GB、1 TB 和 2 TB 可供选择。

paras.en: You can also pay in full or in monthly installments.
paras.zh: 您也可以全额付款或按月分期付款。

paras.en: New customers can switch to T-Mobile when buying the new iPhone, while existing customers can buy the iPhone Duo and add it to their phone plan.
paras.zh: 新客户在购买新 iPhone 时可以切换到 T-Mobile，而现有客户可以购买 iPhone Duo 并将其添加到手机套餐中。

articles.title: LA Times sportswriter has unhinged Shohei Ohtani take after Dodgers fall short of World Series

paras.en: Well, this might be the most insane piece of "advice" you'll ever hear directed at a Major League Baseball team.
paras.zh: 好吧，这可能是你听过的针对美国职业棒球大联盟球队的最疯狂的“建议”。

paras.en: The Los Angeles Dodgers failed to reach the World Series for the third consecutive season, getting swept by the unrelenting Milwaukee Brewers superteam. For most Dodgers fans, it was disappointing, sure, but the success of the previous two years, the big postseason moments from superstar players, and the parades through Los Angeles dampened the blow relative to other seasons.
