paras.zh: 洛杉矶道奇队连续第三个赛季未能进入世界大赛，被顽强的密尔沃基酿酒人队横扫。对于大多数道奇队球迷来说，这当然是令人失望的，但前两年的成功、超级巨星球员的季后赛重要时刻以及洛杉矶的游行相对于其他赛季减轻了打击。

paras.en: But local sports media have spent the past week searching for the explanation for LA's "failure." The actual reason the Dodgers lost, that the postseason in baseball is little more than a coin flip and small sample sizes flatten out any talent advantage, is boring and uninteresting. For example, in game four, the Brewers' expected batting average was .237, while LA's was .296. Milwaukee scored six runs, though the Dodgers scored just four – which is how we get to this week's article from Bill Plaschke at the Los Angeles Times.
paras.zh: 但当地体育媒体过去一周一直在寻找洛杉矶“失败”的原因。道奇队输掉比赛的真正原因是棒球季后赛无异于抛硬币，小样本会抹平任何人才优势，这是无聊和无趣的。例如，在第四场比赛中，酿酒人队的预期安打率为 0.237，而洛杉矶队的预期安打率为 0.296。密尔沃基队得了六分，而道奇队只得了四分——这就是我们如何获得《洛杉矶时报》比尔·普拉施克本周的文章的原因。

paras.en: His postmortem of the Dodgers' season places much of the blame on, uh, Shohei Ohtani.
paras.zh: 他对道奇队赛季的事后分析将大部分责任归咎于，呃，大谷翔平。

paras.en: There's a kernel of truth to it; Ohtani was clearly limited by several injuries down the stretch, with a lengthy slump accompanying an increase in chase rate and swing and miss. There's no way to tell how those injuries happened. Yes, Ohtani had returned to pitching full time in 2026, but LA's famously careful with Ohtani on the mound, and there's no indication that it was directly responsible for him getting hurt.
paras.zh: 它有一个核心的真理；大谷在比赛过程中显然受到了几次伤病的限制，他的长期低迷伴随着追逐率、挥杆和失误的增加。没有办法知道这些伤害是如何发生的。是的，大谷在 2026 年回归全职投手，但洛杉矶对大谷在投手丘上的谨慎是出了名的，没有迹象表明这对他受伤负有直接责任。

paras.en: But the whole team struggled offensively in October, with a .195/.267/.323 batting line and a remarkable .116 batting average with runners in scoring position. Going 5-43 with runners in scoring position isn't going to cut it, and it's a far bigger problem than just one player.
paras.zh: 但10月整支球队的进攻表现不佳，击球线为0.195/.267/.323，得分位置上的跑垒者击球率达到了惊人的0.116。在跑动者处于得分位置的情况下，取得 5 胜 43 负的成绩并不能解决问题，而且这比只有一名球员面临的问题要大得多。

paras.en: The big debate though, that Plaschke references, is whether Ohtani should continue pitching, being a two-way player, in 2027 and beyond. Ohtani and the team have already said he intends to do both next year, but Plashcke believes he knows better.
paras.zh: 不过，普拉什克提到，最大的争论是大谷是否应该在 2027 年及以后继续投球，成为一名双向球员。大谷和团队已经表示他打算明年同时进行这两件事，但普拉什克相信他更清楚。

paras.en: "...He's changing. His body is changing. His skills are changing. He's 32, with 13 seasons of professional baseball burdening his lumbering 6-foot-4 frame, and part of his game is slowly disintegrating under the weight."
paras.zh: “……他在改变。他的身体在改变。他的技能在改变。他今年 32 岁了，13 个赛季的职业棒球生涯给他那笨重的 6 英尺 4 英寸的身躯带来了沉重的负担，而他的部分比赛能力正在这种重量下慢慢瓦解。”

paras.en: "Lumbering" is an odd way to describe a player who stole 50 bases two seasons ago, but don't worry, it gets worse.
paras.zh: 用“笨拙”来形容一个两个赛季前偷了 50 个垒的球员是一种奇怪的方式，但别担心，情况会变得更糟。

paras.en: "The problem is his pitching," Plaschke continues, saying that it's "distracting him" and "exhausting him" and that "enough is enough."
paras.zh: “问题在于他的投球，”普拉施克继续说道，他说这“分散了他的注意力”，“让他精疲力尽”，“够了”。

paras.en: That's debatable, sure, but again, there's logic to it. Ohtani is such a valuable hitter that there's a case to be made for him to focus exclusively on being a DH. But what he says next has well, no logic or reason behind it whatsoever.
paras.zh: 当然，这是有争议的，但同样，它是有逻辑的。大谷是一位非常有价值的击球手，因此他有理由专注于成为一名 DH。但他接下来说的话完全没有逻辑或理由。

paras.en: "They need to pull him off the pitching mound permanently. And if he insists on continuing this detrimental charade, they need to seriously consider trading him."
paras.zh: “他们需要把他永久地从投手丘上拉下来。如果他坚持继续这种有害的游戏，他们需要认真考虑交易他。”

paras.en: Alright, well now we've officially left the world of rationality and gone into some sort of bizarre performance art trolling act. Or something. Hopefully.
paras.zh: 好吧，现在我们已经正式离开了理性的世界，进入了某种奇怪的行为艺术恶搞行为。或者什么。希望如此。

paras.en: Trading Shohei Ohtani is somewhere beyond insane. Even if he hurt his arm and required surgery to miss nine months and permanently put pitching behind him, trading him would be insane. Even if he only pitches 50-70 innings a year, that's immensely valuable combined with his hitting prowess. For context, top end relievers are making $20+ million a season to throw 60-70 innings. Ohtani's offense is worth $50-60 million a year, and even in limited usage, his pitching is worth at least the additional $20 million if not much more. With the upside of even greater value.
paras.zh: 交易 Shohei Ohtani 的行为简直是疯狂到了极点。即使他手臂受伤，需要接受手术，缺席九个月并永久放弃投球，交易他也是疯狂的。即使他每年只投 50-70 局，但结合他的击球能力，这也是非常有价值的。就背景而言，顶级中继投手每赛季投球 60-70 局的收入超过 2000 万美元。大谷的进攻每年价值 50-6000 万美元，即使在有限的使用情况下，他的投球也至少价值额外的 2000 万美元，如果不是更多的话。具有更大价值的优势。

paras.en: Then there's the fact that with Ohtani pitching in 2025, the Dodgers won the World Series. Including game three, when Ohtani hit two homers to help get the game to extra innings. Then there was game four of the 2025 NLCS, when he had arguably the single greatest performance in baseball history. Going six shutout innings with 10 strikeouts and hitting three home runs, including one that literally left Dodger Stadium.
paras.zh: 事实上，随着大谷在 2025 年投球，道奇队赢得了世界大赛。包括第三场比赛，大谷打出两个本垒打，帮助比赛进入加时赛。然后是 2025 年 NLCS 的第四场比赛，当时他可以说是棒球历史上最伟大的一场比赛。六局无胜出，10次三振，击出三支本垒打，其中一支直接离开了道奇体育场。

paras.en: Ohtani is such a transcendent star that he's worth hundreds of millions of dollars a year to Los Angeles in advertising, marketing, and promotions. His contract, even at a heavily deferred $70 million per season, is one of the biggest bargains in the sport. The extra revenue he brings in has allowed the Dodgers to go from being a top three or four spending team to being number one. The rush from the other 29 teams to acquire him would be quite literally hilarious, because trading Ohtani would be an act of financial suicide for LA and a massive windfall for a new team.
paras.zh: 大谷是一位超凡的明星，他每年在洛杉矶的广告、营销和促销方面的身价高达数亿美元。他的合同即使是每赛季 7000 万美元的延期合同，也是这项运动中最划算的合同之一。他带来的额外收入使道奇队从支出前三、四的球队跃升至第一。其他 29 支球队争先恐后地收购他确实会很搞笑，因为交易大谷对洛杉矶来说无异于财务自杀，而对新球队来说则是一笔巨额意外之财。

paras.en: Plashcke is frequently not a serious person, but this is enough to warrant serious questioning of his ability to continue writing about baseball for a "legitimate" newspaper. The LA Times should ask him to focus on his one true love; left-wing politics. Clearly, his attempt to try to do both is hurting both himself, and the paper, and should lead to some very serious conversations between the two sides.
paras.zh: 普拉什克通常不是一个严肃的人，但这足以让人严重质疑他是否有能力继续为一份“合法”报纸撰写有关棒球的文章。 《洛杉矶时报》应该要求他专注于他的真爱；左翼政治。显然，他试图同时做到这两点的尝试正在伤害他自己和报纸，并且应该导致双方之间进行一些非常严肃的对话。

articles.title: Opposition deepfake video sparks outrage in Spain ahead of election
articles.author: Ashifa Kassam in Madrid

paras.en: A political ad from Spain’s main opposition party that used a deepfake video of the prime minister’s wife has sparked outrage and set off a wider debate on AI, as the deeply polarised country gears up for general elections next month.
paras.zh: 西班牙主要反对党的一则政治广告使用了首相妻子的深度伪造视频，引发了愤怒，并引发了关于人工智能的更广泛辩论，因为这个两极分化严重的国家正在为下个月的大选做准备。

paras.en: Launched this week across the social media channels of the conservative People’s party (PP), the video used artificial intelligence to manipulate the likenesses of various people linked to Pedro Sánchez’s Socialist party and appeared to show them admitting to acts such as soliciting prostitutes and taking kickbacks.
paras.zh: 该视频于本周在保守的人民党（PP）的社交媒体渠道上发布，使用人工智能来操纵与佩德罗·桑切斯的社会党有关的各种人的肖像，并似乎显示他们承认招妓和收受回扣等行为。

paras.en: An AI-generated version of Sánchez’s wife, Begoña Gómez, for example, speaks about receiving a university post thanks to her husband’s job, while a deepfake of the former Socialist president José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero speaks about hiding jewellery in a safe. Both lines are nods to ongoing investigations in which Gómez and Zapatero have denied any wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 例如，人工智能生成的桑切斯妻子贝戈尼亚·戈麦斯谈到了由于丈夫的工作而获得大学职位，而前社会党总统何塞·路易斯·罗德里格斯·萨帕特罗的深度伪造版本谈到了将珠宝藏在保险箱中。这两句话都是对正在进行的调查的认可，戈麦斯和萨帕特罗否认有任何不当行为。

paras.en: The Socialist party was swift to respond to the video, which by Friday had racked up nearly 2m views. “It’s telling people a colossal lie, and for a party to do it on its official accounts seems intolerable to me,” Óscar López, Spain’s digital transformation minister, told the broadcaster TVE on Friday.
paras.zh: 社会党迅速对这段视频做出了回应，截至周五，该视频的观看次数已接近 200 万。西班牙数字化转型部长奥斯卡·洛佩斯 (Óscar López) 周五对 TVE 广播公司表示：“这对人们撒了一个弥天大谎，一个政党在其官方账户上这样做似乎无法容忍。”

paras.en: While the video noted at the bottom – in tiny, nearly transparent font – that it had been created with AI, López pointed to the wider risk. “It’s very easy for anyone who isn’t used to AI to confuse that video with reality,” he said. “And call me crazy, but that seems extremely serious to me.”
paras.zh: 虽然视频底部以微小、几乎透明的字体指出它是用人工智能创建的，但洛佩兹指出了更广泛的风险。 “对于任何不习惯人工智能的人来说，很容易将视频与现实混淆，”他说。 “你可以说我疯了，但这对我来说似乎非常严重。”

paras.en: On Friday, one of those whose likeness was used in the video filed a legal challenge against the PP, calling on the party to immediately take down the campaign advert. In a court complaint, Leire Díez, a former Socialist party member, reportedly accused the PP of defamation and digital identity theft, after the video used her likeness to hint at accusations that she worked to undermine judicial and law enforcement in order to help the Socialists.
paras.zh: 周五，其中一位在视频中使用肖像的人对人民党提出了法律挑战，呼吁该党立即撤下竞选广告。据报道，前社会党党员莱尔·迪亚斯在一份法庭起诉书中指控人民党诽谤和盗窃数字身份，因为该视频使用了她的肖像来暗示对她为了帮助社会党而破坏司法和执法的指控。

paras.en: A majority of the nine legal experts consulted by the newspaper El País concurred that what the PP had done was not illegal, given that the video was labelled as AI-generated and that the overall tone was one of political satire. “Given the context, everyone knows those people didn’t say those things,” Íñigo Navarro, a former dean of the faculty of law at Madrid’s Comillas Pontifical University, told the paper.
paras.zh: 《国家报》咨询的九名法律专家中的大多数人都认为，人民党的做法并不违法，因为该视频被标记为人工智能生成，而且整体基调是政治讽刺。马德里科米利亚斯天主教大学前法学院院长伊尼戈·纳瓦罗对该报表示：“考虑到当时的背景，每个人都知道那些人并没有说过这些话。”

paras.en: But the legality of the video was just one aspect, said Juan Antonio Lascuraín, a professor of criminal law at the Autonomous University of Madrid. “It’s quite another matter to ask whether it’s appropriate, exemplary or ethically and politically correct.”
paras.zh: 但马德里自治大学刑法教授胡安·安东尼奥·拉斯库林表示，该视频的合法性只是一方面。 “要问它是否合适、是否具有示范意义，或者在道德和政治上是否正确，那就是另一回事了。”

paras.en: Many sought to contextualise the videos within the wider effort – under way by officials across much of the world – to crack down on the impact of disinformation.
paras.zh: 许多人试图将这些视频融入到世界各地官员正在开展的更广泛的努力中，以打击虚假信息的影响。

paras.en: “It’s truly regrettable that the official account of a party that claims to want to govern and revitalise democracy is using AI-generated deepfakes in its campaign,” said José Javier Olivas, an associate professor who researches populism, conspiracy theories and AI biases at Spain’s National University for Distance Education.
paras.zh: 西班牙国立远程教育大学研究民粹主义、阴谋论和人工智能偏见的副教授何塞·哈维尔·奥利瓦斯 (José Javier Olivas) 表示：“一个声称想要治理和重振民主的政党的官方账户在其竞选活动中使用人工智能生成的深度伪造品，这确实令人遗憾。”

paras.en: He pointed to the wider backdrop of the election campaign, in which both mainstream parties have sought to rally voters by stoking emotions and attacking the morality of their rivals, but he said the video was a “red line” in terms of how campaigns normally unfolded.
paras.zh: 他指出了竞选活动的更广泛背景，其中两个主流政党都试图通过煽动情绪和攻击竞争对手的道德来团结选民，但他表示，就竞选活动通常展开的方式而言，这段视频是一条“红线”。

paras.en: “You’re using the images of other people, putting words in their mouths that they’re not saying, [and] this qualifies for disinformation,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“你使用了其他人的图像，把他们没有说的话放到他们嘴里，这属于虚假信息。”

paras.en: The use of AI to generate or enhance political ads has also become a talking point in the US ahead of next month’s midterm elections. A recent report by a research group based at Wesleyan University in Connecticut identified more than 200 such ads, the vast majority of them tied to the Republicans.
paras.zh: 在下个月的中期选举之前，使用人工智能生成或增强政治广告也成为美国的一个话题。康涅狄格州卫斯理大学的一个研究小组最近发布的一份报告发现了 200 多个此类广告，其中绝大多数与共和党有关。

paras.en: “AI is making its way into the 2026 midterms in a big way this year,” said Erika Franklin Fowler, a co-director of the Wesleyan Media Project. “For comparison, we identified less than $50,000 in spending on AI-generated ads in the 2024 cycle. Much of the AI use is not disclosed through any type of disclaimer.”
paras.zh: 卫斯理媒体项目联合主任埃里卡·富兰克林·福勒 (Erika Franklin Fowler) 表示：“人工智能今年将大规模进入 2026 年中期选举。” “作为比较，我们发现 2024 年周期中人工智能生成的广告支出不到 50,000 美元。人工智能的大部分使用都没有通过任何类型的免责声明披露。”

paras.en: In Spain, the PP has brushed off criticism. “If there had been malicious intent to make people believe that the characters who appear there are real, then we’d have a problem,” Borja Sémper, of the party, told reporters. “But everyone can see that this is a way of using digital tools to highlight the hypocrisy in which the Socialist party operates.”
paras.zh: 在西班牙，人民党不理睬批评。该党的博尔哈·森佩尔 (Borja Sémper) 告诉记者：“如果有人恶意让人们相信出现在那里的人物是真实的，那么我们就会遇到问题。” “但每个人都可以看到，这是利用数字工具来凸显社会党运作的虚伪性的一种方式。”

paras.en: Most polls suggest the PP will win the 29 November general election but will need to rely on the support of the far-right Vox party to form a government.
paras.zh: 大多数民意调查显示，人民党将赢得 11 月 29 日的大选，但需要依靠极右翼 Vox 党的支持来组建政府。

articles.title: Oil price rises above $117 a barrel amid fears US will renew strikes on Iran
articles.author: Lauren Almeida

paras.en: Oil has hit its highest level in more than six months as fears of fresh escalation in the Middle East conflict grip the energy markets.
paras.zh: 由于对中东冲突新升级的担忧笼罩能源市场，油价已触及六个多月以来的最高水平。

paras.en: Brent crude, the international benchmark for oil, rose by about 3.5% on Friday to pass $117 a barrel at one point – its highest level since April.
paras.zh: 国际石油基准布伦特原油周五上涨约 3.5%，一度突破每桶 117 美元，为 4 月份以来的最高水平。

paras.en: The jump came after Tehran said it would attack oil facilities, undersea cables, datacentres and AI facilities in the Gulf region if a new US-Israeli offensive was launched against Iran.
paras.zh: 此前，德黑兰表示，如果美以对伊朗发动新的攻势，它将攻击海湾地区的石油设施、海底电缆、数据中心和人工智能设施。

paras.en: Richard Hunter, of the broker Interactive Investor, said: “Widespread reports that the US is considering renewed military strikes on Iran after the midterm elections rather than pursuing a diplomatic route was enough for the price to pop, after what many had considered would be a brief conflict is now in its eighth month.”
paras.zh: 经纪商Interactive Investor的理查德·亨特(Richard Hunter)表示：“广泛报道称，美国正在考虑在中期选举后对伊朗重新发动军事打击，而不是采取外交途径，这足以导致价格上涨，此前许多人认为这是一场短暂的冲突，现在已经进入第八个月了。”

paras.en: The oil price later eased back slight to sit about 2.7% up at just over $116 a barrel. Brent crude had traded at about $72 a barrel back in February, before the Iran war began, but soared to touch $126 a barrel by the end of April.
paras.zh: 油价随后小幅回落，上涨约 2.7%，至每桶略高于 116 美元。 2月份伊朗战争爆发前，布伦特原油价格约为每桶72美元，但到4月底飙升至每桶126美元。

paras.en: Tensions in the region have been rising this week and Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps claimed to have struck four commercial ships in the strait of Hormuz on Wednesday. The US state department ordered some diplomats and the families of US government employees to leave Saudi Arabia, which has faced continued attacks from Houthi rebels in Yemen.
paras.zh: 本周该地区的紧张局势不断升级，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队声称周三在霍尔木兹海峡袭击了四艘商船。美国国务院命令一些外交官和美国政府雇员的家属离开沙特阿拉伯，该国面临也门胡塞叛军的持续袭击。

paras.en: Susannah Streeter, the chief investment strategist at the broker Wealth Club, said fears were rising that American and Israeli forces would be ordered to launch strikes on Iran’s energy infrastructure after the US elections on 3 November.
paras.zh: 经纪商Wealth Club首席投资策略师苏珊娜·斯特里特(Susannah Streeter)表示，人们越来越担心美国和以色列军队将在11月3日美国大选后奉命对伊朗能源基础设施发动袭击。

paras.en: She added: “At the same time, the attacks on Saudi Arabia’s facilities by Houthi rebels have intensified this week, and for ships attempting to cross the strait of Hormuz, it’s still a dangerous journey, with projectiles still being fired.”
paras.zh: 她补充道：“与此同时，胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯设施的袭击本周有所加剧，对于试图穿越霍尔木兹海峡的船只来说，这仍然是一段危险的旅程，仍然会发射炮弹。”

paras.en: Streeter said Ukraine’s bombardment of Russian diesel refineries was also adding to supply concerns.
paras.zh: 斯特里特表示，乌克兰对俄罗斯柴油炼油厂的轰炸也加剧了供应担忧。

articles.title: Melania Trump has helped broker ceasefire in Russian-occupied Ukrainian town, says White House – Europe live
articles.author: Lucy Campbell (now); Frances Mao and Martin Belam (earlier)

paras.en: Melania Trump helps broker ceasefire in Russian-occupied town where residents were starving to death
paras.zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普帮助斡旋俄罗斯占领小镇停火，那里的居民都快饿死了

paras.en: The White House has issued a statement saying Melania Trump has helped broker a ‘ceasefire’ in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, where residents have been enduring a worsening humanitarian crisis due to the lack of food, electricity and other resources.
paras.zh: 白宫发表声明称，梅拉尼娅·特朗普帮助促成了俄罗斯占领的奥列什基市的“停火”，该市居民因缺乏食品、电力和其他资源而承受着日益恶化的人道主义危机。

paras.en: The small town in southern Kherson has been the centre of an increasingly desperate humanitarian crisis under Russian occupation.
paras.zh: 赫尔松南部的这个小镇在俄罗斯占领下一直是日益严重的人道主义危机的中心。

paras.en: Since May, Russia has failed to deliver food, medicine or other essential goods to the area leading to deaths from starvation and disease. There has also been problems with the burial of bodies and sanitation, as the local morgue has been destroyed and there is no running water.
paras.zh: 自五月以来，俄罗斯未能向该地区运送食品、药品或其他必需品，导致该地区因饥饿和疾病而死亡。尸体埋葬和卫生设施也存在问题，因为当地太平间已被毁坏，而且没有自来水。

paras.en: Russia and Ukraine have accused the other of blocking supplies to the population of the town which Ukrainian forces want to retake.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰指责对方阻止向乌克兰军队想要夺回的该镇居民提供物资。

paras.en: Ukraine has previously appealed for a ceasefire to evacuate the estimated 2,000 civilians left in the town – but Russia hadn’t made any commitments.
paras.zh: 乌克兰此前曾呼吁停火，以疏散该镇约 2000 名平民，但俄罗斯尚未做出任何承诺。

paras.en: Earlier this week, Pope Leo called for an intervention while the Kremlin said Putin had discussed the situation with Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，教皇利奥呼吁进行干预，而克里姆林宫则表示普京已与唐纳德·特朗普讨论了这一情况。

paras.en: The White House now say both countries have agreed to pause military action “to allow for humanitarian aid to enter and to prepare a civilian evacuation through a designated safe passageway. A ceasefire is set to come into effect on 29 October.
paras.zh: 白宫现在表示，两国已同意暂停军事行动，“以允许人道主义援助进入并准备通过指定的安全通道撤离平民。停火定于 10 月 29 日生效。”

paras.en: “The situation in Oleshky is dire. Oleshky is a front-line war city on the brink of disaster. Oleshky’s remaining population is comprised primarily of elderly residents who urgently need medical attention, medicine, food, and clean water,” Melania Trump said in the statement.
paras.zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普在声明中表示，“奥列什基的情况非常严峻。奥列什基是一座处于灾难边缘的前线战争城市。奥列什基的剩余人口主要由老年居民组成，他们迫切需要医疗护理、药品、食物和清洁水。”

paras.en: “It was abundantly clear that without my intervention, the possibility to bring humanitarian aid into the city and to evacuate the elderly would be impossible,” she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“很明显，如果没有我的干预，就不可能将人道主义援助带入该市并疏散老年人。”

paras.en: There is no comment from Moscow or Ukraine yet. The Guardian’s international correspondents are looking into the statement and attempting to corroborate it with their sources.
paras.zh: 莫斯科或乌克兰尚未发表评论。 《卫报》的国际记者正在调查该声明，并试图与他们的消息来源证实它。

paras.en: Earlier on Friday, Emmanuel Macron met directly with around 20 student representatives for the first time since protests began a month ago, as his government prepares for further demonstrations over the weekend.
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙(Emmanuel Macron)自一个月前抗议活动开始以来首次直接会见了约20名学生代表，同时他的政府正在为周末的进一步示威活动做准备。

paras.en: Macron promised an overhaul of France’s much-criticised university admissions system Parcoursup, student groups said after the meeting at the presidential palace, according to France24.
paras.zh: 据 France24 报道，学生团体在总统府会议后表示，马克龙承诺对法国饱受批评的大学招生系统 Parcoursup 进行彻底改革。

paras.en: The French president is now in Trappes, where he will speak this evening alongside the mayor, “to express his solidarity with all those mobilized following today’s racist terrorist attack,” the Élysée Palace said.
paras.zh: 爱丽舍宫表示，法国总统目前正在特拉普，今晚他将与市长一起发表讲话，“向所有在今天的种族主义恐怖袭击后动员起来的人们表示声援”。

paras.en: Russian army chief says Oleshky ceasefire will begin on Tuesday morning
paras.zh: 俄罗斯陆军参谋长表示奥列什基停火将于周二上午开始

paras.en: A ceasefire aimed at providing humanitarian aid to the ravaged Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky will begin in the early hours of Tuesday, Russia’s army chief has said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯陆军参谋长表示，旨在向遭受破坏的俄罗斯占领的乌克兰城市奥列什基提供人道主义援助的停火将于周二凌晨开始。

paras.en: “The Russian army are ceasing fire in the Kherson sector and entering a regime of silence from 4am Moscow time on October 27,” army chief Valery Gerasimov was quoted as saying on Friday by the Russian defence ministry, AFP reports.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，俄罗斯国防部周五援引陆军参谋长瓦列里·格拉西莫夫的话说：“俄罗斯军队将于 10 月 27 日莫斯科时间凌晨 4 点起在赫尔松地区停火，并进入沉默状态。”

paras.en: The White House said earlier that the ceasefire would begin on 29 October. I’ll bring you more clarity on the timings of the truce as we get it.
paras.zh: 白宫早些时候表示，停火将于 10 月 29 日开始。当我们得到消息时，我会更清楚地告诉你们休战的时间。

paras.en: European leaders gather in Budapest for anniversary of Hungarian revolution as Magyar resets EU ties
paras.zh: 马扎尔重置欧盟关系，欧洲领导人齐聚布达佩斯庆祝匈牙利革命周年

paras.en: In other news, guests representing countries across Europe visited Hungary’s capital on Friday to take part in an event commemorating the 70th anniversary of the 1956 anti-Soviet uprising — and to signal a new chapter in their countries’ relations with Budapest after this year’s ousting of former prime minister Viktor Orbán.
paras.zh: 其他新闻方面，代表欧洲各国的嘉宾周五访问了匈牙利首都，参加纪念 1956 年反苏起义 70 周年的活动，并标志着今年前总理欧尔班·维克托 (Viktor Orbán) 下台后，欧洲各国与布达佩斯的关系翻开了新篇章。

paras.en: The visiting dignitaries - including European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen and president of the European Council AntónioCosta - were in Budapest at the invitation of prime minister Péter Magyar, who has spent his first months in office rebuilding Hungary’s ties with Europe that had unraveled under his predecessor.
paras.zh: 来访的政要——包括欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩和欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔——是应总理彼得·马扎尔的邀请来到布达佩斯的。马扎尔在上任的头几个月里致力于重建在前任领导下破裂的匈牙利与欧洲的关系。

paras.en: Addressing tens of thousands of people in Kossuth Square beside Parliament, Magyar praised the bravery of Hungarians who rose up against Soviet oppression in 1956 and “gave their lives for a democratic and independent Hungary.”
paras.zh: 马扎尔在议会旁的科苏特广场向数万人发表讲话，赞扬了 1956 年奋起反抗苏联压迫的匈牙利人的勇敢，并“为民主和独立的匈牙利献出了生命”。

paras.en: He said he wanted Hungary to be a “reliable ally” after the Orbán era:
paras.zh: 他表示，他希望匈牙利在欧尔班时代之后成为“可靠的盟友”：

paras.en: Since 1956, every Hungarian leader, and I repeat every Hungarian leader, must know that his power can never be more important than the freedom of his country.
paras.zh: 自1956年以来，每一位匈牙利领导人，我再说一遍，每一位匈牙利领导人都必须知道，他的权力永远不会比他国家的自由更重要。

paras.en: Hungary is not a country that can drift forever between east and west. In 1956, the Hungarians made a clear choice: We belong to a free and democratic Europe.
paras.zh: 匈牙利并不是一个可以永远在东西方之间漂泊的国家。 1956年，匈牙利人做出了明确的选择：我们属于自由民主的欧洲。

paras.en: We want to be reliable allies who sit at the shared table with our heads held high, not fortune-seekers who isolate themselves through blackmail and pursuing a separate path.
paras.zh: 我们希望成为坐在一起、昂首挺胸的可靠盟友，而不是通过勒索孤立自己、另辟蹊径的求财者。

paras.en: Earlier on Friday, Magyar placed flowers at the graveside of Hungarians who were killed during the popular 1956 uprising that began with a students’ march in Budapest on 23 October and spread across the country.
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，马扎尔在 1956 年民众起义中丧生的匈牙利人的墓地敬献了鲜花，这场起义始于 10 月 23 日布达佩斯的学生游行，随后蔓延到全国。

paras.en: Later, he oversaw a ceremonial raising of Hungary’s flag on Kossuth Square beside Parliament, accompanied by President András Baka and speaker of the national assembly Ágnes Forsthoffer.
paras.zh: 随后，他在总统安德拉斯·巴卡和国民议会议长阿格尼丝·福斯托弗的陪同下，在议会旁边的科苏特广场主持了匈牙利国旗的升旗仪式。

paras.en: Von der Leyen, the head of the EU’s executive Commission, was expected to deliver a speech alongside Magyar later in the day. She and other foreign dignitaries were scheduled to take part in a formal commemoration in the Parliament and attend a gala performance in the National Opera.
paras.zh: 欧盟执行委员会主席冯德莱恩预计将于当天晚些时候与马扎尔一起发表讲话。她和其他外国政要原计划参加议会举行的正式纪念活动，并出席国家歌剧院的晚会演出。

paras.en: Despite the White House’s claim the Oleshky ceasefire had been brokered by Melania Trump, there had already been protracted efforts to organise a humanitarian ceasefire, with claims by Ukrainian officials that it had been Russia that had rejected previous calls.
paras.zh: 尽管白宫声称奥列什基停火是由梅拉尼娅·特朗普斡旋的，但组织人道主义停火已经进行了旷日持久的努力，乌克兰官员声称是俄罗斯拒绝了之前的呼吁。

paras.en: Calls for a ceasefire had been issued by Pope Leo XIV – who discussed the issue with the Ukrainian president, VolodymyrZelenskyy – the United Nations, EU officials and the Council of Europe. As recently as 18 October, Ukraine’s ombudsman, Dmytro Lubinets, had also said he thought agreement was close without any mention of the first lady’s involvement.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世呼吁停火，他与乌克兰总统泽连斯基、联合国、欧盟官员和欧洲委员会讨论了这一问题。就在 10 月 18 日，乌克兰监察员德米特罗·鲁宾涅茨 (Dmytro Lubinets) 还表示，他认为协议已接近达成，但并未提及第一夫人的参与。

paras.en: Ukraine has for weeks been pushing for a civilian evacuation from Oleshky and nearby settlements, at times using drones to airdrop emergency food and medical supplies into town.
paras.zh: 几周来，乌克兰一直在推动奥列什基和附近定居点的平民撤离，有时使用无人机向城镇空投紧急食品和医疗用品。

paras.en: Suspect arrested after shooting in Paris suburb that is considered a 'terrorist crime'
paras.zh: 巴黎郊区发生枪击事件，嫌疑人被捕，被视为“恐怖犯罪”

paras.en: A suspect has been arrested and taken into police custody after a gunman fired from a vehicle in a Paris suburb on Friday, killing one person and wounded several others, including a 12-year-old girl, in a “deadly rampage” that French authorities suspect may have been a “racist, likely Islamophobic” attack.
paras.zh: 周五，一名枪手在巴黎郊区的一辆汽车上开枪，造成一人死亡、包括一名 12 岁女孩在内的多人受伤，一名嫌疑人已被逮捕并被警方拘留，法国当局怀疑这起“致命暴行”可能是一次“种族主义，可能是伊斯兰恐惧症”袭击。

paras.en: France’s National Anti-Terrorism Prosecutor’s office took charge of the case and interior minister Laurent Nuñez spoke of a “terrorist crime.”
paras.zh: 法国国家反恐检察官办公室负责此案，内政部长洛朗·努涅斯称这是“恐怖主义犯罪”。

paras.en: The shootings happened at three separate locations in the towns of Trappes and La Verrière, near Paris, and took less than 15 minutes in total, Nuñez said.
paras.zh: 努涅斯说，枪击事件发生在巴黎附近的特拉普镇和拉韦里埃尔镇的三个不同地点，总共持续了不到 15 分钟。

paras.en: “A deadly rampage took place this morning,” he told reporters in Trappes. According to Nuñez, the attacker fatally shot one person and wounded five others, three of them very seriously, with their lives in danger.
paras.zh: “今天早上发生了一场致命的暴乱，”他在特拉普告诉记者。据努涅斯称，袭击者开枪打死一人，打伤五人，其中三人伤势严重，有生命危险。

paras.en: Nuñez said the attack was considered a “terrorist crime” by prosecutors, with a possible racist motive.
paras.zh: 努涅斯表示，检察官认为这次袭击是“恐怖犯罪”，可能具有种族主义动机。

paras.en: Aurore Bergé, the minister for gender equality and fight against discriminations, said the 12-year-old girl was very seriously injured.
paras.zh: 性别平等和反歧视部长奥罗尔·贝尔热 (Aurore Bergé) 表示，这名 12 岁女孩伤势非常严重。

paras.en: As quoted by the Associated Press, she added:
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，她补充道：

paras.en: If a racist motive is established, I hope that the whole nation will stand alongside the residents of Trappes, La Verrière, and the victims. We cannot tolerate even the slightest racist remark in the French Republic.
paras.zh: 如果种族主义动机成立，我希望全国人民与特拉普斯、拉维里埃的居民和受害者站在一起。我们不能容忍法兰西共和国哪怕是最轻微的种族主义言论。

paras.en: Nuñez said the suspect fired “what appears to have been a military-grade weapon, or at least an automatic weapon.”
paras.zh: 努涅斯说，嫌疑人发射了“似乎是军用级武器，或者至少是自动武器”。

paras.en: Trappes mayor Ali Rabeh said earlier that the gunman appeared to have fired relatively randomly, targeting passersby at several locations including a playground.
paras.zh: 特拉普市市长阿里·拉贝早些时候表示，枪手似乎是相对随机地开枪，在包括游乐场在内的多个地点瞄准路人。

paras.en: This is probably one of the first attempted mass killings motivated by Islamophobia and racism. This was a terrorist attack with racist, likely Islamophobic, overtones.
paras.zh: 这可能是由伊斯兰恐惧症和种族主义引发的首次大规模屠杀企图之一。这是一起带有种族主义甚至仇视伊斯兰色彩的恐怖袭击。

paras.en: Rabeh previously said the person killed was of African origin, while one of those critically wounded was of North African origin.
paras.zh: 拉贝此前表示，死者是非洲裔，其中一名重伤者是北非裔。

paras.en: France’s National Anti-Terrorism Prosecutor’s office said it opened a criminal investigation into several offences, including “murder in connection with a terrorist enterprise with the aggravating circumstance that the act was committed on account of the victim’s actual or perceived membership of a particular race, ethnic group, nationality or religion.”
paras.zh: 法国国家反恐检察官办公室表示，已对多项罪行展开刑事调查，其中包括“与恐怖主义企业有关的谋杀，且情节严重的是，该行为是因为受害者实际或被认为属于特定种族、族裔群体、国籍或宗教而实施的。”

paras.en: Trump says he will talk to Musk if Ukraine's Starlink not fixed
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，如果乌克兰星链无法修复，他将与马斯克交谈

paras.en: Further detail on that now with Donald Trump saying that he would speak to Elon Musk if there are still problems with Ukraine’s military-grade version of the Starlink service.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，如果乌克兰军用级版本的星链服务仍然存在问题，他将与埃隆·马斯克交谈，进一步详细说明这一点。

paras.en: “If there is a problem, I will get it straightened out,” Trump told reporters at the White House after Ukraine said it was still having problems with the Starshield communications platform.
paras.zh: 在乌克兰表示星盾通信平台仍存在问题后，特朗普在白宫对记者表示：“如果出现问题，我会解决它。”

paras.en: Asked if he had contacted Musk to restore access, Trump replied: “I have not spoken to him. I might have to, but I have not. I’ve heard it was fixed, but if it’s not, I’ll speak to him.”
paras.zh: 当被问及是否已联系马斯克以恢复访问权限时，特朗普回答道：“我还没有与他交谈。我可能必须这样做，但我没有。我听说它已经修复了，但如果没有，我会与他交谈。”

paras.en: As we’ve been reporting, it comes after Trump had said on Thursday that Musk, whose SpaceX is behind the Starshield system, had restored access.
paras.zh: 正如我们一直报道的那样，特朗普周四表示，星盾系统背后的 SpaceX 公司已经恢复了访问权限。

paras.en: The US president on Friday also rejected suggestions that Musk had too much power over a system that is vital for Ukraine’s fight against Russia’s invasion, now in its fifth year.
paras.zh: 美国总统周五还驳斥了有关马斯克对乌克兰对抗俄罗斯入侵至关重要的系统拥有过多权力的说法，该系统现已进入第五个年头。

paras.en: “I don’t think he does,” Trump said. “Elon will never do anything wrong. I know him very well, he is a fair person.”
paras.zh: “我认为他不会，”特朗普说。 “埃隆永远不会做错事。我很了解他，他是一个公平的人。”

paras.en: Trump has had a complicated relationship with Musk, who led the (supposedly) cost-cutting Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) last year before an almighty falling out last year. The pair appear to have made up again in recent months.
paras.zh: 特朗普与马斯克的关系很复杂，马斯克去年领导了（据称）削减成本的政府效率部（DOGE），但去年却发生了彻底的争吵。近几个月来，两人似乎又和好了。

paras.en: Further to that, Donald Trump was just asked by a reporter at the White House if he was aware of who ordered the Starlink access in Ukraine to be restricted.
paras.zh: 此外，白宫的一名记者刚刚询问唐纳德·特朗普是否知道是谁下令限制星链在乌克兰的访问。

paras.en: Well, I wouldn’t tell you if I did know. I have no idea. But I wouldn’t tell you if I did know.
paras.zh: 好吧，如果我知道的话我也不会告诉你。我不知道。但即使我知道，我也不会告诉你。

paras.en: He also said that he had not spoken to Elon Musk regarding the issue, but suggested he would do so if the access wasn’t fixed.
paras.zh: 他还表示，他尚未与埃隆·马斯克讨论过这个问题，但表示如果访问权限未修复，他会这样做。

paras.en: Ukrainian forces continue to report widespread disruptions to the Starlink satellite network, despite Donald Trump’s claim that Elon Musk had lifted restrictions on the service.
paras.zh: 尽管唐纳德·特朗普声称埃隆·马斯克已经取消了对该服务的限制，但乌克兰军队继续报告星链卫星网络出现大范围中断。

paras.en: The slowdown, which has affected the key communications system used by Ukrainian troops, began last week after Trump and Starlink founder Musk publicly criticised Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, over continued strikes on Russian oil refineries.
paras.zh: 上周，特朗普和星链创始人马斯克公开批评乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)持续袭击俄罗斯炼油厂后，乌克兰军队使用的关键通信系统受到了影响。

paras.en: The restrictions have raised questions and confusion about who ordered the slowdown and why, with both Trump and Musk denying responsibility.
paras.zh: 这些限制引发了人们对谁下令减速以及原因的疑问和困惑，特朗普和马斯克都否认负有责任。

paras.en: “I don’t comment one way or the other,” Trump said on Thursday when asked about reports that he had personally called Musk to demand the restrictions be lifted.
paras.zh: 周四，当被问及有关他亲自致电马斯克要求取消限制的报道时，特朗普表示：“我不会以任何方式发表评论。”

paras.en: But Ukrainian officials said on Friday morning that speeds remained capped at about 100mph, with no indication that the restrictions had been lifted.
paras.zh: 但乌克兰官员周五上午表示，车速仍限制在 100 英里/小时左右，没有迹象表明限制已被取消。

paras.en: “At present, we have not observed any lifting of the restrictions on Starlink,” said Serhii Beskrestnov, a military expert who advises Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: “目前，我们还没有观察到对星链的限制有任何解除，”泽伦斯基顾问的军事专家谢尔希·别斯克雷斯诺夫(Serhii Beskrestnov)说。

paras.en: “There have been isolated cases in which Starlink has operated at speeds slightly above the imposed limits, but this is likely due to SpaceX’s algorithms or specific conditions of use, rather than any lifting of the restrictions,” Beskrestnov added.
paras.zh: Beskrestnov 补充道：“在个别情况下，Starlink 的运行速度略高于规定的限制，但这可能是由于 SpaceX 的算法或特定的使用条件，而不是任何限制的解除。”

paras.en: The speed restrictions have prevented Ukrainian military equipment, including drones, from maintaining a connection to the satellite network when travelling at high speeds, hampering both offensive drone operations and efforts to intercept incoming Russian attacks.
paras.zh: 速度限制导致包括无人机在内的乌克兰军事装备在高速飞行时无法保持与卫星网络的连接，从而阻碍了无人机的进攻行动和拦截俄罗斯袭击的努力。

paras.en: The slowing down of Starlink, coupled with Zelenskyy’s complaints that Washington had temporarily suspended intelligence-sharing with Kyiv, have plunged relations between Ukraine and the US to a new low in recent days.
paras.zh: 星链计划的放缓，加上泽连斯基抱怨华盛顿暂时中止与基辅的情报共享，导致乌克兰和美国之间的关系最近几天跌至新低。

paras.en: For more on this, my colleague Jonathan Yerushalmy has this explainer on the Starlink row:
paras.zh: 有关这方面的更多信息，我的同事 Jonathan Yerushalmy 在 Starlink 行上有这样的解释：

paras.en: Kremlin confirms Oleshky ceasefire and says working with Ukraine on evacuation timing
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫确认奥列什基停火，并表示与乌克兰合作确定撤离时间

paras.en: And word now from the Kremlin which, in step with the White House, hails Melania Trump’s “significant contribution” in helping broker the ceasefire in Oleshky. (Kyiv also noted her role, along with that of the Pope).
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫现在与白宫一致赞扬梅拉尼娅·特朗普在帮助促成奥列什基停火方面做出的“重大贡献”。 （基辅也指出了她的角色以及教皇的角色）。

paras.en: Confirming that a US-brokered local ceasefire agreement had been struck regarding the Russian-controlled town, the Kremlin has said that the Russian and Ukrainian militaries were working to determine the dates for implementing it.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫证实，在美国斡旋下就俄罗斯控制的城镇达成了当地停火协议，并表示俄罗斯和乌克兰军方正在努力确定实施该协议的日期。

paras.en: The White House said earlier that the ceasefire would begin on 29 October.
paras.zh: 白宫早些时候表示，停火将于 10 月 29 日开始。

paras.en: As reported by Reuters, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters on Friday that all civilians wishing to leave Oleshky would be allowed to do so and that the evacuation operation itself was expected to take at least several days.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫周五告诉记者，所有希望离开奥列什基的平民都将被允许这样做，疏散行动本身预计至少需要几天时间。

paras.en: There have been efforts for some time now to organise a humanitarian ceasefire with claims by Ukrainian officials it has been Russia that has rejected previous calls, including from the Pope.
paras.zh: 一段时间以来，人们一直在努力组织人道主义停火，乌克兰官员声称是俄罗斯拒绝了之前的呼吁，包括来自教皇的呼吁。

paras.en: However, there were indications last week that progress was being made. On October 18 Ukraine’s ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets said he thought agreement was close without any mention of Melania Trump’s involvement.
paras.zh: 然而，上周有迹象表明正在取得进展。 10 月 18 日，乌克兰监察员德米特罗·鲁比内茨 (Dmytro Lubinets) 表示，他认为协议已接近达成，但没有提及梅拉尼娅·特朗普的参与。

paras.en: The reason the talks have been so difficult is reportedly Russian concern that without them holding the several thousand civilians still in the town effectively hostage, the proximity of Oleshky, just the other side of the Dnipro river from Kherson, will see it come under much heavier attack from Ukraine, perhaps even an effort to take it.
paras.zh: 据报道，谈判之所以如此困难，是因为俄罗斯担心，如果他们不把镇上的数千名平民有效地扣为人质，那么靠近赫尔松的第聂伯河对岸的奥列什基将遭受乌克兰更猛烈的攻击，甚至可能是为了夺取它。

paras.en: Russian troops have also been struggling with food which has seen what supplies have been available to Ukrainians under military occupation taken from the, sometimes violently.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯军队也一直在粮食问题上苦苦挣扎，军事占领下的乌克兰人可用的物资也被夺走，有时还被暴力夺走。

paras.en: Ukraine official confirms Oleshky evacuation corridors
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员确认奥列什基疏散走廊

paras.en: Ukraine’s top negotiator has also confirmed the Oleshky ceasefire, which was helped brokered by Melania Trump and the White House. He also thanked Pope Leo who raised concerns about the Russian-occupied town this week.
paras.zh: 乌克兰最高谈判代表也确认了奥列什基停火协议，这是在梅拉尼娅·特朗普和白宫的帮助下达成的。他还感谢教皇利奥本周对这个被俄罗斯占领的城镇提出了担忧。

paras.en: Daivd Arakhamia says an operation to “unblock the settlement of Oleshky and its surroundings will begin in the near future.”
paras.zh: 戴夫德·阿拉卡米亚 (Daivd Arakhamia) 表示，一项“疏通奥列什基及其周边地区定居点封锁的行动将在不久的将来开始”。

paras.en: The goal was to create “permanent humanitarian corridors for the safe evacuation of civilians and the delivery of aid”, he said on Telegram.
paras.zh: 他在 Telegram 上表示，目标是建立“永久人道主义走廊，以安全疏散平民和运送援助物资”。

paras.en: This was a long process in which many people at different political levels took part. We would especially like to note the role of the Pope and the First Lady of the United States, Melania Trump. We express our sincere gratitude to them.
paras.zh: 这是一个漫长的过程，许多不同政治层面的人都参与其中。我们特别想指出教皇和美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普的作用。我们向他们表示诚挚的谢意。

paras.en: Russian media report that dozens of flights were cancelled or suspended this afternoon at Moscow’s four airports following long-range drone strikes from Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯媒体报道称，由于乌克兰的远程无人机袭击，今天下午莫斯科四个机场的数十个航班被取消或暂停。

paras.en: FlightRadar 24 says 88 flights were cancelled and 239 delayed at Moscow’s largest airport, Sheremetyevo International, on Friday afternoon.
paras.zh: FlightRadar 24 表示，周五下午，莫斯科最大的机场谢列梅捷沃国际机场有 88 架航班取消，239 架航班延误。

paras.en: As Ukraine has stepped up its reach deep into Russian territory with long-range drones, temporary airport shutdowns have become more common.
paras.zh: 随着乌克兰利用远程无人机深入俄罗斯领土，机场临时关闭变得更加常见。

paras.en: Zelenskyy last month said Ukraine posed no threat to civilian aircraft but Russian airspace was becoming part of the warzone.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基上个月表示，乌克兰对民用飞机不构成威胁，但俄罗斯领空正在成为战区的一部分。

paras.en: Today, we wish to issue a warning to every airline using Russian airspace, every insurer, and everyone still utilizing key Russian airports: the Russian skies are becoming entirely unsafe.
paras.zh: 今天，我们希望向每家使用俄罗斯领空的航空公司、每家保险公司以及仍在使用俄罗斯主要机场的所有人发出警告：俄罗斯的天空正在变得完全不安全。

paras.en: Ukraine poses no threat to civil aviation as such—not to a single civilian aircraft. However, the presence of drones in the skies over Russia is a reality that must be taken into account.
paras.zh: 乌克兰对民用航空本身不构成威胁，对任何一架民用飞机都没有构成威胁。然而，俄罗斯上空出现无人机是必须考虑的现实。

paras.en: Ukrainian leaders have been calling for a pause in fighting to get civilians out of Oleshky for months but the Russian authorities hadn’t budged.
paras.zh: 几个月来，乌克兰领导人一直呼吁暂停战斗，将平民从奥列什基救出，但俄罗斯当局却没有让步。

paras.en: In a statement, Melania Trump said it had become “abundantly clear that without my intervention, the possibility to bring humanitarian aid into the city and to evacuate the elderly would be impossible.”
paras.zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普在一份声明中表示，“已经非常清楚的是，如果没有我的干预，就不可能将人道主义援助带入该市并疏散老年人。”

paras.en: She said she’d worked with both Russian and Ukrainian leaders on the plan, and evacuating residents would have a choice to either go to Russia or Ukraine.
paras.zh: 她说，她已经与俄罗斯和乌克兰领导人就该计划进行了合作，疏散居民可以选择前往俄罗斯或乌克兰。

paras.en: Oleshky was captured by the Russians in the first week of the war, and about 2,000 residents are estimated to still be living there under Russian rule.
paras.zh: 奥列什基在战争第一周就被俄罗斯人俘获，据估计，在俄罗斯统治下，大约有 2,000 名居民仍居住在那里。

paras.en: The first lady has made helping children in conflict a focus of her tenure. Last year she surpried everyone inrevealing she had a backchannel communication with Putin, in personally arranging for children displaced in the war to be reunited with their families.
paras.zh: 第一夫人将帮助冲突中的儿童作为她任期的重点。去年，她惊讶地透露，她与普京有秘密沟通，亲自安排在战争中流离失所的儿童与家人团聚。

paras.en: In some cases, the children had been abducted by Russia. So far she has helped reunite 34 children with their parents, her office says.
paras.zh: 在某些情况下，儿童被俄罗斯绑架。她的办公室称，到目前为止，她已帮助 34 名儿童与父母团聚。

paras.en: France shooting a 'racist, probably Islamophobic’ attack: mayor
paras.zh: 市长：法国发生“种族主义，可能是伊斯兰恐惧症”袭击

paras.en: Some more details on the shooting this morning in the town west of Paris which killed one person and injured five others, including a 12-year-old girl.
paras.zh: 有关今天早上在巴黎西部小镇发生的枪击事件的更多细节，该枪击事件造成 1 人死亡、5 人受伤，其中包括一名 12 岁女孩。

paras.en: The mayor of Trappes says the gunman was was most likely carrying out “a racist, probably Islamophobic attack”.
paras.zh: 特拉普斯市长表示，枪手很可能正在实施“种族主义，甚至可能是仇视伊斯兰的袭击”。

paras.en: Mayor Ali Rabeh said the gunman, who had opened fire from a car between Trappes and La Verriere, had been shooting at random and “seemed intent on carrying out a massacre”. Two of the victims were of African and North African origin, he said.
paras.zh: 市长阿里·拉贝 (Ali Rabeh) 表示，枪手从特拉普斯 (Trappes) 和拉维里埃 (La Verriere) 之间的一辆汽车中开枪，他是随意开枪，“似乎意图进行屠杀”。他说，其中两名受害者是非洲和北非裔。

paras.en: Authorities are investigating it as an act of terrorism. The gunman had “clearly” committed a “terrorist crime”, said Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez.
paras.zh: 当局正在将其作为恐怖主义行为进行调查。内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，枪手“显然”犯下了“恐怖犯罪”。

paras.en: ‘Hell on earth’: last residents eat weeds to survive in Russian-occupied Oleshky
paras.zh: “人间地狱”：俄罗斯占领的奥列什基最后居民靠吃杂草求生

paras.en: The White House says the first lady has led the charge in negotiating this evacuation corridor for civilians in Oleshky; we’ll have more details soon.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，第一夫人在奥列什基平民疏散走廊的谈判中发挥了主导作用。我们很快就会得到更多细节。

paras.en: My colleagues Peter Beaumont and Artem Mazhulin however had this report last month on just how dire the situation has become in the war-ravaged town:
paras.zh: 然而，我的同事彼得·博蒙特（Peter Beaumont）和阿乔姆·马朱林（Artem Mazhulin）上个月收到了一份报告，说明这个饱受战争蹂躏的小镇的局势有多严峻：

paras.en: Oleshky, across the Dnipro River from the southern city of Kherson, has become “a hell on earth”, according to Ukrainians familiar with conditions there.
paras.zh: 熟悉那里情况的乌克兰人说，与南部城市赫尔松隔第聂伯河相望的奥列什基已经成为“人间地狱”。

paras.en: Food had finally run out for the 2,000 or so civilians, including 50 children, remaining in the city and its surrounding villages.
paras.zh: 留在城市及周边村庄的约 2000 名平民（其中包括 50 名儿童）的食物终于耗尽。

paras.en: In messages shared with the Guardian, residents said they were down to one meal a day: soup without potato, made with courgette grown in what once were the flower boxes of the city’s apartment houses, sometimes with the addition of foraged purslane, an edible weed.
paras.zh: 在与《卫报》分享的信息中，居民们表示，他们每天只吃一顿饭：不吃土豆的汤，用生长在城市公寓花箱里的小胡瓜做的，有时还添加采摘的马齿苋，一种可食用的杂草。

paras.en: “We’re running out of everything,” said a resident early in the summer. “By August, the situation will be critical for us. And come autumn, we’ll definitely die. I’m already dying. I’m getting weaker by the day.”
paras.zh: “我们的一切都快用完了，”夏初的一位居民说道。 “到了八月，情况对我们来说就很危急了。到了秋天，我们肯定会死。我已经快死了。我一天比一天虚弱。”

paras.en: “We’re in Oleshky [and] we can’t get out. We’re going hungry … Right now, I’ve got absolutely nothing to eat,” read another message from a woman in the besieged city who was waiting to be evacuated by the occupying forces. Before the war, she had weighed 110kg (17st); now she weighed just 67kg, she wrote.
paras.zh: “我们在奥列什基，无法出去。我们快要饿死了……现在，我完全没有东西吃，”被围困城市中等待占领军撤离的一名妇女发来的另一条信息写道。战前，她的体重为110公斤（第17公斤）；她写道，现在她的体重只有 67 公斤。

paras.en: In September, military authorities in Kherson carried out a large-scale airdrop of emergency food, water and medical supplies into the city and surrounding areas, using large drones, after Russia reportedly again rejected a ceasefire to evacuate civilians.
paras.zh: 9月，据报道俄罗斯再次拒绝停火以疏散平民，赫尔松军事当局使用大型无人机向该市及周边地区大规模空投紧急食品、水和医疗用品。

paras.en: The Ukrainian foreign minister, Andrii Sybiha, raised the situation in Oleshky at the UN general assembly in New York in September. He told those gathered: “Russia is deliberately making life there impossible. They are starving them to death.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈 (Andrii Sybiha) 9 月在纽约举行的联合国大会上提出了奥列什基的局势。他告诉与会者：“俄罗斯故意让那里的人无法生存。他们正在把他们饿死。”

paras.en: Melania Trump helps broker ceasefire in Russian-occupied town where residents were starving to death
paras.zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普帮助斡旋俄罗斯占领小镇停火，那里的居民都快饿死了

paras.en: The White House has issued a statement saying Melania Trump has helped broker a ‘ceasefire’ in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, where residents have been enduring a worsening humanitarian crisis due to the lack of food, electricity and other resources.
paras.zh: 白宫发表声明称，梅拉尼娅·特朗普帮助促成了俄罗斯占领的奥列什基市的“停火”，该市居民因缺乏食品、电力和其他资源而承受着日益恶化的人道主义危机。

paras.en: The small town in southern Kherson has been the centre of an increasingly desperate humanitarian crisis under Russian occupation.
paras.zh: 赫尔松南部的这个小镇在俄罗斯占领下一直是日益严重的人道主义危机的中心。

paras.en: Since May, Russia has failed to deliver food, medicine or other essential goods to the area leading to deaths from starvation and disease. There has also been problems with the burial of bodies and sanitation, as the local morgue has been destroyed and there is no running water.
paras.zh: 自五月以来，俄罗斯未能向该地区运送食品、药品或其他必需品，导致该地区因饥饿和疾病而死亡。尸体埋葬和卫生设施也存在问题，因为当地太平间已被毁坏，而且没有自来水。

paras.en: Russia and Ukraine have accused the other of blocking supplies to the population of the town which Ukrainian forces want to retake.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰指责对方阻止向乌克兰军队想要夺回的该镇居民提供物资。

paras.en: Ukraine has previously appealed for a ceasefire to evacuate the estimated 2,000 civilians left in the town – but Russia hadn’t made any commitments.
paras.zh: 乌克兰此前曾呼吁停火，以疏散该镇约 2000 名平民，但俄罗斯尚未做出任何承诺。

paras.en: Earlier this week, Pope Leo called for an intervention while the Kremlin said Putin had discussed the situation with Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，教皇利奥呼吁进行干预，而克里姆林宫则表示普京已与唐纳德·特朗普讨论了这一情况。

paras.en: The White House now say both countries have agreed to pause military action “to allow for humanitarian aid to enter and to prepare a civilian evacuation through a designated safe passageway. A ceasefire is set to come into effect on 29 October.
paras.zh: 白宫现在表示，两国已同意暂停军事行动，“以允许人道主义援助进入并准备通过指定的安全通道撤离平民。停火定于 10 月 29 日生效。”

paras.en: “The situation in Oleshky is dire. Oleshky is a front-line war city on the brink of disaster. Oleshky’s remaining population is comprised primarily of elderly residents who urgently need medical attention, medicine, food, and clean water,” Melania Trump said in the statement.
paras.zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普在声明中表示，“奥列什基的情况非常严峻。奥列什基是一座处于灾难边缘的前线战争城市。奥列什基的剩余人口主要由老年居民组成，他们迫切需要医疗护理、药品、食物和清洁水。”

paras.en: “It was abundantly clear that without my intervention, the possibility to bring humanitarian aid into the city and to evacuate the elderly would be impossible,” she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“很明显，如果没有我的干预，就不可能将人道主义援助带入该市并疏散老年人。”

paras.en: There is no comment from Moscow or Ukraine yet. The Guardian’s international correspondents are looking into the statement and attempting to corroborate it with their sources.
paras.zh: 莫斯科或乌克兰尚未发表评论。 《卫报》的国际记者正在调查该声明，并试图与他们的消息来源证实它。

articles.title: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted

paras.en: Ukraine is still recording issues with the Starlink network, sources within the defence ministry say, after Donald Trump said limits had been reversed by Elon Musk who owns the satellite system.
paras.zh: 国防部内部消息人士称，在唐纳德·特朗普表示拥有该卫星系统的埃隆·马斯克已经取消了限制后，乌克兰仍在记录星链网络的问题。

paras.en: The sources told the BBC that instances of drones experiencing connection loss at speeds of 161km/h (100mph) were being recorded, hampering military operations.
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉 BBC，有记录显示无人机在时速 161 公里/小时（100 英里/小时）时出现连接中断，从而阻碍了军事行动。

paras.en: The US president had denied instructing the tech billionaire to restrict connectivity to Starlink's military-grade counterpart, Starshield, before saying on Thursday that Musk had "put it back".
paras.zh: 美国总统否认指示这位科技亿万富翁限制与星链的军用级对应物星盾的连接，然后周四表示马斯克已“将其恢复”。

paras.en: Asked on Friday, Trump said: "If there is a problem, I will get it straightened out."
paras.zh: 周五被问及时，特朗普表示：“如果有问题，我会解决它。”

paras.en: Trump added: "I have not spoken to him. I might have to, but I have not. I've heard it was fixed, but if it's not, I'll speak to him."
paras.zh: 特朗普补充道：“我还没有和他谈过。我可能必须这样做，但我还没有。我听说它已经解决了，但如果没有，我会和他谈谈。”

paras.en: Musk previously said he was not behind the slowdown, which affected Ukraine's ability to use attack drones and co-ordinate defensive operations.
paras.zh: 马斯克此前表示，他并不是经济放缓的幕后黑手，经济放缓影响了乌克兰使用攻击无人机和协调防御行动的能力。

paras.en: Trump told reporters he did not think the tech billionaire had too much power.
paras.zh: 特朗普告诉记者，他认为这位科技亿万富翁没有太多权力。

paras.en: The Ukrainian defence ministry sources said the military was constantly monitoring the performance of both the Starlink and Starshield networks.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国防部消息人士称，军方正在持续监控“星链”和“星盾”网络的性能。

paras.en: They added that there was "currently no confirmation that these restrictions have been lifted".
paras.zh: 他们补充说，“目前尚未确认这些限制已被取消”。

paras.en: Last week, Kyiv said uplink speeds to the low Earth orbit satellites had been restricted, affecting the speed at which drones could travel. Any drone travelling faster than 100mph lost its connection, officials said.
paras.zh: 上周，基辅表示，近地轨道卫星的上行速度受到限制，影响了无人机的飞行速度。官员称，任何飞行速度超过 100 英里/小时的无人机都会失去连接。

paras.en: Shortly after, Musk said that Starshield, which Ukraine uses for some of its operation, was controlled by the US military and suggested that the Pentagon could be behind the issues.
paras.zh: 不久之后，马斯克表示，乌克兰用于部分行动的“星盾”由美国军方控制，并暗示五角大楼可能是这些问题的幕后黑手。

paras.en: The White House has since repeatedly denied deliberately placing limits on the network in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 此后，白宫一再否认故意对乌克兰的网络施加限制。

paras.en: Ukraine uses both the civilian service Starlink and the more secure Starshield, depending on what communications are needed.
paras.zh: 乌克兰根据需要的通信方式同时使用民用服务“星链”和更安全的“星盾”。

paras.en: The networks use 10,000 satellites to provide connectivity, particularly in remote areas and on the battlefield. Starshield allows Ukrainian drone operators to see targets in real time, as well as operate interceptor drones.
paras.zh: 该网络使用 10,000 颗卫星提供连接，特别是在偏远地区和战场上。 Starshield允许乌克兰无人机操作员实时查看目标，并操作拦截无人机。

paras.en: Russia is not authorised to use Starlink, so when Ukraine sends long-range missiles deep into Russia to hit oil refineries, the network does not work.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯无权使用星链，因此当乌克兰向俄罗斯深处发射远程导弹打击炼油厂时，该网络无法工作。

paras.en: One Ukrainian soldier said there was "simply no alternative" to Starshield, adding that earlier in the week, connectivity had been cutting out when his unit had been travelling in a car at 80km/h (50 mph).
paras.zh: 一名乌克兰士兵表示，除了“星盾”之外，“根本没有其他选择”，并补充说，本周早些时候，当他的部队以 80 公里/小时（50 英里/小时）的速度行驶时，网络连接就被切断了。

paras.en: "I'll tell you this much: God forbid they shut it off completely - it would be an absolute catastrophe," he told the BBC. "We need a backup option for securing communications and internet."
paras.zh: “我要告诉你的是：上帝禁止他们完全关闭它——这将是一场绝对的灾难，”他告诉英国广播公司。 “我们需要一个备份选项来保护通信和互联网的安全。”

paras.en: Another soldier said they had reverted to the "proven algorithms" they used before they had Starlink when it initially started playing up, but stressed that Ukrainian forces did need the network, citing its speed.
paras.zh: 另一名士兵表示，他们已经恢复了星链最初开始使用时使用的“经过验证的算法”，但强调乌克兰军队确实需要该网络，理由是它的速度。

paras.en: "Even one or two seconds is critical when we can transfer data and orders faster," she said. "You can really feel that advantage on the battlefield."
paras.zh: “当我们能够更快地传输数据和订单时，即使一两秒也至关重要，”她说。 “在战场上你才能真正感受到这种优势。”

paras.en: Ukrainian reports of a slowdown to the service came during a tense diplomatic row between Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky about Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil infrastructure.
paras.zh: 乌克兰有关服务速度放缓的报道是在特朗普与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基就乌克兰袭击俄罗斯石油基础设施问题发生紧张外交争执期间发布的。

paras.en: Faced with midterm elections next month, Trump has waived some sanctions on Russia and agreed a deal to import Russian diesel for the US market - a move criticised by Ukraine and its European allies.
paras.zh: 面对下个月的中期选举，特朗普放弃了对俄罗斯的部分制裁，并同意一项为美国市场进口俄罗斯柴油的协议，此举遭到乌克兰及其欧洲盟友的批评。

paras.en: Trump said the strikes on Russian oil refineries, which Kyiv says are crucial to stemming the main revenue source for Moscow's war effort, have pushed global prices higher.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击推高了全球油价，基辅称这对于阻止莫斯科战争的主要收入来源至关重要。

paras.en: While the attacks have had an impact on global fuel prices, rises seen this year have primarily been due to the Iran war.
paras.zh: 虽然袭击事件对全球燃油价格产生了影响，但今年的上涨主要是由于伊朗战争。

paras.en: Zelensky said the US had also threatened to withdraw intelligence sharing if the strikes did not stop, something Trump later denied.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，美国还威胁说，如果袭击不停止，美国将取消情报共享，但特朗普后来否认了这一点。

paras.en: The row prompted a war of words between the two world leaders, with Trump suggesting it was time for Ukraine to get a new president and Zelensky implying Trump was not a real leader.
paras.zh: 这场争吵引发了两国领导人之间的口水战，特朗普暗示乌克兰是时候选出新总统了，而泽伦斯基则暗示特朗普不是真正的领导人。

paras.en: Earlier on Thursday - before Trump's comments - Zelensky had said the speed of the system had still not been restored fully.
paras.zh: 周四早些时候，在特朗普发表评论之前，泽连斯基曾表示系统的速度尚未完全恢复。

paras.en: "I am waiting to hear from US Secretary of State [Marco] Rubio. He promised to get back to me with information within 48 hours or so."
paras.zh: “我正在等待美国国务卿卢比奥的回复。他承诺在 48 小时左右的时间内向我提供信息。”

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal reported that Trump had told Musk that he was frustrated the Starlink system's speeds were still capped, and that the system was working closer to normal following that conversation.
paras.zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，特朗普告诉马斯克，他对星链系统的速度仍然受到限制感到沮丧，并且在那次谈话后，该系统的工作状态已接近正常。

articles.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say

paras.en: Seven people have been killed in an attack on a funeral in central Jordan, officials have said.
paras.zh: 官员称，约旦中部一场葬礼遇袭事件已造成七人死亡。

paras.en: At least 34 others were injured as gunmen opened fire on a church in Hmoud, in the Karak governorate on Friday.
paras.zh: 周五，武装分子向卡拉克省赫穆德的一座教堂开枪，造成至少 34 人受伤。

paras.en: The unidentified gunmen are reported to have arrived in a car, entered the church and opened fire before fleeing. No-one has admitted carrying out the attack.
paras.zh: 据报道，身份不明的枪手乘坐汽车抵达教堂，开枪后逃跑。没有人承认实施了这次袭击。

paras.en: In a news conference, Interior Minister Mazen al-Faraya said authorities were working to apprehend the perpetrators which he described as a "group of extremists".
paras.zh: 内政部长马赞·法拉亚在新闻发布会上表示，当局正在努力逮捕肇事者，他将​​其描述为“极端分子团体”。

paras.en: Jordan's King Abdullah II, said the authorities would "confront the terrorist act that targeted Karak with the harshest penalties".
paras.zh: 约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世表示，当局将“对针对卡拉克的恐怖行为施以最严厉的惩罚”。

paras.en: "Whoever imagines that the bullets of treachery can divide the ranks of Jordanians will fail in his endeavour before our steadfastness and unity," the king added in a post on X.
paras.zh: 国王在 X 上的一篇帖子中补充道：“任何人如果认为背叛的子弹能够分裂约旦人的队伍，他的努力就会在我们的坚定和团结面前失败。”

paras.en: Dozens of people had been inside the church for the funeral when the shooting began, Khaled Burqan, one of the mourners, told Jordan's al-Mamlaka state-run TV.
paras.zh: 哀悼者之一哈立德·布尔坎 (Khaled Burqan) 告诉约旦国营电视台 al-Mamlaka，枪击事件开始时，已有数十人在教堂内参加葬礼。

paras.en: He said two attackers armed with a rifle and a pistol had been firing at the mourners for several minutes.
paras.zh: 他说，两名手持步枪和手枪的袭击者已经向哀悼者开枪了几分钟。

paras.en: Al-Faraya added that the incident was "painful and horrific" and "unparalleled in the history of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan," during his news conference.
paras.zh: 法拉亚在新闻发布会上补充说，这一事件“痛苦而可怕”，“在约旦哈希姆王国的历史上是前所未有的”。

paras.en: Public service television station al-Mamlaka has reported the king arrived in Karak on Friday evening "to check on the condition of the injured".
paras.zh: 公共服务电视台 al-Mamlaka 报道说，国王于周五晚上抵达卡拉克“检查伤者的情况”。

paras.en: Initial reports indicated seven people had been killed in the attack. A government spokesperson later said six people had died, before officials again revised the death toll to seven.
paras.zh: 初步报告显示，袭击中有七人死亡。政府发言人后来表示，已有六人死亡，随后官员再次将死亡人数修正为七人。

paras.en: CCTV footage, verified by the BBC, appears to shows three gunmen making their way from a road toward the church.
paras.zh: 经英国广播公司证实的闭路电视录像似乎显示三名枪手从一条道路走向教堂。

paras.en: Two of the attackers are seen making their way on to what appears to be a vehicle entrance to the church grounds, before retreating briefly and returning with a third man. All three appear to be armed with handguns.
paras.zh: 可以看到两名袭击者走向教堂场地的一个似乎是车辆入口的地方，然后短暂撤退并带着第三名男子返回。三人似乎都配备了手枪。

paras.en: Separate footage believed to be from the aftermath of the attack appears to show several dead and wounded bodies on the ground amid some chaotic scenes.
paras.zh: 据信是袭击发生后的另一段视频显示，在一些混乱的场景中，地面上有几具死伤尸体。

paras.en: There was a heavy security presence at the entrance to a hospital treating people injured in the incident in Karak, amid an atmosphere charged with anger among residents of the governorate, particularly the families of those injured and killed.
paras.zh: 卡拉克一家治疗事件中受伤人员的医院入口处有重兵戒备，该省居民，尤其是伤者和遇难者家属，气氛充满愤怒。

paras.en: Karak has a sizeable Christian community in the majority-Muslim Jordan.
paras.zh: 卡拉克在穆斯林占多数的约旦拥有相当大的基督教社区。

paras.en: Such violence is rare in the country, but deadly attacks have been carried out in the past.
paras.zh: 这种暴力事件在该国很少见，但过去也曾发生过致命袭击事件。

paras.en: Lebanon's President Joseph Aoun, a Christian head of state, said the "heinous terrorist attack" on the church "violated the sanctity of death and funeral mourners, contradicts all religious and humanitarian values," according to Lebanese media.
paras.zh: 据黎巴嫩媒体报道，黎巴嫩总统、基督教国家元首约瑟夫·奥恩表示，针对教堂的“令人发指的恐怖袭击”“侵犯了死亡和葬礼哀悼者的神圣性，违背了所有宗教和人道主义价值观”。

paras.en: Additional reporting by Majd Gousous, BBC Arabic.
paras.zh: BBC 阿拉伯语 Majd Gousous 的补充报道。

articles.title: White House says Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'

paras.en: US First Lady Melania Trump has "successfully secured" a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, the White House has said.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普在俄罗斯占领的奥列什基市“成功确保”俄罗斯和乌克兰之间停火。

paras.en: It said the truce in the "front-line war city on the brink of disaster" without medicine, food and clean water would begin on 29 October.
paras.zh: 声明称，“处于灾难边缘的前线战争城市”将于10月29日开始在没有药品、食物和清洁水的情况下停战。

paras.en: Ukraine and Russia confirmed the deal was agreed to evacuate residents and deliver aid. Moscow said its forces would stop firing at 04:00 (02:00 GMT) on 27 October.
paras.zh: 乌克兰和俄罗斯确认达成协议，旨在疏散居民并提供援助。莫斯科表示，其部队将于 10 月 27 日凌晨 04:00（格林尼治标准时间 02:00）停止射击。

paras.en: Oleshky was seized by Russia during the first days of its full-scale invasion in February 2022. Trapped between Ukrainian positions across the Dnipro River and Russian forces to the east, residents have recently resorted to eating garden weeds to survive.
paras.zh: 奥列什基在 2022 年 2 月俄罗斯全面入侵的头几天就被俄罗斯占领。这里被困在第聂伯河对岸的乌克兰阵地和东边的俄罗斯军队之间，居民最近只能靠吃花园杂草来生存。

paras.en: The White House statement said Melania Trump and one of her representatives had worked "directly with Russian and Ukrainian leadership to define the terms of the localised ceasefire".
paras.zh: 白宫声明称，梅拉尼娅·特朗普和她的一名代表“直接与俄罗斯和乌克兰领导人合作，确定局部停火的条款”。

paras.en: "Non-military, civilian leaders from both countries will work together to visit Oleshky residents in their homes and determine the level of assistance they require," she is quoted as saying.
paras.zh: 报道援引她的话说：“两国非军事、文职领导人将共同努力，拜访奥列什基居民的家中，并确定他们所需的援助水平。”

paras.en: "Residents who wish to evacuate will receive co-ordinated support and transportation to their preferred destination. I anticipate some will want to go to Russia, and some to Ukraine."
paras.zh: “希望撤离的居民将获得协调的支持和前往他们首选目的地的交通。我预计有些人会想去俄罗斯，有些人会去乌克兰。”

paras.en: Melania Trump added that Oleshky residents "have limited electricity, live amid mined roads, and endure regular military attacks" and that "without my intervention, the possibility to bring humanitarian aid into the city and to evacuate the elderly would be impossible".
paras.zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普补充说，奥列什基居民“电力有限，生活在布满地雷的道路上，经常遭受军事袭击”，“如果没有我的干预，就不可能将人道主义援助带入该市并疏散老年人”。

paras.en: The statement did not say how long the ceasefire would be in place for.
paras.zh: 声明没有说明停火将持续多久。

paras.en: Davyd Arakhamia, a Ukrainian MP who heads President Volodymyr Zelensky's party in parliament, later said "an operation to unblock the settlement of Oleshky and its surroundings will begin in the near future".
paras.zh: 乌克兰议员达维德·阿拉卡米亚（Davyd Arakhamia）是泽连斯基总统在议会中领导的政党，他后来表示，“一项旨在疏通奥列什基及其周边地区定居点的行动将在不久的将来开始”。

paras.en: "To achieve this goal, a ceasefire will be achieved in the near future, as announced by the First Lady of the United States, Melania Trump," he said. No date or time has been announced by Kyiv yet.
paras.zh: 他说：“为了实现这一目标，正如美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普所宣布的那样，将在不久的将来实现停火。”基辅尚未宣布日期或时间。

paras.en: In Russia, President Vladimir Putin's spokesman confirmed that, "those who wish to do so will be able to leave this settlement".
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯，总统弗拉基米尔·普京的发言人证实，“那些愿意这样做的人将能够离开这个定居点”。

paras.en: Last month, some of the remaining Oleshky residents told the BBC harrowing accounts of how they were surviving in the city that was being constantly shelled and cut off from food and water.
paras.zh: 上个月，奥列什基的一些剩余居民向英国广播公司讲述了他们如何在这座不断遭受炮击、食物和水源被切断的城市中生存的悲惨经历。

paras.en: They said that children remaining in wider Oleshky were suffering from malnutrition, a lack of medical services and were "degrading" without access to education.
paras.zh: 他们说，留在大奥列什基地区的儿童营养不良，缺乏医疗服务，并且无法接受教育而“有辱人格”。

paras.en: Many also told the BBC there was only one hospital partially operational, opening a few days a week to perform critical amputations.
paras.zh: 许多人还告诉英国广播公司，只有一家医院部分运营，每周开放几天来进行危重截肢手术。

paras.en: The local population was living under a "full blockade" by Russian forces, according to Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha.
paras.zh: 乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈表示，当地居民生活在俄罗斯军队的“全面封锁”之下。

paras.en: Ukraine says it has attempted to deliver supplies to the area but has not had success in recent months.
paras.zh: 乌克兰表示，它已尝试向该地区运送物资，但近几个月来并未成功。

paras.en: The Kremlin in September acknowledged that Oleshky was facing "a critical situation" and "problems with supplies of food and medicine", but added that "Russia's military was working to resolve them" and blamed Kyiv.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫9月承认奥列什基面临“危急局势”和“食品和药品供应问题”，但补充说“俄罗斯军方正在努力解决这些问题”，并指责基辅。

paras.en: Oleshky was home to 24,000 people before Russia's full-scale invasion. Now Ukraine estimates that some 6,000 people remain in the city and its surrounding areas, including 200 children.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯全面入侵之前，奥列什基居住着 24,000 人。目前乌克兰估计约有6000人仍留在该市及其周边地区，其中包括200名儿童。

paras.en: It is also one of a number of settlements where thousands of people lost their homes to a massive flooding caused by the collapse of Nova Khakovka Dam in 2023. Ukraine and its allies accused Russia of blowing up the dam, while Russia blamed Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这也是 2023 年新哈科夫卡大坝倒塌引发的大规模洪水导致数千人失去家园的众多定居点之一。乌克兰及其盟友指责俄罗斯炸毁大坝，而俄罗斯则指责乌克兰。

paras.en: While the US first lady is relatively lower profile than some of her predecessors - and only occasionally seen at White House events - she has become involved in addressing humanitarian issues stemming from the Russia-Ukraine war.
paras.zh: 虽然美国第一夫人比她的一些前任相对低调，而且只是偶尔出现在白宫活动中，但她已经开始参与解决俄罗斯-乌克兰战争引发的人道主义问题。

paras.en: In August 2025, Melania Trump penned a letter to Putin, telling him it was "time to protect children and future generations worldwide".
paras.zh: 2025年8月，梅拉尼娅·特朗普给普京写了一封信，告诉他“是时候保护全世界的儿童和子孙后代了”。

paras.en: Although she did not mention Ukraine by name, just days later at the White House Zelensky handed over a letter from his wife Olena, thanking her for her efforts on children.
paras.zh: 尽管她没有提到乌克兰的名字，但几天后，泽连斯基在白宫转交了妻子奥琳娜的一封信，感谢她为儿童所做的努力。

paras.en: In a rare public appearance in October the same year, the US first lady said that Putin had answered directly in writing and that her representatives were working with the Russian president's team to repatriate Ukrainian children from Russia and vice versa.
paras.zh: 同年10月，美国第一夫人罕见地公开露面，表示普京已直接书面答复，她的代表正在与俄罗斯总统团队合作，将乌克兰儿童从俄罗斯遣返，反之亦然。

paras.en: Some 34 children have reportedly been returned since 2025, including five this July.
paras.zh: 据报道，自 2025 年以来已有约 34 名儿童返回，其中 5 名儿童于今年 7 月返回。

paras.en: According to US President Donald Trump, his wife has also privately expressed scepticism about Putin and his desire to achieve peace.
paras.zh: 据美国总统唐纳德·特朗普称，他的妻子私下也对普京及其实现和平的愿望表示怀疑。

paras.en: "I'd get home, I'd say, 'First lady, I had the most wonderful talk with Vladimir. I think we're finished'," Trump said in July last year.
paras.zh: “我回到家后，我会说，‘第一夫人，我和弗拉基米尔进行了最精彩的谈话。我想我们已经结束了’，”特朗普去年 7 月说道。

paras.en: "And then I'll turn on the television, or she'll say to me one time, 'Wow, that's strange because they just bombed a nursing home.'"
paras.zh: “然后我会打开电视，或者有一次她会对我说，‘哇，这很奇怪，因为他们刚刚炸毁了一家疗养院。’”

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.

"For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
A Century of Innovation in Motion Control

For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration

To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.

A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.

To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Introducing the 2026 Class of BodyShop Business Women in Collision
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Presenting the 2026 Class of BodyShop Business Women in Collision, highlighting an exceptional group of female collision repair professionals who are making meaningful contributions in the industry. This year’s class represents an impressive range of organizations, from collision facilities to manufacturers and suppliers.

The collision repair industry has traditionally been male-dominated, but women are increasingly making their mark across virtually every corner of the business. From repairing vehicles on the shop floor and managing high-performing collision centers to developing business strategies, supporting repairers and building companies of their own, women are helping shape where the industry goes next. Their career paths are as varied as the roles they hold, demonstrating there is no single route to building a successful career in collision repair.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: That diversity is evident in the 2026 Class of BodyShop Business Women in Collision. Some of this year’s honorees grew up around body shops or automotive businesses, while others arrived in collision almost by accident after beginning careers in fields such as accounting, healthcare and education. Their accomplishments include competing in SkillsUSA, growing family businesses, developing future industry talent, leading large collision operations, advocating for independent repairers and helping shop owners strengthen or transition their businesses. Despite those different backgrounds, common themes emerge: taking chances, embracing uncomfortable challenges, continually learning, and recognizing the value of strong mentors and relationships.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Perhaps most importantly, these women aren’t simply building impressive careers for themselves. They’re developing employees, mentoring the next generation, strengthening businesses and demonstrating the breadth of opportunities available to women entering the industry today. Their advice to those following them is equally powerful: ask questions, take risks, don’t fear failure and don’t wait until you feel completely ready to step forward.
Stephanie Steelman – Body Technician, DCR Systems

How did your collision career begin? I started learning the basics of collision repair in high school. I was able to compete in the SkillsUSA collision repair competition at the national level and was awarded 4th place. After high school, I had the opportunity to start working as my father’s apprentice.

What is the proudest accomplishment of your career? Getting my first job at DCR Systems after working for my dad. It felt good, having built the confidence in myself and the skills I had developed to go off on my own. I couldn’t be more proud of what I continue to build for myself with DCR Systems. The team at DCR has mentored me, provided me with many training opportunities and helped me grow in my skills.

What would you tell your younger collision self? It’s okay to fail. Repairing cars isn’t easy, and it takes a lot of trial-and-error to improve yourself. Take the feeling of being stumped and use it as encouragement to network, seek new ideas and try different techniques.
Leila Hobart – Associate Strategy & Portfolio Manager, OEC

How did your collision career begin? Four years ago, I joined OEC’s Repair Technologies team alongside some of the best mentors in the industry. I didn’t come from automotive — my background is in healthcare and education — but the mission hooked me: helping repairers deliver safe, proper repairs that protect vehicle owners.

What is the proudest accomplishment of your career? There are several that come to mind, including building OEM partnerships and leading WIN’s virtual conference, but the one closest to my heart is building OEC’s repair education program and helping schools put tools and training in the hands of the next generation of talent in our industry.

What would you tell your younger collision self? Take chances! It’s okay to end up somewhere different than your post-college plan. I went from an audiologist, to managing college programs, to shaping strategy in collision. Though I’ve worn different hats, I’ve found a throughline I’m passionate about — working with great people and making a true difference.
April Lausch – Collision Center Manager, Faulkner Collision Center

How did your collision career begin? After college, I began my career with a business background and accepted an office manager position at a collision center. I quickly developed a passion for the industry, learning every aspect of the repair process. That experience inspired me to grow professionally and build a long-term career in collision repair.

What is the proudest accomplishment of your career? Helping build a strong team and creating opportunities for others to grow. Seeing employees develop their skills, advance their careers and deliver exceptional repairs while providing outstanding customer service has been the most rewarding part of my career.

What would you tell your younger collision self? Believe in yourself, stay curious and never stop learning. Don’t be afraid to ask questions or take on new challenges. Every experience, even the difficult ones, will help you grow into a stronger leader and a better advocate for your team and the collision repair industry.
Wendy Patrick – Vice President of Store Operations, Gerber Collision & Glass

How did your collision career begin? I started in the industry at 17, working in an independent body shop. I never expected it to become my career, but I quickly realized I loved the work, the people and the constant opportunity to learn. That experience sparked a passion that has stayed with me ever since.

What is the proudest accomplishment of your career? I’m proud of the opportunities I’ve had throughout my career, but what means the most to me is helping others grow. Watching people gain confidence, step into leadership roles and succeed in ways they may not have imagined has been the most rewarding part of my journey.

What would you tell your younger collision self? Be curious, stay open to learning and don’t be afraid to ask questions. Trust that every challenge will teach you something valuable. Build strong relationships, lead with integrity and remember that the way you treat people will define your career more than any title ever will.
Syndey Feehan – General Manager, Fix Auto Maple Grove

How did your collision career begin? I graduated high school in 2020 and was working towards an internship with a State Farm agent. The testing facilities closed due to COVID, and I had to figure out what I wanted to do — wait or figure something else out. What is the proudest accomplishment of your career? I’m most proud of the family legacy that I get to help carry on. To work alongside my dad, brothers and husband every day is such a gift. To be able to achieve metrics like the no. 1 GEICO ARX store in the country and having all three of our stores scoring a 99-100 RPM score for State Farm is a testament to our dedication to our work and the grit we have in all that we do.
