paras.zh: “那么没有带激光的狗吗？” 《连线》杂志问拉姆。

paras.en: “I can’t comment on what Anduril plans,” he says. “Dog safety and performance, and then helping continue helping to improve the human handler and dog bond, and working as a team—that is what the mission is.”
paras.zh: “我无法评论安杜里尔的计划，”他说。 “狗的安全和表现，然后继续帮助改善人类处理者和狗的关系，并作为一个团队工作——这就是我们的使命。”

paras.en: Neither Luckey nor Lamm will be involved in Warhound’s day-to-day, although Lamm is on the company’s board, he says. David Spirk, a former Department of Defense chief data officer who most recently worked at Palantir, is serving as chief executive, and investors include In-Q-Tel, Sequoia Capital, and ARK Invest. Luckey is not an owner and does not have equity in the company, nor does Anduril; Colossal Biosciences does have an ownership stake.
paras.zh: 他表示，尽管 Lamm 是公司董事会成员，但 Luckey 和 Lamm 都不会参与 Warhound 的日常事务。最近在 Palantir 工作的前国防部首席数据官 David Spirk 担任首席执行官，投资者包括 In-Q-Tel、红杉资本和 ARK Invest。 Luckey 不是该公司的所有者，也没有该公司的股权，Anduril 也没有； Colossal Biosciences 确实拥有所有权股份。

paras.en: Luckey and Lamm have been working on the project for over a year, Lamm says, and just recently decided to take the company out of stealth. “Someone said, ‘So it's like the Captain America dog program with the Ironman tech program on top of it,’” Lamm tells WIRED.
paras.zh: 拉姆说，拉基和拉姆已经在这个项目上工作了一年多，最近才决定让该公司不再隐秘。 “有人说，‘所以这就像美国队长的狗计划，加上钢铁侠技术计划，’”拉姆告诉《连线》杂志。

paras.en: Everyone can agree that this is normal, and good, and that when the precision-designed beasts arrive on Earth, they will recognize that we are not the enemy.
paras.zh: 每个人都同意这是正常的，也是好的，当精心设计的野兽到达地球时，他们会认识到我们不是敌人。

paras.en: The company plans to operate under the guidance of the American Humane Society.
paras.zh: 该公司计划在美国人道协会的指导下运营。

articles.title: U.S. Supreme Court says New Hampshire can limit student IDs for voting

paras.en: Oct. 22 (UPI) -- The U.S. Supreme Court ruled Thursday student IDs in New Hampshire cannot be used for next month's midterm election.
paras.zh: 10 月 22 日（UPI）——美国最高法院周四裁定新罕布什尔州的学生证不能用于下个月的中期选举。

paras.en: In a brief court order, the justices granted an emergency request by the state, which was backed by the Republican National Committee.
paras.zh: 在一份简短的法院命令中，法官批准了州政府的紧急请求，并得到了共和党全国委员会的支持。

paras.en: The unsigned order said a federal judge should not have ordered voting rule changes so close to the Nov. 3 election, citing precedent.
paras.zh: 这份未签署的命令称，联邦法官不应在临近 11 月 3 日大选之际下令改变投票规则，并援引先例。

paras.en: "Here, the District Court did not point to anything that would justify deviating from that principle," the order said.
paras.zh: 该命令称：“在这里，地方法院没有指出任何可以证明偏离这一原则的理由。”

paras.en: Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson was the sole dissenter. "I would not disturb a clearly justifiable federal court order issued to ensure that the public receives accurate information about a State's electoral processes," she wrote.
paras.zh: 法官科坦吉·布朗·杰克逊是唯一的反对者。她写道：“我不会干扰联邦法院发布的明确合理的命令，以确保公众收到有关州选举程序的准确信息。”

paras.en: A state law was already on the books that restricted the use of student IDs as a primary form of identification. The ruling means voters cannot use them as backups to establish their identities.
paras.zh: 州法律已经明文规定限制使用学生证作为主要身份证明形式。该裁决意味着选民不能使用它们作为备份来确定自己的身份。

paras.en: The dispute arose from a state law enacted in the spring that removed student IDs from a list of forms of identification which election officials would accept when a ballot is requested.
paras.zh: 这场争议源于今年春季颁布的一项州法律，该法律将学生证从选举官员在要求投票时接受的身份证明形式列表中删除。

paras.en: The law was challenged by nonprofit voting rights group Coalition for Open Democracy, which argued it unlawfully burdened the right to vote and discriminated against young voters
paras.zh: 该法律受到非营利投票权组织开放民主联盟的质疑，该组织认为该法律非法加重了投票权的负担并歧视年轻选民

paras.en: U.S. District Judge Joseph Laplante declined to block the law, but he earlier this month reconsidered the case and put guidance from Republican New Hampshire Secretary of State David Scanlan on hold.
paras.zh: 美国地区法官约瑟夫·拉普兰特拒绝阻止这项法律，但他本月早些时候重新考虑了此案，并搁置了共和党新罕布什尔州国务卿戴维·斯坎兰的指导。

paras.en: The guidance from Scanlan said student IDs could be used when people seek ballots, which Laplante ruled went further than the law, which barred them as a primary source of identification.
paras.zh: 斯坎兰的指导意见称，当人们寻求选票时可以使用学生证，拉普兰特认为这超出了法律的范围，法律禁止学生证作为身份证明的主要来源。

paras.en: A separate provision of New Hampshire law allows people to establish identities using other unofficial forms of ID. It says people can use "any other evidence that reasonably establishes that it is more likely than not that the person is who they claim to be."
paras.zh: 新罕布什尔州法律的另一项规定允许人们使用其他非官方形式的身份证件来建立身份。它说，人们可以使用“任何其他证据来合理证明该人更有可能是他们所声称的人”。

paras.en: Under the ruling by Laplante, election officials could still consider student ID in trying to determine if someone is a valid voter.
paras.zh: 根据拉普兰特的裁决，选举官员在确定某人是否是有效选民时仍然可以考虑学生证。

paras.en: The 1st U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals in Boston declined to stay Laplante's ruling, prompting the state to ask the Supreme Court to intervene.
paras.zh: 位于波士顿的美国第一巡回上诉法院拒绝维持拉普兰特的裁决，促使该州要求最高法院进行干预。

articles.title: France detects first human case of insect-borne Shamonda virus

paras.en: Oct. 22 (UPI) -- French health officials on Thursday reported the first documented human case of Shamonda, an Africa-origin, insect-borne virus that was first detected in European cattle this summer.
paras.zh: 10 月 22 日（UPI）——法国卫生官员周四报告了首例有记录的人间沙蒙达病例，沙蒙达是一种原产于非洲的虫媒病毒，今年夏天首次在欧洲牛身上发现。

paras.en: France's Ministry of Health said in a statement that the patient infected with the Shamonda virus was severely immunocompromised and died early this month. The person had received treatment at the Hospices Civils de Lyon, it said.
paras.zh: 法国卫生部在一份声明中表示，感染沙蒙达病毒的患者免疫功能严重受损，于本月初死亡。据称，该人已在里昂民事临终关怀医院接受治疗。

paras.en: "Based on available knowledge about this virus, no health risk to the general population has been identified to date," the ministry said.
paras.zh: 卫生部表示：“根据有关该病毒的现有知识，迄今为止尚未发现该病毒对普通人群构成健康风险。”

paras.en: Health officials believe that the patient became infected through a vector, specifically the bite of a midge in eastern France, where the virus has been circulating among livestock since the spring.
paras.zh: 卫生官员认为，该患者是通过媒介感染的，特别是法国东部的蠓叮咬，该病毒自春季以来一直在该地区的牲畜中传播。

paras.en: "Until now, the Shamonda virus was considered incapable of being transmitted to humans," the French Ministry of Health said.
paras.zh: 法国卫生部表示：“到目前为止，沙蒙达病毒被认为无法传播给人类。”

paras.en: "The infection of this patient with Shamonda virus therefore constitutes the first documented and reported detection of the virus in a human."
paras.zh: “因此，这名沙蒙达病毒患者的感染构成了人类首次有记录和报道的该病毒的检测。”

paras.en: The European Center for Disease Prevention and Control said investigations were underway to understand whether the virus caused the patient's death or contributed to it as well as how the infection was acquired.
paras.zh: 欧洲疾病预防和控制中心表示，正在进行调查，以了解该病毒是否导致或促成了患者死亡，以及感染是如何获得的。

paras.en: Transmitted by midge bites, the Shamonda virus was first detected in Nigeria in the mid-1960s and has since been sporadically reported in cattle in West, East and Southern Africa, as well as Japan.
paras.zh: 沙蒙达病毒通过蠓叮咬传播，于 20 世纪 60 年代中期首次在尼日利亚被发现，此后在西非、东非、南部非洲以及日本的牛群中出现零星报道。

paras.en: The human infection follows the first-ever detection of Shamonda in European cattle this summer, according to the ECDC.
paras.zh: 据欧洲疾病预防控制中心称，今年夏天，欧洲牛群中首次检测到沙蒙达病毒，随后发生了人类感染。

paras.en: A U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention report states that dairy cattle in southern Germany and Switzerland have been affected by this virus since mid-June, while the ECDC states it has also been detected in farm animals in Austria, Belgium, Ireland, Italy, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain, as well as Jersey, a British Crown Dependency. French health officials said the virus was also sporadically identified in France.
paras.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心的一份报告指出，自 6 月中旬以来，德国南部和瑞士的奶牛已受到这种病毒的影响，而欧洲疾病预防控制中心表示，在奥地利、比利时、爱尔兰、意大利、列支敦士登、卢森堡、荷兰、葡萄牙和西班牙以及英国皇家属地泽西岛的农场动物中也发现了这种病毒。法国卫生官员表示，法国也零星发现了这种病毒。

paras.en: The disease has caused symptoms including reduced milk yield, diarrhea, fever and lethargy.
paras.zh: 这种疾病引起的症状包括产奶量减少、腹泻、发烧和嗜睡。

paras.en: The ECDC and the World Health Organization have been notified, the French health officials said.
paras.zh: 法国卫生官员表示，欧洲疾控中心和世界卫生组织已收到通知。

paras.en: The ECDC and the WHO each said they were in contact with French authorities and were monitoring the situation.
paras.zh: 欧洲疾病预防控制中心和世界卫生组织均表示，他们正在与法国当局联系并正在监测局势。

paras.en: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said that because the patient was immunocompromised, it made them more vulnerable to infection and severe disease.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事谭德塞表示，由于患者免疫功能低下，这使得他们更容易受到感染和患上严重疾病。

paras.en: "My heartfelt condolences to their loved ones," he said in a statement.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中说：“我向他们的亲人表示衷心的哀悼。”

paras.en: He said French authorities were collecting information to better understand the source of the infection, and possible routes of transmission and potential public health risks.
paras.zh: 他说，法国当局正在收集信息，以更好地了解感染源、可能的传播途径和潜在的公共卫生风险。

paras.en: Òscar Ordeig, agriculture minister for Agriculture for Catalonia in northeastern Spain, urged the public to remain calm, stating that "the detection of the virus does not imply, by itself, a high risk to the population."
paras.zh: 西班牙东北部加泰罗尼亚农业部长奥斯卡·奥尔代格（Òscar Ordeig）敦促公众保持冷静，并表示“检测到该病毒本身并不意味着人们面临高风险。”

paras.en: "The risk to humans in Catalonia is considered very low," he said online.
paras.zh: 他在网上说：“加泰罗尼亚对人类的风险被认为非常低。”

paras.en: "The work of veterinary teams, early notification and control of the vector insects are the main prevention tools. We act with rigor, coordination and transparency."
paras.zh: “兽医团队的工作、及早通知和控制媒介昆虫是主要的预防工具。我们的行动严谨、协调和透明。”

articles.title: U.S. imposes visa restrictions on nearly two dozen people in Colombia

paras.en: Oct. 22 (UPI) -- The United States imposed visa restrictions on nearly two dozen people in Colombia on Thursday, expanding enforcement of a new policy to prohibit entry to those in Latin American whom the Trump administration accuses of corruption or narcotrafficking.
paras.zh: 10月22日（UPI）——美国周四对哥伦比亚近二十人实施签证限制，扩大了一项新政策的执行范围，禁止特朗普政府指控腐败或贩毒的拉丁美洲人入境。

paras.en: The State Department named seven former and current Colombian officials targeted by the visa restrictions, adding that the restrictions also apply to their families.
paras.zh: 美国国务院点名了七名前任和现任哥伦比亚官员的签证限制目标，并补充说这些限制也适用于他们的家人。

paras.en: Of those named, six have been linked to corruption or criminal investigations in Colombia, while the seventh, José Ignacio Mesa Betancur, a former congressman and mayor of Envigado, was convicted and sentenced to 76 months in prison in May 2025, with his conviction upheld in late August for his involvement in a criminal organization that financed his political campaigns and helped secure him votes going back to at least 1995, in exchange for influence over government decisions.
paras.zh: 在被点名的人中，有六人与哥伦比亚的腐败或刑事调查有关，而第七人是前国会议员兼恩维加多市市长何塞·伊格纳西奥·梅萨·贝坦库尔 (José Ignacio Mesa Betancur)，他于 2025 年 5 月被定罪并被判处 76 个月监禁，8 月底维持原判，因为他参与了一个犯罪组织，该组织为他的政治竞选活动提供资金，并帮助他确保选票至少可以追溯到 1995 年，以换取对政府决策的影响力。

paras.en: The others targeted include Ricardo Roa Barragán, the former president of state-run energy company Ecopetrol; Yahir Fernando Acuña Cardales, mayor of Sincelejo; Wadith Alberto Manzur Imbett, senator-elect and former member of the House of Representatives; Julio Elías Chagüí Flórez, former senator, and Liliana Esther Bitar Castilla, former senator.
paras.zh: 其他目标包括国营能源公司 Ecopetrol 前总裁里卡多·罗亚·巴拉甘 (Ricardo Roa Barragán)；辛塞莱霍市市长亚希尔·费尔南多·阿库尼亚·卡达莱斯 (Yahir Fernando Acuña Cardales)； Wadith Alberto Manzur Imbett，当选参议员、前众议院议员；前参议员胡里奥·埃利亚斯·查古伊·弗洛雷斯和前参议员莉莉安娜·埃丝特·比塔尔·卡斯蒂利亚。

paras.en: The punitive measures come as the Trump administration seeks to expand U.S. influence in the Western Hemisphere.
paras.zh: 这些惩罚措施是在特朗普政府寻求扩大美国在西半球的影响力之际出台的。

paras.en: In March, President Donald Trump announced the Shield of the Americas initiative to combat transnational criminal organizations alongside Latin American nations led by either right-leaning governments or those aligned with the U.S. president. Colombia and Peru joined the initiative following right-wing electoral victories.
paras.zh: 今年三月，唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布了“美洲之盾”倡议，旨在与右倾政府或与美国总统结盟的拉丁美洲国家一起打击跨国犯罪组织。哥伦比亚和秘鲁在右翼选举胜利后加入了该倡议。

paras.en: Then last month, at the second leaders' meeting in New York City, the 15 governments moved toward coordinated action, including issuing a declaration stating their intention to impose sanctions and visa restrictions on members, associates and supporters of 24 identified criminal organizations.
paras.zh: 上个月，在纽约市举行的第二次领导人会议上，15 个国家政府采取了协调行动，包括发表声明，表示打算对 24 个已查明的犯罪组织的成员、同伙和支持者实施制裁和签证限制。

paras.en: About a week later, the U.S. State Department unveiled a new policy to restrict visas to those whose actions through corruption or narcotrafficking undermine democratically elected governments in the Western Hemispher.
paras.zh: 大约一周后，美国国务院公布了一项新政策，限制向那些通过腐败或毒品贩运行为破坏西半球民选政府的人发放签证。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Thursday said that new policy targets foreign nationals "regardless of their political affiliation."
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周四表示，新政策针对的是外国人，“无论其政治派别如何”。

paras.en: "The Trump administration stands with the government of Colombia as it works to remove criminal influence, including from their courts police forces and legislature," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“特朗普政府与哥伦比亚政府站在一起，努力消除犯罪影响，包括法院、警察部队和立法机构的影响。”

articles.title: Cristian Castro Accepts the Billboard Lifetime Achievement Award ‘In the Name of Romantic Love’
articles.author: Sigal Ratner-Arias

paras.en: Cristian Castro became emotional on Thursday evening (Oct. 22) as he accepted the Billboard Lifetime Achievement Award at the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards, delivering a poetic speech inspired by love.
paras.zh: 周四晚（10 月 22 日），克里斯蒂安·卡斯特罗 (Cristian Castro) 在接受 2026 年公告牌拉丁音乐奖颁发的公告牌终身成就奖时情绪激动，发表了充满爱的诗意演讲。

paras.en: “Romantic love and poetry are the only real things — the truest aspects of our human existence, the firmest thought, the clearest expression that emerges from our spirit and our hearts from the time we are children,” the pop icon remarked upon receiving the award from Mexican actress Jacqueline Bracamontes. “It is like when we first behold the soul — the serene calm of morning dew, the Moon, the majesty of a sunset — and that face, that presence, which fills your entire soul and which you cannot cast out from your being.”
paras.zh: 这位流行偶像在接受墨西哥女演员杰奎琳·布拉卡蒙特斯颁发的奖项时表示：“浪漫的爱情和诗歌是唯一真实的东西——我们人类存在的最真实的方面、最坚定的思想、从我们孩提时代起就从我们的精神和心灵中出现的最清晰的表达。” “就像当我们第一次看到灵魂时——晨露的宁静、月亮、日落的威严——还有那张脸、那个存在，它充满了你的整个灵魂，你无法将其从你的存在中驱逐出去。”

paras.en: “Throughout my life, romantic love has been my focal point and my true ambition — my firmament and my greatest longing,” continued the singer behind No. 1 hits such as “Amor” and “Azul.” “I accept this award in the name of romantic love and in the name of poetry; they are the most beautiful things I have ever possessed — gifts placed within me by God, alongside my voice.”
paras.zh: “在我的一生中，浪漫的爱情一直是我的焦点和我真正的抱负——我的天空和我最大的渴望，”这位创作了《Amor》和《Azul》等热门歌曲的歌手继续说道。 “我以浪漫爱情和诗歌的名义接受这个奖项；它们是我所拥有的最美丽的东西——上帝与我的声音一起赋予我的礼物。”

paras.en: Castro, who received the honor in recognition of a glittering career spanning more than three decades and his enduring influence on Latin music, also took to the stage for a special performance during the ceremony, broadcast live on Telemundo and Peacock from the James L. Knight Center in Miami. Together with the Mexican-American duo Ha*Ash, he performed their new collaboration “Antes Que Te Cases” live for the first time.
paras.zh: 卡斯特罗获得这一荣誉是为了表彰他三十多年的辉煌职业生涯以及他对拉丁音乐的持久影响，他还在颁奖典礼上登台进行了一场特别表演，并在迈阿密詹姆斯·L·奈特中心的 Telemundo 和 Peacock 频道进行了现场直播。他与墨西哥裔美国组合 Ha*Ash 一起首次现场表演了他们的新合作歌曲“Antes Que Te Cases”。

paras.en: The Billboard Lifetime Achievement Award honors an artist for an exceptional professional career — someone who has elevated Latin music to a new level on the global stage, remains relevant through their artistic and personal contributions, and whose influence has shaped the development of Latin music worldwide. Previous recipients include Andrea Bocelli, Armando Manzanero, Carlos Santana, José José, Maná, Marco Antonio Solís, Ricardo Arjona and Roberto Carlos, among others.
paras.zh: 公告牌终身成就奖旨在表彰一位在职业生涯中取得杰出成就的艺术家——他在全球舞台上将拉丁音乐提升到了一个新的水平，通过他们的艺术和个人贡献保持了影响力，并且他的影响力塑造了全球拉丁音乐的发展。此前的获奖者包括安德里亚·波切利、阿曼多·曼萨内罗、卡洛斯·桑塔纳、何塞·何塞、马纳、马可·安东尼奥·索利斯、里卡多·阿霍纳和罗伯托·卡洛斯等。

paras.en: Castro has solidified his place as one of the defining voices of Latin pop and romantic music. His history on the Billboard charts began in 1992 when “No Podrás” became his first entry on Hot Latin Songs, reaching No. 3. His debut album, Agua Nueva, climbed to No. 2 on Top Latin Pop Albums in January 1993. Since then, he has achieved six No. 1s on Hot Latin Songs, including “Nunca Voy a Olvidarte,” “Amor” and “Azul,” which spent four, eleven and nine weeks at the top, respectively. Years later, Viva El Príncipe, his tribute to legendary Mexican singer José José, spent seven weeks at No. 1 on Top Latin Albums in 2011.
paras.zh: 卡斯特罗巩固了他作为拉丁流行音乐和浪漫音乐的代表人物之一的地位。他在 Billboard 排行榜上的历史始于 1992 年，当时《No Podrás》成为他在热门拉丁歌曲上的第一首歌曲，达到了第 3 名。他的首张专辑《Agua Nueva》于 1993 年 1 月在顶级拉丁流行专辑中攀升至第 2 名。此后，他在热门拉丁歌曲排行榜上获得了六次第一名，其中包括《Nunca Voy a Olvidarte》、《Amor》和《Azul》，这些歌曲花费了 4、11 年的时间和顶部分别为九周。多年后，他向墨西哥传奇歌手何塞·何塞致敬的《Viva El Príncipe》在 2011 年拉丁专辑排行榜上连续七周排名第一。

paras.en: With over 12 million albums sold, Castro continues to connect with audiences through his Nada Solo Éxitos Tour, with performances at major venues such as the Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City and Madison Square Garden in New York.
paras.zh: 专辑销量超过 1200 万张，卡斯特罗继续通过他的 Nada Solo Éxitos Tour 与观众保持联系，并在墨西哥城国家礼堂和纽约麦迪逊广场花园等主要场馆进行演出。

paras.en: The 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards brought together the biggest names in Latin music for a night of unforgettable performances, collaborations and special recognitions. In addition to Castro, special honorees this year included Rubén Blades, who received the Billboard Icon Award; Rosalía, who was honored with the Billboard Hall of Fame Award; and Fuerza Regida, who took home the Billboard Vanguard Award.
paras.zh: 2026 年 Billboard 拉丁音乐奖汇聚了拉丁音乐界最知名的人士，度过了一个令人难忘的表演、合作和特别认可之夜。除了卡斯特罗之外，今年的特别获奖者还包括荣获公告牌偶像奖的鲁本·布莱兹 (Rubén Blades)；荣获公告牌名人堂奖的罗莎莉娅；以及荣获公告牌先锋奖的 Fuerza Regida。

articles.title: LISA, Miley, Kacey Musgraves & John Mayer: New Music Friday Guide
articles.author: Lyndsey Havens

paras.en: Billboard’s Friday Music Guide serves as a handy guide to New Music Friday’s most essential releases each week — the key music that everyone will be talking about today, and that will be dominating playlists this weekend and beyond.
paras.zh: Billboard 的周五音乐指南是每周周五新音乐最重要版本的便捷指南 - 今天每个人都会谈论的关键音乐，并且将在本周末及以后的播放列表中占据主导地位。

paras.en: Last week, we featured Olivia Rodrigo feat. Chappell Roan, Tate McRae, Zach Bryan & Angèle.
paras.zh: 上周，我们特别报道了奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 的壮举。查普尔·罗恩、泰特·麦克雷、扎克·布莱恩和安吉尔。

paras.en: This week, LISA drops her new EP; Miley features two new songs on the Nobody Wants This season three soundtrack; Kacey Musgraves shares a taste of her just-announced Middle of Nowhere Vol. 2: Tex Mex Tapes; and John Mayer is back with a new single and newly-launched label… plus much more.
paras.zh: 本周，LISA 发布了她的新 EP；麦莉在《Nobody Wants This》第三季配乐中收录了两首新歌；凯西·马斯格雷夫斯 (Kacey Musgraves) 分享了她刚刚发布的《Middle of Nowhere》卷的品味。 2：Tex Mex 磁带；约翰·梅尔 (John Mayer) 带着新单曲和新推出的厂牌回归……还有更多。

paras.en: Check out all of this week’s picks below:
paras.zh: 查看以下本周所有精选内容：

paras.en: Led by the hard-hitting pop-rap single “SaWaDiKa,” released in September, LISA is now sharing her very first solo EP. Focus track “Tarantino” packs just as hard a punch, while “Cobra” is an attitude-packed dance-pop song and album closer “Sweat” is a sultry song that leaves its subject with a simple instruction — “don’t stress me out” — and its listener wanting more. Press Play follows the 2025 release of LISA’S debut solo full-length, Alter Ego, and arrives just in time for the Thai singer’s upcoming Vegas residency that kicks off in November. — LYNDSEY HAVENS
paras.zh: 在 9 月份发行的强劲流行说唱单曲“SaWaDiKa”的带领下，LISA 现在正在分享她的第一张个人 EP。焦点曲目《Tarantino》同样具有强烈的冲击力，而《Cobra》是一首充满态度的舞曲流行歌曲，而专辑结尾的《Sweat》是一首性感的歌曲，它给主题留下了一个简单的指示——“别给我压力”——而听众则想要更多。 Press Play 紧接着 LISA 于 2025 年发行的首张个人长曲《Alter Ego》，正好赶上这位泰国歌手即将于 11 月开始的拉斯维加斯驻场演出。 — 林赛·哈文斯

paras.en: For longtime Miley fans, the release of “Cold Blooded” has been a long time coming. Written in the late 2010s ahead of her EP She Is Coming, the track never saw the light of day — until now. A demo version of the ballad, which showcases Miley’s undeniable vocal control and power over simple piano chords, is featured as a bonus track on the season three soundtrack for Nobody Wants This, out today. Its one of two Miley demos that made it on the album, as a stripped-down version of her Endless Summer Vacation track “You” also features on the soundtrack and in an episode. The soundtrack is out on Atlantic, while all 10 episodes of season three are now streaming on Netflix. — L.H.
paras.zh: 对于麦莉的长期粉丝来说，《冷血》的发行已经等了很长时间了。这首歌写于 2010 年代末，在她的 EP She Is Coming 之前，直到现在才面世。这首民谣的演示版本展示了麦莉不可否认的声音控制力以及对简单钢琴和弦的力量，它是今天发布的《Nobody Wants This》第三季原声带的附加曲目。这是麦莉在专辑中收录的两首小样之一，她的无尽暑假歌曲《You》的精简版也出现在原声带和一集中。该原声带已在 Atlantic 上发行，第三季的全部 10 集现已在 Netflix 上播放。 — L.H.

paras.en: Kacey Musgraves is previewing her upcoming project Middle of Nowhere Vol. 2: Tex Mex Tapes (out Jan. 15 on Lost Highway Records) with the release of new music, including “Weekend In Texas.” “I’ve got the hat and the cattle to back it up / Everything will be great in my favorite state of mind,” she sings. Bright horns, an irresistible groove and Musgraves’ dulcet vocal tones blend luxuriously as she sings of longing for a soul-restoring few days of escape in the Lone Star State. This new release feels both classic and invigorating. — JESSICA NICHOLSON
paras.zh: 凯西·马斯格雷夫斯 (Kacey Musgraves) 正在预览她即将推出的项目《Middle of Nowhere Vol》。 2：Tex Mex Tapes（1 月 15 日在 Lost Highway Records 发行），发行新音乐，包括“Weekend In Texas”。 “我有帽子和牛来支持它/在我最喜欢的心态下一切都会很棒，”她唱道。明亮的号角、令人难以抗拒的律动和马斯格雷夫斯悦耳的音调完美地融合在一起，她唱出了对在孤星州逃亡几天恢复灵魂的渴望。这个新版本感觉既经典又充满活力。 — 杰西卡·尼科尔森

paras.en: “I’m never gonna catch you,” sings Mayer over a soft rock opening riff that recalls Bruce Springsteen’s “I’m On Fire.” The lyric immediately sets the stage for his “Tom and Jerry” metaphor to unfold — likening the famous cat-and-mouse rivalry-fueled friendship to that of a relationship where those involved may just never get right. Mayer explained the song’s inspiration on Instagram, writing in a caption: “‘Tom and Jerry’ was the name I used when saving my first voice memo with this song idea. ‘And if you ever come through, which I doubt you’ll do, I’ll run away with you.’ From that moment on, the adventure began in bringing that feeling to life.” The single arrives on Mayer’s newly-launched Sob Rock Records label in partnership with Mercury. — L.H.
paras.zh: “我永远不会抓住你，”梅耶尔在轻柔的摇滚开场即兴重复中唱道，让人想起布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀的“我着火了”。这句歌词立即为他的“汤姆和杰瑞”隐喻的展开奠定了基础——将著名的猫鼠竞争所引发的友谊比作一种关系，其中所涉及的人可能永远不会和好。梅耶尔在 Instagram 上解释了这首歌的灵感，并在标题中写道：“‘汤姆和杰瑞’是我在用这首歌的想法保存我的第一个语音备忘录时使用的名字。‘如果你能成功，我怀疑你会这么做，我会和你一起逃走。’从那一刻起，冒险就开始了，将这种感觉带入生活。”这首单曲由 Mayer 与 Mercury 合作新推出的 Sob Rock Records 唱片公司发行。 — L.H.

paras.en: As the wait for Fike’s third album, How To Quit Smoking, continues — ahead of its pushed release to Oct. 30 — he shares another taste of what’s to come. “Pangea” sounds like a modern-day recording of an Atmosphere track in the best ways, balancing his melodic rapping with sunny, uptempo production resulting in a breezy song that, at just under two-and-a-half minutes, begs for a repeat. — L.H.
paras.zh: Fike 的第三张专辑《How To Quit Smoking》将于 10 月 30 日发行，等待时间仍在继续，他分享了对即将推出的专辑的另一种品味。 “Pangea”听起来像是一首 Atmosphere 歌曲的现代录音，以最好的方式平衡了他的旋律说唱与阳光明媚、快节奏的制作，从而形成了一首轻快的歌曲，在不到两分半钟的时间里，乞求重复。 — L.H.

paras.en: Norwegian indie-pop singer Girl In Red started teasing a new, pensive project earlier this month when she changed her Instagram handle to @girlinblue and updated her bio to read: “once red, now blue.” Now, just a few weeks later, she has dropped a four-song EP, aptly titled BLUE, exploring the heartbreak that accompanies a breakup. “There’s a hole in the door with your silhouette/ A void in my chest, the longer it’s been, the bigger it gets,” she sings at the start of “Missing Person.” The song quickly becomes an accountability anthem, with Girl In Red acknowledging, “In your absence, I’ve met with my actions…Have you seen this girl? ‘Cause I blew it with her.” Who knows if owning up will help, but at least it can offer some relief. — L.H.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，挪威独立流行歌手“Girl In Red”开始酝酿一个新的项目，当时她将自己的 Instagram 用户名改为@girlinblue，并将个人简介更新为：“曾经是红色，现在是蓝色。”现在，仅仅几周后，她就推出了一张四首歌的 EP，题为《BLUE》，探讨了分手带来的心碎。 “门上有一个洞，有你的剪影/我的胸口有一个空洞，时间越长，它就越大，”她在《失踪的人》的开头唱道。这首歌很快成为一首责任赞歌，红衣女孩承认，“在你不在的情况下，我已经认识到了我的行为……你见过这个女孩吗？因为我把它搞砸了。”谁知道承认是否会有帮助，但至少可以缓解一些压力。 — L.H.

paras.en: After overcoming underdog status to score of the biggest hip-hop hits of 2026 with her New York Knicks-approved “Spend Dat,” Yung Miami has finally unveiled her long-awaited debut solo studio album, Watch Dis. Featuring a wide range of collaborators, including Travis Scott, Summer Walker, Trina, Quavo and more, the 21-track set finds the City Girls alum grounding a revelatory autobiography in the history and culture of her hometown. — KYLE DENIS
paras.zh: 在凭借纽约尼克斯队认可的《Spend Dat》克服失败地位，成为 2026 年最热门嘻哈热门歌曲后，Yung Miami 终于推出了她期待已久的首张个人录音室专辑《Watch Dis》。这张包含 21 首曲目的专辑由 Travis Scott、Summer Walker、Trina、Quavo 等众多合作者组成，这位 City Girls 校友将一部以家乡历史和文化为基础的启示性自传。 — 凯尔·丹尼斯

paras.en: After linking up with Clipse and Pharrell Williams for the Let God Sort Em Out standout “The Birds Don’t Sing,” John Legend linked up with the Oscar-nominated production powerhouse for Muse, their first full album together after 20 years of friendship. Primarily written and recorded at Williams’ Louis Vuitton HQ studio in Paris, the two superstars spend the 16-track set blending luscious string arrangements with hard-hitting horns and 808s for what Legend calls a “Black James Bond aesthetic.” — K.D.
paras.zh: 在与 Clipse 和 Pharrell Williams 联手制作了《Let God Sort Em Out》中的杰出作品《The Birds Don't Sing》之后，John Legend 又与这位获得奥斯卡提名的制作巨头联手制作了《Muse》，这是他们 20 年后合作的首张完整专辑。这两位超级巨星主要在威廉姆斯位于巴黎的路易威登总部工作室创作和录制，这首包含 16 首曲目的专辑将甜美的弦乐编排与强劲的圆号和 808 融为一体，形成了 Legend 所称的“黑人詹姆斯·邦德美学”。 — K.D.

articles.title: 5 Things You Didn’t See on TV at The 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards
articles.author: Jessica Roiz

paras.en: Fuerza Regida was the big winner at the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards, sweeping eight awards during the ceremony Thursday night (Oct. 22) at the James L. Knight Center in Miami, FL.
paras.zh: Fuerza Regida 是 2026 年公告牌拉丁音乐奖的大赢家，在周四晚（10 月 22 日）在佛罗里达州迈阿密詹姆斯·L·奈特中心举行的颁奖典礼上包揽了八个奖项。

paras.en: The Música Mexicana sensation’s big night included Hot Latin Song of the Year; Streaming Song of the Year; Global 200 Latin Song of the Year; Regional Mexican Song of the Year; Hot Latin Songs Artist of the Year, Duo or Group; Top Latin Albums Artist of the Year, Duo or Group; and Regional Mexican Artist of the Year, Duo or Group.
paras.zh: 轰动墨西哥音乐界的盛大之夜包括年度热门拉丁歌曲；年度流媒体歌曲；全球200首年度拉丁歌曲；年度墨西哥地区歌曲；年度热门拉丁歌曲艺术家、二人组或团体；年度最佳拉丁专辑艺术家、二人组或团体；年度墨西哥地区艺术家、二人组或团体奖。

paras.en: The Latin favorites also won the Billboard Vanguard Award for their innovative and creative vision. Other special award recipients this year included Cristian Castro who was honored with the Billboard Lifetime Achievement Award, Rosalía with the Hall of Fame Award, and Rubén Blades with the Billboard Icon Award.
paras.zh: 这支拉丁热门乐队还因其创新和创意愿景赢得了公告牌先锋奖。今年的其他特别奖获得者包括荣获公告牌终身成就奖的克里斯蒂安·卡斯特罗、荣获名人堂奖的罗莎莉亚和荣获公告牌偶像奖的鲁本·布雷兹。

paras.en: “I wouldn’t be able to do what I do if it weren’t for the artists who came before me and paved the way—artists like him, whom I admire so much. Celia Cruz, Rocío, Vicente Fernandez, Daddy Yankee…it is incredible to be receiving this today,” Rosalía said during her speech. “And last but certainly not least, thank you to Latin America for the place you’ve given me, and for all these years of inspiration and lessons. I hope to keep finding ways to return all that affection and generosity to you. Here’s to many more years — thank you!”
paras.zh: “如果没有那些在我之前为我铺平道路的艺术家——像他这样的艺术家，我非常钦佩他们，我就不可能取得今天的成就。西莉亚·克鲁兹、罗西奥、文森特·费尔南德斯、洋基老爹……今天收到这个消息真是令人难以置信，”罗莎莉亚在演讲中说道。 “最后但并非最不重要的一点是，感谢拉丁美洲给了我这个地方，以及这些年来给我的灵感和教训。我希望继续寻找方法来回报你们所有的感情和慷慨。谨此祝愿更多的岁月——谢谢你们！”

paras.en: Ahead of all the glitz and glamor that beamed out on Telemundo and Peacock, Billboard’s Ingrid Fajardo and Jessica Roiz hosted a livestream on the blue carpet, where many exciting and behind-the-scenes moments were captured.
paras.zh: 在 Telemundo 和 Peacock 闪耀光芒之前，Billboard 的 Ingrid Fajardo 和 Jessica Roiz 在蓝毯上主持了一场直播，捕捉到了许多激动人心的幕后时刻。

paras.en: Below, check out five things you didn’t see on TV:
paras.zh: 下面，看看你在电视上没有看到的五件事：

paras.en: - Victor Manuelle’s Plena Party Before kicking off the evening with the performance of his new single “La Gozadera en Navidad” alongside Elvis Crespo, Victor Manuelle brought the party to the blue carpet. There, the one-time finalist talked about his holiday traditions which are reflected in his new holiday album that includes collaborations with Gilberto Santa Rosa, Tito Nieves, José Alberto “El Canario,” and many more. To further get us in the Christmas spirit, the Puerto Rican singer invited rising group BLB to spice up the livestream with a fun plena tune.
paras.zh: - Victor Manuelle 的 Plena 派对 在与 Elvis Crespo 一起表演他的新单曲《La Gozadera en Navidad》拉开晚会之前，Victor Manuelle 将派对带到了蓝地毯上。在那里，这位曾经的决赛入围者谈到了他的节日传统，这些传统反映在他的新节日专辑中，其中包括与 Gilberto Santa Rosa、Tito Nieves、José Alberto “El Canario”等的合作。为了进一步让我们感受到圣诞气氛，这位波多黎各歌手邀请了新兴乐队 BLB 用有趣的全乐曲为直播增添了趣味。

paras.en: - Tito Double P Teases New Album Tito Double P—who took three awards, including Top Latin Album of the Year for DINASTÍA, his joint album with Peso Pluma—revealed that he’s working on a new album for 2027. “We’re going to see a Tito who is more attuned to the genres that are currently trending, featuring global artists,” he said. “There’s music on the way that includes many collaborations with fellow artists from here, such as Anuel AA.” The forthcoming collab-stacked set will follow Tito’s latest studio album, Acomodo, released earlier this year and has no collaborations.
paras.zh: - Tito Double P 预告新专辑 Tito Double P 荣获三项大奖，其中包括他与 Peso Pluma 的联合专辑 DINASTÍA 的年度最佳拉丁专辑奖。他透露，他正在制作 2027 年的新专辑。“我们将看到 Tito 更适合当前流行的流派，包括全球艺术家，”他说。 “即将推出的音乐包括与来自这里的其他艺术家的许多合作，例如 Anuel AA。”即将推出的合作系列将遵循 Tito 今年早些时候发行的最新录音室专辑《Acomodo》，但没有任何合作。

paras.en: - Manifesting With Santos Bravos At the blue carpet, Santos Bravos talked about their first major collaboration with Enrique Iglesias in “Oh Laka Laka La,” and while they are extremely grateful and excited with the opportunity, they are ready to conquer another dream collab. Group members Alejandro Aramburú, Drew Venegas, Gabi Bermúdez, Kauê Penna, and Kenneth Lavíll, all agreed that they would love to one day record a song with Cristian Castro. In fact, the boys crooned us with an a cappella version of Castro’s “Lloviendo Estrellas,” before we all held hands and manifested the Santos Bravos, Cristian collab to happen.
paras.zh: - 与桑托斯·布拉沃斯 (Santos Bravos) 一起亮相 在蓝毯上，桑托斯·布拉沃斯 (Santos Bravos) 谈到了他们与恩里克·伊格莱西亚斯 (Enrique Iglesias) 在《Oh Laka Laka La》中的首次重大合作，虽然他们对这次机会感到非常感激和兴奋，但他们已经准备好征服另一个梦想合作。乐队成员 Alejandro Aramburú、Drew Venegas、Gabi Bermúdez、Kauê Penna 和 Kenneth Lavíll 都一致表示，他们很乐意有一天与 Cristian Castro 一起录制一首歌曲。事实上，男孩们用无伴奏合唱版的卡斯特罗的《Lloviendo Estrellas》低声吟唱，然后我们手拉着手，展示了桑托斯·布拉沃斯和克里斯蒂安的合作。

paras.en: - Confessional With Rosalía Rosalía surprised Billboard during the livestream, where she spoke extensively about her successful LUX world tour that wrapped in Miami in September. What follows? The Spanish singer-songwriter—who won three awards and received the Billboard Hall of Fame award on Thursday (Oct. 22)—loosely hinted that she’s working on new music. However, one of the most spontaneous moments of the night was when co-hosts Ingrid and Jessica confessed themselves with the singer to which she was completely appalled with.
paras.zh: - Confessional With Rosalía Rosalía 在直播中让 Billboard 感到惊讶，她在直播中广泛谈论了 9 月份在迈阿密结束的成功的 LUX 世界巡演。接下来是什么？这位西班牙创作歌手荣获三项大奖，并于周四（10 月 22 日）荣获公告牌名人堂奖，她隐约暗示她正在创作新音乐。然而，当晚最自发的时刻之一是联合主持人英格丽德和杰西卡向她完全震惊的歌手表白。

paras.en: - Cuban Representation For the first time in history, the Billboard Latin Music Awards boasted a strong representation of Cuban reparto artists. During the livestream, we spoke to Wow Popy, who released his new album Mundial and formed part of the first-ever reparto panel at Billboard Latin Music Week just a few days earlier. We also caught up with duo Pututi and Nesty, who were moments ahead of making their TV debut with a medley performance of “Efimero” alongside Erick Brian and their reparto version of Tony Dize’s “El Doctorado.” Additionally, Rey Tony and Helabusador, two of the acts behind the ultra-viral song “Dichavate,” also strutted the blue carpet for the first time.
paras.zh: - 古巴代表 公告牌拉丁音乐奖历史上首次拥有强大的古巴表演艺术家代表。在直播期间，我们采访了 Wow Popy，他发行了新专辑《Mundial》，并在几天前参加了 Billboard 拉丁音乐周的首届 Reparto 小组。我们还采访了 Pututi 和 Nesty 组合，他们即将在电视上首次亮相，与 Erick Brian 一起表演了《Efimero》的混合表演，并翻唱了 Tony Dize 的《El Doctorado》。此外，超火热歌曲《Dichavate》的两位创作者 Rey Tony 和 Helabusador 也首次走上蓝毯。

articles.title: ‘Clayface’ Aims to Give DC Studios a Box Office Win as ‘You Can See Everything’ Stays Strong
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: Clayface looks to give the DC Studios team a reason for a happy face in its opening weekend at the box office, although it will encounter competition from the second weekend of A24’s You Can See Everything, which continues to get audiences pumped.
paras.zh: 《Clayface》预计将给 DC Studios 团队带来一个在首映周末票房大放异彩的理由，尽管它将面临来自 A24 电影《你可以看到一切》第二周末的竞争，该片继续吸引观众。

paras.en: Warner Bros. projects a launch between $25 million and $30 million domestically for Clayface from more than 3,400 North American theaters, along with an additional $20 million to $25 million internationally. Director James Watkins’ $44 million-budgeted body-horror feature stars Tom Rhys Harries and Naomi Ackie in the story of Matt Hagen (Harries), an actor who turns to a scientist (Ackie) for assistance after his face becomes disfigured.
paras.zh: 华纳兄弟预计《粘土脸》在北美 3,400 多家影院的国内上映票房将达到 2,500 万至 3,000 万美元，国际票房预计将达到 2,000 万至 2,500 万美元。詹姆斯·沃特金斯导演的这部耗资 4400 万美元的人体恐怖故事片由汤姆·里斯·哈里斯和娜奥米·阿基主演，讲述了演员马特·哈根（哈里斯饰）在脸部毁容后向科学家（阿基饰）寻求帮助的故事。

paras.en: This marks the third feature release in the planned slate for DC Studios bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran. Superman kicked off the DC Universe’s film side with a strong start last year, while Supergirl sputtered over the summer, with the $170 million-budgeted movie debuting to a soft $37.1 million domestically before ending its run with $126 million worldwide. Clayface has the benefit of a far more modest budget.
paras.zh: 这标志着 DC Studios 老板詹姆斯·古恩 (James Gunn) 和彼得·萨夫兰 (Peter Safran) 计划发布的第三个功能。去年，《超人》在 DC 宇宙的电影方面取得了强劲的开局，而《女超人》则在整个夏天表现不佳，这部预算为 1.7 亿美元的电影在国内首映票房为 3710 万美元，最终在全球票房为 1.26 亿美元。粘土脸的好处是预算要少得多。

paras.en: Clayface has fared better with critics than Supergirl, holding a 75 percent approval from Rotten Tomatoes reviewers, as opposed to the 52 score for the summer’s Milly Alcock-led release. In his review for The Hollywood Reporter, critic Frank Sheck called Clayface “a big swing that definitely pays off.”
paras.zh: 《Clayface》在评论界的表现比《女超人》要好，烂番茄影评人的认可度为 75%，而米莉·阿尔科克 (Milly Alcock) 主导的今年夏季发行的电影获得了 52% 的认可度。评论家 Frank Sheck 在《好莱坞报道》的评论中称 Clayface 是“一次绝对有回报的重大转变”。

paras.en: Offering potential competition for the weekend’s top spot is A24’s buzzy Elizabeth Holmes documentary You Can See Everything, which expands to 2,600 North American theaters after playing in 855 in its debut frame. Directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim‘s film about the disgraced Theranos founder’s life before beginning her prison sentence was a sensation in its opening weekend, overperforming to the tune of $15 million as it placed second behind Paramount and Legendary’s Street Fighter.
paras.zh: A24 热门纪录片《你可以看到一切》(You Can See Everything) 为周末的头把交椅提供了潜在的竞争，该片首映在 855 场上映后，已在北美 2,600 家影院上映。导演内森·菲尔德 (Nathan Fielder) 和兰斯·奥本海姆 (Lance Oppenheim) 执导的影片讲述了这位名誉扫地的希拉洛斯 (Theranos) 创始人入狱前的生活，该片在首映周末引起了轰动，票房收入高达 1500 万美元，位居第二，仅次于派拉蒙影业和传奇影业的《街头霸王》。

paras.en: You Can See Everything is projected to hit at least $18 million and could likely go beyond that.
paras.zh: 《你可以看到一切》预计票房至少达到 1800 万美元，而且很可能会超出这个数字。

paras.en: Hitting theaters this weekend is Laika’s animated stop-motion feature Wildwood from director Travis Knight. It is set for 2,926 North American theaters and holds a sterling 100 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes.
paras.zh: 特拉维斯·奈特导演的莱卡定格动画电影《怀尔德伍德》将于本周末上映。该片预计在北美 2,926 家影院上映，并在烂番茄上获得了 100% 的好评。

paras.en: Additionally, Sony’s Klara and the Sun, with Jenna Ortega and Amy Adams starring for director Taika Waititi, debuts over the weekend, as does Amazon MGM Studios’ Ali G: Who Iz I?, as Sacha Baron Cohen‘s comedy hits theaters for just one week ahead of its streaming launch on Prime Video.
paras.zh: 此外，索尼的《克拉拉与太阳》（由珍娜·奥尔特加和艾米·亚当斯主演，导演塔伊卡·维迪蒂主演）将于周末首映；亚马逊米高梅影业的《阿里 G：我是谁？》由萨莎·拜伦·科恩执导的喜剧在 Prime Video 上流媒体上映前仅一周上映。

paras.en: Another newcomer is Black Bear’s Sundance standout Wicker, with directors Alex Huston Fischer and Eleanor Wilson’s romantic fantasy starring Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgård.
paras.zh: 另一位新人是《黑熊》在圣丹斯电影节的杰出演员威克，该片由亚历克斯·休斯顿·费舍尔和埃莉诺·威尔逊执导，由奥利维亚·科尔曼和亚历山大·斯卡斯加德主演的浪漫奇幻片。

articles.title: Chrishell Stause Says She Won’t Be Watching ‘Selling Sunset’ Season 10, But Her Lawyers Will Be
articles.author: Tiffany Taylor

paras.en: The sun has set on Chrishell Stause‘s time on Selling Sunset, and she’s ready to move on.
paras.zh: 克里谢尔·斯塔斯 (Chrishell Stause) 的“销售日落”时间已经落山，她已准备好继续前进。

paras.en: The reality star says she “won’t” be watching the forthcoming tenth installment of the Netflix series following her exit after nine seasons on the real estate reality show.
paras.zh: 这位真人秀明星表示，在她退出房地产真人秀节目九季后，她“不会”观看 Netflix 剧集即将推出的第十部。

paras.en: “And I don’t mean that in a bad way,” Stause told The Hollywood Reporter on the red carpet at THR‘s Creator A-List Party presented by UTA. “I hope they have an amazing season. I’Il have lawyers let me know if there’s defamation, but I feel like, to be honest with you, if you love something, let it go.”
paras.zh: “我的意思并不是不好的，”斯塔斯在 UTA 主办的 THR 一线创作者派对红毯上告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “我希望他们有一个精彩的赛季。如果存在诽谤，我会让律师告诉我，但说实话，我觉得，如果你喜欢某件事，就放手吧。”

paras.en: Stause went on to acknowledge that being on the series brought her “a lot of really amazing things,” and even said that she had a good time on the show, so she harbors no ill will towards the series’ future.
paras.zh: 斯塔斯接着承认，参加该剧给她带来了“很多真正令人惊奇的事情”，甚至说她在剧中度过了一段愉快的时光，所以她对该剧的未来没有恶意。

paras.en: “I want [the cast] to go on and do their thing,” Stause said. “It’s not for me. So, I really wish it the best.”
paras.zh: “我希望[演员]继续做他们的事情，”斯塔斯说。 “这不适合我。所以，我真的希望一切顺利。”

paras.en: However, just because she won’t be watching, don’t think she won’t have people on her team paying attention.
paras.zh: 然而，不要因为她不会观看，就认为她的团队中的人不会关注她。

paras.en: “That being said, don’t defame me,” Stause clarified. “I will sue you.”
paras.zh: “话虽如此，请不要诽谤我，”斯塔斯澄清道。 “我会起诉你。”

paras.en: Stause revealed she was leaving the real estate reality series back in November 2025 following the release of season nine in October of that year.
paras.zh: Stause 透露，她将于 2025 年 11 月离开房地产真人秀节目，第九季于当年 10 月播出。

paras.en: “I’ve gotten to a place where I don’t need the show financially,” she told Bustle at the time. “I’m lucky to have other forms of employment, because it’s no longer good for my mental health.” During Selling Sunset‘s ninth season, a central storyline was Stause and Emma Hernan’s conflict centered around Hernan’s boyfriend.
paras.zh: “我已经到了一个地步，在经济上我不再需要这个节目了，”她当时告诉 Bustle。 “我很幸运有其他形式的工作，因为它不再对我的心理健康有好处。”在《卖日落》第九季中，一个中心故事情节是斯塔斯和艾玛·埃尔南围绕埃尔南的男朋友发生的冲突。

paras.en: “He compared being nonbinary to having a mental illness,” Stause alleged. “He constantly posts anti-trans stuff… He thinks it’s too woke if you don’t sing the N-word in songs. He posted something the other day, with a gun in view, saying he wants to ‘sue [me for lying] my dick off.’”
paras.zh: “他将非二元性别比作患有精神疾病，”斯塔斯声称。 “他经常发布反跨性别的内容……他认为如果你不唱歌曲中的 N 字词，那就太醒了。前几天他拿着枪发布了一些内容，说他想‘起诉我撒谎’。”

paras.en: While speaking to THR, Stause opened up about life post-Selling Sunset.
paras.zh: 在接受《好莱坞报道》采访时，斯塔斯讲述了《出售日落》之后的生活。

paras.en: “It’s been exciting to find projects that I really love that I’m excited to do from the heart,” she said. “So, I think that’s been really where I found my lane. In the creation of shows and now pitching shows and finding that being not only in front of the camera, but behind the camera is nice.”
paras.zh: “找到我真正喜欢的项目真是令人兴奋，我很高兴能从心底里去做，”她说。 “所以，我认为这确实是我找到自己道路的地方。在节目创作和现在的节目推介中，我发现不仅在镜头前，而且在镜头后也很好。”

paras.en: While Stause said she couldn’t reveal details about her upcoming projects just yet, she teased that she will have more to share “soon.”
paras.zh: 虽然斯塔斯表示她目前还无法透露即将推出的项目的细节，但她开玩笑说她“很快”就会有更多内容可以分享。

paras.en: As for Selling Sunset, the series was renewed for a tenth season in April of this year. No official release date has been announced.
paras.zh: 至于《卖日落》，该剧已于今年四月续订第十季。官方发布日期尚未公布。

articles.title: ‘Nobody Wants This’ Creator Erin Foster Reacts to Adam Brody Saying He Supports “A Free Palestine”: “It’s Complicated”
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Nobody Wants This creator Erin Foster is sharing her opinion on Adam Brody recently telling GQ he is in support of “a free Palestine.”
paras.zh: 《没人想要这个》的创作者艾琳·福斯特 (Erin Foster) 分享了她对亚当·布罗迪 (Adam Brody) 的看法，她最近告诉《GQ》，他支持“一个自由的巴勒斯坦”。

paras.en: During an upcoming appearance on the Not Skinny But Not Fat podcast, per Entertainment Weekly, Foster was asked by host Amanda Hirsch how she felt about the actor’s previous comments about the Israel-Gaza war.
paras.zh: 据《娱乐周刊》报道，在即将亮相的“不瘦不胖”播客中，主持人阿曼达·赫希问福斯特，她对福斯特之前对以色列-加沙战争的评论有何看法。

paras.en: “You know, it’s complicated. I think our work environment, our set is very similar to dinner tables around the world where people are having debate and discussion and disagreeing,” the series creator said. “While I love Adam, I also disagree with him, and that’s okay.”
paras.zh: “你知道，这很复杂。我认为我们的工作环境、我们的场景与世界各地的餐桌非常相似，人们在那里进行辩论、讨论和意见分歧，”该剧的创作者说。 “虽然我爱亚当，但我也不同意他的观点，这没关系。”

paras.en: “I think that as the creator of the show, all I can say is that I want our Jewish fans to know that I see you and I hear you and I understand how you feel,” Foster continued. “And the show has always been and always will be a love letter to Judaism. That is why I made this show. It’s because of how beautiful of an experience I’ve had becoming Jewish and being a Jewish person, and sitting here right now at this time in the world where there is almost zero positive representation of Jewish people, I think it’s so important to have that.”
paras.zh: “我认为作为该节目的创作者，我所能说的就是我希望我们的犹太粉丝知道我看到你，我听到你，我理解你的感受，”福斯特继续说道。 “这个节目一直以来都是一封写给犹太教的情书。这就是我制作这个节目的原因。这是因为我成为犹太人和成为犹太人的经历是多么美好，而此时此刻，在世界上犹太人的积极代表几乎为零，我认为拥有这样的经历非常重要。”

paras.en: “That being said, everyone is entitled to a different opinion than me. I can just tell you what I created this show for, what the intention of the show is,” Foster concluded.
paras.zh: “话虽这么说，每个人都有权拥有与我不同的意见。我可以告诉你我创作这个节目的目的是什么，这个节目的目的是什么，”福斯特总结道。

paras.en: During a September profile with GQ, Brody, who appears on the Netflix series as a rabbi, discussed his political activism, and was asked if he thinks Hollywood has gotten more conservative. “I guess outspokenly so, yes. … Between COVID, a second Trump term, Israel-Gaza, it’s really brought out some different beliefs that I was ignorant to, and then disheartened by.”
paras.zh: 布罗迪在 Netflix 剧集中饰演拉比，在 9 月份接受《GQ》采访时，他讨论了自己的政治激进主义，并被问及他是否认为好莱坞变得更加保守。 “我想直言不讳地说，是的。……在新冠疫情、特朗普第二个任期、以色列-加沙之间，这确实引发了一些我以前不了解、然后又感到沮丧的不同信念。”

paras.en: The O.C. actor was asked how Israel-Gaza has come up in his messaging, to which he responded, “Truthfully, it hasn’t. I have spoken a lot about it privately. I haven’t spoken much about it publicly.” When asked if he’d like to speak about the topic, The O.C. actor said, “Put me down as thinking it’s a genocide. Put me down as wanting a free Palestine.”
paras.zh: O.C.当演员被问到他的信息中如何提到以色列-加沙时，他回答说：“说实话，没有。我私下谈过很多关于它的事情。我还没有公开谈论过很多。”当被问及是否愿意谈论这个话题时，The O.C.演员说：“因为我认为这是种族灭绝。因为我想要一个自由的巴勒斯坦。”

paras.en: “It’s awful that it’s taken so much death and misery, but it does feel like it’s reaching a breaking point that it should have a while ago,” he added. “I’m hopeful that another administration can really do some good and correct some of these policies that are helping that situation be as awful as it is.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“经历了如此多的死亡和痛苦，这真是太可怕了，但确实感觉它已经达到了早就应该达到的临界点。” “我希望另一届政府能够真正做一些好事并纠正一些导致局势变得如此糟糕的政策。”

paras.en: In an August 2025 interview with The Hollywood Reporter, Foster said of the show, “It was really important to me and continues to be really important to tell positive Jewish stories. I know that it can be polarizing, but it shouldn’t be. This is not the show to tackle conflict in Israel and Palestine.”
paras.zh: 在 2025 年 8 月接受《好莱坞报道》采访时，福斯特谈到该剧时表示，“讲述积极的犹太故事对我来说非常重要，并且仍然非常重要。我知道它可能会两极分化，但不应该如此。这不是一个解决以色列和巴勒斯坦冲突的节目。”

paras.en: “I’m not the person to tell that story,” Foster added. “And after [the attacks on] Oct. 7 happened, there were conversations around if we were going to dive into it, and the truth is, the way that I can get my message across best is by shedding a positive light on Jewish characters and Jewish traditions. I don’t think somebody watching wants to see another voice give you their opinion on what’s happening.”
paras.zh: “我不是讲这个故事的人，”福斯特补充道。 “10 月 7 日（袭击事件）发生后，大家都在讨论我们是否要深入研究此事，事实是，我能最好地传达我的信息的方式是对犹太人物和犹太传统进行积极的阐述。我认为观看者不想看到另一个声音对正在发生的事情发表自己的看法。”

paras.en: Nobody Wants This released its third season on Netflix Thursday. Brody was nominated for a 2025 Emmy for his role in the series, and won the Critics Choice Award for best comedy actor that same year.
paras.zh: 《没人想要》周四在 Netflix 上发布了第三季。布罗迪因其在该剧中的角色获得 2025 年艾美奖提名，并于同年获得评论家选择奖最佳喜剧演员。

articles.title: Wealthy Chinese move offshore money to U.S. banks as Beijing’s tax net widens

paras.en: SINGAPORE — Wealthy Chinese rattled by Beijing's widening hunt for overseas wealth are turning to a once-familiar refuge for their money: the U.S.
paras.zh: 新加坡——中国富人对北京不断扩大的海外财富追逐感到不安，他们正在转向曾经熟悉的资金避难所：美国。

paras.en: Private bankers and lawyers who work with Chinese clients say inquiries about opening U.S. bank accounts have grown in the months after Beijing imposed retroactive taxes on offshore wealth in July, moving assets previously stored in Singapore or Hong Kong there to stay further away from Beijing's reach.
paras.zh: 与中国客户合作的私人银行家和律师表示，自北京7月份对离岸财富征收追溯税、将之前存放在新加坡或香港的资产转移到那里以远离北京的影响力之后的几个月里，有关开设美国银行账户的询问有所增加。

paras.en: "It has become relatively prevalent," said Keith Tan, CEO of Singapore-based Golden Acacia Capital, who is helping Chinese clients manage their offshore portfolios. His clients began planning exits to the U.S. in July, and some have the accounts set up in less than two months. "The hurdle is not that high for Chinese clients to open American accounts and transfer assets there."
paras.zh: 总部位于新加坡的金合欢资本公司首席执行官基思·谭（Keith Tan）表示：“这种现象已经变得相对普遍。”他正在帮助中国客户管理他们的离岸投资组合。他的客户从七月份开始计划离开美国，有些客户在不到两个月的时间内就开设了账户。 “对于中国客户来说，在美国开设账户并转移资产的障碍并不高。”

paras.en: Wealthy clients tend to choose large private banks while smaller accounts go to regional banks or online brokers, Tan said.
paras.zh: 谭说，富裕的客户倾向于选择大型私人银行，而较小的账户则选择区域银行或在线经纪商。

paras.en: The rush has gained urgency with China's new tax regime on offshore trusts. Authorities said in July that income and gains from overseas trusts owned by Chinese tax residents would be taxed at 20%, setting off a scramble for cash and alternative structures.
paras.zh: 随着中国针对离岸信托的新税收制度的实施，这种热潮变得更加紧迫。当局7月份表示，中国税收居民拥有的海外信托的收入和收益将按20%的税率征税，引发了对现金和替代结构的争夺。

paras.en: Lawyers in Singapore and Hong Kong have been working to tally how much tax their clients owe, facilitating trusts' unwinding, sales of shares in listed companies or applying for loans to meet the outsized tax bill.
paras.zh: 新加坡和香港的律师一直在努力计算客户所欠税款，协助信托解散、出售上市公司股票或申请贷款，以满足巨额税款。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the U.S. sits outside the Common Reporting Standard, or CRS, the OECD framework under which more than 100 jurisdictions automatically share financial account data. While banks in Singapore and Hong Kong are supposed to report China-linked accounts to Beijing, American banks have no such obligation.
paras.zh: 与此同时，美国不在共同报告标准（CRS）之外，该标准是经合组织的框架，根据该框架，100多个司法管辖区自动共享金融账户数据。虽然新加坡和香港的银行应该向北京报告与中国有关的账户，但美国银行没有这样的义务。

paras.en: Non-resident clients who open foreign bank accounts in the U.S. can also find investment vehicles with reduced or no tax-filing obligations to the Internal Revenue Service, said James Wang, CEO of Blue Brick Consulting Group, a private-client tax advisor. But China's latest regulations require people classified as Chinese tax residents to self-declare worldwide income to Beijing, Wang said.
paras.zh: 私人客户税务顾问 Blue Brick Consulting Group 首席执行官 James Wang 表示，在美国开设外国银行账户的非居民客户也可以找到投资工具，减少或无需向国税局报税。但王说，中国最新的规定要求被归类为中国纳税居民的人向北京自行申报全球收入。

paras.en: Banks in New York are seizing the opportunity to offer a solution that could shield Chinese customers from their country's tax man. U.S. banks are straining to keep up with the rise in demand, according to a New York-based wealth-planning advisor who works with Chinese family offices.
paras.zh: 纽约的银行正在抓住机会提供一种解决方案，保护中国客户免受本国税务人员的侵害。一位与中国家族办公室合作的纽约财富规划顾问表示，美国银行正竭力跟上需求的增长。

paras.en: "With inquiries surging, some banks have shortened the timeframe for clients to meet required minimum capital commitments" before the accounts are subject to closure, said the advisor, who requested anonymity to speak about bank processes.
paras.zh: 这位要求匿名谈论银行流程的顾问表示，“随着咨询量的激增，一些银行缩短了客户在账户关闭之前满足最低资本承诺要求的时间”。

paras.en: Chinese families with offspring holding U.S. green cards have also used foreign grantor trusts – structures treated as owned by their non-American founder – to shield them from some tax exposure in the U.S., Tan said. Low-tax states such as Nevada and Florida have become popular choices, he added.
paras.zh: 谭说，子女持有美国绿卡的中国家庭也利用外国授予人信托——这种结构被视为由其非美国创始人拥有——来保护他们免受美国的一些税收风险。他补充说，内华达州和佛罗里达州等低税州已成为受欢迎的选择。

paras.en: "They are gambling on not being disclosed, because the U.S. does not share information as part of the CRS system; they can dodge tax authorities," said Clifford Ng, a partner at Zhong Lun law firm in Hong Kong. Ng also expects that some with Hong Kong or Singapore residency whose trusts have not yet been flagged to Beijing may unwind those structures and transfer the money out.
paras.zh: 香港中伦律师事务所合伙人克利福德·吴(Clifford Ng)表示：“他们赌的是不被披露，因为美国不会将信息作为CRS系统的一部分进行共享；他们可以躲避税务机关。”吴还预计，一些拥有香港或新加坡居住权但其信托尚未被北京标记的人可能会解除这些结构并将资金转移出去。

paras.en: Lawyers caution that though the route works for now to avoid disclosure, it may be temporary. Money held offshore has probably already been reported to Beijing through the CRS and would "have shown up in China at some point," Ng said, so a transfer from a Singapore or Hong Kong bank to a U.S. one would be visible on its way out.
paras.zh: 律师警告说，尽管该路线目前可以避免信息泄露，但这可能是暂时的。吴说，海外持有的资金可能已经通过 CRS 报告给北京，并且“在某个时候会出现在中国”，因此从新加坡或香港银行转移到美国银行的资金在流出时就会可见。

paras.en: "They may still be in breach of the rules because they have an undisclosed offshore account that's making money and they're not declaring it onshore," Ng said. "Hiding is not tax planning."
paras.zh: “他们可能仍然违反了规定，因为他们有一个未公开的离岸账户正在赚钱，但他们没有在境内申报，”吴说。 “隐藏不是税收筹划。”

paras.en: Washington's Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act requires foreign banks to report American clients, but so far there's no matching automatic flow from U.S. banks to Beijing.
paras.zh: 华盛顿的《外国账户税收合规法案》要求外国银行报告美国客户，但到目前为止，还没有相应的从美国银行流向北京的自动资金流。

paras.en: Cris Cao, Beijing-based partner at W&H Law Firm, agreed on the risk of Beijing's ability to tax money moved to the U.S. "Even if they move all the money out of the CRS-reported accounts and into U.S. bank accounts, that doesn't naturally reduce or wipe out the tax authorities' right to tax, or their obligation to pay," he said.
paras.zh: W&H律师事务所驻北京合伙人Cris Cao同意北京方面对转移到美国的资金征税的风险。“即使他们将所有资金从CRS报告账户转移到美国银行账户，这自然不会减少或消除税务机关的征税权利或纳税义务，”他说。

paras.en: "There was a record of it being transferred out," Cao said, and "that alone is enough for the tax authorities to levy tax."
paras.zh: “有转出的记录，”曹说，“仅凭这一点就足以让税务机关征税了。”

paras.en: What's more, the window of opportunity may have closed. Moving money that is already offshore around is relatively easy, but getting capital out of mainland China has become increasingly difficult.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，机会之窗可能已经关闭。将已经转移到海外的资金相对容易，但将资金转移出中国大陆却变得越来越困难。

paras.en: "Nearly no sizeable money onshore will be able to leave the country from now on," said Jingkuan Lin, a private banker at Bank of Singapore, who sees the offshore banking industry being further limited to serving the existing pool of capital outside China.
paras.zh: 新加坡银行私人银行家林景宽表示：“从现在起，几乎没有大量境内资金能够离开中国。”他认为离岸银行业将进一步局限于为中国以外的现有资金池提供服务。

articles.title: SK Hynix shares rebound after initial drop on scrapped Solidigm IPO plans

paras.en: Shares of South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix rebounded on Friday after falling as much as 3% earlier in the session, following the company's decision to halt a review of a potential U.S. initial public offering for its subsidiary Solidigm.
paras.zh: 韩国芯片制造商 SK 海力士 (SK Hynix) 决定停止对其子公司 Solidigm 可能在美国进行首次公开​​募股 (IPO) 的审查，该公司股价在盘中早些时候下跌 3% 后于周五反弹。

paras.en: The stock reversed earlier losses to trade 3.2% higher.
paras.zh: 该股扭转了早些时候的跌幅，上涨 3.2%。

paras.en: Josh Gilbert, lead analyst for APAC at investment platform eToro, said the stock's rebound suggested that concerns over a potential Solidigm IPO had been weighing on investor sentiment.
paras.zh: 投资平台 eToro 亚太区首席分析师 Josh Gilbert 表示，该股的反弹表明，对 Solidigm 潜在 IPO 的担忧一直在打压投资者情绪。

paras.en: "SK Hynix shareholders have got the outcome they were pushing for," Gilbert said, adding that "in the short term, it removes a governance worry and keeps Solidigm's value inside the company."
paras.zh: 吉尔伯特表示：“SK 海力士股东已经得到了他们所追求的结果。”他补充道，“从短期来看，这消除了治理担忧，并保留了 Solidigm 在公司内部的价值。”

paras.en: He explained that SK Hynix faces the challenge of funding Solidigm's growth without compromising share buybacks and dividends, as the company needs to demonstrate a credible funding plan as it prepares to report earnings next week.
paras.zh: 他解释说，SK 海力士面临着在不影响股票回购和股息的情况下为 Solidigm 的增长提供资金的挑战，因为该公司需要在下周准备报告收益时展示可靠的融资计划。

paras.en: "Solidigm will halt its review of potential pre-IPO and IPO options," the company said in the statement after assessing recent capital market conditions and share price trends, while also exploring various funding options to finance a new U.S. semiconductor fabrication plant amid growing demand for AI memory.
paras.zh: 该公司在评估了近期资本市场状况和股价趋势后在声明中表示，“Solidigm 将停止对潜在的 IPO 前和 IPO 选项的审查”，同时还在探索各种融资方案，以应对人工智能内存需求不断增长的情况，为新的美国半导体制造厂提供资金。

paras.en: The chip manufacturer said an IPO could have helped fund Solidigm's expansion while providing greater financial flexibility for shareholder returns, including dividends, share buybacks and share cancellations.
paras.zh: 这家芯片制造商表示，首次公开募股可能有助于为 Solidigm 的扩张提供资金，同时为股东回报提供更大的财务灵活性，包括股息、股票回购和股票注销。

paras.en: However, financial market volatility had increased and contributed to a broader correction in semiconductor stocks, prompting SK Hynix to reassess whether an IPO would benefit existing shareholders.
paras.zh: 然而，金融市场波动加剧，导致半导体股票出现更广泛的调整，促使 SK 海力士重新评估 IPO 是否会让现有股东受益。

paras.en: SK Hynix said that Solidigm's existing production facilities had limited capacity to meet rising AI-driven memory demand, underscoring the need for additional manufacturing capacity in the U.S.
paras.zh: SK 海力士表示，Solidigm 现有的生产设施产能有限，无法满足不断增长的人工智能驱动的内存需求，这突显出美国需要额外的制造能力。

paras.en: The decision also follows regulatory scrutiny in South Korea.
paras.zh: 该决定也是在韩国进行监管审查之后做出的。

paras.en: The country's financial regulator said Monday that a potential U.S. listing of Solidigm could violate South Korean rules restricting dual listings, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，韩国金融监管机构周一表示，Solidigm 可能在美国上市可能违反韩国限制双重上市的规定。

paras.en: Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Chan-jin said regulators were examining whether the IPO would require a review under the country's rules designed to protect minority shareholders.
paras.zh: 韩国金融监督院院长李灿镇 (Lee Chan-jin) 表示，监管机构正在研究 IPO 是否需要根据该国旨在保护小股东的规则进行审查。

paras.en: SK Hynix said Solidigm's investment needs remain unchanged and that it would continue exploring alternative financing options to support the subsidiary's growth and enhance shareholder value.
paras.zh: SK海力士表示，Solidigm的投资需求保持不变，将继续探索替代融资方案，以支持子公司的增长并提高股东价值。

paras.en: The announcement comes as U.S. technology stocks face pressure amid worries over AI spending.The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite slid 2.6% on Thursday, its worst session since June, while Nvidia fell 4.4% and Advanced Micro Devices dropped 8.1%.
paras.zh: 这一消息发布之际，美国科技股因人工智能支出担忧而面临压力。以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数周四下跌 2.6%，为 6 月以来最糟糕的交易日，而英伟达下跌 4.4%，Advanced Micro Devices 下跌 8.1%。

paras.en: Amid a sell-off in memory stocks, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC Thursday that he does not expect an oversupply of memory chips by 2029, despite concerns over weakening demand.
paras.zh: 在内存股遭到抛售的情况下，Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 周四对 CNBC 表示，尽管人们担心需求疲软，但他预计到 2029 年内存芯片不会出现供应过剩。

paras.en: AI data center stocks have also come under pressure amid growing concerns over financing risks and the pace of AI infrastructure expansion. Shares of CoreWeave plunged 10% on Thursday, extending their monthly decline to 36%, while Australia's NextDC tumbled nearly 40% on Wednesday after cutting its earnings forecast.
paras.zh: 由于对融资风险和人工智能基础设施扩张步伐的担忧日益加剧，人工智能数据中心股票也面临压力。 CoreWeave 股价周四暴跌 10%，月跌幅扩大至 36%，而澳大利亚 NextDC 在下调盈利预期后周三股价暴跌近 40%。

articles.title: Stock futures trade mixed after tech sector sell-off: Live updates

paras.en: U.S. equity futures were mixed in early Friday trading after tech stocks sold off on concerns that the artificial intelligence trade could be faltering, at least in the near term.
paras.zh: 由于担心人工智能交易至少在短期内可能陷入困境，科技股遭到抛售，周五早盘美国股指期货涨跌互现。

paras.en: Futures tied to the S&P 500 lost 0.04%, Dow Jones Industrial Average futures were down 92 points, or 0.17%. Nasdaq-100 futures added 0.11%.
paras.zh: 标普 500 指数期货下跌 0.04%，道琼斯工业平均指数期货下跌 92 点，跌幅 0.17%。纳斯达克 100 指数期货上涨 0.11%。

paras.en: In regular trading, the S&P 500 sank 1.2%, and the Nasdaq Composite slid 2.6%. The broad market benchmark posted its worst session since July, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq had its worst day since June. The Dow Industrials bucked the trend and closed marginally higher.
paras.zh: 常规交易中，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 1.2%，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 2.6%。大盘基准指数创下 7 月以来最糟糕的交易日，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数则创下 6 月以来最糟糕的交易日。道指逆势小幅收高。

paras.en: In Asia, South Korea's benchmark Kospi Index fell 2.42%, while Japan's Nikkei 225 lost 2.1%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index was down 0.47%. Mainland China's CSI 300 declined 1.76%, deepening its descent into a technical bear market. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 was 0.21% lower.
paras.zh: 在亚洲，韩国基准 Kospi 指数下跌 2.42%，日本日经 225 指数下跌 2.1%。香港恒生指数下跌0.47%。中国内地沪深300指数下跌1.76%，进一步陷入技术性熊市。澳大利亚 S&P/ASX 200 指数下跌 0.21%。

paras.en: Worries around artificial intelligence spending weighed down the market and dragged the U.S. tech sector to a 3% decline on the day. Nvidia dropped 4.4%, Alphabet fell 3.2%, and Advanced Micro Devices declined 8.1% as losses occurred in different parts of the technology sector.
paras.zh: 对人工智能支出的担忧打压了市场，并拖累美国科技股当日下跌 3%。 Nvidia 下跌 4.4%，Alphabet 下跌 3.2%，Advanced Micro Devices 下跌 8.1%，因科技行业不同领域均出现亏损。

paras.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC on Thursday he thought capital within the AI buildout was becoming scarce.
paras.zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋周四对 CNBC 表示，他认为人工智能建设中的资本正在变得稀缺。

paras.en: "There's a scarcity of capital. The demand [for] the capital is much greater than the availability of the capital," Huang said when asked about the neocloud segment of the AI buildout, which is proving to be fragile.
paras.zh: 当被问及人工智能建设的新云部分时，黄说：“资本稀缺。对资本的需求远远大于可用的资本。”事实证明，该领域很脆弱。

paras.en: Ed Yardeni, president of Yardeni Research, described the AI trade on Thursday as a "bubble" but said that some depressurization wouldn't be all bad.
paras.zh: 亚德尼研究公司 (Yardeni Research) 总裁埃德·亚德尼 (Ed Yardeni) 周四将人工智能交易描述为“泡沫”，但表示，一定程度的减压也并非全是坏事。

paras.en: "Taking some air out of the AI bubble is a good thing. I don't think it's going to burst and create problems for the economy," he said, pointing to the bond market as a source of capital competition for equities.
paras.zh: “从人工智能泡沫中抽出一些空气是一件好事。我认为它不会破裂并给经济带来问题，”他表示，并指出债券市场是股票资本竞争的来源。

paras.en: Bond yields eased on Thursday, with the 10-year Treasury sliding 18.5 basis points to 4.961% as traders bid up safe-haven assets. The yield on the 30-year slid 15 basis points, and the 2-year yield fell 17.5 basis points.
paras.zh: 由于交易员抬高避险资产，债券收益率周四有所回落，10 年期国债收益率下跌 18.5 个基点至 4.961%。 30年期国债收益率下跌15个基点，2年期国债收益率下跌17.5个基点。

paras.en: Brent crude prices spiked following a report that the U.S. and Israel were drawing up plans for renewed attacks on Iran as part of the regional war that started in late February. Brent jumped 4% to end the session at $113.17, the highest settle since May.
paras.zh: 有报道称，作为二月底开始的地区战争的一部分，美国和以色列正在制定新一轮袭击伊朗的计划，布伦特原油价格飙升。布伦特原油价格上涨 4%，收于 113.17 美元，为 5 月份以来的最高收盘价。

paras.en: On the week, the S&P 500 is heading for a slim gain, up less than 0.1%, while the Nasdaq is down 0.5% in the period. The Dow is tracking for a 1.7% advance.
paras.zh: 本周，标准普尔 500 指数小幅上涨，涨幅不到 0.1%，而纳斯达克指数同期下跌 0.5%。道指上涨 1.7%。

paras.en: On the economic front, traders will be watching for the final reading of the University of Michigan's consumer sentiment report.
paras.zh: 在经济方面，交易员将关注密歇根大学消费者信心报告的最终结果。

articles.title: This implant burns up excess blood sugar with electricity

paras.en: A new wireless implant could burn up excess sugar in the blood, letting people with type 2 diabetes live healthier lives without having to completely rely on medication.
paras.zh: 一种新的无线植入物可以燃烧血液中多余的糖分，让 2 型糖尿病患者过上更健康的生活，而不必完全依赖药物。

paras.en: Traditional drugs used for diabetes such as insulin, metformin and glucagonlike peptide 1 (GLP-1) agonists all treat the condition by effectively forcing the body to keep glucose levels under control—but these treatments are prone to side effects and many involve taking a fixed quantity of medication regularly despite blood sugar changing with mood, sleep and meals. Automated insulin pumps can adjust dosing to a patient’s blood sugar in real time, but they still deliver drugs that can linger in the body.
paras.zh: 用于治疗糖尿病的传统药物，如胰岛素、二甲双胍和胰高血糖素样肽 1 (GLP-1) 激动剂，都是通过有效地迫使身体控制血糖水平来治疗糖尿病，但这些治疗方法很容易产生副作用，而且许多治疗方法需要定期服用固定剂量的药物，尽管血糖会随着情绪、睡眠和进餐而变化。自动胰岛素泵可以根据患者的血糖实时调整剂量，但它们仍然会输送可在体内停留的药物。

paras.en: “We wanted to have a completely new principle,” says Martin Fussenegger, the study’s senior author and a bioengineer at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Zurich. For a new study in mice, published in Science, he and his team abandoned drugs altogether by developing a below-the-skin implant that chemically eliminates glucose from the blood on its own rather than triggering the body’s own mechanisms in order to do so.
paras.zh: “我们想要一个全新的原理，”该研究的资深作者、瑞士苏黎世联邦理工学院的生物工程师 Martin Fussenegger 说。在《科学》杂志上发表的一项针对小鼠的新研究中，他和他的团队完全放弃了药物，开发了一种皮下植入物，可以通过化学方式自行消除血液中的葡萄糖，而不是触发人体自身的机制来消除葡萄糖。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The device, called ECHO, which stands for electrocatalytic closed-loop health optimization, looks like a little flat rectangular chip, roughly the size of a USB stick. It contains a graphite wafer that carries an electric current, embedded with branching structures of gold nanoflakes that are studded with even smaller spheres of platinum. These structures work as a catalyst—a substance that speeds up a chemical reaction without being consumed in the process. The implant is operated and powered wirelessly, and when voltage is applied, the surface oxidizes glucose into an easily processed metabolite called gluconate. The mouse subjects’ bodies burned roughly a fifth of the resulting gluconate for energy, and the rest was flushed out through the kidneys.
paras.zh: 该设备名为 ECHO，代表电催化闭环健康优化，看起来像一个扁平的矩形小芯片，大约有 U 盘大小。它包含一个携带电流的石墨晶片，嵌入金纳米薄片的分支结构，这些金纳米薄片上镶嵌着更小的铂球。这些结构充当催化剂——一种加速化学反应但不会在过程中被消耗的物质。该植入物以无线方式操作和供电，当施加电压时，表面会将葡萄糖氧化成一种易于加工的代谢物，称为葡萄糖酸盐。小鼠受试者的身体燃烧了大约五分之一的葡萄糖酸盐来获取能量，其余的则通过肾脏排出体外。

paras.en: Blood carries important molecules similar to glucose such as fructose, galactose and lactose, but the implant successfully targeted glucose specifically. Fussenegger admits the researchers don’t yet know why it is so successful, although that likely relates to the particular combination of gold and platinum. “We have no functional or structural explanation for that. We did not design for it,” Fussenegger says. “The specificity is, I would say, a lucky strike.”
paras.zh: 血液携带与葡萄糖类似的重要分子，如果糖、半乳糖和乳糖，但植入物成功地专门针对葡萄糖。富森格承认，研究人员还不知道为什么它如此成功，尽管这可能与黄金和铂金的特殊组合有关。 “我们对此没有任何功能或结构解释。我们没有为此进行设计，”富塞内格说。 “我想说，这种特殊性是一次幸运的打击。”

paras.en: In diabetic mice with obesity, the implant brought blood glucose levels under control within an hour when turned on, and repeated treatment held it there for six weeks. The mice also showed reduced triglycerides—a type of fat associated with disease risk—and lower body weight.
paras.zh: 在患有肥胖症的糖尿病小鼠中，植入物在启动后一小时内就使血糖水平得到控制，并通过重复治疗将其保持在六周内。 The mice also showed reduced triglycerides—a type of fat associated with disease risk—and lower body weight.

paras.en: The team also tested the implant while connected via a smartphone to a commercial continuous glucose monitor, which relayed blood sugar readings that allowed the smartphone to turn the implant on and off as needed. For two weeks, this closed-loop system ran with no human involvement.
paras.zh: 该团队还测试了植入物，同时通过智能手机连接到商用连续血糖监测仪，该监测仪转发血糖读数，使智能手机可以根据需要打开和关闭植入物。这个闭环系统在无人参与的情况下运行了两周。

paras.en: Many glucose-focused implants under development rely on capsules containing engineered cells that secrete therapeutic proteins—these tend not to last because they get sealed off by scar tissue in the body. But for ECHO, the mice’s tissue showed no signs of inflammation around the implant, no scarring and no leached metal. Implants removed after six weeks still worked, and some remained active even after three months under the skin, according to the study.
paras.zh: 许多正在开发的以葡萄糖为中心的植入物依赖于含有工程细胞的胶囊，这些细胞可以分泌治疗性蛋白质——这些植入物往往不会持久，因为它们被体内的疤痕组织封闭。但对于 ECHO 来说，小鼠的组织在植入物周围没有显示出炎症迹象，没有疤痕，也没有浸出的金属。研究表明，六周后取出的植入物仍然有效，有些甚至在皮下三个月后仍然有效。

paras.en: “Six weeks of operational stability is already well beyond the current technology,” says Luisa Torsi, a chemist at the University of Bari Aldo Moro in Italy, who was not involved in the study. “The crucial next steps are to establish long-term tissue compatibility, sustained catalytic activity and safe, effective glucose removal at the scale required for human treatment.”
paras.zh: “六周的运行稳定性已经远远超出了当前技术的水平，”意大利巴里阿尔多莫罗大学的化学家路易莎·托尔西（Luisa Torsi）说道，她没有参与这项研究。 “接下来关键的步骤是建立长期的组织相容性、持续的催化活性以及以人类治疗所需的规模安全、有效地去除葡萄糖。”

paras.en: A mouse has roughly two milliliters of blood, whereas humans typically hold five liters—ECHO would need to scale up to function at that level. Fussenegger is confident about that task, however. As part of the study, the team circulated sugary fluid through a five-liter flask—a stand-in for human blood volume—and the implant cleared it just as efficiently.
paras.zh: 小鼠大约有 2 毫升血液，而人类通常有 5 升——ECHO 需要扩大规模才能在这个水平发挥作用。然而，富塞内格对这项任务充满信心。作为研究的一部分，研究小组通过一个五升烧瓶（人体血容量的替代品）循环含糖液体，植入物同样有效地清除它。

paras.en: Because the device is small and sits just under the skin, Fussenegger expects the implantation procedure in humans would require a minor incision rather than complex surgery. “If it’s possible to do this maybe every three months or up to a year, and then ‘I can forget my diabetes,’ I think people would be happy,” he says.
paras.zh: 由于该装置很小并且位于皮肤下，富森格预计人体植入过程需要一个小切口，而不是复杂的手术。 “如果有可能每三个月或最多一年这样做一次，然后‘我可以忘记我的糖尿病’，我想人们会很高兴，”他说。

articles.title: RFK, Jr., adviser Calley Means announces his resignation from the Trump administration

paras.en: Calley Means, a senior adviser to Secretary of Health and Humans Services Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., and a key figure in the “Make America Healthy Again” (MAHA) movement, has resigned.
paras.zh: 卡利·米恩斯 (Calley Means) 是美国卫生与公众服务部部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪 (Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.) 的高级顾问，也是“让美国再次健康”(MAHA) 运动的关键人物，现已辞职。

paras.en: In a post on X, Means said he was leaving the Trump administration “with tremendous respect for President Trump and Bobby Kennedy.”
paras.zh: 在 X 上的一篇帖子中，米恩斯表示，他将“带着对特朗普总统和鲍比·肯尼迪的极大尊重”离开特朗普政府。

paras.en: “They laid out a vision of combatting the entrenched, dark forces in DC that profit from Americans getting sick,” Means wrote, touting MAHA achievements such as changing dietary guidelines, pushing forward psychedelic-based treatments and removing soda from SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) benefits, among others.
paras.zh: 米恩斯写道：“他们提出了打击华盛顿根深蒂固的黑暗势力的愿景，这些势力从美国人的患病中获利。”他还宣扬了 MAHA 的成就，例如改变饮食指南、推动基于致幻剂的治疗以及从 SNAP（补充营养援助计划）福利中取消苏打水等。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: A Department of Health and Human Services spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 卫生与公众服务部发言人没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Means, who has no experience as a health care professional, had previously worked in the private sector and founded the telehealth company Truemed, which works with customers to spend health savings account money on supplements and fitness equipment.
paras.zh: Means 没有医疗保健专业人士的经验，此前曾在私营部门工作，并创立了远程医疗公司 Truemed，该公司与客户合作，将健康储蓄账户的钱用于补充剂和健身器材。

paras.en: Many of Means’s views have come under fire from medical professionals, including his advocacy for drinking raw milk, which can contain harmful pathogens, opposition to fluoride in drinking water and description of COVID vaccines mandates for children as a “war crime.”
paras.zh: 米恩斯的许多观点都受到了医疗专业人士的批评，包括他提倡饮用可能含有有害病原体的生奶、反对饮用水中添加氟化物，以及将儿童接种新冠疫苗的规定描述为“战争罪”。

paras.en: Means also played a key role in connecting Kennedy with Trump before the 2024 election, at a time when the two were both vying for the Oval Office. Kennedy ultimately endorsed Trump after dropping out of the race and was appointed to lead HHS in turn.
paras.zh: 米恩斯还在 2024 年大选前将肯尼迪与特朗普联系起来，当时两人都在争夺椭圆形办公室。肯尼迪在退出竞选后最终支持特朗普，并被任命轮流领导美国卫生与公众服务部。

paras.en: Means’s sister, Casey Means, a wellness influencer and former physician, was nominated by Trump for the role of surgeon general in May 2025. But her name was withdrawn this past April amid concerns over her stance on vaccines, abortion pills and alternative medicine.
paras.zh: 米恩斯的妹妹凯西·米恩斯是一位健康影响者和前医生，于 2025 年 5 月被特朗普提名为卫生局局长。但由于人们担心她在疫苗、堕胎药和替代医学方面的立场，她的名字在今年 4 月被撤回。

articles.title: Here’s what Moderna’s latest mRNA cancer vaccine data actually show

paras.en: Data from Moderna and Merck’s phase 3 clinical trial for an mRNA-based skin cancer vaccine leaked on social media on Thursday, prompting the pharmaceutical companies to release an early look at the results of the trial.
paras.zh: Moderna 和默克公司基于 mRNA 的皮肤癌疫苗 3 期临床试验的数据于周四在社交媒体上泄露，促使制药公司发布了试验结果的早期预览。

paras.en: The results, which triggered Moderna’s stock to drop, are “really encouraging,” says Karen Knudsen, CEO of the Parker Institute for Cancer Immunotherapy, a nonprofit. This kind of mRNA cancer vaccine was “fiction” 10 years ago, she says. “It was thought to be very difficult to do.”
paras.zh: 非营利组织帕克癌症免疫治疗研究所首席执行官凯伦·克努森 (Karen Knudsen) 表示，这一结果“非常令人鼓舞”，导致 Moderna 股价下跌。她说，这种 mRNA 癌症疫苗在 10 年前还只是“虚构”。 “人们认为这很难做到。”

paras.en: As Scientific American previously reported, the Moderna-Merck clinical trial includes two treatments: a personalized mRNA-vaccine called intismeran autogene, which works by instructing the body in how to identify and fight cancer, and pembrolizumab (sold as Keytruda), a drug designed to prevent cancer from “hiding” from our immune system, according to Merck.
paras.zh: 正如《科学美国人》之前报道的那样，Moderna-Merck 临床试验包括两种治疗方法：一种名为 intismeran autogene 的个性化 mRNA 疫苗，它的作用是指导身体如何识别和对抗癌症；另一种是 pembrolizumab（以 Keytruda 出售），据默克公司介绍，这是一种旨在防止癌症“隐藏”我们的免疫系统的药物。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The clinical trial included 1,137 cancer patients with “high risk” melanoma, a type of skin cancer. Together, the mRNA vaccine and pembrolizumab reduced the risk of cancer recurrence or death by 42 percent in people, after a median period of about two years, compared to people on pembrolizumab alone. On top of that, the dual treatment reduced the risk of cancer spreading to other parts of the body or death by 38 percent over just pembrolizumab, according to Moderna and Merck.
paras.zh: 该临床试验纳入了 1,137 名患有“高风险”黑色素瘤（皮肤癌的一种）的癌症患者。与单独使用 pembrolizumab 的患者相比，在中位时间约两年后，mRNA 疫苗和 pembrolizumab 共同将癌症复发或死亡的风险降低了 42%。最重要的是，据 Moderna 和默克公司称，与单独使用派姆单抗相比，双重治疗将癌症扩散到身体其他部位或死亡的风险降低了 38%。

paras.en: The findings don’t yet include overall survival, Knudsen notes. “Did people who got the vaccine live longer than people who didn't? And what was their quality of life?” she asks. Those results are coming. But the new findings are “really, really good milestones along the way,” she says.
paras.zh: 克努森指出，研究结果尚未包括总体生存率。 “接种疫苗的人比没有接种疫苗的人活得更长吗？他们的生活质量如何？”她问。这些结果即将到来。但她说，新发现“是一路上非常非常好的里程碑”。

paras.en: “From the beginning, we believed mRNA technology could make it possible to develop cancer treatments uniquely matched to each patient’s tumor, Moderna CEO Stéphane Bancel said in a statement. “These results reinforce our conviction that mRNA has the potential to fundamentally change how we treat cancer.”
paras.zh: Moderna 首席执行官 Stéphane Bancel 在一份声明中表示：“从一开始，我们就相信 mRNA 技术可以开发出与每位患者的肿瘤独特匹配的癌症治疗方法。这些结果增强了我们的信念，即 mRNA 有可能从根本上改变我们治疗癌症的方式。”

paras.en: The results have been accepted for publication in the New England Journal of Medicine, Merck and Moderna said. Now, the companies are “engaging with regulatory authorities” to seek approval for their mRNA vaccine.
paras.zh: 默克和 Moderna 表示，该结果已被《新英格兰医学杂志》接受发表。现在，这些公司正在“与监管机构合作”，寻求其 mRNA 疫苗的批准。

paras.en: Moderna and Merck did not immediately reply to requests for comment from Scientific American.
paras.zh: Moderna 和默克公司没有立即回复《科学美国人》的置评请求。

articles.title: AI can give you your voice back
articles.author: Laura Sanders

paras.en: When people face losing the ability to talk, they need alternative ways to communicate. One way people preserve their voice is by banking it. The process has improved in recent years, but it still produces a voice that can sound unnatural. Jules Rodriguez did this as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, or ALS, left his own voice diminished. But he wasn’t happy with the sound.
paras.zh: 当人们面临失去说话的能力时，他们需要其他的沟通方式。人们保护自己声音的一种方法是将其存入银行。近年来，这一过程有所改进，但它仍然会产生听起来不自然的声音。朱尔斯·罗德里格斯（Jules Rodriguez）这样做是因为肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）导致他自己的声音减弱。但他对这个声音并不满意。

paras.en: New technology that uses artificial intelligence allowed Jules to create a voice clone, one that sounds like his old voice. With breaths, intonations and even stutters, these voice clones capture the quirks of a human voice. Jules’ voice clone was so realistic that his wife cried the first time she heard it.
paras.zh: 使用人工智能的新技术使朱尔斯能够创建一个声音克隆，听起来就像他以前的声音。这些声音克隆通过呼吸、语调甚至口吃捕捉到了人类声音的怪癖。朱尔斯的声音克隆是如此逼真，以至于他的妻子第一次听到它时哭了。

paras.en: In this episode, hear how AI-powered voice clones are changing the conversation around how people connect. That includes a musician named Patrick Darling who uses his voice clone to sing and perform songs.
paras.zh: 在本集中，了解人工智能驱动的语音克隆如何改变围绕人们联系方式的对话。其中包括一位名叫帕特里克·达林（Patrick Darling）的音乐家，他使用自己的声音克隆来唱歌和表演歌曲。

paras.en: Laura Sanders: Jules Rodriguez’s voice was disappearing.
paras.zh: 劳拉·桑德斯：朱尔斯·罗德里格斯的声音正在消失。

paras.en: Jules Rodriguez: For me, it felt like I was fading away, like when Marty McFly was seeing his family fade away in the picture he had in “Back to the Future.”
paras.zh: 朱尔斯·罗德里格斯：对我来说，感觉就像我正在消失，就像马蒂·麦克弗莱在《回到未来》的照片中看到他的家人逐渐消失一样。

paras.en: Sanders: Jules has ALS, and like many people with that disease, this fading felt inevitable. But there was something Jules could do about it. I’m Laura Sanders, and this is episode three of The Deep End: Talk To Me, a Science News podcast on the human voice and all it can hold.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：朱尔斯患有肌萎缩侧索硬化症，和许多患有这种疾病的人一样，这种衰退感觉是不可避免的。但朱尔斯可以做点什么。我是劳拉·桑德斯，这是《深渊：跟我说话》的第三集，这是一个关于人类声音及其所能容纳的科学新闻播客。

paras.en: [voices] Hey mom, can I tell you something? The voice is absolutely an integral part of your identity. Do you want to talk? That added layer of it being you. Hello? Your voice. Hi.
paras.zh: [声音] 嘿妈妈，我可以告诉你一件事吗？声音绝对是您身份的一个组成部分。你想说话吗？那增加的一层就是你。你好？你的声音。你好。

paras.en: Sanders: On today’s episode, we’re going to hear about the return of Jules’ voice.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：在今天的节目中，我们将听到朱尔斯的声音回归。

paras.en: We touched on this in the last episode, but as a reminder, there are a few traditional ways people preserve their ways to communicate when they’re faced with losing a voice. One is for people to record themselves saying common or special phrases if they can still talk. That’s called message banking. And then there’s a technique called voice banking. It requires a person to record themselves saying very specific words. And then these sounds get fed into a computer program that can stitch them together to make any word a person wants to say. Sounds good in theory, but in practice, the output didn’t sound very human. Jules banked his voice soon after his diagnosis. MA describes what that was like.
paras.zh: 我们在上一集中谈到了这一点，但提醒一下，当人们面临失声时，有一些传统的方式可以保留他们的沟通方式。一种是让人们在还能说话的情况下记录自己所说的常用或特殊短语。这就是所谓的消息银行。还有一种称为语音银行的技术。它要求一个人记录自己所说的非常具体的单词。然后这些声音被输入到计算机程序中，该程序可以将它们拼接在一起以组成一个人想说的任何单词。理论上听起来不错，但实际上，输出听起来不太人性化。朱尔斯确诊后不久就压低了声音。 MA 描述了当时的情况。

paras.en: MA: I remember both of us looking at each other while he was recording, basically the old school way, and they still recommend to bank your voice this way, besides your cloned voice, but you’re sent all these phrases that you’re just recording, like 350 phrases, and that goes into, you know, a file, and then when you do need it, the company will pull it up and plug it into your device.
paras.zh: MA：我记得他录音时我们俩都看着对方，基本上是老派的方式，除了克隆的声音之外，他们仍然建议以这种方式存储你的声音，但是你会收到你刚刚录制的所有这些短语，比如 350 个短语，这些短语会进入，你知道，一个文件，然后当你确实需要它时，公司会把它拉出来并将其插入你的设备。

paras.en: Sanders: I spoke with Richard Cave. He’s a speech therapist at University College London who works with people with ALS. That’s also called motor neuron disease, or MND.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：我和理查德·凯夫谈过。他是伦敦大学学院的一名言语治疗师，专门为肌萎缩侧索硬化症患者提供治疗。这也称为运动神经元疾病（MND）。

paras.en: Richard Cave: My role was to build out the voice banking initiative across the UK. This was back in 2017. And I remember… After the first, I don’t know, six months, nine months, being very proud that I managed to put through 100 people or so at an average duration to complete the voice banking, all 1,600 phrases in around three months each. Very proud of that. They weren’t awful, but they weren’t good. And they didn’t really represent the person. They represented kind of part, a little bit, of the person. But that was the best we had.
paras.zh: 理查德·凯夫（Richard Cave）：我的职责是在英国各地建立语音银行计划。那是在 2017 年。我记得……在第一次之后，我不知道，六个月，九个月，我非常自豪，我成功地在平均时间内帮助 100 个人完成了语音银行，每个人在大约三个月内完成了所有 1,600 个短语。对此感到非常自豪。他们并不可怕，但也不好。而且它们并不能真正代表这个人。它们代表了这个人的一部分。但这是我们拥有的最好的。
