articles.title: Who is Stephen Hubbard, the retired American teacher freed by Russia?
articles.author: Garrett Haake

paras.en: Stephen James Hubbard, a retired American teacher, was released by Russia on Wednesday after nearly five years in detention in the midst of an apparent warming of ties between Washington and Moscow.
paras.zh: 斯蒂芬·詹姆斯·哈伯德（Stephen James Hubbard）是一位退休的美国教师，在华盛顿和莫斯科之间的关系明显升温之际，他被拘留了近五年，于周三被俄罗斯释放。

paras.en: Hubbard, 74, of Michigan, had been living in eastern Ukraine for years when Russia launched its full-scale invasion in 2022. He was detained two months into the war as Russia captured swaths of Ukrainian territory. Two years later, a Russian court convicted him of serving as a mercenary.
paras.zh: 2022 年俄罗斯发动全面入侵时，74 岁的密歇根州哈伯德已在乌克兰东部生活多年。战争爆发两个月后，俄罗斯占领了乌克兰大片领土，他被拘留。两年后，俄罗斯法院判定他担任雇佣兵罪名成立。

paras.en: The jet carrying Hubbard touched down at Lackland Air Force Base, Texas, at about 10:49 p.m. Wednesday (11:49 p.m. ET), video at the base showed.
paras.zh: 载有哈伯德的喷气式飞机于晚上 10 点 49 分左右降落在德克萨斯州拉克兰空军基地。星期三（美国东部时间晚上 11:49），基地的视频显示。

paras.en: The news of his release came out of a meeting between President Donald Trump’s special envoy Steve Witkoff and Russian President Vladimir Putin on Wednesday, when they were due to discuss an end to the Ukraine war.
paras.zh: 他获释的消息是在周三唐纳德·特朗普总统的特使史蒂夫·威特科夫与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行会晤时传出的，当时他们将讨论结束乌克兰战争的问题。

paras.en: Son of Stephen Hubbard says 'no evidence' his father was a mercenary
paras.zh: 斯蒂芬·哈伯德的儿子表示“没有证据”他的父亲是一名雇佣兵

paras.en: Witkoff thanked Putin for freeing Hubbard during their on-camera talks. He later met Hubbard in St. Petersburg before he boarded a flight back to the United States.
paras.zh: 维特科夫感谢普京在他们的镜头谈话中释放了哈伯德。后来，他在登上返回美国的航班之前在圣彼得堡遇见了哈伯德。

paras.en: In a video from the Russian state news agency RIA, Hubbard is smiling as he meets Witkoff. “Thank you very much for all your efforts,” he tells Witkoff as they shake hands. Putin sent Hubbard “blessings,” Witkoff tells him, adding, “From today, it’s a new life.”
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯国家通讯社 RIA 的一段视频中，哈伯德在见到维特科夫时微笑着。 “非常感谢你们所做的一切努力，”他们握手时他告诉维特科夫。威特科夫告诉哈伯德，普京向他送上了“祝福”，并补充道，“从今天开始，这是新的生活。”

paras.en: During the meeting, Witkoff said on X, Trump “called Stephen to check on him and reaffirm his unwavering commitment to bringing all Americans wrongfully detained home.”
paras.zh: 威特科夫在会议期间表示，特朗普“打电话给斯蒂芬，询问他的情况，并重申他坚定不移地致力于将所有被错误拘留的美国人带回家。”

paras.en: Witkoff shared an image of Hubbard on a plane next to the American flag and several other people, writing that he was “headed back home to his family.”
paras.zh: 威特科夫分享了一张哈伯德在美国国旗和其他几个人旁边的飞机上的照片，并写道他“正在回家与家人团聚”。

paras.en: Martin De Luca, Hubbard’s lawyer, said in a phone interview Wednesday that he had spoken with Hubbard as he was getting ready to take off on a plane bound for the U.S. and that his client was overjoyed to be released.
paras.zh: 哈伯德的律师马丁·德卢卡(Martin De Luca)周三在接受电话采访时表示，当哈伯德准备搭乘飞往美国的飞机时，他与哈伯德进行了交谈，他的当事人对于获释感到非常高兴。

paras.en: “He was overwhelmed with joy,” De Luca said. “The No. 1 thing he was excited about was seeing his children and family, who will be waiting for him when he arrives in the U.S. tonight. He was in a fragile state, so it wasn’t a long conversation, but he’s OK, which is what’s important.”
paras.zh: “他欣喜若狂，”德卢卡说。 “他最兴奋的第一件事就是见到他的孩子和家人，当他今晚抵达美国时，他们会在等他。他的状态很脆弱，所以谈话时间并不长，但他没事，这才是重要的。”

paras.en: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Putin released Hubbard “on humanitarian grounds.” Russia did not provide more details.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，普京“出于人道主义理由”释放了哈伯德。俄罗斯没有提供更多细节。

paras.en: Hubbard’s family acknowledged Trump’s and Putin’s roles in securing his release.
paras.zh: 哈伯德的家人承认特朗普和普京在确保他获释方面发挥的作用。

paras.en: “We have been gravely concerned for his safety and health since his 2022 detention,” Hubbard’s son, Joseph Coleman, said in a statement on behalf of the family. “Never once did we waver as we prayed for success in these negotiations, and we must acknowledge that this humanitarian move by President Putin in this matter is deeply appreciated,” the statement said.
paras.zh: “自 2022 年他被拘留以来，我们一直严重关注他的安全和健康，”哈伯德的儿子约瑟夫·科尔曼 (Joseph Coleman) 代表家人在一份声明中表示。声明称：“我们在祈祷这些谈判取得成功时从未动摇过，我们必须承认，普京总统在这件事上采取的人道主义行动受到了深深的赞赏。”

paras.en: Coleman, a Greek Orthodox priest who lives in Cyprus, wrote Putin “a long and very emotional letter” last month, De Luca said.
paras.zh: 德卢卡说，科尔曼是一位居住在塞浦路斯的希腊东正教牧师，他上个月给普京写了“一封长而充满感情的信”。

paras.en: In the letter, Coleman said Hubbard’s family “feared he would die without ever seeing his kids or grandchildren,” De Luca said. Coleman also outlined his father’s background and family history and emphasized his faith.
paras.zh: 科尔曼在信中说，哈伯德的家人“担心他会在看不到孩子或孙子的情况下死去”，德卢卡说。科尔曼还概述了他父亲的背景和家族史，并强调了他的信仰。

paras.en: NBC News’ Garrett Haake spoke Wednesday with Coleman, who again thanked Putin and Trump for his father’s release.
paras.zh: 美国全国广播公司新闻频道的加勒特·哈克周三与科尔曼进行了交谈，科尔曼再次感谢普京和特朗普释放了他的父亲。

paras.en: Coleman said it was his “understanding” that Putin had read his letter.
paras.zh: 科尔曼表示，他“理解”普京读过他的信。

paras.en: Asked about the Russian accusation that his father was a mercenary fighting for Ukraine, Coleman replied, “And I say the moon is made out of cheese.”
paras.zh: 当被问及俄罗斯指控他的父亲是为乌克兰而战的雇佣兵时，科尔曼回答说：“我说月亮是奶酪做的。”

paras.en: “There’s no evidence to that effect,” he added.
paras.zh: “没有证据表明这一点，”他补充道。

paras.en: Coleman said his father is not political and may have been targeted because of his American nationality.
paras.zh: 科尔曼说，他的父亲不参与政治，可能因为他的美国国籍而成为攻击目标。

paras.en: “I think my father was in the wrong place at the wrong time,” he said. “I think it served the interests of low-level military men to say, ‘Hey, we got this American.’ It’s a trophy.”
paras.zh: “我认为我父亲在错误的时间出现在错误的地点，”他说。 “我认为，说‘嘿，我们找到了这个美国人。’这符合低级军人的利益。这是一个奖杯。”

paras.en: Coleman said his father had lived with him in Cyprus for a time before he decided to move to Ukraine to live with his girlfriend for economic reasons.
paras.zh: 科尔曼说，他的父亲曾在塞浦路斯和他一起生活过一段时间，然后他出于经济原因决定搬到乌克兰与女友住在一起。

paras.en: Coleman had only a brief conversation with his father while he was on the tarmac in Russia.
paras.zh: 当科尔曼在俄罗斯的停机坪上时，他只与父亲进行了简短的交谈。

paras.en: “He was just looking forward to seeing family,” Coleman said.
paras.zh: “他只是期待见到家人，”科尔曼说。

paras.en: Trump cheered Hubbard’s return, framing it as a demonstration of the Kremlin’s “respect” for its American counterparts.
paras.zh: 特朗普对哈伯德的回归表示欢迎，认为这是克里姆林宫对美国同行“尊重”的表现。

paras.en: “Stephen is on his way back home and will soon be with his family,” Trump said Wednesday on Truth Social, shortly after Witkoff announced Hubbard’s release. “The United States, out of respect for President Trump, was not required to give anything in return — an unprecedented situation for Russia.”
paras.zh: “斯蒂芬正在回家的路上，很快就会与家人团聚，”周三，在威特科夫宣布哈伯德获释后不久，特朗普在《真相社交》上表示。 “出于对特朗普总统的尊重，美国不需要给予任何回报——这对俄罗斯来说是前所未有的情况。”

paras.en: There was no “swap” necessary for the release, Trump added, though in a later post he said “those negotiations would have come to a complete and total halt” had the U.S. gone ahead with sanctions that he waived last week.
paras.zh: 特朗普补充说，释放不需要“交换”，不过他在后来的帖子中表示，如果美国继续实施他上周放弃的制裁，“这些谈判将完全停止”。

paras.en: Hubbard was sentenced in a closed-door trial in 2024, with very little information about his case reported by Russian state media.
paras.zh: 哈伯德于 2024 年在一次闭门审判中被判刑，俄罗斯官方媒体报道的有关他案件的信息很少。

paras.en: At the time, Russian prosecutors alleged that as the Kremlin launched its “special military operation” in Ukraine in February 2022, Hubbard voluntarily joined a territorial defense battalion in the eastern city of Izyum, where he had been living since 2014. The prosecutors said Hubbard took part in the Ukraine war and regularly received financial compensation before he was detained in April 2022 as advancing Russian forces captured the city.
paras.zh: 当时，俄罗斯检察官声称，随着克里姆林宫于 2022 年 2 月在乌克兰发起“特别军事行动”，哈伯德自愿加入了东部城市伊久姆的一个领土防御营，他自 2014 年以来一直居住在那里。检察官称，哈伯德参加了乌克兰战争，并定期获得经济补偿，然后于 2022 年 4 月在推进的俄罗斯军队占领该城市时被拘留。

paras.en: “He was aware of the unlawful nature of his actions, yet — with the deliberate intent of personal enrichment — he carried out the orders of his superiors, which entailed direct participation in combat operations on the side of the Armed Forces of Ukraine against service members of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation,” according to Russia’s prosecutor general’s office.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总检察长办公室称，“他意识到自己行为的非法性质，但出于个人致富的目的，他执行了上级的命令，这意味着直接参与乌克兰武装部队针对俄罗斯联邦武装部队军人的战斗行动。”

paras.en: Russian state media reported that he pleaded guilty. Following Hubbard’s release Wednesday, De Luca stood by his previous statements that Hubbard had told him that the charges were false and that he was not part of any combat or military unit.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官方媒体报道称，他已认罪。哈伯德周三获释后，德卢卡坚持之前的声明，即哈伯德告诉他这些指控是错误的，而且他不属于任何战斗或军事单位。

paras.en: The New York Times reported last year that Patricia Hubbard Fox, Hubbard’s sister, disputes that he fought for Ukraine, as do three former Ukrainian prisoners of war held with Hubbard.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》去年报道称，哈伯德的妹妹帕特里夏·哈伯德·福克斯(Patricia Hubbard Fox)对他为乌克兰而战的说法提出异议，与哈伯德一起关押的三名前乌克兰战俘也对此提出异议。

paras.en: The paper also cited Fox as saying her brother had a master’s degree in English and had lived in Japan and Cyprus before he moved to eastern Ukraine, where he had a Ukrainian partner. Fox also said Hubbard taught English online when he needed money and did not speak either Ukrainian or Russian.
paras.zh: 该报还援引福克斯的话说，她的哥哥拥有英语硕士学位，在搬到乌克兰东部之前曾在日本和塞浦路斯生活过，在那里他有一个乌克兰伴侣。福克斯还表示，哈伯德在需要钱时在线教英语，而且不会说乌克兰语或俄语。

paras.en: Russia occupied Izyum, where Fox said her brother settled, for six months in 2022, but Ukraine later recaptured it in a major counteroffensive. It is currently held by Ukraine and is not part of the four Ukrainian oblasts Russia has illegally annexed.
paras.zh: 2022 年，俄罗斯占领了伊久姆（福克斯称她哥哥定居于此）六个月，但乌克兰后来在一次大规模反攻中重新夺回了该地区。它目前由乌克兰控制，不属于俄罗斯非法吞并的四个乌克兰州的一部分。

paras.en: Hubbard was released from Russian custody just months after former U.S. Marine Robert Gilman, who spent more than four years in a Russian prison, was set free in August.
paras.zh: 哈伯德从俄罗斯拘留所释放，几个月前，前美国海军陆战队队员罗伯特·吉尔曼在俄罗斯监狱度过了四年多，于八月获释。

paras.en: Washington has accused Moscow of arbitrarily detaining American citizens in Russia for years, with their cases often used to negotiate prisoner swaps, including exchanges for state-backed intelligence operatives detained around the world.
paras.zh: 华盛顿多年来一直指责莫斯科在俄罗斯任意拘留美国公民，他们的案件经常被用来谈判囚犯交换，包括交换在世界各地被拘留的国家支持的情报人员。

paras.en: In some of the higher-profile cases, U.S. journalist Evan Gershkovich was released in a swap in 2024, alongside Marine veteran Paul Whelan — both had been jailed on espionage charges. WNBA star Brittney Griner, detained on drug charges in 2022, was freed after the Biden administration negotiated her release in exchange for a Russian arms dealer.
paras.zh: 在一些备受瞩目的案件中，美国记者埃文·格什科维奇 (Evan Gershkovich) 与海军陆战队退伍军人保罗·惠兰 (Paul Whelan) 于 2024 年交换释放——两人均因间谍罪名入狱。 WNBA 球星布兰妮·格林纳 (Brittney Griner) 于 2022 年因毒品指控被拘留，在拜登政府与一名俄罗斯军火商交换条件后，她获释。

paras.en: John Herbst, a former U.S. ambassador to Ukraine and the senior director of the Atlantic Council think tank’s Eurasia Center, said that despite the depiction of Hubbard’s release, “it was not a freebie. It was not a gift to the United States.”
paras.zh: 美国前驻乌克兰大使、大西洋理事会智库欧亚中心高级主任约翰·赫布斯特表示，尽管描述了哈伯德的获释，“这不是免费赠品。这不是送给美国的礼物。”

paras.en: He told NBC News’ “Here’s the Scoop” podcast that it came after the release of a prominent Russian war blogger, Mikhail Zvinchuk, who was detained in Montenegro in October and freed after the U.S. opted not to extradite him.
paras.zh: 他告诉 NBC 新闻的“Here’s the Scoop”播客，这是在俄罗斯著名战争博主米哈伊尔·兹温丘克 (Mikhail Zvinchuk) 获释后发布的。米哈伊尔·兹温丘克于 10 月份在黑山被拘留，在美国选择不引渡他后获释。

paras.en: “Russia’s got back a bad guy who we should have taken into custody, and we got back an American who was innocent. That’s the pattern,” he said.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯找回了一个我们本应拘留的坏人，而我们找回了一个无辜的美国人。这就是模式，”他说。

paras.en: Meanwhile, on the day Hubbard was released, Russia said it had detained a German national accused of serving in the Ukrainian army.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在哈伯德获释当天，俄罗斯表示拘留了一名被指控在乌克兰军队服役的德国国民。

paras.en: Russia’s Federal Security Service did not release the man’s name or any other identifying details and did not say where or when he was taken into custody.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局没有公布该男子的姓名或任何其他身份细节，也没有透露他是在何​​时何地被拘留的。

articles.title: Discarded acrylic nails, beer can enshrined in mosaic of Aussie drag icon
articles.author: Lily Nothling

paras.en: Discarded fingernails, sequins, a pair of high heels, a beer can, and a dismembered Barbie doll have been used to capture the likeness of Australia's most celebrated drag queen.
paras.zh: 废弃的指甲、亮片、一双高跟鞋、一个啤酒罐和一个被肢解的芭比娃娃被用来捕捉澳大利亚最著名的变装皇后的肖像。

paras.en: A glittering new portrait of Courtney Act has been unveiled at the National Portrait Gallery in Canberra.
paras.zh: 考特尼·阿克特的一幅闪闪发光的新肖像在堪培拉国家肖像画廊揭幕。

paras.en: The large mosaic by artist Paul Yore is an eclectic assemblage of thousands of objects, each meticulously placed with tweezers, to pay tribute to the queer icon.
paras.zh: 艺术家 Paul Yore 创作的大型马赛克是数千件物品的折衷组合，每一件物品都用镊子精心放置，以向这位酷儿偶像致敬。

paras.en: "I sent Paul a bag of my old fingernails and eyelashes and broken jewellery, and so I knew that it was going to be made of found objects and mixed media, but to see it hanging on the wall is absolutely amazing,"
paras.zh: “我给保罗寄了一袋我的旧指甲、睫毛和破损的珠宝，所以我知道它将由找到的物品和混合媒体制成，但看到它挂在墙上绝对是令人惊奇的，”

paras.en: Courtney Act has spent more than two decades in the public eye and is an internationally celebrated drag performer, queer advocate and television personality.
paras.zh: 考特尼·阿特已经在公众视野中度过了二十多年，是一位国际知名的变装表演者、酷儿倡导者和电视名人。

paras.en: She is the alter ego of Queensland-born Shane Janek, who never felt like he fit into masculine norms growing up.
paras.zh: 她是昆士兰出生的肖恩·贾内克的另一个自我，他在成长过程中从未觉得自己符合男性规范。

paras.en: "Imagine beaming back to 14-year-old me, listening to the Spice Girls, wearing my platform buffalo boots to school," Act said.
paras.zh: “想象一下，回到 14 岁的我，穿着厚底水牛靴去学校，聆听辣妹组合的音乐，”阿特说。

paras.en: "In Brisbane in the 90s there was certainly nobody like me around and not anybody like me portrayed in the media.
paras.zh: “在 90 年代的布里斯班，周围肯定没有人像我一样，媒体上也没有描绘像我这样的人。

paras.en: "So when an institution like the National Portrait Gallery commissions a portrait of you, it feels very validating."
paras.zh: “因此，当像国家肖像画廊这样的机构委托为您拍摄肖像时，感觉非常有效。”

paras.en: Among the objects used in the portrait is an old Nokia phone — the same model used by a young Shane Janek to come out to his parents.
paras.zh: 肖像中使用的物品包括一部旧的诺基亚手机——年轻的肖恩·贾内克向父母出柜时使用的就是同一型号。

paras.en: There is also a statue of Aphrodite, an array of Australian iconography, and a football — something Act admits she has never played.
paras.zh: 还有一尊阿佛洛狄忒雕像、一系列澳大利亚肖像画和一个足球——阿克特承认她从未踢过足球。

paras.en: Artist Paul Yore said he was initially intimidated when he was approached by the gallery to create the portrait.
paras.zh: 艺术家保罗·约尔 (Paul Yore) 表示，当画廊找他创作这幅肖像时，他最初感到害怕。

paras.en: "I've obviously followed Courtney's career for decades now and idolise her as an icon as so many of us in the queer community do," he said.
paras.zh: “我显然已经关注考特尼的职业生涯几十年了，并且像我们酷儿社区中的许多人一样将她视为偶像，”他说。

paras.en: The process took him about a year, and Yore said he felt a great sense of responsibility to "get it right".
paras.zh: 这个过程花了他大约一年的时间，尤尔说，他对“把事情做好”感到有很大的责任感。

paras.en: "It was one of the most challenging things I've ever had to make,"
paras.zh: “这是我做过的最具挑战性的事情之一，”

paras.en: "At different times, I did hear Courtney's voice in my head being like, 'Oi, what are you doing? Why are you putting that there? Get that off my face!'"
paras.zh: “在不同的时间，我确实听到考特尼的声音在我脑海中响起，‘哎呀，你在做什么？你为什么把它放在那里？把它从我脸上拿走！’”

paras.en: Growing up queer in a Catholic household, Yore said he took inspiration from illuminated icons — including the Virgin Mary — to make the portrait.
paras.zh: 约尔在一个天主教家庭中长大，他说他从发光的图标（包括圣母玛利亚）中汲取灵感来制作这幅肖像。

paras.en: National Portrait Gallery director Bree Pickering described the artwork as a "monument to queer culture".
paras.zh: 国家肖像画廊馆长布丽·皮克林（Bree Pickering）将这件艺术品描述为“酷儿文化的纪念碑”。

paras.en: "At a distance, this is a glossy likeness of Courtney, yet up close thousands of small details tell another story, about a big life lived without apology," she said.
paras.zh: “从远处看，这是考特尼光滑的肖像，但近距离观察时，数千个小细节讲述了另一个故事，讲述了一个没有道歉的伟大生活，”她说。

paras.en: The portrait is now the first artwork you see when you walk into the gallery.
paras.zh: 现在，这幅肖像画是您走进画廊时看到的第一件艺术品。

paras.en: "Well, they say that you should always open with a strong number," Act said.
paras.zh: “嗯，他们说你应该总是以一个强劲的数字开始，”阿克特说。

paras.en: "I think that when people turn in, and they see this, they're just going to have a smile on their face.
paras.zh: “我认为，当人们进来看到这个时，他们的脸上只会露出微笑。

paras.en: "I'm very grateful that this portrait has been created of me and that it celebrates drag and queerness in all of its sparkle."
paras.zh: “我非常感谢这幅肖像是为我创作的，它在所有的闪光中颂扬了变装和酷儿。”

articles.title: Breaking: Former cop found guilty of cold case murder of Warrnambool man
articles.author: Jean Bell and Matt Neal

paras.en: Steven Frederick Johnson found guilty of cold case murder of Christopher Jarvis
paras.zh: 史蒂文·弗雷德里克·约翰逊因谋杀克里斯托弗·贾维斯悬案而被判有罪

paras.en: Steven Frederick Johnson has been found guilty of murdering Christopher Jarvis in 2006.
paras.zh: 史蒂文·弗雷德里克·约翰逊 (Steven Frederick Johnson) 因 2006 年谋杀克里斯托弗·贾维斯 (Christopher Jarvis) 而被判有罪。

paras.en: A Supreme Court jury found Johnson killed his tenant over $2,210 of unpaid rent, before dumping his body and setting fire to his car.
paras.zh: 最高法院陪审团裁定，约翰逊杀死了未付租金 2,210 美元的房客，然后将他的尸体扔掉，并纵火焚烧了他的汽车。

paras.en: Johnson did not apply for bail and will be sentenced at a later date.
paras.zh: 约翰逊没有申请保释，将在晚些时候被判刑。

articles.title: NSW's second-largest national park created to protect koalas
articles.author: Samuel O'Brien

paras.en: The NSW parliament has passed legislation that will officially create the Great Koala National Park.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州议会已通过立法，正式创建大考拉国家公园。

paras.en: The federal Clean Energy Regulator announced the registration of the land to generate carbon credits yesterday.
paras.zh: 联邦清洁能源监管机构昨天宣布登记土地以产生碳信用额。

paras.en: Environmental campaigners have hailed the park's creation as a "big step forward" for protecting native forest.
paras.zh: 环保人士称赞该公园的创建是保护原生森林的“一大进步”。

paras.en: After a marathon parliamentary debate, the state government has established New South Wales's second-largest national park.
paras.zh: 经过马拉松式的议会辩论，州政府建立了新南威尔士州第二大国家公园。

paras.en: The Great Koala National Park (GKNP) will take in 478,000 hectares of land between Kempsey and Grafton on the Mid North Coast, following a key promise from Labor during the 2023 state election.
paras.zh: 根据工党在 2023 年州选举期间做出的重要承诺，大考拉国家公园 (GKNP) 将占用中北海岸肯普西和格拉夫顿之间 478,000 公顷的土地。

paras.en: It will comprise a patchwork of existing national parks and more than 178,000 hectares of state forest and Crown Land.
paras.zh: 它将由现有的国家公园和超过 178,000 公顷的国家森林和国有土地组成。

paras.en: The legislation passed today after more than 14 hours of debate in the Legislative Council, which considered approximately 160 amendments.
paras.zh: 立法会经过14个多小时的辩论，审议了约160项修正案，今天通过了该法案。

paras.en: NSW Environment Minister Penny Sharpe hailed the GKNP as a win for the environment that would protect more than 100 species of flora and fauna.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州环境部长 Penny Sharpe 称赞 GKNP 是环境的胜利，将保护 100 多种动植物。

paras.en: "This is a defining moment for conservation in NSW," she said in a statement.
paras.zh: “这是新南威尔士州保护的决定性时刻，”她在一份声明中说。

paras.en: "After more than a decade of campaigning and years of detailed assessments, consultation and planning, we have cleared the final hurdles to delivering our biggest environmental commitment.
paras.zh: “经过十多年的宣传活动以及多年的详细评估、咨询和规划，我们已经扫清了兑现我们最大的环境承诺的最后障碍。

paras.en: "We are protecting extraordinary forests … while ensuring future generations can enjoy these incredible places."
paras.zh: “我们正在保护非凡的森林……同时确保子孙后代能够享受这些令人难以置信的地方。”

paras.en: For conservationist Ashley Love, the park's creation is the culmination of more than a decade of campaigning to protect koalas and their habitat along the Mid North Coast.
paras.zh: 对于自然资源保护主义者阿什利·洛夫（Ashley Love）来说，该公园的创建是十多年来保护考拉及其中北海岸栖息地运动的顶峰。

paras.en: "We're extremely grateful that the government has decided to protect native forest," he said.
paras.zh: “我们非常感谢政府决定保护原生森林，”他说。

paras.en: "Its nature is quite fragmented, and there are gaps and connectivity issues between sections of it, but it is a big step forward."
paras.zh: “它的性质相当分散，各个部分之间存在间隙和连接问题，但这是向前迈出的一大步。”

paras.en: Mr Love began lobbying for what would become the Great Koala National Park after hearing multiple reports from residents that koalas in the region were not as common as they once were.
paras.zh: 在听到居民多次报告称该地区的考拉不再像以前那么常见后，洛夫先生开始游说建立大考拉国家公园。

paras.en: "It became too much to ignore," he said.
paras.zh: “这变得太难以忽视了，”他说。

paras.en: "We proposed a reserve over the Crown land covering [the region], and that was a basis for the proposal for the Great Koala National Park."
paras.zh: “我们提议在覆盖[该地区]的皇家土地上建立一个保护区，这是大考拉国家公园提案的基础。”

paras.en: The NSW Labor Party unsuccessfully took the proposal to the 2015 and 2019 state elections, before winning government in 2023.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州工党未能在 2015 年和 2019 年州选举中将该提案纳入州选举，但最终在 2023 年赢得政府。

paras.en: Mr Love said despite the passing of the legislation, he would continue to push for more areas of the surrounding forest to be protected.
paras.zh: 洛夫先生表示，尽管立法已通过，他仍将继续推动周围森林的更多地区受到保护。

paras.en: "We still have to keep working on those elements that were not included," he said.
paras.zh: “我们仍然必须继续研究那些未包括在内的元素，”他说。

paras.en: Key to the establishment of the park was the approval from the federal government to generate carbon credits for ending native forest logging in the park's state forest areas.
paras.zh: 该公园建立的关键是获得联邦政府的批准，以产生碳信用额，以结束公园州立森林地区的原生森林采伐。

paras.en: On Thursday, the federal Clean Energy Regulator announced it had registered the project, with more than 117,000 hectares designated for carbon protection.
paras.zh: 周四，联邦清洁能源监管机构宣布已注册该项目，指定面积超过 117,000 公顷用于碳保护。

paras.en: A moratorium on logging on the proposed area of the GKNP was introduced last year, and a transition package was offered to affected workers.
paras.zh: 去年，GKNP 拟议区域暂停采伐，并向受影响的工人提供了过渡方案。

paras.en: Timber New South Wales president Andrew Hurford said the logging ban has had a "creeping impact" for the industry along the Mid North Coast.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州木材公司总裁安德鲁·赫福德表示，伐木禁令对中北海岸的木材行业产生了“悄然影响”。

paras.en: "Staff have been laid off; engineering firms that provide support to those companies have no forward orders … downstream people supplying tyres, fuel, trucking, transport, engineering.
paras.zh: “员工被解雇；为这些公司提供支持的工程公司没有远期订单……供应轮胎、燃料、卡车运输、运输、工程的下游人员。

paras.en: "All of those things are gradually becoming slower and quieter."
paras.zh: “所有这些事情都逐渐变得更慢、更安静。”

paras.en: In July, state forest manager the Forestry Corporation of NSW (FCNSW) announced it would cut more than 30 jobs in Coffs Harbour related to the impacts of the GKNP.
paras.zh: 7 月，国家森林管理者新南威尔士州林业公司 (FCNSW) 宣布，由于 GKNP 的影响，将在考夫斯港裁减 30 多个工作岗位。

paras.en: The government said impacted FCNSW staff would be appointed to suitable roles with the National Parks and Wildlife Service.
paras.zh: 政府表示，受影响的 FCNSW 工作人员将被任命到国家公园和野生动物管理局担任合适的职务。

articles.title: New York City council votes to advance bill that would ban horse-drawn carriages

paras.en: New York City council votes to advance bill that would ban horse-drawn carriages
paras.zh: 纽约市议会投票通过推进禁止马车的法案

paras.en: Legislation requires mayor to develop plan to transition drivers to new jobs
paras.zh: 立法要求市长制定计划将司机转移到新工作

paras.en: New York City council passed a bill Thursday that would ban horse-drawn carriage rides by June 2028, pulling back the reins after the death of a teenage tourist last spring.
paras.zh: 纽约市议会周四通过了一项法案，将于 2028 年 6 月之前禁止乘坐马车，去年春天一名青少年游客死亡后，这一限制被收回。

paras.en: The legislation requires Mayor Zohran Mamdani's office to develop a plan by next April to help the more than 150 remaining drivers and the rest of the industry find other jobs, though its provisions are vague and doesn't set clear benchmarks for displaced workers.
paras.zh: 该立法要求市长 Zohran Mamdani 的办公室在明年 4 月之前制定一项计划，帮助 150 多名剩余的司机和该行业的其他人员找到其他工作，尽管其规定含糊不清，也没有为失业工人设定明确的基准。

paras.en: Instead, it requires city hall to come up with a program that includes job referrals, career counselling and educational opportunities. It also allows the administration to consider some form of compensation for industry workers.
paras.zh: 相反，它要求市政府制定一项计划，其中包括工作推荐、职业咨询和教育机会。它还允许政府考虑对行业工人进行某种形式的补偿。

paras.en: The mayor's office has been working on a workforce transition program and has started discussions on potential compensation, according to city hall.
paras.zh: 据市政府称，市长办公室一直在制定劳动力过渡计划，并已开始讨论潜在的补偿方案。

paras.en: "The mayor will sign this bill, and the Mamdani administration is working every day to ensure we can do so while providing the strongest possible protections for the owners and workers in this industry," a spokesperson for the mayor said after the council's vote.
paras.zh: 市长发言人在议会投票后表示：“市长将签署这项法案，马姆达尼政府每天都在努力确保我们能够这样做，同时为该行业的业主和工人提供尽可能强有力的保护。”

paras.en: The union representing carriage drivers had vowed to file a legal challenge "the minute the ink dries" on the legislation.
paras.zh: 代表马车司机的工会发誓要在“墨水干了的那一刻”对该立法提出法律挑战。

paras.en: The latest push began in June after an 18-year-old Indian tourist, Romanch Mahajan, died after jumping from a runaway carriage during a ride. His death appeared to be the first fatality involving a horse carriage in Central Park since the rides began.
paras.zh: 最新的行动始于 6 月，当时一名 18 岁的印度游客 Romanch Mahajan 在乘车时从一辆失控的马车上跳下身亡。他的死亡似乎是中央公园自游乐设施开始以来第一起涉及马车的死亡事件。

paras.en: - Former NHL player happy that horse-drawn vehicles set to be legal in Saskatoon
paras.zh: - 前 NHL 球员很高兴马车在萨斯卡通变得合法

paras.en: - Teen dies after being thrown from horse-drawn carriage in New York's Central Park
paras.zh: - 青少年在纽约中央公园被从马车上扔下后死亡

paras.en: Mahajan's family has personally appealed to the city to end the rides, offering tearful testimony that they thought the rides were safe. His uncle, Gaurav Mahajan, praised the proposal during a rally Thursday, saying "the hour of justice has finally arrived," as he stood beside local lawmakers and animal welfare activists.
paras.zh: 马哈詹的家人亲自呼吁市政府停止这些游乐设施，并含泪作证说他们认为这些游乐设施是安全的。他的叔叔高拉夫·马哈詹 (Gaurav Mahajan) 在周四的一次集会上赞扬了这一提议，并与当地立法者和动物福利活动人士站在一起，称“正义的时刻终于到来”。

paras.en: "We're turning our shattering loss into an unbreakable shield of kindness for the city. For months, our family hasn't been allowed to just grieve," he said. "We've had to fight. We've had to channel our devastating sorrow into a war for change."
paras.zh: 他说：“我们正在把惨痛的损失变成这座城市坚不可摧的善意盾牌。几个月来，我们的家人不能只是悲伤。” “我们必须战斗。我们必须将毁灭性的悲伤转化为一场变革之战。”

paras.en: Carriage drivers have expressed sympathy for Mahajan and his family but argue they are being unfairly targeted because of a single accident.
paras.zh: 马车司机对马哈詹和他的家人表示同情，但辩称他们因为一次事故而成为不公平的目标。

paras.en: "It does nothing for alternate employment, for the continuation of our businesses," said Christina Hansen, a longtime carriage driver and industry spokesperson. "Who's going to pay my rent while I'm looking for a job?"
paras.zh: 长期担任马车司机和行业发言人的克里斯蒂娜·汉森 (Christina Hansen) 表示：“这对于替代就业和我们业务的延续没有任何帮助。” “我找工作的时候谁来付我的房租？”

articles.title: Tibet earthquake kills at least 16

paras.en: Chinese state media reports communication in part of the region has been down
paras.zh: 中国官方媒体报道该地区部分地区的通讯中断

paras.en: A magnitude 7 earthquake hit China's Tibet region on Thursday evening, killing at least 16 people, injuring 46 and collapsing hundreds of homes in the northern regional city of Nagqu, official media said.
paras.zh: 官方媒体称，中国西藏地区周四晚间发生了 7 级地震，造成至少 16 人死亡、46 人受伤，北部地区城市那曲地区数百间房屋倒塌。

paras.en: Search and rescue efforts continued following the collapse of at least 339 homes and 20 livestock sheds, the Nagqu media office said, citing city government officials. Among the injured, 11 people were in serious condition and the other 35 sustained minor injuries, the media office said.
paras.zh: 那曲媒体办公室援引市政府官员的话说，至少 339 所房屋和 20 个牲畜棚倒塌后，搜救工作仍在继续。媒体办公室称，伤者中，11人伤势严重，另外35人轻伤。

paras.en: More than 1,600 people from the local county were deployed for rescue efforts. Supplies including 1,000 prefabricated housing units, around 3,000 tents and folding beds, as well as flashlights and winter clothing arrived in the region.
paras.zh: 当地县调集1600余人参与救援。包括 1,000 个预制房屋、约 3,000 个帐篷和折叠床以及手电筒和冬季服装在内的物资已抵达该地区。

paras.en: China's official news agency Xinhua said on Friday that communication in part of the region has been down. Local railway authorities have taken emergency actions to halt trains passing through the region.
paras.zh: 中国官方通讯社新华社周五表示，该地区部分地区的通讯中断。当地铁路部​​门已采取紧急行动，停止列车通过该地区。

paras.en: The earthquake also caused rockfalls that have forced local authorities to close a section of National Highway 317, allowing only emergency, rescue and official support vehicles through as crews worked to clear debris, according to Xinhua.
paras.zh: 据新华社报道，地震还造成落石，迫使地方当局关闭了 317 号国道的一段路段，只允许应急、救援和官方支援车辆通过，工作人员正在清理废墟。

paras.en: Intermittent snows are expected in the earthquake region over the next three days, Xinhua said.
paras.zh: 新华社称，预计未来三天震区将出现间歇性降雪。

paras.en: It was the biggest earthquake in the region in the last five years, China's national broadcaster CCTV said.
paras.zh: 中国中央电视台称，这是该地区过去五年来最严重的地震。

paras.en: The U.S. Geological Survey said the quake occurred at 10:33 p.m. local time, with its epicentre 191 kilometres east-northeast of Nagqu, in a sparsely populated, high-altitude area of northern Tibet. It put the earthquake's depth at 18 kilometres.
paras.zh: 美国地质调查局表示，地震发生在晚上 10 点 33 分。当地时间，震中位于那曲地区东北偏东191公里处，位于藏北人口稀少的高海拔地区。地震深度为18公里。

paras.en: Nagqu is more than 300 kilometres north of Tibet's capital, Lhasa.
paras.zh: 那曲位于西藏首府拉萨以北300多公里处。

articles.title: Execution staff warned of possibility some of Christa Pike's veins had 'blown': attorney

paras.en: Execution staff warned of possibility some of Christa Pike's veins had 'blown': attorney
paras.zh: 执行人员警告说，克里斯塔·派克的一些血管可能已经“破裂”：律师

paras.en: Defence says IV team went through about 10 needles, tried several IV sites
paras.zh: 辩方称静脉注射小组使用了大约 10 根针，尝试了多个静脉注射部位

paras.en: Tennessee execution team members failed multiple times to establish working IV lines in Christa Pike's arms before her attempted execution and warned that some of her veins may have ruptured, or "blown," before she was injected with the lethal drug, her attorney wrote in a court document filed Thursday.
paras.zh: 克里斯塔·派克的律师在周四提交的一份法庭文件中写道，在试图处决克里斯塔·派克之前，田纳西州行刑小组成员多次未能在她的手臂上建立有效的静脉注射管，并警告说，在她注射致命药物之前，她的一些静脉可能已经破裂或“爆炸”。

paras.en: The IV team went through about 10 needles and tried several IV sites on both arms, attorney Randy Spivey wrote in the document, which provides the most detailed account of the execution attempt so far. They even struggled to push saline through the last IV site they established, Spivey wrote.
paras.zh: 律师兰迪·斯皮维（Randy Spivey）在文件中写道，静脉注射团队注射了大约 10 根针，并在双臂上尝试了多个静脉注射部位，该文件提供了迄今为止对处决尝试的最详细描述。斯皮维写道，他们甚至努力将盐水推入他们建立的最后一个静脉注射部位。

paras.en: Pike, 50, was hospitalized after surviving two doses of pentobarbital as the state tried to execute her on Sept. 30 for the 1995 stabbing death of classmate Colleen Slemmer. She was 18 when she tortured and killed Slemmer with her boyfriend, becoming one of the youngest women to be sentenced to death.
paras.zh: 50 岁的派克因 1995 年刺死同学科琳·斯莱默 (Colleen Slemmer) 事件而于 9 月 30 日被州政府处决，她注射了两剂戊巴比妥后幸存下来，随后住院治疗。 18岁时，她与男友一起折磨并杀害了斯莱默，成为被判处死刑的最年轻的女性之一。

paras.en: No protocol for those who survive 2nd injection
paras.zh: 对于第二次注射后幸存的人没有方案

paras.en: State protocol calls for a second dose of pentobarbital if the first doesn't result in death, but it doesn't spell out what to do if a person survives the second injection.
paras.zh: 州协议要求，如果第一次注射不会导致死亡，则需要注射第二剂戊巴比妥，但它没有说明如果一个人在第二次注射中幸存下来该怎么办。

paras.en: After being taken to a hospital, Pike was on a ventilator for several days. At one point, her attorneys did not expect her to survive. She ultimately regained consciousness and returned to prison after being discharged.
paras.zh: 派克被送往医院后几天都需要依靠呼吸机。有一次，她的律师并不认为她能活下来。她最终恢复知觉，出院后返回监狱。

paras.en: - Emergency medical help for Christa Pike was delayed due to confusion, 911 tapes reveal
paras.zh: - 911 录音带显示，由于混乱，对 Christa Pike 的紧急医疗救助被推迟

paras.en: - Christa Pike discharged from hospital after surviving execution attempt, attorney says
paras.zh: - 律师称，克里斯塔·派克在行刑尝试中幸存后出院

paras.en: The failed execution has brought renewed scrutiny to how Tennessee carries out death sentences. The court document was part of a separate legal proceeding in which people on the state's death row are challenging Tennessee's lethal injection procedures.
paras.zh: 此次处决失败让人们重新审视田纳西州执行死刑的方式。这份法庭文件是一项单独法律诉讼的一部分，该州死囚在该诉讼中对田纳西州的注射死刑程序提出质疑。

paras.en: "Our predictions about the likelihood of botched executions have come true — and will continue to come true — without substantial change," said Kit Thomas, an attorney representing people on death row in the case.
paras.zh: 代表该案死囚的律师基特·托马斯 (Kit Thomas) 表示：“我们对处决失败可能性的预测已经实现，并将继续实现，而且不会发生实质性变化。”

paras.en: The execution team began trying to place the two IVs required by Tennessee's execution protocols at 6:34 p.m., Spivey wrote, and when they struggled Pike helped, advising them to look in her upper arm for a viable vein.
paras.zh: 斯皮维写道，执行小组于下午 6 点 34 分开始尝试放置田纳西州执行协议所需的两个静脉注射器，当他们陷入困境时，派克提供了帮助，建议他们在她的上臂中寻找可行的静脉。

paras.en: They managed to set an IV in Pike's right arm within about six minutes, but it took them nearly an hour to complete the same process in her left arm.
paras.zh: 他们在大约六分钟内成功地在派克的右臂上放置了静脉注射，但他们花了近一个小时才在她的左臂上完成了同样的过程。

paras.en: Pike was "wincing and grimacing" as the IV team members moved the needles around inside her left arm, Spivey wrote, and the team members repeatedly expressed doubts after inserting the needles.
paras.zh: 斯皮维写道，当静脉注射团队成员在她的左臂内移动针头时，派克“皱着眉头，做鬼脸”，而团队成员在插入针头后一再表示怀疑。

paras.en: One team member said a vein "might be blowing" at 6:57 p.m. while examining an IV in Pike's left arm, but two others said they couldn't tell, Spivey wrote. "One of them said something like, ‘it's either blood or blown, I need to know,'" Spivey wrote.
paras.zh: 一名团队成员表示，下午 6 点 57 分，静脉“可能会破裂”。斯皮维写道，当时正在检查派克左臂的静脉注射，但另外两人表示他们无法判断。 “其中一个人说了类似的话，‘我需要知道，要么是流血，要么是爆炸，’”斯皮维写道。

paras.en: The team tried again with a different spot in her left arm, and the needle appeared to be severely bent when they pulled it out, the attorney said.
paras.zh: 律师说，团队再次尝试在她左臂的另一个位置进行操作，当他们拔出针头时，针头似乎严重弯曲。

paras.en: "I think it's blown," the attorney recalled one of the IV team members saying at 7:07 p.m.
paras.zh: “我认为事情已经搞砸了，”律师回忆说，IV 团队的一名成员在晚上 7 点 07 分说道。

paras.en: After more attempts, the team decided at 7:13 p.m. that they had successfully placed an IV in Pike's left arm, and they taped her hands down and hooked her up to a heart monitor.
paras.zh: 经过多次尝试，团队于晚上 7 点 13 分做出决定。他们已经成功地在派克的左臂上放置了静脉注射，然后用胶带将她的双手粘住，并将她连接到心脏监护仪上。

paras.en: A series of phone calls were made to the execution chamber starting about five minutes later.
paras.zh: 大约五分钟后，行刑室接到一系列电话。

paras.en: Spivey said it appeared the execution team members responsible for pushing the pentobarbital into the lines — a process that happens in an adjoining room — were asking the IV team for repeated checks of Pike's left arm.
paras.zh: 斯皮维说，负责将戊巴比妥推入生产线的执行小组成员似乎正在要求静脉输液小组对派克的左臂进行反复检查。

paras.en: Emergency vehicles are seen arriving at Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville, Tenn., on Sept. 30, after the execution of Christa Pike was halted. (AP Photo/George Walker IV)
paras.zh: 9月30日，在克里斯塔·派克的处决停止后，紧急车辆抵达田纳西州纳什维尔的河湾最高安全机构。 （美联社照片/乔治·沃克四世）

paras.en: It's not clear exactly when the pentobarbital was pushed into the IV lines, but at 7:34 p.m., Pike said her arm was hurting.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚戊巴比妥何时被注入静脉注射管，但在晚上 7 点 34 分，派克说她的手臂很疼。

paras.en: "I feel like my arm is about to bust. It burns," she said, according to her attorney. She continued to talk to her spiritual adviser for the next 10 minutes before she began making an "agitated snoring sound," Spivey wrote.
paras.zh: 据她的律师说，“我感觉我的手臂快要断裂了。它在燃烧。”斯皮维写道，在接下来的 10 分钟里，她继续与精神顾问交谈，然后开始发出“激动的鼾声”。

paras.en: Over the next 30 minutes Pike strained, flinched, moved her head and seemed to struggle to breathe, Spivey said, and when he asked to use a phone he was led on a circuitous, seven-minute route through the facility instead of being allowed to use the phone in the execution witness room.
paras.zh: 斯皮维说，在接下来的 30 分钟内，派克紧张、退缩、移动头部，似乎呼吸困难，当他要求使用电话时，他被引导绕了七分钟的路线穿过设施，而不是被允许在行刑证人室使用电话。

paras.en: Spivey called fellow attorneys at 8:22 p.m. and asked them to stop the execution because a third dose of pentobarbital isn't authorized under the state's protocol. He then went back to the witness room and told the deputy attorney general that Pike needed immediate medical care.
paras.zh: 晚上 8 点 22 分，斯皮维给其他律师打电话。并要求他们停止处决，因为根据该州的协议，第三剂戊巴比妥未获授权。然后他回到证人室并告诉副检察长派克需要立即接受医疗护理。

paras.en: Spivey was told an ambulance was on the way at 8:50 p.m., and 20 minutes later he was told that medical staff were providing life-saving measures, he wrote. An ambulance was seen arriving at the hospital at 9:14 p.m.
paras.zh: 斯皮维写道，晚上 8 点 50 分，他被告知一辆救护车正在路上，20 分钟后，他被告知医务人员正在提供救生措施。晚上9点14分，一辆救护车抵达医院。

articles.title: Bulgaria: Concerns about security in the Black Sea dominate presidential election campaign

paras.en: Six months after Bulgaria's parliamentary election, the country is gearing up to choose its next president.
paras.zh: 保加利亚议会选举六个月后，该国正准备选举下一任总统。

paras.en: Although the role of president in Bulgaria is largely ceremonial, the election on October 25 — with a potential runoff on November 1 — will serve as a test for the government of former President Rumen Radev, whose party won a landslide victory in April, securing an unprecedented majority — the first in Bulgaria in almost three decades.
paras.zh: 尽管保加利亚总统的角色主要是仪式性的，但 10 月 25 日的选举——可能在 11 月 1 日进行决选——将成为对前总统鲁门·拉德夫 (Rumen Radev) 政府的考验，他的政党在 4 月份赢得了压倒性胜利，获得了前所未有的多数席位——这是保加利亚近三十年来的第一次。

paras.en: Although there are 27 candidates on the ballot, the race has narrowed to a duel between the incumbent president, Iliana Yotova, who served two terms as Radev's vice president and is backed by the prime minister, and former caretaker Prime Minister Andrey Gyurov, who is supported by opposition parties.
paras.zh: 尽管有27名候选人参加投票，但竞争已缩小为现任总统伊利亚娜·约托娃(Iliana Yotova)和前看守总理安德烈·久罗夫(Andrey Gyurov)之间的对决。伊利亚娜·约托娃曾担任拉德夫的副总统两届，并得到了总理的支持。

paras.en: According to the Bulgarian Constitution, the Bulgarian president embodies national unity. He or she represents the country at international level (with a few exceptions), is the commander-in-chief of its armed forces, appoints members of the Supreme Judicial Council and various regulatory bodies, including caretaker governments, and has the power to veto legislation.
paras.zh: 根据保加利亚宪法，保加利亚总统代表国家团结。他或她在国际层面代表国家（除少数例外），是武装部队的总司令，任命最高司法委员会和各种监管机构（包括看守政府）的成员，并有权否决立法。

paras.en: Hristo Panchugov, a political scientist at the New Bulgarian University in Sofia, argued that although the president's powers are formally limited, the office is particularly significant in the current context.
paras.zh: 索非亚新保加利亚大学政治学家赫里斯托·潘楚戈夫认为，尽管总统的权力在形式上受到限制，但该职位在当前背景下尤为重要。

paras.en: "For the first time in Bulgaria's modern democratic history, we have an absolutely uncontested majority that is not held together by any coalition, but rather by a single political party that faces an opposition that is completely falling apart," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“在保加利亚现代民主历史上，我们第一次拥有了绝对无可争议的多数席位，这个多数席位不是由任何联盟联合起来的，而是由一个面临彻底分崩离析的反对派的单一政党联合起来的。”

paras.en: Panchugov went on to say that it would have been better if the campaign had focused more on "whether the president could serve as a counterbalance."
paras.zh: 潘楚戈夫接着表示，如果竞选活动更多地关注“总统是否可以起到制衡作用”，那就更好了。

paras.en: Opposition candidate Andrey Gyurov reiterated this point in an interview with DW: "We are seeing a concentration of power that always bears the marks of a slide toward autocracy... A president should know how to say no."
paras.zh: 反对派候选人安德烈·久罗夫在接受德国之声采访时重申了这一点：“我们看到权力的集中总是带有滑向独裁的标志……总统应该知道如何说不。”

paras.en: Iliana Yotova declined DW's request for an interview.
paras.zh: 伊利亚娜·约托娃拒绝了德国之声的采访请求。

paras.en: Initially, the presidential race was characterized by small rallies, a lack of televised debates and numerous personal attacks on the two leading candidates.
paras.zh: 最初，总统竞选的特点是小型集会、缺乏电视辩论以及对两位主要候选人进行多次人身攻击。

paras.en: In recent weeks, however, following drone attacks on ships in the Black Sea, the two frontrunners' diverging positions on support for Ukraine have come to the fore.
paras.zh: 然而，最近几周，在黑海船只遭到无人机袭击后，两位领跑者在支持乌克兰问题上的分歧立场凸显出来。

paras.en: Bulgaria's government initially declined invitations to join the Coalition of the Willing and NATO's anti-drone initiative but changed its position on the latter after the recent drone attacks.
paras.zh: 保加利亚政府最初拒绝加入自愿联盟和北约反无人机倡议的邀请，但在最近的无人机袭击事件后改变了对后者的立场。

paras.en: Yotova has advocated for the establishment of a "Coalition of Peace," in which she believes Bulgaria would have a stronger diplomatic voice in the process to endRussia's war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 约托娃主张建立“和平联盟”，她相信保加利亚将在结束俄罗斯乌克兰战争的过程中拥有更强有力的外交声音。

paras.en: "There are many warmongers in our country; I am not one of them," she said at a campaign rally this month. "As long as I am president — and if you place your trust in me — not a single Bulgarian soldier will go to Ukraine."
paras.zh: “我们国家有很多战争贩子；我不是其中之一，”她在本月的一次竞选集会上说。 “只要我还是总统——如果你们信任我——没有一个保加利亚士兵会去乌克兰。”

paras.en: Yotova has sought to reassure voters that no Bulgarian troops will be sent to Ukraine, even though this has not featured in public debate, and has been ruled out by a 2025 parliamentary declaration that reaffirmed that the Bulgarian Armed Forces would not participate in hostilities there.
paras.zh: 约托娃试图向选民保证，保加利亚不会向乌克兰派遣军队，尽管这一点并未出现在公开辩论中，并且已被 2025 年议会声明所排除，该声明重申保加利亚武装部队不会参与乌克兰的敌对行动。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the recent drone attacks on commercial ships in the Black Sea have put new pressure on both the president and Rumen Radev's Progressive Bulgaria party.
paras.zh: 然而，最近黑海商船遭受的无人机袭击给总统和鲁门·拉德夫领导的保加利亚进步党带来了新的压力。

paras.en: The effect of the Black Sea drone strikes
paras.zh: 黑海无人机袭击的影响

paras.en: "The drone strikes in the Black Sea brought the otherwise abstract geopolitical situation right into the daily lives of every Bulgarian," Boriana Dimitrova, managing partner of the Alpha Research market and social research agency, told DW.
paras.zh: “黑海的无人机袭击将原本抽象的地缘政治局势带入了每个保加利亚人的日常生活，”阿尔法研究市场和社会研究机构的执行合伙人博里亚娜·迪米特罗娃（Boriana Dimitrova）告诉德国之声。

paras.en: Many in Europe, including Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, have laid the blame for the attacks squarely at Russia's door. The fact that Bulgaria's leaders did not clearly attribute blame for the attacks fueled frustration across the country.
paras.zh: 包括乌克兰总统泽连斯基在内的许多欧洲人都将此次袭击归咎于俄罗斯。保加利亚领导人没有明确归咎于袭击事件，这一事实加剧了全国各地的不满情绪。

paras.en: After the first drone attack, President Yotova convened the country's Consultative Council on National Security. Its subsequent declaration did not name the source of the threat in the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 第一次无人机袭击后，总统约托娃召集了该国国家安全咨询委员会。其随后的声明没有指出黑海威胁的来源。

paras.en: A week later, after the second attack, Prime Minister Radev said, "We lack solid, clear evidence to level accusations against any specific party; however logic suggests the outcome works to the advantage of Russia." He then summoned the Russian ambassador for talks.
paras.zh: 一周后，第二次袭击发生后，拉德夫总理表示，“我们缺乏可靠、明确的证据来对任何特定政党提出指控；但逻辑表明，结果对俄罗斯有利。”随后他召见俄罗斯大使进行会谈。

paras.en: Opposition to an 'ambiguous' foreign policy stance
paras.zh: 反对“模棱两可”的外交政策立场

paras.en: The stance of the government and president is having an impact on the race.
paras.zh: 政府和总统的立场正在对竞选产生影响。

paras.en: "We're seeing a slight decline in support for Iliana Yotova, which is not threatening her first-place position by any means in the first round, but there has been a decline given the ambiguity of some of the positions she has taken," said Boriana Dimitrova.
paras.zh: 博里亚娜·迪米特罗娃 (Boriana Dimitrova) 表示：“我们看到伊利亚娜·约托娃 (Iliana Yotova) 的支持率略有下降，这不会以任何方式威胁到她在第一轮中的第一名位置，但由于她所采取的一些立场不明确，支持率有所下降。”

paras.en: As the issue of security entered the public debate, some Bulgarians took to the streets in Sofia to protest against what they saw as the government's ambiguous foreign policy stance on this matter.
paras.zh: 随着安全问题进入公众辩论，一些保加利亚人走上索非亚街头抗议政府在这一问题上模棱两可的外交政策立场。

paras.en: "I think the drone attacks in the Black Sea and the utterly spineless stance of the president, the prime minister, and everyone acting in unison were the last straw, and I believe that, on the eve of the presidential election, this should serve as a catalyst," Vlada Tzenova, one of the protesters, told DW.
paras.zh: 抗议者之一弗拉达·策诺娃（Vlada Tzenova）告诉德国之声：“我认为黑海的无人机袭击以及总统、总理和所有人一致行动的毫无骨气的立场是最后一根稻草，我相信，在总统选举前夕，这应该成为一种催化剂。”

paras.en: All this is reflected in the preliminary results of the latest opinion poll conducted by Alpha Research. While expected voter turnout is up, the gap between the two frontrunners has narrowed: Yotova is still ahead, leading Gyurov by about 12 percentage points in the first round, but the margin is smaller than it was.
paras.zh: 这一切都反映在Alpha Research最新民意调查的初步结果中。虽然预期选民投票率有所上升，但两位领跑者之间的差距已经缩小：约托娃仍然领先，在第一轮中领先久罗夫约 12 个百分点，但差距比原来要小。

paras.en: Nevertheless, these recent dynamics do not necessarily mean a shift in the balance of power.
paras.zh: 然而，最近的这些动态并不一定意味着力量平衡的转变。

paras.en: Panchugov said that Gyurov's campaign has been hampered by his hesitancy to declare his candidacy, a lack of "passion" in his campaign, and the fact that he made few comments on current affairs before he joined the race.
paras.zh: 潘丘戈夫表示，久罗夫的竞选活动受到了阻碍，因为他在宣布参选时犹豫不决，竞选活动缺乏“热情”，而且在参加竞选之前很少对时事发表评论。

paras.en: Moreover, supporters of the candidate of the pro-Russian nationalist Vazrazhdane (Revival) party, which ranked third in the Alpha Research poll, would be most likely to support Yotova in a second round.
paras.zh: 此外，在阿尔法研究民意调查中排名第三的亲俄罗斯民族主义复兴党候选人的支持者最有可能在第二轮投票中支持约托娃。

paras.en: What could decide the outcome of the election is the fact that both GERB and DPS, two of the established parties that attracted the support of more than 660,000 voters in April, did not field a presidential candidate.
paras.zh: 决定选举结果的因素是，4 月份获得超过 66 万选民支持的两个老牌政党 GERB 和 DPS 都没有派出总统候选人。

paras.en: According to Alpha Research, half of GERB's supporters do not intend to vote in the first round. The party dominated Bulgaria's political landscape for 17 years but lost power in December following mass anti-corruption protests backed by opposition parties supporting Andrey Gyurov.
paras.zh: 据Alpha Research称，一半的GERB支持者不打算在第一轮投票。该党在保加利亚政坛占据主导地位长达 17 年，但在支持安德烈·久罗夫的反对党支持的大规模反腐败抗议活动之后于 12 月失去权力。

paras.en: Most of the remaining GERB supporters are expected to back Gyurov, as the party has historically opposed Iliana Yotova's political home, the Bulgarian Socialist Party.
paras.zh: 大多数剩余的 GERB 支持者预计将支持久罗夫，因为该党历来反对伊利亚娜·约托娃的政治家园保加利亚社会党。

paras.en: At the same time, both Gyurov's campaign and nationalist parties are seeing increased mobilization, with the latter drawing support from voters disappointed by the government's cautious response to the drone attacks.
paras.zh: 与此同时，久罗夫的竞选团队和民族主义政党的动员程度都在增加，后者得到了对政府对无人机袭击的谨慎反应感到失望的选民的支持。

paras.en: "We can view these elections as the first test of confidence in the party that recently won the election," Boriana Dimitrova said. "In peaceful times, the center attracts the most attention; in turbulent times, those candidates who take a clearer stance — regardless of the direction — gain greater visibility."
paras.zh: 博里亚娜·迪米特罗娃说：“我们可以将这些选举视为对最近赢得选举的政党信心的首次考验。” “在和平时期，中间派最受关注；在动荡时期，那些立场更明确的候选人——无论方向如何——会获得更大的关注度。”

articles.title: Ukraine: Life near the front line in Sloviansk

paras.en: A few days ago, three Russian aerial bombs struck a residential neighborhood on the outskirts of Sloviansk. One hit a five-story apartment building, injuring seven people. Along with neighboring Kramatorsk, Sloviansk is one of the last major towns in the eastern Ukrainian region of Donetsk still under Ukrainian control. Since summer, the city has been a combat zone.
paras.zh: 几天前，三枚俄罗斯航空炸弹袭击了斯洛维斯克郊区的一个居民区。其中一起击中了一栋五层公寓楼，造成七人受伤。斯洛维安斯克与邻近的克拉马托尔斯克一样，是乌克兰东部顿涅茨克地区最后仍受乌克兰控制的主要城镇之一。自夏季以来，这座城市一直是战区。

paras.en: In a courtyard surrounded by damaged apartment blocks, a dusty carpet hangs over the metal frame of a swing set. Tetjana, a pensioner who lives in the building across the street, has brought it out of her rubble-strewn apartment to clean it. She was in her kitchen when the bombs struck.
paras.zh: 在一个被损坏的公寓楼包围的庭院里，一张布满灰尘的地毯悬挂在秋千的金属框架上。住在街对面大楼里的养老金领取者特贾娜（Tetjana）将其从她满是瓦砾的公寓中取出来进行清理。炸弹袭击时她正在厨房里。

paras.en: "The bomb hit the second floor, and a woman who lived on the fourth floor was screaming," she tells DW. "They managed to rescue her before that entire section of the building collapsed," she adds.
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声：“炸弹击中了二楼，一名住在四楼的妇女正在尖叫。” “他们在整栋大楼倒塌之前成功救出了她，”她补充道。

paras.en: Despite being offered the opportunity to evacuate, Tetjana has yet to leave Sloviansk. "I don't know where I would go," she says. Rent can cost up to €400 ($449) a month. Tetjana's pension is the equivalent of just €67 ($75) a month. Even with monthly relocation assistance of about €40 ($45), she could not make ends meet. "I couldn't live on that. Nowhere!"
paras.zh: 尽管获得了撤离的机会，特贾纳尚未离开斯洛维安斯克。 “我不知道我会去哪里，”她说。每月租金最高可达 400 欧元（449 美元）。 Tetjana 的养老金相当于每月 67 欧元（75 美元）。即使每月有大约 40 欧元（45 美元）的搬迁援助，她也无法维持收支平衡。 “我不能靠这个生活。无处可去！”

paras.en: Meanwhile, electricity and water are still available in her neighborhood, but the gas supply has been cut off. "We'll get through this," Tetjana says hopefully. "Everything will be OK. That's what I tell everyone. I want that so much."
paras.zh: 与此同时，她所在的社区仍然有水电供应，但燃气供应已被切断。 “我们会渡过难关的，”泰贾娜满怀希望地说。 “一切都会好起来的。这就是我告诉大家的。我非常想要这样。”

paras.en: Residents reluctant to evacuate without pets
paras.zh: 居民不愿在没有宠物的情况下撤离

paras.en: Days after the attack, the few residents remaining in the damaged buildings were still clearing out their apartments. But another attack hit as they worked. This time, the bombs struck a building housing a state-run emergency assistance center and the Red Cross. While firefighters put out the blaze, rescue workers and volunteers retrieved belongings left inside and cleared away broken glass. Eight people were injured in the attack.
paras.zh: 袭击发生几天后，留在受损建筑物中的少数居民仍在清理他们的公寓。但就在他们工作时，另一次袭击袭来。这次，炸弹袭击了一座国营紧急援助中心和红十字会所在的建筑。当消防队员扑灭大火时，救援人员和志愿者取回了留在里面的物品并清理了碎玻璃。八人在袭击中受伤。

paras.en: "I was on the balcony when there was a deafening bang. It felt as if someone had hit me over the head," says Natalja, describing one of the recent attacks. The pensioner comes to this part of the city to care for her twin sister. "She can no longer get around. Today, I couldn't bring her bread, only crispbread," she tells DW. Although shops and a few stalls remain at the burned-out market, bread is not available every day.
paras.zh: “我当时正在阳台上，突然听到一声震耳欲聋的巨响。感觉好像有人打了我的头，”纳塔利亚在描述最近发生的一起袭击事件时说道。这位养老金领取者来到城市的这个地区照顾她的双胞胎妹妹。 “她无法再四处走动。今天，我无法给她带来面包，只能给她带来薄脆面包，”她告诉德国之声。尽管被烧毁的市场上还保留着商店和一些摊位，但并不是每天都能买到面包。

paras.en: "I tried to persuade my sister to leave. I would go to a nursing home and she would go to a hospital. But her dog is sick, and I have one, too," Natalja says, noting that pets are not allowed during evacuations. "I can't leave my sister behind. She is worried and angry with me, as if everything were my fault. I have no strength left."
paras.zh: “我试图说服我姐姐离开。我会去疗养院，她会去医院。但她的狗病了，我也有一只，”纳塔利亚说，并指出疏散期间不允许携带宠物。 “我不能丢下姐姐不管。她对我又担心又生气，好像一切都是我的错。我已经没有力气了。”

paras.en: Natalja slowly sets off for home, "so I can get there before dark." The city center is nearly 4 kilometers (2.5 miles) away. Public transportation has been suspended since 30 people were killed in an attack on two buses in neighboring Kramatorsk.
paras.zh: 娜塔莉娅慢慢地出发回家，“这样我就能在天黑之前到达那里。”距离市中心近 4 公里（2.5 英里）。邻近克拉马托尔斯克两辆公交车发生袭击事件，造成 30 人死亡，公共交通已暂停。

paras.en: The center of Sloviansk is heavily damaged. Few people are out on the streets, though a handful of shops remain open. Of the city's 100,000 residents, about 20,000 remain, most of them elderly people who are unable to leave.
paras.zh: 斯洛维斯克市中心遭到严重破坏。街上几乎没有人，但少数商店仍然营业。该市10万居民中，约有2万人幸存，其中大多数是无法离开的老年人。

paras.en: Vasyl, a pensioner, is from the village of Mayaky, north of Sloviansk. A neighbor drove him into the city center, where he sat down for lunch in a cafe. "We're used to living under fire by now," he says. "But it's a bad habit. We should have broken it long ago."
paras.zh: 瓦西里是一名养老金领取者，来自斯洛维斯克北部的马亚基村。一位邻居开车送他到市中心，他在一家咖啡馆坐下来吃午餐。 “我们现在已经习惯了生活在炮火之下，”他说。 “但这是一个坏习惯。我们早就应该改掉它了。”

paras.en: Vasyl wants peace for his homeland. But he rejects Russian President Vladimir Putin's demand that the part of the Donetsk region under Ukrainian control be handed over to Moscow.
paras.zh: 瓦西里希望他的祖国享有和平。但他拒绝了俄罗斯总统普京关于将乌克兰控制下的顿涅茨克地区部分移交给莫斯科的要求。

paras.en: Two elderly women talk on a street covered with nets to protect against drones. "I can't remember the last time I slept through the night," says Iryna, a pensioner. "It's terrible, but I have nowhere to go. I'm supposed to leave my two cats behind, but I love them so much. They're all I have."
paras.zh: 两名老年妇女在布满防无人机网的街道上交谈。 “我不记得上次睡整夜是什么时候了，”养老金领取者伊琳娜说。 “这太可怕了，但我无处可去。我应该把我的两只猫留下，但我非常爱它们。它们是我的全部。”

paras.en: "We can only hide, trembling, and pray to God that everything will be all right," Iryna continues. "When I have to go to the market, I don't know if I'll make it there alive."
paras.zh: “我们只能躲起来，瑟瑟发抖，向上帝祈祷一切都会好起来，”伊琳娜继续说道。 “当我必须去市场时，我不知道我是否能活着到达那里。”

paras.en: Russian drones attacked the central market several weeks ago, injuring at least three people. Since then, fewer vendors and customers have been coming to the market.
paras.zh: 几周前，俄罗斯无人机袭击了中央市场，造成至少三人受伤。从那时起，进入市场的供应商和客户越来越少。

paras.en: Valeriya sells women's underwear. With kindergartens closed, she has to bring her 5-year-old daughter Sofia to work. Their neighborhood in Sloviansk is not yet subject to the mandatory evacuation of families with children.
paras.zh: Valeriya 销售女士内衣。由于幼儿园关闭，她不得不带着 5 岁的女儿索菲亚去上班。他们位于斯洛维安斯克的社区尚未对有孩子的家庭进行强制疏散。

paras.en: "We're used to this life by now. We were evacuated in 2022, but later returned. Now we're waiting to be evacuated again," Valeriya says.
paras.zh: “我们现在已经习惯了这种生活。我们在 2022 年被疏散，但后来又回来了。现在我们正在等待再次疏散，”瓦莱里亚说。

paras.en: Sofia races through the market aisles with her friend Anya, who is a year older. Anya's mother is a soldier defending her hometown. Her grandmother, Tetjana, sits nearby selling men's clothing. She, too, has to look after her granddaughter while working.
paras.zh: 索菲亚和比她大一岁的朋友安雅跑过市场过道。安雅的母亲是一名保卫家乡的士兵。她的祖母泰贾娜 (Tetjana) 坐在附近卖男装。她也必须一边工作一边照顾孙女。

paras.en: Tetjana has started shipping her belongings to the Dnipropetrovsk region, where she hopes to start a new life. She is sending them while the post office is still open. "It hurts to see our Ukraine being destroyed," she says, fighting back tears. "Who will rebuild our cities?"
paras.zh: Tetjana 已开始将她的物品运送到第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克地区，她希望在那里开始新的生活。她在邮局还开门的时候寄出它们。 “看到我们的乌克兰被摧毁，我很伤心，”她强忍着泪水说道。 “谁来重建我们的城市？”

paras.en: She hopes to return one day. But the fate of Bakhmut weighs on her mind. "Look at Bakhmut. There are no houses left. I'm counting on our boys to hold our cities, even though it's very difficult." Bakhmut, about 50 kilometers (31 miles) from Sloviansk, fell to Russian forces in 2023 after months of heavy fighting.
paras.zh: 她希望有一天能回来。但巴克穆特的命运让她心神不宁。 “看看巴克穆特。已经没有房子了。我指望我们的孩子们能够守住我们的城市，尽管这非常困难。”巴赫穆特距离斯洛维斯克约 50 公里（31 英里），经过数月的激战，于 2023 年落入俄罗斯军队之手。

paras.en: The women see little hope for a ceasefire. "Putin won't want one. And our younger generation will ask us what we fought for in the first place," Tetjana says. She believes Russia must withdraw from Ukrainian territory.
paras.zh: 妇女们看不到停火的希望。 “普京不会想要这样的人。我们的年轻一代会问我们最初是为了什么而战，”泰贾纳说。她认为俄罗斯必须从乌克兰领土撤军。

paras.en: Drones buzz overhead as gunfire echoes across the market. "It's hard for our boys to shoot them down," Tetjana says. "But they're doing their best."
paras.zh: 枪声在市场上回响，无人机在头顶嗡嗡作响。 “我们的队员很难击落它们，”泰贾纳说。 “但他们正在尽力而为。”

paras.en: This article was originally published in Ukrainian.
paras.zh: 本文最初以乌克兰语发表。

articles.title: Albania's student protests are only getting bigger

paras.en: The fallout from the October 13 protests was still visible when students and faculty from the University of Tirana gathered outside the Education Ministry in Albania's capital on Tuesday to express their continued discontent. Smashed windows have yet to be replaced; the walls are still black with soot from fires that broke out during the protests.
paras.zh: 周二，地拉那大学的学生和教师聚集在阿尔巴尼亚首都教育部外，表达他们持续的不满，10 月 13 日抗议活动的影响仍然清晰可见。被打碎的窗户尚未更换；墙壁仍然因抗议期间爆发的火灾而被烟灰熏黑。

paras.en: Albania has seen nearly five months of peaceful anti-government protests, sparked initially when plans were made public that Jared Kushner — a son-in-law of US President Donald Trump — and associates intended to build a luxury hotel complex within a nature reserve.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚已经经历了近五个月的和平反政府抗议活动，最初是在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳及其同事打算在自然保护区内建造一座豪华酒店综合体的计划公开时引发的。

paras.en: Since then, anti-government and anti-corruption protests have escalated. Now, college and high school students clash with police forces almost daily, with the fiercest clashes so far occurring last week.
paras.zh: 此后，反政府和反腐败抗议活动不断升级。现在，大学生和高中生几乎每天都会与警察发生冲突，迄今为止最激烈的冲突发生在上周。

paras.en: Protesters denounce corruption, mismanaged universities and the rising cost of education in Albania — and call for the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, who has been in office since 2013.
paras.zh: 抗议者谴责阿尔巴尼亚的腐败、大学管理不善以及不断上涨的教育成本，并要求自 2013 年就任的总理埃迪·拉马辞职。

paras.en: Wearing a black hooded jacket and a scarf across her face to conceal her identity, a woman who asked to be called Sara because she fears repercussions for speaking to the press told DW that protesters "communicate via text messages — that's the only way."
paras.zh: 一名身穿黑色连帽夹克并用围巾遮住脸以隐藏身份的女子告诉德国之声，抗议者“通过短信进行交流——这是唯一的方式”。由于担心接受媒体采访而受到影响，她要求自己称呼自己为萨拉。

paras.en: She cut the interview short as some protesters began flinging stones at the Education Ministry. Police pushed demonstrators and journalists out of the way, using water cannons to disperse the crowd.
paras.zh: 当一些抗议者开始向教育部投掷石块时，她中断了采访。警察将示威者和记者推开，并使用高压水枪驱散人群。

paras.en: "Social media is the most important public space today — more so than physical spaces," Besmir Semanaj, a prominent Albanian cybersecurity advocate told DW. "Young Albanians no longer organize through traditional structures such as political parties, associations or public appeals. Instead, they organize themselves where they spend much of their daily lives: on their cellphones."
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚著名网络安全倡导者贝斯米尔·塞马纳吉 (Besmir Semanaj) 告诉德国之声：“社交媒体是当今最重要的公共空间，比物理空间更重要。” “年轻的阿尔巴尼亚人不再通过政党、协会或公众呼吁等传统结构进行组织。相反，他们在日常生活中大部分时间都在手机上组织自己。”

paras.en: "The most important communication channels include Instagram, WhatsApp groups for academic-year cohorts, departments and dormitories, Telegram channels for general announcements, and TikTok for sharing videos," Semanaj said. He added that people who are especially concerned with security use the Signal messaging app.
paras.zh: Semanaj 说：“最重要的沟通渠道包括 Instagram、针对学年班级、院系和宿舍的 WhatsApp 群组、用于一般公告的 Telegram 频道以及用于分享视频的 TikTok。”他补充说，特别关心安全的人会使用 Signal 消息应用程序。

paras.en: "This is a horizontal organizational structure, without individual 'leaders' and without a central command structure," Semanaj said. "That is exactly why the government is having such a hard time understanding and controlling the situation."
paras.zh: “这是一个横向的组织结构，没有个人‘领导者’，也没有中央指挥结构，”塞马纳吉说。 “这正是政府如此难以理解和控制局势的原因。”

paras.en: Semanaj said the Telegram messenger app had proven particularly useful for protesters. "Telegram channels allow you to reach tens of thousands of people at once," he said. "Notifications are sent out within seconds, and external control is more difficult to establish than on traditional platforms."
paras.zh: Semanaj 表示，Telegram 通讯应用程序已被证明对抗议者特别有用。 “电报频道可以让你同时联系数以万计的人，”他说。 “通知在几秒钟内发出，外部控制比传统平台更难建立。”

paras.en: Rama has called the youth uprising a "hybrid war." He said protesters thought they could "make Albania a better country through TikTok and without even being able to string together more than seven coherent words." Though not all are terrorists, he said, he believes that "they are hostages to a certain mindset, a new ideology that has only one goal: to destroy, to turn everything upside down, to raze everything to the ground."
paras.zh: 拉玛称青年起义是一场“混合战争”。他说，抗议者认为他们可以“通过 TikTok 让阿尔巴尼亚成为一个更好的国家，甚至无法将七个以上连贯的单词串在一起。”他说，虽然并非所有人都是恐怖分子，但他相信“他们是某种心态、一种新意识形态的人质，这种意识形态只有一个目标：摧毁、颠覆一切、将一切夷为平地。”

paras.en: Over nearly five months, Rama has accused various "true" masterminds of organizing the anti-government and anti-corruption protests. He has alleged that the governments of Greece, Russia and Iran are stirring up dissent.
paras.zh: 近五个月来，拉玛指责各种“真正”的策划者组织了反政府和反腐败抗议活动。他声称希腊、俄罗斯和伊朗政府正在煽动异议。

paras.en: Most recently, Rama said it was "antifa" — or a decentralized movement of global antifascists — that had stoked anti-government and anti-corruption sentiments in Albania. "These are young people who have been radicalized and ideologically indoctrinated and who are acting under the pressure or influence of a new, dark force that has emerged in Europe and the United States, a force that the President of the United States has designated as a terrorist organization: Antifa," Rama claimed.
paras.zh: 最近，拉马表示，“反法西斯运动”（即全球反法西斯分子的去中心化运动）激起了阿尔巴尼亚的反政府和反腐败情绪。拉马声称：“这些年轻人已经被激进化和意识形态灌输，他们在欧洲和美国出现的新的黑暗势力的压力或影响下行事，美国总统将这股势力定为恐怖组织：Antifa。”

paras.en: Redion Qirjazi, a security affairs researcher who focuses on violence prevention and conflict resolution, told DW that Rama's claim was not likely to prove true. "That is a serious accusation — one that requires equally compelling evidence," Qirjazi said. "To date, no verifiable evidence has been presented to prove the existence of an organized Antifa structure in Albania, let alone its involvement in coordinating the protests."
paras.zh: 专注于预防暴力和解决冲突的安全事务研究员雷迪恩·齐贾兹 (Redion Qirjazi) 告诉德国之声，拉玛的说法不太可能得到证实。 “这是一项严重的指控，需要同样令人信服的证据，”齐贾兹说。 “迄今为止，还没有任何可证实的证据证明阿尔巴尼亚存在有组织的安提法组织，更不用说它参与协调抗议活动了。”

paras.en: Qirjazi said Rama's reference to Trump's calling antifa a terror group was problematic. "Antifa is not a unified international organization with a centralized structure or leadership," he said, "but rather an umbrella term for various movements and groups united by the fact that they are, at their core, anti-fascist."
paras.zh: 基尔贾兹表示，拉玛提及特朗普称安提法为恐怖组织的说法是有问题的。他说：“Antifa 不是一个具有集中结构或领导层的统一国际组织，而是各种运动和团体的总称，这些运动和团体的核心是反法西斯。”

paras.en: Sara said she rejected the "terrorist" label that Rama had attempted to slap on her and her fellow protesters. "There are groups that are willing to use violence — that's true — but I have nothing to do with them," she said. "As soon as I see violence, I walk away; I'm against it."
paras.zh: 萨拉说，她拒绝拉玛试图给她和其他抗议者贴上“恐怖分子”标签。 “有些团体愿意使用暴力——这是事实——但我与他们没有任何关系，”她说。 “我一看到暴力，我就会走开；我反对它。”

paras.en: Arlind Qori, the chairman of the Together Movement, a social-democratic opposition party with just one seat in Albania's parliament, said youths had taken to the streets out of dissatisfaction with the status quo rather than any particular ideology. "Young Albanians are outraged by the current socioeconomic conditions: the poverty, the fact that many of their parents have emigrated because they couldn't support their families, the decline of the education system, the lack of postgraduation prospects," Qori said. The students' central demand is for Rama to resign, he added "not a socialist revolution."
paras.zh: 在阿尔巴尼亚议会中只有一个席位的社会民主党反对党“共同运动”的主席阿尔林德·科里表示，年轻人走上街头是出于对现状的不满，而不是出于任何特定的意识形态。科里说：“年轻的阿尔巴尼亚人对当前的社会经济状况感到愤怒：贫困、许多父母因为无法养家糊口而移民、教育体系衰落、缺乏毕业前景。”学生们的核心要求是拉玛辞职，他补充说“不是社会主义革命”。

paras.en: "People aren't demanding anything radical," Qori said. "They merely want a corrupt head of government to resign — that's a fundamental and moderate demand. But Edi Rama continues to meet this demand with police violence and arrogance."
paras.zh: “人们并没有要求任何激进的东西，”科里说。 “他们只是希望腐败的政府首脑辞职——这是一个基本且温和的要求。但埃迪·拉玛继续以警察暴力和傲慢来满足这一要求。”

paras.en: Qirjazi said Rama's allegations of foreign interference could be a strategy. "When a government faces protests and public discontent, linking demonstrators to extremism and foreign influence may serve to divert attention away from the actual causes and toward a national security narrative," he said.
paras.zh: 基尔贾兹表示，拉玛对外国干涉的指控可能是一种策略。他说：“当政府面临抗议和公众不满时，将示威者与极端主义和外国影响联系起来可能会转移人们对实际原因的注意力，而转向国家安全的叙述。”

paras.en: "This can serve several political purposes: to delegitimize the protesters, to weaken their support among the public, and to justify a tougher crackdown in the name of law and order," Qirjazi said.
paras.zh: 齐尔贾兹说：“这可以达到几个政治目的：使抗议者失去合法性，削弱他们在公众中的支持，并为以法律和秩序的名义进行更严厉的镇压提供理由。”

paras.en: Semanaj said this was a common pattern in governments' efforts to dismiss dissent. "Protests are portrayed as acts of violence," he said. "Young people are cast as manipulated, and their legitimate concerns — conditions at universities, tuition fees, corruption and a lack of prospects — vanish from the news agenda."
paras.zh: 塞马纳吉表示，这是政府消除异议的常见模式。 “抗议被描述为暴力行为，”他说。 “年轻人被认为是被操纵的，他们的合理担忧——大学条件、学费、腐败和缺乏前景——从新闻议程中消失了。”

paras.en: This article was translated from German.
paras.zh: 这篇文章是从德文翻译过来的。

articles.title: Israel arrests 36 Palestinians in the West Bank, attacks on farmers ramp up

paras.en: Israeli forces have arrested 36 Palestinians during raids across the occupied West Bank, as attacks on Palestinian farmers and their lands during the olive harvest season ramp up.
paras.zh: 随着橄榄收获季节对巴勒斯坦农民及其土地的袭击加剧，以色列军队在被占领的约旦河西岸的袭击中逮捕了 36 名巴勒斯坦人。

paras.en: In Jenin governorate, Israeli forces raided towns and villages on Thursday, arresting 10 Palestinians, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported, citing data from the Palestinian Prisoner’s Society.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦通讯社瓦法社援引巴勒斯坦囚犯协会的数据报道，以色列军队周四袭击了杰宁省的城镇和村庄，逮捕了 10 名巴勒斯坦人。

paras.en: Israeli forces also raided the town of Tuqu in the Hebron governorate on Thursday and arrested former prisoner Shorok al-Badan, along with five others from other parts of Hebron, according to Wafa.
paras.zh: 据瓦法报道，以色列军队周四还袭击了希伯伦省的图克镇，逮捕了前囚犯肖罗克·巴丹以及希伯伦其他地区的其他五人。

paras.en: The Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission said on Thursday that Israeli forces arrested 14 people in Khirbet Jawaya village of Masafer Yatta in Hebron, while Wafa reported that three other Palestinians were arrested across the Hebron governorate, citing a security source.
paras.zh: 殖民和隔离墙抵抗委员会周四表示，以色列军队在希伯伦 Masafer Yatta 的 Khirbet Jawaya 村逮捕了 14 人，而瓦法援引安全消息人士的话报道称，希伯伦省其他三名巴勒斯坦人被捕。

paras.en: In Nablus and Jerusalem, three more Palestinians were arrested during Israeli raids in the village of Burin, the town of Awarta, and the Qalandiya refugee camp.
paras.zh: 在纳布卢斯和耶路撒冷，以色列对 Burin 村、Awarta 镇和 Qalandiya 难民营的袭击中又逮捕了三名巴勒斯坦人。

paras.en: The Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission said it documented 17 pogroms by Israeli forces and settlers on Thursday against Palestinian farmers and their land during the olive harvest.
paras.zh: 殖民和抵抗隔离墙委员会表示，周四，以色列军队和定居者在橄榄收获期间对巴勒斯坦农民及其土地进行了 17 起大屠杀。

paras.en: The incidents were recorded across occupied West Bank governorates, including Hebron, Qalqilya, Nablus, Ramallah and el-Bireh, Jenin and Salfit.
paras.zh: 这些事件发生在被占领的西岸省份，包括希伯伦、盖勒吉利耶、纳布卢斯、拉马拉和比雷、杰宁和萨尔菲特。

paras.en: According to the Commission, the attacks included assaults on farmers, preventing them from reaching their land, theft of crops and agricultural equipment, damage and burning of olive trees, as well as arrests, threats at gunpoint and live fire.
paras.zh: 据该委员会称，这些袭击包括袭击农民、阻止他们到达自己的土地、盗窃农作物和农业设备、损坏和焚烧橄榄树，以及逮捕、持枪威胁和实弹射击。

paras.en: The Commission says the pattern represents an escalation in attacks targeting the olive harvest and undermines Palestinians’ ability to access and cultivate their land and maintain their livelihoods.
paras.zh: 委员会表示，这种模式表明针对橄榄收获的袭击不断升级，并损害了巴勒斯坦人获得和耕种土地以及维持生计的能力。

paras.en: Israeli attacks on Palestinian farmers garnered international attention and condemnation. US Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander was briefly detained on Wednesday by the Israeli military with a warning while volunteering to help Palestinian farmers harvest olives in the occupied West Bank.
paras.zh: 以色列对巴勒斯坦农民的袭击引起了国际社会的关注和谴责。美国民主党国会候选人布拉德·兰德周三在自愿帮助巴勒斯坦农民在被占领的约旦河西岸收获橄榄时被以色列军方短暂拘留并发出警告。

articles.title: Keeping Madhubala alive: The fight for Karachi’s captive elephants

paras.en: At Karachi Zoo, Jude Allen sang, You Are My Sunshine, to an elephant he could not save.
paras.zh: 在卡拉奇动物园，裘德·艾伦对着一头他无法拯救的大象唱起了《你是我的阳光》。

paras.en: Noor Jehan, the 17-year-old African elephant, was suffering. Allen recalls massaging her legs, nursing her bedsores and spending her final days beside her.
paras.zh: 17 岁的非洲象努尔·杰汉 (Noor Jehan) 正在遭受痛苦。艾伦回忆起按摩她的双腿、护理她的褥疮并在她身边度过了最后的日子。

paras.en: She died on April 22, 2023, surrounded by a few activists. Allen, 45, had held various corporate jobs while volunteering as an animal caregiver since an early age.
paras.zh: 她于 2023 年 4 月 22 日去世，周围有几名活动人士。 45 岁的艾伦从小就做过各种公司工作，同时也志愿担任动物看护者。

paras.en: But Noor Jehan changed something in him, he said. “The day this wild African elephant rested her painful forehead on mine, and I hugged her for the first time – it all made sense,” he tells Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 但努尔·贾汉改变了他的一些东西，他说。 “那天，这头野生非洲象把她痛苦的额头靠在我的额头上，我第一次拥抱了她——这一切都是有道理的，”他告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: Now three years later, Allen has turned the grief of Noor Jehan’s loss into care for one of her sisters, Madhubala, who also faces major health challenges. He is part of a growing campaign of Pakistani and international activists and doctors trying to save Madhubala, a victim, her carers say, not just of medical conditions, but also of a system that is simply unable to give animals in captivity the attention and facilities they need.
paras.zh: 三年后的今天，艾伦将努尔·杰汉去世的悲痛转为照顾她的妹妹马杜巴拉，她也面临着重大的健康挑战。马杜巴拉的护理人员表示，他是巴基斯坦和国际活动人士和医生发起的一场不断壮大的运动的一部分，试图拯救马杜巴拉。马杜巴拉的护理人员说，她不仅是因为医疗状况，而且是因为一个系统根本无法为圈养动物提供它们所需的关注和设施。

paras.en: In 2009, four elephant calves captured in Tanzania were brought to Pakistan, allegedly through an animal trader.
paras.zh: 2009年，据称通过动物商人将在坦桑尼亚捕获的四头小象带到巴基斯坦。

paras.en: Two of them, Noor Jehan and Madhubala, were kept at the Karachi Zoo, while their sisters Sonia and Malika were taken to Safari Park, a larger facility also in Pakistan’s largest city that has both a zoo and other viewing spaces for visitors to watch animals up close.
paras.zh: 其中两只努尔·杰汉和马杜巴拉被关在卡拉奇动物园，而它们的姐妹索尼娅和马利卡被带到野生动物园，这是巴基斯坦最大城市的一个更大的设施，设有动物园和其他观赏空间，供游客近距离观看动物。

paras.en: Then, in 2020, Pakistan was gripped by the story of Kaavan, an Asian elephant that had spent 35 years in the capital city of Islamabad, eight of them alone after his companion Saheli died. Four Paws, an international animal welfare organisation, helped move Kaavan to an animal sanctuary in Cambodia, where he now lives with other elephants.
paras.zh: 然后，在2020年，巴基斯坦被Kaavan的故事所困扰， Kaavan是一只亚洲大象，在首都伊斯兰堡度过了35年，在他的同伴萨赫勒去世后，只有八只大象。国际动物福利组织Four Paws帮助将Kaavan转移到柬埔寨的一个动物保护区，他现在在那里与其他大象一起生活。

paras.en: That episode also shone a light on the Karachi sisters. At the time, Allen was helping a friend with another animal shelter, and came to know Four Paws was in town. He reached out to them, and they led him to Noor Jehan and Madhubala.
paras.zh: 那一集也让卡拉奇姐妹有了一些新的认识。当时，艾伦正在帮助一位朋友建立另一个动物收容所，并得知“四爪”就在城里。他向他们伸出援手，他们带他找到了努尔·贾汉和马杜巴拉。

paras.en: By 2021, Noor Jehan’s tusk was infected. She suffered from malnutrition and stress, too.
paras.zh: 到了 2021 年，努尔·贾汉的象牙被感染了。她还患有营养不良和压力。

paras.en: Allen and the other activists couldn’t save Noor Jehan, but the campaign had turned into a wider cry, demanding care and justice for captive animals in the urban jungle of Karachi, the coastal home to 20 million people.
paras.zh: 艾伦和其他活动人士无法拯救努尔·杰汉，但这场运动已经变成了更广泛的呼声，要求照顾卡拉奇城市丛林中的圈养动物并伸张正义，卡拉奇是一个拥有 2000 万人口的沿海家园。

paras.en: One animal in particular became the focus of attention.
paras.zh: 一种动物尤其成为人们关注的焦点。

paras.en: Named after an iconic Indian film actress from the mid-20th century, Madhubala was now the only African elephant at the Karachi Metropolitan Corporation-run zoo. She was alone, banging her head against the gate of her enclosure, Allen recalls. “She didn’t have a friend.”
paras.zh: 马杜巴拉以 20 世纪中叶一位标志性的印度电影女演员的名字命名，现在是卡拉奇大都会公司运营的动物园中唯一的非洲象。艾伦回忆说，她独自一人，用头撞着围栏的大门。 “她没有朋友。”

paras.en: Allen says she needed company – she wanted a friend.
paras.zh: 艾伦说她需要陪伴——她想要一个朋友。

paras.en: Allen, along with Four Paws, helped prepare her for a move to Safari Park, so she could join her sister elephants, Sonia and Malika.
paras.zh: 艾伦和四爪帮助她做好搬到野生动物园的准备，这样她就可以和她的姐妹象索尼娅和玛莉卡一起生活。

paras.en: Four Paws assessed the elephants and found that they needed better diets, enrichment and medical treatment. The organisation recommended reuniting them.
paras.zh: 四爪对大象进行了评估，发现它们需要更好的饮食、营养和医疗。该组织建议他们重新团聚。

paras.en: The reunion came in November 2024. Four Paws documented the meeting between the siblings at Safari Park. Sonia approached Madhubala first. Malika followed. The three touched one another with their trunks and drank together.
paras.zh: 重聚发生在 2024 年 11 月。《四爪》记录了兄弟姐妹在野生动物园的会面。索尼娅首先接近了马杜巴拉。玛莉卡紧随其后。三人用鼻子碰了一下，一起喝了下去。

paras.en: But days later, on December 8, Sonia died, aged about 19, after collapsing in her enclosure. The park’s director initially described an apparent heart failure. Subsequent findings, reported by Four Paws, identified a severe bacterial infection associated with an advanced abscess on her foot.
paras.zh: 但几天后，即 12 月 8 日，索尼娅在围栏内倒塌后死亡，年仅 19 岁。公园负责人最初描述了明显的心力衰竭。据《四爪》报道，随后的调查结果发现，她的脚部出现了严重的细菌感染，并伴有严重的脓肿。

paras.en: Amir Khalil, a Four Paws wildlife vet involved in the elephants’ care, told The Associated Press at the time that “such infections don’t spread in one day”. Four Paws linked her death to prolonged unsuitable living conditions and malnutrition.
paras.zh: 参与大象护理的四爪野生动物兽医阿米尔·哈利勒当时告诉美联社，“这种感染不会在一天内传播”。 《四爪》将她的死亡与长期不适宜的生活条件和营养不良联系起来。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Madhubala and Malika were both diagnosed with tuberculosis, although recent examinations reported by her veterinarian have indicated that Madhubala is no longer testing positive.
paras.zh: 与此同时，马杜巴拉和马利卡都被诊断出患有结核病，尽管她的兽医最近报告的检查表明，马杜巴拉的检测结果不再呈阳性。

paras.en: Now Madhubala, 22, is recovering after losing more than 200kg (440 pounds) and becoming too weak to get up safely after lying down.
paras.zh: 22 岁的马杜巴拉 (Madhubala) 减重超过 200 公斤（440 磅），并且变得太虚弱，躺下后无法安全起身，现在正在康复中。

paras.en: Khalil, who has also rescued wild animals from multiple conflict zones, is one of the carers who has taken charge of Madhubala’s recovery. He told Al Jazeera that Madhubala had recovered 85 percent of her ability to walk, and was a good patient: “She really wants to follow the standard operation procedure and to adhere to the programme that I put in,” he says. That includes a “water massage for the leg with high-pressure water”.
paras.zh: 卡里尔还从多个冲突地区拯救过野生动物，他是负责马杜巴拉康复工作的护理人员之一。他告诉半岛电视台，马杜巴拉已经恢复了 85% 的行走能力，是一个很好的病人：“她真的想遵循标准手术程序并遵守我制定的计划，”他说。其中包括“用高压水对腿部进行水按摩”。

paras.en: He says the required medication needs to be administered properly, and treating all the wounds – and they were getting better when he left Pakistan a few days ago.
paras.zh: 他说，需要正确施用所需的药物，并治疗所有伤口——几天前他离开巴基斯坦时，伤口已经好转。

paras.en: For Allen, the work began with Noor Jehan.
paras.zh: 对于艾伦来说，这项工作是从努尔·贾汉开始的。

paras.en: While she was unwell, he says he visited the zoo daily, checking that the elephants received their food on time and in the right quantities. During Noor Jehan’s final 10 days, he was a near-permanent presence there, assisting the medical team however he could.
paras.zh: 他说，虽然她身体不适，但他每天都会去动物园，检查大象是否按时收到适量的食物。在努尔·贾汉生命的最后 10 天里，他几乎一直呆在那里，尽其所能地协助医疗团队。

paras.en: Her death became the beginning of the “I Am Noor Jehan” movement, which Allen leads for animals in captivity. The Pakistan Animal Welfare Society (PAWS), with I Am Noor Jehan, held a memorial for Noor Jehan with artists, filmmakers, and other animal activists.
paras.zh: 她的死成为艾伦领导的“我是努尔杰汉”运动的开始，该运动旨在保护圈养动物。巴基斯坦动物福利协会 (PAWS) 与我是努尔·杰汉 (I Am Noor Jehan) 一起，与艺术家、电影制作人和其他动物活动家一起为努尔·贾汉举行了纪念活动。

paras.en: Then came Madhubala. Preparing her to enter a transport crate required patience. Allen describes an elephant who could be aggressive and difficult to approach. Four Paws specialists helped him understand her needs.
paras.zh: 然后是马杜巴拉。让她准备进入运输箱需要耐心。艾伦描述了一头具有攻击性且难以接近的大象。四位 Paws 专家帮助他了解了她的需求​​。

paras.en: But delays to the relocation disrupted the training, he says. Madhubala became frustrated and bored. Allen tried football.
paras.zh: 但他说，搬迁的延误扰乱了培训。马杜巴拉变得沮丧和无聊。艾伦尝试过踢足球。

paras.en: He entered her enclosure, an approach he acknowledges Four Paws did not endorse. The caretakers warned him too: Madhubala wasn’t in a playful mood.
paras.zh: 他进入了她的围栏，他承认四爪并不赞同这种做法。看护人员也警告他：马杜巴拉心情不好。

paras.en: But within 20 minutes, he says, Madhubala wanted the ball.
paras.zh: 但他说，20 分钟内，马杜巴拉想要球。

paras.en: She picked it up with her trunk and hid it between her legs. Then she began teasing her caretakers who were trying to retrieve it, offering the ball before concealing it again.
paras.zh: 她用鼻子把它捡起来，藏在两腿之间。然后她开始取笑那些试图取回球的看护者，将球递给她，然后又把它藏了起来。

paras.en: The sessions helped him build a relationship with her, he says. Madhubala began responding eagerly to training again.
paras.zh: 他说，这些课程帮助他与她建立了关系。马杜巴拉再次开始对训练做出积极反应。

paras.en: “Earning her trust was the most significant accomplishment.”
paras.zh: “赢得她的信任是最重要的成就。”

paras.en: That trust is especially important to Allen because he believes that Noor Jehan, and then Sonia, could have been saved.
paras.zh: 这种信任对艾伦来说尤其重要，因为他相信努尔·贾汉和索尼娅都可以得救。

paras.en: When Sonia was unwell, Allen says he had raised concerns with local authorities about her weight loss and a swelling beneath her body. He says those warnings were not adequately acted upon.
paras.zh: 艾伦说，当索尼娅身体不适时，他曾向当地政府提出对她体重减轻和身体下方肿胀的担忧。他说，这些警告没有得到充分落实。

paras.en: ‘What was meant to be a sanctuary became a zoo’
paras.zh: “原本是避难所的地方变成了动物园”

paras.en: The deaths of two of the four African elephants in Karachi raise questions about the resources, expertise and accountability behind keeping wild animals in public institutions, experts say.
paras.zh: 专家表示，卡拉奇四头非洲象中的两头死亡引发了人们对公共机构饲养野生动物背后的资源、专业知识和责任的质疑。

paras.en: Karachi Municipal Corporation has not procured any animals in the last 20 years, and the elephants were brought in long before his time, Karachi Mayor Murtaza Wahab said, speaking to Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 卡拉奇市长穆尔塔扎·瓦哈卜在接受半岛电视台采访时表示，卡拉奇市政公司在过去20年里没有采购过任何动物，这些大象早在他的时代之前就被引入了。

paras.en: “I’ve always said that animal welfare should be paramount. Anyone who wants to come join hands, to look after the animal, we would be ready and willing to work with them,” he said.
paras.zh: “我一直说动物福利应该是最重要的。任何想要携手来照顾动物的人，我们都会准备好并愿意与他们合作，”他说。

paras.en: He argued that his team at KMC had done whatever it could to look after Madhubala with Khalil and other doctors.
paras.zh: 他辩称，他在 KMC 的团队已尽一切努力与哈利勒和其他医生一起照顾马杜巴拉。

paras.en: “Madhubala was being treated, and the good thing is, now, Dr Khalil is also saying things are moving in the right direction and we’ve got a third-party perspective endorsing whatever was being done,” Wahab said.
paras.zh: 瓦哈卜说：“马杜巴拉正在接受治疗，好消息是，现在哈利勒医生也说事情正在朝着正确的方向发展，我们已经得到了第三方的观点支持我们所做的一切。”

paras.en: But Allen says Safari Park, where Madhubala was moved after Noor Jehan’s death, has been a disappointment. Allen says he helped develop Madhubala’s new enclosure there, working on landscaping and the procedures that caregivers needed to use to help her.
paras.zh: 但艾伦表示，努尔·贾汉去世后，马杜巴拉被搬到了野生动物园，这令人失望。艾伦说，他在那里帮助开发了马杜巴拉的新围栏，负责景观美化和护理人员需要用来帮助她的程序。

paras.en: Moving her was supposed to change the conditions of her life. But at Safari Park, he says, people come right up to the elephants, feed them, and treat the facility like a zoo.
paras.zh: 搬家本来应该改变她的生活状况。但他说，在野生动物园，人们会直接来到大象身边，给它们喂食，并把这里当作动物园一样对待。

paras.en: “What was meant to be a sanctuary became a zoo,” he says.
paras.zh: “原本的避难所变成了动物园，”他说。

paras.en: Javed Maher, the top wildlife official in the government of Sindh, the province containing Karachi, says elephants and wildlife need to be in their own habitat, and people caring for them need to have knowledge of animals.
