paras.zh: 卡拉奇所在的信德省政府野生动物高级官员贾韦德·马赫表示，大象和野生动物需要有自己的栖息地，照顾它们的人需要了解动物。

paras.en: Currently, the Safari Park enclosure for elephants is about 14 hectares, roughly 35 acres, according to Four Paws.
paras.zh: 据“四爪”称，目前野生动物园的大象围栏面积约为 14 公顷（约 35 英亩）。

paras.en: Mahar says he offered hundreds of acres in the rural country for these elephants so they can live freely.
paras.zh: 马哈尔说，他在农村地区为这些大象提供了数百英亩的土地，以便它们能够自由生活。

paras.en: “Karachi Zoo, along with the majority of the zoos of the country, is not capable,” he says.
paras.zh: “卡拉奇动物园以及该国大多数动物园都没有能力，”他说。

paras.en: But the elephants have remained at Safari Park.
paras.zh: 但大象仍留在野生动物园。

paras.en: Former Islamabad High Court Chief Justice Athar Minallah, in a landmark 2020 judgement, declared that animals had rights. It was that ruling that enabled the transfer of Kaavan to Cambodia, and two Himalayan bears to a sanctuary in Jordan. The zoo in Islamabad was closed, and all 878 animals kept there were released or relocated.
paras.zh: 伊斯兰堡高等法院前首席法官 Athar Minallah 在 2020 年具有里程碑意义的判决中宣布动物享有权利。正是这一裁决使得卡万被转移到柬埔寨，两只喜马拉雅熊被转移到约旦的避难所。伊斯兰堡动物园被关闭，里面饲养的878只动物全部被释放或转移。

paras.en: “That judgement remains the law, as no appeal was filed against it,” says Minallah speaking to Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 米纳拉对半岛电视台表示：“该判决仍然是法律，因为没有人对此提出上诉。”

paras.en: “Under this jurisprudence, Madhubala has the right to live in an environment where her social, behavioural, and psychological needs can be met,” he says.
paras.zh: “根据这一判例，马杜巴拉有权生活在她的社会、行为和心理需求能够得到满足的环境中，”他说。

paras.en: To be sure, the challenges that officials like those at KMC and elsewhere face are also real.
paras.zh: 平心而论，KMC 和其他地方的官员所面临的挑战也是真实存在的。

paras.en: Pakistan already faces profound human hardship. A United Nations account published in March says more than 60 percent of people in the country cannot afford a healthy diet.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦已经面临着深刻的人类苦难。联合国 3 月份发布的一份报告称，该国 60% 以上的人无法负担健康饮食。

paras.en: Acquiring animals that require specialist care creates obligations lasting decades. Once confined, they depend on people for every meal, for movement, companionship and treatment.
paras.zh: 获得需要专门护理的动物会产生持续数十年的义务。一旦被限制，他们的每顿饭、活动、陪伴和治疗都依赖于人们。

paras.en: But that, say analysts, is even more reason to “stop keeping them in our custody”, says Allen.
paras.zh: 但艾伦表示，分析人士表示，这更成为我们“停止监管它们”的理由。

paras.en: He last saw Madhubala on October 8, when he was assisting the Four Paws team. When there are lots of people, he says, she gets distracted easily.
paras.zh: 他最后一次见到 Madhubala 是在 10 月 8 日，当时他正在协助“四爪”团队。他说，当人很多时，她很容易分心。

paras.en: But she can also get jealous for Allen’s attention. “She will literally throw rocks if she can at anyone talking to me,” he smiled.
paras.zh: 但她也会嫉妒艾伦的关注。 “如果她能向任何跟我说话的人扔石头，她真的会扔石头，”他微笑着说。

articles.title: Grenade exercise sparked deadly fire at Canada military base, army says

paras.en: A fire that killed four soldiers at a western Canadian military base was sparked by an exercise using live grenades, a military official said.
paras.zh: 一名军方官员称，加拿大西部军事基地因使用实弹进行演习而引发火灾，造成四名士兵死亡。

paras.en: The deadly fire broke out on a grenade launcher range during military exercises on Saturday, with high winds propelling it across the base, Brigadier-General Vanessa Hanrahan, commander of the Canadian Forces Military Police Group, told reporters on Thursday.
paras.zh: 加拿大军队宪兵大队指挥官瓦妮莎·汉拉汉准将周四告诉记者，周六军事演习期间，榴弹发射器靶场发生致命火灾，强风将其吹过基地。

paras.en: “A subsequent change in wind direction and velocity significantly increased the fire’s intensity,” she added, with the flames spreading to a training area at the Wainwright military base in Alberta.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“随后风向和风速的变化显着增加了火势，”火势蔓延到阿尔伯塔省温赖特军事基地的训练区。

paras.en: Due to the blaze being in the “permanent danger area” of the range, firefighters were unable to directly combat it, Hanrahan added.
paras.zh: 汉拉汉补充说，由于大火位于靶场的“永久危险区域”，消防队员无法直接扑灭大火。

paras.en: The fire spread on Saturday afternoon during high-intensity combat training involving Charlie Company of the 3rd Battalion, Princess Patricia’s Canadian Light Infantry.
paras.zh: 周六下午，帕特里夏公主的加拿大轻步兵团第三营查理连进行高强度战斗训练时，火势蔓延。

paras.en: The military base lies in the prairies, a landscape of wide, open grasslands, rolling plains and scattered groves of trees.
paras.zh: 军事基地地处大草原，草原辽阔开阔，平原连绵起伏，树林星罗棋布。

paras.en: About 84 soldiers were split between a grenade range and an area where they practised attacks on simulated enemy positions. The fire swept into the second training area.
paras.zh: 大约 84 名士兵被分散在一个手榴弹靶场和一个练习攻击模拟敌方阵地的区域。大火蔓延至第二训练区。

paras.en: Four soldiers died and 39 were injured, with 27 requiring hospitalisation. The incident was one of the worst peacetime tragedies for Canada’s military.
paras.zh: 4 名士兵死亡，39 人受伤，其中 27 人需要住院治疗。该事件是加拿大军队和平时期最严重的悲剧之一。

paras.en: The soldiers and reserve members were participating in exercises ahead of a planned deployment to Latvia, where Canadian forces have their largest international military operation.
paras.zh: 这些士兵和预备役成员正在计划部署到拉脱维亚之前参加演习，加拿大军队在那里开展最大规模的国际军事行动。

paras.en: The Wainwright base is one of the largest bases operated by the Canadian Armed Forces. It regularly hosts training exercises involving military personnel from NATO countries.
paras.zh: 温赖特基地是加拿大武装部队运营的最大基地之一。它定期举办由北约国家军事人员参加的训练演习。

paras.en: During the final months of World War II and for several months in 1946, the base was used as an internment centre for German prisoners of war.
paras.zh: 在第二次世界大战的最后几个月和 1946 年的几个月里，该基地被用作德国战俘的拘留中心。

articles.title: U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible attack on Iran, source tells NPR
articles.author: Daniel Estrin

paras.en: U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible attack on Iran, source tells NPR
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉美国国家公共广播电台，美国和以色列正在计划对伊朗发动可能的袭击

paras.en: TEL AVIV, Israel and ISTANBUL — The U.S. and Israel are preparing plans for a possible attack on Iran in early November, after the U.S. midterm elections, a person briefed on the U.S. and Israel's war planning told NPR on Thursday. Iran said it is prepared.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫、以色列和伊斯坦布尔——周四，一位了解美国和以色列战争计划的人士告诉 NPR，美国和以色列正在制定计划，在美国中期选举之后，可能在 11 月初对伊朗发动袭击。伊朗表示已做好准备。

paras.en: The person, who spoke to NPR on condition of anonymity to discuss the preparations, said Israel had initially planned to strike Iran in mid-October, about two weeks before Israeli elections on Oct. 27, but President Trump objected.
paras.zh: 这位不愿透露姓名的人士在接受 NPR 采访时讨论了准备工作，他表示，以色列最初计划在 10 月中旬袭击伊朗，距离 10 月 27 日以色列大选大约两周，但特朗普总统表示反对。

paras.en: According to the person briefed, the U.S. is now amassing forces in the region to be ready to attack by early November, after the U.S. midterm elections, but that these preparations could also be part of a campaign to pressure Iran to reach a diplomatic deal.
paras.zh: 据知情人士透露，美国目前正在该地区集结部队，准备在美国中期选举之后的 11 月初发动攻击，但这些准备工作也可能是向伊朗施压以达成外交协议的行动的一部分。

paras.en: U.S. midterm elections take place on Nov. 3.
paras.zh: 美国中期选举将于 11 月 3 日举行。

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who is seeking reelection, is campaigning on a threat to topple Iran's regime.
paras.zh: 寻求连任的以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在竞选活动中威胁要推翻伊朗政权。

paras.en: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi told Iranian state media on Thursday, "We are just as prepared for diplomacy as we are for war."
paras.zh: 伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇周四对伊朗官方媒体表示，“我们为外交做好了准备，就像我们为战争做好了准备一样。”

paras.en: "Any scenario is conceivable, including the possibility of an attack by the U.S. and Israel," Araghchi said.
paras.zh: 阿拉格奇说：“任何情况都是可以想象的，包括美国和以色列发动袭击的可能性。”

paras.en: Iranian state media also quoted a security source saying that if Iranian officials or civilian infrastructure were attacked, Iran would retaliate by targeting U.S. interests in the region, as well as the infrastructure and assets of countries participating in the war.
paras.zh: 伊朗官方媒体还援引安全消息人士的话称，如果伊朗官员或民用基础设施遭到袭击，伊朗将通过针对美国在该地区的利益以及参战国家的基础设施和资产进行报复。

paras.en: The U.S. and Israel launched a war on Iran on Feb. 28, killing its supreme leader and a number of senior Iranian officials. Since then, the two sides have failed to uphold a ceasefire agreement and have traded strikes over the control of the Strait of Hormuz. Iran has blocked the key global waterway since the start of the war, targeting commercial vessels, and the U.S. responded by imposing a blockade on Iranian ports and its oil shipments.
paras.zh: 2月28日，美国和以色列对伊朗发动战争，杀死了伊朗最高领导人和多名伊朗高级官员。此后，双方未能遵守停火协议，并为争夺霍尔木兹海峡的控制权而互相攻击。自战争开始以来，伊朗封锁了全球主要航道，以商船为目标，美国则对伊朗港口及其石油运输实施封锁作为回应。

paras.en: The U.S. strikes have reduced Iran's military capabilities, including its air force, air defenses and its navy. But despite the inflicted damage, Iran remains a threat to the Arab countries in the Gulf, as well as Middle Eastern states farther away, including Israel. It has targeted U.S. military bases in the Gulf and Jordan.
paras.zh: 美国的打击削弱了伊朗的军事能力，包括空军、防空和海军。但尽管造成了损害，伊朗仍然对海湾阿拉伯国家以及更远的中东国家（包括以色列）构成威胁。它的目标是美国在海湾和约旦的军事基地。

paras.en: Iran's Revolutionary Guard has threatened that if the U.S. and Israel resume attacks, data centers and underwater internet cables in the Gulf could be targeted.
paras.zh: 伊朗革命卫队威胁称，如果美国和以色列恢复袭击，海湾地区的数据中心和水下互联网电缆可能成为攻击目标。

paras.en: Deputy for Political Affairs of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Yadollah Javani said that Iran was prepared to destroy internet cables running under the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 伊斯兰革命卫队政治事务副官亚多拉·贾瓦尼表示，伊朗准备摧毁霍尔木兹海峡下的互联网电缆。

paras.en: "The Americans must leave the region — they no longer have a place here — and they can never restore the situation to what it was before the war," he said.
paras.zh: “美国人必须离开该地区——他们在这里不再有立足之地——而且他们永远无法将局势恢复到战前的状态，”他说。

paras.en: Iranian state media also said that seven oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz were targeted by the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps on Thursday. Four tankers caught fire and three others hit naval mines.
paras.zh: 伊朗官方媒体还称，霍尔木兹海峡的七艘油轮周四成为伊朗革命卫队的袭击目标。四艘油轮起火，另外三艘油轮触雷。

paras.en: A new report by the International Monetary Fund says disruptions to energy production, shipping, tourism and trade this year have delivered substantial shocks to countries in the Gulf, even as higher oil prices offset some of these losses for energy exporters.
paras.zh: 国际货币基金组织的一份新报告称，今年能源生产、航运、旅游业和贸易的中断给海湾国家带来了巨大冲击，尽管油价上涨抵消了能源出口国的部分损失。

paras.en: The international lender says Iraq, Kuwait and Qatar are all expected to experience contractions of around 16% to their economies this year.
paras.zh: 这家国际贷款机构表示，伊拉克、科威特和卡塔尔今年的经济预计将萎缩 16% 左右。

paras.en: The economies of Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates are also in recession this year.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯和阿联酋的经济今年也陷入衰退。

paras.en: The IMF says if the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran continues and energy supply disruptions persist, the price of oil will average $130 a barrel in 2027.
paras.zh: 国际货币基金组织表示，如果美以与伊朗的战争继续下去并且能源供应中断持续存在，到2027年石油价格将平均达到每桶130美元。

paras.en: Daniel Estrin reported from Tel Aviv, Israel, Ruth Sherlock from Jerusalem and Hadeel Al-Shalchi from Istanbul, Turkey. Aya Batrawy contributed to this story from Dubai, UAE.
paras.zh: Daniel Estrin 从以色列特拉维夫报道，Ruth Sherlock 从耶路撒冷报道，Hadeel Al-Shalchi 从土耳其伊斯坦布尔报道。 Aya Batrawy 在阿联酋迪拜为这篇报道做出了贡献。

articles.title: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
articles.author: Ruth Sherlock

paras.en: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
paras.zh: 了解大型科技如何改变西班牙的面貌

paras.en: ZARAGOZA, Spain — Aragon's rugged plains stretch out under a clear blue sky, the buildings visible as "a few tiny cubes sprawled like a throw of dice" across the terrain — as George Orwell wrote in Homage to Catalonia, of his time here during the Spanish Civil War in the 1930s. Today, excavators eat the earth, carving huge chunks of the landscape in the race to build the behemoths of the AI boom.
paras.zh: 西班牙萨拉戈萨——阿拉贡崎岖的平原在晴朗的蓝天下伸展开来，建筑物就像“几个小立方体，像骰子一样散布在整个地形上”——正如乔治·奥威尔在《向加泰罗尼亚致敬》中所写的，他在 1930 年代西班牙内战期间曾在这里度过了一段时光。如今，挖掘机正在吞噬地球，在竞相建造人工智能热潮中的庞然大物的过程中挖掘出大片土地。

paras.en: This drought-stricken region of northeast Spain has become the focus of American companies searching for locations to place their energy- and water-intensive data centers. In Aragon, Amazon Web Services promises to spend almost $40 billion to build multiple vast complexes — one alone as large as 600 American football fields. Microsoft and the asset management firm Blackstone are among those following suit, signing agreements to build data centers that will transform this region and the livelihoods of its inhabitants.
paras.zh: 西班牙东北部这个遭受干旱的地区已成为美国公司寻找地点来放置能源和水密集型数据中心的焦点。在阿拉贡，Amazon Web Services 承诺斥资近 400 亿美元建造多个大型综合体，其中一个综合体就有 600 个美式足球场那么大。微软和资产管理公司 Blackstone 也纷纷效仿，签署了建设数据中心的协议，这将改变该地区及其居民的生计。

paras.en: Even as other countries enact regulations to curb the expansion of data centers (and Spain's national government weighs new restrictions), Aragon's regional government is welcoming the companies with open arms. Touting themselves as the "Virginia of southern Europe" after the U.S. state with the largest concentration of data centers, they are taking the bet that hosting data centers will bring jobs and prepare the region for the economic shifts they believe AI will bring.
paras.zh: 尽管其他国家颁布了限制数据中心扩张的法规（西班牙国家政府也在考虑新的限制），阿拉贡地方政府却张开双臂欢迎这些公司。他们自称为“南欧的弗吉尼亚州”，仅次于美国数据中心最集中的州，他们押注托管数据中心将带来就业机会，并为他们认为人工智能将带来的经济转变做好准备。

paras.en: "This is a new economy that is evolving, and it's very difficult to foresee how many activities are going to be coming around it," said Eva Valle, the economic counsellor for the regional government. "But they are coming."
paras.zh: “这是一个正在发展的新经济，很难预见会有多少活动围绕它展开，”地方政府经济顾问伊娃·瓦莱(Eva Valle)说。 “但他们来了。”

paras.en: The companies were drawn to the region with promises of large tax breaks and fast-tracked planning permissions that give these data centers a special status usually reserved for the general interest of the local population. This order gives them the power to expropriate land, strips local mayors of veto powers, and restricts the time the public has to object to 23 working days. (For the recent Amazon Web Services development, the regional government opened the window to oppose the project over the Christmas period. Opponents of the project believe they did this to try to push it through at a time when people would be paying less attention, though the government denies this.)
paras.zh: 这些公司被吸引到该地区的原因是大量税收减免和快速规划许可的承诺，这些承诺赋予这些数据中心通常为当地居民的普遍利益保留的特殊地位。该命令赋予他们征用土地的权力，剥夺当地市长的否决权，并将公众反对的时间限制为 23 个工作日。 （对于最近的亚马逊网络服务开发，地方政府在圣诞节期间打开了反对该项目的窗口。该项目的反对者认为，他们这样做是为了试图在人们不太关注的时候推动该项目，尽管政府否认了这一点。）

paras.en: The rapid approval process for these large and hyperscale facilities has left many in Aragon feeling excluded from decisions that will profoundly impact their region and lives.
paras.zh: 这些大型和超大规模设施的快速审批流程让阿拉贡的许多人感到被排除在将深刻影响他们的地区和生活的决策之外。

paras.en: "It's going to be like living beside a prison"
paras.zh: “这就像住在监狱旁边”

paras.en: The first time Silvia Baselga and her family learned of the data center soon to tower over their home was when they noticed the survey markers poking out of the ground on the other side of their garden wall. "When we saw this, we went to the city hall and said, 'OK, we want information. This is really close to our house.'" But the local council told them they had no information. Only when the planning documents were later made public did they learn that the outer perimeter of the data center is to be built within 300 feet of their home in the hilltop village of Botorrita. The plans showed that the complex will be larger than the village itself.
paras.zh: 西尔维娅·巴塞尔加 (Silvia Baselga) 和她的家人第一次得知数据中心即将高耸于他们的家时，是在他们注意到花园墙另一侧的地面上伸出的测量标记时。 “当我们看到这个时，我们去了市政厅并说，‘好吧，我们想要信息。这离我们家很近。’”但当地议会告诉他们他们没有任何信息。直到后来规划文件公开后，他们才得知数据中心的外围将建在距离他们位于波托里塔山顶村庄的家 300 英尺以内的地方。规划显示，该综合体将比村庄本身还要大。

paras.en: Baselga's parents retired here for the tranquility of a life spent in a tight-knit village community. Their home looks out over fields and gently rolling hills. To try to block the noise the data center will emit, Baselga believes the company will build a 20-foot-high wall, as happened in a nearby village. "We're going to open the window and see nothing," she said. Friends regularly visit at night to gaze at the stars in this rural setting. Baselga said the center's 24-hour security lights will block out the night sky. "It's going to be like living beside a prison."
paras.zh: 巴塞尔加的父母在这里退休，在一个紧密团结的乡村社区过着平静的生活。他们的家俯瞰着田野和连绵起伏的山丘。为了阻止数据中心发出的噪音，Baselga 相信该公司将建造一堵 20 英尺高的墙，就像附近村庄的情况一样。 “我们打开窗户就什么也看不见了，”她说。朋友们经常在晚上来到这个乡村环境中观赏星星。巴塞尔加表示，该中心的 24 小时安全灯将遮挡夜空。 “这就像住在监狱旁边一样。”

paras.en: Centers like these are set to be built across Aragon — 27 in total, according to official documents — some by Spanish and other firms, but most by American companies, taking up about 7 square miles of land. At least one is built partly on ground originally classified as protected for natural ecosystems. The companies promise employment. Amazon Web Services told NPR it will create 6,200 permanent jobs once these centers are built. But many residents fear they will also deliver an environmental crisis.
paras.zh: 类似的中心将在阿拉贡各地建设——根据官方文件，总共有 27 个——其中一些是由西班牙和其他公司建造的，但大多数是由美国公司建造的，占地约 7 平方英里的土地。至少其中一部分是建在最初被列为自然生态系统保护地的土地上的。公司承诺就业。亚马逊网络服务公司告诉 NPR，一旦这些中心建成，它将创造 6,200 个永久性就业岗位。但许多居民担心这也会引发环境危机。

paras.en: Economic development "at the cost of the environment"
paras.zh: 经济发展“以牺牲环境为代价”

paras.en: The data centers will consume many times the current electricity needs of the region and require large amounts of water to cool their servers in one of Spain's driest regions, one that's been repeatedly blighted by drought.
paras.zh: 这些数据中心的消耗量将是该地区当前电力需求的许多倍，并且需要大量的水来冷却位于西班牙最干旱地区之一的服务器，该地区多次遭受干旱。

paras.en: Julio Enfedaque drives across the parched land his family has farmed for generations. This year it barely rained for four months, and the government cut the amount of water available for irrigation by two-thirds. "Even if they say the data centers won't take the water that we need for agriculture, I am sure it's going to become very complicated to farm like my ancestors used to." Enfedaque has advised his nephews to find different careers and leave the land.
paras.zh: 胡里奥·恩菲达克 (Julio Enfedaque) 开车穿过他家族世代耕种的干旱土地。今年四个月几乎没有下雨，政府将可用于灌溉的水量减少了三分之二。 “即使他们说数据中心不会获取我们农业所需的水，我相信农业将会变得非常复杂，就像我的祖先过去那样。”恩菲达克建议他的侄子们寻找不同的职业并离开这片土地。

paras.en: Amazon Web Services says its data centers will draw water only after temperatures hit 86 degrees Fahrenheit and that they are investing millions of dollars to help fix leaking water pipes and working with farmers to use AI technology to make their water use more efficient. "We're trying to not only use as less [sic] water as possible, but also to help those communities where we operate have the best infrastructure," David Blázquez, Amazon's head of public policy for Spain and Portugal, told NPR.
paras.zh: 亚马逊网络服务表示，其数据中心只有在气温达到 86 华氏度后才会取水，并且他们正在投资数百万美元来帮助修复泄漏的水管，并与农民合作使用人工智能技术来提高用水效率。亚马逊西班牙和葡萄牙公共政策主管戴维·布拉兹克斯 (David Blázquez) 告诉 NPR，“我们不仅努力尽可能减少用水，而且还帮助我们运营的社区拥有最好的基础设施。”

paras.en: But the company remains opaque about how much water each center will use. Blázquez said it's "a company policy not to publish water usage per site." Regional figures show Amazon's three existing data centers, which are much smaller than what is planned, used 68 million liters — 48% more than the company had originally told regional officials they would need.
paras.zh: 但该公司对于每个中心将使用多少水仍然不透明。布拉兹克斯表示，“公司政策规定不公布每个地点的用水量”。区域数据显示，亚马逊现有的三个数据中心比计划小得多，但使用了 6800 万升——比该公司最初告诉区域官员所需的水量多了 48%。

paras.en: Endangering valuable habitat for rare and migratory birds
paras.zh: 危及珍稀鸟类和候鸟的宝贵栖息地

paras.en: Perhaps an even bigger problem is the energy these centers need to run. Unlike many data centers in the U.S., which are powered by natural gas, companies in Aragon say they will rely mainly on renewable sources (though they also have diesel generators on site). Blázquez says Amazon Web Services has secured "a hundred renewable projects in Spain," including 17 in Aragon.
paras.zh: 也许更大的问题是这些中心运行所需的能源。与美国许多由天然气供电的数据中心不同，阿拉贡的公司表示，他们将主要依赖可再生能源（尽管他们现场也有柴油发电机）。 Blázquez 表示，Amazon Web Services 已获得“西班牙 100 个可再生能源项目”，其中 17 个位于阿拉贡。

paras.en: While that energy is carbon-free, ecologists and biologists warn that additional wind projects could have their own devastating consequences for the environment.
paras.zh: 虽然这种能源是无碳的，但生态学家和生物学家警告说，额外的风能项目可能会对环境造成毁灭性后果。

paras.en: The region is full of hunting grounds for vultures and other birds of prey and an important stop for migrating birds.
paras.zh: 该地区遍布秃鹰和其他猛禽的狩猎场，也是候鸟的重要停留地。

paras.en: "The vultures look for the thermal air currents to lift them. But they run straight into the windmills — for them it's like flying through knives," explained José Antonio Pinzolas, an ornithologist.
paras.zh: 鸟类学家何塞·安东尼奥·平佐拉斯（José Antonio Pinzolas）解释说：“秃鹰寻找热气流来提升它们。但它们直接冲向风车——对它们来说，这就像飞过刀子一样。”

paras.en: Aragon's own environmental agency has warned that wind farms in this area pose a high risk of collision to the endangered red kite and other protected raptors, and has documented an increase in bird and bat deaths in recent years as the renewable sector expands.
paras.zh: 阿拉贡自己的环境机构警告说，该地区的风电场对濒临灭绝的红鸢和其他受保护的猛禽构成了很高的碰撞风险，并记录了近年来随着可再生能源部门的扩张，鸟类和蝙蝠死亡人数有所增加。

paras.en: "I've collected ospreys, golden eagles, kestrels by the dozen, black vultures," said Juan Ballesteros, a nature protection officer for the local government.
paras.zh: “我收集了鱼鹰、金雕、红隼、黑秃鹫，”当地政府自然保护官员胡安·巴列斯特罗斯 (Juan Ballesteros) 说。

paras.en: Ballesteros used to love his job for its access to wildlife. Now, he said, he spends his days placing the corpses of birds killed by turbine blades into body bags. Ballesteros met NPR as he arrived to collect the body of a young Eurasian black vulture that lay dead on the ground, its wings splayed in the dirt at the foot of a wind turbine.
paras.zh: 巴列斯特罗斯曾经很喜欢他的工作，因为可以接触野生动物。他说，现在他每天都把被涡轮叶片杀死的鸟类尸体放入尸袋中。巴列斯特罗斯在前来收集一只年轻欧亚黑秃鹫的尸体时遇到了美国公共广播电台，这只秃鹫死在地上，翅膀张开在风力涡轮机脚下的泥土中。

paras.en: Blázquez told NPR, of the damage to this important habitat that the expansion of wind and solar farms causes, that Amazon Web Services "definitely shares those concerns." He said they work with renewable energy companies that comply with environmental legislation. But Pinzolas said the growing number of bird deaths shows the current protections in place are not working.
paras.zh: Blázquez 告诉 NPR，关于风能和太阳能发电厂的扩张对这一重要栖息地造成的破坏，亚马逊网络服务“肯定也有同样的担忧”。他说，他们与遵守环境立法的可再生能源公司合作。但平佐拉斯表示，鸟类死亡数量不断增加表明目前的保护措施并未发挥作用。

paras.en: Environmental groups say the overall impact of wind turbines on birds isn't being properly assessed.
paras.zh: 环保组织表示，风力涡轮机对鸟类的总体影响尚未得到适当评估。

paras.en: Several groups have crowdfunded together to mount a legal action to try to stop Amazon Web Services' expansion in Aragon. The court case challenges the Aragon government's fast-tracked approvals of the plans. "We have concerns about water consumption, about energy consumption, the impact on some other industries and on the environment," said Luis García,, an activist with Ecologistas En Accion, one of the organizations involved in the case. He said the economic benefits of data centers are not great enough to justify the "huge damage they do to the environment."
paras.zh: 多个团体联合起来发起法律诉讼，试图阻止亚马逊网络服务在阿拉贡的扩张。该法庭案件对阿拉贡政府对该计划的快速批准提出了挑战。 “我们担心水消耗、能源消耗以及对其他一些行业和环境的影响，”参与此案的组织之一生态学家行动组织的活动人士路易斯·加西亚 (Luis García) 说。他表示，数据中心的经济效益还不足以证明“它们对环境造成的巨大破坏”是合理的。

paras.en: Locals fight to preserve nature for future generations
paras.zh: 当地人为子孙后代保护自然而奋斗

paras.en: One recent weekend in the region's capital, Zaragoza, an avenue filled with demonstrators protesting against a new data center to be built at the edge of a forest by the city. Residents fear the heat and noise of the complex will destroy a tranquil space that is a haven during the hot summer months.
paras.zh: 最近的一个周末，该地区首府萨拉戈萨的大街上挤满了示威者，抗议在该市森林边缘修建一座新数据中心。居民担心该建筑群的高温和噪音会破坏炎热夏季避风港般的宁静空间。

paras.en: "This is a worthy fight as all the worlds invades us, to save this pine forests, to save the environment, against this voracious capitalism that thinks only of economic interests and not of people," said Marian Rams, a local resident with white hair dyed in hues of pink, green and blue. "They want to swap nature for data centers."
paras.zh: “这是一场值得的战斗，因为全世界都在入侵我们，为了拯救这片松林，为了拯救环境，反对这种只考虑经济利益而不考虑人民的贪婪资本主义，”当地居民玛丽安·拉姆斯(Marian Rams)说，她的白发染成了粉色、绿色和蓝色。 “他们想用自然来代替数据中心。”

paras.en: Nearby, a little girl no older than 5 chanted along with the demonstrators. Her mother, Ana Domezian, walked alongside her with her second child, a baby, nestled in a carrier against her chest. "If we don't fight now for what we have," she asked, "what are we going to leave to them in the future?"
paras.zh: 附近，一名不到5岁的小女孩与示威者一起高喊口号。她的母亲安娜·多梅齐安 (Ana Domezian) 与她并肩而行，带着她的第二个孩子，一个婴儿，依偎在她胸前的背带里。 “如果我们现在不为我们所拥有的而奋斗，”她问道，“将来我们还能给他们留下什么？”

articles.title: What we know about war plans that Trump and Netanyahu are drawing up
articles.author: Daniel Estrin

paras.en: What we know about war plans that Trump and Netanyahu are drawing up
paras.zh: 我们对特朗普和内塔尼亚胡正在制定的战争计划了解多少

paras.en: Could the U.S. and Israel be on the verge of launching a new attack on Iran? President Trump and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have been suggesting that's on the table.
paras.zh: 美国和以色列可能即将对伊朗发动新的攻击吗？特朗普总统和本杰明·内塔尼亚胡总理一直建议将此事摆在桌面上。

paras.en: Could the U.S. and Israel be on the verge of launching a new attack on Iran? President Trump and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have been suggesting that's on the table. And now, there's new reporting about war plans the two countries are drawing up for early November. NPR's Daniel Estrin is on the line from Tel Aviv. Hey there.
paras.zh: 美国和以色列可能即将对伊朗发动新的攻击吗？特朗普总统和本杰明·内塔尼亚胡总理一直建议将此事摆在桌面上。现在，有关于两国正在制定 11 月初战争计划的新报道。 NPR 的丹尼尔·埃斯特林 (Daniel Estrin) 从特拉维夫接到电话。嘿。

paras.en: SUMMERS: Daniel, what can you tell us about these plans?
paras.zh: 萨默斯：丹尼尔，你能告诉我们关于这些计划的什么信息吗？

paras.en: ESTRIN: I spoke to a person briefed on the matter, who was not authorized to speak publicly, but said the U.S. and Israel are working on plans for a potential strike on Iran as early as early November, after Israeli elections that take place next week and after U.S. midterm elections, which are November 3. The person I spoke to said Israel had initially planned a strike on Iran for mid-October but that the U.S. ruled it out. This information was all first reported by the Financial Times and The New York Times. Netanyahu has denied the reports.
paras.zh: 埃斯特林：我与一位了解此事的人士进行了交谈，他没有被授权公开发言，但他表示，美国和以色列正在制定最早可能在 11 月初对伊朗发动打击的计划，即下周以色列大选之后以及 11 月 3 日美国中期选举之后。与我交谈的人士表示，以色列最初计划在 10 月中旬对伊朗发动打击，但美国排除了这一可能性。该消息均由英国《金融时报》和《纽约时报》率先报道。内塔尼亚胡否认了这些报道。

paras.en: SUMMERS: But Daniel, hasn't Netanyahu openly been threatening an attack?
paras.zh: 萨默斯：但是丹尼尔，内塔尼亚胡不是公开威胁要发动袭击吗？

paras.en: ESTRIN: He has. All of this has been coming out just in the last few days. On Sunday, President Trump endorsed Netanyahu for reelection. Israelis go to the polls this coming Tuesday. And Trump said the reason that he was endorsing him was that he said, we may have to finish the job in Iran and that he would need Netanyahu and Israel's support to do that. And ever since Trump endorsed Netanyahu, Netanyahu has been campaigning for reelection with the promise that he will strike Iran.
paras.zh: 埃斯特林：他有。所有这些都是在最近几天才出现的。周日，特朗普总统支持内塔尼亚胡连任。以色列人将于下周二前往投票站。特朗普表示，他支持他的原因是他说，我们可能必须完成在伊朗的工作，他需要内塔尼亚胡和以色列的支持才能做到这一点。自从特朗普支持内塔尼亚胡以来，内塔尼亚胡一直在竞选连任，并承诺将打击伊朗。

paras.en: Just yesterday, Netanyahu gave a speech and said that the new supreme leader of Iran is attempting to develop what he called the bombs of death, referring to nuclear weapons. And Netanyahu said there's only one way to remove this threat once and for all - overthrow the regime in Iran. He said that is his directive to the Israeli military and to Israeli security and intelligence agencies. He said the supreme leader has not learned his lesson from the previous two rounds of war that Iran has faced from Israel and the U.S.
paras.zh: 就在昨天，内塔尼亚胡发表讲话称，伊朗新任最高领导人正试图研制他所说的“死亡炸弹”，指的是核武器。内塔尼亚胡表示，只有一种方法可以一劳永逸地消除这一威胁——推翻伊朗政权。他说，这是他对以色列军方以及以色列安全和情报机构的指示。他说，最高领袖没有从伊朗与以色列和美国的前两轮战争中吸取教训。

paras.en: SUMMERS: How are people in Israel responding?
paras.zh: 萨默斯：以色列人民有何反应？

paras.en: ESTRIN: Many analysts in Israel are actually criticizing this strategy that Netanyahu is laying out. One Israeli analyst, Danny Citrinowicz, used to head the Iran branch of Israel's military intelligence, and he's arguing that it's actually the U.S. and Israel that have not learned the lessons of the previous wars. He said that more attacks will not convince Iran to give up its nuclear or its ballistic missile ambitions and program. And he said that Iran, this time around, if there is a war, could retaliate with even more severe attacks that could affect global markets. So the question he's posing is, what would another military campaign actually achieve that the last two failed to achieve?
paras.zh: 埃斯特林：以色列的许多分析人士实际上都在批评内塔尼亚胡制定的这一战略。以色列分析人士丹尼·西特里诺维奇(Danny Citrinowicz)曾担任以色列军事情报部门伊朗分部的负责人，他认为实际上是美国和以色列没有吸取之前战争的教训。他表示，更多袭击不会说服伊朗放弃其核或弹道导弹野心和计划。他表示，这一次，如果爆发战争，伊朗可能会发动更严重的袭击进行报复，这可能会影响全球市场。所以他提出的问题是，另一场军事行动实际上会实现前两次行动未能实现的目标吗？

paras.en: SUMMERS: Daniel, what can you tell us about how the U.S. is preparing for war?
paras.zh: 萨默斯：丹尼尔，你能告诉我们美国是如何备战的吗？

paras.en: ESTRIN: My colleague Tom Bowman reports that Pentagon officials have told him that the U.S. is moving a third aircraft carrier, the Theodore Roosevelt, to the region, and that it's expected to arrive in the region later next month. We know that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met with Netanyahu in Israel earlier this week. I should stress, though, Juana, an attack may not occur. This war preparation could be part of a campaign to pressure Iran to reach a diplomatic deal. It's certainly - all this talk - is serving Netanyahu's own reelection campaign. He is trailing in the polls against his main challenger, and so he is very heavily campaigning on this new line of a possible war.
paras.zh: 埃斯特林：我的同事汤姆·鲍曼报告说，五角大楼官员告诉他，美国正在向该地区派遣第三艘航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号，预计将于下个月晚些时候抵达该地区。我们知道，国防部长皮特·赫格斯本周早些时候在以色列会见了内塔尼亚胡。不过，我应该强调，胡安娜，袭击可能不会发生。这次战争准备可能是迫使伊朗达成外交协议的行动的一部分。当然，所有这些言论都是为了内塔尼亚胡自己的连任竞选服务。他在民意调查中落后于他的主要挑战者，因此他正在大力宣传可能爆发战争的新路线。

paras.en: SUMMERS: And last thing, Daniel, before we let you go - what does Iran had to say about all of this?
paras.zh: 萨默斯：最后一件事，丹尼尔，在我们放你走之前——伊朗对这一切有什么要说的？

paras.en: ESTRIN: Iran's foreign minister says that just as Iran is prepared for diplomacy, it's prepared for war. He said any scenario is conceivable, including the possibility of an attack by the U.S. and Israel. Iranian state media is also reporting that Iranian officials are saying that if civilian infrastructure in their country is attacked, that it would retaliate by targeting U.S. interests in the region. Iran is also threatening to target data centers and underwater internet cables in the Gulf. And that is really making Gulf countries very nervous. There's a new report out by the International Monetary Fund that Gulf economies took a very serious hit by the previous rounds of U.S. and Israeli attacks.
paras.zh: 埃斯特林：伊朗外交部长表示，正如伊朗为外交做好准备一样，它也为战争做好了准备。他说任何情况都是可以想象的，包括美国和以色列发动袭击的可能性。伊朗官方媒体还报道称，伊朗官员表示，如果伊朗的民用基础设施受到攻击，伊朗将通过针对美国在该地区的利益进行报复。伊朗还威胁要袭击海湾地区的数据中心和水下互联网电缆。这确实让海湾国家非常紧张。国际货币基金组织发布的一份新报告称，海湾经济体因前几轮美国和以色列的袭击而受到严重打击。

paras.en: SUMMERS: NPR's Daniel Estrin on the line from Tel Aviv. Thanks so much.
paras.zh: 萨默斯：NPR 的丹尼尔·埃斯特林 (Daniel Estrin) 从特拉维夫接到电话。非常感谢。

articles.title: Utah man charged with attempted hate crime after alleged threat to 'blow up' synagogue

paras.en: A Utah man is facing several charges, including attempting to commit a hate crime, after he allegedly threatened to "blow up" a synagogue.
paras.zh: 一名犹他州男子因涉嫌威胁要“炸毁”一座犹太教堂而面临多项指控，包括企图实施仇恨犯罪。

paras.en: Skyler AJ Rose, 22, of Ogden, was indicted by a federal grand jury on Wednesday, on multiple federal charges, including possession of an unregistered destructive device, threatening to kill or injure people and destroy a building with an explosive, and attempting to commit a hate crime, among other offenses, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office for the District of Utah.
paras.zh: 据犹他州地区检察官办公室称，来自奥格登的 22 岁斯凯勒·A·J·罗斯 (Skyler AJ Rose) 周三被联邦大陪审团起诉，罪名包括持有未注册的破坏性装置、威胁用爆炸物杀人或炸伤建筑物、以及企图实施仇恨犯罪等。

paras.en: "There is no place for hate motivated violence—attempts or otherwise—in our communities. A place of worship should be a refuge of safety, not fear," U.S. Attorney Melissa Holyoak for the District of Utah said in a statement. "Thanks to the dedicated work of the FBI and the outstanding efforts of our local police partners, these alleged threats were identified and stopped before anyone was harmed. Let these charges serve as a clear warning: if you attack or attempt to attack a place of worship, you will face the full force of the federal government."
paras.zh: 犹他州地区联邦检察官梅丽莎·霍利奥克 (Melissa Holyoak) 在一份声明中表示：“我们的社区中不允许出现出于仇恨动机的暴力行为，无论是企图还是其他形式。礼拜场所应该是安全的避难所，而不是恐惧的避难所。” “由于联邦调查局的专注工作和我们当地警察合作伙伴的杰出努力，这些所谓的威胁在任何人受到伤害之前得到了识别和制止。让这些指控成为一个明确的警告：如果你攻击或试图攻击礼拜场所，你将面临联邦政府的全力打击。”

paras.en: On Dec. 23, 2025, Rose allegedly made multiple threatening posts on social media, according to court documents.
paras.zh: 根据法庭文件，2025 年 12 月 23 日，罗斯据称在社交媒体上发布了多条威胁帖子。

paras.en: "I wanna blow up a synagogue," one of the posts read, according to prosecutors.
paras.zh: 据检察官称，其中一篇帖子写道：“我想炸毁一座犹太教堂。”

paras.en: An investigation was launched and authorities learned that the posts were made from an IP address tracing back to Rose's home. The FBI then contacted the Ogden City Police Department to assist, with a home visit where authorities said they confirmed the social media handle belonged to Rose.
paras.zh: 当局展开调查后得知，这些帖子是通过可追溯到罗斯家的 IP 地址发布的。联邦调查局随后联系奥格登市警察局提供协助，并进行了家访，当局表示他们确认社交媒体账号属于罗斯。

paras.en: Investigators executed a search warrant and recovered six improvised explosive pipe bombs and one inert device, explosive precursors and components that officials say could be used to construct further improvised explosive pipe bombs, a black Samsung cellphone and two rifles with accompanying magazines and ammunition, prosecutors said.
paras.zh: 检察官称，调查人员执行了搜查令，发现了六枚简易管状爆炸炸弹和一个惰性装置、爆炸物前体和部件，官员称这些爆炸物前体和部件可用于制造更多简易管状爆炸炸弹、一部黑色三星手机和两支步枪以及附带的弹匣和弹药。

paras.en: A subsequent search of Rose’s cellphone revealed that Rose searched online for a synagogue near him in November 2025.
paras.zh: 随后对罗斯手机的搜索显示，罗斯于 2025 年 11 月在网上搜索了他附近的一座犹太教堂。

paras.en: "Today’s indictment stops in its tracks an alleged plan to carry out a violent attack on a synagogue," Assistant Attorney General Harmeet K. Dhillon of the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division said in a statement. "The Department of Justice will take decisive action to protect American worshippers from violent threats, no matter where they occur."
paras.zh: “今天的起诉书停止了一项涉嫌对犹太教堂进行暴力袭击的计划，”司法部民权司助理总检察长哈米特·K·迪隆(Harmeet K. Dhillon)在一份声明中表示。 “司法部将采取果断行动，保护美国信徒免受暴力威胁，无论这些威胁发生在哪里。”

paras.en: Special Agent in Charge Robert Bohls of the Salt Lake City FBI added that "no one should have to fear for their safety because of their faith."
paras.zh: 盐湖城联邦调查局特别负责人罗伯特·博尔斯补充说，“任何人都不应该因为自己的信仰而担心自己的安全。”

paras.en: "Every person deserves to worship freely, without threats, intimidation, or fear," Bohls said. "The FBI takes every threat seriously. Thanks to the swift, seamless collaboration with our law enforcement partners, we were able to address the threat and protect lives from potential physical harm."
paras.zh: 博尔斯说：“每个人都应该自由崇拜，不受威胁、恐吓或恐惧。” “联邦调查局认真对待每一个威胁。由于与执法合作伙伴的迅速、无缝合作，我们能够应对威胁并保护生命免受潜在的人身伤害。”

paras.en: The investigation also allegedly revealed evidence of child sexual abuse material on Rose's cellphone, including hundreds of cached images and screenshots depicting child sexual abuse material, according to prosecutors. Rose was also indicted on charges of receipt and possession of child pornography.
paras.zh: 据检察官称，调查还据称揭露了罗斯手机上存在儿童性虐待材料的证据，其中包括数百张缓存的描绘儿童性虐待材料的图像和屏幕截图。罗斯还被指控接收和持有儿童色情制品。

paras.en: Rose's initial appearance is scheduled for Oct. 23 in federal court in Salt Lake City.
paras.zh: 罗斯定于 10 月 23 日在盐湖城联邦法院首次出庭。

articles.title: Drake Maye's end-zone interception proves costly as Patriots fall 30-24 to Bears in primetime

paras.en: Ben Johnson and Caleb Williams showed NFL fans once again that they're a match made in heaven.
paras.zh: 本·约翰逊 (Ben Johnson) 和卡勒布·威廉姆斯 (Caleb Williams) 再次向 NFL 球迷展示了他们是天作之合。

paras.en: Chicago didn't give the New England Patriots much of a shot in Week 7's Thursday night matchup. The Bears comfortably beat the Pats, 30-24, improving to 5-2.
paras.zh: 在第七周周四晚上的比赛中，芝加哥队并没有给新英格兰爱国者队太多机会。熊队以 30-24 轻松击败爱国者队，战绩提升至 5-2。

paras.en: In a game decided by just six points, Drake Maye leaving guaranteed points on the turf with a killer second-quarter end-zone pick loomed large. It forced New England into chase mode all night. It was Maye's third INT in the end zone this season.
paras.zh: 在一场仅以六分决定胜负的比赛中，德雷克·梅耶在草皮上留下了保证分数，并在第二节的端区选择中表现出色。它迫使新英格兰整夜进入追逐模式。这是梅耶本赛季第三次在达阵区被罚断。

paras.en: New England almost went into the halftime break facing a scary deficit, if not for a 48-yard TD run by Pats RB Rhamondre Stevenson. Chicago's defense fell asleep at the wheel; an effort on D unbecoming of this franchise.
paras.zh: 如果不是帕茨 RB 拉蒙德雷·史蒂文森 (Rhamondre Stevenson) 的 48 码冲球达阵，新英格兰队几乎在半场休息时就面临着可怕的落后。芝加哥的防守在方向盘上睡着了；对 D 的努力与该系列不相称。

paras.en: In his second game back from a hamstring injury, Caleb continued to ride an offensive groove, throwing for 308 yards (22-of-32) and two touchdowns.
paras.zh: 在从腿筋伤势中恢复的第二场比赛中，卡勒布继续保持进攻状态，传球 308 码（32 码中 22 码）并两次达阵。

paras.en: On the Al Michaels front — the play-by-play icon had another sleepy outing, stumbling through a few sequences, including calling a Pats "fumble" that never occurred. The 81-year-old broadcaster also mistook Williams and Maye for QBs from the "class of 2014." They were drafted in 2024.
paras.zh: 在艾尔·迈克尔斯的前线，这位实况转播偶像又陷入了昏昏欲睡的状态，在几个镜头中跌跌撞撞，包括称帕茨为“掉球”，但从未发生过。这位 81 岁的广播员还将威廉姆斯和梅耶误认为是“2014 届”的四分卫。他们于 2024 年被征召入伍。

paras.en: Chicago extinguished New England's last-minute comeback bid courtesy of exceptional clock management by coach Johnson and a nail-in-the-coffin, career-best 58-yard field goal from Cairo Santos. The kick let the former Vrabel disciple stick it to his old boss, leaving the Patriots coach grimacing on the sideline knowing he'd been out-dueled.
paras.zh: 芝加哥队凭借教练约翰逊出色的时间管理和开罗桑托斯的职业生涯最佳 58 码射门，终结了新英格兰队最后时刻的逆转。这一脚让这位前弗拉贝尔弟子将球踢到了他的老老板身上，爱国者队教练在场边做着鬼脸，因为他知道自己已经被击败了。

paras.en: Maye finished with 321 passing yards (24-of-31) with two touchdowns and that costly turnover.
paras.zh: 梅耶最终传球 321 码（31 码中 24 码），并有两次达阵和代价高昂的失误。

paras.en: Courtesy of the NFL scheduling gods, Vrabel and the Patriots have a prime get-right spot against the Dolphins in Week 8 after dropping to 4-3.
paras.zh: 感谢 NFL 调度之神的帮助，弗拉贝尔和爱国者队在第 8 周以 4-3 落后的情况下对阵海豚队，获得了最佳的右路机会。

paras.en: Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela
paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: Blanche won't rule out DOJ blocking election certification in 'doomsday' scenario

paras.en: Attorney General Todd Blanche refused to rule out whether the Department of Justice could seek to intervene in states’ midterm election certification processes, saying there are extreme scenarios that could prompt federal action.
paras.zh: 司法部长托德·布兰奇拒绝排除司法部是否可能寻求干预各州的中期选举认证程序，称存在可能促使联邦采取行动的极端情况。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters in Virginia on Thursday, Blanche said it was not his intention to "improperly interfere with elections," but declined to rule out federal involvement if a "doomsday scenario" were to happen.
paras.zh: 布兰奇周四在弗吉尼亚州接受记者采访时表示，他无意“不当干预选举”，但拒绝排除如果“世界末日场景”发生，联邦政府会介入的可能性。

paras.en: "Of course there’s scenarios that we can all come up with hypothetically, you know, some doomsday scenario, for example, right?" he said. "So, I don’t think it’s proper to make any kind of conclusory statements about what’s going to happen in the future, because I have no idea what’s happening in the future."
paras.zh: “当然，我们都可以假设一些场景，例如，一些世界末日场景，对吗？”他说。 “所以，我认为对未来会发生什么做出任何结论性的陈述是合适的，因为我不知道未来会发生什么。”

paras.en: Blanche said he could not say there were no circumstances under which the DOJ would get involved.
paras.zh: 布兰奇表示，他不能说司法部在任何情况下都会介入。

paras.en: "Of course, I’m not going to say that," he said. "But am I planning my days around the election to be somewhere to not certify? Of course not, no, not at all."
paras.zh: “当然，我不会这么说，”他说。 “但我是否计划在选举前后的日子里不进行认证？当然不是，不，根本不是。”

paras.en: The DOJ's role in elections is limited under the Constitution and federal law, allowing it primarily to safeguard civil rights and prosecute people who violate election law. Federal law does not specifically authorize the department to challenge ballots or delay a state's certification of election results.
paras.zh: 根据宪法和联邦法律，司法部在选举中的作用受到限制，其主要职责是维护公民权利并起诉违反选举法的人。联邦法律没有明确授权该部门质疑选票或延迟州对选举结果的认证。

paras.en: Under the Constitution and federal law, U.S. elections are run by state and local officials rather than the federal government.
paras.zh: 根据宪法和联邦法律，美国选举由州和地方官员而不是联邦政府主持。

paras.en: During a news conference in Norfolk, Blanche was questioned about the DOJ's litigation against states, seeking to force officials to turn over unredacted voter data and halt the counting of ballots cast by thousands of voters the federal government argues are likely noncitizens.
paras.zh: 在诺福克举行的新闻发布会上，布兰奇被问及司法部针对各州的诉讼，该诉讼试图迫使官员交出未经编辑的选民数据，并停止对联邦政府认为可能是非公民的数千名选民进行的计票。

paras.en: Blanche said the DOJ was "not trying to create chaos" but wanted to alert officials to potential problems.
paras.zh: 布兰奇表示，司法部“并不是试图制造混乱”，而是希望提醒官员注意潜在的问题。

paras.en: "I’m not trying to not have an election certified. Of course not," Blanche said. "What we’re trying to do is guarantee to the American people that the only people that are voting are people that are eligible to vote."
paras.zh: “我并不是想不让选举获得认证。当然不是，”布兰奇说。 “我们试图做的是向美国人民保证，唯一投票的人是有资格投票的人。”

paras.en: In response to Blanche's comments, Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y., said Senate Democrats "have been preparing for this for months and will be ready" for whatever administration officials try.
paras.zh: 针对布兰奇的言论，参议院少数党领袖、纽约州民主党人查克·舒默表示，参议院民主党人“已经为此准备了几个月，并将为”政府官员的任何尝试做好准备。

paras.en: "As Trump and his cronies attempt to steal this election, we are fighting them at every turn," Schumer posted on X. "Our elections must always belong to the voters — not Donald Trump."
paras.zh: 舒默在 X 上发帖称：“当特朗普和他的亲信试图窃取这次选举时，我们处处与他们作斗争。我们的选举必须永远属于选民，而不是唐纳德·特朗普。”

paras.en: The administration sued California election officials last week, arguing they failed to act quickly enough to review names the federal government identified as likely noncitizens. The DOJ asked a judge to block the state from counting mail-in ballots from those individuals unless their eligibility could be confirmed.
paras.zh: 政府上周起诉加州选举官员，称他们未能迅速采取行动，审查联邦政府认定为可能非公民的名字。司法部要求法官阻止该州清点这些人邮寄的选票，除非他们的资格得到确认。

paras.en: The California secretary of state's office said it was given only 48 hours to review roughly 20,000 names.
paras.zh: 加州国务卿办公室表示，他们只有 48 小时的时间来审查大约 20,000 个名字。

paras.en: The DOJ was also weighing additional election-related litigation against states, but a federal judge this week temporarily restricted certain election-related field operations and interviews in nine states through Election Day. The judge stayed the order until Friday evening to give the administration an opportunity to appeal.
paras.zh: 美国司法部还在考虑针对各州提起更多与选举相关的诉讼，但一名联邦法官本周在选举日之前暂时限制了九个州的某些与选举相关的现场行动和采访。法官将该命令保留到周五晚上，以便政府有机会上诉。

paras.en: Earlier this week, Democratic leaders and election groups filed a lawsuit against the administration, accusing it of "threats and intimidation" ahead of Election Day.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，民主党领导人和选举团体对政府提起诉讼，指责政府在选举日之前进行“威胁和恐吓”。

paras.en: President Donald Trump has repeatedly said noncitizen voting poses a serious threat to election integrity, although documented instances of noncitizens casting ballots in federal elections have historically been rare.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统多次表示，非公民投票对选举公正性构成严重威胁，尽管历史上记录在案的非公民在联邦选举中投票的例子很少。

articles.title: Heat killed ‘staggering’ 50,000 people in Europe’s cities this summer, scientists warn
articles.author: Ajit Niranjan

paras.en: Heat killed a record 50,000 people in European cities this summer, new research suggests, with scientists blaming climate breakdown for two in every three of the deaths.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明，今年夏天欧洲城市有创纪录的 5 万人因高温而死亡，科学家将三分之二的死亡归咎于气候崩溃。

paras.en: Morgues and funeral homes filled with bodies from June to August as the heat added by planet-baking pollution cut short an extra 32,000 lives in urban areas, the researchers found. Hot days pushed vulnerable bodies into overdrive and warm nights prevented them from recovering.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，从 6 月到 8 月，停尸房和殡仪馆里堆满了尸体，因为行星烘烤污染增加的热量导致城市地区另外 32,000 人丧生。炎热的白天让脆弱的身体过度劳累，而温暖的夜晚则让他们无法恢复。

paras.en: The “staggering” death toll, modelled using historical relationships between heat and health in 854 cities, was the worst on record, the study found. Hot weather marked by relentless heatwaves killed nearly twice as many people as it did in each of the two next most dangerous years.
paras.zh: 研究发现，根据 854 个城市高温与健康之间的历史关系建模，“令人震惊”的死亡人数是有记录以来最严重的。以无情热浪为特征的炎热天气造成的死亡人数几乎是接下来最危险的两年的两倍。

paras.en: “In some sense, the absolute numbers of the heat-related deaths estimated across the 854 urban areas are indeed staggering,” said Malcolm Mistry, a climate and health scientist at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine, who co-authored the study. “But perhaps what is even more alarming is the proportion of these deaths that we attribute to anthropogenic climate change.”
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、伦敦卫生与热带医学院的气候与健康科学家马尔科姆·米斯特里（Malcolm Mistry）表示：“从某种意义上说，854个城市地区估计的与高温相关的死亡绝对人数确实令人震惊。” “但也许更令人担忧的是，我们将这些死亡归因于人为气候变化的比例。”

paras.en: The share of deaths due to climate breakdown has risen from about 40% at the start of the century to 65% this summer, the study found.
paras.zh: 研究发现，因气候崩溃导致的死亡比例已从本世纪初的约 40% 上升到今年夏天的 65%。

paras.en: People succumbed to heat at the highest rates in Malta, Italy and Hungary, while absolute death tolls were greatest in Italy, France, Spain, Germany and the UK. Because death certificates rarely record contributing factors – such as dangerous temperatures that push a stroke victim or lung cancer patient past their limits – families rarely know that heat and human activity hastened their relatives’ death.
paras.zh: 马耳他、意大利和匈牙利的人们死于高温的比率最高，而意大利、法国、西班牙、德国和英国的绝对死亡人数最高。由于死亡证明很少记录促成因素，例如导致中风患者或肺癌患者超出极限的危险温度，家人很少知道高温和人类活动加速了亲人的死亡。

paras.en: “These shocking figures represent thousands of families who have lost a loved one this summer due to the climate crisis,” said Katie White, the climate transition minister for the UK, where scientists estimated 4,354 heat deaths this summer.”
paras.zh: 英国气候转型大臣凯蒂·怀特 (Katie White) 表示：“这些令人震惊的数字表明，今年夏天有数千个家庭因气候危机而失去了亲人。”英国科学家估计，今年夏天有 4,354 人因高温死亡。

paras.en: In Naples, the hardest-hit city on the continent, 815 people per million died from the heat, according to the study’s age-standardised estimates. Mario Guarino, an emergency doctor at Ospedale CTO in the north of the city, said he witnessed a 15% increase in emergency room visits during the hottest weeks.
paras.zh: 根据该研究的年龄标准化估计，在非洲大陆受灾最严重的城市那不勒斯，每百万人中有 815 人死于高温。马里奥·瓜里诺 (Mario Guarino) 是该市北部 Ospedale CTO 的急诊医生，他表示，在最热的几周内，他看到急诊室就诊人数增加了 15%。

paras.en: The “defining characteristic” of the period was the complexity of health problems exacerbated by heat, he added, with loneliness and poverty worsening the situation further.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这一时期的“决定性特征”是炎热加剧了健康问题的复杂性，孤独和贫困使情况进一步恶化。

paras.en: “We took in a terminal cancer patient who lived in a hot attic simply because his family couldn’t find a company to install air conditioning during the summer,” said Guarino. “An elderly man with dementia was abruptly abandoned by his Ukrainian caregiver who returned home to say goodbye to her son, who had been called to war. Emergency services found [the man] lying on the floor one night with a fractured pelvis, desperately trying to call the tenant next door.”
paras.zh: “我们收留了一名癌症晚期患者，他住在炎热的阁楼里，只是因为他的家人找不到一家公司在夏天安装空调，”瓜里诺说。 “一名患有痴呆症的老人突然被乌克兰看护人遗弃，她回家与应征入伍的儿子告别。一天晚上，紧急服务人员发现（这名男子）骨盆骨折躺在地板上，拼命地想给隔壁的房客打电话。”

paras.en: The study found people over the age of 85 made up almost half of the death toll, though younger people were not immune, with 833 people between the age of 20 and 44 also thought to have died due to the heat. The scientists said the death toll from the cities studied, which account for about 40% of the European population, could not be easily extrapolated to estimate the full death toll including those in towns and villages.
paras.zh: 研究发现，85 岁以上的人几乎占死亡人数的一半，但年轻人也未能幸免，其中 833 名 20 岁至 44 岁之间的人也被认为因高温而死亡。科学家们表示，所研究城市的死亡人数约占欧洲人口的 40%，无法轻易推断出包括城镇和村庄在内的全部死亡人数。

paras.en: The scorching heat that persistently baked western Europe this summer was the worst on record, the EU’s climate monitoring service announced this month, with more than half the continent seared by “very strong” heat stress that felt hotter than 38C. Slightly less punishing temperatures in eastern Europe brought the continental average to its third-hottest level on record.
paras.zh: 欧盟气候监测机构本月宣布，今年夏天西欧持续遭受的酷暑是有记录以来最严重的，超过一半的欧洲大陆遭受“非常强烈”的热浪灼烧，感觉温度超过 38 摄氏度。东欧的气温稍微不那么严酷，使大陆平均气温达到有记录以来第三高的水平。

paras.en: Greenhouse gases have warmed Europe about twice as fast as the global average, exposing more people to intolerably hot summers and fewer people to dangerously cold winters. While cold is a bigger killer than heat, scientists expect rising temperatures to claim more lives than they save, as heat deaths are projected to rise faster than cold deaths fall.
paras.zh: 温室气体使欧洲变暖的速度大约是全球平均水平的两倍，使更多的人面临难以忍受的炎热夏季，而更少的人面临危险的寒冷冬季。虽然寒冷是比炎热更大的杀手，但科学家预计，气温上升夺走的生命将多于拯救的生命，因为预计高温死亡人数的上升速度将快于寒冷死亡人数的下降速度。

paras.en: The study combined established relationships between heat and mortality with temperature data for 2026 to rapidly estimate the fallout from this summer’s heat. The death tolls for individual countries differ from what national public health agencies have calculated using their own methods.
paras.zh: 该研究将高温与死亡率之间已建立的关系与 2026 年的温度数据相结合，以快速估计今年夏季高温的影响。各个国家的死亡人数与国家公共卫生机构使用自己的方法计算的死亡人数不同。

paras.en: David García-García, a researcher at the mortality monitoring system at the Carlos III health institute in Madrid, who was not involved in the study, said it was a “valuable contribution” that allowed for comparisons across the continent. “However, it is important to bear in mind that these are estimates based on observed temperatures and epidemiological models, which do not incorporate actual data on deaths occurring in the summer of 2026,” he said.
paras.zh: 马德里卡洛斯三世卫生研究所死亡率监测系统研究员大卫·加西亚-加西亚（David García-García）并未参与这项研究，他表示这是一项“宝贵的贡献”，可以在整个非洲大陆进行比较。 “然而，重要的是要记住，这些是基于观测到的气温和流行病学模型的估计，并未纳入 2026 年夏季发生的死亡人数的实际数据，”他说。

paras.en: Doctors have urged governments to burn fewer fossil fuels – the core driver of rising temperatures – while bolstering health systems, greening cities, rolling out air conditioning and encouraging people to drink water and seek shade. They have also stressed the benefits of people checking in on vulnerable neighbours and family members so they can get help before tragedy strikes.
paras.zh: 医生们敦促各国政府减少燃烧化石燃料（这是气温上升的核心驱动因素），同时加强卫生系统、绿化城市、推广空调并鼓励人们喝水和寻求阴凉。他们还强调了人们检查弱势邻居和家庭成员的好处，以便他们能够在悲剧发生之前获得帮助。

paras.en: “The real epidemic these days is loneliness,” said Guarino. “Many elderly people are left alone during the summer, abandoned by their families, and due to their low income, they can’t afford air conditioning or, if they do have it, avoid turning it on because of the cost of electricity.”
paras.zh: “如今真正的流行病是孤独，”瓜里诺说。 “许多老年人在夏天被独自留下，被家人遗弃，由于收入低，他们买不起空调，或者即使有空调，也因为电费而避免打开。”

articles.title: Magnitude-7 earthquake hits China’s Tibet, killing at least 16 and destroying hundreds of homes
articles.author: Associated Press

paras.en: A magnitude-7 earthquake has hit China’s Tibet region, killing at least 16 people, injuring 54 and collapsing hundreds of homes in the northern regional city of Nagqu, official media said.
paras.zh: 据官方媒体报道，中国西藏地区发生7级地震，造成至少16人死亡、54人受伤，北部地区城市那曲地区数百间房屋倒塌。

paras.en: Search and rescue efforts continued after the collapse of at least 339 homes and 20 livestock sheds, the Nagqu media office said, citing city government officials.
paras.zh: 那曲媒体办公室援引市政府官员的话说，至少 339 所房屋和 20 个牲畜棚倒塌后，搜救工作仍在继续。

paras.en: More than 1,600 people from the local county were deployed for rescue efforts. Supplies including 1,000 prefabricated housing units and about 3,000 tents and folding beds as well as torches and winter clothing arrived in the region.
paras.zh: 当地县调集1600余人参与救援。包括 1,000 套预制房屋、约 3,000 个帐篷和折叠床以及火把和冬衣在内的物资抵达该地区。

paras.en: The US Geological Survey said the quake occurred at 10.33pm local time on Thursday, with its epicentre 191km (119 miles) east-northeast of Nagqu, in a sparsely populated, high-altitude area of northern Tibet. It put the earthquake’s depth at 18km.
paras.zh: 美国地质调查局表示，地震发生在当地时间周四晚上 10 点 33 分，震中位于那曲地区东北偏东 191 公里（119 英里）处，位于西藏北部人口稀少的高海拔地区。地震深度为18公里。

paras.en: The US agency recorded at least seven aftershocks with magnitude between 4.3 and 5.2, all of them with a depth of 10km, according to its website.
paras.zh: 据美国机构网站称，该机构记录了至少七次余震，震级在4.3级至5.2级之间，所有震源深度均为10公里。

paras.en: Videos posted by China’s national broadcaster CCTV said showed workers running out of restaurants and objects falling off shelves at supermarkets when the quake struck.
paras.zh: 中国中央电视台发布的视频显示，地震发生时，餐厅里的工作人员纷纷逃走，超市货架上的物品纷纷掉落。

paras.en: China’s official Xinhua news agency said on Friday that communication in some areas hit by the quake was down. Local railway authorities had taken emergency actions to halt trains passing through the region.
paras.zh: 中国官方新华社周五表示，部分受地震影响地区的通讯中断。当地铁路部​​门已采取紧急行动，停止列车通过该地区。

paras.en: More than 300 police officers had been dispatched for relief work while the regional fire and rescue corps has mobilised almost 350 personnel to the affected areas, Xinhua reported.
paras.zh: 据新华社报道，已派出300多名警察参与救援工作，地区消防救援总队已调集近350名人员前往受灾地区。

paras.en: Rescue workers clambered through damaged buildings, some with collapsed roofs, footage on CCTV showed.
paras.zh: 闭路电视画面显示，救援人员爬过受损的建筑物，其中一些建筑物的屋顶已经倒塌。

paras.en: The earthquake also caused rockfalls that had forced local authorities to close a section of national highway 317, allowing only emergency, rescue and official support vehicles through as crews worked to clear debris, according to Xinhua.
paras.zh: 据新华社报道，地震还造成落石，迫使地方当局关闭了 317 号国道的一段路段，只允许应急、救援和官方支援车辆通过，工作人员正在清理废墟。

paras.en: Intermittent snows were expected in the quake region over the next three days, Xinhua said. It was the biggest quake in the region in the past five years, CCTV said.
paras.zh: 新华社称，预计未来三天震区将出现间歇性降雪。据央视报道，这是该地区近五年来最严重的地震。

paras.en: China’s leader, Xi Jinping, called for all-out efforts in rescue operations and medical relief work.
paras.zh: 中国领导人习近平要求全力以赴做好救援和医疗救援工作。

paras.en: Nagqu is more than 300km north of Tibet’s capital, Lhasa.
paras.zh: 那曲位于西藏首府拉萨以北300多公里处。

paras.en: Earthquakes are relatively common in China. In January 2025, at least 126 people were killed in one in Tibet’s rural Tingri county.
paras.zh: 地震在中国比较常见。 2025 年 1 月，西藏定日县发生一起火灾，造成至少 126 人死亡。

paras.en: In December 2023, a quake in remote Gansu province in north-west China killed at least 134 people, state media said. That quake was China’s deadliest since 2014, when more than 600 people died in the south-western province of Yunnan.
paras.zh: 官方媒体称，2023 年 12 月，中国西北部偏远的甘肃省发生地震，造成至少 134 人死亡。那次地震是中国自 2014 年以来最严重的一次地震，当时西南部的云南省有 600 多人死亡。

paras.en: A huge tremor in Sichuan province in 2008 left approximately 90,000 people dead or missing, including about 5,000 schoolchildren.
paras.zh: 2008年四川省发生大地震，造成约9万人死亡或失踪，其中包括约5000名学童。

articles.title: Jim Chalmers faces a world of hard choices where the solution to one problem makes the other worse
articles.author: Patrick Commins

paras.en: Jim Chalmers in a speech last week offered the scant encouragement that the economy would be “a bit better” in a year’s time.
paras.zh: 吉姆·查尔默斯(Jim Chalmers)在上周的一次演讲中几乎没有鼓励经济将在一年内“好一点”。

paras.en: Fast forward to Friday morning, and the treasurer revealed that his officials were busy downgrading their forecasts ahead of December’s mid-year budget update to show slower growth and higher unemployment.
paras.zh: 快进到周五上午，财政部长透露，他的官员正忙于在 12 月年中预算更新之前下调预测，以显示经济增长放缓和失业率上升。

paras.en: In other words, things are getting worse, not better.
paras.zh: 换句话说，事情正在变得更糟，而不是更好。

paras.en: Overnight, a broadening Middle East conflict pushed the global benchmark oil price to US$113, and within sight of its April high of nearly US$120.
paras.zh: 一夜之间，不断扩大的中东冲突将全球基准油价推至 113 美元，距离 4 月份高点近 120 美元不远。

paras.en: Motorists are paying 60 cents more for a litre of petrol prices than they were before the US and Israel attacked Iran. That’s an extra $36 to fill up a 60-litre tank. Do that once a week and a family’s monthly fuel bill is $144 higher than in February.
paras.zh: 驾车者每升汽油的价格比美国和以色列袭击伊朗之前高出 60 美分。加满 60 升的油箱需要额外支付 36 美元。每周这样做一次，一个家庭每月的燃油费用会比 2 月份高出 144 美元。

paras.en: The New York Times overnight reported that the US and Israel have drawn up plans to restart attacks on Iran after the upcoming American midterm elections.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》连夜报道称，美国和以色列已制定计划，在美国中期选举即将到来后重启对伊朗的袭击。

paras.en: Westpac analysts have sketched out an “escalation” scenario for the Middle East conflict where oil climbs towards US$150, echoing warnings from the International Monetary Fund earlier this month.
paras.zh: 西太平洋银行分析师描绘了中东冲突“升级”的情景，油价将攀升至 150 美元，这与国际货币基金组织本月早些时候的警告相呼应。

paras.en: That worst-case scenario would have huge implications for inflation and interest rates, even as we brace for a potential fifth interest rate hike on 3 November.
paras.zh: 即使我们准备在 11 月 3 日进行第五次加息，最坏的情况仍将对通胀和利率产生巨大影响。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the one bright spot that has helped paper over many of the cracks in the global economy – the huge spending associated with artificial intelligence – has hit some serious wobbles.
paras.zh: 与此同时，帮助掩盖全球经济许多裂缝的一个亮点——与人工智能相关的巨额支出——却遭遇了一些严重的动摇。

paras.en: Investors are worried about the huge surge in debt among companies racing to build the infrastructure for an AI future – the trigger for another steep sell-off on Wall Street overnight.
paras.zh: 投资者担心竞相为人工智能未来建设基础设施的公司债务大幅飙升，这引发了隔夜华尔街另一场大幅抛售。

paras.en: Community opposition to the massive datacentre build-out could stall the headlong rush towards an AI future. That is likely a good thing in the longer term, but in the short term is another stress to add to the wall of worries. Rising chatter of a new tech stock bubble is naturally accompanied by talk of an imminent bust.
paras.zh: 社区对大规模数据中心建设的反对可能会阻碍人工智能未来的快速发展。从长远来看，这可能是一件好事，但从短期来看，这又是增加担忧的另一个压力。关于新技术股票泡沫的讨论不断增加，自然会伴随着即将破灭的讨论。

paras.en: With all this going on, no wonder that the treasurer can only offer the thinnest of gruel for Australians hungry for any evidence of an end to years of disruption, and of wages that can’t keep up with high and rising prices.
paras.zh: 发生这一切，难怪财政部长只能为澳大利亚人提供最稀薄的粥，他们渴望找到任何证据来证明多年的混乱已经结束，工资也跟不上高涨的物价。

paras.en: High inflation, low growth and rising unemployment is a central banker’s “nightmare”, as the Reserve Bank’s Andrew Hauser has said.
paras.zh: 正如储备银行安德鲁·豪瑟所说，高通胀、低增长和失业率上升是央行行长的“噩梦”。

paras.en: It’s also a nightmare for a federal treasurer who is increasingly unpopular and desperate for a win in the court of public opinion.
paras.zh: 对于一位越来越不受欢迎且迫切希望在公众舆论场上获胜的联邦财政部长来说，这也是一场噩梦。

paras.en: “The pressures on people right now are very substantial and obviously that keeps me awake at night,” Chalmers told Politico.
paras.zh: “人们现在面临的压力非常大，显然这让我彻夜难眠，”查尔默斯告诉《政治》杂志。

paras.en: “And there’s a number of reasons for that, some of them are outside our control, and some of them we have some influence over. You know, providing some cost-of-living help, managing the budget in a responsible way,” he said.
paras.zh: “造成这种情况的原因有很多，有些是我们无法控制的，有些是我们有一定影响力的。你知道，提供一些生活费用帮助，以负责任的方式管理预算，”他说。

paras.en: “Those are the things that we can do, but in lots of ways we’re hostage as well to decisions taken in DC or Tehran or in Eastern Europe about two wars which are pushing up inflation around the world and weighing on growth around the world.”
paras.zh: “这些是我们可以做的事情，但在很多方面，我们也受到华盛顿、德黑兰或东欧就两场战争做出的决定的影响，这两场战争推高了世界各地的通胀，拖累了世界各地的经济增长。”

paras.en: The high level of government spending is not helping the inflation fight, by any means – something the opposition is keen to point out at every opportunity.
paras.zh: 无论如何，高水平的政府支出无助于对抗通货膨胀 — — 反对派热衷于利用一切机会指出这一点。

paras.en: Productivity growth is, if not dead, then resting, and shows no signs of springing back to its perch. That means more inflation at lower rates of growth as the economy hits its speed limits sooner.
paras.zh: 生产率的增长即使没有停滞，也已经处于休息状态，并且没有显示出回升的迹象。这意味着随着经济更快达到速度极限，通货膨胀率会降低。

paras.en: But Chalmers is right when he says there’s a lot that is out of the government’s control.
paras.zh: 但查尔默斯说有很多事情是政府无法控制的，他是对的。

paras.en: His options to alleviate voter discontent are limited, which is why he frequently falls back on platitudes and lines to the effect of “you think we have it bad? You should see other economies.”
paras.zh: 他缓解选民不满的选择有限，这就是为什么他经常诉诸陈词滥调，大意是“你认为我们的情况很糟糕？你应该看看其他经济体。”

paras.en: Sure, the government can lower petrol prices through another temporary cut to the fuel excise. But the billions of dollars that pumps into motorists’ pockets makes it harder for the RBA to bring inflation back under control.
paras.zh: 当然，政府可以通过再次临时削减燃油税来降低汽油价格。但数十亿美元流入驾车者的口袋，让澳大利亚央行更难控制通胀。

paras.en: Labor could go the other way and announce plans for big spending cuts in the December mid-year economic and fiscal outlook.
paras.zh: 工党可能会采取相反的做法，在 12 月中旬的经济和财政展望中宣布大幅削减支出的计划。

paras.en: That would help the central bank’s job, but would drag on an already weak economy and push unemployment higher – would they win any plaudits for that?
paras.zh: 这将有助于央行的工作，但会拖累本已疲软的经济并推高失业率——他们会因此赢得喝彩吗？

paras.en: This is Hauser’s “world of hard choices” – a world where the solution to one problem makes the other worse. A world with which Australians are becoming all too familiar.
paras.zh: 这就是豪瑟所说的“艰难选择的世界”——一个问题的解决方案会让另一个问题变得更糟。这是澳大利亚人变得非常熟悉的世界。

articles.title: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC investigation finds

paras.en: A BBC investigation has found evidence that Sudanese paramilitary fighters systematically destroyed el-Fasher's healthcare system during their long siege and subsequent takeover of the city in Darfur a year ago.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司(BBC)的一项调查发现，有证据表明，苏丹准军事武装分子在一年前长期围困并随后占领达尔富尔市期间，系统性地摧毁了法希尔的医疗系统。

paras.en: UN human rights chief Volker TÃ¼rk called the findings "deeply disturbing", saying multiple attacks by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) on civilian infrastructure, including health facilities, were serious violations of international humanitarian law and may amount to war crimes.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·图尔克称调查结果“令人深感不安”，并表示快速支援部队（RSF）对包括医疗设施在内的民用基础设施的多次袭击严重违反了国际人道主义法，可能构成战争罪。

paras.en: The RSF has rejected the BBC's findings.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织拒绝了 BBC 的调查结果。

paras.en: The paramilitary group's health minister described the allegations as propaganda and a deliberate attempt by the national army and its allies to smear the RSF's reputation.
paras.zh: 该准军事组织的卫生部长将这些指控描述为国家军队及其盟友的宣传和蓄意抹黑无国界医生组织声誉的行为。

paras.en: Using sources who were on the ground in el-Fasher, the BBC has found details of at least 43 separate attacks on hospitals and healthcare sites from May 2024 to October 2025 - some hit multiple times.
paras.zh: BBC 通过法希尔现场的消息来源，发现了 2024 年 5 月至 2025 年 10 月期间至少 43 起针对医院和医疗场所的单独袭击的详细信息，其中一些袭击多次。

paras.en: Under international law it is illegal to attack health facilities or their staff during conflict.
paras.zh: 根据国际法，在冲突期间攻击医疗机构或其工作人员是非法的。

paras.en: The investigation also reveals the toll on medical workers in the western city. In the period from April 2023 to October 2025, the BBC's data shows 120 were injured, 55 killed and 10 forcibly "disappeared" or abducted.
paras.zh: 调查还揭示了西部城市医务人员的伤亡情况。 BBC的数据显示，2023年4月至2025年10月期间，有120人受伤、55人死亡、10人被迫“失踪”或被绑架。

paras.en: "The RSF [were] trying to evacuate the hospitals, to put them out of service because the health system is the cornerstone of any city or any state," says Dr Muhamed Suliman, a surgeon who was based in el-Fasher during the siege and spoke to the BBC.
paras.zh: “无国界医生组织试图疏散医院，让它们停止服务，因为卫生系统是任何城市或任何州的基石，”围困期间驻扎在法希尔的外科医生穆罕默德·苏利曼博士接受 BBC 采访时说。

paras.en: "The RSF started hitting these areas so citizens have no longer any way to stay there. It was intense. It was deliberate. It was planned."
paras.zh: “无国界医生组织开始袭击这些地区，因此公民没有办法再呆在那里。这很激烈。这是故意的。这是有计划的。”

paras.en: The investigation comes a year after the fall of el-Fasher, one of the most brutal chapters of the civil war which erupted in April 2023 between the RSF and Sudan's military.
paras.zh: 这项调查是在法希尔陷落一年后进行的，法希尔陷落是 2023 年 4 月无国界医生组织与苏丹军队之间爆发的内战中最残酷的一章。

paras.en: Both sides have been accused of attacks on health facilities.
paras.zh: 双方都被指控袭击卫生设施。

paras.en: In March 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) condemned the bombing of al-Daein hospital in RSF-held eastern Darfur, which killed dozens and forced the site to close. Sudan's military is believed to have carried out the drone strikes, although it has denied responsibility.
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月，世界卫生组织 (WHO) 谴责无国界医生组织控制的达尔富尔东部 al-Daein 医院发生的爆炸事件，该事件造成数十人死亡，并迫使该医院关闭。据信苏丹军方实施了无人机袭击，但苏丹军方否认对此负责。

paras.en: But events in el-Fasher represent "one of the clearest and most severe examples of the wider impact of the conflict on health care in Sudan," the WHO said in response to a BBC query.
paras.zh: 但世界卫生组织在回答英国广播公司的询问时表示，法希尔发生的事件是“冲突对苏丹医疗保健产生更广泛影响的最明显、最严重的例子之一”。

paras.en: UN investigators have reported that the fighting in el-Fasher bore the "hallmarks of genocide", where historical ethnic animosities have seen Arab militias - now the backbone of RSF forces - target non-Arab groups such as those that populate the city.
paras.zh: 联合国调查人员报告称，法希尔的战斗带有“种族灭绝的标志”，历史上的种族仇恨使得阿拉伯民兵——现在是无国界部队的骨干——以非阿拉伯群体为目标，比如居住在该市的群体。

paras.en: The BBC's investigation reveals for the first time a detailed chronology of attacks on healthcare during the long siege of the city.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司 (BBC) 的调查首次揭示了这座城市长期围困期间医疗保健遭受袭击的详细年表。

paras.en: Some medical facilities in el-Fasher closed down within weeks of the country's civil war starting in April 2023.
paras.zh: 2023 年 4 月该国内战开始后几周内，法希尔的一些医疗设施就关闭了。

paras.en: Crucially this included one of the main hospitals - the Teaching Hospital - located in a conflict zone in the middle of the city.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，其中包括位于市中心冲突地区的主要医院之一——教学医院。

paras.en: Its operations were moved to el-Fasher's South Hospital. There medical services continued, although increasingly hindered by power cuts and dwindling supplies.
paras.zh: 其业务转移至法希尔南部医院。尽管停电和供应减少日益阻碍医疗服务，但医疗服务仍在继续。

paras.en: The situation changed dramatically a year later, when the RSF mounted its siege of el-Fasher.
paras.zh: 一年后，当无国界医生组织围攻法希尔时，情况发生了巨大的变化。

paras.en: In late May and early June of 2024, the South Hospital was shelled several times as paramilitary fighters pushed forward from their positions in the east of the city.
paras.zh: 2024 年 5 月下旬和 6 月初，当准军事武装人员从城市东部的阵地推进时，南方医院遭到多次炮击。

paras.en: The first bombing came as a shock, says Dr Suliman.
paras.zh: 苏利曼博士说，第一次爆炸令人震惊。

paras.en: The area around the hospital that was hit was "very crowded because it was the only working hospital in the city providing surgical services", he says.
paras.zh: 他说，遭受袭击的医院周围地区“非常拥挤，因为它是该市唯一一家提供外科服务的仍在运营的医院”。

paras.en: On that day medical staff operated on 16 injured patients, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，当天医务人员为 16 名受伤患者进行了手术。

paras.en: The attacks culminated in an RSF raid on 8 June. Hospital staff were taken by surprise - many of them escaped over the back wall as the RSF fighters entered the building, says Dr Mustafa Ahmed, a pharmaceutical specialist.
paras.zh: 这些袭击在 6 月 8 日的无国界医生组织突袭中达到顶峰。制药专家穆斯塔法·艾哈迈德博士说，医院工作人员感到惊讶——当无国界医生组织战士进入大楼时，他们中的许多人从后墙逃走了。

paras.en: But the director general of the hospital, surgeon Izzeldin Ahmed Dawaud Asow, encountered a group of the paramilitaries outside his office.
paras.zh: 但医院院长、外科医生伊泽尔丁·艾哈迈德·达瓦德·阿索在他的办公室外遇到了一群准军事人员。

paras.en: They did not know he was a doctor, he said, but denounced him with ethnic slurs.
paras.zh: 他说，他们不知道他是一名医生，而是用种族诽谤来谴责他。

paras.en: "There are no citizens here. You are Falangi," they said, using a derogatory term implying that non-Arab Sudanese are foreigners.
paras.zh: “这里没有公民。你们是法兰吉人，”他们说，使用贬义词暗示非阿拉伯苏丹人是外国人。

paras.en: Dr Asow says he was beaten with rifle butts and lost consciousness at one point. Ultimately, he saved himself by pretending to be dead.
paras.zh: 阿索博士说，他被枪托殴打，一度失去知觉。最终，他通过装死救了自己。

paras.en: "They put their hand on my chest, and I stopped breathing. And they said: 'Leave him, leave him. The rubbish has died. Leave him.' They left me."
paras.zh: “他们把手放在我的胸口，我停止了呼吸。他们说：‘离开他，离开他。垃圾已经死了。离开他。’他们离开了我。”

paras.en: That same day the RSF was driven out by the Sudanese military and its allies and Dr Asow returned to find the bodies of several patients and the surgical equipment in his operating room thoroughly destroyed, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，同一天，无国界医生组织被苏丹军方及其盟友驱逐，阿索医生返回后发现几名患者的尸体和手术室里的手术设备被彻底毁坏。

paras.en: The hospital closed and later fell into RSF hands when the army retreated.
paras.zh: 医院关闭，后来在军队撤退时落入无国界医生组织手中。

paras.en: Dr Alaa Eldin Nugud, a prominent Sudanese surgeon who has joined the RSF-backed civilian government as health minister, insisted the South Hospital was being used as a military base.
paras.zh: 苏丹著名外科医生阿拉·埃尔丁·努古德 (Alaa Eldin Nugud) 博士已加入无国界医生组织支持的文职政府并担任卫生部长，他坚称南方医院被用作军事基地。

paras.en: According to international law, hospitals can lose their protection if they are used by a party to the conflict to commit an "act harmful to the enemy".
paras.zh: 根据国际法，如果冲突一方利用医院实施“对敌人有害的行为”，医院可能会失去保护。

paras.en: In an interview with the BBC, Dr Nugud declared that missile launchers were set up on the grounds and shared a video showing remains of weapons filmed more than a year after the hospital closed, which he said supported his claim.
paras.zh: 努古德博士在接受英国广播公司采访时宣称，现场设置了导弹发射器，并分享了一段视频，显示医院关闭一年多后拍摄的武器残骸，他说这支持了他的说法。

paras.en: He also showed us what he called maps of landmines planted around the Teaching Hospital, which is located next to Sudanese military headquarters.
paras.zh: 他还向我们展示了他所谓的教学医院周围埋设地雷的地图，该医院位于苏丹军事总部旁边。

paras.en: Doctors told us the hospital was not incorporated into the base and said they visited it to pick up medical equipment during the war.
paras.zh: 医生告诉我们，该医院并未并入该基地，并表示他们在战争期间前往该医院领取医疗设备。

paras.en: The BBC has found no independent evidence of Dr Nugud's allegations. And the government of the Darfur region categorically rejected the charges.
paras.zh: BBC 尚未发现 Nugud 博士指控的独立证据。达尔富尔地区政府断然否认了这些指控。

paras.en: After the South Hospital shut, its staff and remaining equipment were moved to the Saudi Maternity Hospital in the west of the city, where the army had its main bases.
paras.zh: 南方医院关闭后，其工作人员和剩余设备被转移到该市西部的沙特妇产医院，那里是军队的主要基地。

paras.en: Within days the pace of attacks on the facility picked up. At this stage the medical charity MÃ©decins Sans FrontiÃ¨res (MSF) sounded the alarm.
paras.zh: 几天之内，对该设施的攻击速度就加快了。在这个阶段，医疗慈善机构无国界医生组织（MSF）敲响了警钟。

paras.en: "We do not know if hospitals are being intentionally targeted, butâ¦ the belligerents are not taking any precautions to spare them," it said in a statement.
paras.zh: “我们不知道医院是否是故意攻击的目标，但是……交战方没有采取任何预防措施来保护他们，”该组织在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: However, in the course of our investigation we spoke to six doctors who described a pattern of systematic targeting.
paras.zh: 然而，在我们的调查过程中，我们采访了六位医生，他们描述了一种系统瞄准的模式。

paras.en: They told us how Saudi Hospital was repeatedly struck - on some days up to 25 times, with a mix of shelling and drones, the latter "intelligent rockets" with precision-guided attacks.
paras.zh: 他们告诉我们沙特医院是如何屡次遭到袭击的——有时袭击次数高达 25 次，其中包括炮击和无人机，后者是具有精确制导攻击的“智能火箭”。

paras.en: Smaller medical facilities also came under fire. The BBC's timeline records the steady closure of private hospitals and neighbourhood clinics.
paras.zh: 较小的医疗设施也受到攻击。 BBC 的时间表记录了私立医院和社区诊所的逐步关闭。

paras.en: Furthermore, when some of these healthcare buildings shifted locations, the alternate venues were also attacked.
paras.zh: 此外，当其中一些医疗建筑转移位置时，替代地点也遭到攻击。

paras.en: The Specialised Children's Hospital, which shut down at the beginning of the war along with the Teaching Hospital, moved to two other locations, both of which were then shelled and forced to close.
paras.zh: 特殊儿童医院在战争开始时与教学医院一起关闭，后来搬到了另外两个地点，随后两个地点都遭到炮击并被迫关闭。

paras.en: Similarly, the main dialysis centre was struck and then attacked again after it relocated.
paras.zh: 同样，主要的透析中心也遭到袭击，搬迁后又再次遭到袭击。

paras.en: By the time the RSF seized the city in October 2025, the Saudi Hospital was the only functioning health facility left.
paras.zh: 当无国界医生组织于 2025 年 10 月占领这座城市时，沙特医院是唯一剩下的仍在运作的医疗机构。

paras.en: The medical staff there had rallied to try to keep working as conditions worsened.
paras.zh: 随着情况恶化，那里的医务人员团结起来，试图继续工作。

paras.en: Doctors described how sandbags were set up to protect the building.
paras.zh: 医生描述了如何设置沙袋来保护建筑物。

paras.en: They built underground bunkers out of steel containers and established a number of alternative sites to house and receive patients and conduct surgery as the threat of attacks and the damage to the main structure steadily increased.
paras.zh: 随着袭击威胁和主体结构损坏的不断增加，他们用钢制集装箱建造了地下掩体，并建立了许多替代场所来容纳和接收病人并进行手术。

paras.en: Dr Asow said this makeshift surgery was attacked five times in 2025.
paras.zh: Asow 博士表示，这个临时手术在 2025 年遭到了五次攻击。

paras.en: In one case, he says, he was operating on a patient's neck when the building was shaken by an explosion - the medical staff ran out in fear, but he stayed.
paras.zh: 他说，有一次，他正在给一名病人的脖子做手术，大楼因爆炸而摇晃，医护人员惊慌失措地跑了出去，但他留下来了。

paras.en: In another case, health workers had prepared the theatre for an operation, but he told them to move the patient elsewhere because it needed a deep clean given the relentless case load. Shortly afterward the room was destroyed by shells - and the patient survived.
paras.zh: 在另一个案例中，卫生工作者已为手术室做好了手术准备，但他告诉他们将患者转移到其他地方，因为鉴于病例数量不断增加，需要进行深度清洁。不久之后，房间被炮弹摧毁——病人幸存下来。

paras.en: "From that day, some of my staff called me 'Mr Deep Cleaning' because they think that the issue of deep cleaning saved that patient," he said.
paras.zh: “从那天起，我的一些员工就叫我‘深度清洁先生’，因为他们认为深度清洁的问题拯救了那个病人，”他说。

paras.en: Dr Asow also describes how drones tracked the movement of patients.
paras.zh: 阿索博士还描述了无人机如何跟踪患者的活动。

paras.en: On 15 March 2025, people carrying the injured from the site of an attack to one of the temporary wards were followed by a hunting drone, he says.
paras.zh: 他说，2025 年 3 月 15 日，人们将伤者从袭击现场抬到临时病房，一架狩猎无人机尾随其后。

paras.en: It struck as they reached the gate of the building, killing nine people.
paras.zh: 当他们到达大楼门口时，爆炸袭击了九人。

paras.en: On 17 August of the same year a donkey cart was transferring patients to the alternative operating theatre because all the ambulances had been destroyed, Dr Asow told the BBC.
paras.zh: 阿索医生告诉 BBC，同年 8 月 17 日，一辆驴车将病人转移到替代手术室，因为所有救护车都被毁坏了。

paras.en: It was hit by a drone, killing two patients, the driver and the donkey, he says.
paras.zh: 他说，它被一架无人机击中，导致两名患者死亡，其中包括司机和驴子。

paras.en: The RSF health minister dismissed these accounts as "a continuation of lies" by the military (SAF) and their local allies, known as the Joint Forces.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织卫生部长驳斥了这些说法，称其为军方（新加坡武装部队）及其当地盟友（称为联合部队）的“谎言的延续”。

paras.en: "Even the medics, and many of the people who were there, because of this conflict, these tribal issues, these racial issues, they are allied with the Joint Forces and with the SAF. That's why you don't depend on that narrative," he said.
paras.zh: “即使是医务人员，以及那里的许多人，由于这场冲突、这些部落问题、这些种族问题，他们也与联合部队和新加坡武装部队结盟。这就是为什么你不依赖这种说法，”他说。

paras.en: Doctors told the BBC they believed RSF fighters deliberately targeted medical facilities because army or allied fighters were among their patients.
paras.zh: 医生告诉英国广播公司，他们相信无国界医生组织战士故意以医疗设施为目标，因为他们的病人中有军队或盟军战士。

paras.en: The onslaught of shelling and bombing culminated on 25 October 2025 with the RSF storming the hospital amid allegations of a massacre that killed more than 460 patients and their companions.
paras.zh: 炮击和轰炸的袭击在 2025 年 10 月 25 日达到顶峰，无国界医生组织袭击了医院，据称发生了一场屠杀，造成 460 多名患者及其同伴死亡。

paras.en: The RSF has denied a massacre occurred, although the WHO condemned the reported killings and satellite imagery appeared to show clusters of bodies on the blood-soaked grounds of the hospital.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织否认发生了大屠杀，尽管世界卫生组织谴责了所报道的杀戮事件，而且卫星图像似乎显示医院血淋淋的场地上有成群的尸体。

paras.en: The BBC shared details of its investigation with the UN human rights chief, who said our findings were "deeply disturbing", and consistent with the analysis of his office.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司与联合国人权事务负责人分享了调查细节，后者表示我们的调查结果“令人深感不安”，并且与他办公室的分析一致。

paras.en: "Our monitoring and documentation shows the RSF repeatedly struck el-Fasher's main hospitals and makeshift health facilities, destroying or seriously damaging them and severely impacting access to health services for thousands of civilians trapped in the city," TÃ¼rk said.
paras.zh: 图尔克说：“我们的监测和记录显示，无国界医生组织多次袭击法希尔的主要医院和临时医疗设施，摧毁或严重损坏它们，并严重影响了该市数千名被困平民获得医疗服务的机会。”

paras.en: Healthcare in el-Fasher is now being run by the RSF-backed government. It has released several videos showing the Saudi Hospital and the Teaching Hospital re-opened, cleaned up and seeing some patients.
paras.zh: 法希尔的医疗保健目前由无国界医生组织支持的政府负责管理。它发布了多段视频，显示沙特医院和教学医院重新开放、进行清理并接诊一些病人。

paras.en: Dr Nugud says South Hospital is also set to reopen. He denied that doctors were forcibly abducted, telling the BBC that instead they had chosen to stay on to work.
paras.zh: 努古德博士说，南方医院也将重新开放。他否认医生被强迫绑架，并告诉 BBC，他们选择继续工作。

paras.en: "I have a video in front of the children's hospital when we freed a consultant, a doctor and six of the medical staff who were working with the SAF, and then when el-Fasher got liberated, there was a forgiveness for all of them.
paras.zh: “我在儿童医院门前放了一段视频，当时我们释放了一名顾问、一名医生和六名与苏丹武装部队一起工作的医务人员，然后当法希尔获释时，他们所有人都得到了宽恕。

paras.en: The BBC spoke to one of the doctors in the video, Dr Al-Haj Mohamed Ahmed. He told us he had no choice: "I was forced to be there.
paras.zh: BBC 采访了视频中的一位医生 Al-Haj Mohamed Ahmed 博士。他告诉我们他别无选择：“我被迫去那里。

paras.en: "If I spoke out of line, they'd put a bullet through my head."
paras.zh: “如果我说话越界，他们就会用子弹射穿我的头。”

paras.en: He was among several medical workers captured while trying to escape the city and sent back, along with Dr Mustafa Ahmed.
paras.zh: 他是几名在试图逃离这座城市时被抓获并与穆斯塔法·艾哈迈德医生一起被送回的医务人员之一。

paras.en: They distinguished themselves by bringing a cholera epidemic in a temporary prison at the paediatric hospital under control and were subsequently taken to Saudi Hospital.
paras.zh: 他们因控制了儿科医院临时监狱的霍乱疫情而出名，随后被送往沙特医院。

paras.en: "They started to say that you are the people of the city, and we take the city, so we need to work together for the sake of the city," says Dr Mustafa Ahmed, who describes waking up several mornings in a row at the prison to find 50 inmates dead of cholera.
paras.zh: “他们开始说，你们是这座城市的人民，我们占领了这座城市，所以我们需要为了这座城市而共同努力，”穆斯塔法·艾哈迈德博士说，他描述了连续几个早上在监狱醒来时发现 50 名囚犯死于霍乱的情况。

paras.en: A year on from the fall of el-Fasher, the trauma of this dark period in Sudan's civil war is still painfully sharp.
paras.zh: 法希尔陷落一年后，苏丹内战这段黑暗时期的创伤仍然令人痛苦。

paras.en: The front lines have shifted elsewhere with no signs of a resolution to the conflict. And attacks on healthcare continue as part of a wider and devastating humanitarian crisis.
paras.zh: 前线已转移到其他地方，但冲突没有解决的迹象。作为更广泛和毁灭性人道主义危机的一部分，对医疗保健的袭击仍在继续。

paras.en: Maps and graphics by Miguel Roca-Terry, Jake Friend and Matt Mitchell-Camp
paras.zh: 地图和图形由 Miguel Roca-Terry、Jake Friend 和 Matt Mitchell-Camp 制作

articles.title: Surveillance and 'constant paranoia': Western diplomats tell BBC of life in war-time Moscow

paras.en: "Being the ambassador to Russia was probably the hardest assignment of my career," Lynne Tracy, who represented the US in Moscow from 2023 and 2025, tells the BBC.
paras.zh: “担任驻俄罗斯大使可能是我职业生涯中最艰巨的任务，”2023 年至 2025 年在莫斯科代表美国的林恩·特雷西 (Lynne Tracy) 告诉 BBC。

paras.en: US, UK and European diplomats once played a crucial role in Russia, defusing tensions even at the worst moments of the Cold War.
paras.zh: 美国、英国和欧洲外交官曾在俄罗斯发挥了至关重要的作用，甚至在冷战最糟糕的时刻也化解了紧张局势。
