Laser phase plate improves structure determination of small proteins by cryo-EM. Science, 2026; 393 (6807): 195 DOI: 10.1126/science.aeh0665
paras.zh: - Petar N. Petrov、Jessie T. 张、Jonathan Remis、Jeremy J. Axelrod、Hang Cheng、Eric S. Cooper、Ian K. Hicklin、Shahar Sandhaus、Cooper Schnurr、Robert M. Glaeser、Holger Müller。激光相位板改进了冷冻电镜对小蛋白质的结构测定。科学，2026； 393 (6807): 195 DOI: 10.1126/science.aeh0665

articles.title: Oxford scientists discover how viruses build themselves without a blueprint

paras.en: Oxford scientists discover how viruses build themselves without a blueprint
paras.zh: 牛津大学科学家发现病毒如何在没有蓝图的情况下自我构建

paras.en: - Scientists have captured virus-like particles assembling themselves step by step, revealing how a surprisingly simple process of trial and error produces complex structures with remarkable precision. The discovery uncovers a crucial molecular turning point that speeds up assembly and could lead to new ways to disrupt viruses and develop vaccines.
paras.zh: - 科学家们捕获了病毒样颗粒逐步组装的过程，揭示了如何通过极其简单的试错过程产生具有非凡精度的复杂结构。这一发现揭示了一个关键的分子转折点，可以加速组装，并可能带来破坏病毒和开发疫苗的新方法。

paras.en: Researchers at the University of Oxford have observed virus-like particles assembling themselves one molecule at a time, uncovering the surprisingly simple rules that allow complex biological structures to form with remarkable reliability. The findings, published in Nature, offer a detailed look at a process that scientists have struggled to observe directly for decades.
paras.zh: 牛津大学的研究人员观察到病毒样颗粒一次组装一个分子，发现了令人惊讶的简单规则，这些规则允许复杂的生物结构以惊人的可靠性形成。这项研究结果发表在《自然》杂志上，详细介绍了科学家几十年来一直努力直接观察的过程。

paras.en: Understanding how viruses construct their protective protein shells, and how that construction might be interrupted, could lead to new antiviral drugs, improved vaccines, and other medical treatments. The discovery helps explain how individual proteins consistently organize themselves into the correct structures despite having thousands of possible ways to connect.
paras.zh: 了解病毒如何构建其保护性蛋白质外壳，以及如何中断这种构建，可能会带来新的抗病毒药物、改进的疫苗和其他医学治疗方法。这一发现有助于解释单个蛋白质如何始终如一地将自己组织成正确的结构，尽管有数千种可能的连接方式。

paras.en: The researchers found that viral assembly resembles navigating a complicated maze, where only certain paths lead to lasting progress. At first, protein components form weak connections that can easily break apart if the arrangement is unsuccessful. This flexibility allows the molecules to keep trying different combinations until they form particular closed structures. Once multiple connections hold these structures together, they become far more stable.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，病毒组装就像在复杂的迷宫中航行，只有特定的路径才能带来持久的进展。起初，蛋白质成分形成弱连接，如果排列不成功，这些连接很容易断裂。这种灵活性允许分子不断尝试不同的组合，直到形成特定的封闭结构。一旦多个连接将这些结构结合在一起，它们就会变得更加稳定。

paras.en: These stable arrangements serve as molecular checkpoints, narrowing the enormous number of possible assembly routes into a much smaller set of successful pathways. One especially important milestone occurs when five larger protein building blocks connect to form a closed pentagonal ring. This is the first highly stable structure in the assembly process. Once it forms, each subsequent stable stage requires fewer additional building blocks, allowing the particle to grow more quickly.
paras.zh: 这些稳定的排列充当分子检查点，将大量可能的组装路线缩小为一组小得多的成功途径。当五个较大的蛋白质构建块连接形成闭合的五边形环时，就会出现一个特别重要的里程碑。这是组装过程中第一个高度稳定的结构。一旦形成，随后的每个稳定阶段都需要更少的额外构建块，从而使粒子能够更快地生长。

paras.en: Co-lead author Dr. Roi Asor (Department of Chemistry and Kavli Institute for Nanoscience Discovery, University of Oxford) explained: "A virus has to solve an extraordinary construction problem. Its components somehow have to find the right arrangement among a huge number of possibilities, without a blueprint or machinery directing the process. We can now watch what happens molecule by molecule and see the physical rules that make it possible."
paras.zh: 共同主要作者 Roi Asor 博士（牛津大学化学系和卡维利纳米科学研究所）解释说：“病毒必须解决一个非凡的构造问题。它的组件必须以某种方式在大量可能性中找到正确的排列，而无需蓝图或机器指导该过程。我们现在可以逐个分子地观察发生的情况，并了解使其成为可能的物理规则。”

paras.en: Watching Virus Particles Assemble Molecule by Molecule
paras.zh: 观察病毒颗粒逐个分子地组装

paras.en: Viruses store and protect their genetic material within organized protein shells known as capsids. Depending on the virus, these shells may consist of tens or even thousands of individual protein components. Remarkably, in many cases, the proteins can arrange themselves into the correct structure without any external machinery directing their assembly.
paras.zh: 病毒在称为衣壳的有组织的蛋白质壳内储存和保护其遗传物质。根据病毒的不同，这些外壳可能由数十甚至数千个单独的蛋白质成分组成。值得注意的是，在许多情况下，蛋白质可以将自己排列成正确的结构，而不需要任何外部机器指导它们的组装。

paras.en: Although scientists have investigated viral self-assembly for decades, capturing the process as it unfolds has been a major challenge. Many of the intermediate structures exist only briefly and appear in very small quantities. As a result, traditional methods have generally allowed researchers to examine the starting materials and finished particles without clearly showing how one transforms into the other.
paras.zh: 尽管科学家们对病毒自组装的研究已有数十年，但捕捉其展开的过程一直是一项重大挑战。许多中间结构仅短暂存在并且出现的数量非常少。因此，传统方法通常允许研究人员检查起始材料和成品颗粒，而无法清楚地显示一种材料如何转变为另一种材料。

paras.en: To overcome this limitation, the Oxford researchers studied an engineered virus-like particle composed of 60 protein units. They used mass photometry, a technique developed at Oxford that determines the mass of individual molecules by measuring the light they scatter. By combining this technology with a new approach for keeping individual molecules confined and continuously observable, the team could repeatedly measure the mass of a growing particle as additional proteins attached.
paras.zh: 为了克服这一限制，牛津大学的研究人员研究了一种由 60 个蛋白质单元组成的工程病毒样颗粒。他们使用了质量光度测定法，这是牛津大学开发的一种技术，通过测量单个分子散射的光来确定单个分子的质量。通过将这项技术与一种限制单个分子并连续观察的新方法相结合，研究小组可以重复测量附着有额外蛋白质的生长颗粒的质量。

paras.en: This approach allowed the scientists to follow the construction process as it happened, effectively tracking the addition of individual molecular building blocks over time.
paras.zh: 这种方法使科学家能够实时跟踪构建过程，有效地跟踪各个分子构建块随时间的添加情况。

paras.en: Co-first author PhD student Dan Loewenthal (Department of Chemistry and Kavli Institute for Nanoscience Discovery, University of Oxford) said: "This method lets us study the assembly process directly, we just take a video!"
paras.zh: 共同第一作者博士生 Dan Loewenthal（牛津大学化学系和 Kavli 纳米科学研究所）说：“这种方法让我们可以直接研究组装过程，我们只需拍摄视频！”

paras.en: Co-lead author Professor Philipp Kukura (Department of Chemistry and Kavli Institute for Nanoscience Discovery, Oxford University) said: "Until now, much of our understanding of how these structures assemble has had to be reconstructed from snapshots or theoretical models. Being able to both quantify the underlying interactions and follow one particle as it grows changes that. We can see the important intermediate structures appear and deduce a detailed model of the construction process."
paras.zh: 共同第一作者、牛津大学化学系和卡维利纳米科学研究所教授 Philipp Kukura 表示：“到目前为止，我们对这些结构如何组装的大部分理解都必须通过快照或理论模型来重建。能够量化潜在的相互作用并跟踪一个粒子的生长会改变这种情况。我们可以看到重要的中间结构的出现，并推断出构建过程的详细模型。”

paras.en: The Surprising Trick That Makes Viral Assembly Work
paras.zh: 使病毒组装发挥作用的惊人技巧

paras.en: The results help explain how a process involving an overwhelming number of possible molecular arrangements can consistently produce the correct structure. Rather than exploring every possible route, the proteins progress through a relatively small number of stable intermediate stages that guide assembly toward completion.
paras.zh: 结果有助于解释涉及大量可能的分子排列的过程如何能够一致地产生正确的结构。蛋白质并没有探索每一种可能的途径，而是通过相对较少的稳定中间阶段来引导组装完成。

paras.en: The findings also clarify why the earliest stage of construction, called nucleation, is particularly difficult and why growth becomes substantially faster after the first stable structure appears.
paras.zh: 研究结果还阐明了为什么构建的最早阶段（称为成核）特别困难，以及为什么在第一个稳定结构出现后生长速度大大加快。

paras.en: A key part of this efficiency comes from the ability of protein building blocks to make mistakes without permanently disrupting the process. Weak initial connections allow incorrect combinations to separate, giving the proteins another opportunity to find a better arrangement. When enough components eventually connect in the correct closed configuration, the resulting structure becomes stable enough to support further growth.
paras.zh: 这种效率的一个关键部分来自蛋白质构建模块犯错误而不永久破坏过程的能力。较弱的初始连接会导致错误的组合分离，从而为蛋白质提供了另一个找到更好排列的机会。当足够的组件最终以正确的闭合配置连接时，所得结构变得足够稳定以支持进一步的增长。

paras.en: Dr. Asor added: "The weak interactions give the system room to make mistakes. Most encounters don't have to be successful: the components can separate and try again. But once enough of them come together in the right closed arrangement, the structure becomes stable, and assembly can move forward. That combination of trial and error followed by locking in successful structures is what makes the process so reliable."
paras.zh: 阿索尔博士补充道：“弱相互作用给系统提供了犯错的空间。大多数遭遇不一定会成功：组件可以分离并重试。但是，一旦足够多的组件以正确的封闭排列组合在一起，结构就会变得稳定，组装就可以继续进行。尝试和错误的结合，然后锁定成功的结构，使得这个过程如此可靠。”

paras.en: New Possibilities for Antiviral Drugs and Vaccines
paras.zh: 抗病毒药物和疫苗的新可能性

paras.en: By identifying the molecular interactions that control viral assembly, scientists may eventually be able to develop treatments that interfere with the construction of viral protein shells. The same insights could also support efforts to engineer virus-like particles for vaccines and other therapeutic applications.
paras.zh: 通过识别控制病毒组装的分子相互作用，科学家最终可能能够开发出干扰病毒蛋白壳构建的治疗方法。同样的见解也可以支持为疫苗和其他治疗应用设计病毒样颗粒的努力。

paras.en: Co-author Dr. Jack Tan (MRC Weatherall Institute of Molecular Medicine and CAMS-Oxford Institute) noted: "The ability to understand these processes at the molecular level could have important applications in vaccine development and antivirals that disrupt viral assembly."
paras.zh: 合著者 Jack Tan 博士（MRC Weatherall 分子医学研究所和 CAMS-牛津研究所）指出：“在分子水平上理解这些过程的能力可能在疫苗开发和破坏病毒组装的抗病毒药物中具有重要的应用。”

paras.en: The implications may extend far beyond viruses. Self-assembly is essential throughout biology, helping create everything from the internal skeletons of cells to specialized molecular compartments and large protein complexes.
paras.zh: 其影响可能远远超出病毒范围。自组装在整个生物学中至关重要，有助于创造从细胞内骨架到专门的分子区室和大型蛋白质复合物的一切。

paras.en: By making it possible to observe these intricate construction processes one molecule at a time, the Oxford team's approach offers researchers a powerful new way to investigate how complex biological structures emerge from relatively simple interactions.
paras.zh: 通过一次观察一个分子的这些复杂的构建过程，牛津大学团队的方法为研究人员提供了一种强大的新方法来研究复杂的生物结构如何从相对简单的相互作用中产生。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Oxford. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由牛津大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Roi Asor, Dan Loewenthal, Diana Melnyk, Tiong Kit Tan, Philipp Kukura. Molecular-level observation of the self-assembly of a virus-like particle. Nature, 2026; 657 (8132): 653 DOI: 10.1038/s41586-026-10948-z
paras.zh: - Roi Asor、Dan Loewenthal、Diana Melnyk、Tiong Kit Tan、Philipp Kukura。病毒样颗粒自组装的分子水平观察。自然，2026； 657 (8132): 653 DOI: 10.1038/s41586-026-10948-z

articles.title: Birds are more afraid of women than men. Scientists have no idea why

paras.en: Birds are more afraid of women than men. Scientists have no idea why
paras.zh: 鸟类比男性更害怕女性。科学家们不知道为什么

paras.en: - Scientists have uncovered a strange pattern in urban bird behavior: Across five European countries and 37 species, birds consistently fled sooner when approached by women than men. Researchers have no clear explanation for the difference, raising intriguing questions about how birds recognize and respond to humans.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了城市鸟类行为的一种奇怪模式：在五个欧洲国家和 37 个物种中，鸟类在女性接近时总是比男性更早逃跑。研究人员对这种差异没有明确的解释，这引发了关于鸟类如何识别人类并对人类做出反应的有趣问题。

paras.en: Birds living in cities appear to react differently to men and women, and scientists are struggling to explain why. An international research team discovered that urban birds, including great tits, house sparrows, and blackbirds, tend to fly away sooner when approached by women than by men. The surprising behavior raises new questions about how birds perceive the people around them.
paras.zh: 生活在城市中的鸟类似乎对男性和女性的反应不同，科学家们正在努力解释其中的原因。一个国际研究小组发现，城市鸟类，包括大山雀、家麻雀和黑鸟，在女性接近时往往比男性更早飞走。这种令人惊讶的行为引发了关于鸟类如何感知周围人类的新问题。

paras.en: The study took place in five European countries, where male and female participants (matched for height and clothing) walked directly toward birds in city parks and other green spaces.
paras.zh: 这项研究在五个欧洲国家进行，男性和女性参与者（身高和服装相匹配）直接走向城市公园和其他绿地中的鸟类。

paras.en: On average, men were able to approach about one meter closer than women before the birds flew away. The researchers measured this response by recording how close a person could get before a bird took flight (termed flight initiation distance).
paras.zh: 平均而言，在鸟儿飞走之前，男性能够比女性靠近约一米。研究人员通过记录鸟类起飞前人可以接近的距离（称为飞行起始距离）来测量这种反应。

paras.en: Published in the British Ecological Society journal People and Nature, the findings showed the same pattern in Czechia, France, Germany, Poland, and Spain. The difference also appeared across all 37 bird species examined, including easily startled magpies and pigeons that typically allow people to approach much more closely.
paras.zh: 发表在英国生态学会期刊《人物与自然》上的研究结果在捷克、法国、德国、波兰和西班牙也显示出同样的模式。这种差异也出现在所有 37 种被检查的鸟类中，包括容易受惊的喜鹊和鸽子，它们通常可以让人们更近距离地接近。

paras.en: The researchers believe their findings indicate that city birds can distinguish between male and female humans. However, they have yet to determine which characteristics the birds recognize or why they appear more cautious around women.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，他们的发现表明城市鸟类可以区分男性和女性。然而，他们还没有确定这些鸟能识别哪些特征，或者为什么它们在女性面前显得更加谨慎。

paras.en: Professor Daniel Blumstein of the University of California, Los Angeles, who helped conduct the research, said the results were convincing despite the lack of an explanation.
paras.zh: 帮助进行这项研究的加州大学洛杉矶分校教授丹尼尔·布鲁姆斯坦表示，尽管缺乏解释，但结果还是令人信服的。

paras.en: "I fully believe our results, that urban birds react differently based on the sex of the person approaching them, but I can't explain them right now. We used bleeding-edge comparative analysis techniques that showed our findings were consistent across cities and species, but we simply don't have a conclusive explanation yet."
paras.zh: “我完全相信我们的结果，城市鸟类会根据接近它们的人的性别做出不同的反应，但我现在无法解释它们。我们使用了尖端的比较分析技术，表明我们的发现在不同城市和物种之间是一致的，但我们还没有一个结论性的解释。”

paras.en: Dr. Yanina Benedetti of the Czech University of Life Sciences Prague, another member of the research team, said the discovery challenged her expectations about how birds respond to human observers.
paras.zh: 研究小组的另一位成员、布拉格捷克生命科学大学的亚尼娜·贝内德蒂博士表示，这一发现挑战了她对鸟类如何对人类观察者做出反应的预期。

paras.en: "As a woman in the field, I was surprised that birds reacted to us differently. This study highlights how animals in cities 'see' humans, which has implications for urban ecology and equality in science. Many behavioral studies assume that a human observer is neutral, but this wasn't the case for urban birds in our study."
paras.zh: “作为一名该领域的女性，我很惊讶鸟类对我们的反应不同。这项研究强调了城市中的动物如何‘看到’人类，这对城市生态和科学平等具有影响。许多行为研究都假设人类观察者是中立的，但在我们的研究中，城市鸟类的情况并非如此。”

paras.en: Scientists have proposed several possible explanations for the difference. Birds might be responding to chemical signals such as pheromones, variations in body shape, or differences in how men and women walk. For now, however, these ideas remain speculative, and additional experiments will be needed to identify the actual cause.
paras.zh: 科学家们对这种差异提出了几种可能的解释。鸟类可能会对信息素、体形变化或男性和女性行走方式的差异等化学信号做出反应。然而，目前这些想法仍然是推测性的，需要进行更多的实验来确定真正的原因。

paras.en: Dr. Federico Morelli of the University of Turin, a co-author of the study, said the unanswered question is one of the discovery's most fascinating aspects.
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、都灵大学的费德里科·莫雷利博士表示，这个尚未解答的问题是这一发现最令人着迷的方面之一。

paras.en: "This is maybe the most interesting part of our study," said Dr. Federico Morelli from the University of Turin, a co-author of the study. "We have identified a phenomenon, but we really don't know why. However, what our results do highlight is the birds' sophisticated ability to evaluate their environment."
paras.zh: “这可能是我们研究中最有趣的部分，”该研究的合著者、都灵大学的费德里科·莫雷利博士说。 “我们发现了一种现象，但我们真的不知道为什么。然而，我们的结果确实强调了鸟类评估环境的复杂能力。”

paras.en: The findings suggest that urban birds may be sensitive to human characteristics that people themselves rarely notice. Identifying those signals could help researchers better understand how wildlife assesses potential threats in environments shared with humans.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，城市鸟类可能对人们自己很少注意到的人类特征很敏感。识别这些信号可以帮助研究人员更好地了解野生动物如何评估与人类共享的环境中的潜在威胁。

paras.en: Dr. Benedetti said: "Urban birds clearly react to subtle cues that humans do not easily notice. Follow-up studies could focus on individual factors such as movement patterns, scent cues, or physical traits, testing them separately rather than grouping them under observer sex. This approach would help identify the specific cues birds detect."
paras.zh: 贝内代蒂博士说：“城市鸟类对人类不易注意到的微妙线索有明显的反应。后续研究可以集中于个体因素，如运动模式、气味线索或身体特征，单独测试它们，而不是根据观察者性别将它们分组。这种方法将有助于识别鸟类检测到的特定线索。”

paras.en: More Research Is Needed to Explain the Bird Behavior
paras.zh: 需要更多的研究来解释鸟类的行为

paras.en: Although the investigation included 2,701 observations, the researchers emphasize that their findings are still preliminary. Further studies will be necessary to establish whether the difference between birds' responses to men and women consistently appears in other settings and populations.
paras.zh: 尽管调查包括 2,701 个观察结果，但研究人员强调他们的发现仍处于初步阶段。需要进一步的研究来确定鸟类对男性和女性的反应差异是否始终存在于其他环境和种群中。

paras.en: For now, the discovery points to an intriguing possibility: Birds sharing our cities may be paying attention to subtle differences between people that scientists have yet to fully understand.
paras.zh: 目前，这一发现指出了一个有趣的可能性：共享我们城市的鸟类可能正在关注科学家尚未完全理解的人与人之间的细微差异。

paras.en: Materials provided by British Ecological Society. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由英国生态学会提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Federico Morelli, Yanina Benedetti, Peter Mikula, Daniel T. Blumstein, Mario DÃaz, Alicia Page, Piotr Tryjanowski, Marta K. Nowak, Eva Vincze, GÃ¡bor L. LÃ¶vei. Sex matters: European urban birds flee approaching women sooner than approaching men. People and Nature, 2025; 8 (2): 316 DOI: 10.1002/pan3.70226
paras.zh: - Federico Morelli、Yanina Benedetti、Peter Mikula、Daniel T. Blumstein、Mario Díaz、Alicia Page、Piotr Tryjanowski、Marta K. Nowak、Eva Vincze、Gábor L. Lövei。性别很重要：欧洲城市鸟类在接近女性时比接近男性时更早逃离。人与自然，2025； 8 (2): 316 DOI: 10.1002/pan3.70226

articles.title: Next Mass Effect game cancelled as EA shuts down legendary sci-fi RPG studio BioWare
articles.author: Fran Ruiz

paras.en: The writing was on the wall, but the news still hit us like a truck yesterday. BioWare, the iconic RPG studio behind the Mass Effect and Dragon Age series, is no more. Development on the next Mass Effect has stopped, but EA might not be entirely done with the IP.
paras.zh: 这是不祥之兆，但昨天这个消息仍然像一辆卡车一样向我们袭来。 BioWare 是《质量效应》和《龙腾世纪》系列背后的标志性 RPG 工作室，现已不复存在。下一款《质量效应》的开发已经停止，但 EA 可能不会完全用这个 IP 来完成。

paras.en: Variety reported, backed by EA’s own statement and BioWare’s goodbye on socials, that EA is laying off 3% of its global workforce and closing down BioWare. The shift comes shortly after the company went fully private this summer, with Saudi Arabia and private equity acquiring it alongside all its studios and properties.
paras.zh: Variety 报道称，在 EA 自己的声明和 BioWare 告别社交的支持下，EA 将裁员 3% 的全球员工并关闭 BioWare。这一转变是在该公司今年夏天完全私有化后不久发生的，沙特阿拉伯和私募股权公司收购了它及其所有工作室和财产。

paras.en: A new Mass Effect game — meant to serve as a follow-up to the original trilogy — had been in development since the early 2020s, though progress was slow following severe downsizing after 2024’s Dragon Age: The Veilguard failed to meet EA’s expectations. According to Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier, only around 50 staff remained at the studio, which would’ve needed to go on a hiring spree to complete development of the massive sci-fi RPG.
paras.zh: 一款新的《质量效应》游戏——旨在作为原三部曲的后续游戏——自 2020 年代初以来一直在开发中，尽管在 2024 年的《龙腾世纪：面纱卫士》未能达到 EA 的预期后，由于规模大幅缩小，进展缓慢。据彭博社的杰森·施赖尔 (Jason Schreier) 报道，工作室只剩下大约 50 名员工，他们需要大举招聘才能完成这款大型科幻角色扮演游戏的开发。

paras.en: The first post-shutdown shocker arrived a bit later, with IGN exclusively revealing that Mass Effect isn't entirely dead, as the upcoming live-action TV show based on Mass Effect is still moving forward at Prime Video.
paras.zh: 停播后的第一个令人震惊的消息来得稍晚一些，IGN 独家透露，《质量效应》并未完全消亡，即将上映的基于《质量效应》的真人电视节目仍在 Prime Video 上播出。

paras.en: The series started active development at Amazon in late 2024, but it has yet to reach production status. Little is known about the story, but rumors point to it aiming to bridge the gap between the original trilogy and the now-cancelled new game. Despite closing the studio that created it, EA still owns the Mass Effect property.
paras.zh: 该系列于 2024 年底在亚马逊开始积极开发，但尚未达到生产状态。人们对这个故事知之甚少，但有传言称它旨在弥合原始三部曲和现已取消的新游戏之间的差距。尽管关闭了创建该游戏的工作室，EA 仍然拥有《质量效应》的财产。

paras.en: Variety’s report, which includes more comments from EA’s top brass about the present and future of the publisher, also contains updates on Marvel’s Iron Man (developed at Motive) and Star Wars Jedi 3 (Respawn Entertainment). Both are still coming, and the more surprising news comes in the shape of DICE and Respawn teaming up for a totally new project, believed to be Star Wars Battlefront 3 after days of strong rumors from a number of reputable sources.
paras.zh: Variety 的报告包括 EA 高层对发行商的现状和未来的更多评论，还包含漫威《钢铁侠》（由 Motive 开发）和《星球大战绝地 3》（Respawn Entertainment）的最新动态。两者都还在推出中，更令人惊讶的消息是 DICE 和 Respawn 联手打造一个全新项目，经过几天来自多个知名来源的强烈传言，据信该项目就是《星球大战：前线 3》。

paras.en: Elsewhere, ex-BioWare developers have teamed up at new studios like Archetype and Arcanaut. The former is preparing to ship Mass Effect-inspired action RPG Exodus in 2027, and the latter recently started work on Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic, with original Knights of the Old Republic (and Mass Effect) director Casey Hudson behind the wheel.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，前 BioWare 开发人员已经在 Archetype 和 Arcanaut 等新工作室合作。前者正准备在 2027 年推出受《质量效应》启发的动作角色扮演游戏《Exodus》，而后者最近开始制作《星球大战：旧共和国的命运》，由原《旧共和国武士》（和《质量效应》）导演 Casey Hudson 负责。

paras.en: Here’s hoping both studios, as well as the recently laid-off developers, can find success in an increasingly hostile industry.
paras.zh: 希望这两家工作室以及最近被解雇的开发商能够在日益充满敌意的行业中取得成功。

paras.en: Fran Ruiz is our resident Star Wars guy. His hunger for movies and TV series is only matched by his love for video games. He got a BA of English Studies, focusing on English Literature, from the University of Malaga, in Spain, as well as a Master's Degree in English Studies, Multilingual and Intercultural Communication. On top of writing features and other longform articles for Space.com since 2021, he is a frequent collaborator of VG247 and other gaming sites. He also serves as associate editor over at Star Wars News Net and its sister site, Movie News Net.
paras.zh: 弗兰·鲁伊斯是我们的星球大战常驻人员。他对电影和电视剧的渴望与他对电子游戏的热爱相匹配。他在西班牙马拉加大学获得英语研究学士学位，主修英国文学，以及英语研究、多语言和跨文化交流硕士学位。自 2021 年以来，他除了为 Space.com 撰写专题文章和其他长篇文章外，还经常与 VG247 和其他游戏网站合作。他还担任星球大战新闻网及其姊妹网站电影新闻网的副编辑。

articles.title: Australia's bizarre 'Spider Crater' seen from orbit | Space photo of the day for Oct. 22, 2026
articles.author: Chelsea Gohd

paras.en: From the dangerous Sydney funnel-web to the common huntsman, Australia is home to its fair share of spiders. It even has a crater shaped like one.
paras.zh: 从危险的悉尼漏斗网到常见的猎人，澳大利亚是蜘蛛的家园。它甚至还有一个形状像这样的火山口。

paras.en: One stretch of the vast Western Australia wilderness is imprinted with a curious crater, which likely formed after a meteor impact hundreds of millions of years ago. Geologists think the spider-like pattern in the crater's center was created when its floor rebounded following the initial impact, NASA has said.
paras.zh: 西澳大利亚广阔的荒野中，有一片留下了一个奇怪的陨石坑的印记，这个陨石坑很可能是在数亿年前的流星撞击后形成的。美国宇航局表示，地质学家认为陨石坑中心的蜘蛛状图案是在最初撞击后底部反弹时形成的。

paras.en: In the hundreds of millions of years since the initial impact, erosion has continued to carve this formation into its current, signature shape. Complete with "legs," the planetary imprint has earned its name Spider Crater.
paras.zh: 自最初撞击以来的数亿年里，侵蚀不断将这一地层雕刻成目前的标志性形状。这个带有“腿”的行星印记被称为“蜘蛛陨石坑”。

paras.en: This image shows the impact structure in its entirety, which stretches 8 by 7 miles (13 by 11 kilometers) in full, with the central "spider" piece measuring 2.5 miles (4 km).
paras.zh: 该图像显示了整个撞击结构，其全长 8 x 7 英里（13 x 11 公里），中央“蜘蛛”部分长 2.5 英里（4 公里）。

paras.en: In this image, we can see this "spider" from space. This snapshot shows the geologic feature as captured by the OLI (Operational Land Imager) aboard the Landsat 9 satellite, an Earth-observing craft that launched back in 2021.
paras.zh: 在这张图片中，我们可以从太空中看到这只“蜘蛛”。这张快照显示了 Landsat 9 卫星上的 OLI（操作陆地成像仪）捕获的地质特征，这是一颗于 2021 年发射的地球观测飞船。

paras.en: The satellite, a collaborative effort between NASA and the U.S. Geological Survey, is the ninth in the Landsat Earth-observing series, which goes all the way back to the launch of Landsat 1 in 1972. On a near-weekly basis, Landsat 9 delivers observations of everything from deforestation to water quality and crop growth.
paras.zh: 这颗卫星是 NASA 和美国地质调查局合作的成果，是 Landsat 地球观测系列中的第九颗卫星，该系列卫星的历史可以追溯到 1972 年 Landsat 1 号的发射。Landsat 9 几乎每周都会提供从森林砍伐到水质和农作物生长等各个方面的观测结果。

paras.en: The series of Landsat satellites have been a critical piece in the modern understanding of how our planet continues to change. Whether it's the repercussions of climate change or fluctuations in agriculture, observations from orbit do more than provide interesting photos of our home world; they also capture critical data.
paras.zh: Landsat 卫星系列是现代理解地球如何持续变化的关键部分。无论是气候变化的影响还是农业波动，轨道观测不仅仅提供我们家园的有趣照片；他们还捕获关键数据。

paras.en: Chelsea Gohd served as a Senior Writer for Space.com from 2018 to 2022 before returning in 2026, covering everything from climate change to planetary science and human spaceflight in both articles and on-camera in videos. With a M.S. in Biology, Chelsea has written and worked for institutions including NASA JPL, the American Museum of Natural History, Scientific American, Discover Magazine Blog, Astronomy Magazine, and Live Science. When not writing, editing or filming something space-y, Gohd is writing music and performing as Foxanne, even launching a song to space in 2021 with Inspiration4. You can follow her online @chelsea.gohd and @foxanne.music
paras.zh: Chelsea Gohd 于 2018 年至 2022 年担任 Space.com 的高级作家，并于 2026 年回归，在文章和视频中报道了从气候变化到行星科学和载人航天的所有内容。拥有硕士学位在生物学领域，Chelsea 曾为 NASA JPL、美国自然历史博物馆、《科学美国人》、Discover 杂志博客、天文学杂志和 Live Science 等机构撰写文章和工作。在创作、编辑或拍摄太空作品之余，Gohd 会创作音乐并以 Foxanne 的身份进行表演，甚至于 2021 年与 Inspiration4 一起向太空推出了一首歌曲。您可以在线关注她@chelsea.gohd 和@foxanne.music

articles.title: 'Cabin leak suspected': Artemis II astronaut reveals how a warning nearly derailed NASA's epic moon mission
articles.author: Daisy Dobrijevic

paras.en: TENERIFE, CANARY ISLANDS — NASA's Artemis II astronauts were just minutes away from a critical engine burn that would send them toward the moon when an unexpected cabin leak warning threatened to change the course of their historic mission.
paras.zh: 加那利群岛特内里费岛——美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯二号宇航员距离发动机严重烧毁只有几分钟的路程，这将使他们飞向月球，但意外的舱室泄漏警告可能会改变他们历史性任务的进程。

paras.en: "If it had happened five minutes later, we may not have been able to have that burn," Artemis II pilot Victor Glover revealed during an Oct. 18 discussion with Canadian former astronaut Chris Hadfield at the Starmus VIII festival here in Tenerife.
paras.zh: 10 月 18 日，阿耳忒弥斯二号飞行员维克多·格洛弗 (Victor Glover) 在特内里费岛举行的 Starmus VIII 节上与加拿大前宇航员克里斯·哈德菲尔德 (Chris Hadfield) 进行讨论时透露，“如果这件事发生在五分钟后，我们可能就无法实现这种燃烧。”

paras.en: The incident unfolded on April 2, the second day of the Artemis II mission, as the astronauts' Orion spacecraft swooped back toward Earth after traveling some 38,000 miles (61,000 kilometers) away. Orion had been completing a highly elliptical orbit around Earth, giving the crew and mission control an opportunity to test the capsule's systems before committing to the journey to the moon. Orion was now approaching its closest point to our planet, roughly 100 miles (160 km) above the surface, ahead of the crucial translunar injection (TLI) burn that would send the astronauts moonward.
paras.zh: 该事件发生在4月2日，即阿耳忒弥斯二号任务的第二天，当时宇航员乘坐的猎户座飞船在飞行约38,000英里（61,000公里）后飞回地球。猎户座已经完成了绕地球的高椭圆轨道，使机组人员和任务控制中心有机会在踏上月球之旅之前测试太空舱的系统。猎户座现在正在接近距我们星球最近的点，距离地表约 100 英里（160 公里），接下来将进行至关重要的跨月注入 (TLI) 燃烧，将宇航员送上月球。

paras.en: "Jeremy looks out the window and says, 'I think we're going to run smack dab into the middle of Earth,'" Glover recalled, referring to Artemis II mission specialist Jeremy Hansen of the Canadian Space Agency. "Because we were getting so low."
paras.zh: 格洛弗回忆道：“杰里米看着窗外说，‘我想我们会直接撞到地球中部’。”格洛弗指的是加拿大航天局的阿耳忒弥斯二号任务专家杰里米·汉森。 “因为我们的地位太低了。”

paras.en: The close approach brought additional challenges, as Orion passed through a region populated by orbital debris and satellites.
paras.zh: 当猎户座穿过充满轨道碎片和卫星的区域时，近距离接近带来了额外的挑战。

paras.en: "The density of things is going up from where we are, and also an increase in radiation," Glover explained.
paras.zh: 格洛弗解释说：“从我们所处的位置来看，物体的密度正在增加，辐射也在增加。”

paras.en: It was at this particularly demanding point in the mission that Orion issued a warning that indicated a possible cabin leak, around 15 minutes before the critical TLI burn.
paras.zh: 正是在任务中这个要求特别高的时刻，Orion 在 TLI 严重燃烧前大约 15 分钟发出了警告，表明机舱可能发生泄漏。

paras.en: "So, determining whether it was real or not was a big deal," Glover said.
paras.zh: “因此，确定它是否真实是一件大事，”格洛弗说。

paras.en: The crew and mission control faced a crucial question: Was it safe to continue heading to the moon, or would they have to abandon the planned maneuver and cut the mission very short? "Are we going to do a TLI and burn to go to the moon, or are we putting on our spacesuits to prepare to come back to Earth right now?" Glover recalled.
paras.zh: 机组人员和任务控制中心面临着一个关键问题：继续前往月球是否安全，或者他们是否必须放弃计划的机动并缩短任务时间？ “我们是要进行 TLI 并燃烧着去月球，还是立即穿上宇航服准备返回地球？”格洛弗回忆道。

paras.en: The timing was particularly critical. The TLI burn was designed to propel Orion out of Earth orbit and onto its trajectory around the moon, marking the first time astronauts had headed toward Earth's nearest neighbor since the Apollo era.
paras.zh: 时机尤为关键。 TLI 燃烧的目的是推动猎户座离开地球轨道并进入绕月轨道，这标志着自阿波罗时代以来宇航员首次飞向地球最近的邻居。

paras.en: Luckily, as NASA flight director Judd Frieling told us during an April 2 media briefing, the warning turned out to be a false alarm.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，正如 NASA 飞行总监贾德·弗里林 (Judd Frieling) 在 4 月 2 日的媒体吹风会上告诉我们的那样，这一警告最终证明是一场虚惊。

paras.en: So Artemis II received the go-ahead. Orion fired its main engine for approximately five minutes and 50 seconds, successfully setting the four astronauts on their journey around the moon.
paras.zh: 因此，阿尔忒弥斯二号获得了批准。猎户座发射了主发动机约 5 分 50 秒，成功让四名宇航员踏上了绕月之旅。

paras.en: "We're watching the timer count down, velocities go up, and the magenta and green numbers coming together," Glover recalled.
paras.zh: “我们看着计时器倒计时，速度上升，洋红色和绿色数字聚集在一起，”格洛弗回忆道。

paras.en: "Everything is tracking. It's looking good."
paras.zh: “一切都在追踪中。看起来不错。”

paras.en: Before long, the crew had broken free of Earth's gravitational hold and were hurtling toward the moon at around 24,500 mph (39,430 kph).
paras.zh: 不久之后，宇航员们就摆脱了地球的引力束缚，以大约 24,500 英里/小时（39,430 公里/小时）的速度冲向月球。

paras.en: Despite the tense moments before the burn, Artemis II went on to make history. NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman (the mission's commander), Glover (pilot) and Christina Koch (mission specialist), along with Hansen, traveled farther from Earth than any humans before them, reaching a maximum distance of 252,756 miles (406,771 km) during their journey around the moon.
paras.zh: 尽管燃烧前的时刻很紧张，但阿耳忒弥斯二号仍然创造了历史。美国宇航局宇航员里德·怀斯曼（任务指挥官）、格洛弗（飞行员）和克里斯蒂娜·科赫（任务专家）与汉森一起，比他们之前的任何人类都远离地球，在绕月之旅中达到了 252,756 英里（406,771 公里）的最大距离。

paras.en: The four astronauts returned safely to Earth on April 10, splashing down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego after nearly 10 days in space.
paras.zh: 四名宇航员在太空停留近 10 天后，于 4 月 10 日安全返回地球，并落入圣地亚哥海岸附近的太平洋。

paras.en: Daisy Dobrijevic joined Space.com in February 2022, having previously worked as a staff writer for All About Space magazine. She completed an editorial internship with BBC Sky at Night Magazine and worked at the National Space Centre, communicating space science to the public.
paras.zh: Daisy Dobrijevic 于 2022 年 2 月加入 Space.com，此前曾担任《All About Space》杂志的特约撰稿人。她完成了 BBC Sky 夜间杂志的编辑实习，并在国家航天中心工作，向公众传播空间科学。

paras.en: Daisy holds a PhD in plant physiology and a Master's in Environmental Science. Based in Nottingham, U.K., she covers all things space, with a special focus on solar activity and space weather. She also has a keen interest in astrotourism and is always on the lookout for the next northern lights adventure.
paras.zh: 黛西拥有植物生理学博士学位和环境科学硕士学位。她居住在英国诺丁汉，研究太空的所有事物，特别关注太阳活动和太空天气。她还对天文旅游有着浓厚的兴趣，并且总是在寻找下一次北极光冒险。

paras.en: She will join Hurtigruten as an onboard astronomer for a northern lights sailing in January 2027.
paras.zh: 她将作为船上天文学家加入海达路德号，于 2027 年 1 月进行北极光航行。

articles.title: How mini-constellations could more quickly bring new tech to Europe, and to orbit
articles.author: Space Inventor

paras.en: When the European thermal-imagery company constellr began working with Space Inventor on its next generation of satellites, some of the most important details of the spacecraft had yet to be finalized.
paras.zh: 当欧洲热成像公司 constellr 开始与 Space Inventor 合作开发下一代卫星时，航天器的一些最重要的细节尚未最终确定。

paras.en: The Munich-based firm knew it wanted its HiVE, or High-precision Versatile Ecosphere, constellation to measure temperatures from space with the precision needed for agricultural applications and urban planning. But the requirements for the payload’s size, weight and power were still evolving.
paras.zh: 这家总部位于慕尼黑的公司知道它希望其 HiVE（高精度多功能生态圈）星座能够以农业应用和城市规划所需的精度从太空测量温度。但对有效载荷的尺寸、重量和功率的要求仍在不断变化。

paras.en: That presented what can be a familiar tradeoff in the small satellite community. Work on satellite buses often begins before every detail of a payload has been finalized. If engineers lock in the spacecraft design too early, the payload may need to conform to the bus. If the payload needs new iterations, the bus may require an extensive – and expensive – redesign.
paras.zh: 这在小型卫星领域是一种常见的权衡。卫星总线的工作通常在有效载荷的每个细节最终确定之前就开始了。如果工程师过早锁定航天器设计，有效载荷可能需要符合总线。如果有效负载需要新的迭代，总线可能需要进行广泛且昂贵的重新设计。

paras.en: But Space Inventor, the Danish manufacturer, took a different approach. Instead of demanding the payload fit a standardized satellite bus, it adapted its BIG CAT 600 bus as constellr’s requirements evolved.
paras.zh: 但丹麦制造商 Space Inventor 采取了不同的方法。它没有要求有效载荷适合标准化卫星总线，而是随着 constellr 要求的变化而调整其 BIG CAT 600 总线。

paras.en: “We needed a platform built around the payload, not the other way around,” said Marius Bierdel, constellr’s co-founder and vice president of program management. “Space Inventor’s system-level approach means our thermal sensors perform exactly as designed once they’re in orbit.”
paras.zh: constellr 联合创始人兼项目管理副总裁 Marius Bierdel 表示：“我们需要一个围绕有效载荷构建的平台，而不是相反。” “Space Inventor 的系统级方法意味着我们的热传感器一旦进入轨道，就能完全按照设计运行。”

paras.en: That ability to repeatedly modify the spacecraft is the centerpiece of Space Inventor’s pitch to operators who need to build payload-centric mini-constellations. Unlike megaconstellations numbering in the hundreds or thousands, mini-constellations typically range from a few satellites to a few dozen and can target specific geographies or niche capabilities.
paras.zh: 反复修改航天器的能力是 Space Inventor 向需要建造以有效载荷为中心的迷你星座的运营商推销的核心内容。与数百或数千个巨型星座不同，迷你星座通常从几颗到几十颗卫星不等，可以针对特定的地理位置或利基功能。

paras.en: “These are high state-of-the-art payloads that often are still in development when we start building the bus,” said Jan Smolders, the chief commercial officer at Space Inventor. As one batch is being built, he said, Space Inventor is already applying lessons learned to the design of the next.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 首席商务官简·斯莫尔德斯 (Jan Smolders) 表示：“这些都是最先进的有效载荷，当我们开始建造巴士时，这些有效载荷通常仍在开发中。”他说，随着一批产品的制造，Space Inventor 已经将吸取的经验教训应用于下一批产品的设计中。

paras.en: “The standardization is in the satellite modules, not in the bus,” he added.
paras.zh: “标准化在于卫星模块，而不是总线，”他补充道。

paras.en: Mini-constellations occupy a middle ground in the satellite market.
paras.zh: 迷你星座在卫星市场中占据中间地位。

paras.en: Their smaller scale offers flexibility. Operators may want to incorporate lessons from the first satellites into later iterations. Or, as technology advances, they may want to upgrade the instruments.
paras.zh: 它们较小的规模提供了灵活性。运营商可能希望将第一批卫星的经验教训纳入以后的迭代中。或者，随着技术的进步，他们可能想要升级仪器。

paras.en: Space Inventor designed its BIG CAT family of services for exactly those moments.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 正是为了这些时刻而设计了 BIG CAT 系列服务。

paras.en: The BIG CAT 100, 300 and 600 platforms are sized for different spacecraft classes, but each is configurable rather than fixed. That means if a mission suddenly needs more power, improved pointing performance or a new communications capability, Space Inventor can often accommodate these changes by swapping out bus modules, rather than redesigning a spacecraft from scratch.
paras.zh: BIG CAT 100、300 和 600 平台的尺寸适合不同的航天器类别，但每个平台都是可配置的而不是固定的。这意味着，如果任务突然需要更多功率、改进的指向性能或新的通信能力，Space Inventor 通常可以通过更换总线模块来适应这些变化，而不是从头开始重新设计航天器。

paras.en: That philosophy of iteration is especially helpful in rapidly changing fields such as thermal imaging, space domain awareness and in-orbit servicing. It also means Space Inventor can avoid locking in a design around requirements developed years before launch.
paras.zh: 这种迭代理念对于快速变化的领域尤其有用，例如热成像、空间域感知和在轨服务。这也意味着 Space Inventor 可以避免围绕发射前几年制定的要求锁定设计。

paras.en: Space Inventor pairs its modular approach with another strategy: making most of its components itself.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 将其模块化方法与另一种策略相结合：自行制造大部分组件。

paras.en: The company manufactures nearly all of its components – with the exception of propulsion – in house at its factory in Aalborg, Denmark, offering more control over its design and less exposure to the volatility of the supply chain.
paras.zh: 该公司几乎所有部件（推进装置除外）均在其位于丹麦奥尔堡的工厂内部生产，从而对其设计提供了更多控制权，并减少了供应链波动的影响。

paras.en: If a new requirement calls for a modified PCB, Space Inventor can update the design, machine a revised housing, assemble the new component and test the change, all under the same roof. Such a change ordered from an outside supplier might take about six weeks. Space Inventor can make the same change in roughly one week, Smolders said.
paras.zh: 如果新要求需要修改 PCB，Space Inventor 可以更新设计、加工修改后的外壳、组装新组件并测试更改，所有这些都在同一屋檐下进行。从外部供应商处订购的此类变更可能需要大约六周的时间。斯莫尔德斯说，Space Inventor 可以在大约一周内做出同样的改变。

paras.en: “Because we make everything in house, we can easily add new modules to facilitate changing requirements, very fast,” he said.
paras.zh: “因为所有东西都是我们内部制造的，所以我们可以非常快速地轻松添加新模块，以适应不断变化的需求，”他说。

paras.en: This gives Space Inventor tighter quality control and reduces exposure to supply chain shortages.
paras.zh: 这使得 Space Inventor 能够进行更严格的质量控制，并减少供应链短缺的风险。

paras.en: Space Inventor also maintains a stock of its components, allowing it to offer next-day shipping. That reduces the risk that a small component or a supplier delay holds up the production of a spacecraft.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 还保留其组件库存，使其能够提供次日发货。这降低了因小部件或供应商延误而阻碍航天器生产的风险。

paras.en: For mini-constellation operators, this model makes it easier to change later satellites based on what they’ve learned from earlier ones.
paras.zh: 对于迷你星座运营商来说，这种模型可以更轻松地根据从早期卫星中学到的知识来更换后来的卫星。

paras.en: The same configurable approach that Space Inventor uses for commercial missions also underpins its offerings for the defense community.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 用于商业任务的相同可配置方法也支撑了其为国防界提供的产品。

paras.en: Rather than only offering military customers a satellite bus, the company can pair a BIG CAT platform with a mission-specific payload to provide a turnkey system.
paras.zh: 该公司不仅可以为军事客户提供卫星总线，还可以将 BIG CAT 平台与特定任务的有效载荷配对，以提供交钥匙系统。

paras.en: Space Inventor’s defense-specific Apex Predator series includes BC Lynx and BC Leopard, two turnkey surveillance solutions built on its BIG CAT platform.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 的国防专用 Apex Predator 系列包括 BC Lynx 和 BC Leopard，这是两种基于其 BIG CAT 平台构建的交钥匙监控解决方案。

paras.en: Lynx is designed to detect radio-frequency emissions, geolocate their source and identify activity that may warrant further investigation. Leopard can then be tasked with capturing high-resolution optical or thermal imagery in the same area.
paras.zh: Lynx 旨在检测射频发射、定位其来源并识别可能需要进一步调查的活动。然后 Leopard 的任务是在同一区域捕获高分辨率光学或热图像。

paras.en: The approach follows a “tip-and-cue” model, with one sensor identifying a potential target and then directing another sensor to collect more detailed information.
paras.zh: 该方法遵循“提示和提示”模型，其中一个传感器识别潜在目标，然后指示另一个传感器收集更详细的信息。

paras.en: The company has also developed a business case for detecting and investigating maritime activity in the heavily trafficked Baltic Sea, bordered by NATO members and Russia. There, Lynx satellites can identify anomalous RF emissions that could reveal dark vessels or help locate sources of GPS spoofing. It can then cue a Leopard satellite to collect additional intelligence.
paras.zh: 该公司还开发了一个商业案例，用于探测和调查与北约成员国和俄罗斯接壤的交通繁忙的波罗的海的海上活动。在那里，Lynx 卫星可以识别异常射频发射，从而揭示黑暗船只或帮助定位 GPS 欺骗源。然后它可以提示 Leopard 卫星收集更多情报。

paras.en: This space-based approach to surveillance, Smolders argues, offers a cost-effective complement to expensive drones and stealth aircraft that can only monitor a relatively contained area at once.
paras.zh: 斯莫尔德斯认为，这种基于太空的监视方法为昂贵的无人机和隐形飞机提供了一种经济有效的补充，因为这些飞机只能同时监视相对封闭的区域。

paras.en: “For the cost of one or two F-35s, you can actually get the intelligence to tell those planes where to go,” he said. “Affordable, proven ISR capability is ready to deploy in Europe today, with Space Inventor at the forefront of turning that capability into operational missions, but the decision-makers need to know about it.”
paras.zh: “只需花费一两架 F-35 的成本，你实际上就可以获得告诉这些飞机要去哪里的情报，”他说。 “如今，经济实惠、经过验证的 ISR 能力已准备好在欧洲部署，Space Inventor 处于将这种能力转化为作战任务的最前沿，但决策者需要了解这一点。”

articles.title: Agile Space Industries Expands to Seattle Area with New Bellevue Office
articles.author: Agile Space Industries

paras.en: BELLEVUE, Wash., Oct. 15, 2026 — Agile Space Industries, a leading provider of in-space chemical propulsion solutions, has expanded into the Seattle metropolitan area with the opening of a new office in Bellevue, Washington. The expansion builds on Agile’s continued growth, extending its engineering capabilities and strengthening its presence in one of the nation’s most established aerospace and technology markets.
paras.zh: 华盛顿州贝尔维尤，2026 年 10 月 15 日 — 领先的太空化学推进解决方案提供商 Agile Space Industries 已将业务扩展到西雅图大都市区，在华盛顿州贝尔维尤开设了新办事处。此次扩张建立在敏捷公司持续增长的基础上，扩大了其工程能力，并加强了其在美国最成熟的航空航天和技术市场之一的影响力。

paras.en: Located at Sunset North in Bellevue, the new 5,470-square-foot office will initially accommodate 7 employees, with the capacity to grow to approximately 30 as Agile expands its regional operations. Agile Chief Technology Officer Jake Mills will be based at the Bellevue office, reinforcing the company’s commitment to establishing a strong engineering and leadership presence in the region.
paras.zh: 位于贝尔维尤 Sunset North 的新办公室占地 5,470 平方英尺，最初可容纳 7 名员工，随着 Agile 扩大其区域业务，其容量将增至约 30 名员工。 Agile 首席技术官 Jake Mills 将常驻贝尔维尤办事处，强化公司在该地区建立强大的工程和领导力的承诺。

paras.en: “Seattle has a remarkable concentration of aerospace talent, innovative companies and organizations advancing the space industry,” said Jake Mills, chief technology officer at Agile Space Industries. “Establishing a presence here allows us to tap into that expertise, strengthen industry relationships and build on the capabilities we’re developing across Agile to support our customers and their missions.”
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 首席技术官杰克·米尔斯 (Jake Mills) 表示：“西雅图集中了航空航天人才、推动航天工业发展的创新公司和组织。” “在这里建立业务使我们能够利用这些专业知识，加强行业关系，并利用我们在敏捷开发中的能力来支持我们的客户及其使命。”

paras.en: The Bellevue office will focus on engineering and program management, supporting the development and delivery of advanced propulsion systems for government and commercial space missions. As the team grows, Agile expects to broaden its technical expertise and support an expanding range of propulsion programs.
paras.zh: 贝尔维尤办事处将专注于工程和项目管理，支持政府和商业太空任务的先进推进系统的开发和交付。随着团队的成长，Agile 希望扩大其技术专业知识并支持不断扩大的推进计划。

paras.en: Beyond its engineering talent, the Seattle region offers an established network of aerospace companies, industry partners and investors. Agile’s presence in this ecosystem creates opportunities to strengthen customer relationships, develop new partnerships and engage with the broader business and investment community as the company pursues its long-term growth objectives.
paras.zh: 除了工程人才之外，西雅图地区还拥有成熟的航空航天公司、行业合作伙伴和投资者网络。在公司追求其长期增长目标的过程中，敏捷在这个生态系统中的存在创造了加强客户关系、发展新的合作伙伴关系以及与更广泛的商业和投资社区互动的机会。

paras.en: The expansion also creates opportunities for experienced aerospace professionals looking to work on complex propulsion challenges in a collaborative, hands-on engineering environment. Agile’s teams contribute to programs spanning early development through qualified flight hardware, with the opportunity to help shape technologies supporting the next generation of space missions.
paras.zh: 此次扩建还为经验丰富的航空航天专业人士创造了机会，让他们能够在协作的实践工程环境中应对复杂的推进挑战。 Agile 的团队通过合格的飞行硬件为早期开发项目做出贡献，并有机会帮助塑造支持下一代太空任务的技术。

paras.en: The Bellevue office joins Agile’s headquarters in Durango, Colorado, and operations in Pennsylvania and Oklahoma. Together, these locations support Agile’s growing capabilities in propulsion design, manufacturing and testing, positioning the company to serve an expanding range of commercial and government space customers.
paras.zh: 贝尔维尤办事处与敏捷公司位于科罗拉多州杜兰戈的总部以及宾夕法尼亚州和俄克拉荷马州的业务部门一起成立。这些地点共同支持敏捷在推进设计、制造和测试方面不断增长的能力，使该公司能够为不断扩大的商业和政府航天客户提供服务。

paras.en: Agile Space Industries develops advanced chemical propulsion solutions that enable spacecraft to move, maneuver, and operate in space. From early concepts to qualified flight hardware, Agile brings together propulsion expertise, additive manufacturing, and in-house testing to rapidly solve complex challenges and accelerate development. Agile partners with leading aerospace companies and the U.S. Government on spacecraft and launch vehicle programs. Learn more at agilespaceindustries.com.
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 开发先进的化学推进解决方案，使航天器能够在太空中移动、机动和运行。从早期概念到合格的飞行硬件，敏捷汇集了推进专业知识、增材制造和内部测试，以快速解决复杂的挑战并加速开发。 Agile 与领先的航空航天公司和美国政府就航天器和运载火箭项目开展合作。请访问agilespaceindustries.com 了解更多信息。

articles.title: How NASA is thinking about a moon base
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss talks with NASA’s Shatel Bhakta, the principal systems engineer for Moon Base, about what’s needed between now and 2028 and the incremental steps to the future.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 NASA 月球基地首席系统工程师 Shatel Bhakta 讨论了从现在到 2028 年的需求以及未来的渐进步骤。

paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

articles.title: NASA to Conduct NCAA Flyover, Engage Fans at University of Alabama
articles.author: Lee Mohon

paras.en: As part of the agency’s Inspiration Tour, NASA will conduct a flyover at the University of Alabama vs. Texas A&M football game in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, on Saturday, Oct. 24. NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman will pilot one of three F-5 fighter jets during the flyover, highlighting NASA’s contributions to aeronautics and the agency’s continued commitment to advancing aviation technologies.
paras.zh: 作为该机构“灵感之旅”的一部分，NASA 将于 10 月 24 日星期六在阿拉巴马州塔斯卡卢萨举行的阿拉巴马大学对阵德克萨斯农工大学的橄榄球比赛中进行飞行表演。NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼将在飞行表演中驾驶三架 F-5 战斗机中的一架，强调 NASA 对航空业的贡献以及该机构对推进航空技术的持续承诺。

paras.en: Ahead of the game, members of the news media are invited to visit the NASA Experience Zone on Champions Lane, where Isaacman will participate in a media opportunity at 11 a.m. CDT. Media interested in attending should confirm their attendance by 12 p.m. Friday, Oct. 23, with Lance D. Davis at lance.d.davis@nasa.gov to receive additional details and instructions.
paras.zh: 比赛前，新闻媒体成员受邀参观位于 Champions Lane 的 NASA 体验区，艾萨克曼将在那里参加中部时间上午 11 点的媒体机会。有兴趣参加的媒体请在中午 12 点之前确认出席。 10 月 23 日星期五，通过 lance.d.davis@nasa.gov 与 Lance D. Davis 联系，获取更多详细信息和说明。

paras.en: Supported by NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, the NASA Experience Zone will be open to the public from 10:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. CDT, with no game ticket required. The experience will give visitors an opportunity to meet NASA team members and learn more about the people and technologies advancing the agency’s missions in aeronautics and space exploration.
paras.zh: 在位于阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔的 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心的支持下，NASA 体验区将于上午 10:30 至下午 2:30 向公众开放。 CDT，无需游戏票。此次体验将使参观者有机会与 NASA 团队成员见面，并更多地了解推动该机构航空和太空探索任务的人员和技术。

paras.en: Attendees can engage with NASA team members and explore exhibits highlighting the agency’s Artemis campaign and efforts to return astronauts to the Moon, including:
paras.zh: 与会者可以与 NASA 团队成员互动，并探索突出该机构阿耳忒弥斯计划和宇航员重返月球努力的展览，包括：

paras.en: - An inflatable SLS (Space Launch System) rocket.
paras.zh: - 充气式 SLS（太空发射系统）火箭。

paras.en: - Displays featuring the Starship and Blue Moon human landing systems.
paras.zh: - 展示星舰和蓝月亮人类登陆系统。

paras.en: - Information about NASA internship opportunities.
paras.zh: - 有关 NASA 实习机会的信息。

paras.en: - Photo opportunities featuring NASA exhibits and displays.
paras.zh: - 以 NASA 展览和展示为特色的拍照机会。

paras.en: With stops across the nation, NASA’s Inspiration Tour convenes academic, industry, and public sector stakeholders to connect the agency with the people, technologies, and organizations that drive American leadership in space.
paras.zh: NASA 的灵感之旅在全国各地停靠，聚集了学术界、工业界和公共部门的利益相关者，将该机构与推动美国在太空领域发挥领导作用的人员、技术和组织联系起来。

paras.en: The tour will culminate in MAX POWER, a public exposition of American air and space innovation, Saturday, Nov. 7, and Sunday, Nov. 8, on and near the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Held in honor of America’s historic 250th anniversary, the multi-day, family-friendly event will showcase the next-generation aircraft, spacecraft, autonomous vehicles, and technologies that will help define the future of transportation in air and space.
paras.zh: 此次巡演将在 MAX POWER 上达到高潮，这是一场美国航空航天创新的公开展览，将于 11 月 7 日星期六和 11 月 8 日星期日在该机构位于佛罗里达州的肯尼迪航天中心及其附近举行。为纪念美国历史性的 250 周年而举办的这项为期多天、适合家庭的活动将展示下一代飞机、航天器、自动驾驶汽车以及有助于定义航空和太空运输未来的技术。

paras.en: For more information about MAX POWER and the agency’s missions, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 MAX POWER 和该机构使命的更多信息，请访问：
